[GeneratedCode("Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Generators", "8.0.9.3103")]
[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
internal static class __LoggerMessageGenerator
{
	public static string Enumerate(IEnumerable? enumerable)
	{
		if (enumerable == null)
		{
			return "(null)";
		}
		StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
		stringBuilder.Append('[');
		bool flag = true;
		foreach (object item in enumerable)
		{
			if (!flag)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(", ");
			}
			if (item == null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("(null)");
			}
			else if (item is IFormattable formattable)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(formattable.ToString(null, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(item);
			}
			flag = false;
		}
		stringBuilder.Append(']');
		return stringBuilder.ToString();
	}
}

	internal static class NpgsqlDbTypeExtensions
	{
		internal static NpgsqlDbType? ToNpgsqlDbType(this DbType dbType)
		{
			return dbType switch
			{
				DbType.AnsiString => NpgsqlDbType.Text, 
				DbType.Binary => NpgsqlDbType.Bytea, 
				DbType.Byte => NpgsqlDbType.Smallint, 
				DbType.Boolean => NpgsqlDbType.Boolean, 
				DbType.Currency => NpgsqlDbType.Money, 
				DbType.Date => NpgsqlDbType.Date, 
				DbType.DateTime => Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior ? NpgsqlDbType.Timestamp : NpgsqlDbType.TimestampTz, 
				DbType.Decimal => NpgsqlDbType.Numeric, 
				DbType.VarNumeric => NpgsqlDbType.Numeric, 
				DbType.Double => NpgsqlDbType.Double, 
				DbType.Guid => NpgsqlDbType.Uuid, 
				DbType.Int16 => NpgsqlDbType.Smallint, 
				DbType.Int32 => NpgsqlDbType.Integer, 
				DbType.Int64 => NpgsqlDbType.Bigint, 
				DbType.Single => NpgsqlDbType.Real, 
				DbType.String => NpgsqlDbType.Text, 
				DbType.Time => NpgsqlDbType.Time, 
				DbType.AnsiStringFixedLength => NpgsqlDbType.Text, 
				DbType.StringFixedLength => NpgsqlDbType.Text, 
				DbType.Xml => NpgsqlDbType.Xml, 
				DbType.DateTime2 => NpgsqlDbType.Timestamp, 
				DbType.DateTimeOffset => NpgsqlDbType.TimestampTz, 
				DbType.Object => null, 
				DbType.SByte => null, 
				DbType.UInt16 => null, 
				DbType.UInt32 => null, 
				DbType.UInt64 => null, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dbType", dbType, null), 
			};
		}

		public static DbType ToDbType(this NpgsqlDbType npgsqlDbType)
		{
			return npgsqlDbType switch
			{
				NpgsqlDbType.Smallint => DbType.Int16, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Integer => DbType.Int32, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Bigint => DbType.Int64, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Real => DbType.Single, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Double => DbType.Double, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Numeric => DbType.Decimal, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Money => DbType.Currency, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Text => DbType.String, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Xml => DbType.Xml, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Varchar => DbType.String, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Char => DbType.String, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Name => DbType.String, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Citext => DbType.String, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Refcursor => DbType.Object, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Jsonb => DbType.Object, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Json => DbType.Object, 
				NpgsqlDbType.JsonPath => DbType.Object, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Timestamp => Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior ? DbType.DateTime : DbType.DateTime2, 
				NpgsqlDbType.TimestampTz => Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior ? DbType.DateTimeOffset : DbType.DateTime, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Date => DbType.Date, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Time => DbType.Time, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Bytea => DbType.Binary, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Boolean => DbType.Boolean, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Uuid => DbType.Guid, 
				NpgsqlDbType.Unknown => DbType.Object, 
				_ => DbType.Object, 
			};
		}

				{
					return "unknown";
				}
				if (npgsqlDbType.HasFlag(NpgsqlDbType.Range) && (npgsqlDbType & (NpgsqlDbType)(-1073741825)) == NpgsqlDbType.Unknown)
				{
					return "unknown";

				if (npgsqlDbType.HasFlag(NpgsqlDbType.Multirange) && (npgsqlDbType & (NpgsqlDbType)(-536870913)) == NpgsqlDbType.Unknown)
				{
					return "unknown";
				}
				object result;
				if (!npgsqlDbType.HasFlag(NpgsqlDbType.Array))
				{
					result = null;
				}
				else
				{
					string text = (npgsqlDbType & (NpgsqlDbType)2147483647).ToUnqualifiedDataTypeName();
					result = ((text != null) ? ("_" + text) : null);
				}
				return (string?)result;
			}
			}
		}

		internal static string ToUnqualifiedDataTypeNameOrThrow(this NpgsqlDbType npgsqlDbType)
		{
			return npgsqlDbType.ToUnqualifiedDataTypeName() ?? throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("npgsqlDbType", npgsqlDbType, "Cannot convert NpgsqlDbType to DataTypeName");
		}

			{
				BoundConverter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(T));
			}
			T lowerBound = (flag5 ? default(T) : ((T)BoundConverter.ConvertFromString(text)));
			T upperBound = (flag6 ? default(T) : ((T)BoundConverter.ConvertFromString(text2)));
			return new NpgsqlRange<T>(lowerBound, flag, flag5, upperBound, flag3, flag6);
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	internal enum RangeFlags : byte
	{
		None = 0,
		Empty = 1,
		LowerBoundInclusive = 2,
		UpperBoundInclusive = 4,
		LowerBoundInfinite = 8,
		UpperBoundInfinite = 0x10,
		Inclusive = 6,
		Infinite = 0x18,
		LowerInclusiveInfinite = 0xA,
		UpperInclusiveInfinite = 0x14
	}

			Write(stringBuilder);

		}

		[Obsolete("Client-side parsing of NpgsqlTsQuery is unreliable and cannot fully duplicate the PostgreSQL logic. Use PG functions instead (e.g. to_tsquery)")]
		public static NpgsqlTsQuery Parse(string value)
		{

			{

			}
			Stack<NpgsqlTsQuery> stack = new Stack<NpgsqlTsQuery>();
			Stack<NpgsqlTsQueryOperator> stack2 = new Stack<NpgsqlTsQueryOperator>();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int i = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			short result = -1;
			while (i < value.Length)
			{
				char c = value[i++];
				if (c != '\'')
				{
					if (((c == ')' || c == '|' || c == '&') && !flag) || ((c == '(' || c == '!') && flag))
					{
						throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery. Unexpected token.");
					}

							if (c2 == '>')
							{
								flag2 = true;
								break;
							}
							stringBuilder.Append(c2);
						}
						if (stringBuilder.Length == length || !flag2)
						{
							throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery. Malformed 'followed by' operator.");
						}
						string text = stringBuilder.ToString(length, stringBuilder.Length - length);
						if (text == "-")
						{
							result = 1;
						}
						else if (!short.TryParse(text, out result) || result < 0)
						{
							throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery. Malformed distance in 'followed by' operator.");
						}
						stringBuilder.Length -= text.Length;
					}
					if (c == '(' || c == '!' || c == '&' || c == '<')
					{

						flag = false;
						result = 0;
						continue;
					}
					if (c == '|')

							}
							NpgsqlTsQuery right = stack.Pop();
							NpgsqlTsQuery left = stack.Pop();
							stack.Push(new NpgsqlTsQueryOr(left, right));

					}

								'&' => new NpgsqlTsQueryAnd(left2, right2),

								'<' => new NpgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy(left2, npgsqlTsQueryOperator.FollowedByDistance, right2), 
								_ => throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery"), 
							});
						}

							throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery: closing parenthesis without an opening parenthesis");
						}

					}

						{
							throw new FormatException("Unexpected : while parsing tsquery");

								continue;

						}

							if (i >= value.Length || value[i] != '\'')
							{

							}

							i++;
						}
						if (c == '\\')

							{
								throw new FormatException("Unexpected \\ in end of value");
							}

						}

						continue;
					case 'B':
					case 'b':
						((NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme)stack.Peek()).Weights |= NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme.Weight.B;
						continue;
					case 'C':
					case 'c':

						continue;
					case 'D':

					{

						{
							throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery");
						}
						NpgsqlTsQuery right4 = stack.Pop();
						NpgsqlTsQuery left4 = stack.Pop();
						stack.Push(new NpgsqlTsQueryAnd(left4, right4));
						stack2.Pop();
						break;

						}

						break;
					case '<':

						if (stack.Count < 2)
						{
							throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery");
						}
						NpgsqlTsQuery right3 = stack.Pop();
						NpgsqlTsQuery left3 = stack.Pop();
						stack.Push(new NpgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy(left3, npgsqlTsQueryOperator2.FollowedByDistance, right3));
						stack2.Pop();
						break;
					}
					default:
						flag3 = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				flag = true;
				continue;
				IL_0334:
				stack.Push(new NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme(stringBuilder.ToString()));
				stringBuilder.Clear();
				goto IL_0431;
			}
			while (stack2.Count > 0)
			{
				if (stack.Count < 2)
				{
					throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery");
				}
				NpgsqlTsQuery right5 = stack.Pop();
				NpgsqlTsQuery left5 = stack.Pop();
				NpgsqlTsQueryOperator npgsqlTsQueryOperator3 = stack2.Pop();
				stack.Push((char)npgsqlTsQueryOperator3 switch

					'|' => new NpgsqlTsQueryOr(left5, right5), 
					'<' => new NpgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy(left5, npgsqlTsQueryOperator3.FollowedByDistance, right5), 
					_ => throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery"), 
				});
			}
			if (stack.Count != 1)
			{
				throw new FormatException("Syntax error in tsquery");
			}
			return stack.Pop();

	public sealed class NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme : NpgsqlTsQuery
	{
		[Flags]
		public enum Weight
		{
			None = 0,
			D = 1,
			C = 2,
			B = 4,
			A = 8
		}

		private string _text;

		private Weight _weights;

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return _text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Text is null or empty string", "value");
				}
				_text = value;
			}
		}

		public Weight Weights
		{
			get
			{
				return _weights;
			}
			set
			{
				if ((byte)value >> 4 != 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", "Illegal weights");
				}
				_weights = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsPrefixSearch { get; set; }

		public NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme(string text)
			: this(text, Weight.None, isPrefixSearch: false)
		{
		}

		public NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme(string text, Weight weights)
			: this(text, weights, isPrefixSearch: false)
		{
		}

		public NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme(string text, Weight weights, bool isPrefixSearch)
			: base(NodeKind.Lexeme)
		{
			_text = text;
			Weights = weights;
			IsPrefixSearch = isPrefixSearch;
		}

		internal override void WriteCore(StringBuilder sb, bool first = false)
		{
			sb.Append('\'').Append(Text.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("'", "''")).Append('\'');
			if (IsPrefixSearch || Weights != Weight.None)
			{
				sb.Append(':');
			}
			if (IsPrefixSearch)
			{
				sb.Append('*');
			}
			if ((Weights & Weight.A) != Weight.None)
			{
				sb.Append('A');
			}
			if ((Weights & Weight.B) != Weight.None)
			{
				sb.Append('B');
			}
			if ((Weights & Weight.C) != Weight.None)
			{
				sb.Append('C');
			}
			if ((Weights & Weight.D) != Weight.None)
			{
				sb.Append('D');
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(NpgsqlTsQuery? other)
		{
			if (other is NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme npgsqlTsQueryLexeme && npgsqlTsQueryLexeme.Text == Text && npgsqlTsQueryLexeme.Weights == Weights)
			{
				return npgsqlTsQueryLexeme.IsPrefixSearch == IsPrefixSearch;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCode.Combine(Text, Weights, IsPrefixSearch);
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlTsQueryNot : NpgsqlTsQuery
	{
		public NpgsqlTsQuery Child { get; set; }

		public NpgsqlTsQueryNot(NpgsqlTsQuery child)
			: base(NodeKind.Not)
		{
			Child = child;
		}

		internal override void WriteCore(StringBuilder sb, bool first = false)
		{
			sb.Append('!');
			if (Child == null)
			{
				sb.Append("''");
				return;
			}
			if (Child.Kind != NodeKind.Lexeme)
			{
				sb.Append("( ");
			}
			Child.WriteCore(sb, first: true);
			if (Child.Kind != NodeKind.Lexeme)
			{
				sb.Append(" )");
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(NpgsqlTsQuery? other)
		{
			if (other is NpgsqlTsQueryNot npgsqlTsQueryNot)
			{
				return npgsqlTsQueryNot.Child == Child;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Child?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp : NpgsqlTsQuery
	{
		public NpgsqlTsQuery Left { get; set; }

		public NpgsqlTsQuery Right { get; set; }

		protected NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp(NodeKind kind, NpgsqlTsQuery left, NpgsqlTsQuery right)
			: base(kind)
		{
			Left = left;
			Right = right;
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlTsQueryAnd : NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp
	{
		public NpgsqlTsQueryAnd(NpgsqlTsQuery left, NpgsqlTsQuery right)
			: base(NodeKind.And, left, right)
		{
		}

		internal override void WriteCore(StringBuilder sb, bool first = false)
		{
			base.Left.WriteCore(sb);
			sb.Append(" & ");
			base.Right.WriteCore(sb);
		}

		public override bool Equals(NpgsqlTsQuery? other)
		{
			if (other is NpgsqlTsQueryAnd npgsqlTsQueryAnd && npgsqlTsQueryAnd.Left == base.Left)
			{
				return npgsqlTsQueryAnd.Right == base.Right;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCode.Combine(base.Left, base.Right);
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlTsQueryOr : NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp
	{
		public NpgsqlTsQueryOr(NpgsqlTsQuery left, NpgsqlTsQuery right)
			: base(NodeKind.Or, left, right)
		{
		}

		internal override void WriteCore(StringBuilder sb, bool first = false)
		{
			if (!first)
			{
				sb.Append("( ");
			}
			base.Left.WriteCore(sb);
			sb.Append(" | ");
			base.Right.WriteCore(sb);
			if (!first)
			{
				sb.Append(" )");
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(NpgsqlTsQuery? other)
		{
			if (other is NpgsqlTsQueryOr npgsqlTsQueryOr && npgsqlTsQueryOr.Left == base.Left)
			{
				return npgsqlTsQueryOr.Right == base.Right;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCode.Combine(base.Left, base.Right);
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy : NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp
	{
		public short Distance { get; set; }

		public NpgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy(NpgsqlTsQuery left, short distance, NpgsqlTsQuery right)
			: base(NodeKind.Phrase, left, right)
		{
			if (distance < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("distance");
			}
			Distance = distance;
		}

		internal override void WriteCore(StringBuilder sb, bool first = false)
		{
			if (!first)
			{
				sb.Append("( ");
			}
			base.Left.WriteCore(sb);
			sb.Append(" <");
			if (Distance == 1)
			{
				sb.Append("-");
			}
			else
			{
				sb.Append(Distance);
			}
			sb.Append("> ");
			base.Right.WriteCore(sb);
			if (!first)
			{
				sb.Append(" )");
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(NpgsqlTsQuery? other)
		{
			if (other is NpgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy npgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy && npgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy.Left == base.Left && npgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy.Right == base.Right)
			{
				return npgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy.Distance == Distance;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCode.Combine(base.Left, base.Right, Distance);
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlTsQueryEmpty : NpgsqlTsQuery
	{
		public NpgsqlTsQueryEmpty()
			: base(NodeKind.Empty)
		{
		}

		internal override void WriteCore(StringBuilder sb, bool first = false)
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(NpgsqlTsQuery? other)
		{
			return other is NpgsqlTsQueryEmpty;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.Kind.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlTsVector : IEnumerable<NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme>, IEnumerable, IEquatable<NpgsqlTsVector>
	{
		public struct Lexeme : IEquatable<Lexeme>
		{
			public struct WordEntryPos : IEquatable<WordEntryPos>
			{
				internal short Value { get; }

				public Weight Weight => (Weight)((Value >> 14) & 3);

				public int Pos => Value & 0x3FFF;

				internal WordEntryPos(short value)
				{
					Value = value;
				}

				public WordEntryPos(int pos, Weight weight = Weight.D)
				{
					if (pos == 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("pos", "Lexeme position is out of range. Min value is 1, max value is 2^14-1. Value was: " + pos);
					}
					if (weight < Weight.D || weight > Weight.A)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("weight");
					}
					if (pos >> 14 != 0)
					{
						pos = 16383;
					}
					Value = (short)(((int)weight << 14) | pos);
				}

				public override string ToString()
				{
					if (Weight != Weight.D)
					{
						return Pos.ToString() + Weight;
					}
					return Pos.ToString();
				}

				public bool Equals(WordEntryPos o)
				{
					return Value == o.Value;
				}

				public override bool Equals(object? o)
				{
					if (o is WordEntryPos o2)
					{
						return Equals(o2);
					}
					return false;
				}

				public override int GetHashCode()
				{
					return Value.GetHashCode();
				}

				public static bool operator ==(WordEntryPos left, WordEntryPos right)
				{
					return left.Equals(right);
				}

				public static bool operator !=(WordEntryPos left, WordEntryPos right)
				{
					return !left.Equals(right);
				}
			}

			public enum Weight
			{
				D,
				C,
				B,
				A
			}

			internal readonly List<WordEntryPos>? WordEntryPositions;

			public string Text { get; set; }

			public WordEntryPos this[int index]
			{
				get
				{
					if (index < 0 || WordEntryPositions == null || index >= WordEntryPositions.Count)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("index");
					}
					return WordEntryPositions[index];
				}
				internal set
				{
					if (index < 0 || WordEntryPositions == null || index >= WordEntryPositions.Count)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
					}
					WordEntryPositions[index] = value;
				}
			}

			public int Count => WordEntryPositions?.Count ?? 0;

			public Lexeme(string text)
			{
				Text = text;
				WordEntryPositions = null;
			}

			public Lexeme(string text, List<WordEntryPos>? wordEntryPositions)
				: this(text, wordEntryPositions, noCopy: false)
			{
			}

			internal Lexeme(string text, List<WordEntryPos>? wordEntryPositions, bool noCopy)
			{
				Text = text;
				if (wordEntryPositions != null)
				{
					WordEntryPositions = (noCopy ? wordEntryPositions : new List<WordEntryPos>(wordEntryPositions));
				}
				else
				{
					WordEntryPositions = null;
				}
			}

			internal static List<WordEntryPos>? UniquePos(List<WordEntryPos>? list)
			{
				if (list == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 1; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (list[i - 1].Pos >= list[i].Pos)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return list;
				}
				list = new List<WordEntryPos>(list);
				list.Sort((WordEntryPos x, WordEntryPos y) => x.Pos.CompareTo(y.Pos));
				int num = 0;
				for (int num2 = 1; num2 < list.Count; num2++)
				{
					if (list[num].Pos != list[num2].Pos)
					{
						num++;
						if (num != num2)
						{
							list[num] = list[num2];
						}
					}
					else if (list[num2].Weight > list[num].Weight)
					{
						list[num] = list[num2];
					}
				}
				if (num != list.Count - 1)
				{
					list.RemoveRange(num, list.Count - 1 - num);
				}
				return list;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				string text = "'" + (Text ?? "").Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("'", "''") + "'";
				if (Count > 0)
				{
					text = text + ":" + string.Join(",", WordEntryPositions);
				}
				return text;
			}

			public bool Equals(Lexeme o)
			{
				if (Text != o.Text)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (WordEntryPositions == null)
				{
					return o.WordEntryPositions == null;
				}
				if (o.WordEntryPositions == null || WordEntryPositions.Count != o.WordEntryPositions.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < WordEntryPositions.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!WordEntryPositions[i].Equals(o.WordEntryPositions[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object? o)
			{
				if (o is Lexeme o2)
				{
					return Equals(o2);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return Text.GetHashCode();
			}

			public static bool operator ==(Lexeme left, Lexeme right)
			{
				return left.Equals(right);
			}

			public static bool operator !=(Lexeme left, Lexeme right)
			{
				return !left.Equals(right);
			}
		}

		private readonly List<Lexeme> _lexemes;

		public Lexeme this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= _lexemes.Count)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("index");
				}
				return _lexemes[index];
			}
		}

		public int Count => _lexemes.Count;

		internal NpgsqlTsVector(List<Lexeme> lexemes, bool noCheck = false)
		{
			if (noCheck)
			{
				_lexemes = lexemes;
				return;
			}
			_lexemes = new List<Lexeme>(lexemes);
			if (_lexemes.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_lexemes.Sort((Lexeme a, Lexeme b) => string.Compare(a.Text, b.Text, StringComparison.CurrentCulture));
			int num = 0;
			int num2;
			for (num2 = 1; num2 < _lexemes.Count; num2++)
			{
				if (_lexemes[num2].Text != _lexemes[num].Text)
				{
					_lexemes[num] = new Lexeme(_lexemes[num].Text, Lexeme.UniquePos(_lexemes[num].WordEntryPositions), noCopy: true);
					num++;
					if (num != num2)
					{
						_lexemes[num] = _lexemes[num2];
					}
					continue;
				}
				List<Lexeme.WordEntryPos> wordEntryPositions = _lexemes[num].WordEntryPositions;
				if (wordEntryPositions != null)
				{
					Lexeme lexeme = _lexemes[num2];
					if (lexeme.WordEntryPositions != null)
					{
						wordEntryPositions.AddRange(lexeme.WordEntryPositions);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_lexemes[num] = _lexemes[num2];
				}
			}
			_lexemes[num] = new Lexeme(_lexemes[num].Text, Lexeme.UniquePos(_lexemes[num].WordEntryPositions), noCopy: true);
			if (num != num2 - 1)
			{
				_lexemes.RemoveRange(num, num2 - 1 - num);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Client-side parsing of NpgsqlTsVector is unreliable and cannot fully duplicate the PostgreSQL logic. Use PG functions instead (e.g. to_tsvector)")]
		public static NpgsqlTsVector Parse(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			List<Lexeme> list = new List<Lexeme>();
			int i = 0;
			int num = 0;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			while (i < value.Length)
			{
				if (char.IsWhiteSpace(value[i]))
				{
					i++;
					continue;
				}
				stringBuilder.Clear();
				if (value[i] == '\'')
				{
					i++;
					while (true)
					{
						if (i >= value.Length)
						{
							throw new FormatException("Unexpected end of value");
						}
						if (value[i] == '\'')
						{
							i++;
							if (i >= value.Length || value[i] != '\'')
							{
								break;
							}
							stringBuilder.Append('\'');
							i++;
							continue;
						}
						if (value[i] == '\\')
						{
							i++;
							if (i >= value.Length)
							{
								throw new FormatException("Missing escaped character after \\ at end of value");
							}
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(value[i++]);
					}
					if (i < value.Length && value[i] == ':')
					{
						i++;
						goto IL_01c9;
					}
					list.Add(new Lexeme(stringBuilder.ToString()));
					continue;
				}
				if (value[i] == '\\')
				{
					i++;
					goto IL_007e;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(value[i++]);
				goto IL_00a4;
				IL_00fd:
				i++;
				goto IL_01c9;
				IL_00ec:
				i++;
				goto IL_007e;
				IL_007e:
				if (i >= value.Length)
				{
					throw new FormatException("Missing escaped character after \\ at end of value");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(value[i++]);
				goto IL_00a4;
				IL_00a4:
				while (i < value.Length && !char.IsWhiteSpace(value[i]))
				{
					if (value[i] == '\\')
					{
						goto IL_00ec;
					}
					if (value[i] != ':')
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(value[i++]);
						continue;
					}
					goto IL_00fd;
				}
				list.Add(new Lexeme(stringBuilder.ToString()));
				if (i >= value.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				i++;
				continue;
				IL_01c9:
				List<Lexeme.WordEntryPos> list2 = new List<Lexeme.WordEntryPos>();
				while (true)
				{
					int num2 = i;
					for (; i < value.Length && value[i] >= '0' && value[i] <= '9'; i++)
					{
					}
					if (num2 == i)
					{
						throw new FormatException("Missing length after :");
					}
					num = int.Parse(value.Substring(num2, i - num2));
					if (i >= value.Length)
					{
						goto IL_02be;
					}
					if (value[i] == 'A' || value[i] == 'a' || value[i] == '*')
					{
						list2.Add(new Lexeme.WordEntryPos(num, Lexeme.Weight.A));
						i++;
					}
					else
					{
						if ((value[i] < 'B' || value[i] > 'D') && (value[i] < 'b' || value[i] > 'd'))
						{
							goto IL_02be;
						}
						char c = value[i];
						if (c >= 'b' && c <= 'd')
						{
							c = (char)(c - 32);
						}
						list2.Add(new Lexeme.WordEntryPos(num, (Lexeme.Weight)(0 + (68 - c))));
						i++;
					}
					goto IL_02cc;
					IL_02be:
					list2.Add(new Lexeme.WordEntryPos(num));
					goto IL_02cc;
					IL_02cc:
					if (i >= value.Length || char.IsWhiteSpace(value[i]))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (value[i] == ',')
					{
						i++;
						continue;
					}
					throw new FormatException("Missing comma, whitespace or end of value after lexeme pos info");
				}
				if (i < value.Length)
				{
					i++;
				}
				list.Add(new Lexeme(stringBuilder.ToString(), list2));
			}
			return new NpgsqlTsVector(list);
		}

		public IEnumerator<Lexeme> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _lexemes.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _lexemes.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Join(" ", _lexemes);
		}

		public bool Equals(NpgsqlTsVector? other)
		{
			if (this == other)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (other == null || _lexemes.Count != other._lexemes.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _lexemes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!_lexemes[i].Equals(other._lexemes[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is NpgsqlTsVector other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			HashCode hashCode = default(HashCode);
			foreach (Lexeme lexeme in _lexemes)
			{
				hashCode.Add(lexeme);
			}
			return hashCode.ToHashCode();
		}
	}
	public struct NpgsqlPoint : IEquatable<NpgsqlPoint>
	{

		public double Y { get; set; }

		{
			this = default(NpgsqlPoint);
			X = x;
			Y = y;
		}

		public bool Equals(NpgsqlPoint other)
		{
			if (X == other.X)
			{
				return Y == other.Y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is NpgsqlPoint other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(NpgsqlPoint x, NpgsqlPoint y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(NpgsqlPoint x, NpgsqlPoint y)
		{
			return !(x == y);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCode.Combine(X, Y);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0},{1})", X, Y);
		}
	}

	public struct NpgsqlBox : IEquatable<NpgsqlBox>
	{
		private NpgsqlPoint _upperRight;

		private NpgsqlPoint _lowerLeft;

		public NpgsqlPoint UpperRight
		{
			get
			{
				return _upperRight;
			}
			set
			{
				_upperRight = value;
				NormalizeBox();
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlPoint LowerLeft
		{
			get
			{
				return _lowerLeft;
			}
			set
			{
				_lowerLeft = value;
				NormalizeBox();
			}
		}

		public double Left => LowerLeft.X;

		public double Right => UpperRight.X;

		public double Bottom => LowerLeft.Y;

		public double Top => UpperRight.Y;

		public double Width => Right - Left;

		public double Height => Top - Bottom;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Width != 0.0)
				{
					return Height == 0.0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlBox(NpgsqlPoint upperRight, NpgsqlPoint lowerLeft)
		{
			this = default(NpgsqlBox);
			_upperRight = upperRight;
			_lowerLeft = lowerLeft;
			NormalizeBox();
		}

		public NpgsqlBox(double top, double right, double bottom, double left)
			: this(new NpgsqlPoint(right, top), new NpgsqlPoint(left, bottom))
		{
		}

		public bool Equals(NpgsqlBox other)
		{
			if (UpperRight == other.UpperRight)
			{
				return LowerLeft == other.LowerLeft;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is NpgsqlBox other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(NpgsqlBox x, NpgsqlBox y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(NpgsqlBox x, NpgsqlBox y)
		{
			return !(x == y);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0},{1}", UpperRight, LowerLeft);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCode.Combine(Top, Right, Bottom, LowerLeft);
		}

		private void NormalizeBox()
		{
			if (_upperRight.X < _lowerLeft.X)
			{
				ref NpgsqlPoint upperRight = ref _upperRight;
				ref NpgsqlPoint lowerLeft = ref _lowerLeft;
				double x = _lowerLeft.X;
				double x2 = _upperRight.X;
				upperRight.X = x;
				lowerLeft.X = x2;
			}
			if (_upperRight.Y < _lowerLeft.Y)
			{
				ref NpgsqlPoint upperRight = ref _upperRight;
				ref NpgsqlPoint lowerLeft2 = ref _lowerLeft;
				double x2 = _lowerLeft.Y;
				double x = _upperRight.Y;
				upperRight.Y = x2;
				lowerLeft2.Y = x;
			}
		}
	}
	public struct NpgsqlPath : IList<NpgsqlPoint>, ICollection<NpgsqlPoint>, IEnumerable<NpgsqlPoint>, IEnumerable, IEquatable<NpgsqlPath>
	{
		private readonly List<NpgsqlPoint> _points;

		public bool Open { get; set; }

		public NpgsqlPoint this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _points[index];
			}
			set
			{
				_points[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Capacity => _points.Capacity;

		public int Count => _points.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public NpgsqlPath()
		{
			Open = false;
			_points = new List<NpgsqlPoint>();
		}

		public NpgsqlPath(IEnumerable<NpgsqlPoint> points, bool open)
		{
			_points = new List<NpgsqlPoint>(points);
			Open = open;
		}

		public NpgsqlPath(IEnumerable<NpgsqlPoint> points)
			: this(points, open: false)
		{
		}

		public NpgsqlPath(params NpgsqlPoint[] points)
			: this(points, open: false)
		{
		}

		public NpgsqlPath(bool open)
			: this()
		{
			_points = new List<NpgsqlPoint>();
			Open = open;
		}

		public NpgsqlPath(int capacity, bool open)
			: this()
		{
			_points = new List<NpgsqlPoint>(capacity);
			Open = open;
		}

		public NpgsqlPath(int capacity)
			: this(capacity, open: false)
		{
		}

		public int IndexOf(NpgsqlPoint item)
		{
			return _points.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, NpgsqlPoint item)
		{
			_points.Insert(index, item);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			_points.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Add(NpgsqlPoint item)
		{
			_points.Add(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_points.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(NpgsqlPoint item)
		{
			return _points.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(NpgsqlPoint[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_points.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(NpgsqlPoint item)
		{
			return _points.Remove(item);
		}

		public IEnumerator<NpgsqlPoint> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _points.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public bool Equals(NpgsqlPath other)
		{
			if (Open != other.Open || Count != other.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_points == other._points)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i != Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] != other[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is NpgsqlPath other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(NpgsqlPath x, NpgsqlPath y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(NpgsqlPath x, NpgsqlPath y)
		{
			return !(x == y);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			HashCode hashCode = default(HashCode);
			hashCode.Add(Open);
			using (IEnumerator<NpgsqlPoint> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					NpgsqlPoint current = enumerator.Current;
					hashCode.Add(current.X);
					hashCode.Add(current.Y);
				}
			}
			return hashCode.ToHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(Open ? '[' : '(');
			for (int i = 0; i < _points.Count; i++)
			{
				NpgsqlPoint npgsqlPoint = _points[i];
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0},{1})", npgsqlPoint.X, npgsqlPoint.Y);
				if (i < _points.Count - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(",");
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(Open ? ']' : ')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public bool Equals(NpgsqlPolygon other)
		{
			if (Count != other.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_points == other._points)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i != Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] != other[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is NpgsqlPolygon other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(NpgsqlPolygon x, NpgsqlPolygon y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(NpgsqlPolygon x, NpgsqlPolygon y)
		{
			return !(x == y);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			HashCode hashCode = default(HashCode);
			using (IEnumerator<NpgsqlPoint> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					NpgsqlPoint current = enumerator.Current;
					hashCode.Add(current.X);
					hashCode.Add(current.Y);
				}
			}
			return hashCode.ToHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append('(');
			for (int i = 0; i < _points.Count; i++)
			{
				NpgsqlPoint npgsqlPoint = _points[i];
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0},{1})", npgsqlPoint.X, npgsqlPoint.Y);
				if (i < _points.Count - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(",");
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

	public readonly record struct NpgsqlInet
	{
		public IPAddress Address { get; }

		public byte Netmask { get; }

		public NpgsqlInet(IPAddress address, byte netmask)
		{
			CheckAddressFamily(address);
			Address = address;
			Netmask = netmask;
		}

		public NpgsqlInet(IPAddress address)
			: this(address, (byte)((address.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork) ? 32u : 128u))
		{
		}

		public NpgsqlInet(string addr)
		{
			string[] array = addr.Split(new char[1] { '/' });
			if (array != null)
			{
				switch (array.Length)
				{
				case 2:
				{
					IPAddress iPAddress2 = IPAddress.Parse(array[0]);
					byte b = byte.Parse(array[1]);
					Address = iPAddress2;
					Netmask = b;
					return;
				}
				case 1:
				{
					IPAddress iPAddress = IPAddress.Parse(array[0]);
					CheckAddressFamily(iPAddress);
					IPAddress iPAddress2 = iPAddress;
					byte b = (byte)((iPAddress.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6) ? 128 : 32);
					Address = iPAddress2;
					Netmask = b;
					return;
				}
				}
			}
			throw new FormatException("Invalid number of parts in CIDR specification");
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if ((Address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetwork || Netmask != 32) && (Address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6 || Netmask != 128))
			{
				return $"{Address}/{Netmask}";
			}
			return Address.ToString();
		}

		public static explicit operator IPAddress(NpgsqlInet inet)
		{
			return inet.Address;
		}

		public static implicit operator NpgsqlInet(IPAddress ip)
		{
			return new NpgsqlInet(ip);
		}

		public void Deconstruct(out IPAddress address, out byte netmask)
		{
			address = Address;
			netmask = Netmask;
		}

		private static void CheckAddressFamily(IPAddress address)
		{
			if (address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetwork && address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Only IPAddress of InterNetwork or InterNetworkV6 address families are accepted", "address");
			}
		}
	}
	public readonly record struct NpgsqlCidr
	{
		public IPAddress Address { get; }

		public byte Netmask { get; }

		public NpgsqlCidr(IPAddress address, byte netmask)
		{
			if (address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetwork && address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Only IPAddress of InterNetwork or InterNetworkV6 address families are accepted", "address");
			}
			Address = address;
			Netmask = netmask;
		}

		public NpgsqlCidr(string addr)
		{
			string[] array = addr.Split(new char[1] { '/' });
			if (array != null)
			{
				switch (array.Length)
				{
				case 2:
					(Address, Netmask) = (IPAddress.Parse(array[0]), byte.Parse(array[1]));
					return;
				case 1:
					throw new FormatException("Missing netmask");
				}
			}
			throw new FormatException("Invalid number of parts in CIDR specification");
		}

		public static implicit operator NpgsqlInet(NpgsqlCidr cidr)
		{
			return new NpgsqlInet(cidr.Address, cidr.Netmask);
		}

		public static explicit operator IPAddress(NpgsqlCidr cidr)
		{
			return cidr.Address;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{Address}/{Netmask}";
		}

		public void Deconstruct(out IPAddress address, out byte netmask)
		{
			address = Address;
			netmask = Netmask;
		}
	}

		{

			{
				return OffsetNumber == other.OffsetNumber;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? o)
		{
			if (o is NpgsqlTid other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)(BlockNumber ^ OffsetNumber);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(NpgsqlTid left, NpgsqlTid right)
		{
			return left.Equals(right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(NpgsqlTid left, NpgsqlTid right)
		{
			return !(left == right);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"({BlockNumber},{OffsetNumber})";
		}
	}

	internal sealed class KerberosUsernameProvider
	{
		private static bool _performedDetection;

		private static string? _principalWithRealm;

		private static string? _principalWithoutRealm;

		internal static ValueTask<string?> GetUsername(bool async, bool includeRealm, ILogger connectionLogger, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (_performedDetection)
			{
				return new ValueTask<string>(includeRealm ? _principalWithRealm : _principalWithoutRealm);
			}
			string text = FindInPath("klist");
			if (text == null)
			{
				connectionLogger.LogDebug("klist not found in PATH, skipping Kerberos username detection");
				return new ValueTask<string>((string)null);
			}
			ProcessStartInfo startInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
			{
				FileName = text,
				RedirectStandardOutput = true,
				RedirectStandardError = true,
				UseShellExecute = false
			};
			Process process = Process.Start(startInfo);
			if (process == null)
			{
				connectionLogger.LogDebug("klist process could not be started");
				return new ValueTask<string>((string)null);
			}
			return GetUsernameAsyncInternal();
			async ValueTask<string?> GetUsernameAsyncInternal()
			{
				process.WaitForExit();
				if (process.ExitCode != 0)
				{
					connectionLogger.LogDebug($"klist exited with code {process.ExitCode}: {process.StandardError.ReadToEnd()}");
					return null;
				}
				string line = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
				{
					if ((line = process.StandardOutput.ReadLine()) == null)
					{
						connectionLogger.LogDebug("Unexpected output from klist, aborting Kerberos username detection");
						return null;
					}
				}
				return ParseKListOutput(line, includeRealm, connectionLogger);
			}
		}

		private static string? ParseKListOutput(string line, bool includeRealm, ILogger connectionLogger)
		{
			int num = line.IndexOf(':');
			int num2 = line.LastIndexOf(':');
			if (num == -1 || num != num2)
			{
				connectionLogger.LogDebug("Unexpected output from klist, aborting Kerberos username detection");
				return null;
			}
			ReadOnlySpan<char> span = System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(line, 1 + line.IndexOf(':')).Trim();
			int num3 = span.IndexOf('@');
			int num4 = span.LastIndexOf('@');
			if (num3 == -1 || num3 != num4)
			{
				connectionLogger.LogDebug("Badly-formed default principal " + span.ToString() + " from klist, aborting Kerberos username detection");
				return null;
			}
			_principalWithRealm = span.ToString();
			_principalWithoutRealm = span.Slice(0, num3).ToString();
			_performedDetection = true;
			if (!includeRealm)
			{
				return _principalWithoutRealm;
			}
			return _principalWithRealm;
		}

		private static string? FindInPath(string name)
		{
			string[] array = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH")?.Split(new char[1] { Path.PathSeparator }) ?? Array.Empty<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = Path.Combine(array[i], name);
				if (File.Exists(text))
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		public MultiHostDataSourceWrapper(NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource source, TargetSessionAttributes targetSessionAttributes)
			: base(CloneSettingsForTargetSessionAttributes(source.Settings, targetSessionAttributes), source.Configuration)
		{
			_wrappedSource = source;
		}

		private static NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder CloneSettingsForTargetSessionAttributes(NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder settings, TargetSessionAttributes targetSessionAttributes)
		{
			NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder = settings.Clone();
			npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.TargetSessionAttributesParsed = targetSessionAttributes;
			return npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder;
		}

		internal override void Clear()
		{
			_wrappedSource.Clear();
		}

		internal override ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector> Get(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return _wrappedSource.Get(conn, timeout, async, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal override bool TryGetIdleConnector([NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? connector)
		{
			throw new NpgsqlException("Npgsql bug: trying to get an idle connector from MultiHostDataSourceWrapper");
		}

		internal override ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector?> OpenNewConnector(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			throw new NpgsqlException("Npgsql bug: trying to open a new connector from MultiHostDataSourceWrapper");
		}

			_wrappedSource.Return(connector);

	internal sealed class MultiplexingDataSource : PoolingDataSource
	{
		private struct MultiplexingStats
		{
			internal Stopwatch Stopwatch;

			internal int NumCommands;

			internal void Reset()
			{
				NumCommands = 0;
				Stopwatch.Reset();
			}

			internal MultiplexingStats Clone()
			{
				MultiplexingStats result = new MultiplexingStats
				{
					Stopwatch = Stopwatch,
					NumCommands = NumCommands
				};
				Stopwatch = new Stopwatch();
				return result;
			}
		}

		private readonly ILogger _connectionLogger;

		private readonly ILogger _commandLogger;

		private readonly bool _autoPrepare;

		private readonly ChannelReader<NpgsqlCommand> _multiplexCommandReader;

		private readonly Task _multiplexWriteLoop;

		private readonly int _writeCoalescingBufferThresholdBytes;

		private const int MultiplexingCommandChannelBound = 4096;

		internal ChannelWriter<NpgsqlCommand> MultiplexCommandWriter { get; }

		internal MultiplexingDataSource(NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder settings, NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration dataSourceConfig, NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource? parentPool = null)
			: base(settings, dataSourceConfig, parentPool)
		{
			_autoPrepare = settings.MaxAutoPrepare > 0;
			_writeCoalescingBufferThresholdBytes = base.Settings.WriteCoalescingBufferThresholdBytes;
			Channel<NpgsqlCommand> channel = Channel.CreateBounded<NpgsqlCommand>(new BoundedChannelOptions(4096)
			{
				FullMode = BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait,
				SingleReader = true
			});
			_multiplexCommandReader = channel.Reader;
			MultiplexCommandWriter = channel.Writer;
			_connectionLogger = dataSourceConfig.LoggingConfiguration.ConnectionLogger;
			_commandLogger = dataSourceConfig.LoggingConfiguration.CommandLogger;
			_multiplexWriteLoop = Task.Run((Func<Task?>)MultiplexingWriteLoop, CancellationToken.None).ContinueWith(delegate(Task t)
			{
				if (t.IsFaulted)
				{
					_connectionLogger.LogError(t.Exception, "Exception in multiplexing write loop, this is an Npgsql bug, please file an issue.");
				}
			});
		}

		private async Task MultiplexingWriteLoop()
		{
			MultiplexingStats stats = new MultiplexingStats
			{
				Stopwatch = new Stopwatch()
			};
			while (true)
			{
				NpgsqlCommand command;
				try
				{
					if (!_multiplexCommandReader.TryRead(out command))
					{
						command = await _multiplexCommandReader.ReadAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
				}
				catch (ChannelClosedException)
				{
					break;
				}
				NpgsqlConnector connector;
				try
				{
					SpinWait spinwait = default(SpinWait);
					while (true)
					{
						if (TryGetIdleConnector(out connector))
						{
							Interlocked.Increment(ref connector.CommandsInFlightCount);
							break;
						}
						connector = await OpenNewConnector(command.InternalConnection, new NpgsqlTimeout(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(base.Settings.Timeout)), async: true, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						if (connector != null)
						{
							connector.Connection = null;
							Interlocked.Increment(ref connector.CommandsInFlightCount);
							break;
						}
						int num = int.MaxValue;
						NpgsqlConnector[] connectors = Connectors;
						foreach (NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector in connectors)
						{
							if (npgsqlConnector != null && npgsqlConnector.MultiplexAsyncWritingLock == 0 && npgsqlConnector.CommandsInFlightCount < num)
							{
								num = npgsqlConnector.CommandsInFlightCount;
								connector = npgsqlConnector;
							}
						}
						if (connector == null)
						{
							spinwait.SpinOnce();
							continue;
						}
						if (Interlocked.Increment(ref connector.CommandsInFlightCount) == 1)
						{
							Interlocked.Decrement(ref connector.CommandsInFlightCount);
							spinwait.SpinOnce();
							continue;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					LogMessages.ExceptionWhenOpeningConnectionForMultiplexing(_connectionLogger, exception);
					command.ExecutionCompletion.SetException(exception);
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					stats.Reset();
					connector.FlagAsNotWritableForMultiplexing();
					command.TraceCommandStart(connector);
					bool flag = true;
					bool flag2;
					do
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						else
						{
							Interlocked.Increment(ref connector.CommandsInFlightCount);
						}
						flag2 = WriteCommand(connector, command, ref stats);
					}
					while (connector.WriteBuffer.WritePosition < _writeCoalescingBufferThresholdBytes && flag2 && _multiplexCommandReader.TryRead(out command));
					if (flag2)
					{
						Flush(connector, ref stats);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception2)
				{
					FailWrite(connector, exception2);
				}
				command = null;
			}
			static void CompleteWrite(NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector2, ref MultiplexingStats reference)
			{
				npgsqlConnector2.FlagAsWritableForMultiplexing();
				NpgsqlEventSource.Log.MultiplexingBatchSent(reference.NumCommands, reference.Stopwatch);
			}
			void FailWrite(NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector2, Exception exception3)
			{
				LogMessages.ExceptionWhenWritingMultiplexedCommands(_commandLogger, npgsqlConnector2.Id, exception3);
			}
			void Flush(NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector2, ref MultiplexingStats reference)
			{
				Task task = npgsqlConnector2.Flush(async: true);
				switch (task.Status)
				{
				case TaskStatus.RanToCompletion:
					CompleteWrite(npgsqlConnector2, ref reference);
					break;
				case TaskStatus.Faulted:
					task.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
					break;
				case TaskStatus.WaitingForActivation:
				case TaskStatus.Running:
				{
					MultiplexingStats clonedStats = reference.Clone();
					task.ContinueWith(delegate(Task t, object o)
					{
						NpgsqlConnector connector2 = (NpgsqlConnector)o;
						if (t.IsFaulted)
						{
							FailWrite(connector2, t.Exception.InnerException);
						}
						else
						{
							CompleteWrite(connector2, ref clonedStats);
						}
					}, npgsqlConnector2);
					break;
				}
				default:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlException("When flushing, task is in invalid state " + task.Status);
					break;
				}
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
			bool WriteCommand(NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector2, NpgsqlCommand npgsqlCommand, ref MultiplexingStats reference)
			{
				if (_autoPrepare)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < npgsqlCommand.InternalBatchCommands.Count; j++)
					{
						npgsqlCommand.InternalBatchCommands[j].TryAutoPrepare(npgsqlConnector2);
					}
				}
				npgsqlConnector2.CommandsInFlightWriter.TryWrite(npgsqlCommand);
				Task task = npgsqlCommand.Write(npgsqlConnector2, async: true, flush: false);
				reference.NumCommands++;
				switch (task.Status)
				{
				case TaskStatus.RanToCompletion:
					return true;
				case TaskStatus.Faulted:
					task.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
					return true;
				case TaskStatus.WaitingForActivation:
				case TaskStatus.Running:
				{
					MultiplexingStats clonedStats = reference.Clone();
					task.ContinueWith(delegate(Task t, object o)
					{
						NpgsqlConnector connector2 = (NpgsqlConnector)o;
						if (t.IsFaulted)
						{
							FailWrite(connector2, t.Exception.InnerException);
							return;
						}
						try
						{
							Flush(connector2, ref clonedStats);
						}
						catch (Exception exception3)
						{
							FailWrite(connector2, exception3);
						}
					}, npgsqlConnector2);
					return false;
				}
				default:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlException("When writing command to connector, task is in invalid state " + task.Status);
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void DisposeBase()
		{
			MultiplexCommandWriter.Complete(new ObjectDisposedException("MultiplexingDataSource"));
			_multiplexWriteLoop.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			base.DisposeBase();
		}

		protected override async ValueTask DisposeAsyncBase()
		{
			MultiplexCommandWriter.Complete(new ObjectDisposedException("MultiplexingDataSource"));
			await _multiplexWriteLoop.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await base.DisposeAsyncBase().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}
	}

	internal static class NpgsqlActivitySource
	{
		private static readonly ActivitySource Source = new ActivitySource("Npgsql", "0.1.0");

		internal static bool IsEnabled => Source.HasListeners();

		internal static Activity? CommandStart(NpgsqlConnector connector, string commandText, CommandType commandType)
		{
			NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder settings = connector.Settings;
			string text = settings.Database ?? connector.InferredUserName;
			string text2 = null;
			string text3 = null;
			string name;
			switch (commandType)
			{
			case CommandType.StoredProcedure:
				text2 = (NpgsqlCommand.EnableStoredProcedureCompatMode ? "SELECT" : "CALL");
				name = text2 + " " + text + "." + commandText;
				break;
			case CommandType.TableDirect:
				text2 = "SELECT";
				text3 = commandText;
				name = text2 + " " + text + "." + text3;
				break;
			case CommandType.Text:
				name = text;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("commandType", commandType, null);
			}
			Activity activity = Source.StartActivity(name, ActivityKind.Client);
			if (activity == null || !activity.IsAllDataRequested)
			{
				return activity;
			}
			activity.SetTag("db.system", "postgresql");
			activity.SetTag("db.connection_string", connector.UserFacingConnectionString);
			activity.SetTag("db.user", connector.InferredUserName);
			activity.SetTag("db.name", text);
			activity.SetTag("db.statement", commandText);
			activity.SetTag("db.connection_id", connector.Id);
			if (text2 != null)
			{
				activity.SetTag("db.operation", text2);
			}
			if (text3 != null)
			{
				activity.SetTag("db.sql.table", text3);
			}
			EndPoint connectedEndPoint = connector.ConnectedEndPoint;
			if (!(connectedEndPoint is IPEndPoint iPEndPoint))
			{
				if (!(connectedEndPoint is System.Net.UnixDomainSocketEndPoint))
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Invalid endpoint type: " + connectedEndPoint.GetType());
				}
				activity.SetTag("net.transport", "unix");
				activity.SetTag("net.peer.name", settings.Host);
			}
			else
			{
				activity.SetTag("net.transport", "ip_tcp");
				activity.SetTag("net.peer.ip", iPEndPoint.Address.ToString());
				if (iPEndPoint.Port != 5432)
				{
					activity.SetTag("net.peer.port", iPEndPoint.Port);
				}
				activity.SetTag("net.peer.name", settings.Host);
			}
			return activity;
		}

		internal static void ReceivedFirstResponse(Activity activity)
		{
			ActivityEvent e = new ActivityEvent("received-first-response");
			activity.AddEvent(e);
		}

		internal static void CommandStop(Activity activity)
		{
			activity.SetTag("otel.status_code", "OK");
			activity.Dispose();
		}

		internal static void SetException(Activity activity, Exception ex, bool escaped = true)
		{
			ActivityTagsCollection activityTagsCollection = new ActivityTagsCollection
			{
				{
					"exception.type",
					ex.GetType().FullName
				},
				{ "exception.message", ex.Message },
				{
					"exception.stacktrace",
					ex.ToString()
				},
				{ "exception.escaped", escaped }
			};
			ActivityTagsCollection tags = activityTagsCollection;
			ActivityEvent e = new ActivityEvent("exception", default(DateTimeOffset), tags);
			activity.AddEvent(e);
			activity.SetTag("otel.status_code", "ERROR");
			activity.SetTag("otel.status_description", (ex is PostgresException ex2) ? ex2.SqlState : ex.Message);
			activity.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public class NpgsqlBatch : DbBatch
	{
		internal const int DefaultBatchCommandsSize = 5;

		private protected NpgsqlCommand Command { get; }

		protected override DbBatchCommandCollection DbBatchCommands => BatchCommands;

		public new NpgsqlBatchCommandCollection BatchCommands { get; }

		public override int Timeout
		{
			get
			{
				return Command.CommandTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				Command.CommandTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public new NpgsqlConnection? Connection
		{
			get
			{
				return Command.Connection;
			}
			set
			{
				Command.Connection = value;
			}
		}

		protected override DbConnection? DbConnection
		{
			get
			{
				return Connection;
			}
			set
			{
				Connection = (NpgsqlConnection)value;
			}
		}

		public new NpgsqlTransaction? Transaction
		{
			get
			{
				return Command.Transaction;
			}
			set
			{
				Command.Transaction = value;
			}
		}

		protected override DbTransaction? DbTransaction
		{
			get
			{
				return Transaction;
			}
			set
			{
				Transaction = (NpgsqlTransaction)value;
			}
		}

		public bool EnableErrorBarriers
		{
			get
			{
				return Command.EnableErrorBarriers;
			}
			set
			{
				Command.EnableErrorBarriers = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool AllResultTypesAreUnknown
		{
			get
			{
				return Command.AllResultTypesAreUnknown;
			}
			set
			{
				Command.AllResultTypesAreUnknown = value;
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlBatch(NpgsqlConnection? connection = null, NpgsqlTransaction? transaction = null)
		{
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			Command = new NpgsqlCommand(5);
			BatchCommands = new NpgsqlBatchCommandCollection(Command.InternalBatchCommands);
			Connection = connection;
			Transaction = transaction;
		}

		internal NpgsqlBatch(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			Command = new NpgsqlCommand(connector, 5);
			BatchCommands = new NpgsqlBatchCommandCollection(Command.InternalBatchCommands);
		}

		private protected NpgsqlBatch(NpgsqlDataSourceCommand command)
		{
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			Command = command;
			BatchCommands = new NpgsqlBatchCommandCollection(Command.InternalBatchCommands);
		}

		protected override DbBatchCommand CreateDbBatchCommand()
		{
			return CreateBatchCommand();
		}

		public new NpgsqlBatchCommand CreateBatchCommand()
		{
			return new NpgsqlBatchCommand();
		}

		protected override DbDataReader ExecuteDbDataReader(CommandBehavior behavior)
		{
			return ExecuteReader(behavior);
		}

		public new NpgsqlDataReader ExecuteReader(CommandBehavior behavior = CommandBehavior.Default)
		{
			return Command.ExecuteReader(behavior);
		}

		protected override async Task<DbDataReader> ExecuteDbDataReaderAsync(CommandBehavior behavior, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return await ExecuteReaderAsync(behavior, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		public new Task<NpgsqlDataReader> ExecuteReaderAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Command.ExecuteReaderAsync(cancellationToken);
		}

		public new Task<NpgsqlDataReader> ExecuteReaderAsync(CommandBehavior behavior, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Command.ExecuteReaderAsync(behavior, cancellationToken);
		}

		public override int ExecuteNonQuery()
		{
			return Command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		public override Task<int> ExecuteNonQueryAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
		}

		public override object? ExecuteScalar()
		{
			return Command.ExecuteScalar();
		}

		public override Task<object?> ExecuteScalarAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Command.ExecuteScalarAsync(cancellationToken);
		}

		public override void Prepare()
		{
			Command.Prepare();
		}

		public override Task PrepareAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Command.PrepareAsync(cancellationToken);
		}

		public override void Cancel()
		{
			Command.Cancel();
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			Command.ResetTransaction();
			if (Command.IsCacheable && Connection != null && Connection.CachedBatch == null)
			{
				BatchCommands.Clear();
				Command.Reset();
				Connection.CachedBatch = this;
			}
			else
			{
				Command.IsCacheable = false;
			}
		}

		internal static NpgsqlBatch CreateCachedBatch(NpgsqlConnection connection)
		{
			NpgsqlBatch npgsqlBatch = new NpgsqlBatch(connection);
			npgsqlBatch.Command.IsCacheable = true;
			return npgsqlBatch;
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlBatchCommand : DbBatchCommand
	{
		internal static readonly List<NpgsqlParameter> EmptyParameters = new List<NpgsqlParameter>();

		private string _commandText;

		internal NpgsqlParameterCollection? _parameters;

		private List<NpgsqlParameter>? _ownedInputParameters;

		private List<NpgsqlParameter>? _inputParameters;

		private RowDescriptionMessage? _description;

		private PreparedStatement? _preparedStatement;

		internal bool IsPreparing;

		public override string CommandText
		{
			get
			{
				return _commandText;
			}
			[param: AllowNull]
			set
			{
				_commandText = value ?? string.Empty;
				ResetPreparation();
			}
		}

		public override CommandType CommandType { get; set; } = CommandType.Text;

		protected override DbParameterCollection DbParameterCollection => Parameters;

		public new NpgsqlParameterCollection Parameters => _parameters ?? (_parameters = new NpgsqlParameterCollection());

		public bool CanCreateParameter => true;

		public bool? AppendErrorBarrier { get; set; }

		public ulong Rows { get; internal set; }

		public override int RecordsAffected
		{
			get
			{
				switch (StatementType)
				{
				case StatementType.Insert:
				case StatementType.Delete:
				case StatementType.Update:
				case StatementType.Move:
				case StatementType.Copy:
				case StatementType.Merge:
					if (Rows <= int.MaxValue)
					{
						return (int)Rows;
					}
					throw new OverflowException("The number of records affected exceeds int.MaxValue. Use Rows.");
				default:
					return -1;
				}
			}
		}

		public StatementType StatementType { get; internal set; }

		public uint OID { get; internal set; }

		internal string? FinalCommandText { get; set; }

		internal List<NpgsqlParameter> PositionalParameters
		{
			get
			{
				List<NpgsqlParameter> list = _inputParameters;
				if (list == null)
				{
					List<NpgsqlParameter>? obj = _ownedInputParameters ?? (_ownedInputParameters = new List<NpgsqlParameter>());
					List<NpgsqlParameter> list2 = obj;
					_inputParameters = obj;
					list = list2;
				}
				return list;
			}
			set
			{
				_inputParameters = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasParameters
		{
			get
			{
				List<NpgsqlParameter>? inputParameters = _inputParameters;
				if (inputParameters == null || inputParameters.Count <= 0)
				{
					List<NpgsqlParameter>? ownedInputParameters = _ownedInputParameters;
					if (ownedInputParameters == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return ownedInputParameters.Count > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal List<NpgsqlParameter> CurrentParametersReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasParameters)
				{
					return EmptyParameters;
				}
				return PositionalParameters;
			}
		}

		internal RowDescriptionMessage? Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (PreparedStatement != null)
				{
					return PreparedStatement.Description;
				}
				return _description;
			}
			set
			{
				if (PreparedStatement == null)
				{
					_description = value;
				}
				else
				{
					PreparedStatement.Description = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal PreparedStatement? PreparedStatement
		{
			get
			{
				if (_preparedStatement == null || _preparedStatement.State != PreparedState.Unprepared)
				{
					return _preparedStatement;
				}
				return _preparedStatement = null;
			}
			set
			{
				_preparedStatement = value;
			}
		}

		internal NpgsqlConnector? ConnectorPreparedOn { get; set; }

		internal byte[] StatementName => PreparedStatement?.Name ?? Array.Empty<byte>();

		internal bool IsPrepared => PreparedStatement?.IsPrepared ?? false;

		public NpgsqlParameter CreateParameter()
		{
			return new NpgsqlParameter();
		}

		internal bool TryGetPrepared([NotNullWhen(true)] out PreparedStatement? preparedStatement)
		{
			preparedStatement = PreparedStatement;
			return preparedStatement?.IsPrepared ?? false;
		}

		public NpgsqlBatchCommand()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public NpgsqlBatchCommand(string commandText)
		{
			_commandText = commandText;
		}

		internal bool ExplicitPrepare(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			if (!IsPrepared)
			{
				PreparedStatement = connector.PreparedStatementManager.GetOrAddExplicit(this);
				PreparedStatement? preparedStatement = PreparedStatement;
				if (preparedStatement != null && preparedStatement.State == PreparedState.NotPrepared)
				{
					PreparedStatement.State = PreparedState.BeingPrepared;
					IsPreparing = true;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		internal bool TryAutoPrepare(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			if (!TryGetPrepared(out PreparedStatement preparedStatement))
			{
				PreparedStatement preparedStatement2 = (PreparedStatement = connector.PreparedStatementManager.TryGetAutoPrepared(this));
				preparedStatement = preparedStatement2;
			}
			if (preparedStatement != null)
			{
				if (preparedStatement.State == PreparedState.NotPrepared)
				{
					preparedStatement.State = PreparedState.BeingPrepared;
					IsPreparing = true;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			CommandText = string.Empty;
			StatementType = StatementType.Select;
			_description = null;
			Rows = 0uL;
			OID = 0u;
			PreparedStatement = null;
			if (_inputParameters == _ownedInputParameters)
			{
				PositionalParameters.Clear();
			}
			else if (_inputParameters != null)
			{
				_inputParameters = null;
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyCommandComplete(CommandCompleteMessage msg)
		{
			StatementType = msg.StatementType;
			Rows = msg.Rows;
			OID = msg.OID;
		}

		internal void ResetPreparation()
		{
			PreparedStatement = null;
			ConnectorPreparedOn = null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return CommandText;
		}
	}
