	public sealed class NpgsqlBinaryExporter : ICancelable, IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable
	{
		private const int BeforeRow = -2;

		private const int BeforeColumn = -1;

		private NpgsqlConnector _connector;

		private NpgsqlReadBuffer _buf;

		private bool _isConsumed;

		private bool _isDisposed;

		private long _endOfMessagePos;

		private short _column;

		private ulong _rowsExported;

		private PgConverterInfo[] _columnInfoCache;

		private readonly ILogger _copyLogger;

		private PgReader PgReader => _buf.PgReader;

		private int NumColumns { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan Timeout
		{
			set
			{
				_buf.Timeout = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsNull
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfNotOnRow();
				if (!IsInitializedAndAtStart)
				{
					return MoveNextColumn(resumableOp: true) == -1;
				}
				return PgReader.FieldSize == -1;
			}
		}

		private bool IsInitializedAndAtStart
		{
			get
			{
				if (PgReader.Initialized)
				{
					if (PgReader.FieldSize != -1)
					{
						return PgReader.FieldOffset == 0;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal NpgsqlBinaryExporter(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			_connector = connector;
			_buf = connector.ReadBuffer;
			_column = -2;
			_columnInfoCache = null;
			_copyLogger = connector.LoggingConfiguration.CopyLogger;
		}

		internal async Task Init(string copyToCommand, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await _connector.WriteQuery(copyToCommand, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await _connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				IBackendMessage backendMessage = await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				switch (backendMessage.Code)
				{
				case BackendMessageCode.CopyOutResponse:
				{
					CopyOutResponseMessage copyOutResponseMessage = (CopyOutResponseMessage)backendMessage;
					if (!copyOutResponseMessage.IsBinary)
					{
						throw _connector.Break(new ArgumentException("copyToCommand triggered a text transfer, only binary is allowed", "copyToCommand"));
					}
					NumColumns = copyOutResponseMessage.NumColumns;
					_columnInfoCache = new PgConverterInfo[NumColumns];
					_rowsExported = 0uL;
					_endOfMessagePos = _buf.CumulativeReadPosition;
					await ReadHeader(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					break;
				}
				case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
					throw new InvalidOperationException("This API only supports import/export from the client, i.e. COPY commands containing TO/FROM STDIN. To import/export with files on your PostgreSQL machine, simply execute the command with ExecuteNonQuery. Note that your data has been successfully imported/exported.");
				default:
					throw _connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task ReadHeader(bool async)
		{
			IBackendMessage msg = await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			_endOfMessagePos = _buf.CumulativeReadPosition + Statics.Expect<CopyDataMessage>(msg, _connector).Length;
			int count = NpgsqlRawCopyStream.BinarySignature.Length + 4 + 4;
			await _buf.Ensure(count, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			byte[] binarySignature = NpgsqlRawCopyStream.BinarySignature;
			foreach (byte b in binarySignature)
			{
				if (_buf.ReadByte() != b)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException("Invalid COPY binary signature at beginning!");
				}
			}
			if (_buf.ReadInt32() != 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Unsupported flags in COPY operation (OID inclusion?)");
			}
			_buf.ReadInt32();
		}

		public int StartRow()
		{
			return StartRow(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public ValueTask<int> StartRowAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return StartRow(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<int> StartRow(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (_isConsumed)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken))
			{
				if (_column >= 0)
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await PgReader.CommitAsync(resuming: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						PgReader.Commit(resuming: false);
					}
					_column++;
				}
				if (_column == NumColumns)
				{
					CopyDataMessage copyDataMessage = Statics.Expect<CopyDataMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					_endOfMessagePos = _buf.CumulativeReadPosition + copyDataMessage.Length;
				}
				else if (_column != -2)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Already in the middle of a row");
				}
				await _buf.Ensure(2, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (_buf.ReadInt16() == -1)
				{
					Statics.Expect<CopyDoneMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					_column = -2;
					_isConsumed = true;
					return -1;
				}
				_column = -1;
				_rowsExported++;
				return NumColumns;
			}
		}

		public T Read<T>()
		{
			return Read<T>(null);
		}

		public ValueTask<T> ReadAsync<T>(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ReadAsync<T>(null, cancellationToken);
		}

		public T Read<T>(NpgsqlDbType type)
		{
			return Read<T>((NpgsqlDbType?)type);
		}

		public ValueTask<T> ReadAsync<T>(NpgsqlDbType type, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ReadAsync<T>((NpgsqlDbType?)type, cancellationToken);
		}

		private T Read<T>(NpgsqlDbType? type)
		{
			ThrowIfNotOnRow();
			if (!IsInitializedAndAtStart)
			{
				MoveNextColumn(resumableOp: false);
			}
			PgReader pgReader = PgReader;
			try
			{
				if (pgReader.FieldSize == -1)
				{
					return DbNullOrThrow<T>();
				}
				bool asObject;
				PgConverterInfo info = GetInfo(typeof(T), type, out asObject);
				pgReader.StartRead(info.BufferRequirement);
				T result = (asObject ? ((T)info.Converter.ReadAsObject(pgReader)) : info.Converter.UnsafeDowncast<T>().Read(pgReader));
				pgReader.EndRead();
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				pgReader.Commit(resuming: false);
			}
		}

		private async ValueTask<T> ReadAsync<T>(NpgsqlDbType? type, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ThrowIfNotOnRow();
			using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				if (!IsInitializedAndAtStart)
				{
					await MoveNextColumnAsync(resumableOp: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				PgReader reader = PgReader;
				T result;
				try
				{
					if (reader.FieldSize == -1)
					{
						result = DbNullOrThrow<T>();
					}
					else
					{
						bool asObject;
						PgConverterInfo info = GetInfo(typeof(T), type, out asObject);
						await reader.StartReadAsync(info.BufferRequirement, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						T val = ((!asObject) ? (await info.Converter.UnsafeDowncast<T>().ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)) : ((T)(await info.Converter.ReadAsObjectAsync(reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))));
						T result2 = val;
						await reader.EndReadAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						result = result2;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					await reader.CommitAsync(resuming: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private static T DbNullOrThrow<T>()
		{
			if (default(T) == null && typeof(T).IsValueType)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			throw new InvalidCastException("Column is null");
		}

		private PgConverterInfo GetInfo(Type type, NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType, out bool asObject)
		{
			ref PgConverterInfo reference = ref _columnInfoCache[_column];
			PgConverterInfo result = (reference.IsDefault ? (reference = CreateConverterInfo(type, npgsqlDbType)) : reference);
			asObject = result.IsBoxingConverter;
			return result;
		}

		private PgConverterInfo CreateConverterInfo(Type type, NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = null)
		{
			PgSerializerOptions options = _connector.SerializerOptions;
			PgTypeId? pgTypeId = null;
			if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
			{
				DataTypeName? dataTypeName = npgsqlDbType.Value.ToDataTypeName();
				PgTypeId value;
				if (dataTypeName.HasValue)
				{
					DataTypeName valueOrDefault = dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault();
					value = options.GetCanonicalTypeId(valueOrDefault);
				}
				else
				{
					value = GetRepresentationalOrDefault(npgsqlDbType.Value.ToUnqualifiedDataTypeNameOrThrow());
				}
				pgTypeId = value;
			}
			PgTypeInfo pgTypeInfo = options.GetTypeInfo(type, pgTypeId) ?? throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format("Reading is not supported for type '{0}'{1}", type, (!npgsqlDbType.HasValue) ? "" : $" and NpgsqlDbType '{npgsqlDbType}'"));
			return pgTypeInfo.Bind(new Field("?", pgTypeInfo.PgTypeId ?? ((PgResolverTypeInfo)pgTypeInfo).GetDefaultResolution(null).PgTypeId, -1), DataFormat.Binary);
			PgTypeId GetRepresentationalOrDefault(string pgName)
			{
				PostgresType postgresType = options.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(pgName);
				return options.ToCanonicalTypeId(postgresType.GetRepresentationalType());
			}
		}

		public void Skip()
		{
			ThrowIfNotOnRow();
			if (!IsInitializedAndAtStart)
			{
				MoveNextColumn(resumableOp: false);
			}
			PgReader.Commit(resuming: false);
		}

		public async Task SkipAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ThrowIfNotOnRow();
			using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken))
			{
				if (!IsInitializedAndAtStart)
				{
					await MoveNextColumnAsync(resumableOp: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				await PgReader.CommitAsync(resuming: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
		}

		private int MoveNextColumn(bool resumableOp)
		{
			PgReader.Commit(resuming: false);
			if (_column + 1 == NumColumns)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No more columns left in the current row");
			}
			_column++;
			_buf.Ensure(4);
			int fieldLength = _buf.ReadInt32();
			PgReader.Init(fieldLength, DataFormat.Binary, resumableOp);
			return PgReader.FieldSize;
		}

		private async ValueTask<int> MoveNextColumnAsync(bool resumableOp)
		{
			await PgReader.CommitAsync(resuming: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (_column + 1 == NumColumns)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No more columns left in the current row");
			}
			_column++;
			await _buf.Ensure(4, async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			int fieldLength = _buf.ReadInt32();
			PgReader.Init(fieldLength, DataFormat.Binary, resumableOp);
			return PgReader.FieldSize;
		}

		private void ThrowIfNotOnRow()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (_column == -2)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Not reading a row");
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			if (_isDisposed)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException("NpgsqlBinaryExporter", "The COPY operation has already ended.");
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			_connector.PerformUserCancellation();
		}

		public Task CancelAsync()
		{
			Cancel();
			return Task.CompletedTask;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			DisposeAsync(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			return DisposeAsync(async: true);
		}

		private async ValueTask DisposeAsync(bool async)
		{
			if (_isDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_isConsumed)
			{
				LogMessages.BinaryCopyOperationCompleted(_copyLogger, _rowsExported, _connector.Id);
			}
			else if (!_connector.IsBroken)
			{
				try
				{
					using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(default(CancellationToken), attemptPgCancellation: false))
					{
						if (async)
						{
							await PgReader.CommitAsync(resuming: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						else
						{
							PgReader.Commit(resuming: false);
						}
						await _buf.Skip(checked((int)(_endOfMessagePos - _buf.CumulativeReadPosition)), async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						_connector.SkipUntil(BackendMessageCode.CopyDone);
						Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
						Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					}
				}
				catch (OperationCanceledException ex) when (ex.InnerException is PostgresException ex2 && ex2.SqlState == "57014")
				{
					LogMessages.CopyOperationCancelled(_copyLogger, _connector.Id);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					LogMessages.ExceptionWhenDisposingCopyOperation(_copyLogger, _connector.Id, exception);
				}
			}
			_connector.EndUserAction();
			Cleanup();
			void Cleanup()
			{
				NpgsqlConnector connector = _connector;
				if (connector != null)
				{
					connector.CurrentCopyOperation = null;
					_connector.Connection?.EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Copy);
					_connector = null;
				}
				_buf = null;
				_isDisposed = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlBinaryImporter : ICancelable, IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable
	{
		private enum ImporterState
		{
			Ready,
			Committed,
			Cancelled,
			Disposed
		}

		private NpgsqlConnector _connector;

		private NpgsqlWriteBuffer _buf;

		private ImporterState _state;

		private short _column;

		private ulong _rowsImported;

		private NpgsqlParameter?[] _params;

		private readonly ILogger _copyLogger;

		private PgWriter _pgWriter;

		private int NumColumns => _params.Length;

		private bool InMiddleOfRow
		{
			get
			{
				if (_column != -1)
				{
					return _column != NumColumns;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan Timeout
		{
			set
			{
				_buf.Timeout = value;
				_connector.ReadBuffer.Timeout = value;
			}
		}

		internal NpgsqlBinaryImporter(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			_connector = connector;
			_buf = connector.WriteBuffer;
			_column = -1;
			_params = null;
			_copyLogger = connector.LoggingConfiguration.CopyLogger;
		}

		internal async Task Init(string copyFromCommand, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await _connector.WriteQuery(copyFromCommand, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await _connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				IBackendMessage backendMessage = await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				switch (backendMessage.Code)
				{
				case BackendMessageCode.CopyInResponse:
				{
					CopyInResponseMessage copyInResponseMessage = (CopyInResponseMessage)backendMessage;
					if (!copyInResponseMessage.IsBinary)
					{
						throw _connector.Break(new ArgumentException("copyFromCommand triggered a text transfer, only binary is allowed", "copyFromCommand"));
					}
					_params = new NpgsqlParameter[copyInResponseMessage.NumColumns];
					_rowsImported = 0uL;
					_buf.StartCopyMode();
					WriteHeader();
					_pgWriter = _buf.GetWriter(_connector.DatabaseInfo);
					break;
				}
				case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
					throw new InvalidOperationException("This API only supports import/export from the client, i.e. COPY commands containing TO/FROM STDIN. To import/export with files on your PostgreSQL machine, simply execute the command with ExecuteNonQuery. Note that your data has been successfully imported/exported.");
				default:
					throw _connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
				}
			}
		}

		private void WriteHeader()
		{
			_buf.WriteBytes(NpgsqlRawCopyStream.BinarySignature, 0, NpgsqlRawCopyStream.BinarySignature.Length);
			_buf.WriteInt32(0);
			_buf.WriteInt32(0);
		}

		public void StartRow()
		{
			StartRow(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task StartRowAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return StartRow(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task StartRow(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckReady();
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if (_column != -1 && _column != NumColumns)
			{
				ThrowColumnMismatch();
			}
			if (_buf.WriteSpaceLeft < 2)
			{
				await _buf.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			_buf.WriteInt16((short)NumColumns);
			_pgWriter.RefreshBuffer();
			_column = 0;
			_rowsImported++;
		}

		public void Write<T>(T value)
		{
			Write(async: false, value, null, null).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task WriteAsync<T>(T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, value, null, null, cancellationToken);
		}

		public void Write<T>(T value, NpgsqlDbType npgsqlDbType)
		{
			Write(async: false, value, npgsqlDbType, null).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task WriteAsync<T>(T value, NpgsqlDbType npgsqlDbType, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, value, npgsqlDbType, null, cancellationToken);
		}

		public void Write<T>(T value, string dataTypeName)
		{
			Write(async: false, value, null, dataTypeName).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task WriteAsync<T>(T value, string dataTypeName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, value, null, dataTypeName, cancellationToken);
		}

		private Task Write<T>(bool async, T value, NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType, string? dataTypeName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(DBNull) || (typeof(T) == typeof(object) && value == null))
			{
				return WriteNull(async, cancellationToken);
			}
			return Core(async, value, npgsqlDbType, dataTypeName, cancellationToken);
			async Task Core(bool flag2, T val, NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType2, string? text, CancellationToken cancellationToken2 = default(CancellationToken))
			{
				CheckReady();
				cancellationToken2.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				CheckColumnIndex();
				bool flag = false;
				NpgsqlParameter<T> npgsqlParameter = _params[_column] as NpgsqlParameter<T>;
				if (npgsqlParameter == null)
				{
					flag = true;
					npgsqlParameter = new NpgsqlParameter<T>();
					if (npgsqlDbType2.HasValue)
					{
						npgsqlParameter._npgsqlDbType = npgsqlDbType2;
					}
					if (text != null)
					{
						npgsqlParameter._dataTypeName = text;
					}
				}
				PgTypeInfo typeInfo = null;
				PgConverter converter = null;
				PgTypeId pgTypeId = default(PgTypeId);
				if (!flag && ((typeof(T) == typeof(object) && npgsqlParameter.ShouldResetObjectTypeInfo(val)) || npgsqlParameter._npgsqlDbType != npgsqlDbType2 || npgsqlParameter._dataTypeName != text))
				{
					npgsqlParameter.GetResolutionInfo(out typeInfo, out converter, out pgTypeId);
					if (!flag)
					{
						npgsqlParameter.ResetDbType();
						if (npgsqlDbType2.HasValue)
						{
							npgsqlParameter._npgsqlDbType = npgsqlDbType2;
						}
						if (text != null)
						{
							npgsqlParameter._dataTypeName = text;
						}
					}
				}
				npgsqlParameter.TypedValue = val;
				npgsqlParameter.ResolveTypeInfo(_connector.SerializerOptions);
				if (typeInfo != null && converter != null && npgsqlParameter.PgTypeId != pgTypeId)
				{
					PgTypeId pgTypeId2 = npgsqlParameter.PgTypeId;
					if (!flag)
					{
						npgsqlParameter.SetResolutionInfo(typeInfo, converter, pgTypeId);
					}
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"Write for column {_column} resolves to a different PostgreSQL type: {pgTypeId2} than the first row resolved to ({pgTypeId}). " + "Please make sure to use clr types that resolve to the same PostgreSQL type across rows. Alternatively pass the same NpgsqlDbType or DataTypeName to ensure the PostgreSQL type ends up to be identical.");
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					_params[_column] = npgsqlParameter;
				}
				npgsqlParameter.Bind(out var _, out var _, DataFormat.Binary);
				try
				{
					await npgsqlParameter.Write(flag2, _pgWriter.WithFlushMode((!flag2) ? FlushMode.Blocking : FlushMode.NonBlocking), cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				catch (Exception reason)
				{
					_connector.Break(reason);
					throw;
				}
				_column++;
			}
		}

		public void WriteNull()
		{
			WriteNull(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task WriteNullAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return WriteNull(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task WriteNull(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckReady();
			if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
			{
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			}
			CheckColumnIndex();
			if (_buf.WriteSpaceLeft < 4)
			{
				await _buf.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			_buf.WriteInt32(-1);
			_pgWriter.RefreshBuffer();
			_column++;
		}

		public void WriteRow(params object?[] values)
		{
			WriteRow(async: false, CancellationToken.None, values).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task WriteRowAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken), params object?[] values)
		{
			return WriteRow(async: true, cancellationToken, values);
		}

		private async Task WriteRow(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken), params object?[] values)
		{
			await StartRow(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			foreach (object value in values)
			{
				await Write(async, value, null, null, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
		}

		private void CheckColumnIndex()
		{
			if (_column == -1 || _column >= NumColumns)
			{
				Throw();
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			void Throw()
			{
				if (_column == -1)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("A row hasn't been started");
				}
				if (_column >= NumColumns)
				{
					ThrowColumnMismatch();
				}
			}
		}

		public ulong Complete()
		{
			return Complete(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public ValueTask<ulong> CompleteAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Complete(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<ulong> Complete(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckReady();
			using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				if (InMiddleOfRow)
				{
					await Cancel(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Binary importer closed in the middle of a row, cancelling import.");
				}
				try
				{
					if (_buf.WriteSpaceLeft < 2)
					{
						await _buf.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					_buf.WriteInt16(-1);
					await _buf.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					_buf.EndCopyMode();
					await _connector.WriteCopyDone(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await _connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					CommandCompleteMessage cmdComplete = Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					_state = ImporterState.Committed;
					return cmdComplete.Rows;
				}
				catch
				{
					Cleanup();
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		void ICancelable.Cancel()
		{
			Close();
		}

		async Task ICancelable.CancelAsync()
		{
			await CloseAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Close();
		}

		public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			return CloseAsync(async: true);
		}

		private async Task Cancel(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			_state = ImporterState.Cancelled;
			_buf.Clear();
			_buf.EndCopyMode();
			await _connector.WriteCopyFail(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await _connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			try
			{
				using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
				{
					IBackendMessage backendMessage = await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					throw _connector.Break(new NpgsqlException("Expected ErrorResponse when cancelling COPY but got: " + backendMessage.Code));
				}
			}
			catch (PostgresException ex)
			{
				if (ex.SqlState != "57014")
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			CloseAsync(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public ValueTask CloseAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return CloseAsync(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask CloseAsync(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			switch (_state)
			{
			case ImporterState.Disposed:
				return;
			case ImporterState.Ready:
				await Cancel(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				break;
			default:
				throw new Exception("Invalid state: " + _state);
			case ImporterState.Committed:
			case ImporterState.Cancelled:
				break;
			}
			Cleanup();
		}

		private void Cleanup()
		{
			if (_state != ImporterState.Disposed)
			{
				NpgsqlConnector connector = _connector;
				LogMessages.BinaryCopyOperationCompleted(_copyLogger, _rowsImported, connector?.Id ?? (-1));
				if (connector != null)
				{
					connector.EndUserAction();
					connector.CurrentCopyOperation = null;
					connector.Connection?.EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Copy);
					_connector = null;
				}
				_buf = null;
				_state = ImporterState.Disposed;
			}
		}

		private void CheckReady()
		{
			ImporterState state = _state;
			if (state != ImporterState.Ready)
			{
				Throw(state);
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			static void Throw(ImporterState importerState)
			{
				throw importerState switch
				{
					ImporterState.Disposed => new ObjectDisposedException(typeof(NpgsqlBinaryImporter).FullName, "The COPY operation has already ended."), 
					ImporterState.Cancelled => new InvalidOperationException("The COPY operation has already been cancelled."), 
					ImporterState.Committed => new InvalidOperationException("The COPY operation has already been committed."), 
					_ => new Exception("Invalid state: " + importerState), 
				};
			}
		}

		private void ThrowColumnMismatch()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException($"The binary import operation was started with {NumColumns} column(s), but {_column + 1} value(s) were provided.");
		}
	}
	[DesignerCategory("")]
	public class NpgsqlCommand : DbCommand, ICloneable, IComponent, IDisposable
	{
		private NpgsqlTransaction? _transaction;

		private readonly NpgsqlConnector? _connector;

		private NpgsqlConnector? _connectorPreparedOn;

		private string _commandText;

		private CommandBehavior _behavior;

		private int? _timeout;

		internal NpgsqlParameterCollection? _parameters;

		private Activity? CurrentActivity;

		private UpdateRowSource _updateRowSource = UpdateRowSource.Both;

		internal static readonly bool EnableSqlRewriting;

		internal static readonly bool EnableStoredProcedureCompatMode;

		private static readonly TaskScheduler ConstrainedConcurrencyScheduler;

		internal const int DefaultTimeout = 30;

		private bool _allResultTypesAreUnknown;

		private bool[]? _unknownResultTypeList;

		private volatile int _state;

		private const string DeriveParametersForFunctionQuery = "\nSELECT\nCASE\n\tWHEN pg_proc.proargnames IS NULL THEN array_cat(array_fill(''::name,ARRAY[pg_proc.pronargs]),array_agg(pg_attribute.attname ORDER BY pg_attribute.attnum))\n\tELSE pg_proc.proargnames\nEND AS proargnames,\npg_proc.proargtypes,\nCASE\n\tWHEN pg_proc.proallargtypes IS NULL AND (array_agg(pg_attribute.atttypid))[1] IS NOT NULL THEN array_cat(string_to_array(pg_proc.proargtypes::text,' ')::oid[],array_agg(pg_attribute.atttypid ORDER BY pg_attribute.attnum))\n\tELSE pg_proc.proallargtypes\nEND AS proallargtypes,\nCASE\n\tWHEN pg_proc.proargmodes IS NULL AND (array_agg(pg_attribute.atttypid))[1] IS NOT NULL THEN array_cat(array_fill('i'::\"char\",ARRAY[pg_proc.pronargs]),array_fill('o'::\"char\",ARRAY[array_length(array_agg(pg_attribute.atttypid), 1)]))\n    ELSE pg_proc.proargmodes\nEND AS proargmodes\nFROM pg_proc\nLEFT JOIN pg_type ON pg_proc.prorettype = pg_type.oid\nLEFT JOIN pg_attribute ON pg_type.typrelid = pg_attribute.attrelid AND pg_attribute.attnum >= 1 AND NOT pg_attribute.attisdropped\nWHERE pg_proc.oid = :proname::regproc\nGROUP BY pg_proc.proargnames, pg_proc.proargtypes, pg_proc.proallargtypes, pg_proc.proargmodes, pg_proc.pronargs;\n";

		internal bool IsWrappedByBatch { get; }

		internal List<NpgsqlBatchCommand> InternalBatchCommands { get; }

		[Obsolete("Use the new DbBatch API")]
		public IReadOnlyList<NpgsqlBatchCommand> Statements => InternalBatchCommands.AsReadOnly();

		private bool IsExplicitlyPrepared => _connectorPreparedOn != null;

		internal bool IsCacheable { get; set; }

		internal bool EnableErrorBarriers { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue("")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public override string CommandText
		{
			get
			{
				return _commandText;
			}
			[param: AllowNull]
			set
			{
				if (State != CommandState.Idle)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("An open data reader exists for this command.");
				}
				_commandText = value ?? string.Empty;
				ResetPreparation();
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(30)]
		public override int CommandTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return _timeout ?? InternalConnection?.CommandTimeout ?? 30;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, "CommandTimeout can't be less than zero.");
				}
				_timeout = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(CommandType.Text)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public override CommandType CommandType { get; set; }

		internal NpgsqlConnection? InternalConnection { get; private set; }

		protected override DbConnection? DbConnection
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalConnection;
			}
			set
			{
				if (InternalConnection != value)
				{
					if (State != CommandState.Idle)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("An open data reader exists for this command.");
					}
					InternalConnection = (NpgsqlConnection)value;
					Transaction = null;
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public new NpgsqlConnection? Connection
		{
			get
			{
				return (NpgsqlConnection)DbConnection;
			}
			set
			{
				DbConnection = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool DesignTimeVisible { get; set; }

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[DefaultValue(UpdateRowSource.Both)]
		public override UpdateRowSource UpdatedRowSource
		{
			get
			{
				return _updateRowSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if ((uint)value <= 3u)
				{
					_updateRowSource = value;
					return;
				}
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}

		public bool IsPrepared
		{
			get
			{
				if (_connectorPreparedOn == (InternalConnection?.Connector ?? _connector))
				{
					return AllPrepared();
				}
				return false;
				bool AllPrepared()
				{
					if (InternalBatchCommands.Count == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand in InternalBatchCommands)
					{
						if (internalBatchCommand.PreparedStatement == null || !internalBatchCommand.PreparedStatement.IsPrepared)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AllResultTypesAreUnknown
		{
			get
			{
				return _allResultTypesAreUnknown;
			}
			set
			{
				_unknownResultTypeList = null;

		internal void DeriveParameters()
		{
			NpgsqlConnection? npgsqlConnection = CheckAndGetConnection();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(CommandText))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("CommandText property has not been initialized");
			}
			NpgsqlConnector connector;
			using (npgsqlConnection.StartTemporaryBindingScope(out connector))
			{
				foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand in InternalBatchCommands)
				{
					PreparedStatement? preparedStatement = internalBatchCommand.PreparedStatement;
					if (preparedStatement != null && preparedStatement.IsExplicit)
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException("Deriving parameters isn't supported for commands that are already prepared.");
					}
				}
				Unprepare();
				Parameters.Clear();
				switch (CommandType)
				{
				case CommandType.Text:
					DeriveParametersForQuery(connector);
					break;
				case CommandType.StoredProcedure:
					DeriveParametersForFunction();
					break;
				default:
					throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot derive parameters for CommandType " + CommandType);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DeriveParametersForFunction()
		{
			using NpgsqlCommand npgsqlCommand = new NpgsqlCommand("\nSELECT\nCASE\n\tWHEN pg_proc.proargnames IS NULL THEN array_cat(array_fill(''::name,ARRAY[pg_proc.pronargs]),array_agg(pg_attribute.attname ORDER BY pg_attribute.attnum))\n\tELSE pg_proc.proargnames\nEND AS proargnames,\npg_proc.proargtypes,\nCASE\n\tWHEN pg_proc.proallargtypes IS NULL AND (array_agg(pg_attribute.atttypid))[1] IS NOT NULL THEN array_cat(string_to_array(pg_proc.proargtypes::text,' ')::oid[],array_agg(pg_attribute.atttypid ORDER BY pg_attribute.attnum))\n\tELSE pg_proc.proallargtypes\nEND AS proallargtypes,\nCASE\n\tWHEN pg_proc.proargmodes IS NULL AND (array_agg(pg_attribute.atttypid))[1] IS NOT NULL THEN array_cat(array_fill('i'::\"char\",ARRAY[pg_proc.pronargs]),array_fill('o'::\"char\",ARRAY[array_length(array_agg(pg_attribute.atttypid), 1)]))\n    ELSE pg_proc.proargmodes\nEND AS proargmodes\nFROM pg_proc\nLEFT JOIN pg_type ON pg_proc.prorettype = pg_type.oid\nLEFT JOIN pg_attribute ON pg_type.typrelid = pg_attribute.attrelid AND pg_attribute.attnum >= 1 AND NOT pg_attribute.attisdropped\nWHERE pg_proc.oid = :proname::regproc\nGROUP BY pg_proc.proargnames, pg_proc.proargtypes, pg_proc.proallargtypes, pg_proc.proargmodes, pg_proc.pronargs;\n", InternalConnection);
			npgsqlCommand.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter("proname", NpgsqlDbType.Text));
			npgsqlCommand.Parameters[0].Value = CommandText;
			string[] array = null;
			uint[] array2 = null;
			char[] array3 = null;
			using (NpgsqlDataReader npgsqlDataReader = npgsqlCommand.ExecuteReader(CommandBehavior.SingleResult | CommandBehavior.SingleRow))
			{
				if (!npgsqlDataReader.Read())
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(CommandText + " does not exist in pg_proc");
				}
				if (!npgsqlDataReader.IsDBNull(0))
				{
					array = npgsqlDataReader.GetFieldValue<string[]>(0);
				}
				if (!npgsqlDataReader.IsDBNull(2))
				{
					array2 = npgsqlDataReader.GetFieldValue<uint[]>(2);
				}
				if (!npgsqlDataReader.IsDBNull(3))
				{
					array3 = npgsqlDataReader.GetFieldValue<char[]>(3);
				}
				if (array2 == null)
				{
					if (npgsqlDataReader.IsDBNull(1) || npgsqlDataReader.GetFieldValue<uint[]>(1).Length == 0)
					{
						return;
					}
					array2 = npgsqlDataReader.GetFieldValue<uint[]>(1);
				}
			}
			PgSerializerOptions serializerOptions = npgsqlCommand.InternalConnection.Connector.SerializerOptions;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = new NpgsqlParameter();
				PostgresType postgresType = serializerOptions.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(array2[i]);
				NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = postgresType.DataTypeName.ToNpgsqlDbType();
				npgsqlParameter.DataTypeName = postgresType.DisplayName;
				npgsqlParameter.PostgresType = postgresType;
				if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
				{
					npgsqlParameter.NpgsqlDbType = npgsqlDbType.Value;
				}
				if (array != null && i < array.Length)
				{
					npgsqlParameter.ParameterName = array[i];
				}
				else
				{
					npgsqlParameter.ParameterName = "parameter" + (i + 1);
				}
				if (array3 == null)
				{
					npgsqlParameter.Direction = ParameterDirection.Input;
				}
				else
				{
					NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter2 = npgsqlParameter;
					npgsqlParameter2.Direction = array3[i] switch
					{
						'i' => ParameterDirection.Input, 
						'o' => ParameterDirection.Output, 
						't' => ParameterDirection.Output, 
						'b' => ParameterDirection.InputOutput, 
						'v' => throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot derive function parameter of type VARIADIC"), 
						_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Unknown code in proargmodes while deriving: " + array3[i]), 
					};
				}
				Parameters.Add(npgsqlParameter);
			}
		}

		private void DeriveParametersForQuery(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			using (connector.StartUserAction())
			{
				LogMessages.DerivingParameters(connector.CommandLogger, CommandText, connector.Id);
				if (IsWrappedByBatch)
				{
					foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand in InternalBatchCommands)
					{
						connector.SqlQueryParser.ParseRawQuery(internalBatchCommand, connector.UseConformingStrings, deriveParameters: true);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					connector.SqlQueryParser.ParseRawQuery(this, connector.UseConformingStrings, deriveParameters: true);
				}
				Task task = SendDeriveParameters(connector, async: false);
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					task.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
				}
				try
				{
					foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand2 in InternalBatchCommands)
					{
						Statics.Expect<ParseCompleteMessage>(connector.ReadMessage(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult(), connector);
						List<uint> typeOIDs = Statics.Expect<ParameterDescriptionMessage>(connector.ReadMessage(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult(), connector).TypeOIDs;
						if (internalBatchCommand2.PositionalParameters.Count != typeOIDs.Count)
						{
							connector.SkipUntil(BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery);
							Parameters.Clear();
							throw new NpgsqlException("There was a mismatch in the number of derived parameters between the Npgsql SQL parser and the PostgreSQL parser. Please report this as bug to the Npgsql developers (https://github.com/npgsql/npgsql/issues).");
						}
						for (int i = 0; i < typeOIDs.Count; i++)
						{
							try
							{
								NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = internalBatchCommand2.PositionalParameters[i];
								uint oid = typeOIDs[i];
								PostgresType postgresType = connector.SerializerOptions.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(oid);
								NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = postgresType.GetRepresentationalType().DataTypeName.ToNpgsqlDbType();
								if (npgsqlParameter.NpgsqlDbType != NpgsqlDbType.Unknown && npgsqlParameter.NpgsqlDbType != npgsqlDbType)
								{
									throw new NpgsqlException("The backend parser inferred different types for parameters with the same name. Please try explicit casting within your SQL statement or batch or use different placeholder names.");
								}
								npgsqlParameter.DataTypeName = postgresType.DisplayName;
								npgsqlParameter.PostgresType = postgresType;
								if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
								{
									npgsqlParameter.NpgsqlDbType = npgsqlDbType.Value;
								}
							}
							catch
							{
								connector.SkipUntil(BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery);
								Parameters.Clear();
								throw;
							}
						}
						IBackendMessage result = connector.ReadMessage(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
						BackendMessageCode code = result.Code;
						if (code != BackendMessageCode.RowDescription && code != BackendMessageCode.NoData)
						{
							throw connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(result.Code);
						}
					}
					Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(connector.ReadMessage(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult(), connector);
				}
				finally
				{
					try
					{
						task.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Prepare()
		{
			Prepare(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public new virtual Task PrepareAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{

		}

		private Task Prepare(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			NpgsqlConnection? npgsqlConnection = CheckAndGetConnection();
			if (npgsqlConnection.Settings.Multiplexing)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Explicit preparation not supported with multiplexing");
			}
			NpgsqlConnector connector = npgsqlConnection.Connector;
			ILogger commandLogger = connector.CommandLogger;
			bool flag = false;
			if (IsWrappedByBatch)
			{
				foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand in InternalBatchCommands)
				{
					internalBatchCommand._parameters?.ProcessParameters(connector.SerializerOptions, validateValues: false, internalBatchCommand.CommandType);
					ProcessRawQuery(connector.SqlQueryParser, connector.UseConformingStrings, internalBatchCommand);
					flag = internalBatchCommand.ExplicitPrepare(connector) || flag;
					internalBatchCommand.ConnectorPreparedOn = connector;
				}
				if (commandLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug) && flag)
				{
					LogMessages.PreparingCommandExplicitly(commandLogger, string.Join("; ", CommandTexts()), connector.Id);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_parameters?.ProcessParameters(connector.SerializerOptions, validateValues: false, CommandType);
				ProcessRawQuery(connector.SqlQueryParser, connector.UseConformingStrings, null);
				foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand2 in InternalBatchCommands)
				{
					flag = internalBatchCommand2.ExplicitPrepare(connector) || flag;
				}
				if (commandLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug) && flag)
				{
					LogMessages.PreparingCommandExplicitly(commandLogger, CommandText, connector.Id);
				}
			}
			_connectorPreparedOn = connector;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return Task.CompletedTask;
			}
			return PrepareLong(this, async, connector, cancellationToken);
			IEnumerable<string> CommandTexts()
			{
				foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand3 in InternalBatchCommands)
				{
					yield return internalBatchCommand3.CommandText;
				}
			}
			static async Task PrepareLong(NpgsqlCommand command, bool flag2, NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				_ = 5;
				try
				{
					using (npgsqlConnector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken2))
					{
						Task sendTask = command.SendPrepare(npgsqlConnector, flag2, CancellationToken.None);
						if (sendTask.IsFaulted)
						{
							sendTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
						}
						try
						{
							bool isFirst = true;
							foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand batchCommand in command.InternalBatchCommands)
							{
								if (batchCommand.IsPreparing)
								{
									PreparedStatement pStatement = batchCommand.PreparedStatement;
									if (pStatement.StatementBeingReplaced != null)
									{
										Statics.Expect<CloseCompletedMessage>(await npgsqlConnector.ReadMessage(flag2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), npgsqlConnector);
										pStatement.StatementBeingReplaced.CompleteUnprepare();
										pStatement.StatementBeingReplaced = null;
									}
									Statics.Expect<ParseCompleteMessage>(await npgsqlConnector.ReadMessage(flag2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), npgsqlConnector);
									Statics.Expect<ParameterDescriptionMessage>(await npgsqlConnector.ReadMessage(flag2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), npgsqlConnector);
									IBackendMessage backendMessage = await npgsqlConnector.ReadMessage(flag2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
									switch (backendMessage.Code)
									{
									case BackendMessageCode.RowDescription:
									{
										RowDescriptionMessage rowDescriptionMessage = ((RowDescriptionMessage)backendMessage).Clone();
										command.FixupRowDescription(rowDescriptionMessage, isFirst);
										batchCommand.Description = rowDescriptionMessage;
										break;
									}
									case BackendMessageCode.NoData:
										batchCommand.Description = null;
										break;
									default:
										throw npgsqlConnector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
									}
									pStatement.State = PreparedState.Prepared;
									npgsqlConnector.PreparedStatementManager.NumPrepared++;
									batchCommand.IsPreparing = false;
									isFirst = false;
								}
							}
							Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await npgsqlConnector.ReadMessage(flag2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), npgsqlConnector);
						}
						finally
						{
							try
							{
								if (flag2)
								{
									await sendTask.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								}
								else
								{
									sendTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
								}
							}
							catch
							{
							}
						}
					}
					LogMessages.CommandPreparedExplicitly(npgsqlConnector.CommandLogger, npgsqlConnector.Id);
				}
				catch
				{
					foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand4 in command.InternalBatchCommands)
					{
						if (internalBatchCommand4.IsPreparing)
						{
							internalBatchCommand4.IsPreparing = false;
							internalBatchCommand4.PreparedStatement.AbortPrepare();
						}
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task Unprepare(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			NpgsqlConnection npgsqlConnection = CheckAndGetConnection();
			if (npgsqlConnection.Settings.Multiplexing)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Explicit preparation not supported with multiplexing");
			}
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand in InternalBatchCommands)
			{
				if (internalBatchCommand.IsPrepared)
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			NpgsqlConnector connector = npgsqlConnection.Connector;
			LogMessages.UnpreparingCommand(connector.CommandLogger, connector.Id);
			using (connector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken))
			{
				await SendClose(connector, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand batchCommand in InternalBatchCommands)
				{
					PreparedStatement? preparedStatement = batchCommand.PreparedStatement;
					if (preparedStatement != null && preparedStatement.State == PreparedState.BeingUnprepared)
					{
						Statics.Expect<CloseCompletedMessage>(await connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), connector);
						PreparedStatement preparedStatement2 = batchCommand.PreparedStatement;
						preparedStatement2.CompleteUnprepare();
						if (!preparedStatement2.IsExplicit)
						{
							connector.PreparedStatementManager.AutoPrepared[preparedStatement2.AutoPreparedSlotIndex] = null;
						}
						batchCommand.PreparedStatement = null;
					}
				}
				Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), connector);
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessRawQuery(SqlQueryParser? parser, bool standardConformingStrings, NpgsqlBatchCommand? batchCommand)
		{
			NpgsqlParameterCollection npgsqlParameterCollection;
			CommandType commandType2;
			string value;
			if (batchCommand != null)
			{
				string commandText = batchCommand.CommandText;
				CommandType commandType = batchCommand.CommandType;
				NpgsqlParameterCollection parameters = batchCommand._parameters;
				npgsqlParameterCollection = parameters;
				commandType2 = commandType;
				value = commandText;
			}
			else
			{
				string commandText2 = CommandText;
				CommandType commandType = CommandType;
				NpgsqlParameterCollection parameters = _parameters;
				npgsqlParameterCollection = parameters;
				commandType2 = commandType;
				value = commandText2;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("CommandText property has not been initialized");
			}
			switch (commandType2)
			{
			case CommandType.Text:
				switch (npgsqlParameterCollection?.PlaceholderType ?? PlaceholderType.NoParameters)
				{
				case PlaceholderType.Positional:
					if (batchCommand == null)
					{
						batchCommand = TruncateStatementsToOne();
						batchCommand.FinalCommandText = CommandText;
						if (npgsqlParameterCollection != null)
						{
							batchCommand.PositionalParameters = npgsqlParameterCollection.InternalList;
							batchCommand._parameters = npgsqlParameterCollection;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						batchCommand.FinalCommandText = batchCommand.CommandText;
						if (npgsqlParameterCollection != null)
						{
							batchCommand.PositionalParameters = npgsqlParameterCollection.InternalList;
						}
					}
					ValidateParameterCount(batchCommand);
					break;
				case PlaceholderType.NoParameters:
					if (!EnableSqlRewriting)
					{
						goto case PlaceholderType.Positional;
					}
					goto case PlaceholderType.Named;
				case PlaceholderType.Named:
					if (!EnableSqlRewriting)
					{
						ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Named parameters are not supported when Npgsql.EnableSqlRewriting is disabled");
					}
					if (parser == null)
					{
						parser = new SqlQueryParser();
					}
					if (batchCommand == null)
					{
						parser.ParseRawQuery(this, standardConformingStrings);
						if (InternalBatchCommands.Count > 1)
						{
							NpgsqlParameterCollection? parameters2 = _parameters;
							if (parameters2 != null && parameters2.HasOutputParameters)
							{
								ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Commands with multiple queries cannot have out parameters");
							}
						}
						for (int j = 0; j < InternalBatchCommands.Count; j++)
						{
							ValidateParameterCount(InternalBatchCommands[j]);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						parser.ParseRawQuery(batchCommand, standardConformingStrings);
						ValidateParameterCount(batchCommand);
					}
					break;
				case PlaceholderType.Mixed:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Mixing named and positional parameters isn't supported");
					break;
				default:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("PlaceholderType", "Unknown PlaceholderType value: {0}", _parameters?.PlaceholderType ?? PlaceholderType.NoParameters);
					break;
				}
				break;
			case CommandType.TableDirect:
				if (batchCommand == null)
				{
					batchCommand = TruncateStatementsToOne();
				}
				batchCommand.FinalCommandText = "SELECT * FROM " + CommandText;
				break;
			case CommandType.StoredProcedure:
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder().Append(EnableStoredProcedureCompatMode ? "SELECT * FROM " : "CALL ").Append(value).Append('(');
				bool flag = true;
				bool flag2 = false;
				List<NpgsqlParameter> list = NpgsqlBatchCommand.EmptyParameters;
				if (npgsqlParameterCollection != null)
				{
					list = new List<NpgsqlParameter>(npgsqlParameterCollection.Count);
					for (int i = 0; i < npgsqlParameterCollection.Count; i++)
					{
						NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = npgsqlParameterCollection[i];
						if (EnableStoredProcedureCompatMode && npgsqlParameter.Direction == ParameterDirection.Output)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						else
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(", ");
						}
						if (npgsqlParameter.IsPositional)
						{
							if (flag2)
							{
								ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentException(NpgsqlStrings.PositionalParameterAfterNamed);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							flag2 = true;
							stringBuilder.Append('"').Append(npgsqlParameter.TrimmedName.Replace("\"", "\"\"")).Append("\" := ");
						}
						if (npgsqlParameter.Direction == ParameterDirection.Output)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append("NULL");
							continue;
						}
						list.Add(npgsqlParameter);
						stringBuilder.Append('$').Append(list.Count);
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(')');
				if (batchCommand == null)
				{
					batchCommand = TruncateStatementsToOne();
				}
				batchCommand.FinalCommandText = stringBuilder.ToString();
				batchCommand._parameters = npgsqlParameterCollection;
				batchCommand.PositionalParameters.AddRange(list);
				ValidateParameterCount(batchCommand);
				break;
			}
			default:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("CommandType", "Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected value {0} of enum CommandType. Please file a bug.", commandType2);
				break;
			}
			static void ValidateParameterCount(NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand)
			{
				if (npgsqlBatchCommand.HasParameters && npgsqlBatchCommand.PositionalParameters.Count > 65535)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlException("A statement cannot have more than 65535 parameters");
				}
			}
		}

		private void BeginSend(NpgsqlConnector connector)

		internal Task Write(NpgsqlConnector connector, bool async, bool flush, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if ((_behavior & CommandBehavior.SchemaOnly) != CommandBehavior.Default)
			{
				return WriteExecuteSchemaOnly(connector, async, flush, cancellationToken);
			}

			async Task WriteExecute(NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector, bool async2, bool flag, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{

						}

					}
					await npgsqlConnector.WriteExecute(0, async2, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					if (batchCommand.AppendErrorBarrier ?? EnableErrorBarriers)
					{

					}

				}
				if (batchCommand == null || !(batchCommand.AppendErrorBarrier ?? EnableErrorBarriers))
				{

				}
				if (flag)

				}
			}
			async Task WriteExecuteSchemaOnly(NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector, bool async2, bool flag, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				bool wroteSomething = false;
				bool syncCaller = !async2;

					}

					if (preparedStatement == null || preparedStatement.State != PreparedState.Prepared)

		private async Task SendDeriveParameters(NpgsqlConnector connector, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			BeginSend(connector);
			bool syncCaller = !async;
			for (int i = 0; i < InternalBatchCommands.Count; i++)
			{
				if (syncCaller && ShouldSchedule(ref async, i))
				{
					await new TaskSchedulerAwaitable(ConstrainedConcurrencyScheduler);
				}
				NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand = InternalBatchCommands[i];
				await connector.WriteParse(npgsqlBatchCommand.FinalCommandText, Array.Empty<byte>(), NpgsqlBatchCommand.EmptyParameters, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await connector.WriteDescribe(StatementOrPortal.Statement, Array.Empty<byte>(), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			await connector.WriteSync(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		private async Task SendPrepare(NpgsqlConnector connector, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			BeginSend(connector);
			bool syncCaller = !async;
			for (int i = 0; i < InternalBatchCommands.Count; i++)
			{
				if (syncCaller && ShouldSchedule(ref async, i))
				{
					await new TaskSchedulerAwaitable(ConstrainedConcurrencyScheduler);
				}
				NpgsqlBatchCommand batchCommand = InternalBatchCommands[i];
				PreparedStatement pStatement = batchCommand.PreparedStatement;
				if (batchCommand.IsPreparing)
				{
					PreparedStatement statementBeingReplaced = pStatement.StatementBeingReplaced;
					if (statementBeingReplaced != null)
					{
						await connector.WriteClose(StatementOrPortal.Statement, statementBeingReplaced.Name, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					await connector.WriteParse(batchCommand.FinalCommandText, pStatement.Name, batchCommand.CurrentParametersReadOnly, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await connector.WriteDescribe(StatementOrPortal.Statement, pStatement.Name, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}
			await connector.WriteSync(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private bool ShouldSchedule(ref bool async, int indexOfStatementInBatch)
		{
			if (indexOfStatementInBatch <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			async = true;
			return TaskScheduler.Current != ConstrainedConcurrencyScheduler;
		}

		private async Task SendClose(NpgsqlConnector connector, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			BeginSend(connector);
			foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand batchCommand in InternalBatchCommands)
			{
				if (batchCommand.IsPrepared)
				{
					await connector.WriteClose(StatementOrPortal.Statement, batchCommand.StatementName, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					batchCommand.PreparedStatement.State = PreparedState.BeingUnprepared;
				}
			}
			await connector.WriteSync(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private async Task<int> ExecuteNonQuery(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			NpgsqlDataReader reader = await ExecuteReader(async, CommandBehavior.Default, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			int recordsAffected;
			try
			{
				while ((!async) ? reader.NextResult() : (await reader.NextResultAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)))
				{
				}
				recordsAffected = reader.RecordsAffected;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await reader.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					reader.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return recordsAffected;
		}

		public override void Cancel()
		{
			if (State == CommandState.InProgress)
			{
				(Connection?.Connector ?? _connector)?.PerformUserCancellation();
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			ResetTransaction();
			State = CommandState.Disposed;
			if (IsCacheable && InternalConnection != null && InternalConnection.CachedCommand == null)
			{
				Reset();
				InternalConnection.CachedCommand = this;
			}
			else
			{
				IsCacheable = false;
			}
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			_commandText = string.Empty;
			CommandType = CommandType.Text;
			_parameters?.Clear();
			_timeout = null;
			_allResultTypesAreUnknown = false;
			EnableErrorBarriers = false;
		}

		internal void ResetTransaction()
		{
			_transaction = null;
		}

		internal void TraceCommandStart(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			if (NpgsqlActivitySource.IsEnabled)
			{
				CurrentActivity = NpgsqlActivitySource.CommandStart(connector, CommandText, CommandType);
			}
		}

		internal void TraceReceivedFirstResponse()
		{
			if (CurrentActivity != null)
			{
				NpgsqlActivitySource.ReceivedFirstResponse(CurrentActivity);
			}
		}

		internal void TraceCommandStop()
		{
			if (CurrentActivity != null)
			{
				NpgsqlActivitySource.CommandStop(CurrentActivity);
				CurrentActivity = null;
			}
		}

		internal void TraceSetException(Exception e)
		{
			if (CurrentActivity != null)
			{
				NpgsqlActivitySource.SetException(CurrentActivity, e);
				CurrentActivity = null;
			}
		}

		private NpgsqlBatchCommand TruncateStatementsToOne()
		{
			switch (InternalBatchCommands.Count)
			{
			case 0:
			{
				NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand = new NpgsqlBatchCommand();
				InternalBatchCommands.Add(npgsqlBatchCommand);
				return npgsqlBatchCommand;
			}
			case 1:
			{
				NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand = InternalBatchCommands[0];
				npgsqlBatchCommand.Reset();
				return npgsqlBatchCommand;
			}
			default:
			{
				NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand = InternalBatchCommands[0];
				npgsqlBatchCommand.Reset();
				InternalBatchCommands.Clear();
				InternalBatchCommands.Add(npgsqlBatchCommand);
				return npgsqlBatchCommand;
			}
			}
		}

		internal void FixupRowDescription(RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription, bool isFirst)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rowDescription.Count; i++)
			{
				rowDescription[i].DataFormat = (((UnknownResultTypeList == null || !isFirst) ? AllResultTypesAreUnknown : UnknownResultTypeList[i]) ? DataFormat.Text : DataFormat.Binary);
			}
		}

		internal void LogExecutingCompleted(NpgsqlConnector connector, bool executing)
		{
			bool flag = connector.LoggingConfiguration.IsParameterLoggingEnabled || connector.Settings.LogParameters;

					{
						LogMessages.CommandExecutionCompletedWithParameters(commandLogger, npgsqlBatchCommand.FinalCommandText, ParametersDbNullAsString(npgsqlBatchCommand), connector.QueryLogStopWatch.ElapsedMilliseconds, connector.Id);

					LogMessages.ExecutingCommand(commandLogger, npgsqlBatchCommand.FinalCommandText, connector.Id);

				{

				}

			else if (flag)
			{
				(string, object[])[] array = new(string, object[])[InternalBatchCommands.Count];

				{
					array[i] = (InternalBatchCommands[i].FinalCommandText, ParametersDbNullAsString(InternalBatchCommands[i]));
				}
				if (executing)
				{
					LogMessages.ExecutingBatchWithParameters(commandLogger, array, connector.Id);
				}
				else
				{
					LogMessages.BatchExecutionCompletedWithParameters(commandLogger, array, connector.QueryLogStopWatch.ElapsedMilliseconds, connector.Id);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				string[] array2 = new string[InternalBatchCommands.Count];
				for (int j = 0; j < InternalBatchCommands.Count; j++)
				{
					array2[j] = InternalBatchCommands[j].FinalCommandText;
				}
				if (executing)
				{
					LogMessages.ExecutingBatch(commandLogger, array2, connector.Id);
				}
				else
				{
					LogMessages.BatchExecutionCompleted(commandLogger, array2, connector.QueryLogStopWatch.ElapsedMilliseconds, connector.Id);
				}
			}
			static object[] ParametersDbNullAsString(NpgsqlBatchCommand c)
			{
				List<NpgsqlParameter> currentParametersReadOnly = c.CurrentParametersReadOnly;
				object[] array3 = new object[currentParametersReadOnly.Count];
				for (int k = 0; k < currentParametersReadOnly.Count; k++)
				{
					array3[k] = ((currentParametersReadOnly[k].Value == DBNull.Value) ? "NULL" : currentParametersReadOnly[k].Value);
				}
				return array3;
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public virtual NpgsqlCommand Clone()
		{
			NpgsqlCommand npgsqlCommand = new NpgsqlCommand(CommandText, InternalConnection, Transaction)
			{
				CommandTimeout = CommandTimeout,
				CommandType = CommandType,
				DesignTimeVisible = DesignTimeVisible,
				_allResultTypesAreUnknown = _allResultTypesAreUnknown,
				_unknownResultTypeList = _unknownResultTypeList
			};
			_parameters?.CloneTo(npgsqlCommand.Parameters);
			return npgsqlCommand;
		}

		private NpgsqlConnection? CheckAndGetConnection()
		{
			if (State == CommandState.Disposed)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException(GetType().FullName);
			}
			NpgsqlConnection internalConnection = InternalConnection;
			if (internalConnection == null)
			{
				if (_connector == null)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Connection property has not been initialized.");
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (!internalConnection.FullState.HasFlag(ConnectionState.Open))
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Connection is not open");
			}
			return internalConnection;
		}
	}
	internal enum CommandState
	{
		Idle,
		InProgress,
		Disposed
	}

		public override string QuotePrefix
		{
			get
			{
				return base.QuotePrefix;
			}
			[param: AllowNull]
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					base.QuotePrefix = value;
				}
				else
				{
					base.QuotePrefix = "\"";
				}
			}
		}

		public override string QuoteSuffix
		{
			get
			{
				return base.QuoteSuffix;
			}
			[param: AllowNull]
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					base.QuoteSuffix = value;
				}
				else
				{
					base.QuoteSuffix = "\"";
				}
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlCommandBuilder()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		{
			base.DataAdapter = adapter;
			QuotePrefix = "\"";
			QuoteSuffix = "\"";
		}

		public static void DeriveParameters(NpgsqlCommand command)
		{
			command.DeriveParameters();
		}

		}

			obj.UpdatedRowSource = UpdateRowSource.None;
			return obj;
		}

		protected override void ApplyParameterInfo(DbParameter p, DataRow row, System.Data.StatementType statementType, bool whereClause)
		{
			((NpgsqlParameter)p).NpgsqlDbType = (NpgsqlDbType)row[SchemaTableColumn.ProviderType];
		}

		protected override string GetParameterName(int parameterOrdinal)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "@p{0}", parameterOrdinal);
		}

		protected override string GetParameterName(string parameterName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "@{0}", parameterName);
		}

		protected override string GetParameterPlaceholder(int parameterOrdinal)
		{
			return GetParameterName(parameterOrdinal);
		}

		protected override void SetRowUpdatingHandler(DbDataAdapter adapter)
		{
			if (!(adapter is NpgsqlDataAdapter npgsqlDataAdapter))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("adapter needs to be a NpgsqlDataAdapter", "adapter");
			}
			if (adapter == base.DataAdapter)
			{
				npgsqlDataAdapter.RowUpdating -= RowUpdatingHandler;
			}
			else
			{
				npgsqlDataAdapter.RowUpdating += RowUpdatingHandler;
			}
		}

		private void RowUpdatingHandler(object sender, NpgsqlRowUpdatingEventArgs e)
		{
			RowUpdatingHandler(e);
		}

		public override string QuoteIdentifier(string unquotedIdentifier)
		{
			if (unquotedIdentifier != null)
			{
				return QuotePrefix + unquotedIdentifier.Replace(QuotePrefix, QuotePrefix + QuotePrefix) + QuoteSuffix;
			}
			throw new ArgumentNullException("unquotedIdentifier", "Unquoted identifier parameter cannot be null");
		}

		public override string UnquoteIdentifier(string quotedIdentifier)
		{
			if (quotedIdentifier == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("quotedIdentifier", "Quoted identifier parameter cannot be null");
			}
			string text = quotedIdentifier.Trim().Replace(QuotePrefix + QuotePrefix, QuotePrefix);
			if (text.StartsWith(QuotePrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				text = text.Remove(0, 1);
			}
			if (text.EndsWith(QuoteSuffix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				text = text.Remove(text.Length - 1, 1);
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public ConnectionState FullState
		{
			get
			{
				if (_fullState != ConnectionState.Open)
				{
					return _fullState;
				}
				if (Connector == null)
				{
					return ConnectionState.Open;
				}
				switch (Connector.State)
				{
				case ConnectorState.Ready:
					return ConnectionState.Open;
				case ConnectorState.Executing:
					return ConnectionState.Open | ConnectionState.Executing;
				case ConnectorState.Fetching:
				case ConnectorState.Waiting:
				case ConnectorState.Copy:
				case ConnectorState.Replication:
					return ConnectionState.Open | ConnectionState.Fetching;
				case ConnectorState.Connecting:
					return ConnectionState.Connecting;
				case ConnectorState.Broken:
					return ConnectionState.Broken;
				case ConnectorState.Closed:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Internal Npgsql bug: connection is in state Open but connector is in state Closed");
					return ConnectionState.Broken;
				default:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected value {0} of enum ConnectorState. Please file a bug.", Connector.State);
					return ConnectionState.Broken;
				}
			}
			internal set
			{
				if ((value < ConnectionState.Closed || value > ConnectionState.Broken) ? true : false)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", "Unknown connection state", value);
				}
				bool flag = _fullState.HasFlag(ConnectionState.Open);
				_fullState = value;
				bool flag2 = _fullState.HasFlag(ConnectionState.Open);
				if (flag2 != flag)
				{
					OnStateChange(flag2 ? ClosedToOpenEventArgs : OpenToClosedEventArgs);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public override ConnectionState State
		{
			get
			{
				ConnectionState fullState = FullState;
				if (fullState.HasFlag(ConnectionState.Connecting))
				{
					return ConnectionState.Connecting;
				}
				if (fullState.HasFlag(ConnectionState.Open))
				{
					return ConnectionState.Open;
				}
				return ConnectionState.Closed;
			}
		}

		private void SetupDataSource()
		{
			if (PoolManager.Pools.TryGetValue(_connectionString, out _dataSource))
			{
				Settings = _dataSource.Settings;
				return;
			}
			if (_connectionString == string.Empty)
			{
				Settings = DefaultSettings;
				_dataSource = null;
				return;
			}
			NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder = new NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(_connectionString);
			npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.PostProcessAndValidate();
			Settings = npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder;
			string connectionStringForMultipleHosts = npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionStringForMultipleHosts;
			if (PoolManager.Pools.TryGetValue(connectionStringForMultipleHosts, out _dataSource))
			{
				if (_dataSource is NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource npgsqlMultiHostDataSource && npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.TargetSessionAttributesParsed.HasValue)
				{
					_dataSource = npgsqlMultiHostDataSource.WithTargetSession(npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.TargetSessionAttributesParsed.Value);
				}
				_dataSource = PoolManager.Pools.GetOrAdd(_connectionString, _dataSource);
				return;
			}
			NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder npgsqlDataSourceBuilder = new NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(connectionStringForMultipleHosts);
			npgsqlDataSourceBuilder.UseLoggerFactory(NpgsqlLoggingConfiguration.GlobalLoggerFactory);
			npgsqlDataSourceBuilder.EnableParameterLogging(NpgsqlLoggingConfiguration.GlobalIsParameterLoggingEnabled);
			NpgsqlDataSource npgsqlDataSource = npgsqlDataSourceBuilder.Build();
			_cloningInstantiator = (string s) => new NpgsqlConnection(s);
			_dataSource = PoolManager.Pools.GetOrAdd(connectionStringForMultipleHosts, npgsqlDataSource);
			if (_dataSource == npgsqlDataSource)
			{
				if (_dataSource is NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource { Pools: var pools })
				{
					foreach (NpgsqlDataSource dataSource in pools)
					{
						NpgsqlEventSource.Log.DataSourceCreated(dataSource);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					NpgsqlEventSource.Log.DataSourceCreated(npgsqlDataSource);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				npgsqlDataSource.Dispose();
			}
			if (_dataSource is NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource npgsqlMultiHostDataSource3 && npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.TargetSessionAttributesParsed.HasValue)
			{
				_dataSource = npgsqlMultiHostDataSource3.WithTargetSession(npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.TargetSessionAttributesParsed.Value);
			}
			_dataSource = PoolManager.Pools.GetOrAdd(_connectionString, _dataSource);
		}

		internal Task Open(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			CheckClosed();
			if (_dataSource == null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("The ConnectionString property has not been initialized.");
			}
			_userFacingConnectionString = _dataSource.ConnectionString;
			_connectionLogger = _dataSource.LoggingConfiguration.ConnectionLogger;
			if (_connectionLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace))
			{
				LogMessages.OpeningConnection(_connectionLogger, Settings.Host, Settings.Port, Settings.Database, _userFacingConnectionString);
			}
			if (Settings.Multiplexing)
			{
				if (Settings.Enlist && Transaction.Current != null)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException();
				}
				if (!_dataSource.IsBootstrapped)
				{
					FullState = ConnectionState.Connecting;
					return PerformMultiplexingStartupCheck(async, cancellationToken);
				}
				if (_connectionLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug))
				{
					LogMessages.OpenedMultiplexingConnection(_connectionLogger, Settings.Host, Settings.Port, Settings.Database, _userFacingConnectionString);
				}
				FullState = ConnectionState.Open;
				return Task.CompletedTask;
			}
			return OpenAsync(async, cancellationToken);
			async Task OpenAsync(bool async2, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				FullState = ConnectionState.Connecting;
				NpgsqlConnector connector = null;
				try
				{
					TimeSpan expiration = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(ConnectionTimeout);
					NpgsqlTimeout timeout = new NpgsqlTimeout(expiration);
					Transaction enlistToTransaction = (Settings.Enlist ? Transaction.Current : null);
					if ((object)enlistToTransaction != null && _dataSource.TryRentEnlistedPending(enlistToTransaction, this, out connector))
					{
						EnlistedTransaction = enlistToTransaction;
						enlistToTransaction = null;
					}
					else
					{
						connector = await _dataSource.Get(this, timeout, async2, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					ConnectorBindingScope = ConnectorBindingScope.Connection;
					connector.Connection = this;
					Connector = connector;
					if ((object)enlistToTransaction != null)
					{
						EnlistTransaction(enlistToTransaction);
					}
					LogMessages.OpenedConnection(_connectionLogger, Host, Port, Database, _userFacingConnectionString, connector.Id);
					FullState = ConnectionState.Open;
				}
				catch
				{
					FullState = ConnectionState.Closed;
					ConnectorBindingScope = ConnectorBindingScope.None;
					Connector = null;
					EnlistedTransaction = null;
					if (connector != null)
					{
						connector.Connection = null;
						connector.Return();
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
			async Task PerformMultiplexingStartupCheck(bool async2, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				try
				{
					NpgsqlTimeout timeout = new NpgsqlTimeout(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(ConnectionTimeout));
					await StartBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Connection, timeout, async2, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Connection);
					LogMessages.OpenedMultiplexingConnection(_connectionLogger, Settings.Host, Settings.Port, Settings.Database, _userFacingConnectionString);
					FullState = ConnectionState.Open;
				}
				catch
				{
					FullState = ConnectionState.Closed;
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

				return cachedCommand;

		}

		public new NpgsqlTransaction BeginTransaction()
