		}

		public new NpgsqlTransaction BeginTransaction(System.Data.IsolationLevel level)
		{
			return BeginTransaction(async: false, level, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		private async ValueTask<NpgsqlTransaction> BeginTransaction(bool async, System.Data.IsolationLevel level, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (level == System.Data.IsolationLevel.Chaos)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Unsupported IsolationLevel: Chaos");
			}
			CheckReady();
			NpgsqlConnector connector = Connector;
			if (connector != null && connector.InTransaction)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("A transaction is already in progress; nested/concurrent transactions aren't supported.");
			}
			connector = ((ConnectorBindingScope != ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction) ? (await StartBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction, NpgsqlTimeout.Infinite, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)) : Connector);
			NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector = connector;
			try
			{
				using (npgsqlConnector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken))
				{
					connector = npgsqlConnector;
					if (connector.Transaction == null)
					{
						connector.Transaction = new NpgsqlTransaction(npgsqlConnector);
					}
					npgsqlConnector.Transaction.Init(level);
					return npgsqlConnector.Transaction;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction);
				throw;
			}
		}

		public override void EnlistTransaction(Transaction? transaction)
		{
			if (Settings.Multiplexing)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Ambient transactions aren't yet implemented for multiplexing");
			}
			if (EnlistedTransaction != null)
			{
				if (EnlistedTransaction.Equals(transaction))
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					if (EnlistedTransaction.TransactionInformation.Status == System.Transactions.TransactionStatus.Active)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Already enlisted to transaction (localid=" + EnlistedTransaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier + ")");
					}
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
			}
			CheckReady();
			NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector = StartBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction);
			EnlistedTransaction = transaction;
			if (transaction == null)
			{
				EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction);
				return;
			}
			VolatileResourceManager volatileResourceManager = new VolatileResourceManager(this, transaction);
			transaction.EnlistVolatile(volatileResourceManager, EnlistmentOptions.None);
			volatileResourceManager.Init();
			EnlistedTransaction = transaction;
			LogMessages.EnlistedVolatileResourceManager(Connector.LoggingConfiguration.TransactionLogger, transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier, npgsqlConnector.Id);
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			Close(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public new Task CloseAsync()
		{
			return Close(async: true);
		}

		internal bool TakeCloseLock()
		{
			return Interlocked.Exchange(ref _closing, 1) == 0;
		}

		internal void ReleaseCloseLock()
		{
			Volatile.Write(ref _closing, 0);
		}

		internal Task Close(bool async)
		{
			if (!TakeCloseLock())
			{
				return Task.CompletedTask;
			}
			switch (FullState)
			{
			case ConnectionState.Broken:
				FullState = ConnectionState.Closed;
				goto case ConnectionState.Closed;
			case ConnectionState.Closed:
				ReleaseCloseLock();
				return Task.CompletedTask;
			case ConnectionState.Connecting:
				ReleaseCloseLock();
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't close, connection is in state " + FullState);
			default:
				ReleaseCloseLock();
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Unknown connection state: " + FullState);
			case ConnectionState.Open:
			case ConnectionState.Open | ConnectionState.Executing:
			case ConnectionState.Open | ConnectionState.Fetching:
				if (Settings.Multiplexing && ConnectorBindingScope == ConnectorBindingScope.None)
				{
					ReleaseCloseLock();
					FullState = ConnectionState.Closed;
					LogMessages.ClosedMultiplexingConnection(_connectionLogger, Settings.Host, Settings.Port, Settings.Database, _userFacingConnectionString);
					return Task.CompletedTask;
				}
				return CloseAsync(async);
			}
		}

		private async Task CloseAsync(bool async)
		{
			_ = 1;
			try
			{
				NpgsqlConnector connector = Connector;
				LogMessages.ClosingConnection(_connectionLogger, Settings.Host, Settings.Port, Settings.Database, _userFacingConnectionString, connector.Id);
				if (connector.CurrentReader != null || connector.CurrentCopyOperation != null)
				{
					await connector.CloseOngoingOperations(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					if (ConnectorBindingScope == ConnectorBindingScope.None)
					{
						FullState = ConnectionState.Closed;
						LogMessages.ClosedMultiplexingConnection(_connectionLogger, Settings.Host, Settings.Port, Settings.Database, _userFacingConnectionString);
						return;
					}
				}
				if (EnlistedTransaction != null)
				{
					connector.Connection = null;
					_dataSource?.AddPendingEnlistedConnector(connector, EnlistedTransaction);
					EnlistedTransaction = null;
				}
				else
				{
					if (Settings.Pooling)
					{
						await connector.Reset(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						connector.Transaction?.UnbindIfNecessary();
					}
					if (!Settings.Multiplexing)
					{
						connector.Connection = null;
						connector.Return();
					}
				}
				LogMessages.ClosedConnection(_connectionLogger, Settings.Host, Settings.Port, Settings.Database, _userFacingConnectionString, connector.Id);
				Connector = null;
				ConnectorBindingScope = ConnectorBindingScope.None;
				FullState = ConnectionState.Closed;
			}
			finally
			{
				ReleaseCloseLock();
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!_disposed)
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					Close();
				}
				_disposed = true;
			}
		}

		public new async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			if (!_disposed)
			{
				await CloseAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				_disposed = true;
			}
		}

		internal void MakeDisposed()
		{
			_disposed = true;
		}

		internal void OnNotice(PostgresNotice e)

			{
				this.Notice?.Invoke(this, new NpgsqlNoticeEventArgs(e));

				LogMessages.CaughtUserExceptionInNoticeEventHandler(_connectionLogger, exception);
			}
		}

			try
			{
				this.Notification?.Invoke(this, e);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				LogMessages.CaughtUserExceptionInNotificationEventHandler(_connectionLogger, exception);
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlBinaryImporter BeginBinaryImport(string copyFromCommand)
		{
			return BeginBinaryImport(async: false, copyFromCommand, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task<NpgsqlBinaryImporter> BeginBinaryImportAsync(string copyFromCommand, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return BeginBinaryImport(async: true, copyFromCommand, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task<NpgsqlBinaryImporter> BeginBinaryImport(bool async, string copyFromCommand, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (copyFromCommand == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("copyFromCommand");
			}
			if (!IsValidCopyCommand(copyFromCommand))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Must contain a COPY FROM STDIN command!", "copyFromCommand");
			}
			CheckReady();
			NpgsqlConnector connector = StartBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Copy);
			LogMessages.StartingBinaryImport(connector.LoggingConfiguration.CopyLogger, connector.Id);
			connector.StartUserAction(ConnectorState.Copy, default(CancellationToken), attemptPgCancellation: false);
			try
			{
				NpgsqlBinaryImporter importer = new NpgsqlBinaryImporter(connector);
				await importer.Init(copyFromCommand, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				connector.CurrentCopyOperation = importer;
				return importer;
			}
			catch
			{
				connector.EndUserAction();
				EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Copy);
				throw;
			}
		}

			if (copyFromCommand == null)

		public NpgsqlRawCopyStream BeginRawBinaryCopy(string copyCommand)
		{
			return BeginRawBinaryCopy(async: false, copyCommand, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task<NpgsqlRawCopyStream> BeginRawBinaryCopyAsync(string copyCommand, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return BeginRawBinaryCopy(async: true, copyCommand, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task<NpgsqlRawCopyStream> BeginRawBinaryCopy(bool async, string copyCommand, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (copyCommand == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("copyCommand");
			}
			if (!IsValidCopyCommand(copyCommand))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Must contain a COPY TO STDOUT OR COPY FROM STDIN command!", "copyCommand");
			}
			CheckReady();
			NpgsqlConnector connector = StartBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Copy);
			LogMessages.StartingRawCopy(connector.LoggingConfiguration.CopyLogger, connector.Id);
			connector.StartUserAction(ConnectorState.Copy, default(CancellationToken), attemptPgCancellation: false);
			try
			{
				NpgsqlRawCopyStream stream = new NpgsqlRawCopyStream(connector);
				await stream.Init(copyCommand, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (!stream.IsBinary)
				{
					throw connector.Break(new ArgumentException("copyToCommand triggered a text transfer, only binary is allowed", "copyCommand"));
				}
				connector.CurrentCopyOperation = stream;
				return stream;
			}
			catch
			{
				connector.EndUserAction();
				EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Copy);
				throw;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsValidCopyCommand(string copyCommand)
		{
			return copyCommand.TrimStart(Array.Empty<char>()).StartsWith("COPY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		public bool Wait(int timeout)
		{
			if (timeout != -1 && timeout < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Argument must be -1, 0 or positive", "timeout");
			}
			if (Settings.Multiplexing)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Wait isn't supported in multiplexing mode");
			}
			CheckReady();
			LogMessages.StartingWait(_connectionLogger, timeout, Connector.Id);
			return Connector.Wait(async: false, timeout, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public bool Wait(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return Wait((int)timeout.TotalMilliseconds);
		}

		public void Wait()
		{
			Wait(0);
		}

		public Task<bool> WaitAsync(int timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (Settings.Multiplexing)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Wait isn't supported in multiplexing mode");
			}
			CheckReady();
			LogMessages.StartingWait(_connectionLogger, timeout, Connector.Id);
			return Connector.Wait(async: true, timeout, cancellationToken);
		}

		public Task<bool> WaitAsync(TimeSpan timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return WaitAsync((int)timeout.TotalMilliseconds, cancellationToken);
		}

		public Task WaitAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return WaitAsync(0, cancellationToken);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private void CheckOpen()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			switch (FullState)
			{
			case ConnectionState.Open:
			case ConnectionState.Connecting:
			case ConnectionState.Open | ConnectionState.Executing:
			case ConnectionState.Open | ConnectionState.Fetching:
				break;
			case ConnectionState.Closed:
			case ConnectionState.Broken:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Connection is not open");
				break;
			default:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void CheckClosed()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			ConnectionState fullState = FullState;
			if (fullState == ConnectionState.Connecting || fullState.HasFlag(ConnectionState.Open))
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Connection already open");
			}
		}

		private void CheckDisposed()
		{
			if (_disposed)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException("NpgsqlConnection");
			}
		}

		internal void CheckReady()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			switch (FullState)
			{
			case ConnectionState.Open:
			case ConnectionState.Connecting:
				break;
			case ConnectionState.Closed:
			case ConnectionState.Broken:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Connection is not open");
				break;
			case ConnectionState.Open | ConnectionState.Executing:
			case ConnectionState.Open | ConnectionState.Fetching:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Connection is busy");
				break;
			default:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				break;
			}
		}

		internal bool TryGetBoundConnector([NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? connector)
		{
			if (ConnectorBindingScope == ConnectorBindingScope.None)
			{
				connector = null;
				return false;
			}
			connector = Connector;
			return true;
		}

		internal ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector> StartBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope scope, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (ConnectorBindingScope != ConnectorBindingScope.None)
			{
				return new ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector>(Connector);
			}
			return StartBindingScopeAsync();
			async ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector> StartBindingScopeAsync()
			{
				try
				{
					NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector = await _dataSource.Get(this, timeout, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					Connector = npgsqlConnector;
					npgsqlConnector.Connection = this;
					ConnectorBindingScope = scope;
					return npgsqlConnector;
				}
				catch
				{
					FullState = ConnectionState.Broken;
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		internal NpgsqlConnector StartBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope scope)
		{
			return StartBindingScope(scope, NpgsqlTimeout.Infinite, async: false, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		internal EndScopeDisposable StartTemporaryBindingScope(out NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			connector = StartBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Temporary);
			return new EndScopeDisposable(this);
		}

		internal T CheckOpenAndRunInTemporaryScope<T>(Func<NpgsqlConnector, T> func)
		{
			CheckOpen();
			NpgsqlConnector connector;
			using (StartTemporaryBindingScope(out connector))
			{
				return func(connector);
			}
		}

		internal void EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope scope)
		{
			if (scope == ConnectorBindingScope)
			{
				NpgsqlConnector? connector = Connector;
				Connector = null;
				connector.Connection = null;
				connector.Transaction?.UnbindIfNecessary();
				connector.Return();
				ConnectorBindingScope = ConnectorBindingScope.None;
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			NpgsqlConnection obj = ((_dataSource == null) ? _cloningInstantiator(_connectionString) : _dataSource.CreateConnection());
			obj.ProvideClientCertificatesCallback = ProvideClientCertificatesCallback;
			obj.UserCertificateValidationCallback = UserCertificateValidationCallback;
			obj.ProvidePasswordCallback = ProvidePasswordCallback;
			obj._userFacingConnectionString = _userFacingConnectionString;
			return obj;
		}

		public NpgsqlConnection CloneWith(string connectionString)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder = new NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString);
			NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder2 = npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder;
			if (npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder2.Password == null)
			{
				string text = (npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder2.Password = _dataSource?.GetPassword(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult());
			}
			if (npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.PersistSecurityInfo && !Settings.PersistSecurityInfo)
			{
				npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.PersistSecurityInfo = false;
			}
			NpgsqlConnection npgsqlConnection = new NpgsqlConnection(npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.ToString());
			object obj = ProvideClientCertificatesCallback;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				Action<X509CertificateCollection> clientCertificatesCallback = _dataSource?.ClientCertificatesCallback;
				obj = ((clientCertificatesCallback != null) ? ((ProvideClientCertificatesCallback)delegate(X509CertificateCollection certs)
				{
					clientCertificatesCallback(certs);
				}) : null);
			}
			npgsqlConnection.ProvideClientCertificatesCallback = (ProvideClientCertificatesCallback?)obj;
			npgsqlConnection.UserCertificateValidationCallback = UserCertificateValidationCallback ?? _dataSource?.UserCertificateValidationCallback;
			npgsqlConnection.ProvidePasswordCallback = ProvidePasswordCallback;
			return npgsqlConnection;
		}

		public override void ChangeDatabase(string dbName)
		{
			if (dbName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dbName");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dbName", dbName, "Invalid database name: " + dbName);
			}
			CheckOpen();
			Close();
			_dataSource = null;
			Settings = Settings.Clone();
			Settings.Database = dbName;
			ConnectionString = Settings.ToString();
			Open();
		}

		public static void ClearPool(NpgsqlConnection connection)
		{
			PoolManager.Clear(connection._connectionString);
		}

		public static void ClearAllPools()
		{
			PoolManager.ClearAll();
		}

		public void UnprepareAll()
		{
			if (Settings.Multiplexing)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Explicit preparation not supported with multiplexing");
			}
			CheckReady();
			using (Connector.StartUserAction())
			{
				Connector.UnprepareAll();
			}
		}

		public void ReloadTypes()
		{
			CheckReady();
			NpgsqlConnector connector;
			using (StartTemporaryBindingScope(out connector))
			{
				_dataSource.Bootstrap(connector, NpgsqlTimeout.Infinite, forceReload: true, async: false, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			}
		}

		public async Task ReloadTypesAsync()
		{
			CheckReady();
			NpgsqlConnector connector;
			using (StartTemporaryBindingScope(out connector))
			{
				await _dataSource.Bootstrap(connector, NpgsqlTimeout.Infinite, forceReload: true, async: true, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
		}

	{
		None,
		Connection,
		Transaction,
		Copy,
		Reader,
		Temporary
	}
	internal readonly struct EndScopeDisposable : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly NpgsqlConnection _connection;

		public EndScopeDisposable(NpgsqlConnection connection)
		{
			_connection = connection;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			_connection.EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Temporary);
		}
	}

		internal string? DataSourceCached
		{
			get
			{
				string socketPath;
				return _dataSourceCached ?? (_dataSourceCached = ((_host == null || _host.Contains(",")) ? null : (IsUnixSocket(_host, _port, out socketPath, replaceForAbstract: false) ? socketPath : $"tcp://{_host}:{_port}")));
			}
		}

		internal TimeSpan HostRecheckSecondsTranslated => TimeSpan.FromSeconds((HostRecheckSeconds == 0) ? (-1) : HostRecheckSeconds);

		public override object this[string keyword]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!TryGetValue(keyword, out object value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Keyword not supported: " + keyword, "keyword");
				}
				return value;
			}
			[param: AllowNull]
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					Remove(keyword);
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					object value2 = value;
					GeneratedActions(GeneratedAction.Set, keyword.ToUpperInvariant(), ref value2);
				}
				catch (Exception innerException)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Couldn't set " + keyword, keyword, innerException);
				}
			}
		}

		object? IDictionary<string, object>.this[string keyword]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[keyword];
			}
			set
			{
				this[keyword] = value;
			}
		}

		[Category("Failover and load balancing")]
		[Description("Determines the preferred PostgreSQL target server type.")]
		[DisplayName("Target Session Attributes")]
		[NpgsqlConnectionStringProperty]
		public string? TargetSessionAttributes
		{
			get
			{
				return TargetSessionAttributesParsed switch
				{
					Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.Any => "any", 
					Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.Primary => "primary", 
					Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.Standby => "standby", 
					Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.PreferPrimary => "prefer-primary", 
					Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.PreferStandby => "prefer-standby", 
					Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.ReadWrite => "read-write", 
					Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.ReadOnly => "read-only", 
					null => null, 
					_ => throw new ArgumentException($"Unhandled enum value '{TargetSessionAttributesParsed}'"), 
				};
			}
			set
			{
				TargetSessionAttributesParsed = ((value == null) ? ((TargetSessionAttributes?)null) : new TargetSessionAttributes?(ParseTargetSessionAttributes(value)));
				SetValue("TargetSessionAttributes", value);
			}
		}

		internal TargetSessionAttributes? TargetSessionAttributesParsed { get; set; }

				SetValue("AutoPrepareMinUsages", value);
			}

				SetValue("InternalCommandTimeout", value);
			}

		internal string ConnectionStringForMultipleHosts
		{
			get
			{
				NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder = Clone();
				npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder["TargetSessionAttributes"] = null;
				return npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
			}
		}

		public new ICollection<string> Keys
		{
			get
			{
				string[] array = new string[base.Keys.Count];
				int num = 0;
				foreach (object key in base.Keys)
				{
					array[num++] = (string)key;
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public new ICollection<object?> Values
		{
			get
			{
				object[] array = new object[base.Keys.Count];
				int num = 0;
				foreach (object value in base.Values)
				{
					array[num++] = value;
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder()
		{
			Init();
		}

		public NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(bool useOdbcRules)
			: base(useOdbcRules)
		{
			Init();
		}

		public NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(string? connectionString)
		{
			Init();
			base.ConnectionString = connectionString;
		}

		private int Init()
		{
			Port = 5432;
			Enlist = true;
			Encoding = "UTF8";
			SslMode = SslMode.Prefer;
			KerberosServiceName = "postgres";
			ChannelBinding = ChannelBinding.Prefer;
			Pooling = true;
			MinPoolSize = 0;
			MaxPoolSize = 100;
			ConnectionIdleLifetime = 300;
			ConnectionPruningInterval = 10;
			Timeout = 15;
			CommandTimeout = 30;
			CancellationTimeout = 2000;
			HostRecheckSeconds = 10;
			ReadBufferSize = 8192;
			WriteBufferSize = 8192;
			AutoPrepareMinUsages = 5;
			Multiplexing = false;
			WriteCoalescingBufferThresholdBytes = 1000;
			base.Clear();
			return 0;
		}

			string[] array = (string[])Keys;

				Remove(keyword);
			}
		}

		}

		public bool Contains(KeyValuePair<string, object?> item)
		{
			if (TryGetValue(item.Key, out object value))
			{
				if (value != null || item.Value != null)
				{
					return value?.Equals(item.Value) ?? false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool TryGetValue(string keyword, [NotNullWhen(true)] out object? value)
		{
			object value2 = null;
			bool result = GeneratedActions(GeneratedAction.Get, (keyword ?? throw new ArgumentNullException("keyword")).ToUpperInvariant(), ref value2);
			value = value2;
			return result;
		}

		private void SetValue(string propertyName, object? value)
		{
			object value2 = null;
			if (!GeneratedActions(GeneratedAction.GetCanonical, (propertyName ?? throw new ArgumentNullException("propertyName")).ToUpperInvariant(), ref value2))
			{
				throw new KeyNotFoundException();
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				base.Remove((string)value2);
			}
			else
			{
				base[(string)value2] = value;
			}
		}

		internal static TargetSessionAttributes ParseTargetSessionAttributes(string s)
		{
			return s switch
			{
				"any" => Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.Any, 
				"primary" => Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.Primary, 
				"standby" => Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.Standby, 
				"prefer-primary" => Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.PreferPrimary, 
				"prefer-standby" => Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.PreferStandby, 
				"read-write" => Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.ReadWrite, 
				"read-only" => Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.ReadOnly, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("TargetSessionAttributes contains an invalid value '" + s + "'"), 
			};
		}

		internal void PostProcessAndValidate()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Host))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Host can't be null");
			}
			if (Multiplexing && !Pooling)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Pooling must be on to use multiplexing");
			}
			if (!Host.Contains(","))
			{
				if (TargetSessionAttributesParsed.HasValue && TargetSessionAttributesParsed != Npgsql.TargetSessionAttributes.Any)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Target Session Attributes other then Any is only supported with multiple hosts");
				}
				if (!IsUnixSocket(Host, Port, out string _) && TrySplitHostPort(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(Host), out string host, out int port))
				{
					Host = host;
					Port = port;
				}
			}
		}

		internal string ToStringWithoutPassword()
		{
			NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder = Clone();
			npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.Password = null;
			return npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder Clone()
		{
			return new NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(base.ConnectionString);
		}

		internal static bool TrySplitHostPort(ReadOnlySpan<char> originalHost, [NotNullWhen(true)] out string? host, out int port)
		{
			int num = originalHost.LastIndexOf(':');
			if (num != -1)
			{
				int num2 = originalHost.Slice(0, num).LastIndexOf(':');
				int num3 = originalHost.LastIndexOf(']');
				if (num2 == -1 || (num > num3 && num2 < num3))
				{
					port = originalHost.Slice(num + 1).ParseInt();
					host = originalHost.Slice(0, num).ToString();
					return true;
				}
			}
			port = -1;
			host = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsUnixSocket(string host, int port, [NotNullWhen(true)] out string? socketPath, bool replaceForAbstract = true)
		{
			socketPath = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(host))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = Path.IsPathRooted(host);
			if (host[0] == '@')
			{
				if (replaceForAbstract)
				{
					host = "\0" + host.Substring(1);
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				socketPath = Path.Combine(host, $".s.PGSQL.{port}");
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder connectionStringBuilder)
			{
				return EquivalentTo(connectionStringBuilder);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Host?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
		}

		public void CopyTo(KeyValuePair<string, object?>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			using IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<string, object>> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				KeyValuePair<string, object> current = enumerator.Current;
				array[arrayIndex++] = current;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<string, object?>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (string key in Keys)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, object>(key, this[key]);
			}
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("PropertyDescriptor's PropertyType cannot be statically discovered.")]
		protected override void GetProperties(Hashtable propertyDescriptors)
		{
			base.GetProperties(propertyDescriptors);
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor value in propertyDescriptors.Values)
			{
				foreach (object attribute in value.Attributes)
				{
					if ((attribute is NpgsqlConnectionStringPropertyAttribute || attribute is ObsoleteAttribute) ? true : false)
					{
						list.Add(value);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in list)
			{
				propertyDescriptors.Remove(item.DisplayName);
			}
		}
	}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Members from serialized types or types used in expressions may be trimmed if not referenced directly.")]
		internal async Task<int> Fill(DataTable dataTable, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			NpgsqlCommand command = SelectCommand;
			NpgsqlConnection activeConnection = command?.Connection ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Connection required");
			ConnectionState originalState = ConnectionState.Closed;
			try
			{
				originalState = activeConnection.State;
				if (originalState == ConnectionState.Closed)
				{
					await activeConnection.Open(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				NpgsqlDataReader dataReader = await command.ExecuteReader(async, CommandBehavior.Default, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				int result;
				try
				{
					result = await Fill(dataTable, dataReader, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await dataReader.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						dataReader.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (originalState == ConnectionState.Closed)
				{
					activeConnection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Members from serialized types or types used in expressions may be trimmed if not referenced directly.")]
		private async Task<int> Fill(DataTable dataTable, NpgsqlDataReader dataReader, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			dataTable.BeginLoadData();
			try
			{
				int rowsAdded = 0;
				int fieldCount = dataReader.FieldCount;
				DataColumnCollection columns = dataTable.Columns;
				for (int i = 0; i < fieldCount; i++)
				{
					string name = dataReader.GetName(i);
					if (!columns.Contains(name))
					{
						Type fieldType = dataReader.GetFieldType(i);
						DataColumn column = new DataColumn(name, fieldType);
						columns.Add(column);
					}
				}
				object[] values = new object[fieldCount];
				while ((!async) ? dataReader.Read() : (await dataReader.ReadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)))
				{
					dataReader.GetValues(values);
					dataTable.LoadDataRow(values, fAcceptChanges: true);
					rowsAdded++;
				}
				return rowsAdded;
			}
			finally
			{
				dataTable.EndLoadData();
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class NpgsqlDataReader : DbDataReader, IDbColumnSchemaGenerator

		private CommandBehavior _behavior;

		private Task? _sendTask;

		internal ReaderState State = ReaderState.Disposed;

		internal NpgsqlReadBuffer Buffer;

		private List<NpgsqlBatchCommand> _statements;

		private readonly List<(int Offset, int Length)> _columns = new List<(int, int)>();

		private int _columnsStartPos;

		private int _column;

		private int _dataMsgEnd;

		private bool _canConsumeRowNonSequentially;

		internal RowDescriptionMessage? RowDescription;

		private ulong? _recordsAffected;

		private bool _hasRows;

		private bool _isSchemaOnly;

		private bool _isSequential;

		private long _startTimestamp;

		private readonly ILogger _commandLogger;

		internal NpgsqlConnector Connector { get; }

		internal int StatementIndex { get; private set; }

		private ColumnInfo[]? ColumnInfoCache { get; set; }

		public override int Depth => 0;

		public override bool IsClosed
		{
			get
			{
				if (State != ReaderState.Closed)
				{
					return State == ReaderState.Disposed;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override int RecordsAffected
		{
			get
			{
				if (_recordsAffected.HasValue)
				{
					if (!(_recordsAffected > int.MaxValue))
					{
						return (int)_recordsAffected.Value;
					}
					throw new OverflowException("The number of records affected exceeds int.MaxValue. Use Rows.");
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public ulong Rows => _recordsAffected.GetValueOrDefault();

		[Obsolete("Use the new DbBatch API")]
		public IReadOnlyList<NpgsqlBatchCommand> Statements => _statements.AsReadOnly();

		public override bool HasRows => State switch
		{
			ReaderState.Closed => throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid attempt to call HasRows when reader is closed."), 
			ReaderState.Disposed => throw new ObjectDisposedException("NpgsqlDataReader"), 
			_ => _hasRows, 
		};

		public bool IsOnRow => State == ReaderState.InResult;

		public override int FieldCount
		{
			get
			{
				CheckClosedOrDisposed();
				return RowDescription?.Count ?? 0;
			}
		}

		public override object this[int ordinal] => GetValue(ordinal);

		public override object this[string name] => GetValue(GetOrdinal(name));

		public event EventHandler? ReaderClosed;

		internal NpgsqlDataReader(NpgsqlConnector connector)

		internal void Init(NpgsqlCommand command, CommandBehavior behavior, List<NpgsqlBatchCommand> statements, long startTimestamp = 0L, Task? sendTask = null)
		{
			Command = command;
			_connection = command.InternalConnection;
			_behavior = behavior;
			_isSchemaOnly = _behavior.HasFlag(CommandBehavior.SchemaOnly);
			_isSequential = _behavior.HasFlag(CommandBehavior.SequentialAccess);
			_statements = statements;
			StatementIndex = -1;
			_sendTask = sendTask;
			State = ReaderState.BetweenResults;
			_recordsAffected = null;
			_startTimestamp = startTimestamp;
		}

		public override bool Read()
		{
			CheckClosedOrDisposed();
			return TryRead()?.Result ?? Read(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override Task<bool> ReadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			CheckClosedOrDisposed();
			return TryRead() ?? Read(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		private Task<bool>? TryRead()
		{
			switch (State)
			{
			case ReaderState.BeforeResult:
				State = ReaderState.InResult;
				return TrueTask;
			default:
				return FalseTask;
			case ReaderState.InResult:
			{
				if (_behavior.HasFlag(CommandBehavior.SingleRow) || !_canConsumeRowNonSequentially)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ConsumeRowNonSequential();
				NpgsqlReadBuffer buffer = Buffer;
				int readPosition = buffer.ReadPosition;
				int num = buffer.FilledBytes - readPosition;
				if (num < 5)
				{
					return null;
				}
				BackendMessageCode backendMessageCode = (BackendMessageCode)buffer.ReadByte();
				int num2 = buffer.ReadInt32() - 4;
				bool flag = backendMessageCode == BackendMessageCode.DataRow;
				int num3 = ((flag && _isSequential) ? 7 : (5 + num2));
				if (num >= num3 && (flag || !(_statements[StatementIndex].AppendErrorBarrier ?? Command.EnableErrorBarriers)))
				{
					IBackendMessage backendMessage = Connector.ParseResultSetMessage(buffer, backendMessageCode, num2);
					if (backendMessage != null)
					{
						ProcessMessage(backendMessage);
						if (!flag)
						{
							return FalseTask;
						}
						return TrueTask;
					}
				}
				buffer.ReadPosition = readPosition;
				return null;
			}
			}
		}

		private async Task<bool> Read(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			using (Connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken))
			{
				_ = 3;
				try
				{
					switch (State)
					{
					case ReaderState.BeforeResult:
						State = ReaderState.InResult;
						return true;
					case ReaderState.InResult:
					{
						await ConsumeRow(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						if (_behavior.HasFlag(CommandBehavior.SingleRow))
						{
							await Consume(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							return false;
						}
						IBackendMessage backendMessage = await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						switch (backendMessage.Code)
						{
						case BackendMessageCode.DataRow:
							ProcessMessage(backendMessage);
							return true;
						case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
						case BackendMessageCode.EmptyQueryResponse:
							ProcessMessage(backendMessage);
							if (_statements[StatementIndex].AppendErrorBarrier ?? Command.EnableErrorBarriers)
							{
								Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
							}
							return false;
						default:
							throw Connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
						}
					}
					case ReaderState.BetweenResults:
					case ReaderState.Consumed:
					case ReaderState.Closed:
					case ReaderState.Disposed:
						return false;
					default:
						ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException();
						return false;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					if (State != ReaderState.Closed)
					{
						State = ReaderState.Consumed;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private ValueTask<IBackendMessage> ReadMessage(bool async)
		{
			if (!_isSequential)
			{
				return Connector.ReadMessage(async);
			}
			return ReadMessageSequential(Connector, async);
			static async ValueTask<IBackendMessage> ReadMessageSequential(NpgsqlConnector connector, bool async2)
			{
				IBackendMessage msg = await connector.ReadMessage(async2, DataRowLoadingMode.Sequential).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (msg.Code == BackendMessageCode.DataRow)
				{
					await connector.ReadBuffer.Ensure(2, async2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					return msg;
				}
				return msg;
			}
		}

		public override bool NextResult()
		{
			return (_isSchemaOnly ? NextResultSchemaOnly(async: false) : NextResult(async: false)).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override Task<bool> NextResultAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!_isSchemaOnly)
			{
				return NextResult(async: true, isConsuming: false, cancellationToken);
			}
			return NextResultSchemaOnly(async: true, isConsuming: false, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task<bool> NextResult(bool async, bool isConsuming = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckClosedOrDisposed();
			if (State == ReaderState.Consumed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = default(bool);
			try
			{
				using (isConsuming ? default(NpgsqlConnector.NestedCancellableScope) : Connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken))
				{
					ReaderState state = State;
					if ((uint)state <= 1u)
					{
						await ConsumeResultSet(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					_hasRows = false;
					List<NpgsqlBatchCommand> statements = _statements;
					int statementIndex = StatementIndex;
					if (statementIndex >= 0)
					{
						RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription = RowDescription;
						if (rowDescription != null && statements[statementIndex].IsPrepared)
						{
							ColumnInfo[] columnInfoCache = ColumnInfoCache;
							if (columnInfoCache != null)
							{
								rowDescription.SetColumnInfoCache(new ReadOnlySpan<ColumnInfo>(columnInfoCache, 0, ColumnCount));
							}
						}
						if (statementIndex == 0 && _behavior.HasFlag(CommandBehavior.SingleResult) && !isConsuming)
						{
							await Consume(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							result = false;
							return result;
						}
					}
					for (statementIndex = ++StatementIndex; statementIndex < statements.Count; statementIndex = ++StatementIndex)
					{
						NpgsqlBatchCommand statement = statements[statementIndex];
						if (statement.TryGetPrepared(out PreparedStatement preparedStatement))
						{
							Statics.Expect<BindCompleteMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
							RowDescription = preparedStatement.Description;
						}
						else
						{
							preparedStatement = statement.PreparedStatement;
							if (preparedStatement != null && preparedStatement.StatementBeingReplaced != null)
							{
								Statics.Expect<CloseCompletedMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
								preparedStatement.StatementBeingReplaced.CompleteUnprepare();
								preparedStatement.StatementBeingReplaced = null;
							}
							Statics.Expect<ParseCompleteMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
							if (statement.IsPreparing)
							{
								preparedStatement.State = PreparedState.Prepared;
								Connector.PreparedStatementManager.NumPrepared++;
								statement.IsPreparing = false;
							}
							Statics.Expect<BindCompleteMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
							IBackendMessage backendMessage = await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription2 = (statement.Description = backendMessage.Code switch
							{
								BackendMessageCode.NoData => null, 
								BackendMessageCode.RowDescription => (preparedStatement == null) ? ((RowDescriptionMessage)backendMessage) : ((RowDescriptionMessage)backendMessage).Clone(), 
								_ => throw Connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code), 
							});
							RowDescription = rowDescription2;
						}
						if (RowDescription != null)
						{
							if (ColumnInfoCache?.Length >= ColumnCount)
							{
								Array.Clear(ColumnInfoCache, 0, ColumnCount);
							}
							else
							{
								ColumnInfo[] columnInfoCache2 = ColumnInfoCache;
								if (columnInfoCache2 != null)
								{
									ArrayPool<ColumnInfo>.Shared.Return(columnInfoCache2, clearArray: true);
								}
								ColumnInfoCache = ArrayPool<ColumnInfo>.Shared.Rent(ColumnCount);
							}
							if (statement.IsPrepared)
							{
								RowDescription.LoadColumnInfoCache(Connector.SerializerOptions, ColumnInfoCache);
							}
							IBackendMessage backendMessage;
							if ((Command.IsWrappedByBatch || StatementIndex == 0) && (Command.InternalBatchCommands[StatementIndex]._parameters?.HasOutputParameters ?? false))
							{
								backendMessage = await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								ProcessMessage(backendMessage);
								if (backendMessage.Code == BackendMessageCode.DataRow)
								{
									PopulateOutputParameters(Command.InternalBatchCommands[StatementIndex]._parameters);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								backendMessage = await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								ProcessMessage(backendMessage);
							}
							switch (backendMessage.Code)
							{
							case BackendMessageCode.DataRow:
								Connector.State = ConnectorState.Fetching;
								result = true;
								return result;
							case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
								if (statement.AppendErrorBarrier ?? Command.EnableErrorBarriers)
								{
									Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
								}
								result = true;
								return result;
							default:
								Connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
								preparedStatement = null;
								break;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							IBackendMessage backendMessage = await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							switch (backendMessage.Code)
							{
							case BackendMessageCode.CopyInResponse:
								throw Connector.Break(new NotSupportedException("COPY isn't supported in regular command execution - see https://www.npgsql.org/doc/copy.html for documentation on COPY with Npgsql. If you are trying to execute a SQL script created by pg_dump, pass the '--inserts' switch to disable generating COPY statements."));
							case BackendMessageCode.CopyOutResponse:
								throw Connector.Break(new NotSupportedException("COPY isn't supported in regular command execution - see https://www.npgsql.org/doc/copy.html for documentation on COPY with Npgsql."));
							default:
								throw Connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
							case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
							case BackendMessageCode.EmptyQueryResponse:
								ProcessMessage(backendMessage);
								if (statement.AppendErrorBarrier ?? Command.EnableErrorBarriers)
								{
									Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
								}
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (_statements.Count == 0 || !(_statements[_statements.Count - 1].AppendErrorBarrier ?? Command.EnableErrorBarriers))
					{
						Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
					}
					State = ReaderState.Consumed;
					RowDescription = null;
					result = false;
					return result;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception e = ex;
				if (e is PostgresException ex2 && StatementIndex >= 0 && StatementIndex < _statements.Count)
				{
					NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand = (ex2.BatchCommand = _statements[StatementIndex]);
					Command.IsCacheable = false;
					if (ex2.SqlState == "0A000")
					{
						PreparedStatement preparedStatement2 = npgsqlBatchCommand.PreparedStatement;
						if (preparedStatement2 != null)
						{
							preparedStatement2.State = PreparedState.Invalidated;
							Command.ResetPreparation();
							foreach (NpgsqlBatchCommand internalBatchCommand in Command.InternalBatchCommands)
							{
								internalBatchCommand.ResetPreparation();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				while (StatementIndex < _statements.Count)
				{
					NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand3 = _statements[StatementIndex];
					if (npgsqlBatchCommand3.IsPreparing)
					{
						npgsqlBatchCommand3.IsPreparing = false;
						npgsqlBatchCommand3.PreparedStatement.AbortPrepare();
					}
					if ((npgsqlBatchCommand3.AppendErrorBarrier ?? Command.EnableErrorBarriers) && StatementIndex < _statements.Count - 1)
					{
						if (isConsuming)
						{
							throw;
						}
						ReaderState state = State;
						if ((uint)(state - 3) > 2u)
						{
							await Consume(async, e).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
					}
					StatementIndex++;
				}
				if (State != ReaderState.Closed)
				{
					State = ReaderState.Consumed;
				}
				ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture((ex as Exception) ?? throw ex).Throw();
			}
			return result;
			async ValueTask ConsumeResultSet(bool async2)
			{
				await ConsumeRow(async2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				IBackendMessage backendMessage2;
				BackendMessageCode code;
				do
				{
					backendMessage2 = await Connector.ReadMessage(async2, DataRowLoadingMode.Skip).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					code = backendMessage2.Code;
				}
				while (code != BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete && code != BackendMessageCode.EmptyQueryResponse);
				ProcessMessage(backendMessage2);
				NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand4 = _statements[StatementIndex];
				if (npgsqlBatchCommand4.IsPrepared && ColumnInfoCache != null)
				{
					RowDescription.SetColumnInfoCache(new ReadOnlySpan<ColumnInfo>(ColumnInfoCache, 0, ColumnCount));
				}
				if (npgsqlBatchCommand4.AppendErrorBarrier ?? Command.EnableErrorBarriers)
				{
					Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PopulateOutputParameters(NpgsqlParameterCollection parameters)
		{
			int readPosition = Buffer.ReadPosition;
			State = ReaderState.InResult;
			Queue<object> queue = new Queue<object>();
			List<NpgsqlParameter> list = new List<NpgsqlParameter>();
			for (int i = 0; i < FieldCount; i++)
			{
				if (parameters.TryGetValue(GetName(i), out NpgsqlParameter parameter) && parameter.IsOutputDirection)
				{
					parameter.Value = GetValue(i);
					list.Add(parameter);
				}
				else
				{
					queue.Enqueue(GetValue(i));
				}
			}
			foreach (NpgsqlParameter item in (IEnumerable<NpgsqlParameter>)parameters)
			{
				if (item.IsOutputDirection && !list.Contains(item))
				{
					if (queue.Count == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					item.Value = queue.Dequeue();
				}
			}
			PgReader.Commit(resuming: false);
			State = ReaderState.BeforeResult;
			Buffer.ReadPosition = readPosition;
			_column = -1;
		}

		private async Task<bool> NextResultSchemaOnly(bool async, bool isConsuming = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			using (isConsuming ? default(NpgsqlConnector.NestedCancellableScope) : Connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken))
			{
				_ = 4;
				try
				{
					switch (State)
					{
					case ReaderState.Consumed:
					case ReaderState.Closed:
					case ReaderState.Disposed:
						return false;
					default:
						ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException();
						return false;
					case ReaderState.BeforeResult:
					case ReaderState.InResult:
					case ReaderState.BetweenResults:
						StatementIndex++;
						while (StatementIndex < _statements.Count)
						{
							NpgsqlBatchCommand statement = _statements[StatementIndex];
							if (statement.TryGetPrepared(out PreparedStatement preparedStatement))
							{
								RowDescription = preparedStatement.Description;
							}
							else
							{
								PreparedStatement pStatement = statement.PreparedStatement;
								if (pStatement != null && pStatement.StatementBeingReplaced != null)
								{
									Statics.Expect<CloseCompletedMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
									pStatement.StatementBeingReplaced.CompleteUnprepare();
									pStatement.StatementBeingReplaced = null;
								}
								Statics.Expect<ParseCompleteMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
								if (statement.IsPreparing)
								{
									pStatement.State = PreparedState.Prepared;
									Connector.PreparedStatementManager.NumPrepared++;
									statement.IsPreparing = false;
								}
								Statics.Expect<ParameterDescriptionMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
								IBackendMessage backendMessage = await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								switch (backendMessage.Code)
								{
								case BackendMessageCode.NoData:
								{
									NpgsqlDataReader npgsqlDataReader2 = this;
									RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription = (_statements[StatementIndex].Description = null);
									npgsqlDataReader2.RowDescription = rowDescription;
									break;
								}
								case BackendMessageCode.RowDescription:
								{
									NpgsqlDataReader npgsqlDataReader = this;
									RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription = (_statements[StatementIndex].Description = (RowDescriptionMessage)backendMessage);
									npgsqlDataReader.RowDescription = rowDescription;
									Command.FixupRowDescription(RowDescription, StatementIndex == 0);
									break;
								}
								default:
									throw Connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
								}
								bool flag = true;
								for (int i = StatementIndex + 1; i < _statements.Count; i++)
								{
									if (!_statements[i].IsPrepared)
									{
										flag = false;
										break;
									}
								}
								if (flag)
								{
									Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
								}
							}
							if (RowDescription != null)
							{
								if (ColumnInfoCache?.Length >= ColumnCount)
								{
									Array.Clear(ColumnInfoCache, 0, ColumnCount);
								}
								else
								{
									ColumnInfo[] columnInfoCache = ColumnInfoCache;
									if (columnInfoCache != null)
									{
										ArrayPool<ColumnInfo>.Shared.Return(columnInfoCache, clearArray: true);
									}
									ColumnInfoCache = ArrayPool<ColumnInfo>.Shared.Rent(ColumnCount);
								}
								return true;
							}
							StatementIndex++;
						}
						State = ReaderState.Consumed;
						RowDescription = null;
						return false;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (State != ReaderState.Closed)
					{
						State = ReaderState.Consumed;
					}
					if (ex is PostgresException ex2 && StatementIndex >= 0 && StatementIndex < _statements.Count)
					{
						ex2.BatchCommand = _statements[StatementIndex];
						Command.IsCacheable = false;
					}
					while (StatementIndex < _statements.Count)
					{
						NpgsqlBatchCommand npgsqlBatchCommand = _statements[StatementIndex];
						if (npgsqlBatchCommand.IsPreparing)
						{
							npgsqlBatchCommand.IsPreparing = false;
							npgsqlBatchCommand.PreparedStatement.AbortPrepare();
						}
						StatementIndex++;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessMessage(IBackendMessage msg)
		{
			if (msg.Code != BackendMessageCode.DataRow)
			{
				HandleUncommon(msg);
				return;
			}
			DataRowMessage obj = (DataRowMessage)msg;
			if (Buffer != Connector.ReadBuffer)
			{
				Buffer = Connector.ReadBuffer;
			}
			short num = Buffer.ReadInt16();
			if (ColumnCount != num)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentException($"Row's number of columns ({num}) differs from the row description's ({ColumnCount})");
			}
			int readPosition = Buffer.ReadPosition;
			int num2 = obj.Length - 2;
			_dataMsgEnd = readPosition + num2;
			_columnsStartPos = readPosition;
			_canConsumeRowNonSequentially = num2 <= Buffer.FilledBytes - readPosition;
			_column = -1;
			if (_columns.Count > 0)
			{
				_columns.Clear();
			}
			switch (State)
			{
			case ReaderState.BetweenResults:
				_hasRows = true;
				State = ReaderState.BeforeResult;
				break;
			case ReaderState.BeforeResult:
				State = ReaderState.InResult;
				break;
			default:
				Connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(BackendMessageCode.DataRow);
				break;
			case ReaderState.InResult:
				break;
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			void HandleUncommon(IBackendMessage backendMessage)
			{
				switch (backendMessage.Code)
				{
				case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
				{
					CommandCompleteMessage commandCompleteMessage = (CommandCompleteMessage)backendMessage;
					switch (commandCompleteMessage.StatementType)
					{
					case StatementType.Insert:
					case StatementType.Delete:
					case StatementType.Update:
					case StatementType.Move:
					case StatementType.Copy:
					case StatementType.Merge:
					{
						ulong valueOrDefault = _recordsAffected.GetValueOrDefault();
						if (!_recordsAffected.HasValue)
						{
							valueOrDefault = 0uL;
							_recordsAffected = valueOrDefault;
						}
						_recordsAffected += commandCompleteMessage.Rows;
						break;
					}
					}
					_statements[StatementIndex].ApplyCommandComplete(commandCompleteMessage);
					State = ReaderState.BetweenResults;
					break;
				}
				case BackendMessageCode.EmptyQueryResponse:
					State = ReaderState.BetweenResults;
					break;
				default:
					Connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task Consume(bool async, Exception? firstException = null)
		{
			List<Exception> exceptions = ((firstException == null) ? null : new List<Exception> { firstException });
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					if (!((!_isSchemaOnly) ? (await NextResult(async, isConsuming: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)) : (await NextResultSchemaOnly(async, isConsuming: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception item)
				{
					if (exceptions == null)
					{
						exceptions = new List<Exception>();
					}
					exceptions.Add(item);
				}
			}
			int? num = exceptions?.Count;
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				if (num != 1)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException("Multiple exceptions occurred when consuming the result set", new AggregateException(exceptions));
				}
				ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(exceptions[0]).Throw();
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				Close(async: false, connectionClosing: false, isDisposing: true).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!(ex is PostgresException) && (!(ex is NpgsqlException) || !(ex.InnerException is AggregateException ex2) || !AllPostgresExceptions(ex2.InnerExceptions)))
				{
					State = ReaderState.Disposed;
				}
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				Command.TraceCommandStop();
			}
		}

		public new async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			try
			{
				await Close(async: true, connectionClosing: false, isDisposing: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!(ex is PostgresException) && (!(ex is NpgsqlException) || !(ex.InnerException is AggregateException ex2) || !AllPostgresExceptions(ex2.InnerExceptions)))
				{
					State = ReaderState.Disposed;
				}
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				Command.TraceCommandStop();
			}
		}

		private static bool AllPostgresExceptions(ReadOnlyCollection<Exception> collection)
		{
			foreach (Exception item in collection)
			{
				if (!(item is PostgresException))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			Close(async: false, connectionClosing: false, isDisposing: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public new Task CloseAsync()
		{
			return Close(async: true, connectionClosing: false, isDisposing: false);
		}

		internal async Task Close(bool async, bool connectionClosing, bool isDisposing)
		{
			ReaderState state = State;
			if ((uint)(state - 4) <= 1u)
			{
				if (isDisposing)
				{
					State = ReaderState.Disposed;
				}
				return;
			}
			Connector.CurrentReader = null;
			switch (Connector.State)
			{
			case ConnectorState.Connecting:
			case ConnectorState.Ready:
			case ConnectorState.Executing:
			case ConnectorState.Fetching:
				if (State != ReaderState.Consumed)
				{
					try
					{
						await Consume(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					catch (Exception ex) when (((ex is OperationCanceledException || (ex is NpgsqlException && ex.InnerException is TimeoutException)) ? 1 : 0) != 0)
					{
					}
					catch (Exception ex2) when (ex2 is PostgresException || (ex2 is NpgsqlException && ex2.InnerException is AggregateException ex3 && AllPostgresExceptions(ex3.InnerExceptions)))
					{
						await Cleanup(async, connectionClosing, isDisposing).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						throw;
					}
					catch
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			case ConnectorState.Closed:
			case ConnectorState.Waiting:
			case ConnectorState.Broken:
			case ConnectorState.Copy:
			case ConnectorState.Replication:
				break;
			}
			await Cleanup(async, connectionClosing, isDisposing).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		internal async Task Cleanup(bool async, bool connectionClosing = false, bool isDisposing = false)
		{
			LogMessages.ReaderCleanup(_commandLogger, Connector.Id);
			Task sendTask = _sendTask;
			if (sendTask != null && sendTask.Status != TaskStatus.RanToCompletion)
			{
				if (Connector.IsBroken)
				{
					_sendTask.ContinueWith((Task t) => t.Exception, CancellationToken.None, TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted, TaskScheduler.Current);
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						if (async)
						{
							await _sendTask.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						else
						{
							_sendTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
						}
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						_commandLogger.LogDebug(exception, "Exception caught while sending the request", Connector.Id);
					}
				}
			}
			ColumnInfo[] columnInfoCache = ColumnInfoCache;
			if (columnInfoCache != null)
			{
				ColumnInfoCache = null;
				ArrayPool<ColumnInfo>.Shared.Return(columnInfoCache, clearArray: true);
			}
			State = ReaderState.Closed;
			Command.State = CommandState.Idle;
			Connector.CurrentReader = null;
			if (_commandLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information))
			{
				Command.LogExecutingCompleted(Connector, executing: false);
			}
			NpgsqlEventSource.Log.CommandStop();
			Connector.DataSource.MetricsReporter.ReportCommandStop(_startTimestamp);
			Connector.EndUserAction();
			if (isDisposing)
			{
				State = ReaderState.Disposed;
			}
			NpgsqlConnection? connection = _connection;
			if (connection != null && connection.ConnectorBindingScope == ConnectorBindingScope.Reader)
			{
				UnbindIfNecessary();
				_connection.Connector = null;
				Connector.Connection = null;
				_connection.ConnectorBindingScope = ConnectorBindingScope.None;
				if (_behavior.HasFlag(CommandBehavior.CloseConnection) && !connectionClosing)
				{
					_connection.Close();
				}
				Connector.ReaderCompleted.SetResult(null);
			}
			else if (_behavior.HasFlag(CommandBehavior.CloseConnection) && !connectionClosing)
			{
				_connection.Close();
			}
			if (this.ReaderClosed != null)
			{
				this.ReaderClosed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				this.ReaderClosed = null;
			}
		}

		public new NpgsqlNestedDataReader GetData(int ordinal)
		{
			if (_isSequential)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("GetData() not supported in sequential mode.");
			}
			FieldDescription fieldDescription = CheckRowAndGetField(ordinal);
			PostgresType postgresType = fieldDescription.PostgresType;
			bool num = postgresType is PostgresArrayType;
			PostgresType postgresType2 = (num ? ((PostgresArrayType)postgresType).Element : postgresType);
			PostgresCompositeType postgresCompositeType = postgresType2 as PostgresCompositeType;
			if (fieldDescription.DataFormat == DataFormat.Text || (postgresType2.InternalName != "record" && postgresCompositeType == null))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("GetData() not supported for type " + fieldDescription.TypeDisplayName);
			}
			if (SeekToColumn(async: false, ordinal, fieldDescription.DataFormat, resumableOp: true).GetAwaiter().GetResult() == -1)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue(fieldDescription);
			}
			if (PgReader.FieldOffset > 0)
			{
				PgReader.Rewind(PgReader.FieldOffset);
			}
			NpgsqlNestedDataReader npgsqlNestedDataReader = CachedFreeNestedDataReader;
			if (npgsqlNestedDataReader != null)
			{
				CachedFreeNestedDataReader = null;
				npgsqlNestedDataReader.Init(postgresCompositeType);
			}
			else
			{
				npgsqlNestedDataReader = new NpgsqlNestedDataReader(this, null, 1, postgresCompositeType);
			}
			if (num)
			{
				npgsqlNestedDataReader.InitArray();
			}
			else
			{
				npgsqlNestedDataReader.InitSingleRow();
			}
			return npgsqlNestedDataReader;
		}

		public override long GetBytes(int ordinal, long dataOffset, byte[]? buffer, int bufferOffset, int length)
		{
			if ((dataOffset < 0 || dataOffset > int.MaxValue) ? true : false)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dataOffset", dataOffset, $"dataOffset must be between {0} and {int.MaxValue}");
			}
			if (buffer != null && (bufferOffset < 0 || bufferOffset >= buffer.Length + 1))
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"bufferOffset must be between 0 and {buffer.Length}");
			}
			if (buffer != null && (length < 0 || length > buffer.Length - bufferOffset))
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"length must be between 0 and {buffer.Length - bufferOffset}");
			}
			FieldDescription fieldDescription = CheckRowAndGetField(ordinal);
			int result = SeekToColumn(async: false, ordinal, fieldDescription.DataFormat, resumableOp: true).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			if (result == -1)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue(fieldDescription);
			}
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (_isSequential && PgReader.FieldOffset > dataOffset)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Attempt to read a position in the column which has already been read");
			}
			PgReader.Seek((int)dataOffset);
			length = Math.Min(length, PgReader.FieldRemaining);
			PgReader.ReadBytes(new Span<byte>(buffer, bufferOffset, length));
			return length;
		}

		public override long GetChars(int ordinal, long dataOffset, char[]? buffer, int bufferOffset, int length)
		{
			if ((dataOffset < 0 || dataOffset > int.MaxValue) ? true : false)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dataOffset", dataOffset, $"dataOffset must be between 0 and {int.MaxValue}");
			}
			if (buffer != null && (bufferOffset < 0 || bufferOffset >= buffer.Length + 1))
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"bufferOffset must be between 0 and {buffer.Length}");
			}
			if (buffer != null && (length < 0 || length > buffer.Length - bufferOffset))
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"length must be between 0 and {buffer.Length - bufferOffset}");
			}
			PgConverter converter;
			Size bufferRequirement;
			bool asObject;
			DataFormat info = GetInfo(ordinal, typeof(GetChars), out converter, out bufferRequirement, out asObject);
			if (SeekToColumn(async: false, ordinal, info, resumableOp: true).GetAwaiter().GetResult() == -1)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue(CheckRowAndGetField(ordinal));
			}
			PgReader pgReader = PgReader;
			dataOffset = ((buffer == null) ? 0 : dataOffset);
			if (_isSequential && pgReader.CharsRead > dataOffset)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Attempt to read a position in the column which has already been read");
			}
			pgReader.StartCharsRead(checked((int)dataOffset), (buffer != null) ? new ArraySegment<char>?(new ArraySegment<char>(buffer, bufferOffset, length)) : ((ArraySegment<char>?)null));
			pgReader.StartRead(bufferRequirement);
			GetChars getChars = (asObject ? ((GetChars)converter.ReadAsObject(pgReader)) : ((PgConverter<GetChars>)converter).Read(pgReader));
			pgReader.EndRead();
			pgReader.EndCharsRead();
			return getChars.Read;
		}

		public override Task<T> GetFieldValueAsync<T>(int ordinal, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!_isSequential)
			{
				return Task.FromResult(GetFieldValueCore<T>(ordinal));
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(Stream))
			{
				return GetStream(ordinal, cancellationToken);
			}
			return Core(ordinal, cancellationToken).AsTask();
			async ValueTask<T> Core(int ordinal2, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				using (Connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken2, attemptPgCancellation: false))
				{
					PgConverter converter;
					Size bufferRequirement;
					bool asObject;
					DataFormat info = GetInfo(ordinal2, typeof(T), out converter, out bufferRequirement, out asObject);
					if (await SeekToColumn(async: true, ordinal2, info).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false) == -1)
					{
						return DbNullValueOrThrow<T>(ordinal2);
					}
					if (typeof(T) == typeof(TextReader))
					{
						PgReader.ThrowIfStreamActive();
					}
					await PgReader.StartReadAsync(bufferRequirement, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					T val = ((!asObject) ? (await converter.UnsafeDowncast<T>().ReadAsync(PgReader, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)) : ((T)(await converter.ReadAsObjectAsync(PgReader, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))));
					T result = val;
					await PgReader.EndReadAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					return result;

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]

		private void CheckResultSet()
		{
			switch (State)
			{
			case ReaderState.BeforeResult:
			case ReaderState.InResult:
				break;
			case ReaderState.Closed:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("The reader is closed");
				break;
			case ReaderState.Disposed:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException("NpgsqlDataReader");
				break;
			default:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No resultset is currently being traversed");
				break;
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private T DbNullValueOrThrow<T>(int ordinal)
		{
			if (default(T) == null && typeof(T).IsValueType)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(object))
			{
				return (T)(object)DBNull.Value;
			}
			ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue(CheckRowAndGetField(ordinal));
			return default(T);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private DataFormat GetInfo(int ordinal, Type type, out PgConverter converter, out Size bufferRequirement, out bool asObject)
		{
			ReaderState state = State;
			if (state != ReaderState.InResult || (uint)ordinal > (uint)ColumnCount)
			{
				Unsafe.SkipInit<PgConverter>(out converter);
				Unsafe.SkipInit<Size>(out bufferRequirement);
				Unsafe.SkipInit<bool>(out asObject);
				HandleInvalidState(state, ColumnCount);
			}
			ref ColumnInfo reference = ref ColumnInfoCache[ordinal];
			if (reference.ConverterInfo.TypeToConvert == type)
			{
				converter = reference.ConverterInfo.Converter;
				bufferRequirement = reference.ConverterInfo.BufferRequirement;
				asObject = reference.AsObject;
				return reference.DataFormat;
			}
			return Slow(ref reference, out converter, out bufferRequirement, out asObject);
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			DataFormat Slow(ref ColumnInfo info, out PgConverter reference2, out Size reference3, out bool reference4)
			{
				FieldDescription fieldDescription = CheckRowAndGetField(ordinal);
				fieldDescription.GetInfo(type, ref info);
				reference2 = info.ConverterInfo.Converter;
				reference3 = info.ConverterInfo.BufferRequirement;
				reference4 = info.AsObject;
				return fieldDescription.DataFormat;
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private DataFormat GetDefaultInfo(int ordinal, out PgConverter converter, out Size bufferRequirement)
		{
			FieldDescription fieldDescription = CheckRowAndGetField(ordinal);
			converter = fieldDescription.ObjectOrDefaultInfo.Converter;
			bufferRequirement = fieldDescription.ObjectOrDefaultInfo.BufferRequirement;
			return fieldDescription.DataFormat;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private FieldDescription CheckRowAndGetField(int column)
		{
			RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription = RowDescription;
			ReaderState state = State;
			if (state == ReaderState.InResult && (uint)column < (uint)rowDescription.Count)
			{
				return rowDescription[column];
			}
			return HandleInvalidState(state, rowDescription?.Count ?? 0);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		[DoesNotReturn]
		private static FieldDescription HandleInvalidState(ReaderState state, int maxColumns)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case ReaderState.InResult:
				ThrowColumnOutOfRange(maxColumns);
				break;
			case ReaderState.Closed:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("The reader is closed");
				break;
			case ReaderState.Disposed:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException("NpgsqlDataReader");
				break;
			default:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No row is available");
				break;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FieldDescription GetField(int column)
		{
			if (RowDescription == null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No resultset is currently being traversed");
			}
			RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription = RowDescription;
			if (column < 0 || column >= rowDescription.Count)
			{
				ThrowColumnOutOfRange(rowDescription.Count);
			}
			return rowDescription[column];
		}

		private void CheckClosedOrDisposed()
		{
			ReaderState state = State;
			if ((uint)(state - 4) <= 1u)
			{
				Throw(state);
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			static void Throw(ReaderState readerState)
			{
				switch (readerState)
				{
				case ReaderState.Closed:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("The reader is closed");
					break;
				case ReaderState.Disposed:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException("NpgsqlDataReader");
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[DoesNotReturn]
		private static void ThrowColumnOutOfRange(int maxIndex)
		{
			throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"Column must be between {0} and {maxIndex - 1}");
		}

		internal void UnbindIfNecessary()
		{
			if (State != ReaderState.Disposed)
			{
				NpgsqlConnector connector = Connector;
				NpgsqlDataReader unboundDataReader = Connector.UnboundDataReader;
				connector.DataReader = ((unboundDataReader != null && unboundDataReader.State == ReaderState.Disposed) ? unboundDataReader : new NpgsqlDataReader(Connector));
				Connector.UnboundDataReader = this;
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum ReaderState
	{
		BeforeResult,
		InResult,
		BetweenResults,
		Consumed,
		Closed,
		Disposed
	}

		private volatile DatabaseStateInfo _databaseStateInfo = new DatabaseStateInfo();

		private protected readonly Dictionary<Transaction, List<NpgsqlConnector>> _pendingEnlistedConnectors = new Dictionary<Transaction, List<NpgsqlConnector>>();

		private volatile int _isDisposed;

		private readonly ILogger _connectionLogger;

		private readonly SemaphoreSlim _setupMappingsSemaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(1);

		private readonly INpgsqlNameTranslator _defaultNameTranslator;

		internal List<HackyEnumTypeMapping>? _hackyEnumTypeMappings;

		internal NpgsqlLoggingConfiguration LoggingConfiguration { get; }

		internal PgSerializerOptions SerializerOptions { get; private set; }

		public string Password
		{
			set
			{
				if (_passwordProvider != null || _periodicPasswordProvider != null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(NpgsqlStrings.CannotSetBothPasswordProviderAndPassword);
				}
				_password = value;
			}
		}

		internal abstract bool OwnsConnectors { get; }

		internal NpgsqlDataSource(NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder settings, NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration dataSourceConfig)
		{
			Settings = settings;
			ConnectionString = (settings.PersistSecurityInfo ? settings.ToString() : settings.ToStringWithoutPassword());
			Configuration = dataSourceConfig;
			dataSourceConfig.Deconstruct(out string Name, out NpgsqlLoggingConfiguration LoggingConfiguration, out TransportSecurityHandler TransportSecurityHandler, out IntegratedSecurityHandler userCertificateValidationCallback, out RemoteCertificateValidationCallback UserCertificateValidationCallback, out Action<X509CertificateCollection> ClientCertificatesCallback, out Func<NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder, string> PasswordProvider, out Func<NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder, CancellationToken, ValueTask<string>> PasswordProviderAsync, out Func<NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder, CancellationToken, ValueTask<string>> PeriodicPasswordProvider, out TimeSpan PeriodicPasswordSuccessRefreshInterval, out TimeSpan PeriodicPasswordFailureRefreshInterval, out PgTypeInfoResolverChain ResolverChain, out List<HackyEnumTypeMapping> HackyEnumMappings, out INpgsqlNameTranslator DefaultNameTranslator, out Action<NpgsqlConnection> ConnectionInitializer, out Func<NpgsqlConnection, Task> ConnectionInitializerAsync);
			string text = Name;
			this.LoggingConfiguration = LoggingConfiguration;
			this.TransportSecurityHandler = TransportSecurityHandler;
			IntegratedSecurityHandler = userCertificateValidationCallback;
			this.UserCertificateValidationCallback = UserCertificateValidationCallback;
			this.ClientCertificatesCallback = ClientCertificatesCallback;
			_passwordProvider = PasswordProvider;
			_passwordProviderAsync = PasswordProviderAsync;
			_periodicPasswordProvider = PeriodicPasswordProvider;
			_periodicPasswordSuccessRefreshInterval = PeriodicPasswordSuccessRefreshInterval;
			_periodicPasswordFailureRefreshInterval = PeriodicPasswordFailureRefreshInterval;
			PgTypeInfoResolverChain resolverChain = ResolverChain;
			_hackyEnumTypeMappings = HackyEnumMappings;
			_defaultNameTranslator = DefaultNameTranslator;
			this.ConnectionInitializer = ConnectionInitializer;
			this.ConnectionInitializerAsync = ConnectionInitializerAsync;
			_connectionLogger = this.LoggingConfiguration.ConnectionLogger;
			_resolverChain = resolverChain;
			_password = settings.Password;
			if (_periodicPasswordSuccessRefreshInterval != default(TimeSpan))
			{
				_timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
				_periodicPasswordProviderTimer = new Timer(delegate
				{
					RefreshPassword();
				}, null, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
				_passwordRefreshTask = Task.Run((Func<Task?>)RefreshPassword);
			}
			this.Name = text ?? ConnectionString;
			MetricsReporter = new MetricsReporter(this);
		}

		public new NpgsqlConnection CreateConnection()
		{
			return NpgsqlConnection.FromDataSource(this);
		}

		public new NpgsqlConnection OpenConnection()
		{
			NpgsqlConnection npgsqlConnection = CreateConnection();
			try
			{
				npgsqlConnection.Open();
				return npgsqlConnection;
			}
			catch
			{
				npgsqlConnection.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override DbConnection OpenDbConnection()
		{
			return OpenConnection();
		}

		public new async ValueTask<NpgsqlConnection> OpenConnectionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			NpgsqlConnection connection = CreateConnection();
			try
			{
				await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				return connection;
			}
			catch
			{
				await connection.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override async ValueTask<DbConnection> OpenDbConnectionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return await OpenConnectionAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		protected override DbConnection CreateDbConnection()
		{
			return CreateConnection();
		}
