		internal async Task Bootstrap(NpgsqlConnector connector, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool forceReload, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (IsBootstrapped && !forceReload)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!((!async) ? _setupMappingsSemaphore.Wait(timeout.CheckAndGetTimeLeft(), cancellationToken) : (await _setupMappingsSemaphore.WaitAsync(timeout.CheckAndGetTimeLeft(), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))))
			{
				throw new TimeoutException();
			}
			try
			{
				if (!IsBootstrapped || forceReload)
				{
					connector.SerializerOptions = new PgSerializerOptions(PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo.DefaultTypeCatalog)
					{
						TextEncoding = connector.TextEncoding,
						TypeInfoResolver = AdoTypeInfoResolverFactory.Instance.CreateResolver()
					};
					NpgsqlDatabaseInfo npgsqlDatabaseInfo;
					using (connector.StartUserAction(ConnectorState.Executing, cancellationToken))
					{
						npgsqlDatabaseInfo = await NpgsqlDatabaseInfo.Load(connector, timeout, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					NpgsqlDatabaseInfo databaseInfo = (DatabaseInfo = npgsqlDatabaseInfo);
					connector.DatabaseInfo = databaseInfo;
					PgSerializerOptions serializerOptions = (SerializerOptions = new PgSerializerOptions(npgsqlDatabaseInfo, _resolverChain, CreateTimeZoneProvider(connector.Timezone))
					{
						ArrayNullabilityMode = Settings.ArrayNullabilityMode,
						EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions = !Statics.DisableDateTimeInfinityConversions,
						TextEncoding = connector.TextEncoding,
						DefaultNameTranslator = _defaultNameTranslator
					});
					connector.SerializerOptions = serializerOptions;
					IsBootstrapped = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_setupMappingsSemaphore.Release();
			}
			static Func<string> CreateTimeZoneProvider(string postgresTimeZone)
			{
				return delegate
				{
					if (string.Equals(postgresTimeZone, "localtime", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						throw new TimeZoneNotFoundException("The special PostgreSQL timezone 'localtime' is not supported when reading values of type 'timestamp with time zone'. Please specify a real timezone in 'postgresql.conf' on the server, or set the 'PGTZ' environment variable on the client.");
					}
					return postgresTimeZone;
				};
			}
		}

		internal ValueTask<string?> GetPassword(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (_passwordProvider != null)
			{
				return GetPassword(async, cancellationToken);
			}
			if (_password == null && _periodicPasswordProvider != null)
			{
				return GetInitialPeriodicPassword(async);
			}
			return new ValueTask<string>(_password);
			async ValueTask<string?> GetInitialPeriodicPassword(bool flag)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					await _passwordRefreshTask.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					_passwordRefreshTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
				}
				return _password;
			}
			async ValueTask<string?> GetPassword(bool flag, CancellationToken arg)
			{
				try
				{
					return (!flag) ? _passwordProvider(Settings) : (await _passwordProviderAsync(Settings, arg).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					_connectionLogger.LogError(ex, "Password provider threw an exception");
					throw new NpgsqlException("An exception was thrown from the password provider", ex);
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task RefreshPassword()
		{
			try
			{
				_password = await _periodicPasswordProvider(Settings, _timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource.Token).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				_periodicPasswordProviderTimer.Change(_periodicPasswordSuccessRefreshInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				_connectionLogger.LogError(ex, "Periodic password provider threw an exception");
				_periodicPasswordProviderTimer.Change(_periodicPasswordFailureRefreshInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
				throw new NpgsqlException("An exception was thrown from the periodic password provider", ex);
			}
		}

		internal abstract ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector> Get(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

		internal abstract bool TryGetIdleConnector([NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? connector);

		internal abstract ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector?> OpenNewConnector(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

		internal abstract void Return(NpgsqlConnector connector);

		internal abstract void Clear();

		internal DatabaseState GetDatabaseState(bool ignoreExpiration = false)
		{
			DatabaseStateInfo databaseStateInfo = _databaseStateInfo;
			if (!ignoreExpiration && databaseStateInfo.Timeout.HasExpired)
			{
				return DatabaseState.Unknown;
			}
			return databaseStateInfo.State;
		}

		internal DatabaseState UpdateDatabaseState(DatabaseState newState, DateTime timeStamp, TimeSpan stateExpiration, bool ignoreTimeStamp = false)
		{
			DatabaseStateInfo databaseStateInfo = _databaseStateInfo;
			if (!ignoreTimeStamp && timeStamp <= databaseStateInfo.TimeStamp)
			{
				return _databaseStateInfo.State;
			}
			_databaseStateInfo = new DatabaseStateInfo(newState, new NpgsqlTimeout(stateExpiration), timeStamp);
			return newState;
		}

		internal virtual void AddPendingEnlistedConnector(NpgsqlConnector connector, Transaction transaction)
		{
			lock (_pendingEnlistedConnectors)
			{
				if (!_pendingEnlistedConnectors.TryGetValue(transaction, out var value))
				{
					List<NpgsqlConnector> list = (_pendingEnlistedConnectors[transaction] = new List<NpgsqlConnector>(1));
					value = list;
				}
				value.Add(connector);
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool TryRemovePendingEnlistedConnector(NpgsqlConnector connector, Transaction transaction)
		{
			lock (_pendingEnlistedConnectors)
			{
				if (!_pendingEnlistedConnectors.TryGetValue(transaction, out var value))
				{
					return false;
				}
				value.Remove(connector);
				if (value.Count == 0)
				{
					_pendingEnlistedConnectors.Remove(transaction);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool TryRentEnlistedPending(Transaction transaction, NpgsqlConnection connection, [NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? connector)
		{
			lock (_pendingEnlistedConnectors)
			{
				if (!_pendingEnlistedConnectors.TryGetValue(transaction, out var value))
				{
					connector = null;
					return false;
				}
				connector = value[value.Count - 1];
				value.RemoveAt(value.Count - 1);
				if (value.Count == 0)
				{
					_pendingEnlistedConnectors.Remove(transaction);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected sealed override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _isDisposed, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				DisposeBase();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeBase()
		{
			CancellationTokenSource timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource = _timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource;
			if (timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource != null)
			{
				timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
				timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
			}
			_periodicPasswordProviderTimer?.Dispose();
			_setupMappingsSemaphore.Dispose();
			MetricsReporter.Dispose();
			Clear();
		}

		protected sealed override ValueTask DisposeAsyncCore()
		{
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _isDisposed, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				return DisposeAsyncBase();
			}
			return default(ValueTask);
		}

		protected virtual async ValueTask DisposeAsyncBase()
		{
			CancellationTokenSource timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource = _timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource;
			if (timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource != null)
			{
				timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
				timerPasswordProviderCancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
			}
			if (_periodicPasswordProviderTimer != null)
			{
				_periodicPasswordProviderTimer.Dispose();
			}
			_setupMappingsSemaphore.Dispose();
			MetricsReporter.Dispose();
			Clear();
		}

		private protected void CheckDisposed()
		{
			if (_isDisposed == 1)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException(GetType().FullName);
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder : INpgsqlTypeMapper
	{
		private readonly NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder _internalBuilder;

		private static UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver<NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder> UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver { get; }

		public string? Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _internalBuilder.Name;
			}
			set
			{
				_internalBuilder.Name = value;
			}
		}

		public INpgsqlNameTranslator DefaultNameTranslator
		{
			get
			{
				return _internalBuilder.DefaultNameTranslator;
			}
			set
			{
				_internalBuilder.DefaultNameTranslator = value;
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder ConnectionStringBuilder => _internalBuilder.ConnectionStringBuilder;

		public string ConnectionString => _internalBuilder.ConnectionString;

		internal static void ResetGlobalMappings(bool overwrite)
		{
			GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.AddGlobalTypeMappingResolvers(new PgTypeInfoResolverFactory[8]
			{
				overwrite ? new AdoTypeInfoResolverFactory() : AdoTypeInfoResolverFactory.Instance,
				new ExtraConversionResolverFactory(),
				new JsonTypeInfoResolverFactory(),
				new RecordTypeInfoResolverFactory(),
				new FullTextSearchTypeInfoResolverFactory(),
				new NetworkTypeInfoResolverFactory(),
				new GeometricTypeInfoResolverFactory(),
				new LTreeTypeInfoResolverFactory()
			}, delegate
			{
				PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder result = new PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder();
				result.EnableRanges();
				result.EnableMultiranges();
				result.EnableArrays();
				return result;
			}, overwrite);
		}

		static NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder()
		{
			UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver = new UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver<NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder>();
			ResetGlobalMappings(overwrite: false);
		}

		public NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(string? connectionString = null)
		{
			_internalBuilder = new NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder(new NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString));
			_internalBuilder.ConfigureDefaultFactories = delegate(NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder instance)
			{
				instance.AppendDefaultFactories();
				instance.AppendResolverFactory(new ExtraConversionResolverFactory());
				instance.AppendResolverFactory(() => new JsonTypeInfoResolverFactory(instance.JsonSerializerOptions));
				instance.AppendResolverFactory(new RecordTypeInfoResolverFactory());
				instance.AppendResolverFactory(new FullTextSearchTypeInfoResolverFactory());
				instance.AppendResolverFactory(new NetworkTypeInfoResolverFactory());
				instance.AppendResolverFactory(new GeometricTypeInfoResolverFactory());
				instance.AppendResolverFactory(new LTreeTypeInfoResolverFactory());
			};
			_internalBuilder.ConfigureResolverChain = delegate(List<IPgTypeInfoResolver> chain)
			{
				chain.Add(UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver);
			};
			_internalBuilder.EnableTransportSecurity();
			_internalBuilder.EnableIntegratedSecurity();
			_internalBuilder.EnableRanges();
			_internalBuilder.EnableMultiranges();
			_internalBuilder.EnableArrays();
		}

		public NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder UseLoggerFactory(ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory)
		{
			_internalBuilder.UseLoggerFactory(loggerFactory);
			return this;
		}

		public NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder EnableParameterLogging(bool parameterLoggingEnabled = true)
		{
			_internalBuilder.EnableParameterLogging(parameterLoggingEnabled);
			return this;
		}

		public NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder ConfigureJsonOptions(JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions)
		{
			_internalBuilder.ConfigureJsonOptions(serializerOptions);
			return this;
		}

	internal sealed class NpgsqlEventSource : EventSource
	{
		public static readonly NpgsqlEventSource Log = new NpgsqlEventSource();

		private const string EventSourceName = "Npgsql";

		internal const int CommandStartId = 3;

		internal const int CommandStopId = 4;

		private long _bytesWritten;

		private long _bytesRead;

		private long _totalCommands;

		private long _totalPreparedCommands;

		private long _currentCommands;

		private long _failedCommands;

		private long _multiplexingBatchesSent;

		private long _multiplexingCommandsSent;

		private long _multiplexingTicksWritten;

		internal NpgsqlEventSource()
			: base("Npgsql")
		{
		}

		internal void BytesWritten(long bytesWritten)
		{
			if (IsEnabled())
			{
				Interlocked.Add(ref _bytesWritten, bytesWritten);
			}
		}

		internal void BytesRead(long bytesRead)
		{
			if (IsEnabled())
			{
				Interlocked.Add(ref _bytesRead, bytesRead);
			}
		}

		public void CommandStart(string sql)
		{
			if (IsEnabled())
			{
				Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalCommands);
				Interlocked.Increment(ref _currentCommands);
			}
			NpgsqlSqlEventSource.Log.CommandStart(sql);
		}

		public void CommandStop()
		{
			if (IsEnabled())
			{
				Interlocked.Decrement(ref _currentCommands);
			}
			NpgsqlSqlEventSource.Log.CommandStop();
		}

		internal void CommandStartPrepared()
		{
			if (IsEnabled())
			{
				Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalPreparedCommands);
			}
		}

		internal void CommandFailed()
		{
			if (IsEnabled())
			{
				Interlocked.Increment(ref _failedCommands);
			}
		}

		internal void DataSourceCreated(NpgsqlDataSource dataSource)
		{
		}

		internal void MultiplexingBatchSent(int numCommands, Stopwatch stopwatch)
		{
			if (IsEnabled())
			{
				Interlocked.Increment(ref _multiplexingBatchesSent);
				Interlocked.Add(ref _multiplexingCommandsSent, numCommands);
				Interlocked.Add(ref _multiplexingTicksWritten, stopwatch.ElapsedTicks);
			}
		}
	}

	public class NpgsqlException : DbException
	{
		public new virtual bool IsTransient
		{
			get
			{
				Exception innerException = base.InnerException;
				if (innerException is IOException || innerException is SocketException || innerException is TimeoutException || innerException is NpgsqlException { IsTransient: not false })
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public new NpgsqlBatchCommand? BatchCommand { get; set; }

		}

		}

			: base(message)
		{
		}

		protected internal NpgsqlException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
		}
	}

	[Obsolete("NpgsqlLargeObjectManager allows manipulating PostgreSQL large objects via publicly available PostgreSQL functions (lo_read, lo_write); call these yourself directly.")]
	public class NpgsqlLargeObjectManager
	{
		private const int InvWrite = 131072;

		private const int InvRead = 262144;

		internal NpgsqlConnection Connection { get; }

		public int MaxTransferBlockSize { get; set; }

		public bool Has64BitSupport => Connection.PostgreSqlVersion.IsGreaterOrEqual(9, 3);

		public NpgsqlLargeObjectManager(NpgsqlConnection connection)
		{
			Connection = connection;
			MaxTransferBlockSize = 4194304;
		}

		internal async Task<T> ExecuteFunction<T>(bool async, string function, CancellationToken cancellationToken, params object[] arguments)
		{
			using NpgsqlCommand command = Connection.CreateCommand();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("SELECT * FROM ").Append(function).Append('(');
			for (int i = 0; i < arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append('$').Append(i + 1);
				command.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter
				{
					Value = arguments[i]
				});
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			command.CommandText = stringBuilder.ToString();
			object obj = ((!async) ? command.ExecuteScalar() : (await command.ExecuteScalarAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
			return (T)obj;
		}

		internal async Task<int> ExecuteFunctionGetBytes(bool async, string function, byte[] buffer, int offset, int len, CancellationToken cancellationToken, params object[] arguments)
		{
			using NpgsqlCommand command = Connection.CreateCommand();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("SELECT * FROM ").Append(function).Append('(');
			for (int i = 0; i < arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append('$').Append(i + 1);
				command.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter
				{
					Value = arguments[i]
				});
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			command.CommandText = stringBuilder.ToString();
			NpgsqlDataReader npgsqlDataReader = ((!async) ? command.ExecuteReader(CommandBehavior.SequentialAccess) : (await command.ExecuteReaderAsync(CommandBehavior.SequentialAccess, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
			NpgsqlDataReader reader = npgsqlDataReader;
			int result;
			try
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await reader.ReadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					reader.Read();
				}
				result = (int)reader.GetBytes(0, 0L, buffer, offset, len);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await reader.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					reader.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public uint Create(uint preferredOid = 0u)
		{
			return Create(preferredOid, async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task<uint> CreateAsync(uint preferredOid, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Create(preferredOid, async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		private Task<uint> Create(uint preferredOid, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ExecuteFunction<uint>(async, "lo_create", cancellationToken, new object[1] { (int)preferredOid });
		}

		public NpgsqlLargeObjectStream OpenRead(uint oid)
		{
			return OpenRead(async: false, oid).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task<NpgsqlLargeObjectStream> OpenReadAsync(uint oid, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return OpenRead(async: true, oid, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task<NpgsqlLargeObjectStream> OpenRead(bool async, uint oid, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return new NpgsqlLargeObjectStream(this, await ExecuteFunction<int>(async, "lo_open", cancellationToken, new object[2]
			{
				(int)oid,
				262144
			}).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), writeable: false);
		}

		public NpgsqlLargeObjectStream OpenReadWrite(uint oid)
		{
			return OpenReadWrite(async: false, oid).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task<NpgsqlLargeObjectStream> OpenReadWriteAsync(uint oid, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return OpenReadWrite(async: true, oid, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task<NpgsqlLargeObjectStream> OpenReadWrite(bool async, uint oid, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return new NpgsqlLargeObjectStream(this, await ExecuteFunction<int>(async, "lo_open", cancellationToken, new object[2]
			{
				(int)oid,
				393216
			}).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), writeable: true);
		}

		public void Unlink(uint oid)
		{
			ExecuteFunction<object>(async: false, "lo_unlink", CancellationToken.None, new object[1] { (int)oid }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task UnlinkAsync(uint oid, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))

	[Obsolete("NpgsqlLargeObjectStream allows manipulating PostgreSQL large objects via publicly available PostgreSQL functions (lo_read, lo_write); call these yourself directly.")]
	public sealed class NpgsqlLargeObjectStream : Stream
	{
		private readonly NpgsqlLargeObjectManager _manager;

		private readonly int _fd;

		private long _pos;

		private readonly bool _writeable;

		private bool _disposed;

		public bool Has64BitSupport => _manager.Connection.PostgreSqlVersion.IsGreaterOrEqual(9, 3);

		public override bool CanTimeout => false;

		public override bool CanRead => !_disposed;

		public override bool CanWrite
		{
			get
			{
				if (_writeable)
				{
					return !_disposed;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanSeek => !_disposed;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				CheckDisposed();
				return _pos;
			}
			set
			{
				Seek(value, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
		}

		public override long Length => GetLength(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

		internal NpgsqlLargeObjectStream(NpgsqlLargeObjectManager manager, int fd, bool writeable)
		{
			_manager = manager;
			_fd = fd;
			_pos = 0L;
			_writeable = writeable;
		}

		private void CheckDisposed()
		{
			if (_disposed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Object disposed");
			}
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			return Read(async: false, buffer, offset, count).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override Task<int> ReadAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Read(async: true, buffer, offset, count, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task<int> Read(bool async, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset");
			}
			if (count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			if (buffer.Length - offset < count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid offset or count for this buffer");
			}
			CheckDisposed();
			int chunkCount = Math.Min(count, _manager.MaxTransferBlockSize);
			int read = 0;
			while (read < count)
			{
				int num = await _manager.ExecuteFunctionGetBytes(async, "loread", buffer, offset + read, count - read, cancellationToken, _fd, chunkCount).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				_pos += num;
				read += num;
				if (num < chunkCount)
				{
					return read;
				}
			}
			return read;
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			Write(async: false, buffer, offset, count).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override Task WriteAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Write(async: true, buffer, offset, count, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task Write(bool async, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset");
			}
			if (count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			if (buffer.Length - offset < count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid offset or count for this buffer");
			}
			CheckDisposed();
			if (!_writeable)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Write cannot be called on a stream opened with no write permissions");
			}
			int totalWritten = 0;
			while (totalWritten < count)
			{
				int chunkSize = Math.Min(count - totalWritten, _manager.MaxTransferBlockSize);
				int num = await _manager.ExecuteFunction<int>(async, "lowrite", cancellationToken, new object[2]
				{
					_fd,
					new ArraySegment<byte>(buffer, offset + totalWritten, chunkSize)
				}).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				totalWritten += num;
				if (num != chunkSize)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal Npgsql bug, please report");
				}
				_pos += num;
			}
		}

		public Task<long> GetLengthAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return GetLength(async: true);
		}

		private async Task<long> GetLength(bool async)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			long old = _pos;
			long retval = await Seek(async, 0L, SeekOrigin.End).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (retval != old)
			{
				await Seek(async, old, SeekOrigin.Begin).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			return retval;
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			return Seek(async: false, offset, origin).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task<long> SeekAsync(long offset, SeekOrigin origin, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Seek(async: true, offset, origin, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task<long> Seek(bool async, long offset, SeekOrigin origin, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (origin < SeekOrigin.Begin || origin > SeekOrigin.End)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid origin");
			}
			if (!Has64BitSupport && offset != (int)offset)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", "offset must fit in 32 bits for PostgreSQL versions older than 9.3");
			}
			CheckDisposed();
			return (!_manager.Has64BitSupport) ? (_pos = await _manager.ExecuteFunction<int>(async, "lo_lseek", cancellationToken, new object[3]
			{
				_fd,
				(int)offset,
				(int)origin
			}).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)) : (_pos = await _manager.ExecuteFunction<long>(async, "lo_lseek64", cancellationToken, new object[3]
			{
				_fd,
				offset,
				(int)origin
			}).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			SetLength(async: false, value).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task SetLength(long value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return SetLength(async: true, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task SetLength(bool async, long value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if (value < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value");
			}
			if (!Has64BitSupport && value != (int)value)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", "offset must fit in 32 bits for PostgreSQL versions older than 9.3");
			}
			CheckDisposed();
			if (!_writeable)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("SetLength cannot be called on a stream opened with no write permissions");
			}
			if (_manager.Has64BitSupport)
			{
				await _manager.ExecuteFunction<int>(async, "lo_truncate64", cancellationToken, new object[2] { _fd, value }).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				await _manager.ExecuteFunction<int>(async, "lo_truncate", cancellationToken, new object[2]
				{
					_fd,
					(int)value
				}).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			if (!_disposed)
			{
				_manager.ExecuteFunction<int>(async: false, "lo_close", CancellationToken.None, new object[1] { _fd }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
				_disposed = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				Close();
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource : NpgsqlDataSource

		internal override (int Total, int Idle, int Busy) Statistics
		{

				for (int i = 0; i < pools.Length; i++)

					(int, int, int) statistics = pools[i].Statistics;
					num += statistics.Item1;

		}

		internal NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource(NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder settings, NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration dataSourceConfig)
			: base(settings, dataSourceConfig)
		{

			_pools = new NpgsqlDataSource[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder = settings.Clone();
				ReadOnlySpan<char> originalHost = System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(array[i]).Trim();
				if (NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.TrySplitHostPort(originalHost, out string host, out int port))

			}

				{
					num = (int)targetSessionAttributes;
				}
			}
			_wrappers = new MultiHostDataSourceWrapper[num + 1];
			array3 = array2;
			foreach (TargetSessionAttributes targetSessionAttributes2 in array3)
			{
				_wrappers[(uint)targetSessionAttributes2] = new MultiHostDataSourceWrapper(this, targetSessionAttributes2);
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlConnection CreateConnection(TargetSessionAttributes targetSessionAttributes)

		private static bool IsPreferred(DatabaseState state, TargetSessionAttributes preferredType)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case DatabaseState.Offline:
				return false;
			case DatabaseState.Unknown:
				return true;
			case DatabaseState.PrimaryReadWrite:
			{
				bool flag;
				switch (preferredType)
				{
				case TargetSessionAttributes.ReadWrite:
				case TargetSessionAttributes.Primary:
				case TargetSessionAttributes.PreferPrimary:
					flag = true;
					break;
				default:
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case DatabaseState.PrimaryReadOnly:
				if ((preferredType - 2 <= TargetSessionAttributes.ReadWrite || preferredType == TargetSessionAttributes.PreferPrimary) ? true : false)
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case DatabaseState.Standby:
			{
				bool flag;
				switch (preferredType)
				{
				case TargetSessionAttributes.ReadOnly:
				case TargetSessionAttributes.Standby:
				case TargetSessionAttributes.PreferStandby:
					flag = true;
					break;
				default:
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return preferredType == TargetSessionAttributes.Any;
		}

		private static bool IsOnline(DatabaseState state, TargetSessionAttributes preferredType)
		{
			return state != DatabaseState.Offline;
		}

		private async ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector?> TryGetIdleOrNew(NpgsqlConnection conn, TimeSpan timeoutPerHost, bool async, TargetSessionAttributes preferredType, Func<DatabaseState, TargetSessionAttributes, bool> stateValidator, int poolIndex, IList<Exception> exceptions, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			NpgsqlDataSource[] pools = _pools;
			for (int i = 0; i < pools.Length; i++)
			{
				NpgsqlDataSource pool = pools[poolIndex];
				poolIndex++;
				if (poolIndex == pools.Length)
				{
					poolIndex = 0;
				}
				DatabaseState databaseState = pool.GetDatabaseState();
				if (!stateValidator(databaseState, preferredType))
				{
					continue;
				}
				NpgsqlConnector connector = null;
				try
				{
					if (pool.TryGetIdleConnector(out connector))
					{
						if (databaseState == DatabaseState.Unknown && !stateValidator(await connector.QueryDatabaseState(new NpgsqlTimeout(timeoutPerHost), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), preferredType))
						{
							pool.Return(connector);
							continue;
						}
						return connector;
					}
					connector = await pool.OpenNewConnector(conn, new NpgsqlTimeout(timeoutPerHost), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					if (connector != null)
					{
						if (databaseState != DatabaseState.Unknown)
						{
							goto IL_0326;
						}
						databaseState = pool.GetDatabaseState();
						if (databaseState == DatabaseState.Unknown)
						{
							databaseState = await connector.QueryDatabaseState(new NpgsqlTimeout(timeoutPerHost), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						if (stateValidator(databaseState, preferredType))
						{
							goto IL_0326;
						}
						pool.Return(connector);
					}
					goto end_IL_00af;
					IL_0326:
					return connector;
					end_IL_00af:;
				}
				catch (Exception item)
				{
					exceptions.Add(item);
					if (connector != null)
					{
						pool.Return(connector);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private async ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector?> TryGet(NpgsqlConnection conn, TimeSpan timeoutPerHost, bool async, TargetSessionAttributes preferredType, Func<DatabaseState, TargetSessionAttributes, bool> stateValidator, int poolIndex, IList<Exception> exceptions, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			NpgsqlDataSource[] pools = _pools;
			for (int i = 0; i < pools.Length; i++)
			{
				NpgsqlDataSource pool = pools[poolIndex];
				poolIndex++;
				if (poolIndex == pools.Length)
				{
					poolIndex = 0;
				}
				DatabaseState databaseState = pool.GetDatabaseState();
				if (!stateValidator(databaseState, preferredType))
				{
					continue;
				}
				NpgsqlConnector connector = null;
				try
				{
					connector = await pool.Get(conn, new NpgsqlTimeout(timeoutPerHost), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					if (databaseState != DatabaseState.Unknown)
					{
						goto IL_0225;
					}
					databaseState = pool.GetDatabaseState();
					if (databaseState == DatabaseState.Unknown)
					{
						databaseState = await connector.QueryDatabaseState(new NpgsqlTimeout(timeoutPerHost), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					if (stateValidator(databaseState, preferredType))
					{
						goto IL_0225;
					}
					pool.Return(connector);
					goto end_IL_00a7;
					IL_0225:
					return connector;
					end_IL_00a7:;
				}
				catch (Exception item)
				{
					exceptions.Add(item);
					if (connector != null)
					{
						pool.Return(connector);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override async ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector> Get(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			List<Exception> exceptions = new List<Exception>();
			int poolIndex = (conn.Settings.LoadBalanceHosts ? GetRoundRobinIndex() : 0);
			TimeSpan timeoutPerHost = (timeout.IsSet ? timeout.CheckAndGetTimeLeft() : TimeSpan.Zero);
			TargetSessionAttributes preferredType = GetTargetSessionAttributes(conn);
			bool flag = preferredType - 5 <= TargetSessionAttributes.ReadWrite;
			bool checkUnpreferred = flag;
			NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector = await TryGetIdleOrNew(conn, timeoutPerHost, async, preferredType, IsPreferred, poolIndex, exceptions, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (npgsqlConnector == null)
			{
				NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector2 = ((!checkUnpreferred) ? null : (await TryGetIdleOrNew(conn, timeoutPerHost, async, preferredType, IsOnline, poolIndex, exceptions, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
				NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector3 = npgsqlConnector2;
				if (npgsqlConnector3 == null)
				{
					NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector4 = await TryGet(conn, timeoutPerHost, async, preferredType, IsPreferred, poolIndex, exceptions, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					if (npgsqlConnector4 == null)
					{
						NpgsqlConnector npgsqlConnector5 = ((!checkUnpreferred) ? null : (await TryGet(conn, timeoutPerHost, async, preferredType, IsOnline, poolIndex, exceptions, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
						npgsqlConnector4 = npgsqlConnector5;
					}
					npgsqlConnector3 = npgsqlConnector4;
				}
				npgsqlConnector = npgsqlConnector3;
			}
			return npgsqlConnector ?? throw NoSuitableHostsException(exceptions);
		}

		private static NpgsqlException NoSuitableHostsException(IList<Exception> exceptions)
		{
			if (exceptions.Count != 0)
			{
				if (!(exceptions[0] is PostgresException ex) || !AllEqual(ex, exceptions))
				{
					return new NpgsqlException("Unable to connect to a suitable host. Check inner exception for more details.", new AggregateException(exceptions));
				}
				return ex;
			}
			return new NpgsqlException("No suitable host was found.");
			static bool AllEqual(PostgresException first, IList<Exception> list)
			{
				foreach (Exception item in list)
				{
					if (!(item is PostgresException ex2) || ex2.SqlState != first.SqlState)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private int GetRoundRobinIndex()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				int num = Interlocked.Increment(ref _roundRobinIndex);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num % _pools.Length;
				}
				if (num == int.MinValue)
				{
					break;
				}
				SpinWait spinWait = default(SpinWait);
				while (_roundRobinIndex < 0)
				{
					spinWait.SpinOnce();
				}
			}
			_roundRobinIndex = 0;
			return 0;
		}

		internal override void Return(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			throw new NpgsqlException("Npgsql bug: a connector was returned to NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource");
		}

		internal override bool TryGetIdleConnector([NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? connector)
		{
			throw new NpgsqlException("Npgsql bug: trying to get an idle connector from NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource");
		}

		internal override ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector?> OpenNewConnector(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			throw new NpgsqlException("Npgsql bug: trying to open a new connector from NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource");
		}

		internal override void Clear()
		{
			NpgsqlDataSource[] pools = _pools;
			for (int i = 0; i < pools.Length; i++)
			{
				pools[i].Clear();
			}
		}

		public void ClearDatabaseStates()
		{
			NpgsqlDataSource[] pools = _pools;
			for (int i = 0; i < pools.Length; i++)
			{
				pools[i].UpdateDatabaseState(DatabaseState.Unknown, default(DateTime), default(TimeSpan), ignoreTimeStamp: true);
			}
		}

		internal override bool TryRentEnlistedPending(Transaction transaction, NpgsqlConnection connection, [NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? connector)
		{
			lock (_pendingEnlistedConnectors)
			{
				if (!_pendingEnlistedConnectors.TryGetValue(transaction, out var value))
				{
					connector = null;
					return false;
				}
				TargetSessionAttributes targetSessionAttributes = GetTargetSessionAttributes(connection);
				if (TryGetValidConnector(value, targetSessionAttributes, IsPreferred, out connector))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if ((targetSessionAttributes == TargetSessionAttributes.PreferPrimary || targetSessionAttributes == TargetSessionAttributes.PreferStandby) && TryGetValidConnector(value, targetSessionAttributes, IsOnline, out connector))
				{
					return true;
				}
				connector = null;
				return false;
			}
			bool TryGetValidConnector(List<NpgsqlConnector> list, TargetSessionAttributes preferredType, Func<DatabaseState, TargetSessionAttributes, bool> validationFunc, [NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? reference)
			{
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					reference = list[num];
					DatabaseState databaseState = reference.DataSource.GetDatabaseState(ignoreExpiration: true);
					if (validationFunc(databaseState, preferredType))
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num);
						if (list.Count == 0)
						{
							_pendingEnlistedConnectors.Remove(transaction);
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
				reference = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static TargetSessionAttributes GetTargetSessionAttributes(NpgsqlConnection connection)
		{
			TargetSessionAttributes? targetSessionAttributesParsed = connection.Settings.TargetSessionAttributesParsed;
			if (!targetSessionAttributesParsed.HasValue)
			{
				string targetSessionAttributes = PostgresEnvironment.TargetSessionAttributes;
				if (targetSessionAttributes == null)
				{
					return TargetSessionAttributes.Any;
				}
				return NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.ParseTargetSessionAttributes(targetSessionAttributes);
			}
			return targetSessionAttributesParsed.GetValueOrDefault();
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlNestedDataReader : DbDataReader
	{
		private readonly struct ColumnInfo
		{
			private readonly DataFormat _format;

			public PostgresType PostgresType { get; }

			public int BufferPos { get; }

			public PgConverterInfo LastConverterInfo { get; init; }

			public PgTypeInfo ObjectOrDefaultTypeInfo { get; }

			private Field Field => new Field("?", ObjectOrDefaultTypeInfo.Options.PortableTypeIds ? ((PgTypeId)PostgresType.DataTypeName) : ((PgTypeId)(Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid)PostgresType.OID), -1);

			public PgConverterInfo GetObjectOrDefaultInfo()
			{
				return ObjectOrDefaultTypeInfo.Bind(Field, _format);
			}

			public PgConverterInfo Bind(PgTypeInfo typeInfo)
			{
				return typeInfo.Bind(Field, _format);
			}

			public ColumnInfo(PostgresType postgresType, int bufferPos, PgTypeInfo objectOrDefaultTypeInfo, DataFormat format)
			{
				LastConverterInfo = default(PgConverterInfo);
				_format = format;
				PostgresType = postgresType;
				BufferPos = bufferPos;
				ObjectOrDefaultTypeInfo = objectOrDefaultTypeInfo;
			}
		}

		private enum ReaderState
		{
			BeforeFirstRow,
			OnRow,
			AfterRows,
			AfterResult,
			Closed,
			Disposed
		}

		private readonly NpgsqlDataReader _outermostReader;

		private readonly NpgsqlNestedDataReader? _outerNestedReader;

		private NpgsqlNestedDataReader? _cachedFreeNestedDataReader;

		private PostgresCompositeType? _compositeType;

		private readonly int _depth;

		private int _numRows;

		private int _nextRowIndex;

		private int _nextRowBufferPos;

		private ReaderState _readerState;

		private readonly List<ColumnInfo> _columns = new List<ColumnInfo>();

		private long _startPos;

		private DataFormat Format => DataFormat.Binary;

		private PgReader PgReader => _outermostReader.Buffer.PgReader;

		private PgSerializerOptions SerializerOptions => _outermostReader.Connector.SerializerOptions;

		public override object this[int ordinal] => GetValue(ordinal);

		public override object this[string name] => GetValue(GetOrdinal(name));

		public override int Depth
		{
			get
			{
				CheckNotClosed();
				return _depth;
			}
		}

		public override int FieldCount
		{
			get
			{
				CheckNotClosed();
				if (_readerState != ReaderState.OnRow)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _columns.Count;
			}
		}

		public override bool HasRows
		{
			get
			{
				CheckNotClosed();
				return _numRows > 0;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsClosed
		{
			get
			{
				if (_readerState != ReaderState.Closed && _readerState != ReaderState.Disposed && !_outermostReader.IsClosed)
				{
					return PgReader.FieldStartPos != _startPos;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override int RecordsAffected => -1;

		internal NpgsqlNestedDataReader(NpgsqlDataReader outermostReader, NpgsqlNestedDataReader? outerNestedReader, int depth, PostgresCompositeType? compositeType)
		{
			_outermostReader = outermostReader;
			_outerNestedReader = outerNestedReader;
			_depth = depth;
			_compositeType = compositeType;
			_startPos = PgReader.FieldStartPos;
		}

		internal void Init(PostgresCompositeType? compositeType)
		{
			_startPos = PgReader.FieldStartPos;
			_columns.Clear();
			_numRows = 0;
			_nextRowIndex = 0;
			_nextRowBufferPos = 0;
			_readerState = ReaderState.BeforeFirstRow;
			_compositeType = compositeType;
		}

		internal void InitArray()
		{
			int num = PgReader.ReadInt32();
			bool num2 = PgReader.ReadInt32() == 1;
			PgReader.ReadUInt32();
			if (num2)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Record array contains null record");
			}
			switch (num)
			{
			case 0:
				break;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot read a multidimensional array with a nested DbDataReader");
			case 1:
				_numRows = PgReader.ReadInt32();
				PgReader.ReadInt32();
				if (_numRows > 0)
				{
					PgReader.ReadInt32();
				}
				_nextRowBufferPos = PgReader.FieldOffset;
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void InitSingleRow()
		{
			_numRows = 1;
			_nextRowBufferPos = PgReader.FieldOffset;
		}

		public override bool GetBoolean(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<bool>(ordinal);
		}

		public override byte GetByte(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<byte>(ordinal);
		}

		public override char GetChar(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<char>(ordinal);
		}

		public override DateTime GetDateTime(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<DateTime>(ordinal);
		}

		public override decimal GetDecimal(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<decimal>(ordinal);
		}

		public override double GetDouble(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<double>(ordinal);
		}

		public override float GetFloat(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<float>(ordinal);
		}

		public override Guid GetGuid(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<Guid>(ordinal);
		}

		public override short GetInt16(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<short>(ordinal);
		}

		public override int GetInt32(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<int>(ordinal);
		}

		public override long GetInt64(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<long>(ordinal);
		}

		public override string GetString(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetFieldValue<string>(ordinal);
		}

		public override long GetBytes(int ordinal, long dataOffset, byte[]? buffer, int bufferOffset, int length)
		{
			if ((dataOffset < 0 || dataOffset > int.MaxValue) ? true : false)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("dataOffset", dataOffset, $"dataOffset must be between 0 and {int.MaxValue}");
			}
			if (buffer != null && (bufferOffset < 0 || bufferOffset >= buffer.Length + 1))
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"bufferOffset must be between 0 and {buffer.Length}");
			}
			if (buffer != null && (length < 0 || length > buffer.Length - bufferOffset))
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"length must be between 0 and {buffer.Length - bufferOffset}");
			}
			ColumnInfo column;
			int num = CheckRowAndColumnAndSeek(ordinal, out column);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue();
			}
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				return num;
			}
			using (PgReader.BeginNestedRead(num, Size.Zero))
			{
				PgReader.Seek((int)dataOffset);
				length = Math.Min(length, PgReader.CurrentRemaining);
				PgReader.ReadBytes(new Span<byte>(buffer, bufferOffset, length));
				return length;
			}
		}

		public override long GetChars(int ordinal, long dataOffset, char[]? buffer, int bufferOffset, int length)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override DbDataReader GetDbDataReader(int ordinal)
		{
			return GetData(ordinal);
		}

		public new NpgsqlNestedDataReader GetData(int ordinal)
		{
			ColumnInfo column;
			int num = CheckRowAndColumnAndSeek(ordinal, out column);
			PostgresType postgresType = column.PostgresType;
			bool flag = postgresType is PostgresArrayType;
			PostgresType obj = (flag ? ((PostgresArrayType)postgresType).Element : postgresType);
			PostgresCompositeType postgresCompositeType = obj as PostgresCompositeType;
			if (obj.InternalName != "record" && postgresCompositeType == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("GetData() not supported for type " + postgresType.DisplayName);
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("field is null");
			}
			NpgsqlNestedDataReader npgsqlNestedDataReader = _cachedFreeNestedDataReader;
			if (npgsqlNestedDataReader != null)
			{
				_cachedFreeNestedDataReader = null;
				npgsqlNestedDataReader.Init(postgresCompositeType);
			}
			else
			{
				npgsqlNestedDataReader = new NpgsqlNestedDataReader(_outermostReader, this, _depth + 1, postgresCompositeType);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				npgsqlNestedDataReader.InitArray();
			}
			else
			{
				npgsqlNestedDataReader.InitSingleRow();
			}
			return npgsqlNestedDataReader;
		}

		public override string GetDataTypeName(int ordinal)
		{
			return CheckRowAndColumn(ordinal).PostgresType.DisplayName;
		}

		public override IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new DbEnumerator(this);
		}

		public override string GetName(int ordinal)
		{
			CheckRowAndColumn(ordinal);
			return _compositeType?.Fields[ordinal].Name ?? "?column?";
		}

		public override int GetOrdinal(string name)
		{
			if (_compositeType == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("GetOrdinal is not supported for the record type");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _compositeType.Fields.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_compositeType.Fields[i].Name == name)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _compositeType.Fields.Count; j++)
			{
				if (string.Compare(_compositeType.Fields[j].Name, name, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase | CompareOptions.IgnoreKanaType | CompareOptions.IgnoreWidth) == 0)
				{
					return j;
				}
			}
			throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("Field not found in row: " + name);
		}

		[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("ILLink", "IL2093", Justification = "No members are dynamically accessed by Npgsql via NpgsqlNestedDataReader.GetFieldType.")]
		public override Type GetFieldType(int ordinal)
		{
			return CheckRowAndColumn(ordinal).GetObjectOrDefaultInfo().TypeToConvert;
		}

		public override object GetValue(int ordinal)
		{
			ColumnInfo column;
			int num = CheckRowAndColumnAndSeek(ordinal, out column);
			PgConverterInfo objectOrDefaultInfo = column.GetObjectOrDefaultInfo();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			using (PgReader.BeginNestedRead(num, objectOrDefaultInfo.BufferRequirement))
			{
				return objectOrDefaultInfo.Converter.ReadAsObject(PgReader);
			}
		}

		public override int GetValues(object[] values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("values");
			}
			CheckOnRow();
			int num = Math.Min(FieldCount, values.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				values[i] = GetValue(i);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool IsDBNull(int ordinal)
		{
			ColumnInfo column;
			return CheckRowAndColumnAndSeek(ordinal, out column) == -1;
		}

		public override T GetFieldValue<T>(int ordinal)
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(Stream))
			{
				return (T)(object)GetStream(ordinal);
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(TextReader))
			{
				return (T)(object)GetTextReader(ordinal);
			}
			ColumnInfo column;
			int num = CheckRowAndColumnAndSeek(ordinal, out column);
			bool asObject;
			PgConverterInfo orAddConverterInfo = GetOrAddConverterInfo(typeof(T), column, ordinal, out asObject);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				if (default(T) == null && typeof(T).IsValueType)
				{
					return default(T);
				}
				if (typeof(T) == typeof(object))
				{
					return (T)(object)DBNull.Value;
				}
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue();
			}
			using (PgReader.BeginNestedRead(num, orAddConverterInfo.BufferRequirement))
			{
				return asObject ? ((T)orAddConverterInfo.Converter.ReadAsObject(PgReader)) : orAddConverterInfo.Converter.UnsafeDowncast<T>().Read(PgReader);
			}
		}

		public override bool Read()
		{
			CheckResultSet();
			PgReader.Seek(_nextRowBufferPos);
			if (_nextRowIndex == _numRows)
			{
				_readerState = ReaderState.AfterRows;
				return false;
			}
			if (_nextRowIndex++ != 0)
			{
				PgReader.ReadInt32();
			}
			int num = PgReader.ReadInt32();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				uint num2 = PgReader.ReadUInt32();
				int fieldOffset = PgReader.FieldOffset;
				if (i >= _columns.Count)
				{
					PostgresType postgresType = SerializerOptions.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(num2);
					_columns.Add(new ColumnInfo(postgresType, fieldOffset, AdoSerializerHelpers.GetTypeInfoForReading(typeof(object), postgresType, SerializerOptions), Format));
				}
				else
				{
					PostgresType postgresType2 = ((_columns[i].PostgresType.OID == num2) ? _columns[i].PostgresType : SerializerOptions.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(num2));
					_columns[i] = new ColumnInfo(postgresType2, fieldOffset, AdoSerializerHelpers.GetTypeInfoForReading(typeof(object), postgresType2, SerializerOptions), Format);
				}
				int num3 = PgReader.ReadInt32();
				if (num3 >= 0)
				{
					PgReader.Consume(num3);
				}
			}
			_columns.RemoveRange(num, _columns.Count - num);
			_nextRowBufferPos = PgReader.FieldOffset;
			_readerState = ReaderState.OnRow;
			return true;
		}

		public override bool NextResult()
		{
			CheckNotClosed();
			_numRows = 0;
			_nextRowBufferPos = 0;
			_nextRowIndex = 0;
			_readerState = ReaderState.AfterResult;
			return false;
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			if (_readerState != ReaderState.Disposed)
			{
				_readerState = ReaderState.Closed;
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposing || _readerState == ReaderState.Disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			Close();
			_readerState = ReaderState.Disposed;
			if (_outerNestedReader != null)
			{
				NpgsqlNestedDataReader outerNestedReader = _outerNestedReader;
				if (outerNestedReader._cachedFreeNestedDataReader == null)
				{
					outerNestedReader._cachedFreeNestedDataReader = this;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				NpgsqlDataReader outermostReader = _outermostReader;
				if (outermostReader.CachedFreeNestedDataReader == null)
				{
					outermostReader.CachedFreeNestedDataReader = this;
				}
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private void CheckNotClosed()
		{
			if (IsClosed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The reader is closed");
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private void CheckResultSet()
		{
			CheckNotClosed();
			ReaderState readerState = _readerState;
			if ((uint)readerState > 2u)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("No resultset is currently being traversed");
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private void CheckOnRow()
		{
			CheckResultSet();
			if (_readerState != ReaderState.OnRow)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("No row is available");
			}
		}

		private ColumnInfo CheckRowAndColumn(int column)
		{
			CheckOnRow();
			if (column < 0 || column >= _columns.Count)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"Column must be between {0} and {_columns.Count - 1}");
			}
			return _columns[column];
		}

		private int CheckRowAndColumnAndSeek(int ordinal, out ColumnInfo column)
		{
			column = CheckRowAndColumn(ordinal);
			PgReader.Seek(column.BufferPos);
			return PgReader.ReadInt32();
		}

		private PgConverterInfo GetOrAddConverterInfo(Type type, ColumnInfo column, int ordinal, out bool asObject)
		{
			PgConverterInfo lastConverterInfo = column.LastConverterInfo;
			if (!lastConverterInfo.IsDefault && lastConverterInfo.TypeToConvert == type)
			{
				asObject = lastConverterInfo.IsBoxingConverter && lastConverterInfo.Converter.TypeToConvert != type;
				return lastConverterInfo;
			}
			PgConverterInfo objectOrDefaultInfo = column.GetObjectOrDefaultInfo();
			if (!objectOrDefaultInfo.IsDefault)
			{
				if (typeof(object) == type)
				{
					asObject = true;
					return objectOrDefaultInfo;
				}
				if (objectOrDefaultInfo.TypeToConvert == type)
				{
					asObject = objectOrDefaultInfo.IsBoxingConverter && objectOrDefaultInfo.Converter.TypeToConvert != type;
					return objectOrDefaultInfo;
				}
			}
			PgConverterInfo pgConverterInfo = column.Bind(AdoSerializerHelpers.GetTypeInfoForReading(type, column.PostgresType, SerializerOptions));
			List<ColumnInfo> columns = _columns;
			ColumnInfo value = column;
			value.LastConverterInfo = pgConverterInfo;
			columns[ordinal] = value;
			asObject = pgConverterInfo.IsBoxingConverter;
			return pgConverterInfo;
		}
	}

	{
		public int PID { get; }

		public string Channel { get; }

		public string Payload { get; }

		internal NpgsqlNotificationEventArgs(NpgsqlReadBuffer buf)
		{
			PID = buf.ReadInt32();
			Channel = buf.ReadNullTerminatedString();
			Payload = buf.ReadNullTerminatedString();
		}
	}

	{
		public NpgsqlCommand? CommandInProgress { get; }

		public NpgsqlOperationInProgressException(NpgsqlCommand command)
			: base("A command is already in progress: " + command.CommandText)
		{
			CommandInProgress = command;
		}

			: base($"The connection is already in state '{state}'")

		}
	}
	public class NpgsqlParameter : DbParameter, IDbDataParameter, IDataParameter, ICloneable
	{
		private protected byte _precision;

		private protected byte _scale;

		private protected int _size;

		internal NpgsqlDbType? _npgsqlDbType;

		internal string? _dataTypeName;

		private protected string _name = string.Empty;

		private object? _value;

		private protected bool _useSubStream;

		private protected SubReadStream? _subStream;

		private protected string _sourceColumn;

		internal const string PositionalName = "";

		private protected object? _writeState;

		private protected Size _bufferRequirement;

		private protected bool _asObject;

		internal string TrimmedName { get; private protected set; } = "";

		private protected PgTypeInfo? TypeInfo { get; private set; }

		internal PgTypeId PgTypeId { get; private set; }

		private protected PgConverter? Converter { get; private set; }

		internal DataFormat Format { get; private protected set; }

		private protected Size? WriteSize { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue("")]
		public sealed override string ParameterName
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			[param: AllowNull]
			set
			{
				if (Collection != null)
				{
					Collection.ChangeParameterName(this, value);
				}
				else
				{
					ChangeParameterName(value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsPositional => ParameterName.Length == 0;

		[TypeConverter(typeof(StringConverter))]
		[Category("Data")]
		public override object? Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ShouldResetObjectTypeInfo(value))
				{
					ResetTypeInfo();
				}
				else
				{
					ResetBindingInfo();
				}
				_value = value;
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(StringConverter))]
		public object? NpgsqlValue
		{
			get
			{
				return Value;
			}
			set
			{
				Value = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(DbType.Object)]
		[Category("Data")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		public sealed override DbType DbType
		{
			get
			{
				NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = _npgsqlDbType;
				if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
				{
					NpgsqlDbType valueOrDefault = npgsqlDbType.GetValueOrDefault();
					return valueOrDefault.ToDbType();
				}
				if (_dataTypeName != null)
				{
					return Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.DataTypeName.FromDisplayName(_dataTypeName).ToNpgsqlDbType()?.ToDbType() ?? DbType.Object;
				}
				if (Value != null)
				{
					return GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.FindDataTypeName(GetValueType(StaticValueType), Value)?.ToNpgsqlDbType()?.ToDbType() ?? DbType.Object;
				}
				return DbType.Object;
			}
			set
			{
				ResetTypeInfo();
				_npgsqlDbType = ((value == DbType.Object) ? ((NpgsqlDbType?)null) : new NpgsqlDbType?(value.ToNpgsqlDbType() ?? throw new NotSupportedException($"The parameter type DbType.{value} isn't supported by PostgreSQL or Npgsql")));
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(NpgsqlDbType.Unknown)]
		[Category("Data")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[DbProviderSpecificTypeProperty(true)]
		public NpgsqlDbType NpgsqlDbType
		{
			get
			{
				if (_npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
				{
					return _npgsqlDbType.Value;
				}
				if (_dataTypeName != null)
				{
					return Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.DataTypeName.FromDisplayName(_dataTypeName).ToNpgsqlDbType() ?? NpgsqlDbType.Unknown;
				}
				if (Value != null)
				{
					return GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.FindDataTypeName(GetValueType(StaticValueType), Value)?.ToNpgsqlDbType() ?? NpgsqlDbType.Unknown;
				}
				return NpgsqlDbType.Unknown;
			}
			set
			{
				switch (value)
				{
				case NpgsqlDbType.Array:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", "Cannot set NpgsqlDbType to just Array, Binary-Or with the element type (e.g. Array of Box is NpgsqlDbType.Array | NpgsqlDbType.Box).");
				case NpgsqlDbType.Range:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", "Cannot set NpgsqlDbType to just Range, Binary-Or with the element type (e.g. Range of integer is NpgsqlDbType.Range | NpgsqlDbType.Integer)");
				}
				ResetTypeInfo();
				_npgsqlDbType = value;
			}
		}

		public string? DataTypeName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_dataTypeName != null)
				{
					return _dataTypeName;
				}
				NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = _npgsqlDbType;
				if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
				{
					NpgsqlDbType valueOrDefault = npgsqlDbType.GetValueOrDefault();
					string text = valueOrDefault.ToUnqualifiedDataTypeName();
					if (text != null)
					{
						return Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.DataTypeName.ValidatedName("pg_catalog." + text).UnqualifiedDisplayName;
					}
					return null;
				}
				if (Value != null)
				{
					return GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.FindDataTypeName(GetValueType(StaticValueType), Value)?.DisplayName;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				ResetTypeInfo();
				_dataTypeName = value;
			}
		}

		public sealed override bool IsNullable { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(ParameterDirection.Input)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public sealed override ParameterDirection Direction { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(0)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public new byte Precision
		{
			get
			{
				return _precision;
			}
			set
			{
				_precision = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(0)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public new byte Scale
		{
			get
			{
				return _scale;
			}
			set
			{
				_scale = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(0)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public sealed override int Size
		{
			get
			{
				return _size;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < -1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid parameter Size value '{value}'. The value must be greater than or equal to 0.");
				}
				ResetBindingInfo();
				_size = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue("")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public sealed override string SourceColumn
		{
			get
			{
				return _sourceColumn;
			}
			[param: AllowNull]
			set
			{
				_sourceColumn = value ?? string.Empty;
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		[DefaultValue(DataRowVersion.Current)]
		public sealed override DataRowVersion SourceVersion { get; set; }

		public sealed override bool SourceColumnNullMapping { get; set; }

		public NpgsqlParameterCollection? Collection { get; set; }

		public PostgresType? PostgresType { get; internal set; }

		private protected virtual Type StaticValueType => typeof(object);

		internal bool IsInputDirection
		{
			get
			{
				if (Direction != ParameterDirection.InputOutput)
				{
					return Direction == ParameterDirection.Input;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOutputDirection
		{
			get
			{
				if (Direction != ParameterDirection.InputOutput)
				{
					return Direction == ParameterDirection.Output;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlParameter()
		{
			_sourceColumn = string.Empty;
			Direction = ParameterDirection.Input;
			SourceVersion = DataRowVersion.Current;
		}

			: this()

		public NpgsqlParameter(string parameterName, NpgsqlDbType parameterType, int size, string? sourceColumn, ParameterDirection direction, bool isNullable, byte precision, byte scale, DataRowVersion sourceVersion, object value)
		{
			ParameterName = parameterName;
			Size = size;
			_sourceColumn = sourceColumn ?? string.Empty;
			Direction = direction;

			Precision = precision;
