		public NpgsqlParameter(string parameterName, DbType parameterType, int size, string? sourceColumn, ParameterDirection direction, bool isNullable, byte precision, byte scale, DataRowVersion sourceVersion, object value)
		{
			ParameterName = parameterName;
			Size = size;
			_sourceColumn = sourceColumn ?? string.Empty;
			Direction = direction;
			IsNullable = isNullable;
			Precision = precision;
			Scale = scale;
			SourceVersion = sourceVersion;
			Value = value;
			DbType = parameterType;
		}

		internal void ChangeParameterName(string? value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				string name = (TrimmedName = "");
				_name = name;
			}
			else if (value.Length > 0 && (value[0] == ':' || value[0] == '@'))
			{
				TrimmedName = (_name = value).Substring(1);
			}
			else
			{
				string name = (TrimmedName = value);
				_name = name;
			}
		}

		private Type? GetValueType(Type staticValueType)
		{
			if (!(staticValueType != typeof(object)))
			{
				return Value?.GetType();
			}
			return staticValueType;
		}

		internal bool ShouldResetObjectTypeInfo(object? value)
		{
			Type type = TypeInfo?.Type;
			if ((object)type == null || value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type2 = value.GetType();
			if (type2 != typeof(DBNull))
			{
				return type != type2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void GetResolutionInfo(out PgTypeInfo? typeInfo, out PgConverter? converter, out PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			typeInfo = TypeInfo;
			converter = Converter;
			pgTypeId = PgTypeId;
		}

		internal void SetResolutionInfo(PgTypeInfo typeInfo, PgConverter converter, PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			if (WriteSize.HasValue)
			{
				ResetBindingInfo();
			}
			TypeInfo = typeInfo;
			Converter = converter;
			PgTypeId = pgTypeId;
		}

		internal void ResolveTypeInfo(PgSerializerOptions options)
		{
			PgTypeInfo pgTypeInfo = TypeInfo;
			bool flag = pgTypeInfo?.Options == options;
			if (!flag)
			{
				NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = _npgsqlDbType;
				object obj;
				if (!npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
				{
					obj = ((_dataTypeName != null) ? Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.DataTypeName.NormalizeName(_dataTypeName) : null);
				}
				else
				{
					NpgsqlDbType valueOrDefault = npgsqlDbType.GetValueOrDefault();
					DataTypeName? dataTypeName = valueOrDefault.ToDataTypeName();
					obj = (dataTypeName.HasValue ? ((string)dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault()) : valueOrDefault.ToUnqualifiedDataTypeNameOrThrow());
				}
				string text = (string)obj;
				PgTypeId? pgTypeId = null;
				if (text != null)
				{
					if (!options.DatabaseInfo.TryGetPostgresTypeByName(text, out PostgresType pgType))
					{
						ThrowNotSupported(text);
						return;
					}
					pgTypeId = options.ToCanonicalTypeId(pgType.GetRepresentationalType());
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				Type type = StaticValueType;
				if (type == typeof(object))
				{
					type = Value?.GetType();
					if ((object)type == null && !pgTypeId.HasValue)
					{
						ThrowNoTypeInfo();
						return;
					}
					if (type == typeof(DBNull))
					{
						if (!pgTypeId.HasValue)
						{
							flag2 = true;
							pgTypeInfo = options.UnspecifiedDBNullTypeInfo;
						}
						else
						{
							type = null;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					pgTypeInfo = AdoSerializerHelpers.GetTypeInfoForWriting(type, pgTypeId, options, _npgsqlDbType);
				}
				TypeInfo = pgTypeInfo;
			}
			if (!flag || pgTypeInfo.IsResolverInfo)
			{
				ResetBindingInfo();
				PgConverterResolution pgConverterResolution = ResolveConverter(pgTypeInfo);
				Converter = pgConverterResolution.Converter;
				PgTypeId = pgConverterResolution.PgTypeId;
			}
			void ThrowNoTypeInfo()
			{
				string text2;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ParameterName))
				{
					NpgsqlParameterCollection? collection = Collection;
					text2 = $"${((collection != null) ? new int?(collection.IndexOf(this) + 1) : ((int?)null))}";
				}
				else
				{
					text2 = ParameterName;
				}
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Parameter '" + text2 + "' must have either its NpgsqlDbType or its DataTypeName or its Value set.");
			}
			void ThrowNotSupported(string text2)
			{
				NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType2 = _npgsqlDbType;
				throw new NotSupportedException(npgsqlDbType2.HasValue ? $"The NpgsqlDbType '{_npgsqlDbType}' isn't present in your database. You may need to install an extension or upgrade to a newer version." : ("The data type name '" + text2 + "' isn't present in your database. You may need to install an extension or upgrade to a newer version."));
			}
		}

		private protected virtual PgConverterResolution ResolveConverter(PgTypeInfo typeInfo)
		{
			_asObject = true;
			return typeInfo.GetObjectResolution(Value);
		}

		internal void Bind(out DataFormat format, out Size size, DataFormat? requiredFormat = null)
		{
			if (TypeInfo == null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Missing type info, ResolveTypeInfo needs to be called before Bind.");
			}
			if (!TypeInfo.SupportsWriting)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException($"Cannot write values for parameters of type '{TypeInfo.Type}' and postgres type '{TypeInfo.Options.DatabaseInfo.GetDataTypeName(PgTypeId).DisplayName}'.");
			}
			if (!WriteSize.HasValue)
			{
				if (_size > 0)
				{
					HandleSizeTruncation();
				}
				BindCore(requiredFormat);
			}
			format = Format;
			size = WriteSize.Value;
			if (requiredFormat.HasValue && format != requiredFormat)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException($"Parameter '{ParameterName}' must be written in {requiredFormat} format, but does not support this format.");
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			void HandleSizeTruncation()
			{
				Type typeToConvert = Converter.TypeToConvert;
				if (!(typeToConvert != typeof(string)) || !(typeToConvert != typeof(char[])) || !(typeToConvert != typeof(byte[])) || !(typeToConvert != typeof(Stream)))
				{
					object value = Value;
					if (value != null)
					{
						DataTypeName dataTypeName = TypeInfo.Options.GetDataTypeName(PgTypeId);
						if (dataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Text || dataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Varchar || dataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Bpchar)
						{
							if (value is string text && text.Length > _size)
							{
								Value = text.Substring(0, _size);
							}
							else if (value is char[] array && array.Length > _size)
							{
								char[] array2 = new char[_size];
								Array.Copy(array, array2, _size);
								Value = array2;
							}
						}
						else if (dataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Bytea)
						{
							if (value is byte[] array3 && array3.Length > _size)
							{
								byte[] array4 = new byte[_size];
								Array.Copy(array3, array4, _size);
								Value = array4;
							}
							else if (value is Stream)
							{
								_asObject = true;
								_useSubStream = true;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private protected virtual void BindCore(DataFormat? formatPreference, bool allowNullReference = false)
		{
			object obj = Value;
			if (obj == null && !allowNullReference)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Parameter '" + ParameterName + "' cannot be null, DBNull.Value should be used instead.");
			}
			if (_useSubStream && obj != null)
			{
				obj = (_subStream = new SubReadStream((Stream)obj, _size));
			}
			Size size;
			DataFormat format;
			PgConverterInfo? pgConverterInfo = TypeInfo.BindObject(Converter, obj, out size, out _writeState, out format, formatPreference);
			if (pgConverterInfo.HasValue)
			{
				PgConverterInfo valueOrDefault = pgConverterInfo.GetValueOrDefault();
				WriteSize = size;
				_bufferRequirement = valueOrDefault.BufferRequirement;
			}
			else
			{
				WriteSize = -1;
				_bufferRequirement = default(Size);
			}
			Format = format;
		}

		internal async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Size? writeSize = WriteSize;
			if (writeSize.HasValue)
			{
				Size writeSize2 = writeSize.GetValueOrDefault();
				try
				{
					if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
					{
						await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					writer.WriteInt32(writeSize2.Value);
					if (writeSize2.Value == -1)
					{
						writer.Commit(4);
						return;
					}
					ValueMetadata current = new ValueMetadata
					{
						Format = Format,
						BufferRequirement = _bufferRequirement,
						Size = writeSize2,
						WriteState = _writeState
					};
					await writer.BeginWrite(async, current, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await WriteValue(async, writer, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					writer.Commit(writeSize2.Value + 4);
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					ResetBindingInfo();
				}
			}
			ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Missing type info or binding info.");
		}

		private protected virtual ValueTask WriteValue(bool async, PgWriter writer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			object value = (_useSubStream ? _subStream : Value);
			if (async)
			{
				return Converter.WriteAsObjectAsync(writer, value, cancellationToken);
			}
			Converter.WriteAsObject(writer, value);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}

		public override void ResetDbType()
		{
			_npgsqlDbType = null;
			_dataTypeName = null;
			ResetTypeInfo();
		}

		private protected void ResetTypeInfo()
		{
			TypeInfo = null;
			_asObject = false;
			Converter = null;
			PgTypeId = default(PgTypeId);
			ResetBindingInfo();
		}

		private protected void ResetBindingInfo()
		{
			if (WriteSize.HasValue)
			{
				if (_writeState != null)
				{
					TypeInfo?.DisposeWriteState(_writeState);
					_writeState = null;
				}
				if (_useSubStream)
				{
					_useSubStream = false;
					_subStream?.Dispose();
					_subStream = null;
				}
				WriteSize = null;
				Format = DataFormat.Binary;
				_bufferRequirement = default(Size);
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlParameter Clone()
		{
			return CloneCore();
		}

		private protected virtual NpgsqlParameter CloneCore()
		{
			return new NpgsqlParameter
			{
				_precision = _precision,
				_scale = _scale,
				_size = _size,
				_npgsqlDbType = _npgsqlDbType,
				_dataTypeName = _dataTypeName,
				Direction = Direction,
				IsNullable = IsNullable,
				_name = _name,
				TrimmedName = TrimmedName,
				SourceColumn = SourceColumn,
				SourceVersion = SourceVersion,
				_value = _value,
				SourceColumnNullMapping = SourceColumnNullMapping
			};
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlParameterCollection : DbParameterCollection, IList<NpgsqlParameter>, ICollection<NpgsqlParameter>, IEnumerable<NpgsqlParameter>, IEnumerable
	{
		internal const int LookupThreshold = 5;

		internal static readonly bool TwoPassCompatMode;

		private Dictionary<string, int>? _caseInsensitiveLookup;

		private Dictionary<string, int>? _caseSensitiveLookup;

		internal List<NpgsqlParameter> InternalList { get; } = new List<NpgsqlParameter>(5);

		private bool LookupEnabled => InternalList.Count >= 5;

		public new NpgsqlParameter this[string parameterName]
		{
			get
			{
				if (parameterName == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("parameterName");
				}
				int num = IndexOf(parameterName);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Parameter not found");
				}
				return InternalList[num];
			}
			set
			{
				if (parameterName == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("parameterName");
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
				}
				int num = IndexOf(parameterName);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Parameter not found");
				}
				if (!string.Equals(parameterName, value.TrimmedName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Parameter name must be a case-insensitive match with the property 'ParameterName' on the given NpgsqlParameter", "parameterName");
				}
				NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = InternalList[num];
				LookupChangeName(value, npgsqlParameter.ParameterName, npgsqlParameter.TrimmedName, num);
				InternalList[num] = value;
			}
		}

		public new NpgsqlParameter this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentNullException("value");
				}
				if (value.Collection != null)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("The parameter already belongs to a collection");
				}
				NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = InternalList[index];
				if (npgsqlParameter != value)
				{
					LookupChangeName(value, npgsqlParameter.ParameterName, npgsqlParameter.TrimmedName, index);
					InternalList[index] = value;
					value.Collection = this;
					npgsqlParameter.Collection = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public override bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public override bool IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)InternalList).IsSynchronized;

		public override int Count => InternalList.Count;

		bool ICollection<NpgsqlParameter>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public override object SyncRoot => ((ICollection)InternalList).SyncRoot;

		internal bool HasOutputParameters { get; set; }

		internal PlaceholderType PlaceholderType { get; set; }

		static NpgsqlParameterCollection()
		{
			TwoPassCompatMode = AppContext.TryGetSwitch("Npgsql.EnableLegacyCaseInsensitiveDbParameters", out var isEnabled) && isEnabled;
		}

		internal NpgsqlParameterCollection()
		{
		}

		private void LookupClear()
		{
			_caseInsensitiveLookup?.Clear();
			_caseSensitiveLookup?.Clear();
		}

		private void LookupAdd(string name, int index)
		{
			if (_caseInsensitiveLookup != null)
			{
				if (TwoPassCompatMode)
				{
					DictonaryExtensions.TryAdd(_caseSensitiveLookup, name, index);
				}
				DictonaryExtensions.TryAdd(_caseInsensitiveLookup, name, index);
			}
		}

		private void LookupInsert(string name, int index)
		{
			if (_caseInsensitiveLookup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (TwoPassCompatMode && (!_caseSensitiveLookup.TryGetValue(name, out var value) || index < value))
			{
				for (int i = index + 1; i < InternalList.Count; i++)
				{
					string trimmedName = InternalList[i].TrimmedName;
					if (_caseSensitiveLookup.TryGetValue(trimmedName, out var value2) && value2 + 1 == i)
					{
						_caseSensitiveLookup[trimmedName] = i;
					}
				}
				_caseSensitiveLookup[name] = index;
			}
			if (_caseInsensitiveLookup.TryGetValue(name, out var value3) && index >= value3)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int j = index + 1; j < InternalList.Count; j++)
			{
				string trimmedName2 = InternalList[j].TrimmedName;
				if (_caseInsensitiveLookup.TryGetValue(trimmedName2, out var value4) && value4 + 1 == j)
				{
					_caseInsensitiveLookup[trimmedName2] = j;
				}
			}
			_caseInsensitiveLookup[name] = index;
		}

		private void LookupRemove(string name, int index)
		{
			if (_caseInsensitiveLookup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (TwoPassCompatMode && _caseSensitiveLookup.Remove(name))
			{
				for (int i = index; i < InternalList.Count; i++)
				{
					string trimmedName = InternalList[i].TrimmedName;
					if (_caseSensitiveLookup.TryGetValue(trimmedName, out var value) && value - 1 == i)
					{
						_caseSensitiveLookup[trimmedName] = i;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!_caseInsensitiveLookup.Remove(name))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int j = index; j < InternalList.Count; j++)
			{
				string trimmedName2 = InternalList[j].TrimmedName;
				if (_caseInsensitiveLookup.TryGetValue(trimmedName2, out var value2) && value2 - 1 == j)
				{
					_caseInsensitiveLookup[trimmedName2] = j;
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < InternalList.Count; k++)
			{
				NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = InternalList[k];
				if (string.Equals(name, npgsqlParameter.TrimmedName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					_caseInsensitiveLookup[npgsqlParameter.TrimmedName] = k;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LookupChangeName(NpgsqlParameter parameter, string oldName, string oldTrimmedName, int index)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(oldTrimmedName, parameter.TrimmedName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				if (oldName.Length != 0)
				{
					LookupRemove(oldTrimmedName, index);
				}
				if (!parameter.IsPositional)
				{
					LookupAdd(parameter.TrimmedName, index);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ChangeParameterName(NpgsqlParameter parameter, string? value)
		{
			string parameterName = parameter.ParameterName;
			string trimmedName = parameter.TrimmedName;
			parameter.ChangeParameterName(value);
			if (_caseInsensitiveLookup != null && _caseInsensitiveLookup.Count != 0)
			{
				int num = IndexOf(parameter);
				if (num != -1)
				{
					LookupChangeName(parameter, parameterName, trimmedName, num);
				}
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlParameter Add(NpgsqlParameter value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (value.Collection != null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("The parameter already belongs to a collection");
			}
			InternalList.Add(value);
			value.Collection = this;
			if (!value.IsPositional)
			{
				LookupAdd(value.TrimmedName, InternalList.Count - 1);
			}
			return value;
		}

		void ICollection<NpgsqlParameter>.Add(NpgsqlParameter item)
		{
			Add(item);
		}

		public NpgsqlParameter AddWithValue(string parameterName, object value)

		}

			{
				Value = value

			{
				Value = value

				Value = value

		public NpgsqlParameter Add(string parameterName, NpgsqlDbType parameterType)
		{
			return Add(new NpgsqlParameter(parameterName, parameterType));

		public NpgsqlParameter Add(string parameterName, NpgsqlDbType parameterType, int size)
		{
			return Add(new NpgsqlParameter(parameterName, parameterType, size));

		public NpgsqlParameter Add(string parameterName, NpgsqlDbType parameterType, int size, string sourceColumn)

			return Add(new NpgsqlParameter(parameterName, parameterType, size, sourceColumn));
		}

		public override void RemoveAt(string parameterName)
		{
			RemoveAt(IndexOf(parameterName ?? throw new ArgumentNullException("parameterName")));
		}

		public override bool Contains(string parameterName)
		{
			return IndexOf(parameterName ?? throw new ArgumentNullException("parameterName")) != -1;
		}

		public override int IndexOf(string parameterName)
		{
			if (parameterName == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (parameterName.Length > 0 && (parameterName[0] == ':' || parameterName[0] == '@'))
			{
				parameterName = parameterName.Remove(0, 1);
			}
			if (LookupEnabled && parameterName.Length != 0)
			{
				if (_caseInsensitiveLookup == null)
				{
					BuildLookup();
				}
				if (TwoPassCompatMode && _caseSensitiveLookup.TryGetValue(parameterName, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				if (_caseInsensitiveLookup.TryGetValue(parameterName, out var value2))
				{
					return value2;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (TwoPassCompatMode)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < InternalList.Count; i++)
				{
					string trimmedName = InternalList[i].TrimmedName;
					if (string.Equals(parameterName, trimmedName))
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < InternalList.Count; j++)
			{
				string trimmedName2 = InternalList[j].TrimmedName;
				if ((object)parameterName == trimmedName2 || string.Equals(parameterName, trimmedName2, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return j;
				}
			}
			return -1;
			void BuildLookup()
			{
				if (TwoPassCompatMode)
				{
					_caseSensitiveLookup = new Dictionary<string, int>(InternalList.Count);
				}
				_caseInsensitiveLookup = new Dictionary<string, int>(InternalList.Count, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				for (int k = 0; k < InternalList.Count; k++)
				{
					NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = InternalList[k];
					if (!npgsqlParameter.IsPositional)
					{
						LookupAdd(npgsqlParameter.TrimmedName, k);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (InternalList.Count - 1 < index)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			Remove(InternalList[index]);
		}

		public override void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, Cast(value));
		}

		public void Remove(string parameterName)
		{
			if (parameterName == null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentNullException("parameterName");
			}
			int num = IndexOf(parameterName);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No parameter with the specified name exists in the collection");
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
		}

		public override void Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove(Cast(value));
		}

		public override bool Contains(object value)
		{
			if (value is NpgsqlParameter item)
			{
				return InternalList.Contains(item);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(string parameterName, [NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlParameter? parameter)
		{
			if (parameterName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parameterName");
			}
			int num = IndexOf(parameterName);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				parameter = InternalList[num];
				return true;
			}
			parameter = null;
			return false;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (NpgsqlParameter @internal in InternalList)
			{
				@internal.Collection = null;
			}
			InternalList.Clear();
			LookupClear();
		}

		public override int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf(Cast(value));
		}

		public override int Add(object value)
		{
			Add(Cast(value));
			return Count - 1;
		}

		public override void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection)InternalList).CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		IEnumerator<NpgsqlParameter> IEnumerable<NpgsqlParameter>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return InternalList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return InternalList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override void AddRange(Array values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("values");
			}
			foreach (object value in values)
			{
				Add(Cast(value));
			}
		}

		protected override DbParameter GetParameter(string parameterName)
		{
			return this[parameterName];
		}

		protected override DbParameter GetParameter(int index)
		{
			return this[index];
		}

		protected override void SetParameter(string parameterName, DbParameter value)
		{
			this[parameterName] = Cast(value);
		}

		protected override void SetParameter(int index, DbParameter value)
		{
			this[index] = Cast(value);
		}

		public int IndexOf(NpgsqlParameter item)
		{
			return InternalList.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, NpgsqlParameter item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			if (item.Collection != null)
			{
				throw new Exception("The parameter already belongs to a collection");
			}
			InternalList.Insert(index, item);
			item.Collection = this;
			if (!item.IsPositional)
			{
				LookupInsert(item.TrimmedName, index);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(NpgsqlParameter item)
		{
			return InternalList.Contains(item);
		}

		public bool Remove(NpgsqlParameter item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			if (item.Collection != this)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("The item does not belong to this collection");
			}
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				InternalList.RemoveAt(num);
				if (!LookupEnabled)
				{
					LookupClear();
				}
				if (!item.IsPositional)
				{
					LookupRemove(item.TrimmedName, num);
				}
				item.Collection = null;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CopyTo(NpgsqlParameter[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			InternalList.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public NpgsqlParameter[] ToArray()
		{
			return InternalList.ToArray();
		}

		internal void CloneTo(NpgsqlParameterCollection other)
		{
			other.InternalList.Clear();
			foreach (NpgsqlParameter @internal in InternalList)
			{
				NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = @internal.Clone();
				npgsqlParameter.Collection = this;
				other.InternalList.Add(npgsqlParameter);
			}
			if (LookupEnabled && _caseInsensitiveLookup != null)
			{
				other._caseInsensitiveLookup = new Dictionary<string, int>(_caseInsensitiveLookup, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				if (TwoPassCompatMode)
				{
					other._caseSensitiveLookup = new Dictionary<string, int>(_caseSensitiveLookup);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessParameters(PgSerializerOptions options, bool validateValues, CommandType commandType)
		{
			HasOutputParameters = false;
			PlaceholderType = PlaceholderType.NoParameters;
			List<NpgsqlParameter> internalList = InternalList;
			for (int i = 0; i < internalList.Count; i++)
			{
				NpgsqlParameter npgsqlParameter = internalList[i];
				switch (PlaceholderType)
				{
				case PlaceholderType.NoParameters:
					PlaceholderType = ((!npgsqlParameter.IsPositional) ? PlaceholderType.Named : PlaceholderType.Positional);
					break;
				case PlaceholderType.Named:
					if (npgsqlParameter.IsPositional)
					{
						PlaceholderType = PlaceholderType.Mixed;
					}
					break;
				case PlaceholderType.Positional:
					if (!npgsqlParameter.IsPositional)
					{
						PlaceholderType = PlaceholderType.Mixed;
					}
					break;
				default:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("PlaceholderType", "Unknown PlaceholderType value: {0}", PlaceholderType);
					break;
				case PlaceholderType.Mixed:
					break;
				}
				switch (npgsqlParameter.Direction)
				{
				case ParameterDirection.InputOutput:
					if (PlaceholderType == PlaceholderType.Positional && commandType != CommandType.StoredProcedure)
					{
						ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Output parameters are not supported in positional mode (unless used with CommandType.StoredProcedure)");
					}
					HasOutputParameters = true;
					break;
				case ParameterDirection.Output:
					if (PlaceholderType == PlaceholderType.Positional && commandType != CommandType.StoredProcedure)
					{
						ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Output parameters are not supported in positional mode (unless used with CommandType.StoredProcedure)");
					}
					HasOutputParameters = true;
					continue;
				default:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("ParameterDirection", "Unhandled ParameterDirection value: {0}", npgsqlParameter.Direction);
					break;
				case ParameterDirection.Input:
					break;
				case ParameterDirection.ReturnValue:
					continue;
				}
				npgsqlParameter.ResolveTypeInfo(options);
				if (validateValues)
				{
					npgsqlParameter.Bind(out var _, out var _);
				}
			}
		}

		private static NpgsqlParameter Cast(object? value)
		{
			NpgsqlParameter obj = value as NpgsqlParameter;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				ThrowInvalidCastException(value);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		[DoesNotReturn]
		private static void ThrowInvalidCastException(object? value)
		{
			throw new InvalidCastException(string.Format("The value \"{0}\" is not of type \"{1}\" and cannot be used in this parameter collection.", value, "NpgsqlParameter"));
		}
	}
	internal enum PlaceholderType
	{
		NoParameters,
		Named,
		Positional,
		Mixed
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlParameter<T> : NpgsqlParameter
	{
		private T? _typedValue;

		public T? TypedValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _typedValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (typeof(T) == typeof(object) && ShouldResetObjectTypeInfo(value))
				{
					ResetTypeInfo();
				}
				else
				{
					ResetBindingInfo();
				}
				_typedValue = value;
			}
		}

		public override object? Value
		{
			get
			{
				return TypedValue;
			}
			set
			{
				TypedValue = (T)value;
			}
		}

		private protected override Type StaticValueType => typeof(T);

		public NpgsqlParameter()
		{
		}

		public NpgsqlParameter(string parameterName, T value)
		{
			ParameterName = parameterName;
			TypedValue = value;
		}

		public NpgsqlParameter(string parameterName, NpgsqlDbType npgsqlDbType)
		{
			ParameterName = parameterName;
			base.NpgsqlDbType = npgsqlDbType;
		}

		public NpgsqlParameter(string parameterName, DbType dbType)
		{
			ParameterName = parameterName;
			DbType = dbType;
		}

		private protected override PgConverterResolution ResolveConverter(PgTypeInfo typeInfo)
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(object) || base.TypeInfo.IsBoxing)
			{
				return base.ResolveConverter(typeInfo);
			}
			_asObject = false;
			return typeInfo.GetResolution(TypedValue);
		}

		private protected override void BindCore(DataFormat? formatPreference, bool allowNullReference = false)
		{
			if (_asObject)
			{
				base.BindCore(formatPreference, typeof(T) != typeof(object));
				return;
			}
			T typedValue = TypedValue;
			Size size;
			DataFormat format;
			PgConverterInfo? pgConverterInfo = base.TypeInfo.Bind(base.Converter.UnsafeDowncast<T>(), typedValue, out size, out _writeState, out format, formatPreference);
			if (pgConverterInfo.HasValue)
			{
				PgConverterInfo valueOrDefault = pgConverterInfo.GetValueOrDefault();
				base.WriteSize = size;
				_bufferRequirement = valueOrDefault.BufferRequirement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.WriteSize = -1;
				_bufferRequirement = default(Size);
			}
			base.Format = format;
		}

		private protected override ValueTask WriteValue(bool async, PgWriter writer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (_asObject)
			{
				return base.WriteValue(async, writer, cancellationToken);
			}
			if (async)
			{
				return base.Converter.UnsafeDowncast<T>().WriteAsync(writer, TypedValue, cancellationToken);
			}
			base.Converter.UnsafeDowncast<T>().Write(writer, TypedValue);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}

		private protected override NpgsqlParameter CloneCore()
		{
			return new NpgsqlParameter<T>
			{
				_precision = _precision,
				_scale = _scale,
				_size = _size,
				_npgsqlDbType = _npgsqlDbType,
				_dataTypeName = _dataTypeName,
				Direction = Direction,
				IsNullable = IsNullable,
				_name = _name,
				TrimmedName = base.TrimmedName,
				SourceColumn = SourceColumn,
				SourceVersion = SourceVersion,
				TypedValue = TypedValue,
				SourceColumnNullMapping = SourceColumnNullMapping
			};
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlRawCopyStream : Stream, ICancelable, IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable
	{
		private NpgsqlConnector _connector;

		private NpgsqlReadBuffer _readBuf;

		private NpgsqlWriteBuffer _writeBuf;

		private int _leftToReadInDataMsg;

		private bool _isDisposed;

		private bool _isConsumed;

		private bool _canRead;

		private bool _canWrite;

		internal static readonly byte[] BinarySignature = new byte[11]
		{
			80, 71, 67, 79, 80, 89, 10, 255, 13, 10,
			0
		};

		private readonly ILogger _copyLogger;

		internal bool IsBinary { get; private set; }

		public override bool CanWrite => _canWrite;

		public override bool CanRead => _canRead;

		public override bool CanTimeout => true;

		public override int WriteTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)_writeBuf.Timeout.TotalMilliseconds;
			}
			set
			{
				_writeBuf.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value);
			}
		}

		public override int ReadTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)_readBuf.Timeout.TotalMilliseconds;
			}
			set
			{
				_readBuf.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override long Length
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		internal NpgsqlRawCopyStream(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			_connector = connector;
			_readBuf = connector.ReadBuffer;
			_writeBuf = connector.WriteBuffer;
			_copyLogger = connector.LoggingConfiguration.CopyLogger;
		}

		internal async Task Init(string copyCommand, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await _connector.WriteQuery(copyCommand, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await _connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				IBackendMessage backendMessage = await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				switch (backendMessage.Code)
				{
				case BackendMessageCode.CopyInResponse:
				{
					CopyInResponseMessage copyInResponseMessage = (CopyInResponseMessage)backendMessage;
					IsBinary = copyInResponseMessage.IsBinary;
					_canWrite = true;
					_writeBuf.StartCopyMode();
					break;
				}
				case BackendMessageCode.CopyOutResponse:
				{
					CopyOutResponseMessage copyOutResponseMessage = (CopyOutResponseMessage)backendMessage;
					IsBinary = copyOutResponseMessage.IsBinary;
					_canRead = true;
					break;
				}
				case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
					throw new InvalidOperationException("This API only supports import/export from the client, i.e. COPY commands containing TO/FROM STDIN. To import/export with files on your PostgreSQL machine, simply execute the command with ExecuteNonQuery. Note that your data has been successfully imported/exported.");
				default:
					throw _connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			ValidateArguments(buffer, offset, count);
			Write(new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(buffer, offset, count));
		}

		public override Task WriteAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ValidateArguments(buffer, offset, count);
			return WriteAsync(new Memory<byte>(buffer, offset, count), cancellationToken).AsTask();
		}

		public void Write(ReadOnlySpan<byte> buffer)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (!CanWrite)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Stream not open for writing");
			}
			if (buffer.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (buffer.Length <= _writeBuf.WriteSpaceLeft)
			{
				_writeBuf.WriteBytes(buffer);
				return;
			}
			Flush();
			if (buffer.Length <= _writeBuf.WriteSpaceLeft)
			{
				_writeBuf.WriteBytes(buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				_writeBuf.DirectWrite(buffer);
			}
		}

		public ValueTask WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (!CanWrite)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Stream not open for writing");
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			return WriteAsyncInternal(buffer, cancellationToken);
			async ValueTask WriteAsyncInternal(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> memory, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				if (memory.Length != 0)
				{
					if (memory.Length <= _writeBuf.WriteSpaceLeft)
					{
						_writeBuf.WriteBytes(memory.Span);
					}
					else
					{
						await FlushAsync(async: true, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						if (memory.Length <= _writeBuf.WriteSpaceLeft)
						{
							_writeBuf.WriteBytes(memory.Span);
						}
						else
						{
							await _writeBuf.DirectWrite(memory, async: true, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			FlushAsync(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override Task FlushAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
			{
				return Task.FromCanceled(cancellationToken);
			}
			return FlushAsync(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		private Task FlushAsync(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			return _writeBuf.Flush(async, cancellationToken);
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			ValidateArguments(buffer, offset, count);
			return Read(new Span<byte>(buffer, offset, count));
		}

		public override Task<int> ReadAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ValidateArguments(buffer, offset, count);
			return ReadAsync(new Memory<byte>(buffer, offset, count), cancellationToken).AsTask();
		}

		public int Read(Span<byte> span)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (!CanRead)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Stream not open for reading");
			}
			int result = ReadCore(span.Length, async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			if (result > 0)
			{
				_readBuf.ReadBytes(span.Slice(0, result));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (!CanRead)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Stream not open for reading");
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			return ReadAsyncInternal();
			async ValueTask<int> ReadAsyncInternal()
			{
				int num = await ReadCore(buffer.Length, async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					_readBuf.ReadBytes(buffer.Slice(0, num).Span);
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private async ValueTask<int> ReadCore(int count, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (_isConsumed)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			using (_connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				if (_leftToReadInDataMsg == 0)
				{
					IBackendMessage backendMessage;
					try
					{
						backendMessage = await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					catch
					{
						if (!_isDisposed)
						{
							Cleanup();
						}
						throw;
					}
					switch (backendMessage.Code)
					{
					case BackendMessageCode.CopyData:
						break;
					case BackendMessageCode.CopyDone:
						Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
						Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
						_isConsumed = true;
						return 0;
					default:
						throw _connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
					}
					_leftToReadInDataMsg = ((CopyDataMessage)backendMessage).Length;
				}
				if (_readBuf.ReadBytesLeft == 0)
				{
					await _readBuf.ReadMore(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				int num = Math.Min(_readBuf.ReadBytesLeft, _leftToReadInDataMsg);
				if (count > num)
				{
					count = num;
				}
				_leftToReadInDataMsg -= count;
				return count;
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			Cancel(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public Task CancelAsync()
		{
			return Cancel(async: true);
		}

		private async Task Cancel(bool async)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (CanWrite)
			{
				_writeBuf.EndCopyMode();
				_writeBuf.Clear();
				await _connector.WriteCopyFail(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await _connector.Flush(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				try
				{
					IBackendMessage backendMessage = await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					throw _connector.Break(new NpgsqlException("Expected ErrorResponse when cancelling COPY but got: " + backendMessage.Code));
				}
				catch (PostgresException ex)
				{
					Cleanup();
					if (ex.SqlState != "57014")
					{
						throw;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			_connector.PerformPostgresCancellation();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			DisposeAsync(disposing, async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public new ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			return DisposeAsync(disposing: true, async: true);
		}

		private async ValueTask DisposeAsync(bool disposing, bool async)
		{
			if (_isDisposed || !disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				_connector.CurrentCopyOperation = null;
				if (CanWrite)
				{
					await FlushAsync(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					_writeBuf.EndCopyMode();
					await _connector.WriteCopyDone(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await _connector.Flush(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
				}
				else
				{
					if (_isConsumed)
					{
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						if (_leftToReadInDataMsg > 0)
						{
							await _readBuf.Skip(_leftToReadInDataMsg, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						_connector.SkipUntil(BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery);
						return;
					}
					catch (OperationCanceledException ex) when (ex.InnerException is PostgresException ex2 && ex2.SqlState == "57014")
					{
						LogMessages.CopyOperationCancelled(_copyLogger, _connector.Id);
						return;
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						LogMessages.ExceptionWhenDisposingCopyOperation(_copyLogger, _connector.Id, exception);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Cleanup();
			}
		}

		private void Cleanup()
		{
			LogMessages.CopyOperationCompleted(_copyLogger, _connector.Id);
			_connector.EndUserAction();
			_connector.CurrentCopyOperation = null;
			_connector.Connection?.EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Copy);
			_connector = null;
			_readBuf = null;
			_writeBuf = null;
			_isDisposed = true;
		}

		private void CheckDisposed()
		{
			if (_isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException("NpgsqlRawCopyStream", "The COPY operation has already ended.");
			}
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private static void ValidateArguments(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("offset");
			}
			if (count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("count");
			}
			if (buffer.Length - offset < count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Offset and length were out of bounds for the array or count is greater than the number of elements from index to the end of the source collection.");
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlCopyTextWriter : StreamWriter, ICancelable, IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable
	{

			: base(underlying)

			{
				throw connector.Break(new Exception("Can't use a binary copy stream for text writing"));
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			((NpgsqlRawCopyStream)BaseStream).Cancel();
		}

		{
			return ((NpgsqlRawCopyStream)BaseStream).CancelAsync();
		}

		public new ValueTask DisposeAsync()

			return default(ValueTask);
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlCopyTextReader : StreamReader, ICancelable, IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable
	{
		internal NpgsqlCopyTextReader(NpgsqlConnector connector, NpgsqlRawCopyStream underlying)
			: base(underlying)
		{
			if (underlying.IsBinary)
			{
				throw connector.Break(new Exception("Can't use a binary copy stream for text reading"));
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			((NpgsqlRawCopyStream)BaseStream).Cancel();
		}

		public Task CancelAsync()
		{
			return ((NpgsqlRawCopyStream)BaseStream).CancelAsync();
		}

		public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			Dispose();
			return default(ValueTask);
		}
	}
	internal static class NpgsqlSchema
	{

		public static Task<DataTable> GetSchema(bool async, NpgsqlConnection conn, string? collectionName, string?[]? restrictions, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (collectionName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collectionName");
			}
			if (collectionName.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Collection name cannot be empty.", "collectionName");
			}
			return collectionName.ToUpperInvariant() switch
			{
				"METADATACOLLECTIONS" => Task.FromResult(GetMetaDataCollections()), 
				"RESTRICTIONS" => Task.FromResult(GetRestrictions()), 
				"DATASOURCEINFORMATION" => Task.FromResult(GetDataSourceInformation(conn)), 
				"DATATYPES" => Task.FromResult(GetDataTypes(conn)), 
				"RESERVEDWORDS" => Task.FromResult(GetReservedWords()), 
				"DATABASES" => GetDatabases(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"SCHEMATA" => GetSchemata(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"TABLES" => GetTables(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"COLUMNS" => GetColumns(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"VIEWS" => GetViews(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"MATERIALIZEDVIEWS" => GetMaterializedViews(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"USERS" => GetUsers(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"INDEXES" => GetIndexes(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"INDEXCOLUMNS" => GetIndexColumns(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				"CONSTRAINTS" => GetConstraints(conn, restrictions, collectionName, async, cancellationToken), 
				"PRIMARYKEY" => GetConstraints(conn, restrictions, collectionName, async, cancellationToken), 
				"UNIQUEKEYS" => GetConstraints(conn, restrictions, collectionName, async, cancellationToken), 
				"FOREIGNKEYS" => GetConstraints(conn, restrictions, collectionName, async, cancellationToken), 
				"CONSTRAINTCOLUMNS" => GetConstraintColumns(conn, restrictions, async, cancellationToken), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("collectionName", collectionName, "Invalid collection name."), 
			};
		}

		private static NpgsqlCommand BuildCommand(NpgsqlConnection conn, StringBuilder query, string?[]? restrictions, params string[]? names)
		{
			return BuildCommand(conn, query, restrictions, addWhere: true, names);
		}

		private static NpgsqlCommand BuildCommand(NpgsqlConnection conn, StringBuilder query, string?[]? restrictions, bool addWhere, params string[]? names)
		{
			NpgsqlCommand npgsqlCommand = new NpgsqlCommand();
			if (restrictions != null && names != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < restrictions.Length && i < names.Length; i++)
				{
					string text = restrictions[i];
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
					{
						if (addWhere)
						{
							query.Append(" WHERE ");
							addWhere = false;
						}
						else
						{
							query.Append(" AND ");
						}
						string text2 = RemoveSpecialChars(names[i]);
						query.AppendFormat("{0} = :{1}", names[i], text2);
						npgsqlCommand.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter(text2, text));
					}
				}
			}
			npgsqlCommand.CommandText = query.ToString();
			npgsqlCommand.Connection = conn;
			return npgsqlCommand;
		}

		private static string RemoveSpecialChars(string paramName)
		{
			return paramName.Replace("(", "").Replace(")", "").Replace(".", "");
		}

		private static Task<DataTable> GetDatabases(NpgsqlConnection conn, string?[]? restrictions, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("Databases")
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
				Columns = 
				{
					new DataColumn("database_name"),
					new DataColumn("owner"),
					new DataColumn("encoding")
				}
			};
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("SELECT d.datname, u.usename, pg_catalog.pg_encoding_to_char(d.encoding)\nFROM pg_catalog.pg_database d\nLEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_user u ON d.datdba = u.usesysid");
			return ParseResults(async, BuildCommand(conn, stringBuilder, restrictions, "datname"), dataTable, delegate(NpgsqlDataReader reader, DataRow row)
			{
				row["database_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 0);
				row["owner"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 1);
				row["encoding"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 2);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<DataTable> GetSchemata(NpgsqlConnection conn, string?[]? restrictions, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("Schemata")
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
				Columns = 
				{
					new DataColumn("catalog_name"),
					new DataColumn("schema_name"),
					new DataColumn("schema_owner")
				}
			};
			StringBuilder query = new StringBuilder("SELECT * FROM (\n    SELECT current_database(), nspname, r.rolname\n    FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace\n    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r ON r.oid = nspowner\n) tmp");
			return ParseResults(async, BuildCommand(conn, query, restrictions, "catalog_name", "schema_name", "schema_owner"), dataTable, delegate(NpgsqlDataReader reader, DataRow row)
			{
				row["catalog_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 0);
				row["schema_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 1);
				row["schema_owner"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 2);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<DataTable> GetTables(NpgsqlConnection conn, string?[]? restrictions, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("Tables")
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
				Columns = 
				{
					new DataColumn("table_catalog"),
					new DataColumn("table_schema"),
					new DataColumn("table_name"),
					new DataColumn("table_type")
				}
			};
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("SELECT table_catalog, table_schema, table_name, table_type\nFROM information_schema.tables\nWHERE\n    table_type IN ('BASE TABLE', 'FOREIGN', 'FOREIGN TABLE') AND\n    table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')");
			return ParseResults(async, BuildCommand(conn, stringBuilder, restrictions, false, "table_catalog", "table_schema", "table_name", "table_type"), dataTable, delegate(NpgsqlDataReader reader, DataRow row)
			{
				row["table_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 0);
				row["table_schema"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 1);
				row["table_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 2);
				row["table_type"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 3);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<DataTable> GetColumns(NpgsqlConnection conn, string?[]? restrictions, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("Columns")
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
				Columns = 
				{
					new DataColumn("table_catalog"),
					new DataColumn("table_schema"),
					new DataColumn("table_name"),
					new DataColumn("column_name"),
					new DataColumn("ordinal_position", typeof(int)),
					new DataColumn("column_default"),
					new DataColumn("is_nullable"),
					new DataColumn("data_type"),
					new DataColumn("character_maximum_length", typeof(int)),
					new DataColumn("character_octet_length", typeof(int)),
					new DataColumn("numeric_precision", typeof(int)),
					new DataColumn("numeric_precision_radix", typeof(int)),
					new DataColumn("numeric_scale", typeof(int)),
					new DataColumn("datetime_precision", typeof(int)),
					new DataColumn("character_set_catalog"),
					new DataColumn("character_set_schema"),
					new DataColumn("character_set_name"),
					new DataColumn("collation_catalog")
				}
			};
			StringBuilder query = new StringBuilder("SELECT\n    table_catalog,\n    table_schema,\n    table_name,\n    column_name,\n    ordinal_position,\n    column_default,\n    is_nullable,\n    CASE WHEN udt_schema is NULL THEN udt_name ELSE format_type(typ.oid, NULL) END,\n    character_maximum_length,\n    character_octet_length,\n    numeric_precision,\n    numeric_precision_radix,\n    numeric_scale,\n    datetime_precision,\n    character_set_catalog,\n    character_set_schema,\n    character_set_name,\n    collation_catalog\nFROM information_schema.columns\nJOIN pg_namespace AS ns ON ns.nspname = udt_schema\nJOIN pg_type AS typ ON typnamespace = ns.oid AND typname = udt_name");
			return ParseResults(async, BuildCommand(conn, query, restrictions, "table_catalog", "table_schema", "table_name", "column_name"), dataTable, delegate(NpgsqlDataReader reader, DataRow row)
			{
				row["table_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 0);
				row["table_schema"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 1);
				row["table_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 2);
				row["column_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 3);
				row["ordinal_position"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<int>(reader, 4);
				row["column_default"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 5);
				row["is_nullable"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 6);
				row["data_type"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 7);
				row["character_maximum_length"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<int>(reader, 8);
				row["character_octet_length"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<int>(reader, 9);
				row["numeric_precision"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<int>(reader, 10);
				row["numeric_precision_radix"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<int>(reader, 11);
				row["numeric_scale"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<int>(reader, 12);
				row["datetime_precision"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<int>(reader, 13);
				row["character_set_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 14);
				row["character_set_schema"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 15);
				row["character_set_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 16);
				row["collation_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 17);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}
