		private static Task<DataTable> GetIndexes(NpgsqlConnection conn, string?[]? restrictions, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("Indexes")
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
				Columns = 
				{
					new DataColumn("table_catalog"),
					new DataColumn("table_schema"),
					new DataColumn("table_name"),
					new DataColumn("index_name"),
					new DataColumn("type_desc")
				}
			};
			StringBuilder query = new StringBuilder("SELECT current_database(),\n    n.nspname,\n    t.relname,\n    i.relname,\n    ''\nFROM\n    pg_catalog.pg_class i\n    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = i.oid\n    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON ix.indrelid = t.oid\n    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_user u ON u.usesysid = i.relowner\n    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = i.relnamespace\nWHERE\n    i.relkind = 'i' AND\n    n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'pg_toast') AND\n    t.relkind = 'r'");
			return ParseResults(async, BuildCommand(conn, query, restrictions, false, "current_database()", "n.nspname", "t.relname", "i.relname"), dataTable, delegate(NpgsqlDataReader reader, DataRow row)
			{
				row["table_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 0);
				row["table_schema"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 1);
				row["table_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 2);
				row["index_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 3);
				row["type_desc"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 4);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<DataTable> GetIndexColumns(NpgsqlConnection conn, string?[]? restrictions, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("IndexColumns")
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
				Columns = 
				{
					new DataColumn("constraint_catalog"),
					new DataColumn("constraint_schema"),
					new DataColumn("constraint_name"),
					new DataColumn("table_catalog"),
					new DataColumn("table_schema"),
					new DataColumn("table_name"),
					new DataColumn("column_name"),
					new DataColumn("index_name")
				}
			};
			StringBuilder query = new StringBuilder("SELECT\n    current_database(),\n    t_ns.nspname,\n    ix_cls.relname,\n    current_database(),\n    ix_ns.nspname,\n    t.relname,\n    a.attname,\n    ix_cls.relname\nFROM\n    pg_class t\n    JOIN pg_index ix ON t.oid = ix.indrelid\n    JOIN pg_class ix_cls ON ix.indexrelid = ix_cls.oid\n    JOIN pg_attribute a ON t.oid = a.attrelid\n    LEFT JOIN pg_namespace t_ns ON t.relnamespace = t_ns.oid\n    LEFT JOIN pg_namespace ix_ns ON ix_cls.relnamespace = ix_ns.oid\nWHERE\n    ix_cls.relkind = 'i' AND\n    t_ns.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'pg_toast') AND\n    a.attnum = ANY(ix.indkey) AND\n    t.relkind = 'r'");
			return ParseResults(async, BuildCommand(conn, query, restrictions, false, "current_database()", "t_ns.nspname", "t.relname", "ix_cls.relname", "a.attname"), dataTable, delegate(NpgsqlDataReader reader, DataRow row)
			{
				row["constraint_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 0);
				row["constraint_schema"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 1);
				row["constraint_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 2);
				row["table_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 3);
				row["table_schema"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 4);
				row["table_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 5);
				row["column_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 6);
				row["index_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 7);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<DataTable> GetConstraints(NpgsqlConnection conn, string?[]? restrictions, string? constraintType, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("SELECT\n    current_database(),\n    pgn.nspname,\n    pgc.conname,\n    current_database(),\n    pgtn.nspname,\n    pgt.relname,\n    constraint_type,\n    pgc.condeferrable,\n    pgc.condeferred\nFROM\n    pg_catalog.pg_constraint pgc\n    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pgn ON pgc.connamespace = pgn.oid\n    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pgt ON pgc.conrelid = pgt.oid\n    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pgtn ON pgt.relnamespace = pgtn.oid\n    JOIN (\n        SELECT 'PRIMARY KEY' AS constraint_type, 'p' AS contype\n        UNION ALL\n        SELECT 'FOREIGN KEY' AS constraint_type, 'f' AS contype\n        UNION ALL\n        SELECT 'UNIQUE KEY' AS constraint_type, 'u' AS contype\n) mapping_table ON mapping_table.contype = pgc.contype");
			switch (constraintType)
			{
			case "ForeignKeys":
				stringBuilder.Append(" and pgc.contype='f'");
				break;
			case "PrimaryKey":
				stringBuilder.Append(" and pgc.contype='p'");
				break;
			case "UniqueKeys":
				stringBuilder.Append(" and pgc.contype='u'");
				break;
			default:
				constraintType = "Constraints";
				break;
			}
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable(constraintType)
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
				Columns = 
				{
					new DataColumn("CONSTRAINT_CATALOG"),
					new DataColumn("CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA"),
					new DataColumn("CONSTRAINT_NAME"),
					new DataColumn("TABLE_CATALOG"),
					new DataColumn("TABLE_SCHEMA"),
					new DataColumn("TABLE_NAME"),
					new DataColumn("CONSTRAINT_TYPE"),
					new DataColumn("IS_DEFERRABLE", typeof(bool)),
					new DataColumn("INITIALLY_DEFERRED", typeof(bool))
				}
			};
			return ParseResults(async, BuildCommand(conn, stringBuilder, restrictions, false, "current_database()", "pgtn.nspname", "pgt.relname", "pgc.conname"), dataTable, delegate(NpgsqlDataReader reader, DataRow row)
			{
				row["CONSTRAINT_CATALOG"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 0);
				row["CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 1);
				row["CONSTRAINT_NAME"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 2);
				row["TABLE_CATALOG"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 3);
				row["TABLE_SCHEMA"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 4);
				row["TABLE_NAME"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 5);
				row["CONSTRAINT_TYPE"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 6);
				row["IS_DEFERRABLE"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<bool>(reader, 7);
				row["INITIALLY_DEFERRED"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<bool>(reader, 8);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<DataTable> GetConstraintColumns(NpgsqlConnection conn, string?[]? restrictions, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			StringBuilder query = new StringBuilder("SELECT current_database(),\n    n.nspname,\n    c.conname,\n    current_database(),\n    n.nspname,\n    t.relname,\n    a.attname,\n    a.attnum,\n    mapping_table.constraint_type\nFROM pg_constraint c\n    JOIN pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.connamespace\n    JOIN pg_class t on t.oid = c.conrelid AND t.relkind = 'r'\n    JOIN pg_attribute a on t.oid = a.attrelid AND a.attnum = ANY(c.conkey)\n    JOIN (\n        SELECT 'PRIMARY KEY' AS constraint_type, 'p' AS contype\n        UNION ALL\n        SELECT 'FOREIGN KEY' AS constraint_type, 'f' AS contype\n        UNION ALL\n        SELECT 'UNIQUE KEY' AS constraint_type, 'u' AS contype\n) mapping_table ON\n    mapping_table.contype = c.contype\n    AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'pg_toast')");
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("ConstraintColumns")
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
				Columns = 
				{
					new DataColumn("constraint_catalog"),
					new DataColumn("constraint_schema"),
					new DataColumn("constraint_name"),
					new DataColumn("table_catalog"),
					new DataColumn("table_schema"),
					new DataColumn("table_name"),
					new DataColumn("column_name"),
					new DataColumn("ordinal_number", typeof(int)),
					new DataColumn("constraint_type")
				}
			};
			return ParseResults(async, BuildCommand(conn, query, restrictions, false, "current_database()", "n.nspname", "t.relname", "c.conname", "a.attname"), dataTable, delegate(NpgsqlDataReader reader, DataRow row)
			{
				row["constraint_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 0);
				row["constraint_schema"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 1);
				row["constraint_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 2);
				row["table_catalog"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 3);
				row["table_schema"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 4);
				row["table_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 5);
				row["column_name"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 6);
				row["ordinal_number"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<int>(reader, 7);
				row["constraint_type"] = GetFieldValueOrDBNull<string>(reader, 8);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static DataTable GetDataSourceInformation(NpgsqlConnection conn)
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("DataSourceInformation");
			DataRow dataRow = dataTable.Rows.Add();
			dataTable.Columns.Add("CompositeIdentifierSeparatorPattern", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("DataSourceProductName", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("DataSourceProductVersion", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("DataSourceProductVersionNormalized", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("GroupByBehavior", typeof(GroupByBehavior));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("IdentifierPattern", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("IdentifierCase", typeof(IdentifierCase));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("OrderByColumnsInSelect", typeof(bool));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ParameterMarkerFormat", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ParameterMarkerPattern", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ParameterNameMaxLength", typeof(int));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("QuotedIdentifierPattern", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("QuotedIdentifierCase", typeof(IdentifierCase));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ParameterNamePattern", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("StatementSeparatorPattern", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("StringLiteralPattern", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("SupportedJoinOperators", typeof(SupportedJoinOperators));
			Version postgreSqlVersion = conn.PostgreSqlVersion;
			string text = $"{postgreSqlVersion.Major:00}.{postgreSqlVersion.Minor:00}";
			if (postgreSqlVersion.Build >= 0)
			{
				text += $".{postgreSqlVersion.Build:00}";
			}
			dataRow["CompositeIdentifierSeparatorPattern"] = "\\.";
			dataRow["DataSourceProductName"] = "Npgsql";
			dataRow["DataSourceProductVersion"] = postgreSqlVersion.ToString();
			dataRow["DataSourceProductVersionNormalized"] = text;
			dataRow["GroupByBehavior"] = GroupByBehavior.Unrelated;
			dataRow["IdentifierPattern"] = "(^\\[\\p{Lo}\\p{Lu}\\p{Ll}_@#][\\p{Lo}\\p{Lu}\\p{Ll}\\p{Nd}@$#_]*$)|(^\\[[^\\]\\0]|\\]\\]+\\]$)|(^\\\"[^\\\"\\0]|\\\"\\\"+\\\"$)";
			dataRow["IdentifierCase"] = IdentifierCase.Insensitive;
			dataRow["OrderByColumnsInSelect"] = false;
			dataRow["QuotedIdentifierPattern"] = "\"(([^\\\"]|\\\"\\\")*)\"";
			dataRow["QuotedIdentifierCase"] = IdentifierCase.Sensitive;
			dataRow["StatementSeparatorPattern"] = ";";
			dataRow["StringLiteralPattern"] = "'(([^']|'')*)'";
			dataRow["SupportedJoinOperators"] = SupportedJoinOperators.Inner | SupportedJoinOperators.LeftOuter | SupportedJoinOperators.RightOuter | SupportedJoinOperators.FullOuter;
			dataRow["ParameterNameMaxLength"] = 63;
			dataRow["ParameterMarkerFormat"] = "{0}";
			if (NpgsqlCommand.EnableSqlRewriting)
			{
				dataRow["ParameterMarkerPattern"] = "@[\\p{Lo}\\p{Lu}\\p{Ll}\\p{Lm}_@#][\\p{Lo}\\p{Lu}\\p{Ll}\\p{Lm}\\p{Nd}\\uff3f_@#\\$]*(?=\\s+|$)";
				dataRow["ParameterNamePattern"] = "^[\\p{Lo}\\p{Lu}\\p{Ll}\\p{Lm}_@#][\\p{Lo}\\p{Lu}\\p{Ll}\\p{Lm}\\p{Nd}\\uff3f_@#\\$]*(?=\\s+|$)";
				return dataTable;
			}
			dataRow["ParameterMarkerPattern"] = "$\\d+";
			dataRow["ParameterNamePattern"] = "\\d+";
			return dataTable;
		}

		private static DataTable GetDataTypes(NpgsqlConnection conn)
		{
			NpgsqlConnector connector;
			using (conn.StartTemporaryBindingScope(out connector))
			{
				DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("DataTypes");
				dataTable.Columns.Add("TypeName", typeof(string));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("ColumnSize", typeof(long));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("CreateFormat", typeof(string));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("CreateParameters", typeof(string));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("DataType", typeof(string));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsAutoIncrementable", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsBestMatch", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsCaseSensitive", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsConcurrencyType", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsFixedLength", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsFixedPrecisionAndScale", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsLiteralSupported", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsLong", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsNullable", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsSearchable", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsSearchableWithLike", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("IsUnsigned", typeof(bool));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("LiteralPrefix", typeof(string));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("LiteralSuffix", typeof(string));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("MaximumScale", typeof(short));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("MinimumScale", typeof(short));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("NativeDataType", typeof(string));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("ProviderDbType", typeof(int));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("OID", typeof(uint));
				try
				{
					PgSerializerOptions.IntrospectionCaller = true;
					List<PostgresType> list = new List<PostgresType>();
					list.AddRange(connector.DatabaseInfo.BaseTypes);
					list.AddRange(connector.DatabaseInfo.EnumTypes);
					list.AddRange(connector.DatabaseInfo.CompositeTypes);
					foreach (PostgresType item in list)
					{
						PgTypeInfo defaultTypeInfo = connector.SerializerOptions.GetDefaultTypeInfo(item);
						if (defaultTypeInfo != null)
						{
							DataRow dataRow = dataTable.Rows.Add();
							PopulateDefaultDataTypeInfo(dataRow, item);
							PopulateHardcodedDataTypeInfo(dataRow, item);
							dataRow["DataType"] = defaultTypeInfo.Type.FullName;
							NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = item.DataTypeName.ToNpgsqlDbType();
							if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
							{
								NpgsqlDbType valueOrDefault = npgsqlDbType.GetValueOrDefault();
								dataRow["ProviderDbType"] = (int)valueOrDefault;
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (PostgresArrayType arrayType in connector.DatabaseInfo.ArrayTypes)
					{
						PgTypeInfo defaultTypeInfo2 = connector.SerializerOptions.GetDefaultTypeInfo(arrayType);
						if (defaultTypeInfo2 != null)
						{
							DataRow dataRow2 = dataTable.Rows.Add();
							PopulateDefaultDataTypeInfo(dataRow2, arrayType.Element);
							PopulateHardcodedDataTypeInfo(dataRow2, arrayType.Element);
							dataRow2["TypeName"] = arrayType.DisplayName;
							dataRow2["OID"] = arrayType.OID;
							DataRow dataRow3 = dataRow2;
							dataRow3["CreateFormat"] = dataRow3["CreateFormat"]?.ToString() + "[]";
							dataRow2["DataType"] = defaultTypeInfo2.Type.FullName;
							NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = arrayType.DataTypeName.ToNpgsqlDbType();
							if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
							{
								NpgsqlDbType valueOrDefault2 = npgsqlDbType.GetValueOrDefault();
								dataRow2["ProviderDbType"] = (int)valueOrDefault2;
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (PostgresRangeType rangeType in connector.DatabaseInfo.RangeTypes)
					{
						PgTypeInfo defaultTypeInfo3 = connector.SerializerOptions.GetDefaultTypeInfo(rangeType);
						if (defaultTypeInfo3 != null)
						{
							DataRow dataRow4 = dataTable.Rows.Add();
							PopulateDefaultDataTypeInfo(dataRow4, rangeType.Subtype);
							PopulateHardcodedDataTypeInfo(dataRow4, rangeType.Subtype);
							dataRow4["TypeName"] = rangeType.DisplayName;
							dataRow4["OID"] = rangeType.OID;
							dataRow4["CreateFormat"] = rangeType.DisplayName.ToUpperInvariant();
							dataRow4["DataType"] = defaultTypeInfo3.Type.FullName;
							NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = rangeType.DataTypeName.ToNpgsqlDbType();
							if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
							{
								NpgsqlDbType valueOrDefault3 = npgsqlDbType.GetValueOrDefault();
								dataRow4["ProviderDbType"] = (int)valueOrDefault3;
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (PostgresMultirangeType multirangeType in connector.DatabaseInfo.MultirangeTypes)
					{
						PostgresType subtype = multirangeType.Subrange.Subtype;
						PgTypeInfo defaultTypeInfo4 = connector.SerializerOptions.GetDefaultTypeInfo(multirangeType);
						if (defaultTypeInfo4 != null)
						{
							DataRow dataRow5 = dataTable.Rows.Add();
							PopulateDefaultDataTypeInfo(dataRow5, subtype);
							PopulateHardcodedDataTypeInfo(dataRow5, subtype);
							dataRow5["TypeName"] = multirangeType.DisplayName;
							dataRow5["OID"] = multirangeType.OID;
							dataRow5["CreateFormat"] = multirangeType.DisplayName.ToUpperInvariant();
							dataRow5["DataType"] = defaultTypeInfo4.Type.FullName;
							NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = multirangeType.DataTypeName.ToNpgsqlDbType();
							if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
							{
								NpgsqlDbType valueOrDefault4 = npgsqlDbType.GetValueOrDefault();
								dataRow5["ProviderDbType"] = (int)valueOrDefault4;
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (PostgresDomainType domainType in connector.DatabaseInfo.DomainTypes)
					{
						PostgresType representationalType = domainType.GetRepresentationalType();
						PgTypeInfo defaultTypeInfo5 = connector.SerializerOptions.GetDefaultTypeInfo(representationalType);
						if (defaultTypeInfo5 != null)
						{
							DataRow dataRow6 = dataTable.Rows.Add();
							PopulateDefaultDataTypeInfo(dataRow6, representationalType);
							PopulateHardcodedDataTypeInfo(dataRow6, representationalType);
							dataRow6["TypeName"] = domainType.DisplayName;
							dataRow6["OID"] = domainType.OID;
							dataRow6["IsBestMatch"] = false;
							dataRow6["DataType"] = defaultTypeInfo5.Type.FullName;
							NpgsqlDbType? npgsqlDbType = representationalType.DataTypeName.ToNpgsqlDbType();
							if (npgsqlDbType.HasValue)
							{
								NpgsqlDbType valueOrDefault5 = npgsqlDbType.GetValueOrDefault();
								dataRow6["ProviderDbType"] = (int)valueOrDefault5;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					PgSerializerOptions.IntrospectionCaller = false;
				}
				return dataTable;
			}
		}

		private static void PopulateDefaultDataTypeInfo(DataRow row, PostgresType type)
		{
			row["TypeName"] = type.DisplayName;
			row["CreateFormat"] = type.DisplayName.ToUpperInvariant();
			row["CreateParameters"] = "";
			row["IsAutoIncrementable"] = false;
			row["IsBestMatch"] = true;
			row["IsCaseSensitive"] = true;
			row["IsConcurrencyType"] = false;
			row["IsFixedLength"] = false;
			row["IsFixedPrecisionAndScale"] = false;
			row["IsLiteralSupported"] = false;
			row["IsLong"] = false;
			row["IsNullable"] = true;
			row["IsSearchable"] = true;
			row["IsSearchableWithLike"] = false;
			row["IsUnsigned"] = DBNull.Value;
			row["MaximumScale"] = DBNull.Value;
			row["MinimumScale"] = DBNull.Value;
			row["OID"] = type.OID;
		}

		private static void PopulateHardcodedDataTypeInfo(DataRow row, PostgresType type)
		{
			string name = type.Name;
			if (name == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataRow dataRow;
			switch (name.Length)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case 7:
			{
				char c = name[0];
				if ((uint)c <= 110u)
				{
					switch (c)
					{
					default:
						return;
					case 'n':
						if (name == "numeric")
						{
							dataRow = row;
							dataRow["CreateFormat"] = dataRow["CreateFormat"]?.ToString() + "({0},{1})";
							row["CreateParameters"] = "precision, scale";
							row["MaximumScale"] = 16383;
							row["MinimumScale"] = 16383;
							row["IsUnsigned"] = false;
						}
						return;
					case 'i':
						break;
					}
					if (!(name == "integer"))
					{
						return;
					}
					goto IL_0356;
				}
				if (c != 'r')
				{
					if (c != 'v' || !(name == "varchar"))
					{
						return;
					}
					goto IL_0216;
				}
				if (!(name == "regtype"))
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			case 4:
			{
				char c = name[0];
				if (c != 'c')
				{
					if (c != 'r')
					{
						if (c != 't' || !(name == "text"))
						{
							return;
						}
						goto IL_0237;
					}
					if (!(name == "real"))
					{
						return;
					}
					goto IL_0356;
				}
				if (!(name == "char"))
				{
					return;
				}
				goto IL_0216;
			}
			case 5:
				switch (name[0])
				{
				default:
					return;
				case 'b':
					if (name == "bytea")
					{
						row["IsLong"] = true;
					}
					return;
				case 'm':
					break;
				}
				if (!(name == "money"))
				{
					return;
				}
				goto IL_0356;
			case 6:
				switch (name[0])
				{
				default:
					return;
				case 'c':
					if (name == "citext")
					{
						row["IsCaseSensitive"] = false;
					}
					return;
				case 'b':
					break;
				}
				if (!(name == "bigint"))
				{
					return;
				}
				goto IL_0356;
			case 3:
				switch (name[0])
				{
				default:
					return;
				case 'o':
					if (!(name == "oid"))
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				case 'c':
					if (!(name == "cid"))
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				case 'x':
					if (name == "xid")
					{
						row["IsUnsigned"] = true;
						row["IsConcurrencyType"] = true;
					}
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 8:
				if (!(name == "smallint"))
				{
					return;
				}
				goto IL_0356;
			case 16:
				if (!(name == "double precision"))
				{
					return;
				}
				goto IL_0356;
			case 9:
				if (!(name == "regconfig"))
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 10:
			case 11:
			case 12:
			case 13:
			case 14:
			case 15:
				return;
				IL_0356:
				row["IsUnsigned"] = false;
				return;
				IL_0237:
				dataRow = row;
				dataRow["CreateFormat"] = dataRow["CreateFormat"]?.ToString() + "({0})";
				row["CreateParameters"] = "size";
				row["IsSearchableWithLike"] = true;
				row["IsLiteralSupported"] = true;
				row["LiteralPrefix"] = "'";
				row["LiteralSuffix"] = "'";
				return;
				IL_0216:
				row["DataType"] = "String";
				row["IsBestMatch"] = false;
				goto IL_0237;
			}
			row["IsUnsigned"] = true;
		}

		private static DataTable GetReservedWords()
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable("ReservedWords")
			{
				Locale = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture
			};
			dataTable.Columns.Add("ReservedWord", typeof(string));
			string[] reservedKeywords = ReservedKeywords;
			foreach (string text in reservedKeywords)
			{
				dataTable.Rows.Add(text);
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private static async Task<DataTable> ParseResults(bool async, NpgsqlCommand command, DataTable dataTable, Action<NpgsqlDataReader, DataRow> populateRow, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			NpgsqlDataReader reader = null;
			try
			{
				NpgsqlDataReader npgsqlDataReader = ((!async) ? command.ExecuteReader() : (await command.ExecuteReaderAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
				reader = npgsqlDataReader;
				dataTable.BeginLoadData();
				while ((!async) ? reader.Read() : (await reader.ReadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)))
				{
					populateRow(reader, dataTable.Rows.Add());
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dataTable.EndLoadData();
				if (async)
				{
					if (reader != null)
					{
						await reader.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					command.Dispose();
				}
				else
				{
					reader?.Dispose();
					command.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private static object GetFieldValueOrDBNull<T>(NpgsqlDataReader reader, int ordinal)
		{
			if (!reader.IsDBNull(ordinal))
			{
				return reader.GetFieldValue<T>(ordinal);
			}
			return DBNull.Value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder : INpgsqlTypeMapper
	{
		private ILoggerFactory? _loggerFactory;

		private bool _sensitiveDataLoggingEnabled;

		private TransportSecurityHandler _transportSecurityHandler = new TransportSecurityHandler();

		private RemoteCertificateValidationCallback? _userCertificateValidationCallback;

		private Action<X509CertificateCollection>? _clientCertificatesCallback;

		private IntegratedSecurityHandler _integratedSecurityHandler = new IntegratedSecurityHandler();

		private Func<NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder, string>? _passwordProvider;

		private Func<NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder, CancellationToken, ValueTask<string>>? _passwordProviderAsync;

		private Func<NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder, CancellationToken, ValueTask<string>>? _periodicPasswordProvider;

		private TimeSpan _periodicPasswordSuccessRefreshInterval;

		private TimeSpan _periodicPasswordFailureRefreshInterval;

		private PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder _resolverChainBuilder = new PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder();

		private readonly UserTypeMapper _userTypeMapper;

		private Action<NpgsqlConnection>? _connectionInitializer;

		private Func<NpgsqlConnection, Task>? _connectionInitializerAsync;

		private static UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver<NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder> UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver { get; }

		internal JsonSerializerOptions? JsonSerializerOptions { get; private set; }

		internal Action<NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder> ConfigureDefaultFactories { get; set; }

		public NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder ConnectionStringBuilder { get; }

		public string ConnectionString => ConnectionStringBuilder.ToString();

		public string? Name { get; set; }

		public INpgsqlNameTranslator DefaultNameTranslator
		{
			get
			{
				return _userTypeMapper.DefaultNameTranslator;
			}
			set
			{
				_userTypeMapper.DefaultNameTranslator = value;
			}
		}

		internal Action<List<IPgTypeInfoResolver>> ConfigureResolverChain { get; set; }

		static NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder()
		{
			UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver = new UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver<NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder>();
			GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.AddGlobalTypeMappingResolvers(new PgTypeInfoResolverFactory[1]
			{
				new AdoTypeInfoResolverFactory()
			});
		}

		public NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder(string? connectionString = null)
			: this(new NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString))
		{
		}

		internal NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder(NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder connectionStringBuilder)
		{
			ConnectionStringBuilder = connectionStringBuilder;
			_userTypeMapper = new UserTypeMapper
			{
				DefaultNameTranslator = GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.DefaultNameTranslator
			};
			ConfigureDefaultFactories = delegate(NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder instance)
			{
				instance.AppendDefaultFactories();
			};
			ConfigureResolverChain = delegate(List<IPgTypeInfoResolver> chain)
			{
				chain.Add(UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver);
			};
		}

		public NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder UseLoggerFactory(ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory)
		{
			_loggerFactory = loggerFactory;
			return this;
		}

		public NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder EnableParameterLogging(bool parameterLoggingEnabled = true)
		{
			_sensitiveDataLoggingEnabled = parameterLoggingEnabled;
			return this;
		}

		public NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder ConfigureJsonOptions(JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions)
		{
			JsonSerializerOptions = serializerOptions;
			return this;
		}

		public NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder UseUserCertificateValidationCallback(RemoteCertificateValidationCallback userCertificateValidationCallback)
		{
			_userCertificateValidationCallback = userCertificateValidationCallback;
			return this;
		}

		public NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder UseClientCertificate(X509Certificate? clientCertificate)
		{
			if (clientCertificate == null)
			{
				return UseClientCertificatesCallback(null);
			}
			X509CertificateCollection clientCertificates = new X509CertificateCollection { clientCertificate };
			return UseClientCertificates(clientCertificates);
		}

		public NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder UseClientCertificates(X509CertificateCollection? clientCertificates)
		{
			return UseClientCertificatesCallback((clientCertificates == null) ? null : ((Action<X509CertificateCollection>)delegate(X509CertificateCollection certs)
			{
				certs.AddRange(clientCertificates);
			}));
		}

		public NpgsqlSlimDataSourceBuilder UseClientCertificatesCallback(Action<X509CertificateCollection>? clientCertificatesCallback)

				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.ArgumentMustBePositive, "successRefreshInterval"), "successRefreshInterval");
			}

			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.ArgumentMustBePositive, "failureRefreshInterval"), "failureRefreshInterval");

			_periodicPasswordProvider = passwordProvider;
			_periodicPasswordSuccessRefreshInterval = successRefreshInterval;
			_periodicPasswordFailureRefreshInterval = failureRefreshInterval;
			return this;
		}

			_passwordProviderAsync = passwordProviderAsync;

		public void AddTypeInfoResolverFactory(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)

			_resolverChainBuilder.PrependResolverFactory(factory);

		void INpgsqlTypeMapper.Reset()
		{
			_resolverChainBuilder.Clear();
		}

		internal void AppendResolverFactory(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
		{
			_resolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(factory);
		}

		internal void AppendResolverFactory<T>(Func<T> factory) where T : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
		{
			_resolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(factory);
		}

		internal void AppendDefaultFactories()
		{
			_resolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(_userTypeMapper);
			PgTypeInfoResolverFactory userMappingsResolverFactory = GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.GetUserMappingsResolverFactory();
			if (userMappingsResolverFactory != null)
			{
				_resolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(userMappingsResolverFactory);
			}
			foreach (PgTypeInfoResolverFactory pluginResolverFactory in GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.GetPluginResolverFactories())
			{
				_resolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(pluginResolverFactory);
			}
			_resolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(new AdoTypeInfoResolverFactory());
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Json serializer may perform reflection on trimmed types.")]

			_connectionInitializerAsync = connectionInitializerAsync;
			return this;

		public NpgsqlDataSource Build()
		{
			NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration dataSourceConfig = PrepareConfiguration();
			NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder settings = ConnectionStringBuilder.Clone();
			if (ConnectionStringBuilder.Host.Contains(","))
			{
				ValidateMultiHost();
				return new NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource(settings, dataSourceConfig);
			}
			if (!ConnectionStringBuilder.Multiplexing)
			{
				if (!ConnectionStringBuilder.Pooling)
				{
					return new UnpooledDataSource(settings, dataSourceConfig);
				}
				return new PoolingDataSource(settings, dataSourceConfig);
			}
			return new MultiplexingDataSource(settings, dataSourceConfig);
		}

		public NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource BuildMultiHost()
		{
			NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration dataSourceConfig = PrepareConfiguration();
			ValidateMultiHost();
			return new NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource(ConnectionStringBuilder.Clone(), dataSourceConfig);
		}

		private NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration PrepareConfiguration()
		{
			ConnectionStringBuilder.PostProcessAndValidate();
			if (!_transportSecurityHandler.SupportEncryption && (_userCertificateValidationCallback != null || _clientCertificatesCallback != null))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(NpgsqlStrings.TransportSecurityDisabled);
			}
			if (_passwordProvider != null && _periodicPasswordProvider != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(NpgsqlStrings.CannotSetMultiplePasswordProviderKinds);
			}
			if ((_passwordProvider != null || _periodicPasswordProvider != null) && (ConnectionStringBuilder.Password != null || ConnectionStringBuilder.Passfile != null))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(NpgsqlStrings.CannotSetBothPasswordProviderAndPassword);
			}
			ConfigureDefaultFactories(this);
			return new NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration(Name, (_loggerFactory == null) ? NpgsqlLoggingConfiguration.NullConfiguration : new NpgsqlLoggingConfiguration(_loggerFactory, _sensitiveDataLoggingEnabled), _transportSecurityHandler, _integratedSecurityHandler, _userCertificateValidationCallback, _clientCertificatesCallback, _passwordProvider, _passwordProviderAsync, _periodicPasswordProvider, _periodicPasswordSuccessRefreshInterval, _periodicPasswordFailureRefreshInterval, _resolverChainBuilder.Build(ConfigureResolverChain), HackyEnumMappings(), DefaultNameTranslator, _connectionInitializer, _connectionInitializerAsync);
			List<HackyEnumTypeMapping> HackyEnumMappings()
			{
				List<HackyEnumTypeMapping> list = new List<HackyEnumTypeMapping>();
				if (_userTypeMapper.Items.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (UserTypeMapping item in _userTypeMapper.Items)
					{
						if (item is UserTypeMapper.EnumMapping enumMapping)
						{
							list.Add(new HackyEnumTypeMapping(enumMapping.ClrType, enumMapping.PgTypeName, enumMapping.NameTranslator));
						}
					}
				}
				if (GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.HackyEnumTypeMappings.Count > 0)
				{
					list.AddRange(GlobalTypeMapper.Instance.HackyEnumTypeMappings);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private void ValidateMultiHost()
		{
			if (ConnectionStringBuilder.TargetSessionAttributes != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(NpgsqlStrings.CannotSpecifyTargetSessionAttributes);
			}
			if (ConnectionStringBuilder.Multiplexing)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Multiplexing is not supported with multiple hosts");
			}
			if (ConnectionStringBuilder.ReplicationMode != ReplicationMode.Off)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Replication is not supported with multiple hosts");
			}
		}

		INpgsqlTypeMapper INpgsqlTypeMapper.ConfigureJsonOptions(JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions)
		{
			return ConfigureJsonOptions(serializerOptions);
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Json serializer may perform reflection on trimmed types.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Serializing arbitrary types to json can require creating new generic types or methods, which requires creating code at runtime. This may not work when AOT compiling.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper INpgsqlTypeMapper.EnableDynamicJson(Type[]? jsonbClrTypes, Type[]? jsonClrTypes)
		{
			return EnableDynamicJson(jsonbClrTypes, jsonClrTypes);
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("The mapping of PostgreSQL records as .NET tuples requires reflection usage which is incompatible with trimming.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("The mapping of PostgreSQL records as .NET tuples requires dynamic code usage which is incompatible with NativeAOT.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper INpgsqlTypeMapper.EnableRecordsAsTuples()
		{
			return EnableRecordsAsTuples();
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("The use of unmapped enums, ranges or multiranges requires reflection usage which is incompatible with trimming.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("The use of unmapped enums, ranges or multiranges requires dynamic code usage which is incompatible with NativeAOT.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper INpgsqlTypeMapper.EnableUnmappedTypes()
		{
			return EnableUnmappedTypes();
		}

			: base("Npgsql.Sql")
