	public sealed class NpgsqlTransaction : DbTransaction
	{
		private NpgsqlConnector _connector;

		internal bool IsDisposed;

		private Exception? _disposeReason;

		private System.Data.IsolationLevel _isolationLevel;

		private readonly ILogger _transactionLogger;

		private const System.Data.IsolationLevel DefaultIsolationLevel = System.Data.IsolationLevel.ReadCommitted;

		public new NpgsqlConnection? Connection
		{
			get
			{
				CheckDisposed();
				return _connector?.Connection;
			}
		}

		protected override DbConnection? DbConnection => Connection;

		internal bool IsCompleted
		{
			get
			{
				if (_connector != null)
				{
					return _connector.TransactionStatus == Npgsql.Internal.TransactionStatus.Idle;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override System.Data.IsolationLevel IsolationLevel
		{
			get
			{
				CheckReady();
				return _isolationLevel;
			}
		}

		public new bool SupportsSavepoints => _connector.DatabaseInfo.SupportsTransactions;

		internal NpgsqlTransaction(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			_connector = connector;
			_transactionLogger = connector.TransactionLogger;
		}

		internal void Init(System.Data.IsolationLevel isolationLevel = System.Data.IsolationLevel.ReadCommitted)
		{
			if (!_connector.DatabaseInfo.SupportsTransactions)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isolationLevel <= System.Data.IsolationLevel.ReadCommitted)
			{
				if (isolationLevel != System.Data.IsolationLevel.Unspecified)
				{
					if (isolationLevel == System.Data.IsolationLevel.ReadUncommitted)
					{
						_connector.PrependInternalMessage(PregeneratedMessages.BeginTransReadUncommitted, 2);
						goto IL_00bb;
					}
					if (isolationLevel != System.Data.IsolationLevel.ReadCommitted)
					{
						goto IL_009e;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					isolationLevel = System.Data.IsolationLevel.ReadCommitted;
				}
				_connector.PrependInternalMessage(PregeneratedMessages.BeginTransReadCommitted, 2);
			}
			else
			{
				if (isolationLevel != System.Data.IsolationLevel.RepeatableRead)
				{
					if (isolationLevel == System.Data.IsolationLevel.Serializable)
					{
						_connector.PrependInternalMessage(PregeneratedMessages.BeginTransSerializable, 2);
						goto IL_00bb;
					}
					if (isolationLevel != System.Data.IsolationLevel.Snapshot)
					{
						goto IL_009e;
					}
				}
				_connector.PrependInternalMessage(PregeneratedMessages.BeginTransRepeatableRead, 2);
			}
			goto IL_00bb;
			IL_009e:
			throw new NotSupportedException("Isolation level not supported: " + isolationLevel);
			IL_00bb:
			_connector.TransactionStatus = Npgsql.Internal.TransactionStatus.Pending;
			_isolationLevel = isolationLevel;
			IsDisposed = false;
			LogMessages.StartedTransaction(_transactionLogger, isolationLevel, _connector.Id);
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			Commit(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		private async Task Commit(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckReady();
			if (_connector.DatabaseInfo.SupportsTransactions)
			{
				using (_connector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken))
				{
					await _connector.ExecuteInternalCommand(PregeneratedMessages.CommitTransaction, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					LogMessages.CommittedTransaction(_transactionLogger, _connector.Id);
				}
			}
		}

		public new Task CommitAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Commit(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		public override void Rollback()
		{
			Rollback(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		private async Task Rollback(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckReady();
			if (_connector.DatabaseInfo.SupportsTransactions)
			{
				using (_connector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken))
				{
					await _connector.Rollback(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					LogMessages.RolledBackTransaction(_transactionLogger, _connector.Id);
				}
			}
		}

		public new Task RollbackAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Rollback(async: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		public new void Save(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("name can't be empty", "name");
			}
			CheckReady();
			if (!_connector.DatabaseInfo.SupportsTransactions)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (_connector.StartUserAction())
			{
				LogMessages.CreatingSavepoint(_transactionLogger, name, _connector.Id);
				if (RequiresQuoting(name))
				{
					name = "\"" + name.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
				}
				_connector.WriteQuery("SAVEPOINT " + name, async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
				_connector.PendingPrependedResponses += 2;
			}
		}

		public new Task SaveAsync(string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			Save(name);
			return Task.CompletedTask;
		}

		private async Task Rollback(bool async, string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("name can't be empty", "name");
			}
			CheckReady();
			if (_connector.DatabaseInfo.SupportsTransactions)
			{
				using (_connector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken))
				{
					string text = (RequiresQuoting(name) ? ("\"" + name.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"") : name);
					await _connector.ExecuteInternalCommand("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + text, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					LogMessages.RolledBackToSavepoint(_transactionLogger, name, _connector.Id);
				}
			}
		}

		public new void Rollback(string name)
		{
			Rollback(async: false, name).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public new Task RollbackAsync(string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Rollback(async: true, name, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async Task Release(bool async, string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("name can't be empty", "name");
			}
			CheckReady();
			if (_connector.DatabaseInfo.SupportsTransactions)
			{
				using (_connector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken))
				{
					string text = (RequiresQuoting(name) ? ("\"" + name.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"") : name);
					await _connector.ExecuteInternalCommand("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + text, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					LogMessages.ReleasedSavepoint(_transactionLogger, name, _connector.Id);
				}
			}
		}

		public new void Release(string name)
		{
			Release(async: false, name).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public new Task ReleaseAsync(string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Release(async: false, name, cancellationToken);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (IsDisposed || !disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsCompleted)
			{
				try
				{
					_connector.CloseOngoingOperations(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
					Rollback();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			IsDisposed = true;
			_connector?.Connection?.EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction);
		}

		public new ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			if (!IsDisposed)
			{
				if (!IsCompleted)
				{
					return DisposeAsyncInternal();
				}
				IsDisposed = true;
				_connector?.Connection?.EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction);
			}
			return default(ValueTask);
			async ValueTask DisposeAsyncInternal()
			{
				_ = 1;
				try
				{
					await _connector.CloseOngoingOperations(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await Rollback(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					LogMessages.ExceptionDuringTransactionDispose(_transactionLogger, _connector.Id, exception);
				}
				IsDisposed = true;
				_connector?.Connection?.EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction);
			}
		}

		internal void DisposeImmediately(Exception? disposeReason)
		{
			IsDisposed = true;
			_disposeReason = disposeReason;
		}

		private void CheckReady()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (IsCompleted)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("This NpgsqlTransaction has completed; it is no longer usable.");
			}
		}

		private void CheckDisposed()
		{
			if (IsDisposed)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException("NpgsqlTransaction", _disposeReason);
			}
		}

		private static bool RequiresQuoting(string identifier)
		{
			char c = identifier[0];
			if (c != '_' && !char.IsLower(c))
			{
				return true;
			}
			ReadOnlySpan<char> readOnlySpan = System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(identifier, 1);
			for (int i = 0; i < readOnlySpan.Length; i++)
			{
				char c2 = readOnlySpan[i];
				if (c2 != '_' && c2 != '$' && !char.IsLower(c2) && !char.IsDigit(c2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UnbindIfNecessary()
		{
			if (!IsDisposed)
			{
				NpgsqlTransaction unboundTransaction = _connector.UnboundTransaction;
				if (unboundTransaction != null && unboundTransaction.IsDisposed)
				{
					unboundTransaction._connector = _connector;
					_connector.Transaction = unboundTransaction;
				}
				else
				{
					_connector.Transaction = null;
				}
				_connector.UnboundTransaction = this;
				_connector = null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class PgPassFile
	{
		internal sealed class Entry
		{
			internal string? Host { get; }

			internal int? Port { get; }

			internal string? Database { get; }

			internal string? Username { get; }

			internal string? Password { get; }

			private Entry(string? host, int? port, string? database, string? username, string? password)
			{
				Host = host;
				Port = port;
				Database = database;
				Username = username;
				Password = password;
			}

			internal static Entry Parse(string serializedEntry)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>(5);
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				for (int i = 0; i < serializedEntry.Length; i++)
				{
					char c = serializedEntry[i];
					switch (c)
					{
					case '\\':
						if (i < serializedEntry.Length - 1)
						{
							c = serializedEntry[++i];
							if ((c != ':' && c != '\\') || 1 == 0)
							{
								stringBuilder.Append('\\');
							}
							stringBuilder.Append(c);
							continue;
						}
						break;
					case ':':
					{
						string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
						list.Add((text == "*") ? null : text);
						stringBuilder.Clear();
						continue;
					}
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
				string text2 = stringBuilder.ToString();
				list.Add((text2 == "*") ? null : text2);
				if (list.Count != 5)
				{
					throw new FormatException("pgpass entry was not well-formed. Please ensure all non-comment entries are formatted as hostname:port:database:username:password. If colon is included, it must be escaped like \\:.");
				}
				int? port = null;
				if (list[1] != null)
				{
					if (!int.TryParse(list[1], out var result))
					{
						throw new FormatException("pgpass entry was not formatted correctly. Port must be a valid integer.");
					}
					port = result;
				}
				return new Entry(list[0], port, list[2], list[3], list[4]);
			}

			internal bool IsMatch(string? host, int? port, string? database, string? username)
			{
				if (AreValuesMatched(host, Host) && AreValuesMatched(port, Port) && AreValuesMatched(database, Database))
				{
					return AreValuesMatched(username, Username);
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool AreValuesMatched(string? query, string? actual)
			{
				if (!(query == actual) && actual != null)
				{
					return query == null;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private bool AreValuesMatched(int? query, int? actual)
			{
				if (query != actual && actual.HasValue)
				{
					return !query.HasValue;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal string FileName { get; }

		internal IEnumerable<Entry> Entries
		{
			get
			{
				MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(File.ReadAllBytes(FileName));
				using StreamReader reader = new StreamReader(stream);
				while (true)
				{
					string text = reader.ReadLine();
					if (text != null)
					{
						string text2 = text.Trim();
						if (text2.Length > 0 && text2[0] != '#')
						{
							yield return Entry.Parse(text2);
						}
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public PgPassFile(string fileName)
		{
			FileName = fileName;
		}

		internal Entry? GetFirstMatchingEntry(string? host = null, int? port = null, string? database = null, string? username = null)
		{
			foreach (Entry entry in Entries)
			{
				if (entry.IsMatch(host, port, database, username))
				{
					return entry;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class PoolingDataSource : NpgsqlDataSource
	{
		private readonly TimeSpan _connectionLifetime;

		private volatile int _numConnectors;

		private volatile int _idleCount;

		private protected readonly NpgsqlConnector?[] Connectors;

		private readonly NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource? _parentPool;

		private readonly ChannelReader<NpgsqlConnector?> _idleConnectorReader;

		private readonly ILogger _logger;

		private volatile int _clearCounter;

		private static readonly TimerCallback PruningTimerCallback = PruneIdleConnectors;

		private readonly Timer _pruningTimer;

		private readonly TimeSpan _pruningSamplingInterval;

		private readonly int _pruningSampleSize;

		private readonly int[] _pruningSamples;

		private readonly int _pruningMedianIndex;

		private volatile bool _pruningTimerEnabled;

		private int _pruningSampleIndex;

		private volatile int _isClearing;

		internal int MaxConnections { get; }

		internal int MinConnections { get; }

		internal ChannelWriter<NpgsqlConnector?> IdleConnectorWriter { get; }

		internal sealed override (int Total, int Idle, int Busy) Statistics
		{
			get
			{
				int numConnectors = _numConnectors;
				int idleCount = _idleCount;
				return (Total: numConnectors, Idle: idleCount, Busy: numConnectors - idleCount);
			}
		}

		internal sealed override bool OwnsConnectors => true;

		private static SemaphoreSlim SyncOverAsyncSemaphore { get; } = new SemaphoreSlim(Math.Max(1, Environment.ProcessorCount / 2));

		internal PoolingDataSource(NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder settings, NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration dataSourceConfig, NpgsqlMultiHostDataSource? parentPool = null)
			: base(settings, dataSourceConfig)
		{
			if (settings.MaxPoolSize < settings.MinPoolSize)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Connection can't have 'Max Pool Size' {settings.MaxPoolSize} under 'Min Pool Size' {settings.MinPoolSize}");
			}
			_parentPool = parentPool;
			Channel<NpgsqlConnector> channel = Channel.CreateUnbounded<NpgsqlConnector>();
			_idleConnectorReader = channel.Reader;
			IdleConnectorWriter = channel.Writer;
			MaxConnections = settings.MaxPoolSize;
			MinConnections = settings.MinPoolSize;
			if (settings.ConnectionPruningInterval == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("ConnectionPruningInterval can't be 0.");
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(settings.ConnectionIdleLifetime);
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(settings.ConnectionPruningInterval);
			if (timeSpan < timeSpan2)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format("Connection can't have {0} {1} under {2} {3}", "ConnectionIdleLifetime", timeSpan, "ConnectionPruningInterval", timeSpan2));
			}
			_pruningTimer = new Timer(PruningTimerCallback, this, -1, -1);
			_pruningSampleSize = DivideRoundingUp(settings.ConnectionIdleLifetime, settings.ConnectionPruningInterval);
			_pruningMedianIndex = DivideRoundingUp(_pruningSampleSize, 2) - 1;
			_pruningSamplingInterval = timeSpan2;
			_pruningSamples = new int[_pruningSampleSize];
			_pruningTimerEnabled = false;
			_connectionLifetime = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(settings.ConnectionLifetime);
			Connectors = new NpgsqlConnector[MaxConnections];
			_logger = base.LoggingConfiguration.ConnectionLogger;
		}

		internal sealed override ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector> Get(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (!TryGetIdleConnector(out NpgsqlConnector connector))
			{
				return RentAsync(conn, timeout, async, cancellationToken);
			}
			return new ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector>(connector);
			async ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector> RentAsync(NpgsqlConnection conn2, NpgsqlTimeout timeout2, bool flag, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				NpgsqlConnector connector2 = await OpenNewConnector(conn2, timeout2, flag, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (connector2 != null)
				{
					return connector2;
				}
				using CancellationTokenSource linkedSource = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(new CancellationToken[1] { cancellationToken2 });
				CancellationToken finalToken = linkedSource.Token;
				linkedSource.CancelAfter(timeout2.CheckAndGetTimeLeft());
				base.MetricsReporter.ReportPendingConnectionRequestStart();
				try
				{
					do
					{
						try
						{
							if (flag)
							{
								connector2 = await _idleConnectorReader.ReadAsync(finalToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							}
							else
							{
								SyncOverAsyncSemaphore.Wait(finalToken);
								try
								{
									ConfiguredValueTaskAwaitable<NpgsqlConnector>.ConfiguredValueTaskAwaiter awaiter = _idleConnectorReader.ReadAsync(finalToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false).GetAwaiter();
									ManualResetEventSlim mres = new ManualResetEventSlim(initialState: false, 0);
									awaiter.UnsafeOnCompleted(delegate
									{
										mres.Set();
									});
									mres.Wait(CancellationToken.None);
									connector2 = awaiter.GetResult();
								}
								finally
								{
									SyncOverAsyncSemaphore.Release();
								}
							}
							if (CheckIdleConnector(connector2))
							{
								return connector2;
							}
						}
						catch (OperationCanceledException)
						{
							cancellationToken2.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
							base.MetricsReporter.ReportConnectionPoolTimeout();
							throw new NpgsqlException($"The connection pool has been exhausted, either raise 'Max Pool Size' (currently {MaxConnections}) " + $"or 'Timeout' (currently {base.Settings.Timeout} seconds) in your connection string.", new TimeoutException());
						}
						catch (ChannelClosedException)
						{
							throw new NpgsqlException("The connection pool has been shut down.");
						}
						if (TryGetIdleConnector(out connector2))
						{
							return connector2;
						}
						connector2 = await OpenNewConnector(conn2, timeout2, flag, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					while (connector2 == null);
					return connector2;
				}
				finally
				{
					base.MetricsReporter.ReportPendingConnectionRequestStop();
				}
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		internal sealed override bool TryGetIdleConnector([NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? connector)
		{
			while (_idleConnectorReader.TryRead(out connector))
			{
				if (CheckIdleConnector(connector))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private bool CheckIdleConnector([NotNullWhen(true)] NpgsqlConnector? connector)
		{
			if (connector == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Interlocked.Decrement(ref _idleCount);
			if (connector.IsBroken)
			{
				CloseConnector(connector);
				return false;
			}
			if (_connectionLifetime != TimeSpan.Zero && DateTime.UtcNow > connector.OpenTimestamp + _connectionLifetime)
			{
				LogMessages.ConnectionExceededMaximumLifetime(_logger, _connectionLifetime, connector.Id);
				CloseConnector(connector);
				return false;
			}
			connector.SerializerOptions = base.SerializerOptions;
			connector.DatabaseInfo = base.DatabaseInfo;
			return true;
		}

		internal sealed override async ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector?> OpenNewConnector(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			for (int numConnectors = _numConnectors; numConnectors < MaxConnections; numConnectors = _numConnectors)
			{
				if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _numConnectors, numConnectors + 1, numConnectors) == numConnectors)
				{
					try
					{
						NpgsqlConnector connector = new NpgsqlConnector(this, conn)
						{
							ClearCounter = _clearCounter
						};
						await connector.Open(timeout, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						int i;
						for (i = 0; i < MaxConnections && Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref Connectors[i], connector, null) != null; i++)
						{
						}
						if (i == MaxConnections)
						{
							throw new NpgsqlException($"Could not find free slot in {Connectors} when opening. Please report a bug.");
						}
						if (numConnectors >= MinConnections)
						{
							UpdatePruningTimer();
						}
						return connector;
					}
					catch
					{
						Interlocked.Decrement(ref _numConnectors);
						IdleConnectorWriter.TryWrite(null);
						UpdatePruningTimer();
						throw;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal sealed override void Return(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			if (connector.ClearCounter != _clearCounter || connector.IsBroken)
			{
				CloseConnector(connector);
				return;
			}
			Interlocked.Increment(ref _idleCount);
			IdleConnectorWriter.TryWrite(connector);
		}

		internal override void Clear()
		{
			Interlocked.Increment(ref _clearCounter);
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _isClearing, 1, 0) == 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				int num = _idleCount;
				NpgsqlConnector item;
				while (num > 0 && _idleConnectorReader.TryRead(out item))
				{
					if (CheckIdleConnector(item))
					{
						CloseConnector(item);
						num--;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_isClearing = 0;
			}
		}

		private void CloseConnector(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			try
			{
				connector.Close();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				LogMessages.ExceptionWhenClosingPhysicalConnection(_logger, connector.Id, exception);
			}
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < MaxConnections && Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref Connectors[i], null, connector) != connector; i++)
			{
			}
			if (i != MaxConnections)
			{
				int num = Interlocked.Decrement(ref _numConnectors);
				IdleConnectorWriter.TryWrite(null);
				if (num == MinConnections)
				{
					UpdatePruningTimer();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool TryRemovePendingEnlistedConnector(NpgsqlConnector connector, Transaction transaction)
		{
			if (_parentPool != null)
			{
				return _parentPool.TryRemovePendingEnlistedConnector(connector, transaction);
			}
			return base.TryRemovePendingEnlistedConnector(connector, transaction);
		}

		private void UpdatePruningTimer()
		{
			lock (_pruningTimer)
			{
				int numConnectors = _numConnectors;
				if (numConnectors > MinConnections && !_pruningTimerEnabled)
				{
					_pruningTimerEnabled = true;
					_pruningTimer.Change(_pruningSamplingInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
				}
				else if (numConnectors <= MinConnections && _pruningTimerEnabled)
				{
					_pruningTimer.Change(-1, -1);
					_pruningSampleIndex = 0;
					_pruningTimerEnabled = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void PruneIdleConnectors(object? state)
		{
			PoolingDataSource poolingDataSource = (PoolingDataSource)state;
			int[] pruningSamples = poolingDataSource._pruningSamples;
			int num;
			lock (poolingDataSource._pruningTimer)
			{
				if (!poolingDataSource._pruningTimerEnabled)
				{
					return;
				}
				int pruningSampleIndex = poolingDataSource._pruningSampleIndex;
				pruningSamples[pruningSampleIndex] = poolingDataSource._idleCount;
				if (pruningSampleIndex != poolingDataSource._pruningSampleSize - 1)
				{
					poolingDataSource._pruningSampleIndex = pruningSampleIndex + 1;
					poolingDataSource._pruningTimer.Change(poolingDataSource._pruningSamplingInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
					return;
				}
				Array.Sort(pruningSamples);
				num = pruningSamples[poolingDataSource._pruningMedianIndex];
				poolingDataSource._pruningSampleIndex = 0;
				poolingDataSource._pruningTimer.Change(poolingDataSource._pruningSamplingInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
			}
			NpgsqlConnector item;
			while (num > 0 && poolingDataSource._numConnectors > poolingDataSource.MinConnections && poolingDataSource._idleConnectorReader.TryRead(out item) && item != null)
			{
				if (poolingDataSource.CheckIdleConnector(item))
				{
					poolingDataSource.CloseConnector(item);
				}
				num--;
			}
		}

		private static int DivideRoundingUp(int value, int divisor)
		{
			return 1 + (value - 1) / divisor;
		}
	}
	internal static class PoolManager
	{
		internal static ConcurrentDictionary<string, NpgsqlDataSource> Pools { get; }

		internal static void Clear(string connString)
		{
			if (Pools.TryGetValue(connString, out var value))
			{
				value.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal static void ClearAll()
		{
			foreach (NpgsqlDataSource value in Pools.Values)
			{
				value.Clear();
			}
		}

		static PoolManager()
		{
			Pools = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, NpgsqlDataSource>();
			AppDomain.CurrentDomain.DomainUnload += delegate
			{
				ClearAll();
			};
			AppDomain.CurrentDomain.ProcessExit += delegate
			{
				ClearAll();
			};
		}

		internal static void Reset()
		{
			ClearAll();
			Pools.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class PostgresDatabaseInfoFactory : INpgsqlDatabaseInfoFactory
	{
		public async Task<NpgsqlDatabaseInfo?> Load(NpgsqlConnector conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async)
		{
			PostgresDatabaseInfo db = new PostgresDatabaseInfo(conn);
			await db.LoadPostgresInfo(conn, timeout, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return db;
		}
	}
	internal class PostgresDatabaseInfo : NpgsqlDatabaseInfo
	{
		private readonly ILogger _connectionLogger;

		private List<PostgresType>? _types;

		public string LongVersion { get; set; }

		public bool IsRedshift { get; private set; }

		public override bool SupportsUnlisten
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(6, 4))
				{
					return !IsRedshift;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool HasEnumSortOrder => base.Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(9, 1);

		public virtual bool HasTypeCategory => base.Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(8, 4);

		protected override IEnumerable<PostgresType> GetTypes()
		{
			IEnumerable<PostgresType> types = _types;
			return types ?? Array.Empty<PostgresType>();
		}

		internal PostgresDatabaseInfo(NpgsqlConnector conn)
			: base(conn.Host, conn.Port, conn.Database, conn.PostgresParameters["server_version"])
		{
			_connectionLogger = conn.LoggingConfiguration.ConnectionLogger;
		}

		private protected PostgresDatabaseInfo(string host, int port, string databaseName, string serverVersion)
			: base(host, port, databaseName, serverVersion)
		{
			_connectionLogger = NullLogger.Instance;
		}

		internal async Task LoadPostgresInfo(NpgsqlConnector conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async)
		{
			HasIntegerDateTimes = conn.PostgresParameters.TryGetValue("integer_datetimes", out var value) && value == "on";
			IsRedshift = conn.Settings.ServerCompatibilityMode == ServerCompatibilityMode.Redshift;
			_types = await LoadBackendTypes(conn, timeout, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		private static string GenerateLoadTypesQuery(bool withRange, bool withMultirange, bool loadTableComposites)
		{
			return "\nSELECT ns.nspname, t.oid, t.typname, t.typtype, t.typnotnull, t.elemtypoid\nFROM (\n    -- Arrays have typtype=b - this subquery identifies them by their typreceive and converts their typtype to a\n    -- We first do this for the type (innerest-most subquery), and then for its element type\n    -- This also returns the array element, range subtype and domain base type as elemtypoid\n    SELECT\n        typ.oid, typ.typnamespace, typ.typname, typ.typtype, typ.typrelid, typ.typnotnull, typ.relkind,\n        elemtyp.oid AS elemtypoid, elemtyp.typname AS elemtypname, elemcls.relkind AS elemrelkind,\n        CASE WHEN elemproc.proname='array_recv' THEN 'a' ELSE elemtyp.typtype END AS elemtyptype\n    FROM (\n        SELECT typ.oid, typnamespace, typname, typrelid, typnotnull, relkind, typelem AS elemoid,\n            CASE WHEN proc.proname='array_recv' THEN 'a' ELSE typ.typtype END AS typtype,\n            CASE\n                WHEN proc.proname='array_recv' THEN typ.typelem\n                " + (withRange ? "WHEN typ.typtype='r' THEN rngsubtype" : "") + "\n                " + (withMultirange ? "WHEN typ.typtype='m' THEN (SELECT rngtypid FROM pg_range WHERE rngmultitypid = typ.oid)" : "") + "\n                WHEN typ.typtype='d' THEN typ.typbasetype\n            END AS elemtypoid\n        FROM pg_type AS typ\n        LEFT JOIN pg_class AS cls ON (cls.oid = typ.typrelid)\n        LEFT JOIN pg_proc AS proc ON proc.oid = typ.typreceive\n        " + (withRange ? "LEFT JOIN pg_range ON (pg_range.rngtypid = typ.oid)" : "") + "\n    ) AS typ\n    LEFT JOIN pg_type AS elemtyp ON elemtyp.oid = elemtypoid\n    LEFT JOIN pg_class AS elemcls ON (elemcls.oid = elemtyp.typrelid)\n    LEFT JOIN pg_proc AS elemproc ON elemproc.oid = elemtyp.typreceive\n) AS t\nJOIN pg_namespace AS ns ON (ns.oid = typnamespace)\nWHERE\n    typtype IN ('b', 'r', 'm', 'e', 'd') OR -- Base, range, multirange, enum, domain\n    (typtype = 'c' AND " + (loadTableComposites ? "ns.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast')" : "relkind='c'") + ") OR -- User-defined free-standing composites (not table composites) by default\n    (typtype = 'p' AND typname IN ('record', 'void', 'unknown')) OR -- Some special supported pseudo-types\n    (typtype = 'a' AND (  -- Array of...\n        elemtyptype IN ('b', 'r', 'm', 'e', 'd') OR -- Array of base, range, multirange, enum, domain\n        (elemtyptype = 'p' AND elemtypname IN ('record', 'void')) OR -- Arrays of special supported pseudo-types\n        (elemtyptype = 'c' AND " + (loadTableComposites ? "ns.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast')" : "elemrelkind='c'") + ") -- Array of user-defined free-standing composites (not table composites) by default\n    ))\nORDER BY CASE\n       WHEN typtype IN ('b', 'e', 'p') THEN 0           -- First base types, enums, pseudo-types\n       WHEN typtype = 'c' THEN 1                        -- Composites after (fields loaded later in 2nd pass)\n       WHEN typtype = 'r' THEN 2                        -- Ranges after\n       WHEN typtype = 'm' THEN 3                        -- Multiranges after\n       WHEN typtype = 'd' AND elemtyptype <> 'a' THEN 4 -- Domains over non-arrays after\n       WHEN typtype = 'a' THEN 5                        -- Arrays after\n       WHEN typtype = 'd' AND elemtyptype = 'a' THEN 6  -- Domains over arrays last\nEND;";
		}

		private static string GenerateLoadCompositeTypesQuery(bool loadTableComposites)
		{
			return "\n-- Load field definitions for (free-standing) composite types\nSELECT typ.oid, att.attname, att.atttypid\nFROM pg_type AS typ\nJOIN pg_namespace AS ns ON (ns.oid = typ.typnamespace)\nJOIN pg_class AS cls ON (cls.oid = typ.typrelid)\nJOIN pg_attribute AS att ON (att.attrelid = typ.typrelid)\nWHERE\n  (typ.typtype = 'c' AND " + (loadTableComposites ? "ns.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast')" : "cls.relkind='c'") + ") AND\n  attnum > 0 AND     -- Don't load system attributes\n  NOT attisdropped\nORDER BY typ.oid, att.attnum;";
		}

		private static string GenerateLoadEnumFieldsQuery(bool withEnumSortOrder)
		{
			return "\n-- Load enum fields\nSELECT pg_type.oid, enumlabel\nFROM pg_enum\nJOIN pg_type ON pg_type.oid=enumtypid\nORDER BY oid" + (withEnumSortOrder ? ", enumsortorder" : "") + ";";
		}

		internal async Task<List<PostgresType>> LoadBackendTypes(NpgsqlConnector conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async)
		{
			string text = "SELECT version();";
			string loadTypesQuery = GenerateLoadTypesQuery(SupportsRangeTypes, SupportsMultirangeTypes, conn.Settings.LoadTableComposites);
			string loadCompositeTypesQuery = GenerateLoadCompositeTypesQuery(conn.Settings.LoadTableComposites);
			string loadEnumFieldsQuery = (SupportsEnumTypes ? GenerateLoadEnumFieldsQuery(HasEnumSortOrder) : string.Empty);
			timeout.CheckAndApply(conn);
			bool isReplicationConnection = conn.Settings.ReplicationMode != ReplicationMode.Off;
			if (isReplicationConnection)
			{
				await conn.WriteQuery(text, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await conn.WriteQuery(SanitizeForReplicationConnection(loadTypesQuery), async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await conn.WriteQuery(SanitizeForReplicationConnection(loadCompositeTypesQuery), async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (SupportsEnumTypes)
				{
					await conn.WriteQuery(SanitizeForReplicationConnection(loadEnumFieldsQuery), async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(text.Length + loadTypesQuery.Length + loadCompositeTypesQuery.Length + (SupportsEnumTypes ? loadEnumFieldsQuery.Length : 0)).AppendLine(text).AppendLine(loadTypesQuery).AppendLine(loadCompositeTypesQuery);
				if (SupportsEnumTypes)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(loadEnumFieldsQuery);
				}
				await conn.WriteQuery(stringBuilder.ToString(), async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			await conn.Flush(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			Dictionary<uint, PostgresType> byOID = new Dictionary<uint, PostgresType>();
			Statics.Expect<RowDescriptionMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			Statics.Expect<DataRowMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			conn.ReadBuffer.Skip(2);
			LongVersion = ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer);
			Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			if (isReplicationConnection)
			{
				Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			}
			Statics.Expect<RowDescriptionMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			IBackendMessage backendMessage;
			while (true)
			{
				backendMessage = await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (!(backendMessage is DataRowMessage))
				{
					break;
				}
				conn.ReadBuffer.Skip(2);
				string ns = ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer);
				uint oid = uint.Parse(ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer), NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				string text2 = ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer);
				char c = ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer)[0];
				bool notNull = ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer)[0] == 't';
				int num = conn.ReadBuffer.ReadInt32();
				uint num2 = ((num != -1) ? uint.Parse(conn.ReadBuffer.ReadString(num), NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo) : 0u);
				switch (c)
				{
				case 'b':
				case 'p':
				{
					PostgresBaseType postgresBaseType = new PostgresBaseType(ns, text2, oid);
					byOID[postgresBaseType.OID] = postgresBaseType;
					break;
				}
				case 'a':
				{
					if (!byOID.TryGetValue(num2, out var value3))
					{
						_connectionLogger.LogTrace("Array type '{ArrayTypeName}' refers to unknown element with OID {ElementTypeOID}, skipping", text2, num2);
					}
					else
					{
						PostgresArrayType postgresArrayType = new PostgresArrayType(ns, text2, oid, value3);
						byOID[postgresArrayType.OID] = postgresArrayType;
					}
					break;
				}
				case 'r':
				{
					if (!byOID.TryGetValue(num2, out var value2))
					{
						_connectionLogger.LogTrace("Range type '{RangeTypeName}' refers to unknown subtype with OID {ElementTypeOID}, skipping", text2, num2);
					}
					else
					{
						PostgresRangeType postgresRangeType = new PostgresRangeType(ns, text2, oid, value2);
						byOID[postgresRangeType.OID] = postgresRangeType;
					}
					break;
				}
				case 'm':
				{
					if (!byOID.TryGetValue(num2, out var value4))
					{
						_connectionLogger.LogTrace("Multirange type '{MultirangeTypeName}' refers to unknown range with OID {ElementTypeOID}, skipping", text2, num2);
					}
					else if (!(value4 is PostgresRangeType rangePostgresType))
					{
						_connectionLogger.LogTrace("Multirange type '{MultirangeTypeName}' refers to non-range type '{TypeName}', skipping", text2, value4.Name);
					}
					else
					{
						PostgresMultirangeType postgresMultirangeType = new PostgresMultirangeType(ns, text2, oid, rangePostgresType);
						byOID[postgresMultirangeType.OID] = postgresMultirangeType;
					}
					break;
				}
				case 'e':
				{
					PostgresEnumType postgresEnumType = new PostgresEnumType(ns, text2, oid);
					byOID[postgresEnumType.OID] = postgresEnumType;
					break;
				}
				case 'c':
				{
					PostgresCompositeType postgresCompositeType = new PostgresCompositeType(ns, text2, oid);
					byOID[postgresCompositeType.OID] = postgresCompositeType;
					break;
				}
				case 'd':
				{
					if (!byOID.TryGetValue(num2, out var value))
					{
						_connectionLogger.LogTrace("Domain type '{DomainTypeName}' refers to unknown base type with OID {ElementTypeOID}, skipping", text2, num2);
					}
					else
					{
						PostgresDomainType postgresDomainType = new PostgresDomainType(ns, text2, oid, value, notNull);
						byOID[postgresDomainType.OID] = postgresDomainType;
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException($"Unknown typtype for type '{text2}' in pg_type: {c}");
				}
			}
			Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(backendMessage, conn);
			if (isReplicationConnection)
			{
				Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			}
			Statics.Expect<RowDescriptionMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			uint currentOID = uint.MaxValue;
			PostgresCompositeType currentComposite = null;
			bool skipCurrent = false;
			while (true)
			{
				backendMessage = await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (!(backendMessage is DataRowMessage))
				{
					break;
				}
				conn.ReadBuffer.Skip(2);
				uint num3 = uint.Parse(ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer), NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				string text3 = ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer);
				uint num4 = uint.Parse(ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer), NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
				if (num3 != currentOID)
				{
					currentOID = num3;
					if (!byOID.TryGetValue(num3, out var value5))
					{
						_connectionLogger.LogWarning("Skipping composite type with OID {CompositeTypeOID} which was not found in pg_type", num3);
						byOID.Remove(num3);
						skipCurrent = true;
						continue;
					}
					currentComposite = value5 as PostgresCompositeType;
					if (currentComposite == null)
					{
						_connectionLogger.LogWarning("Type {TypeName} was referenced as a composite type but is a {type}", value5.Name, value5.GetType());
						byOID.Remove(num3);
						skipCurrent = true;
						continue;
					}
					skipCurrent = false;
				}
				if (!skipCurrent)
				{
					if (!byOID.TryGetValue(num4, out var value6))
					{
						_connectionLogger.LogWarning("Skipping composite type '{CompositeTypeName}' with field '{fieldName}' with type OID '{FieldTypeOID}', which could not be resolved to a PostgreSQL type.", currentComposite.DisplayName, text3, num4);
						byOID.Remove(num3);
						skipCurrent = true;
					}
					else
					{
						currentComposite.MutableFields.Add(new PostgresCompositeType.Field(text3, value6));
					}
				}
			}
			Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(backendMessage, conn);
			if (isReplicationConnection)
			{
				Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			}
			if (SupportsEnumTypes)
			{
				Statics.Expect<RowDescriptionMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
				currentOID = uint.MaxValue;
				PostgresEnumType currentEnum = null;
				skipCurrent = false;
				while (true)
				{
					backendMessage = await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					if (!(backendMessage is DataRowMessage))
					{
						break;
					}
					conn.ReadBuffer.Skip(2);
					uint num5 = uint.Parse(ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer), NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
					string item = ReadNonNullableString(conn.ReadBuffer);
					if (num5 != currentOID)
					{
						currentOID = num5;
						if (!byOID.TryGetValue(num5, out var value7))
						{
							_connectionLogger.LogWarning("Skipping enum type with OID {OID} which was not found in pg_type", num5);
							byOID.Remove(num5);
							skipCurrent = true;
							continue;
						}
						currentEnum = value7 as PostgresEnumType;
						if (currentEnum == null)
						{
							_connectionLogger.LogWarning("Type type '{TypeName}' was referenced as an enum type but is a {Type}", value7.Name, value7.GetType());
							byOID.Remove(num5);
							skipCurrent = true;
							continue;
						}
						skipCurrent = false;
					}
					if (!skipCurrent)
					{
						currentEnum.MutableLabels.Add(item);
					}
				}
				Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(backendMessage, conn);
				if (isReplicationConnection)
				{
					Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
				}
			}
			if (!isReplicationConnection)
			{
				Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await conn.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), conn);
			}
			return new List<PostgresType>(byOID.Values);
			static string ReadNonNullableString(NpgsqlReadBuffer buffer)
			{
				return buffer.ReadString(buffer.ReadInt32());
			}
			static string SanitizeForReplicationConnection(string str)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder(str.Length);
				using CharEnumerator charEnumerator = str.GetEnumerator();
				while (charEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					char current = charEnumerator.Current;
					if (current == '\r')
					{
						goto IL_002e;
					}
					if (current != '-')
					{
						stringBuilder2.Append(charEnumerator.Current);
						continue;
					}
					goto IL_0068;
					IL_0068:
					if (!charEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (charEnumerator.Current != '\r')
					{
						if (charEnumerator.Current != '-')
						{
							stringBuilder2.Append('-');
							stringBuilder2.Append(charEnumerator.Current);
						}
						else
						{
							while (charEnumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								if (charEnumerator.Current != '\r')
								{
									if (charEnumerator.Current == '\n')
									{
										stringBuilder2.Append('\n');
										break;
									}
									continue;
								}
								goto IL_002e;
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
					stringBuilder2.Append('-');
					goto IL_002e;
					IL_002e:
					stringBuilder2.Append('\n');
					if (!charEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (charEnumerator.Current != '-')
					{
						if (charEnumerator.Current != '\n')
						{
							stringBuilder2.Append(charEnumerator.Current);
						}
						continue;
					}
					goto IL_0068;
				}
				return stringBuilder2.ToString();
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class PostgresEnvironment
	{
		internal static string? User => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGUSER");

		internal static string? Password => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGPASSWORD");

		internal static string? PassFile => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGPASSFILE");

		internal static string? PassFileDefault
		{
			get
			{
				string text = (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows) ? GetHomePostgresDir() : GetHomeDir());
				if (text != null)
				{
					string text2 = Path.Combine(text, RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows) ? "pgpass.conf" : ".pgpass");
					if (File.Exists(text2))
					{
						return text2;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static string? SslCert => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGSSLCERT");

		internal static string? SslCertDefault
		{
			get
			{
				string homePostgresDir = GetHomePostgresDir();
				if (homePostgresDir != null)
				{
					string text = Path.Combine(homePostgresDir, "postgresql.crt");
					if (File.Exists(text))
					{
						return text;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static string? SslKey => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGSSLKEY");

		internal static string? SslKeyDefault
		{
			get
			{
				string homePostgresDir = GetHomePostgresDir();
				if (homePostgresDir != null)
				{
					string text = Path.Combine(homePostgresDir, "postgresql.key");
					if (File.Exists(text))
					{
						return text;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static string? SslCertRoot => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGSSLROOTCERT");

		internal static string? SslCertRootDefault
		{
			get
			{
				string homePostgresDir = GetHomePostgresDir();
				if (homePostgresDir != null)
				{
					string text = Path.Combine(homePostgresDir, "root.crt");
					if (File.Exists(text))
					{
						return text;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static string? ClientEncoding => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGCLIENTENCODING");

		internal static string? TimeZone => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGTZ");

		internal static string? Options => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGOPTIONS");

		internal static string? TargetSessionAttributes => Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PGTARGETSESSIONATTRS");

		private static string? GetHomeDir()
		{
			return Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows) ? "APPDATA" : "HOME");
		}

		private static string? GetHomePostgresDir()
		{
			string homeDir = GetHomeDir();
			if (homeDir == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Path.Combine(homeDir, RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows) ? "postgresql" : ".postgresql");
		}
	}

		private static readonly string[] CriticalFailureCodes = new string[7] { "53", "57P01", "57P02", "57P03", "58", "F0", "XX" };

		internal static bool IsCriticalFailure(PostgresException e, bool clusterError = true)
		{
			string[] criticalFailureCodes = CriticalFailureCodes;
			foreach (string value in criticalFailureCodes)
			{
				if (e.SqlState.StartsWith(value, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (!clusterError)
			{
				return e.SqlState == "08P01";
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public sealed class PostgresException : NpgsqlException
	{
		public override bool IsTransient
		{
			get
			{
				switch (SqlState)
				{
				case "53000":
				case "53100":
				case "53200":
				case "53300":
				case "53400":
				case "57P03":
				case "58000":
				case "58030":
				case "40001":
				case "40P01":
				case "55P03":
				case "55006":
				case "55000":
				case "08000":
				case "08003":
				case "08006":
				case "08001":
				case "08004":
				case "08007":
				case "57P01":
				case "57P02":
				case "57P05":
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public string Severity { get; }

		public string InvariantSeverity { get; }

		public new string SqlState { get; }

		public string MessageText { get; }

		public string? Detail { get; }

		public string? Hint { get; }

		public int Position { get; }

		public int InternalPosition { get; }

		public string? InternalQuery { get; }

		public string? Where { get; }

		public string? SchemaName { get; }

		public string? TableName { get; }

		public string? ColumnName { get; }

		public string? DataTypeName { get; }

		public string? ConstraintName { get; }

		public string? File { get; }

		public string? Line { get; }

		public string? Routine { get; }

		public PostgresException(string messageText, string severity, string invariantSeverity, string sqlState)
			: this(messageText, severity, invariantSeverity, sqlState, null, null, 0, 0, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null)
		{
		}

		public PostgresException(string messageText, string severity, string invariantSeverity, string sqlState, string? detail = null, string? hint = null, int position = 0, int internalPosition = 0, string? internalQuery = null, string? where = null, string? schemaName = null, string? tableName = null, string? columnName = null, string? dataTypeName = null, string? constraintName = null, string? file = null, string? line = null, string? routine = null)
			: base(GetMessage(sqlState, messageText, position, detail))
		{
			MessageText = messageText;
			Severity = severity;
			InvariantSeverity = invariantSeverity;
			SqlState = sqlState;
			Detail = detail;
			Hint = hint;
			Position = position;
			InternalPosition = internalPosition;
			InternalQuery = internalQuery;
			Where = where;
			SchemaName = schemaName;
			TableName = tableName;
			ColumnName = columnName;
			DataTypeName = dataTypeName;
			ConstraintName = constraintName;
			File = file;
			Line = line;
			Routine = routine;
			AddData<string>("Severity", Severity);
			AddData<string>("InvariantSeverity", InvariantSeverity);
			AddData<string>("SqlState", SqlState);
			AddData<string>("MessageText", MessageText);
			AddData<string>("Detail", Detail);
			AddData<string>("Hint", Hint);
			AddData<int>("Position", Position);
			AddData<int>("InternalPosition", InternalPosition);
			AddData<string>("InternalQuery", InternalQuery);
			AddData<string>("Where", Where);
			AddData<string>("SchemaName", SchemaName);
			AddData<string>("TableName", TableName);
			AddData<string>("ColumnName", ColumnName);
			AddData<string>("DataTypeName", DataTypeName);
			AddData<string>("ConstraintName", ConstraintName);
			AddData<string>("File", File);
			AddData<string>("Line", Line);
			AddData<string>("Routine", Routine);
			void AddData<T>(string key, T value)
			{
				if (!EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(value, default(T)))
				{
					Data.Add(key, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private static string GetMessage(string sqlState, string messageText, int position, string? detail)
		{
			string text = sqlState + ": " + messageText;
			string text2 = TryAddString("POSITION", (position == 0) ? null : position.ToString()) + TryAddString("DETAIL", detail);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				return text + Environment.NewLine + text2;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static string TryAddString(string text, string? value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return Environment.NewLine + text + ": " + value;
		}

		private PostgresException(ErrorOrNoticeMessage msg)
			: this(msg.Message, msg.Severity, msg.InvariantSeverity, msg.SqlState, msg.Detail, msg.Hint, msg.Position, msg.InternalPosition, msg.InternalQuery, msg.Where, msg.SchemaName, msg.TableName, msg.ColumnName, msg.DataTypeName, msg.ConstraintName, msg.File, msg.Line, msg.Routine)
		{
		}

		internal static PostgresException Load(NpgsqlReadBuffer buf, bool includeDetail, ILogger exceptionLogger)
		{
			return new PostgresException(ErrorOrNoticeMessage.Load(buf, includeDetail, exceptionLogger));
		}

		internal PostgresException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			Severity = GetValue<string>("Severity");
			InvariantSeverity = GetValue<string>("InvariantSeverity");
			SqlState = GetValue<string>("SqlState");
			MessageText = GetValue<string>("MessageText");
			Detail = GetValue<string>("Detail");
			Hint = GetValue<string>("Hint");
			Position = GetValue<int>("Position");
			InternalPosition = GetValue<int>("InternalPosition");
			InternalQuery = GetValue<string>("InternalQuery");
			Where = GetValue<string>("Where");
			SchemaName = GetValue<string>("SchemaName");
			TableName = GetValue<string>("TableName");
			ColumnName = GetValue<string>("ColumnName");
			DataTypeName = GetValue<string>("DataTypeName");
			ConstraintName = GetValue<string>("ConstraintName");
			File = GetValue<string>("File");
			Line = GetValue<string>("Line");
			Routine = GetValue<string>("Routine");
			T GetValue<T>(string propertyName)
			{
				return (T)info.GetValue(propertyName, typeof(T));
			}
		}

		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			info.AddValue("Severity", Severity);
			info.AddValue("InvariantSeverity", InvariantSeverity);
			info.AddValue("SqlState", SqlState);
			info.AddValue("MessageText", MessageText);
			info.AddValue("Detail", Detail);
			info.AddValue("Hint", Hint);
			info.AddValue("Position", Position);
			info.AddValue("InternalPosition", InternalPosition);
			info.AddValue("InternalQuery", InternalQuery);
			info.AddValue("Where", Where);
			info.AddValue("SchemaName", SchemaName);
			info.AddValue("TableName", TableName);
			info.AddValue("ColumnName", ColumnName);
			info.AddValue("DataTypeName", DataTypeName);
			info.AddValue("ConstraintName", ConstraintName);
			info.AddValue("File", File);
			info.AddValue("Line", Line);
			info.AddValue("Routine", Routine);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(base.ToString()).AppendLine().Append("  Exception data:");
			AppendLine<string>("Severity", Severity);
			AppendLine<string>("SqlState", SqlState);
			AppendLine<string>("MessageText", MessageText);
			AppendLine<string>("Detail", Detail);
			AppendLine<string>("Hint", Hint);
			AppendLine<int>("Position", Position);
			AppendLine<int>("InternalPosition", InternalPosition);
			AppendLine<string>("InternalQuery", InternalQuery);
			AppendLine<string>("Where", Where);
			AppendLine<string>("SchemaName", SchemaName);
			AppendLine<string>("TableName", TableName);
			AppendLine<string>("ColumnName", ColumnName);
			AppendLine<string>("DataTypeName", DataTypeName);
			AppendLine<string>("ConstraintName", ConstraintName);
			AppendLine<string>("File", File);
			AppendLine<string>("Line", Line);
			AppendLine<string>("Routine", Routine);
			return builder.ToString();
			void AppendLine<T>(string propertyName, T propertyValue)
			{
				if (!EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(propertyValue, default(T)))
				{
					builder.AppendLine().Append("    ").Append(propertyName)
						.Append(": ")
						.Append(propertyValue);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo : PostgresDatabaseInfo
	{
		private static PostgresType[]? _typesWithMultiranges;

		private static PostgresType[]? _typesWithoutMultiranges;

		private static PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo? _defaultTypeCatalog;

		internal static PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo DefaultTypeCatalog
		{
			get
			{
				if (_defaultTypeCatalog != null)
				{
					return _defaultTypeCatalog;
				}
				PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo postgresMinimalDatabaseInfo = new PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo();
				postgresMinimalDatabaseInfo.ProcessTypes();
				_defaultTypeCatalog = postgresMinimalDatabaseInfo;
				return postgresMinimalDatabaseInfo;
			}
		}

		private static PostgresType[] CreateTypes(bool withMultiranges)
		{
			List<PostgresType> types = new List<PostgresType>();
			Add(DataTypeNames.Int2, 21u, 1005u);
			AddWithRange(DataTypeNames.Int4, 23u, 1007u, DataTypeNames.Int4Range, 3904u, 3905u, 4451u, 6150u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Int8, 20u, 1016u);
			AddWithRange(DataTypeNames.Int8, 20u, 1016u, DataTypeNames.Int8Range, 3926u, 3927u, 4536u, 6157u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Float4, 700u, 1021u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Float8, 701u, 1022u);
			AddWithRange(DataTypeNames.Numeric, 1700u, 1231u, DataTypeNames.NumRange, 3906u, 3907u, 4532u, 6151u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Money, 790u, 791u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Bool, 16u, 1000u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Box, 603u, 1020u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Circle, 718u, 719u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Line, 628u, 629u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.LSeg, 601u, 1018u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Path, 602u, 1019u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Point, 600u, 1017u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Polygon, 604u, 1027u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Bpchar, 1042u, 1014u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Text, 25u, 1009u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Varchar, 1043u, 1015u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Name, 19u, 1003u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Bytea, 17u, 1001u);
			AddWithRange(DataTypeNames.Date, 1082u, 1182u, DataTypeNames.DateRange, 3912u, 3913u, 4535u, 6155u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Time, 1083u, 1183u);
			AddWithRange(DataTypeNames.Timestamp, 1114u, 1115u, DataTypeNames.TsRange, 3908u, 3909u, 4533u, 6152u);
			AddWithRange(DataTypeNames.TimestampTz, 1184u, 1185u, DataTypeNames.TsTzRange, 3910u, 3911u, 4534u, 6153u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Interval, 1186u, 1187u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.TimeTz, 1266u, 1270u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Inet, 869u, 1041u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Cidr, 650u, 651u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.MacAddr, 829u, 1040u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.MacAddr8, 774u, 775u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Bit, 1560u, 1561u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Varbit, 1562u, 1563u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.TsVector, 3614u, 3643u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.TsQuery, 3615u, 3645u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.RegConfig, 3734u, 3735u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Uuid, 2950u, 2951u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Xml, 142u, 143u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Json, 114u, 199u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Jsonb, 3802u, 3807u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Jsonpath, 4072u, 4073u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.RefCursor, 1790u, 2201u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.OidVector, 30u, 1013u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Int2Vector, 22u, 1006u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Oid, 26u, 1028u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Xid, 28u, 1011u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Xid8, 5069u, 271u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Cid, 29u, 1012u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.RegType, 2206u, 2211u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Tid, 27u, 1010u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.PgLsn, 3220u, 3221u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Unknown, 705u, 0u);
			Add(DataTypeNames.Void, 2278u, 0u);
			return types.ToArray();
			void Add(DataTypeName name, uint oid, uint arrayOid)
			{
				PostgresBaseType postgresBaseType = new PostgresBaseType(name, oid);
				types.Add(postgresBaseType);
				if (arrayOid != 0)
				{
					types.Add(new PostgresArrayType(name.ToArrayName(), arrayOid, postgresBaseType));
				}
			}
			void AddWithRange(DataTypeName name, uint oid, uint arrayOid, DataTypeName rangeName, uint rangeOid, uint rangeArrayOid, uint multirangeOid, uint multirangeArrayOid)
			{
				PostgresBaseType postgresBaseType = new PostgresBaseType(name, oid);
				PostgresRangeType postgresRangeType = new PostgresRangeType(rangeName, rangeOid, postgresBaseType);
				types.Add(postgresBaseType);
				types.Add(new PostgresArrayType(name.ToArrayName(), arrayOid, postgresBaseType));
				types.Add(postgresRangeType);
				types.Add(new PostgresArrayType(rangeName.ToArrayName(), rangeArrayOid, postgresRangeType));
				if (withMultiranges)
				{
					PostgresMultirangeType postgresMultirangeType = new PostgresMultirangeType(rangeName.ToDefaultMultirangeName(), multirangeOid, postgresRangeType);
					types.Add(postgresMultirangeType);
					types.Add(new PostgresArrayType(postgresMultirangeType.DataTypeName.ToArrayName(), multirangeArrayOid, postgresMultirangeType));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<PostgresType> GetTypes()
		{
			object obj;
			if (!SupportsMultirangeTypes)
			{
				obj = _typesWithoutMultiranges;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return _typesWithoutMultiranges = CreateTypes(withMultiranges: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = _typesWithMultiranges ?? (_typesWithMultiranges = CreateTypes(withMultiranges: true));
			}
			return (IEnumerable<PostgresType>)obj;
		}

		internal PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo(NpgsqlConnector conn)
			: base(conn)
		{
			HasIntegerDateTimes = !conn.PostgresParameters.TryGetValue("integer_datetimes", out var value) || value == "on";
		}

		internal PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo()
			: base("minimal", 5432, "minimal", "14")
		{
		}
	}

	internal static class PregeneratedMessages
	{
		internal static readonly byte[] BeginTransRepeatableRead;

		internal static readonly byte[] BeginTransSerializable;

		internal static readonly byte[] BeginTransReadCommitted;

		internal static readonly byte[] BeginTransReadUncommitted;

		internal static readonly byte[] CommitTransaction;

		internal static readonly byte[] RollbackTransaction;

		internal static readonly byte[] DiscardAll;

		static PregeneratedMessages()
		{
			using NpgsqlWriteBuffer buf = new NpgsqlWriteBuffer(null, new MemoryStream(), null, 4096, Encoding.ASCII);
			BeginTransRepeatableRead = Generate(buf, "BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ");
			BeginTransSerializable = Generate(buf, "BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE");
			BeginTransReadCommitted = Generate(buf, "BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED");
			BeginTransReadUncommitted = Generate(buf, "BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED");
			CommitTransaction = Generate(buf, "COMMIT");
			RollbackTransaction = Generate(buf, "ROLLBACK");
			DiscardAll = Generate(buf, "DISCARD ALL");
		}

		internal static byte[] Generate(NpgsqlWriteBuffer buf, string query)
		{
			int byteCount = Encoding.ASCII.GetByteCount(query);
			buf.WriteByte(81);
			buf.WriteInt32(4 + byteCount + 1);
			buf.WriteString(query, byteCount, async: false).Wait();
			buf.WriteByte(0);
			byte[] contents = buf.GetContents();
			buf.Clear();
			return contents;
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("{Name} ({State}): {Sql}")]
	internal sealed class PreparedStatement
	{
		private readonly PreparedStatementManager _manager;

		internal byte[]? Name;

		internal RowDescriptionMessage? Description;

		internal int Usages;

		internal PreparedStatement? StatementBeingReplaced;

		internal string Sql { get; }

		internal PreparedState State { get; set; }

		internal bool IsPrepared => State == PreparedState.Prepared;

		internal bool IsExplicit { get; }

		internal int AutoPreparedSlotIndex { get; set; }

		internal long LastUsed { get; set; }

		private PgTypeId[]? ConverterParamTypes { get; set; }

		internal void RefreshLastUsed()
		{
			LastUsed = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
		}

		internal static PreparedStatement CreateExplicit(PreparedStatementManager manager, string sql, string name, List<NpgsqlParameter> parameters, PreparedStatement? statementBeingReplaced)
		{
			PreparedStatement preparedStatement = new PreparedStatement(manager, sql, isExplicit: true);
			preparedStatement.Name = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(name);
			preparedStatement.StatementBeingReplaced = statementBeingReplaced;
			preparedStatement.SetParamTypes(parameters);
			return preparedStatement;
		}

		internal static PreparedStatement CreateAutoPrepareCandidate(PreparedStatementManager manager, string sql)
		{
			return new PreparedStatement(manager, sql, isExplicit: false);
		}

		internal PreparedStatement(PreparedStatementManager manager, string sql, bool isExplicit)
		{
			_manager = manager;
			Sql = sql;
			IsExplicit = isExplicit;
			State = PreparedState.NotPrepared;
		}

		internal void SetParamTypes(List<NpgsqlParameter> parameters)
		{
			if (parameters.Count == 0)
			{
				ConverterParamTypes = Array.Empty<PgTypeId>();
				return;
			}
			ConverterParamTypes = new PgTypeId[parameters.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Count; i++)
			{
				ConverterParamTypes[i] = parameters[i].PgTypeId;
			}
		}

		internal bool DoParametersMatch(List<NpgsqlParameter> parameters)
		{
			PgTypeId[] converterParamTypes = ConverterParamTypes;
			if (converterParamTypes.Length != parameters.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < converterParamTypes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (converterParamTypes[i] != parameters[i].PgTypeId)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void AbortPrepare()
		{
			_manager.BySql.Remove(Sql);
			if (!IsExplicit)
			{
				_manager.AutoPrepared[AutoPreparedSlotIndex] = StatementBeingReplaced;
				if (StatementBeingReplaced != null)
				{
					StatementBeingReplaced.State = PreparedState.Prepared;
				}
			}
			State = PreparedState.Unprepared;
		}

		internal void CompleteUnprepare()
		{
			_manager.BySql.Remove(Sql);
			_manager.NumPrepared--;
			State = PreparedState.Unprepared;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Sql;
		}
	}
	internal enum PreparedState
	{
		NotPrepared,
		BeingPrepared,
		Prepared,
		BeingUnprepared,
		Unprepared,
		Invalidated
	}
	internal sealed class PreparedStatementManager
	{
		private readonly PreparedStatement?[] _candidates;

		private static readonly List<NpgsqlParameter> EmptyParameters = new List<NpgsqlParameter>();

		internal int NumPrepared;

		private readonly NpgsqlConnector _connector;

		private ulong _preparedStatementIndex;

		private readonly ILogger _commandLogger;

		internal const int CandidateCount = 100;

		internal int MaxAutoPrepared { get; }

		internal int UsagesBeforePrepare { get; }

		internal Dictionary<string, PreparedStatement> BySql { get; } = new Dictionary<string, PreparedStatement>();

		internal PreparedStatement?[] AutoPrepared { get; }

		internal string NextPreparedStatementName()
		{
			ulong num = ++_preparedStatementIndex;
			return "_p" + num;
		}

		internal PreparedStatementManager(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			_connector = connector;
			_commandLogger = connector.LoggingConfiguration.CommandLogger;
			MaxAutoPrepared = connector.Settings.MaxAutoPrepare;
			UsagesBeforePrepare = connector.Settings.AutoPrepareMinUsages;
			if (MaxAutoPrepared > 0)
			{
				if (MaxAutoPrepared > 256)
				{
					_commandLogger.LogWarning("MaxAutoPrepared is over 256, performance degradation may occur. Please report via an issue.");
				}
				AutoPrepared = new PreparedStatement[MaxAutoPrepared];
				_candidates = new PreparedStatement[100];
			}
			else
			{
				AutoPrepared = null;
				_candidates = null;
			}
		}

		internal PreparedStatement? GetOrAddExplicit(NpgsqlBatchCommand batchCommand)
		{
			string finalCommandText = batchCommand.FinalCommandText;
			PreparedStatement statementBeingReplaced = null;
			if (BySql.TryGetValue(finalCommandText, out var value))
			{
				if (value.IsExplicit)
				{
					if (!value.DoParametersMatch(batchCommand.CurrentParametersReadOnly))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return value;
				}
				switch (value.State)
				{
				case PreparedState.NotPrepared:
					RemoveCandidate(value);
					break;
				case PreparedState.Prepared:
					statementBeingReplaced = value;
					break;
				case PreparedState.Unprepared:
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Found unprepared statement in PreparedStatementManager");
				default:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
			}
			return BySql[finalCommandText] = PreparedStatement.CreateExplicit(this, finalCommandText, NextPreparedStatementName(), batchCommand.CurrentParametersReadOnly, statementBeingReplaced);
		}

		internal PreparedStatement? TryGetAutoPrepared(NpgsqlBatchCommand batchCommand)
		{
			string finalCommandText = batchCommand.FinalCommandText;
			if (!BySql.TryGetValue(finalCommandText, out var value))
			{
				int num = -1;
				int num2 = int.MaxValue;
				long num3 = long.MaxValue;
				for (int i = 0; i < _candidates.Length; i++)
				{
					PreparedStatement preparedStatement = _candidates[i];
					if (preparedStatement == null)
					{
						num = i;
						break;
					}
					if (preparedStatement.Usages < num2)
					{
						num2 = preparedStatement.Usages;
						num = i;
						num3 = preparedStatement.LastUsed;
					}
					else if (preparedStatement.Usages == num2 && preparedStatement.LastUsed < num3)
					{
						num = i;
						num3 = preparedStatement.LastUsed;
					}
				}
				PreparedStatement preparedStatement2 = _candidates[num];
				if (preparedStatement2 != null)
				{
					BySql.Remove(preparedStatement2.Sql);
				}
				PreparedStatement preparedStatement3 = (BySql[finalCommandText] = (_candidates[num] = PreparedStatement.CreateAutoPrepareCandidate(this, finalCommandText)));
				value = preparedStatement3;
			}
			switch (value.State)
			{
			case PreparedState.BeingPrepared:
			case PreparedState.Prepared:
				if (!value.DoParametersMatch(batchCommand.CurrentParametersReadOnly))
				{
					return null;
				}
				value.LastUsed = long.MaxValue;
				return value;
			case PreparedState.BeingUnprepared:
				return null;
			default:
			{
				if (++value.Usages < UsagesBeforePrepare)
				{
					value.RefreshLastUsed();
					return null;
				}
				LogMessages.AutoPreparingStatement(_commandLogger, finalCommandText, _connector.Id);
				long num4 = long.MaxValue;
				int num5 = -1;
				for (int j = 0; j < AutoPrepared.Length; j++)
				{
					PreparedStatement preparedStatement5 = AutoPrepared[j];
					if ((preparedStatement5 == null || preparedStatement5.State == PreparedState.Invalidated) ? true : false)
					{
						num5 = j;
						break;
					}
					switch (preparedStatement5.State)
					{
					case PreparedState.Prepared:
						if (preparedStatement5.LastUsed < num4)
						{
							num5 = j;
							num4 = preparedStatement5.LastUsed;
						}
						break;
					default:
						ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException(string.Format("Invalid {0} state {1} encountered when scanning prepared statement slots", "PreparedState", preparedStatement5.State));
						return null;
					case PreparedState.BeingPrepared:
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num5 == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (value.State != PreparedState.Invalidated)
				{
					RemoveCandidate(value);
				}
				PreparedStatement preparedStatement6 = AutoPrepared[num5];
				if (preparedStatement6 == null)
				{
					value.Name = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("_auto" + num5);
				}
				else
				{
					if (preparedStatement6 == value)
					{
						preparedStatement6 = new PreparedStatement(this, preparedStatement6.Sql, isExplicit: false)
						{
							Name = preparedStatement6.Name
						};
					}
					value.Name = preparedStatement6.Name;
					value.State = PreparedState.NotPrepared;
					value.StatementBeingReplaced = preparedStatement6;
					preparedStatement6.State = PreparedState.BeingUnprepared;
				}
				value.AutoPreparedSlotIndex = num5;
				AutoPrepared[num5] = value;
				value.LastUsed = long.MaxValue;
				value.SetParamTypes(batchCommand.CurrentParametersReadOnly);
				return value;
			}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveCandidate(PreparedStatement candidate)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _candidates.Length; i++)
			{
				if (_candidates[i] == candidate)
				{
					_candidates[i] = null;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ClearAll()
		{
			BySql.Clear();
			NumPrepared = 0;
			_preparedStatementIndex = 0uL;
			if (AutoPrepared != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < AutoPrepared.Length; i++)
				{
					AutoPrepared[i] = null;
				}
			}
			if (_candidates != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < _candidates.Length; j++)
				{
					_candidates[j] = null;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class PreparedTextReader : TextReader
	{
		private string _str;

		private NpgsqlReadBuffer.ColumnStream _stream;

		private int _position;

		private bool _disposed;

		public bool IsDisposed => _disposed;

		public void Init(string str, NpgsqlReadBuffer.ColumnStream stream)
		{
			_str = str;
			_stream = stream;
			_disposed = false;
			_position = 0;
		}

		public override int Peek()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (_position >= _str.Length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _str[_position];
		}

		public override int Read()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (_position >= _str.Length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _str[_position++];
		}

		public int Read(Span<char> buffer)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			int num = Math.Min(buffer.Length, _str.Length - _position);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(_str, _position, num).CopyTo(buffer);
			_position += num;
			return num;
		}

		public override int Read(char[] buffer, int index, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (index < 0 || count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException((index < 0) ? "index" : "count");
			}
			if (buffer.Length - index < count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Offset and length were out of bounds for the array or count is greater than the number of elements from index to the end of the source collection.");
			}
			return Read(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(buffer, index, count));
		}

		public override Task<int> ReadAsync(char[] buffer, int index, int count)
		{
			return Task.FromResult(Read(buffer, index, count));
		}

		public ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<char> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return new ValueTask<int>(Read(buffer.Span));
		}

		public override Task<string?> ReadLineAsync()
		{
			return Task.FromResult(ReadLine());
		}

		public override string ReadToEnd()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			if (_position == _str.Length)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string result = _str.Substring(_position);
			_position = _str.Length;
			return result;
		}

		public override Task<string> ReadToEndAsync()
		{
			return Task.FromResult(ReadToEnd());
		}

		private void CheckDisposed()
		{
			if (_disposed || _stream.IsDisposed)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowObjectDisposedException("PreparedTextReader");
			}
		}

		public void Restart()
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			_position = 0;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing)
			{
				_disposed = true;
				_stream.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class MemoryExtensions
	{
		public static int IndexOfAnyExcept<T>(this ReadOnlySpan<T> span, T value0, T value1) where T : IEquatable<T>
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < span.Length; i++)
			{
				T val = span[i];
				if (!val.Equals(value0) && !val.Equals(value1))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}

					for (; i < length && commandText[i] != c; i++)
					{
					}
					if (i >= length)
					{
						goto end_IL_00a1;
					}
					i++;
					c = '\0';
					goto IL_00a1;
					continue;
					end_IL_00b9:
					break;
				}
				_rewrittenSql.Append(commandText, num, i - num - 1);
				batchCommand.FinalCommandText = _rewrittenSql.ToString();
				while (true)
				{
					if (i < length)
					{
						c = commandText[i];
						if (!char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
						{
							break;
						}
						i++;
						continue;
					}
					if (batchCommands != null && batchCommands.Count > statementIndex + 1)
					{
						batchCommands.RemoveRange(statementIndex + 1, batchCommands.Count - (statementIndex + 1));
					}
					return;
				}
				if (command == null)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Specifying multiple SQL statements in a single NpgsqlBatchCommand isn't supported, please remove all semicolons.");
				}
				statementIndex++;
				MoveToNextBatchCommand();
				_paramIndexMap.Clear();
				_rewrittenSql.Clear();
				num = i;
				continue;
				end_IL_00a1:
				break;
				IL_00a1:;
			}
			_rewrittenSql.Append(commandText, num, length - num);
			if (statementIndex == 0 && _paramIndexMap.Count == 0)
			{
				batchCommand.FinalCommandText = commandText;
			}
			else
			{
				batchCommand.FinalCommandText = _rewrittenSql.ToString();
			}
			if (batchCommands != null && batchCommands.Count > statementIndex + 1)
			{
				batchCommands.RemoveRange(statementIndex + 1, batchCommands.Count - (statementIndex + 1));
			}
			void MoveToNextBatchCommand()
			{
				if (batchCommands.Count > statementIndex)
				{
					batchCommand = batchCommands[statementIndex];
					batchCommand.Reset();
					batchCommand._parameters = parameters;
				}
				else
				{
					batchCommand = new NpgsqlBatchCommand
					{
						_parameters = parameters
					};
					batchCommands.Add(batchCommand);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsLetter(char ch)
		{
			return (uint)((ch | 0x20) - 97) <= 25u;
		}

		private static bool IsIdentifierStart(char ch)
		{
			if ((uint)((ch | 0x20) - 97) > 25u && ch != '_')
			{
				return (uint)(ch - 128) <= 127u;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsDollarTagIdentifier(char ch)
		{
			if ((uint)((ch | 0x20) - 97) > 25u && (uint)(ch - 48) > 9u && ch != '_')
			{
				return (uint)(ch - 128) <= 127u;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsIdentifier(char ch)
		{
			if ((uint)((ch | 0x20) - 97) > 25u && (uint)(ch - 48) > 9u && ch != '_' && ch != '$')
			{
				return (uint)(ch - 128) <= 127u;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsParamNameChar(char ch)
		{
			if (!char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) && ch != '_')
			{
				return ch == '.';
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		PreferStandby

	internal static class TaskTimeoutAndCancellation
	{
		internal static async Task<TResult> ExecuteAsync<TResult>(Func<CancellationToken, Task<TResult>> getTaskFunc, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Task<TResult> task = null;
			await ExecuteAsync((Func<CancellationToken, Task>)((CancellationToken ct) => task = getTaskFunc(ct)), timeout, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return await task.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		internal static async Task ExecuteAsync(Func<CancellationToken, Task> getTaskFunc, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			using CancellationTokenSource combinedCts = (timeout.IsSet ? CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(new CancellationToken[1] { cancellationToken }) : null);
			Task task = getTaskFunc(combinedCts?.Token ?? cancellationToken);
			try
			{
				try
				{
					await TaskExtensions.WaitAsync(task, timeout.CheckAndGetTimeLeft(), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				catch (TimeoutException) when (!task.IsCompleted)
				{
					combinedCts?.Cancel();
					throw;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				task.ContinueWith((Task t) => t.Exception, CancellationToken.None, TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted, TaskScheduler.Current);
				throw;
			}
		}
	}
