	internal sealed class UnpooledDataSource : NpgsqlDataSource
	{
		private volatile int _numConnectors;

		internal override (int Total, int Idle, int Busy) Statistics => (Total: _numConnectors, Idle: 0, Busy: _numConnectors);

		internal override bool OwnsConnectors => true;

		public UnpooledDataSource(NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder settings, NpgsqlDataSourceConfiguration dataSourceConfig)
			: base(settings, dataSourceConfig)
		{
		}

		internal override async ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector> Get(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			NpgsqlConnector connector = new NpgsqlConnector(this, conn);
			await connector.Open(timeout, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			Interlocked.Increment(ref _numConnectors);
			return connector;
		}

		internal override bool TryGetIdleConnector([NotNullWhen(true)] out NpgsqlConnector? connector)
		{
			connector = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal override ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector?> OpenNewConnector(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return new ValueTask<NpgsqlConnector>((NpgsqlConnector)null);
		}

		internal override void Return(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			Interlocked.Decrement(ref _numConnectors);
			connector.Close();
		}

		internal override void Clear()
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class VolatileResourceManager : ISinglePhaseNotification, IEnlistmentNotification
	{
		private NpgsqlConnector _connector;

		private Transaction _transaction;

		private readonly string _txId;

		private NpgsqlTransaction _localTx;

		private string? _preparedTxName;

		private bool _isDisposed;

		private readonly ILogger _transactionLogger;

		private const int MaximumRollbackAttempts = 20;

		private bool IsPrepared => _preparedTxName != null;

		internal VolatileResourceManager(NpgsqlConnection connection, Transaction transaction)
		{
			_connector = connection.Connector;
			_transaction = transaction;
			_txId = transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier;
			_transactionLogger = _connector.LoggingConfiguration.TransactionLogger;
		}

		internal void Init()
		{
			_localTx = _connector.Connection.BeginTransaction(ConvertIsolationLevel(_transaction.IsolationLevel));
		}

		public void SinglePhaseCommit(SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			LogMessages.CommittingSinglePhaseTransaction(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
			try
			{
				_localTx.Commit();
				singlePhaseEnlistment.Committed();
			}
			catch (PostgresException e)
			{
				singlePhaseEnlistment.Aborted(e);
			}
			catch (Exception e2)
			{
				singlePhaseEnlistment.InDoubt(e2);
			}
			finally
			{
				Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void Prepare(PreparingEnlistment preparingEnlistment)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			LogMessages.PreparingTwoPhaseTransaction(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
			_preparedTxName = $"{_transaction.TransactionInformation.DistributedIdentifier}/{_connector.BackendProcessId}";
			try
			{
				using (_connector.StartUserAction())
				{
					_connector.ExecuteInternalCommand("PREPARE TRANSACTION '" + _preparedTxName + "'");
				}
				if (_connector.Connection != null)
				{
					_connector.Connection.EnlistedTransaction = null;
				}
				preparingEnlistment.Prepared();
			}
			catch (Exception e)
			{
				Dispose();
				preparingEnlistment.ForceRollback(e);
			}
		}

		[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("Trimming", "IL2026", Justification = "Changing Enlist to be false does not affect potentially trimmed out functionality.")]
		[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("Aot", "IL3050", Justification = "Changing Enlist to be false does not cause dynamic codegen.")]
		public void Commit(Enlistment enlistment)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			LogMessages.CommittingTwoPhaseTransaction(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
			try
			{
				if (_connector.Connection == null)
				{
					using (_connector.StartUserAction())
					{
						_connector.ExecuteInternalCommand("COMMIT PREPARED '" + _preparedTxName + "'");
						return;
					}
				}
				NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder = _connector.Connection.Settings.Clone();
				npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.Enlist = false;
				using NpgsqlConnection npgsqlConnection = _connector.Connection.CloneWith(npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString);
				npgsqlConnection.Open();
				NpgsqlConnector connector = npgsqlConnection.Connector;
				using (connector.StartUserAction())
				{
					connector.ExecuteInternalCommand("COMMIT PREPARED '" + _preparedTxName + "'");
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				LogMessages.TwoPhaseTransactionCommitFailed(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id, exception);
			}
			finally
			{
				Dispose();
				enlistment.Done();
			}
		}

		public void Rollback(Enlistment enlistment)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			try
			{
				if (IsPrepared)
				{
					RollbackTwoPhase();
				}
				else
				{
					RollbackLocal();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Dispose();
				enlistment.Done();
			}
		}

		public void InDoubt(Enlistment enlistment)
		{
			LogMessages.TwoPhaseTransactionInDoubt(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
			try
			{
				RollbackTwoPhase();
			}
			finally
			{
				Dispose();
				enlistment.Done();
			}
		}

		private void RollbackLocal()
		{
			LogMessages.RollingBackSinglePhaseTransaction(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
			try
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (true)
				{
					try
					{
						_localTx.Rollback();
						break;
					}
					catch (NpgsqlOperationInProgressException)
					{
						if (num++ == 20)
						{
							throw new Exception($"Could not roll back after {20} attempts, aborting. Transaction is in an unknown state.");
						}
						LogMessages.ConnectionInUseWhenRollingBack(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
						_connector.PerformPostgresCancellation();
						Thread.Sleep(500);
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				LogMessages.SinglePhaseTransactionRollbackFailed(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
			}
		}

		private void RollbackTwoPhase()
		{
			LogMessages.RollingBackTwoPhaseTransaction(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
			try
			{
				if (_connector.Connection == null)
				{
					using (_connector.StartUserAction())
					{
						_connector.ExecuteInternalCommand("ROLLBACK PREPARED '" + _preparedTxName + "'");
						return;
					}
				}
				using NpgsqlConnection npgsqlConnection = (NpgsqlConnection)((ICloneable)_connector.Connection).Clone();
				npgsqlConnection.Open();
				NpgsqlConnector connector = npgsqlConnection.Connector;
				using (connector.StartUserAction())
				{
					connector.ExecuteInternalCommand("ROLLBACK PREPARED '" + _preparedTxName + "'");
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				LogMessages.TwoPhaseTransactionRollbackFailed(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id, exception);
			}
		}

		private void Dispose()
		{
			if (!_isDisposed)
			{
				LogMessages.CleaningUpResourceManager(_transactionLogger, _txId, _connector.Id);
				if (_localTx != null)
				{
					_localTx.Dispose();
					_localTx = null;
				}
				if (_connector.Connection != null)
				{
					_connector.Connection.EnlistedTransaction = null;
				}
				else if (_connector.TryRemovePendingEnlistedConnector(_transaction))
				{
					_connector.Return();
				}
				_connector = null;
				_transaction = null;
				_isDisposed = true;
			}
		}

		private void CheckDisposed()
		{
			if (_isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException("VolatileResourceManager");
			}
		}

		private static System.Data.IsolationLevel ConvertIsolationLevel(System.Transactions.IsolationLevel isolationLevel)
		{
			return isolationLevel switch
			{
				System.Transactions.IsolationLevel.Chaos => System.Data.IsolationLevel.Chaos, 
				System.Transactions.IsolationLevel.ReadCommitted => System.Data.IsolationLevel.ReadCommitted, 
				System.Transactions.IsolationLevel.ReadUncommitted => System.Data.IsolationLevel.ReadUncommitted, 
				System.Transactions.IsolationLevel.RepeatableRead => System.Data.IsolationLevel.RepeatableRead, 
				System.Transactions.IsolationLevel.Serializable => System.Data.IsolationLevel.Serializable, 
				System.Transactions.IsolationLevel.Snapshot => System.Data.IsolationLevel.Snapshot, 
				_ => System.Data.IsolationLevel.Unspecified, 
			};
		}
	}
}

	public readonly struct NpgsqlTimeout
	{
		private readonly DateTime _expiration;

		internal static readonly NpgsqlTimeout Infinite = new NpgsqlTimeout(TimeSpan.Zero);

		internal bool IsSet => _expiration != DateTime.MaxValue;

		internal bool HasExpired => DateTime.UtcNow >= _expiration;

		internal NpgsqlTimeout(TimeSpan expiration)
		{
			_expiration = ((expiration > TimeSpan.Zero) ? (DateTime.UtcNow + expiration) : ((expiration == TimeSpan.Zero) ? DateTime.MaxValue : DateTime.MinValue));
		}

		internal void Check()
		{
			if (HasExpired)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlExceptionWithInnerTimeoutException("The operation has timed out");
			}
		}

		internal void CheckAndApply(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			if (IsSet)
			{
				TimeSpan timeSpan = CheckAndGetTimeLeft();
				NpgsqlReadBuffer readBuffer = connector.ReadBuffer;
				TimeSpan timeout = (connector.WriteBuffer.Timeout = timeSpan);
				readBuffer.Timeout = timeout;
			}
		}

		internal TimeSpan CheckAndGetTimeLeft()
		{
			if (!IsSet)
			{
				return Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan;
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan = _expiration - DateTime.UtcNow;
			if (timeSpan <= TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				Check();
			}
			return timeSpan;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ResettableCancellationTokenSource : IDisposable
	{
		private bool isDisposed;

		private CancellationTokenSource _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

		private CancellationTokenRegistration? _registration;

		private readonly object lockObject = new object();

		public TimeSpan Timeout { get; set; }

		public CancellationToken Token => _cts.Token;

		public bool IsCancellationRequested => _cts.IsCancellationRequested;

		public ResettableCancellationTokenSource()
		{
			Timeout = System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan;
		}

		public ResettableCancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			Timeout = timeout;
		}

		public CancellationToken Start(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (isDisposed)
				{
					return CancellationToken.None;
				}
				_cts.CancelAfter(Timeout);
				if (_cts.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					_cts.Dispose();
					_cts = new CancellationTokenSource(Timeout);
				}
			}
			if (cancellationToken.CanBeCanceled)
			{
				_registration = cancellationToken.Register(delegate(object cts)
				{
					((CancellationTokenSource)cts).Cancel();
				}, _cts);
			}
			return _cts.Token;
		}

		public void RestartTimeoutWithoutReset()
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					_cts.CancelAfter(Timeout);
				}
			}
		}

		public CancellationToken Reset()
		{
			_registration?.Dispose();
			_registration = null;
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (isDisposed)
				{
					return CancellationToken.None;
				}
				_cts.CancelAfter(System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
				if (_cts.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					_cts.Dispose();
					_cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
				}
			}
			return _cts.Token;
		}

		public void ResetCts()
		{
			if (_cts.IsCancellationRequested)
			{
				_cts.Dispose();
				_cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
			}
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			_registration?.Dispose();
			_registration = null;
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					_cts.CancelAfter(System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					_cts.Cancel();
				}
			}
		}

		public void CancelAfter(int delay)
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					_cts.CancelAfter(delay);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				_registration?.Dispose();
				_cts.Dispose();
				isDisposed = true;
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class Statics
	{
		internal static readonly bool EnableAssertions;

		internal static readonly bool LegacyTimestampBehavior;

		internal static readonly bool DisableDateTimeInfinityConversions;

		static Statics()
		{
			EnableAssertions = AppContext.TryGetSwitch("Npgsql.EnableAssertions", out var isEnabled) && isEnabled;
			LegacyTimestampBehavior = AppContext.TryGetSwitch("Npgsql.EnableLegacyTimestampBehavior", out isEnabled) && isEnabled;
			DisableDateTimeInfinityConversions = AppContext.TryGetSwitch("Npgsql.DisableDateTimeInfinityConversions", out isEnabled) && isEnabled;
		}

		internal static T Expect<T>(IBackendMessage msg, NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			if (msg.GetType() != typeof(T))
			{
				ThrowIfMsgWrongType<T>(msg, connector);
			}
			return (T)msg;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		internal static T ExpectAny<T>(IBackendMessage msg, NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			if (msg is T)
			{
				return (T)msg;
			}
			ThrowIfMsgWrongType<T>(msg, connector);
			return default(T);
		}

		[DoesNotReturn]
		private static void ThrowIfMsgWrongType<T>(IBackendMessage msg, NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			throw connector.Break(new NpgsqlException($"Received backend message {msg.Code} while expecting {typeof(T).Name}. Please file a bug."));
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		internal static void ValidateBackendMessageCode(BackendMessageCode code)
		{
			switch (code)
			{
			case BackendMessageCode.PasswordPacket:
			case BackendMessageCode.ParseComplete:
			case BackendMessageCode.BindComplete:
			case BackendMessageCode.CloseComplete:
			case BackendMessageCode.NotificationResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
			case BackendMessageCode.DataRow:
			case BackendMessageCode.ErrorResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.FunctionCall:
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyInResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyOutResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.EmptyQueryResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.BackendKeyData:
			case BackendMessageCode.NoticeResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.AuthenticationRequest:
			case BackendMessageCode.ParameterStatus:
			case BackendMessageCode.RowDescription:
			case BackendMessageCode.FunctionCallResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyBothResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery:
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyDone:
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyData:
			case BackendMessageCode.NoData:
			case BackendMessageCode.PortalSuspended:
			case BackendMessageCode.ParameterDescription:
				return;
			}
			ThrowUnknownMessageCode(code);
			static void ThrowUnknownMessageCode(BackendMessageCode backendMessageCode)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlException($"Unknown message code: {backendMessageCode}");
			}
		}

	internal sealed class SubReadStream : Stream
	{
		private readonly long _startInSuperStream;

		private long _positionInSuperStream;

		private readonly long _endInSuperStream;

		private readonly Stream _superStream;

		private readonly bool _canSeek;

		private bool _isDisposed;

		public override long Length
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				if (!_canSeek)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
				return _endInSuperStream - _startInSuperStream;
			}
		}

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				if (!_canSeek)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
				return _positionInSuperStream - _startInSuperStream;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override bool CanRead
		{
			get
			{
				if (_superStream.CanRead)
				{
					return !_isDisposed;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override bool CanWrite => false;

		public SubReadStream(Stream superStream, long maxLength)
		{
			_startInSuperStream = -1L;
			_positionInSuperStream = 0L;
			_endInSuperStream = maxLength;
			_superStream = superStream;
			_canSeek = false;
			_isDisposed = false;
		}

		public SubReadStream(Stream superStream, long startPosition, long maxLength)
		{
			_startInSuperStream = startPosition;
			_positionInSuperStream = startPosition;
			_endInSuperStream = startPosition + maxLength;
			_superStream = superStream;
			_canSeek = superStream.CanSeek;
			_isDisposed = false;
		}

		private void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			if (_isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().ToString());
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfCantRead()
		{
			if (!CanRead)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			ThrowIfCantRead();
			if (_canSeek && _superStream.Position != _positionInSuperStream)
			{
				_superStream.Seek(_positionInSuperStream, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
			if (_positionInSuperStream > _endInSuperStream - count)
			{
				count = (int)(_endInSuperStream - _positionInSuperStream);
			}
			int num = _superStream.Read(buffer, offset, count);
			_positionInSuperStream += num;
			return num;
		}

		private int Read(Span<byte> destination)
		{
			_ = destination.Length;
			int num = destination.Length;
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			ThrowIfCantRead();
			if (_canSeek && _superStream.Position != _positionInSuperStream)
			{
				_superStream.Seek(_positionInSuperStream, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
			if (_positionInSuperStream + num > _endInSuperStream)
			{
				num = (int)(_endInSuperStream - _positionInSuperStream);
			}
			int num2 = _superStream.Read(destination.Slice(0, num));
			_positionInSuperStream += num2;
			return num2;
		}

		public override int ReadByte()
		{
			Span<byte> destination = stackalloc byte[1];
			if (Read(destination) != 1)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return destination[0];
		}

		public override Task<int> ReadAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ValidateBufferArguments(buffer, offset, count);
			return ReadAsync(new Memory<byte>(buffer, offset, count), cancellationToken).AsTask();
		}

		private ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			ThrowIfCantRead();
			if (_canSeek && _superStream.Position != _positionInSuperStream)
			{
				_superStream.Seek(_positionInSuperStream, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
			if (_positionInSuperStream > _endInSuperStream - buffer.Length)
			{
				buffer = buffer.Slice(0, (int)(_endInSuperStream - _positionInSuperStream));
			}
			return Core(buffer, cancellationToken);
			async ValueTask<int> Core(Memory<byte> buffer2, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				int num = await _superStream.ReadAsync(buffer2, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				_positionInSuperStream += num;
				return num;
			}
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && !_isDisposed)
			{
				_isDisposed = true;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private new void ValidateBufferArguments(byte[]? buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", "Offset is less than 0");
			}
			if ((uint)count > buffer.Length - offset)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("count", "Count larger than buffer minus offset");
			}
		}
	}
	internal readonly struct TaskSchedulerAwaitable : ICriticalNotifyCompletion, INotifyCompletion
	{
		private readonly TaskScheduler _scheduler;

		public bool IsCompleted => false;

		public TaskSchedulerAwaitable(TaskScheduler scheduler)
		{
			_scheduler = scheduler;
		}

		public void GetResult()
		{
		}

		public void OnCompleted(Action continuation)
		{
			Task.Factory.StartNew(continuation, CancellationToken.None, TaskCreationOptions.DenyChildAttach, _scheduler);
		}

		public void UnsafeOnCompleted(Action continuation)
		{
			OnCompleted(continuation);
		}

		public TaskSchedulerAwaitable GetAwaiter()
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	internal static class VersionExtensions
	{
		public static bool IsGreaterOrEqual(this Version version, int major, int minor = 0)
		{
			if (version.Major == major)
			{
				return version.Minor >= minor;
			}
			return version.Major > major;
		}
	}

namespace Npgsql.TypeMapping

	internal sealed class GlobalTypeMapper : INpgsqlTypeMapper
	{
		private readonly UserTypeMapper _userTypeMapper = new UserTypeMapper();

		private readonly List<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory> _pluginResolverFactories = new List<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory>();

		private readonly ReaderWriterLockSlim _lock = new ReaderWriterLockSlim();

		private PgTypeInfoResolverFactory[] _typeMappingResolvers = Array.Empty<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory>();

		private PgSerializerOptions? _typeMappingOptions;

		private Func<PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder>? _builderFactory;

		private JsonSerializerOptions? _jsonSerializerOptions;

		internal List<HackyEnumTypeMapping> HackyEnumTypeMappings { get; } = new List<HackyEnumTypeMapping>();

		private PgSerializerOptions TypeMappingOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_typeMappingOptions != null)
				{
					return _typeMappingOptions;
				}
				_lock.EnterReadLock();
				try
				{
					PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder pgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder = _builderFactory?.Invoke() ?? new PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder();
					pgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(_userTypeMapper);
					foreach (PgTypeInfoResolverFactory pluginResolverFactory in _pluginResolverFactories)
					{
						pgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(pluginResolverFactory);
					}
					PgTypeInfoResolverFactory[] typeMappingResolvers = _typeMappingResolvers;
					foreach (PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory in typeMappingResolvers)
					{
						pgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder.AppendResolverFactory(factory);
					}
					PgTypeInfoResolverChain value = pgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder.Build();
					return _typeMappingOptions = new PgSerializerOptions(PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfo.DefaultTypeCatalog, value)
					{
						PortableTypeIds = true,
						IntrospectionMode = true
					};
				}
				finally
				{
					_lock.ExitReadLock();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static GlobalTypeMapper Instance { get; }

		public INpgsqlNameTranslator DefaultNameTranslator
		{
			get
			{
				return _userTypeMapper.DefaultNameTranslator;
			}
			set
			{
				_userTypeMapper.DefaultNameTranslator = value;
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory> GetPluginResolverFactories()
		{
			List<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory> list = new List<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory>();
			_lock.EnterReadLock();
			try
			{
				list.AddRange(_pluginResolverFactories);
				return list;
			}
			finally
			{
				_lock.ExitReadLock();
			}
		}

		internal PgTypeInfoResolverFactory? GetUserMappingsResolverFactory()
		{
			_lock.EnterReadLock();
			try
			{
				return (_userTypeMapper.Items.Count > 0) ? _userTypeMapper : null;
			}
			finally
			{
				_lock.ExitReadLock();
			}
		}

		internal void AddGlobalTypeMappingResolvers(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory[] factories, Func<PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder>? builderFactory = null, bool overwrite = false)
		{
			if (overwrite || factories.Length > _typeMappingResolvers.Length)
			{
				_builderFactory = builderFactory;
				_typeMappingResolvers = factories;
				ResetTypeMappingCache();
			}
		}

		private void ResetTypeMappingCache()
		{
			_typeMappingOptions = null;
		}

		internal DataTypeName? FindDataTypeName(Type type, object value)
		{
			DataTypeName? result;
			try
			{
				PgTypeInfo typeInfo = TypeMappingOptions.GetTypeInfo(type);
				if (typeInfo is PgResolverTypeInfo pgResolverTypeInfo)
				{
					return pgResolverTypeInfo.GetObjectResolution(value).PgTypeId.DataTypeName;
				}
				return typeInfo?.GetResolution().PgTypeId.DataTypeName;
			}
			catch
			{
				result = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		static GlobalTypeMapper()
		{
			Instance = new GlobalTypeMapper();
		}

		public void AddTypeInfoResolverFactory(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
		{
			_lock.EnterWriteLock();
			try
			{
				Type type = factory.GetType();
				if (_pluginResolverFactories.Count > 0 && _pluginResolverFactories[0].GetType() == type)
				{
					_pluginResolverFactories[0] = factory;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < _pluginResolverFactories.Count; i++)
				{
					if (_pluginResolverFactories[i].GetType() == type)
					{
						_pluginResolverFactories.RemoveAt(i);
						break;
					}
				}
				_pluginResolverFactories.Insert(0, factory);
				ResetTypeMappingCache();
			}
			finally
			{
				_lock.ExitWriteLock();
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceTypeInfoResolverFactory(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
		{
			_lock.EnterWriteLock();
			try
			{
				Type type = factory.GetType();
				for (int i = 0; i < _pluginResolverFactories.Count; i++)
				{
					if (_pluginResolverFactories[i].GetType() == type)
					{
						_pluginResolverFactories[i] = factory;
						break;
					}
				}
				ResetTypeMappingCache();
			}
			finally
			{
				_lock.ExitWriteLock();
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_lock.EnterWriteLock();
			try
			{
				_pluginResolverFactories.Clear();
				_userTypeMapper.Items.Clear();
				HackyEnumTypeMappings.Clear();
			}
			finally
			{
				_lock.ExitWriteLock();
			}
		}

		public INpgsqlTypeMapper ConfigureJsonOptions(JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions)
		{
			_jsonSerializerOptions = serializerOptions;
			ReplaceTypeInfoResolverFactory(new JsonTypeInfoResolverFactory(serializerOptions));
			return this;
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Json serializer may perform reflection on trimmed types.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Serializing arbitrary types to json can require creating new generic types or methods, which requires creating code at runtime. This may not work when AOT compiling.")]
		public INpgsqlTypeMapper EnableDynamicJson(Type[]? jsonbClrTypes = null, Type[]? jsonClrTypes = null)
		{
			AddTypeInfoResolverFactory(new JsonDynamicTypeInfoResolverFactory(jsonbClrTypes, jsonClrTypes, _jsonSerializerOptions));
			return this;
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("The mapping of PostgreSQL records as .NET tuples requires reflection usage which is incompatible with trimming.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("The mapping of PostgreSQL records as .NET tuples requires dynamic code usage which is incompatible with NativeAOT.")]
		public INpgsqlTypeMapper EnableRecordsAsTuples()
		{
			AddTypeInfoResolverFactory(new TupledRecordTypeInfoResolverFactory());
			return this;
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("The use of unmapped enums, ranges or multiranges requires reflection usage which is incompatible with trimming.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("The use of unmapped enums, ranges or multiranges requires dynamic code usage which is incompatible with NativeAOT.")]
		public INpgsqlTypeMapper EnableUnmappedTypes()
		{
			AddTypeInfoResolverFactory(new UnmappedTypeInfoResolverFactory());
			return this;
		}

			_lock.EnterWriteLock();

				_userTypeMapper.MapEnum<TEnum>(pgName, nameTranslator);

	public interface INpgsqlTypeMapper
	{
		INpgsqlNameTranslator DefaultNameTranslator { get; set; }

		INpgsqlTypeMapper MapEnum<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] TEnum>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null) where TEnum : struct, Enum;

		bool UnmapEnum<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] TEnum>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null) where TEnum : struct, Enum;

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Calling MapEnum with a Type can require creating new generic types or methods. This may not work when AOT compiling.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper MapEnum([DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicParameterlessConstructor | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] Type clrType, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null);

		bool UnmapEnum([DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicParameterlessConstructor | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] Type clrType, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null);

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper MapComposite<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] T>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null);

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		bool UnmapComposite<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] T>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null);

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper MapComposite([DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] Type clrType, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null);

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		bool UnmapComposite([DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] Type clrType, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null);

		void AddTypeInfoResolverFactory(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory);

		INpgsqlTypeMapper ConfigureJsonOptions(JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions);

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Json serializer may perform reflection on trimmed types.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Serializing arbitrary types to json can require creating new generic types or methods, which requires creating code at runtime. This may not work when AOT compiling.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper EnableDynamicJson(Type[]? jsonbClrTypes = null, Type[]? jsonClrTypes = null);

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("The mapping of PostgreSQL records as .NET tuples requires reflection usage which is incompatible with trimming.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("The mapping of PostgreSQL records as .NET tuples requires dynamic code usage which is incompatible with NativeAOT.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper EnableRecordsAsTuples();

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("The use of unmapped enums, ranges or multiranges requires reflection usage which is incompatible with trimming.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("The use of unmapped enums, ranges or multiranges requires dynamic code usage which is incompatible with NativeAOT.")]
		INpgsqlTypeMapper EnableUnmappedTypes();

		void Reset();
	}
	public abstract class UserTypeMapping
	{
		public string PgTypeName { get; }

		public Type ClrType { get; }

		internal UserTypeMapping(string pgTypeName, Type type)
		{
			PgTypeName = pgTypeName;
			ClrType = type;
		}

		internal abstract void AddMapping(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings);

		internal abstract void AddArrayMapping(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings);
	}
	internal sealed class UserTypeMapper : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
	{
		private class Resolver : IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			protected readonly List<UserTypeMapping> _userTypeMappings;

			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			protected TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection()));

			public Resolver(List<UserTypeMapping> userTypeMappings)
			{
				_userTypeMappings = userTypeMappings;
			}

			PgTypeInfo? IPgTypeInfoResolver.GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				foreach (UserTypeMapping userTypeMapping in _userTypeMappings)
				{
					userTypeMapping.AddMapping(mappings);
				}
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ArrayResolver : Resolver, IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private new TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(base.Mappings)));

			public ArrayResolver(List<UserTypeMapping> userTypeMappings)
				: base(userTypeMappings)
			{
			}

			PgTypeInfo? IPgTypeInfoResolver.GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				foreach (UserTypeMapping userTypeMapping in _userTypeMappings)
				{
					userTypeMapping.AddArrayMapping(mappings);
				}
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		private sealed class CompositeMapping<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] T> : UserTypeMapping where T : class
		{
			private readonly INpgsqlNameTranslator _nameTranslator;

			public CompositeMapping(string pgTypeName, INpgsqlNameTranslator nameTranslator)
				: base(pgTypeName, typeof(T))
			{
				_nameTranslator = nameTranslator;
			}

			internal override void AddMapping(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddType<T>(base.PgTypeName, delegate(PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _)
				{
					if (!(mapping.GetPgType(options) is PostgresCompositeType pgType))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Composite mapping must be to a composite type");
					}
					return mapping.CreateInfo(options, new CompositeConverter<T>(ReflectionCompositeInfoFactory.CreateCompositeInfo<T>(pgType, _nameTranslator, options)));
				}, isDefault: true);
			}

			internal override void AddArrayMapping(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddArrayType<T>(base.PgTypeName);
			}
		}

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		private sealed class StructCompositeMapping<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] T> : UserTypeMapping where T : struct
		{
			private readonly INpgsqlNameTranslator _nameTranslator;

			public StructCompositeMapping(string pgTypeName, INpgsqlNameTranslator nameTranslator)
				: base(pgTypeName, typeof(T))
			{
				_nameTranslator = nameTranslator;
			}

			internal override void AddMapping(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructType<T>(base.PgTypeName, delegate(PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool dataTypeNameMatch)
				{
					if (!(mapping.GetPgType(options) is PostgresCompositeType pgType))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Composite mapping must be to a composite type");
					}
					return mapping.CreateInfo(options, new CompositeConverter<T>(ReflectionCompositeInfoFactory.CreateCompositeInfo<T>(pgType, _nameTranslator, options)));
				}, isDefault: true);
			}

			internal override void AddArrayMapping(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<T>(base.PgTypeName);
			}
		}

		internal abstract class EnumMapping : UserTypeMapping
		{
			internal INpgsqlNameTranslator NameTranslator { get; }

			public EnumMapping(string pgTypeName, [DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] Type enumClrType, INpgsqlNameTranslator nameTranslator)
				: base(pgTypeName, enumClrType)
			{
				NameTranslator = nameTranslator;
			}
		}

		private sealed class EnumMapping<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] TEnum> : EnumMapping where TEnum : struct, Enum
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<TEnum, string> _enumToLabel = new Dictionary<TEnum, string>();

			private readonly Dictionary<string, TEnum> _labelToEnum = new Dictionary<string, TEnum>();

			public EnumMapping(string pgTypeName, INpgsqlNameTranslator nameTranslator)
				: base(pgTypeName, typeof(TEnum), nameTranslator)
			{
				FieldInfo[] fields = typeof(TEnum).GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
				foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in fields)
				{
					PgNameAttribute pgNameAttribute = (PgNameAttribute)fieldInfo.GetCustomAttribute(typeof(PgNameAttribute), inherit: false);
					string text = ((pgNameAttribute == null) ? nameTranslator.TranslateMemberName(fieldInfo.Name) : pgNameAttribute.PgName);
					TEnum val = (TEnum)fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
					_enumToLabel[val] = text;
					_labelToEnum[text] = val;
				}
			}

			internal override void AddMapping(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructType<TEnum>(base.PgTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new EnumConverter<TEnum>(_enumToLabel, _labelToEnum, options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text), isDefault: true);
			}

			internal override void AddArrayMapping(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<TEnum>(base.PgTypeName);
			}
		}

		private readonly List<UserTypeMapping> _mappings;

		public IList<UserTypeMapping> Items => _mappings;

		public INpgsqlNameTranslator DefaultNameTranslator { get; set; } = NpgsqlSnakeCaseNameTranslator.Instance;

		private UserTypeMapper(IEnumerable<UserTypeMapping> mappings)
		{
			_mappings = new List<UserTypeMapping>(mappings);
		}

		public UserTypeMapper()
		{
			_mappings = new List<UserTypeMapping>();
		}

		public UserTypeMapper Clone()
		{
			return new UserTypeMapper(_mappings)
			{
				DefaultNameTranslator = DefaultNameTranslator
			};
		}

		public UserTypeMapper MapEnum<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] TEnum>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null) where TEnum : struct, Enum
		{
			Unmap(typeof(TEnum), out var resolvedName, pgName, nameTranslator);
			Items.Add(new EnumMapping<TEnum>(resolvedName, nameTranslator ?? DefaultNameTranslator));
			return this;
		}

		public bool UnmapEnum<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] TEnum>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null) where TEnum : struct, Enum
		{
			string resolvedName;
			return Unmap(typeof(TEnum), out resolvedName, pgName, nameTranslator ?? DefaultNameTranslator);
		}

		[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("Trimming", "IL2111", Justification = "MapEnum<TEnum> TEnum has less DAM annotations than clrType.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Calling MapEnum with a Type can require creating new generic types or methods. This may not work when AOT compiling.")]
		public UserTypeMapper MapEnum([DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicParameterlessConstructor | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] Type clrType, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null)
		{
			if (!clrType.IsEnum || !clrType.IsValueType)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Type must be a concrete Enum", "clrType");
			}
			typeof(UserTypeMapper).GetMethod("MapEnum", new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(INpgsqlNameTranslator)
			}).MakeGenericMethod(clrType).Invoke(this, new object[2] { pgName, nameTranslator });
			return this;
		}

		public bool UnmapEnum([DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] Type clrType, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null)
		{
			if (!clrType.IsEnum || !clrType.IsValueType)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Type must be a concrete Enum", "clrType");
			}
			string resolvedName;
			return Unmap(clrType, out resolvedName, pgName, nameTranslator ?? DefaultNameTranslator);
		}

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		public UserTypeMapper MapComposite<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] T>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null) where T : class
		{
			Unmap(typeof(T), out var resolvedName, pgName, nameTranslator);
			Items.Add(new CompositeMapping<T>(resolvedName, nameTranslator ?? DefaultNameTranslator));
			return this;
		}

		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		public UserTypeMapper MapStructComposite<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] T>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null) where T : struct
		{
			Unmap(typeof(T), out var resolvedName, pgName, nameTranslator);
			Items.Add(new StructCompositeMapping<T>(resolvedName, nameTranslator ?? DefaultNameTranslator));
			return this;
		}

		[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("Trimming", "IL2111", Justification = "MapStructComposite and MapComposite have identical DAM annotations to clrType.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Mapping composite types involves serializing arbitrary types which can require creating new generic types or methods. This is currently unsupported with NativeAOT, vote on issue #5303 if this is important to you.")]
		public UserTypeMapper MapComposite([DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields | DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] Type clrType, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null)
		{
			if (clrType.IsConstructedGenericType && clrType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Cannot map nullable.", "clrType");
			}
			typeof(UserTypeMapper).GetMethod(clrType.IsValueType ? "MapStructComposite" : "MapComposite", new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(INpgsqlNameTranslator)
			}).MakeGenericMethod(clrType).Invoke(this, new object[2] { pgName, nameTranslator });
			return this;
		}

		public bool UnmapComposite<T>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null) where T : class
		{
			return UnmapComposite(typeof(T), pgName, nameTranslator);
		}

		public bool UnmapStructComposite<T>(string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null) where T : struct
		{
			return UnmapComposite(typeof(T), pgName, nameTranslator);
		}

		public bool UnmapComposite(Type clrType, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null)
		{
			string resolvedName;
			return Unmap(clrType, out resolvedName, pgName, nameTranslator);
		}

		private bool Unmap(Type type, out string resolvedName, string? pgName = null, INpgsqlNameTranslator? nameTranslator = null)
		{
			if (pgName != null && pgName.Trim() == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("pgName can't be empty", "pgName");
			}
			if (nameTranslator == null)
			{
				nameTranslator = DefaultNameTranslator;
			}
			resolvedName = pgName ?? (pgName = GetPgName(type, nameTranslator));
			UserTypeMapping userTypeMapping = null;
			foreach (UserTypeMapping mapping in _mappings)
			{
				if (mapping.PgTypeName == pgName)
				{
					userTypeMapping = mapping;
				}
			}
			if (userTypeMapping != null)
			{
				return _mappings.Remove(userTypeMapping);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetPgName(Type type, INpgsqlNameTranslator nameTranslator)
		{
			return type.GetCustomAttribute<PgNameAttribute>()?.PgName ?? nameTranslator.TranslateTypeName(type.Name);
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateResolver()
		{
			return new Resolver(new List<UserTypeMapping>(_mappings));
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateArrayResolver()
		{
			return new ArrayResolver(new List<UserTypeMapping>(_mappings));
		}
	}
}

	internal static class ReadOnlySpanOfCharExtensions
	{
		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		public static int ParseInt(this ReadOnlySpan<char> span)
		{
			return int.Parse(span.ToString());
		}
	}

namespace Npgsql.Schema
{
	internal sealed class DbColumnSchemaGenerator
	{
		private readonly RowDescriptionMessage _rowDescription;

		private readonly NpgsqlConnection _connection;

		private readonly bool _fetchAdditionalInfo;

		internal DbColumnSchemaGenerator(NpgsqlConnection connection, RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription, bool fetchAdditionalInfo)
		{
			_connection = connection;
			_rowDescription = rowDescription;
			_fetchAdditionalInfo = fetchAdditionalInfo;
		}

		private static string GenerateColumnsQuery(Version pgVersion, string columnFieldFilter)
		{
			return "SELECT\n     typ.oid AS typoid, nspname, relname, attname, attrelid, attnum, attnotnull,\n     " + (pgVersion.IsGreaterOrEqual(10) ? "attidentity != ''" : "FALSE") + " AS isidentity,\n     CASE WHEN typ.typtype = 'd' THEN typ.typtypmod ELSE atttypmod END AS typmod,\n     CASE WHEN atthasdef THEN (SELECT pg_get_expr(adbin, cls.oid) FROM pg_attrdef WHERE adrelid = cls.oid AND adnum = attr.attnum) ELSE NULL END AS default,\n     CASE WHEN col.is_updatable = 'YES' THEN true ELSE false END AS is_updatable,\n     EXISTS (\n       SELECT * FROM pg_index\n       WHERE pg_index.indrelid = cls.oid AND\n             pg_index.indisprimary AND\n             attnum = ANY (indkey)\n     ) AS isprimarykey,\n     EXISTS (\n       SELECT * FROM pg_index\n       WHERE pg_index.indrelid = cls.oid AND\n             pg_index.indisunique AND\n             pg_index." + (pgVersion.IsGreaterOrEqual(11) ? "indnkeyatts" : "indnatts") + " = 1 AND\n             attnum = pg_index.indkey[0]\n     ) AS isunique\nFROM pg_attribute AS attr\nJOIN pg_type AS typ ON attr.atttypid = typ.oid\nJOIN pg_class AS cls ON cls.oid = attr.attrelid\nJOIN pg_namespace AS ns ON ns.oid = cls.relnamespace\nLEFT OUTER JOIN information_schema.columns AS col ON col.table_schema = nspname AND\n     col.table_name = relname AND\n     col.column_name = attname\nWHERE\n     atttypid <> 0 AND\n     relkind IN ('r', 'v', 'm') AND\n     NOT attisdropped AND\n     nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND\n     attnum > 0 AND\n     (" + columnFieldFilter + ")\nORDER BY attnum";
		}

		private static string GenerateOldColumnsQuery(string columnFieldFilter)
		{
			return "SELECT\n     typ.oid AS typoid, nspname, relname, attname, attrelid, attnum, attnotnull,\n     CASE WHEN typ.typtype = 'd' THEN typ.typtypmod ELSE atttypmod END AS typmod,\n     CASE WHEN atthasdef THEN (SELECT pg_get_expr(adbin, cls.oid) FROM pg_attrdef WHERE adrelid = cls.oid AND adnum = attr.attnum) ELSE NULL END AS default,\n     TRUE AS is_updatable,  /* Supported only since PG 8.2 */\n     FALSE AS isprimarykey, /* Can't do ANY() on pg_index.indkey which is int2vector */\n     FALSE AS isunique      /* Can't do ANY() on pg_index.indkey which is int2vector */\nFROM pg_attribute AS attr\nJOIN pg_type AS typ ON attr.atttypid = typ.oid\nJOIN pg_class AS cls ON cls.oid = attr.attrelid\nJOIN pg_namespace AS ns ON ns.oid = cls.relnamespace\nLEFT OUTER JOIN information_schema.columns AS col ON col.table_schema = nspname AND\n     col.table_name = relname AND\n     col.column_name = attname\nWHERE\n     atttypid <> 0 AND\n     relkind IN ('r', 'v', 'm') AND\n     NOT attisdropped AND\n     nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND\n     attnum > 0 AND\n     (" + columnFieldFilter + ")\nORDER BY attnum";
		}

		internal async Task<ReadOnlyCollection<NpgsqlDbColumn>> GetColumnSchema(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			bool oldQueryMode = _connection.PostgreSqlVersion < new Version(8, 2);
			int numFields = _rowDescription.Count;
			List<NpgsqlDbColumn?> result = new List<NpgsqlDbColumn>(numFields);
			for (int i = 0; i < numFields; i++)
			{
				result.Add(null);
			}
			int populatedColumns = 0;
			if (_fetchAdditionalInfo)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				for (int j = 0; j < _rowDescription.Count; j++)
				{
					FieldDescription fieldDescription = _rowDescription[j];
					if (fieldDescription.TableOID != 0)
					{
						list.Add($"(attr.attrelid={fieldDescription.TableOID} AND attr.attnum={fieldDescription.ColumnAttributeNumber})");
					}
				}
				string text = string.Join(" OR ", list);
				if (text != string.Empty)
				{
					string query = (oldQueryMode ? GenerateOldColumnsQuery(text) : GenerateColumnsQuery(_connection.PostgreSqlVersion, text));
					using (new TransactionScope(TransactionScopeOption.Suppress, async ? TransactionScopeAsyncFlowOption.Enabled : TransactionScopeAsyncFlowOption.Suppress))
					{
						using NpgsqlConnection connection = (NpgsqlConnection)((ICloneable)_connection).Clone();
						await connection.Open(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						using NpgsqlCommand cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(query, connection);
						NpgsqlDataReader reader = await cmd.ExecuteReader(async, CommandBehavior.Default, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						try
						{
							while ((!async) ? reader.Read() : (await reader.ReadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)))
							{
								NpgsqlDbColumn npgsqlDbColumn = LoadColumnDefinition(reader, _connection.Connector.DatabaseInfo, oldQueryMode);
								for (int k = 0; k < numFields; k++)
								{
									FieldDescription fieldDescription2 = _rowDescription[k];
									if (fieldDescription2.TableOID == npgsqlDbColumn.TableOID && fieldDescription2.ColumnAttributeNumber == npgsqlDbColumn.ColumnAttributeNumber)
									{
										populatedColumns++;
										if (npgsqlDbColumn.ColumnOrdinal.HasValue)
										{
											npgsqlDbColumn = npgsqlDbColumn.Clone();
										}
										npgsqlDbColumn.ColumnOrdinal = k;
										result[k] = npgsqlDbColumn;
									}
								}
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							if (async)
							{
								await reader.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							}
							else
							{
								reader.Dispose();
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < numFields; l++)
			{
				NpgsqlDbColumn npgsqlDbColumn2 = result[l];
				FieldDescription fieldDescription3 = _rowDescription[l];
				if (npgsqlDbColumn2 == null)
				{
					npgsqlDbColumn2 = SetUpNonColumnField(fieldDescription3);
					npgsqlDbColumn2.ColumnOrdinal = l;
					result[l] = npgsqlDbColumn2;
					populatedColumns++;
				}
				npgsqlDbColumn2.ColumnName = fieldDescription3.Name;
				npgsqlDbColumn2.IsAliased = ((npgsqlDbColumn2.BaseColumnName == null) ? ((bool?)null) : new bool?(npgsqlDbColumn2.BaseColumnName != npgsqlDbColumn2.ColumnName));
			}
			if (populatedColumns != numFields)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("Could not load all columns for the resultset");
			}
			return result.AsReadOnly();
		}

		private NpgsqlDbColumn LoadColumnDefinition(NpgsqlDataReader reader, NpgsqlDatabaseInfo databaseInfo, bool oldQueryMode)
		{
			NpgsqlDbColumn npgsqlDbColumn = new NpgsqlDbColumn
			{
				AllowDBNull = !reader.GetBoolean(reader.GetOrdinal("attnotnull")),
				BaseCatalogName = _connection.Database,
				BaseSchemaName = reader.GetString(reader.GetOrdinal("nspname")),
				BaseServerName = _connection.Host,
				BaseTableName = reader.GetString(reader.GetOrdinal("relname")),
				BaseColumnName = reader.GetString(reader.GetOrdinal("attname")),
				ColumnAttributeNumber = reader.GetInt16(reader.GetOrdinal("attnum")),
				IsKey = reader.GetBoolean(reader.GetOrdinal("isprimarykey")),
				IsReadOnly = !reader.GetBoolean(reader.GetOrdinal("is_updatable")),
				IsUnique = reader.GetBoolean(reader.GetOrdinal("isunique")),
				TableOID = reader.GetFieldValue<uint>(reader.GetOrdinal("attrelid")),
				TypeOID = reader.GetFieldValue<uint>(reader.GetOrdinal("typoid"))
			};
			npgsqlDbColumn.PostgresType = databaseInfo.ByOID[npgsqlDbColumn.TypeOID];
			npgsqlDbColumn.DataTypeName = npgsqlDbColumn.PostgresType.DisplayName;
			int ordinal = reader.GetOrdinal("default");
			npgsqlDbColumn.DefaultValue = (reader.IsDBNull(ordinal) ? null : reader.GetString(ordinal));
			npgsqlDbColumn.IsIdentity = !oldQueryMode && reader.GetBoolean(reader.GetOrdinal("isidentity"));
			npgsqlDbColumn.IsAutoIncrement = npgsqlDbColumn.IsIdentity == true || (npgsqlDbColumn.DefaultValue != null && npgsqlDbColumn.DefaultValue.StartsWith("nextval(", StringComparison.Ordinal));
			ColumnPostConfig(npgsqlDbColumn, reader.GetInt32(reader.GetOrdinal("typmod")));
			return npgsqlDbColumn;
		}

		private NpgsqlDbColumn SetUpNonColumnField(FieldDescription field)
		{
			NpgsqlDbColumn npgsqlDbColumn = new NpgsqlDbColumn
			{
				BaseCatalogName = _connection.Database,
				BaseServerName = _connection.Host,
				IsReadOnly = true,
				DataTypeName = field.PostgresType.DisplayName,
				TypeOID = field.TypeOID,
				TableOID = field.TableOID,
				ColumnAttributeNumber = field.ColumnAttributeNumber,
				PostgresType = field.PostgresType
			};
			ColumnPostConfig(npgsqlDbColumn, field.TypeModifier);
			return npgsqlDbColumn;
		}

		private void ColumnPostConfig(NpgsqlDbColumn column, int typeModifier)
		{
			PgSerializerOptions serializerOptions = _connection.Connector.SerializerOptions;
			column.NpgsqlDbType = column.PostgresType.DataTypeName.ToNpgsqlDbType();
			PgTypeInfo objectOrDefaultTypeInfo = serializerOptions.GetObjectOrDefaultTypeInfo(column.PostgresType);
			if (objectOrDefaultTypeInfo != null)
			{
				column.DataType = objectOrDefaultTypeInfo.Type;
				column.IsLong = column.PostgresType.DataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Bytea;
				if (column.PostgresType is PostgresCompositeType)
				{
					column.UdtAssemblyQualifiedName = objectOrDefaultTypeInfo.Type.AssemblyQualifiedName;
				}
			}
			PostgresFacets facets = column.PostgresType.GetFacets(typeModifier);
			if (facets.Size.HasValue)
			{
				column.ColumnSize = facets.Size;
			}
			if (facets.Precision.HasValue)
			{
				column.NumericPrecision = facets.Precision;
			}
			if (facets.Scale.HasValue)
			{
				column.NumericScale = facets.Scale;
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class PgDateTime
	{
		private const long PostgresTimestampOffsetTicks = 630822816000000000L;

		public static DateTime DecodeTimestamp(long value, DateTimeKind kind)
		{
			return new DateTime(value * 10 + 630822816000000000L, kind);
		}

		public static long EncodeTimestamp(DateTime value)
		{
			return (value.Ticks - 630822816000000000L) / 10;
		}

		public async Task<PhysicalReplicationSlot> CreateReplicationSlot(string slotName, bool isTemporary = false, bool reserveWal = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("CREATE_REPLICATION_SLOT ").Append(slotName);
			if (isTemporary)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" TEMPORARY");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(" PHYSICAL");
			if (reserveWal)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append((base.PostgreSqlVersion.Major >= 15) ? " (RESERVE_WAL)" : " RESERVE_WAL");
			}
			string commandText = stringBuilder.ToString();
			LogMessages.CreatingReplicationSlot(base.ReplicationLogger, slotName, commandText, base.Connector.Id);
			return new PhysicalReplicationSlot((await CreateReplicationSlot(stringBuilder.ToString(), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)).SlotName);
		}

		public Task<PhysicalReplicationSlot?> ReadReplicationSlot(string slotName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ReadReplicationSlotInternal(slotName, cancellationToken);
		}

		public IAsyncEnumerable<XLogDataMessage> StartReplication(PhysicalReplicationSlot? slot, NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber walLocation, CancellationToken cancellationToken, uint timeline = 0u)
		{
			return StartPhysicalReplication(slot, walLocation, cancellationToken, timeline);
			async IAsyncEnumerable<XLogDataMessage> StartPhysicalReplication(PhysicalReplicationSlot? physicalReplicationSlot, NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber npgsqlLogSequenceNumber, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken2, uint num)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("START_REPLICATION");
				if (physicalReplicationSlot != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" SLOT ").Append(physicalReplicationSlot.Name);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(" PHYSICAL ").Append(npgsqlLogSequenceNumber);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" TIMELINE ").Append(num.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
				LogMessages.StartingPhysicalReplication(base.ReplicationLogger, physicalReplicationSlot?.Name, text, base.Connector.Id);
				IAsyncEnumerator<XLogDataMessage> enumerator = StartReplicationInternalWrapper(text, bypassingStream: false, cancellationToken2);
				while (await enumerator.MoveNextAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
					yield return enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
		}

		public IAsyncEnumerable<XLogDataMessage> StartReplication(NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber walLocation, CancellationToken cancellationToken, uint timeline = 0u)

		}

		public IAsyncEnumerable<XLogDataMessage> StartReplication(PhysicalReplicationSlot slot, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!slot.RestartLsn.HasValue)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("For this overload of StartReplication the slot argument must contain a valid RestartLsn. Please use an overload with the walLocation argument otherwise.", "slot");
			}
			return StartReplication(slot, slot.RestartLsn.Value, cancellationToken, slot.RestartTimeline.GetValueOrDefault());
		}
