	public abstract class ReplicationConnection : IAsyncDisposable
	{
		private static readonly Version FirstVersionWithTwoPhaseSupport = new Version(15, 0);

		private static readonly Version FirstVersionWithoutDropSlotDoubleCommandCompleteMessage = new Version(13, 0);

		private static readonly Version FirstVersionWithTemporarySlotsAndSlotSnapshotInitMode = new Version(10, 0);

		private readonly NpgsqlConnection _npgsqlConnection;

		private readonly SemaphoreSlim _feedbackSemaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(1, 1);

		private string? _userFacingConnectionString;

		private TimeSpan? _commandTimeout;

		private TimeSpan _walReceiverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0);

		private Timer? _sendFeedbackTimer;

		private Timer? _requestFeedbackTimer;

		private TimeSpan _requestFeedbackInterval;

		private IAsyncEnumerator<XLogDataMessage>? _currentEnumerator;

		private CancellationTokenSource? _replicationCancellationTokenSource;

		private bool _pgCancellationSupported;

		private bool _isDisposed;

		private long _lastReceivedLsn;

		private long _lastFlushedLsn;

		private long _lastAppliedLsn;

		private readonly XLogDataMessage _cachedXLogDataMessage = new XLogDataMessage();

		internal ILogger ReplicationLogger { get; private set; }

		public string ConnectionString
		{
			get
			{
				return _userFacingConnectionString ?? string.Empty;
			}
			[param: AllowNull]
			set
			{
				_userFacingConnectionString = value;
				NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder = new NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(value)
				{
					Pooling = false,
					Enlist = false,
					Multiplexing = false,
					KeepAlive = 0,
					ReplicationMode = ReplicationMode
				};
				if (ReplicationMode == ReplicationMode.Physical)
				{
					npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.ServerCompatibilityMode = ServerCompatibilityMode.NoTypeLoading;
				}
				_npgsqlConnection.ConnectionString = npgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber LastReceivedLsn
		{
			get
			{
				return (NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber)(ulong)Interlocked.Read(in _lastReceivedLsn);
			}
			private protected set
			{
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastReceivedLsn, (long)(ulong)value);
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber LastFlushedLsn
		{
			get
			{
				return (NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber)(ulong)Interlocked.Read(in _lastFlushedLsn);
			}
			set
			{
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastFlushedLsn, (long)(ulong)value);
			}
		}

		public NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber LastAppliedLsn
		{
			get
			{
				return (NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber)(ulong)Interlocked.Read(in _lastAppliedLsn);
			}
			set
			{
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastAppliedLsn, (long)(ulong)value);
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan WalReceiverStatusInterval { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		public TimeSpan WalReceiverTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return _walReceiverTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				_walReceiverTimeout = value;
				_requestFeedbackInterval = ((value == Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan) ? value : new TimeSpan(value.Ticks / 2));
			}
		}

		private protected abstract ReplicationMode ReplicationMode { get; }

		public Version PostgreSqlVersion => _npgsqlConnection.PostgreSqlVersion;

		public string ServerVersion => _npgsqlConnection.ServerVersion;

		internal NpgsqlConnector Connector => _npgsqlConnection.Connector ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The Connector property can only be used when there is an active connection");

		public TimeSpan CommandTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				TimeSpan? commandTimeout = _commandTimeout;
				if (!commandTimeout.HasValue)
				{
					if (_npgsqlConnection.CommandTimeout <= 0)
					{
						return Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan;
					}
					return TimeSpan.FromSeconds(_npgsqlConnection.CommandTimeout);
				}
				return commandTimeout.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < TimeSpan.Zero && value != Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, $"A finite CommandTimeout can't be less than {TimeSpan.Zero}.");
				}
				_commandTimeout = value;
				if (Connector.State != ConnectorState.Replication)
				{
					SetTimeouts(value, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public Encoding Encoding => _npgsqlConnection.Connector?.TextEncoding ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The Encoding property can only be used when there is an active connection");

		public int ProcessID => (_npgsqlConnection.Connector ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The ProcessID property can only be used when there is an active connection")).BackendProcessId;

		private protected ReplicationConnection()
		{
			_npgsqlConnection = new NpgsqlConnection();
			_requestFeedbackInterval = new TimeSpan(_walReceiverTimeout.Ticks / 2);
		}

		private protected ReplicationConnection(string? connectionString)
			: this()
		{
			ConnectionString = connectionString;
		}

		public async Task Open(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			await _npgsqlConnection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			_pgCancellationSupported = _npgsqlConnection.PostgreSqlVersion.IsGreaterOrEqual(10);
			SetTimeouts(CommandTimeout, CommandTimeout);
			_npgsqlConnection.Connector.LongRunningConnection = true;
			ReplicationLogger = _npgsqlConnection.Connector.LoggingConfiguration.ReplicationLogger;
		}

		public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			if (_isDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			NpgsqlConnector? connector = _npgsqlConnection.Connector;
			if (connector != null && connector.State == ConnectorState.Replication)
			{
				_replicationCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
				try
				{
					while (await _currentEnumerator.MoveNextAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
					{
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			_feedbackSemaphore.Dispose();
			try
			{
				await _npgsqlConnection.Close(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			_isDisposed = true;
		}

		public async Task<ReplicationSystemIdentification> IdentifySystem(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			object[] array = await ReadSingleRow("IDENTIFY_SYSTEM", cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return new ReplicationSystemIdentification((string)array[0], (uint)array[1], NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber.Parse((string)array[2]), (string)array[3]);
		}

		public Task<string> Show(string parameterName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (parameterName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parameterName");
			}
			return ShowInternal(parameterName, cancellationToken);
			async Task<string> ShowInternal(string text, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				return (string)(await ReadSingleRow("SHOW " + text, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))[0];
			}
		}

		public async Task<TimelineHistoryFile> TimelineHistory(uint tli, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			object[] array = await ReadSingleRow($"TIMELINE_HISTORY {tli:D}", cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return new TimelineHistoryFile((string)array[0], (byte[])array[1]);
		}

		internal async Task<ReplicationSlotOptions> CreateReplicationSlot(string command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			try
			{
				object[] obj = await ReadSingleRow(command, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				string slotName = (string)obj[0];
				string s = (string)obj[1];
				string snapshotName = (string)obj[2];
				return new ReplicationSlotOptions(slotName, NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber.Parse(s), snapshotName);
			}
			catch (PostgresException ex) when (!Connector.IsBroken && ex.SqlState == "42601")
			{
				if (PostgreSqlVersion < FirstVersionWithTwoPhaseSupport && command.Contains(" TWO_PHASE"))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Logical replication support for prepared transactions was introduced in PostgreSQL " + FirstVersionWithTwoPhaseSupport.ToString(1) + ". Using PostgreSQL version " + ((PostgreSqlVersion.Build == -1) ? PostgreSqlVersion.ToString(2) : PostgreSqlVersion.ToString(3)) + " you have to set the twoPhase argument to false.", ex);
				}
				if (PostgreSqlVersion < FirstVersionWithTemporarySlotsAndSlotSnapshotInitMode)
				{
					if (command.Contains(" TEMPORARY"))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("Temporary replication slots were introduced in PostgreSQL " + FirstVersionWithTemporarySlotsAndSlotSnapshotInitMode.ToString(1) + ". Using PostgreSQL version " + PostgreSqlVersion.ToString(3) + " you have to set the isTemporary argument to false.", ex);
					}
					if (command.Contains(" EXPORT_SNAPSHOT") || command.Contains(" NOEXPORT_SNAPSHOT") || command.Contains(" USE_SNAPSHOT"))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("The EXPORT_SNAPSHOT, USE_SNAPSHOT and NOEXPORT_SNAPSHOT syntax was introduced in PostgreSQL " + FirstVersionWithTemporarySlotsAndSlotSnapshotInitMode.ToString(1) + ". Using PostgreSQL version " + PostgreSqlVersion.ToString(3) + " you have to omit the slotSnapshotInitMode argument.", ex);
					}
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		internal async Task<PhysicalReplicationSlot?> ReadReplicationSlotInternal(string slotName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			object[] array = await ReadSingleRow("READ_REPLICATION_SLOT " + slotName, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			string text = (string)array[0];
			if (!(text == "physical"))
			{
				if (text == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException("The replication slot type '" + text + "' is currently not supported by Npgsql. Please file an issue.");
			}
			string text2 = (string)array[1];
			uint? restartTimeline = (uint?)array[2];
			return new PhysicalReplicationSlot(slotName.ToLowerInvariant(), (text2 == null) ? ((NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber?)null) : new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber?(NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber.Parse(text2)), restartTimeline);
		}

		internal IAsyncEnumerator<XLogDataMessage> StartReplicationInternalWrapper(string command, bool bypassingStream, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			_currentEnumerator = StartReplicationInternal(command, bypassingStream, cancellationToken);
			return _currentEnumerator;
		}

		internal async IAsyncEnumerator<XLogDataMessage> StartReplicationInternal(string command, bool bypassingStream, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			NpgsqlConnector connector = _npgsqlConnection.Connector;
			_replicationCancellationTokenSource = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(new CancellationToken[1] { cancellationToken });
			using (connector.StartUserAction(ConnectorState.Replication, _replicationCancellationTokenSource.Token, _pgCancellationSupported))
			{
				NpgsqlReadBuffer.ColumnStream columnStream = null;
				try
				{
					await connector.WriteQuery(command, async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await connector.Flush(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					IBackendMessage backendMessage = await connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					switch (backendMessage.Code)
					{
					case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
						break;
					default:
						throw connector.UnexpectedMessageReceived(backendMessage.Code);
					case BackendMessageCode.CopyBothResponse:
					{
						NpgsqlReadBuffer buf = connector.ReadBuffer;
						columnStream = new NpgsqlReadBuffer.ColumnStream(connector);
						SetTimeouts(_walReceiverTimeout, CommandTimeout);
						_sendFeedbackTimer = new Timer(TimerSendFeedback, null, WalReceiverStatusInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
						_requestFeedbackTimer = new Timer(TimerRequestFeedback, null, _requestFeedbackInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
						while (true)
						{
							backendMessage = await connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							Statics.Expect<CopyDataMessage>(backendMessage, Connector);
							_requestFeedbackTimer.Change(_requestFeedbackInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
							int messageLength = ((CopyDataMessage)backendMessage).Length;
							await buf.EnsureAsync(1).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							char c = (char)buf.ReadByte();
							switch (c)
							{
							case 'w':
							{
								await buf.EnsureAsync(24).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								ulong num3 = buf.ReadUInt64();
								ulong num4 = buf.ReadUInt64();
								DateTime serverClock = PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc);
								if ((ulong)Interlocked.Read(in _lastReceivedLsn) < num3)
								{
									Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastReceivedLsn, (long)num3);
								}
								if ((ulong)Interlocked.Read(in _lastReceivedLsn) < num4)
								{
									Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastReceivedLsn, (long)num4);
								}
								int len = messageLength - 25;
								columnStream.Init(len, canSeek: false, commandScoped: false);
								_cachedXLogDataMessage.Populate(new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(num3), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(num4), serverClock, columnStream);
								yield return _cachedXLogDataMessage;
								if (!columnStream.IsDisposed && columnStream.Position < columnStream.Length && !bypassingStream)
								{
									await buf.Skip(checked((int)(columnStream.Length - columnStream.Position)), async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								}
								break;
							}
							case 'k':
							{
								await buf.EnsureAsync(17).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								ulong num = buf.ReadUInt64();
								if (ReplicationLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace))
								{
									NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber endLsn = new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(num);
									DateTime timestamp = PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc);
									LogMessages.ReceivedReplicationPrimaryKeepalive(ReplicationLogger, endLsn, timestamp, Connector.Id);
								}
								else
								{
									buf.Skip(8);
								}
								bool num2 = buf.ReadByte() == 1;
								if ((ulong)Interlocked.Read(in _lastReceivedLsn) < num)
								{
									Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastReceivedLsn, (long)num);
								}
								if (num2)
								{
									LogMessages.SendingReplicationStandbyStatusUpdate(ReplicationLogger, "the server requested it", Connector.Id);
									await SendFeedback(waitOnSemaphore: true, requestReply: false, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								}
								break;
							}
							default:
								throw Connector.Break(new NpgsqlException($"Unknown replication message code '{c}'"));
							}
						}
					}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (columnStream != null && !bypassingStream && !_replicationCancellationTokenSource.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						await columnStream.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					if (_sendFeedbackTimer != null)
					{
						ManualResetEvent manualResetEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
						if (_sendFeedbackTimer.Dispose(manualResetEvent))
						{
							await manualResetEvent.WaitOneAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
					}
					if (_requestFeedbackTimer != null)
					{
						ManualResetEvent manualResetEvent2 = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
						if (_requestFeedbackTimer.Dispose(manualResetEvent2))
						{
							await manualResetEvent2.WaitOneAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
					}
					_sendFeedbackTimer = null;
					_requestFeedbackTimer = null;
					SetTimeouts(CommandTimeout, CommandTimeout);
					_replicationCancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
					_replicationCancellationTokenSource = null;
					_currentEnumerator = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetReplicationStatus(NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber lastAppliedAndFlushedLsn)
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastAppliedLsn, (long)(ulong)lastAppliedAndFlushedLsn);
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastFlushedLsn, (long)(ulong)lastAppliedAndFlushedLsn);
		}

		public async Task SendStatusUpdate(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if (Connector.State != ConnectorState.Replication)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Status update can only be sent during replication");
			}
			LogMessages.SendingReplicationStandbyStatusUpdate(ReplicationLogger, "SendStatusUpdatewas called", Connector.Id);
			await SendFeedback(waitOnSemaphore: true, requestReply: false, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		private async Task SendFeedback(bool waitOnSemaphore = false, bool requestReply = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (!((!waitOnSemaphore) ? (await _feedbackSemaphore.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.Zero, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)) : (await _feedbackSemaphore.WaitAsync(-1, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))))
			{
				ReplicationLogger.LogTrace("Aborting feedback due to expired WalReceiverStatusInterval because of a concurrent feedback request");
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				NpgsqlConnector connector = _npgsqlConnection.Connector;
				NpgsqlWriteBuffer buf = connector.WriteBuffer;
				if (buf.WriteSpaceLeft < 39)
				{
					await connector.Flush(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				buf.StartMessage(39);
				buf.WriteByte(100);
				buf.WriteInt32(38);
				buf.WriteByte(114);
				long lastReceivedLsn = Interlocked.Read(in _lastReceivedLsn);
				long lastFlushedLsn = Interlocked.Read(in _lastFlushedLsn);
				long lastAppliedLsn = Interlocked.Read(in _lastAppliedLsn);
				DateTime timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
				buf.WriteInt64(lastReceivedLsn);
				buf.WriteInt64(lastFlushedLsn);
				buf.WriteInt64(lastAppliedLsn);
				buf.WriteInt64(PgDateTime.EncodeTimestamp(timestamp));
				buf.WriteByte(requestReply ? ((byte)1) : ((byte)0));
				await connector.Flush(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (ReplicationLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace))
				{
					LogMessages.SentReplicationFeedbackMessage(ReplicationLogger, new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber((ulong)lastReceivedLsn), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber((ulong)lastFlushedLsn), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber((ulong)lastAppliedLsn), timestamp, Connector.Id);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				LogMessages.ReplicationFeedbackMessageSendingFailed(ReplicationLogger, _npgsqlConnection?.Connector?.Id, exception);
			}
			finally
			{
				_sendFeedbackTimer.Change(WalReceiverStatusInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
				if (requestReply)
				{
					_requestFeedbackTimer.Change(_requestFeedbackInterval, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
				}
				_feedbackSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}

		private async void TimerRequestFeedback(object? obj)
		{
			try
			{
				if (Connector.State == ConnectorState.Replication)
				{
					if (ReplicationLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace))
					{
						LogMessages.SendingReplicationStandbyStatusUpdate(ReplicationLogger, string.Format("half of the {0} of {1} has expired", "WalReceiverTimeout", WalReceiverTimeout), Connector.Id);
					}
					await SendFeedback(waitOnSemaphore: true, requestReply: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private async void TimerSendFeedback(object? obj)
		{
			try
			{
				if (Connector.State == ConnectorState.Replication)
				{
					if (ReplicationLogger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace))
					{
						LogMessages.SendingReplicationStandbyStatusUpdate(ReplicationLogger, string.Format("{0} of {1} has expired", "WalReceiverStatusInterval", WalReceiverStatusInterval), Connector.Id);
					}
					await SendFeedback().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public Task DropReplicationSlot(string slotName, bool wait = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (slotName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("slotName");
			}
			CheckDisposed();
			return DropReplicationSlotInternal(slotName, wait, cancellationToken);
			async Task DropReplicationSlotInternal(string text2, bool flag, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				using (Connector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken2, _pgCancellationSupported))
				{
					string text = "DROP_REPLICATION_SLOT " + text2;
					if (flag)
					{
						text += " WAIT";
					}
					LogMessages.DroppingReplicationSlot(ReplicationLogger, text2, text, Connector.Id);
					await Connector.WriteQuery(text, async: true, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await Connector.Flush(async: true, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
					if (PostgreSqlVersion < FirstVersionWithoutDropSlotDoubleCommandCompleteMessage)
					{
						Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
					}
					Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task<object[]> ReadSingleRow(string command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckDisposed();
			using (Connector.StartUserAction(cancellationToken, _pgCancellationSupported))
			{
				LogMessages.ExecutingReplicationCommand(ReplicationLogger, command, Connector.Id);
				await Connector.WriteQuery(command, async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await Connector.Flush(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription = Statics.Expect<RowDescriptionMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
				Statics.Expect<DataRowMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
				NpgsqlReadBuffer buf = Connector.ReadBuffer;
				await buf.EnsureAsync(2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				object[] results = new object[buf.ReadInt16()];
				for (int i = 0; i < results.Length; i++)
				{
					await buf.EnsureAsync(4).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					int len = buf.ReadInt32();
					if (len == -1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					await buf.EnsureAsync(len).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					FieldDescription fieldDescription = rowDescription[i];
					switch (fieldDescription.PostgresType.Name)
					{
					case "text":
						results[i] = buf.ReadString(len);
						break;
					case "integer":
					case "bigint":
					{
						string text = buf.ReadString(len);
						if (!uint.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.None, null, out var result))
						{
							throw Connector.Break(new NpgsqlException("Could not parse '" + text + "' as unsigned integer in field " + fieldDescription.Name));
						}
						results[i] = result;
						break;
					}
					case "bytea":
						try
						{
							results[i] = ParseBytea(buf.ReadMemory(len).Span);
						}
						catch (Exception innerException)
						{
							throw Connector.Break(new NpgsqlException("Could not parse data as bytea in field " + fieldDescription.Name, innerException));
						}
						break;
					default:
						throw Connector.Break(new NpgsqlException("Field " + fieldDescription.Name + " has PostgreSQL type " + fieldDescription.PostgresType.Name + " which isn't supported yet"));
					}
				}
				Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
				Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await Connector.ReadMessage(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Connector);
				return results;
			}
			static byte[] ParseBytea(ReadOnlySpan<byte> bytes)
			{
				if (bytes.Length < 2 || bytes[0] != 92 || bytes[1] != 120)
				{
					return ParseByteaEscape(bytes);
				}
				return ParseByteaHex(bytes.Slice(2));
			}
			static byte[] ParseByteaEscape(ReadOnlySpan<byte> inBytes)
			{
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(new byte[inBytes.Length]);
				int num = 0;
				while (num < inBytes.Length)
				{
					byte b = inBytes[num];
					if (b != 92)
					{
						memoryStream.WriteByte(b);
						num++;
					}
					else
					{
						byte b2 = inBytes[num + 1];
						if (b2 == 92)
						{
							memoryStream.WriteByte(b2);
							num += 2;
						}
						else
						{
							byte b3 = inBytes[num + 2];
							byte b4 = inBytes[num + 3];
							if (b2 < 48 || b2 > 51 || b3 < 48 || b3 > 55 || b4 < 48 || b4 > 55)
							{
								throw new FormatException("Invalid syntax for type bytea");
							}
							b2 <<= 3;
							b2 += b3;
							b2 <<= 3;
							memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(b2 + b4));
							num += 4;
						}
					}
				}
				return memoryStream.ToArray();
			}
			static byte[] ParseByteaHex(ReadOnlySpan<byte> inBytes)
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[inBytes.Length / 2];
				for (int j = 0; j < inBytes.Length; j++)
				{
					byte b = inBytes[j++];
					byte b2 = inBytes[j];
					array[j / 2] = (byte)((b - ((b < 58) ? 48 : 87) << 4) | (b2 - ((b2 < 58) ? 48 : 87)));
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		private void SetTimeouts(TimeSpan readTimeout, TimeSpan writeTimeout)
		{
			NpgsqlConnector connector = Connector;
			NpgsqlReadBuffer readBuffer = connector.ReadBuffer;
			if (readBuffer != null)
			{
				readBuffer.Timeout = ((readTimeout > TimeSpan.Zero) ? readTimeout : TimeSpan.Zero);
			}
			NpgsqlWriteBuffer writeBuffer = connector.WriteBuffer;
			if (writeBuffer != null)
			{
				writeBuffer.Timeout = writeTimeout;
			}
		}

		internal void CheckDisposed()
		{
			if (_isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
			}
		}
	}

namespace Npgsql.Replication.TestDecoding

	internal sealed class TestDecodingAsyncEnumerable : IAsyncEnumerable<TestDecodingData>
	{
		private readonly LogicalReplicationConnection _connection;

		private readonly TestDecodingReplicationSlot _slot;

		private readonly TestDecodingOptions _options;

		private readonly CancellationToken _baseCancellationToken;

		private readonly NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber? _walLocation;

		private readonly TestDecodingData _cachedMessage = new TestDecodingData();

		internal TestDecodingAsyncEnumerable(LogicalReplicationConnection connection, TestDecodingReplicationSlot slot, TestDecodingOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken, NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber? walLocation = null)
		{
			_connection = connection;
			_slot = slot;
			_options = options;
			_baseCancellationToken = cancellationToken;
			_walLocation = walLocation;
		}

		public async IAsyncEnumerator<TestDecodingData> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			cancellationToken = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(_baseCancellationToken, cancellationToken).Token;
			IAsyncEnumerable<XLogDataMessage> source = _connection.StartLogicalReplication(_slot, cancellationToken, _walLocation, _options.GetOptionPairs());
			Encoding encoding = _connection.Encoding;
			byte[] buffer = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(4096);
			try
			{
				await foreach (XLogDataMessage msg in source.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
					int len = (int)msg.Data.Length;
					if (len > buffer.Length)
					{
						ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(buffer);
						buffer = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(len);
					}
					int num;
					for (int offset = 0; offset < len; offset += num)
					{
						num = await msg.Data.ReadAsync(buffer, offset, len - offset, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						if (num == 0)
						{
							throw new EndOfStreamException();
						}
					}
					string data = encoding.GetString(buffer, 0, len);
					yield return _cachedMessage.Populate(msg.WalStart, msg.WalEnd, msg.ServerClock, data);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(buffer);
			}
		}
	}

		}

	public class TestDecodingOptions : IEquatable<TestDecodingOptions>
	{
		public bool? IncludeXids { get; }

		public bool? IncludeTimestamp { get; }

		public bool? ForceBinary { get; }

		public bool? SkipEmptyXacts { get; }

		public bool? OnlyLocal { get; }

		public bool? IncludeRewrites { get; }

		public bool? StreamChanges { get; }

		public TestDecodingOptions(bool? includeXids = null, bool? includeTimestamp = null, bool? forceBinary = null, bool? skipEmptyXacts = null, bool? onlyLocal = null, bool? includeRewrites = null, bool? streamChanges = null)
		{
			IncludeXids = includeXids;
			IncludeTimestamp = includeTimestamp;
			ForceBinary = forceBinary;
			SkipEmptyXacts = skipEmptyXacts;
			OnlyLocal = onlyLocal;
			IncludeRewrites = includeRewrites;
			StreamChanges = streamChanges;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string?>> GetOptionPairs()
		{
			if (IncludeXids.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("include-xids", IncludeXids.Value ? null : "f");
			}
			if (IncludeTimestamp.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("include-timestamp", IncludeTimestamp.Value ? null : "f");
			}
			if (ForceBinary.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("force-binary", ForceBinary.Value ? "t" : "f");
			}
			if (SkipEmptyXacts.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("skip-empty-xacts", SkipEmptyXacts.Value ? null : "f");
			}
			if (OnlyLocal.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("only-local", OnlyLocal.Value ? null : "false");
			}
			if (IncludeRewrites.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("include-rewrites", IncludeRewrites.Value ? "t" : "f");
			}
			if (StreamChanges.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("stream-changes", StreamChanges.Value ? "t" : "f");
			}
		}

		public bool Equals(TestDecodingOptions? other)
		{
			if (other != null)
			{
				if (this != other)
				{
					if (IncludeXids == other.IncludeXids && IncludeTimestamp == other.IncludeTimestamp && ForceBinary == other.ForceBinary && SkipEmptyXacts == other.SkipEmptyXacts && OnlyLocal == other.OnlyLocal && IncludeRewrites == other.IncludeRewrites)
					{
						return StreamChanges == other.StreamChanges;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is TestDecodingOptions testDecodingOptions)
			{
				return testDecodingOptions.Equals(this);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (((((((((((IncludeXids.GetHashCode() * 397) ^ IncludeTimestamp.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ ForceBinary.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ SkipEmptyXacts.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ OnlyLocal.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ IncludeRewrites.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ StreamChanges.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class TestDecodingReplicationSlot : LogicalReplicationSlot

			: this(new ReplicationSlotOptions(slotName))
		{
		}

		public TestDecodingReplicationSlot(ReplicationSlotOptions options)
			: base("test_decoding", options)
		{
		}
	}

namespace Npgsql.Replication.PgOutput
{
	internal sealed class PgOutputAsyncEnumerable : IAsyncEnumerable<PgOutputReplicationMessage>
	{
		private enum BackendReplicationMessageCode : byte
		{
			Begin = 66,
			Message = 77,
			Commit = 67,
			Origin = 79,
			Relation = 82,
			Type = 89,
			Insert = 73,
			Update = 85,
			Delete = 68,
			Truncate = 84,
			StreamStart = 83,
			StreamStop = 69,
			StreamCommit = 99,
			StreamAbort = 65,
			BeginPrepare = 98,
			Prepare = 80,
			CommitPrepared = 75,
			RollbackPrepared = 114,
			StreamPrepare = 112
		}

		private readonly LogicalReplicationConnection _connection;

		private readonly PgOutputReplicationSlot _slot;

		private readonly PgOutputReplicationOptions _options;

		private readonly CancellationToken _baseCancellationToken;

		private readonly NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber? _walLocation;

		private readonly BeginMessage _beginMessage = new BeginMessage();

		private readonly LogicalDecodingMessage _logicalDecodingMessage = new LogicalDecodingMessage();

		private readonly CommitMessage _commitMessage = new CommitMessage();

		private readonly OriginMessage _originMessage = new OriginMessage();

		private readonly Dictionary<uint, RelationMessage> _relations = new Dictionary<uint, RelationMessage>();

		private readonly TypeMessage _typeMessage = new TypeMessage();

		private readonly InsertMessage _insertMessage;

		private readonly DefaultUpdateMessage _defaultUpdateMessage;

		private readonly FullUpdateMessage _fullUpdateMessage;

		private readonly IndexUpdateMessage _indexUpdateMessage;

		private readonly FullDeleteMessage _fullDeleteMessage;

		private readonly KeyDeleteMessage _keyDeleteMessage;

		private readonly TruncateMessage _truncateMessage = new TruncateMessage();

		private readonly ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<RelationMessage> _truncateMessageRelations = new ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<RelationMessage>();

		private readonly StreamStartMessage _streamStartMessage = new StreamStartMessage();

		private readonly StreamStopMessage _streamStopMessage = new StreamStopMessage();

		private readonly StreamCommitMessage _streamCommitMessage = new StreamCommitMessage();

		private readonly StreamAbortMessage _streamAbortMessage = new StreamAbortMessage();

		private readonly BeginPrepareMessage _beginPrepareMessage = new BeginPrepareMessage();

		private readonly PrepareMessage _prepareMessage = new PrepareMessage();

		private readonly CommitPreparedMessage _commitPreparedMessage = new CommitPreparedMessage();

		private readonly RollbackPreparedMessage _rollbackPreparedMessage = new RollbackPreparedMessage();

		private readonly StreamPrepareMessage _streamPrepareMessage = new StreamPrepareMessage();

		internal PgOutputAsyncEnumerable(LogicalReplicationConnection connection, PgOutputReplicationSlot slot, PgOutputReplicationOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken, NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber? walLocation = null)
		{
			_connection = connection;
			_slot = slot;
			_options = options;
			_baseCancellationToken = cancellationToken;
			_walLocation = walLocation;
			NpgsqlConnector connector = _connection.Connector;
			_insertMessage = new InsertMessage(connector);
			_defaultUpdateMessage = new DefaultUpdateMessage(connector);
			_fullUpdateMessage = new FullUpdateMessage(connector);
			_indexUpdateMessage = new IndexUpdateMessage(connector);
			_fullDeleteMessage = new FullDeleteMessage(connector);
			_keyDeleteMessage = new KeyDeleteMessage(connector);
		}

		public IAsyncEnumerator<PgOutputReplicationMessage> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return StartReplicationInternal(CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(_baseCancellationToken, cancellationToken).Token);
		}

		private async IAsyncEnumerator<PgOutputReplicationMessage> StartReplicationInternal(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			IAsyncEnumerable<XLogDataMessage> source = _connection.StartLogicalReplication(_slot, cancellationToken, _walLocation, _options.GetOptionPairs(), bypassingStream: true);
			NpgsqlReadBuffer buf = _connection.Connector.ReadBuffer;
			bool inStreamingTransaction = false;
			DataFormat dataFormat = ((_options.Binary != true) ? DataFormat.Text : DataFormat.Binary);
			await foreach (XLogDataMessage xLogData in source.WithCancellation(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
			{
				await buf.EnsureAsync(1).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				BackendReplicationMessageCode backendReplicationMessageCode = (BackendReplicationMessageCode)buf.ReadByte();
				switch (backendReplicationMessageCode)
				{
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Begin:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(20).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _beginMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc), buf.ReadUInt32());
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Message:
				{
					uint? transactionXid;
					if (inStreamingTransaction)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(14).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid = buf.ReadUInt32();
					}
					else
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(10).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid = null;
					}
					byte flags2 = buf.ReadByte();
					NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber messageLsn = new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64());
					string prefix = await buf.ReadNullTerminatedString(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await buf.EnsureAsync(4).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					uint num5 = buf.ReadUInt32();
					NpgsqlReadBuffer.ColumnStream data = (NpgsqlReadBuffer.ColumnStream)xLogData.Data;
					data.Init(checked((int)num5), canSeek: false, commandScoped: false);
					yield return _logicalDecodingMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid, flags2, messageLsn, prefix, data);
					await data.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					break;
				}
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Commit:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(25).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _commitMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, (CommitMessage.CommitFlags)buf.ReadByte(), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc));
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Origin:
				{
					await buf.EnsureAsync(9).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					OriginMessage originMessage = _originMessage;
					NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber messageLsn = xLogData.WalStart;
					NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber walEnd = xLogData.WalEnd;
					DateTime serverClock = xLogData.ServerClock;
					NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber originCommitLsn = new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64());
					yield return originMessage.Populate(messageLsn, walEnd, serverClock, originCommitLsn, await buf.ReadNullTerminatedString(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
					break;
				}
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Relation:
				{
					uint? transactionXid;
					if (inStreamingTransaction)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(10).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid = buf.ReadUInt32();
					}
					else
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(6).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid = null;
					}
					uint relationId = buf.ReadUInt32();
					string prefix = await buf.ReadNullTerminatedString(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					string relationName = await buf.ReadNullTerminatedString(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await buf.EnsureAsync(3).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					RelationMessage.ReplicaIdentitySetting relationReplicaIdentitySetting = (RelationMessage.ReplicaIdentitySetting)buf.ReadByte();
					ushort numColumns4 = buf.ReadUInt16();
					if (!_relations.TryGetValue(relationId, out var msg))
					{
						RelationMessage relationMessage = (_relations[relationId] = new RelationMessage());
						msg = relationMessage;
					}
					msg.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid, relationId, prefix, relationName, relationReplicaIdentitySetting);
					ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<RelationMessage.Column> columns = msg.InternalColumns;
					columns.Count = numColumns4;
					for (int i = 0; i < numColumns4; i++)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						RelationMessage.Column.ColumnFlags flags = (RelationMessage.Column.ColumnFlags)buf.ReadByte();
						string columnName = await buf.ReadNullTerminatedString(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						await buf.EnsureAsync(8).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						uint dataTypeId = buf.ReadUInt32();
						int typeModifier = buf.ReadInt32();
						columns[i] = new RelationMessage.Column(flags, columnName, dataTypeId, typeModifier);
					}
					msg.RowDescription = RowDescriptionMessage.CreateForReplication(_connection.Connector.SerializerOptions, relationId, dataFormat, columns);
					yield return msg;
					break;
				}
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Type:
				{
					uint? transactionXid;
					if (inStreamingTransaction)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(9).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid = buf.ReadUInt32();
					}
					else
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(5).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid = null;
					}
					uint relationId = buf.ReadUInt32();
					string relationName = await buf.ReadNullTerminatedString(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					string name = await buf.ReadNullTerminatedString(async: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _typeMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid, relationId, relationName, name);
					break;
				}
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Insert:
				{
					uint? transactionXid3;
					if (inStreamingTransaction)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(11).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid3 = buf.ReadUInt32();
					}
					else
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(7).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid3 = null;
					}
					uint num3 = buf.ReadUInt32();
					buf.ReadByte();
					ushort numColumns2 = buf.ReadUInt16();
					if (!_relations.TryGetValue(num3, out var value3))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException($"Could not find previous Relation message for relation ID {num3} when processing Insert message");
					}
					yield return _insertMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid3, value3, numColumns2);
					await _insertMessage.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					break;
				}
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Update:
				{
					uint? transactionXid2;
					if (inStreamingTransaction)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(11).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid2 = buf.ReadUInt32();
					}
					else
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(7).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid2 = null;
					}
					uint num2 = buf.ReadUInt32();
					TupleType tupleType = (TupleType)buf.ReadByte();
					ushort numColumns = buf.ReadUInt16();
					if (!_relations.TryGetValue(num2, out var value2))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException($"Could not find previous Relation message for relation ID {num2} when processing Update message");
					}
					switch (tupleType)
					{
					case TupleType.Key:
						yield return _indexUpdateMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid2, value2, numColumns);
						await _indexUpdateMessage.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						break;
					case TupleType.OldTuple:
						yield return _fullUpdateMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid2, value2, numColumns);
						await _fullUpdateMessage.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						break;
					case TupleType.NewTuple:
						yield return _defaultUpdateMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid2, value2, numColumns);
						await _defaultUpdateMessage.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						break;
					default:
						throw new NotSupportedException($"The tuple type '{tupleType}' is not supported.");
					}
					break;
				}
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Delete:
				{
					uint? transactionXid4;
					if (inStreamingTransaction)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(11).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid4 = buf.ReadUInt32();
					}
					else
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(7).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid4 = null;
					}
					uint num4 = buf.ReadUInt32();
					TupleType tupleType2 = (TupleType)buf.ReadByte();
					ushort numColumns3 = buf.ReadUInt16();
					if (!_relations.TryGetValue(num4, out var value4))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException($"Could not find previous Relation message for relation ID {num4} when processing Update message");
					}
					switch (tupleType2)
					{
					case TupleType.Key:
						yield return _keyDeleteMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid4, value4, numColumns3);
						await _keyDeleteMessage.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						break;
					case TupleType.OldTuple:
						yield return _fullDeleteMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid4, value4, numColumns3);
						await _fullDeleteMessage.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						break;
					default:
						throw new NotSupportedException($"The tuple type '{tupleType2}' is not supported.");
					}
					break;
				}
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Truncate:
				{
					uint? transactionXid;
					if (inStreamingTransaction)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(9).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid = buf.ReadUInt32();
					}
					else
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(5).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						transactionXid = null;
					}
					int i = checked((int)buf.ReadUInt32());
					TruncateMessage.TruncateOptions truncateOptions = (TruncateMessage.TruncateOptions)buf.ReadByte();
					_truncateMessageRelations.Count = i;
					for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
					{
						await buf.EnsureAsync(4).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						uint num = buf.ReadUInt32();
						if (!_relations.TryGetValue(num, out var value))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException($"Could not find previous Relation message for relation ID {num} when processing Update message");
						}
						_truncateMessageRelations[j] = value;
					}
					yield return _truncateMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, transactionXid, truncateOptions, _truncateMessageRelations);
					break;
				}
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.StreamStart:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(5).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					inStreamingTransaction = true;
					yield return _streamStartMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadByte());
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.StreamStop:
					inStreamingTransaction = false;
					yield return _streamStopMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock);
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.StreamCommit:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(29).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _streamCommitMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadByte(), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc));
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.StreamAbort:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(8).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _streamAbortMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadUInt32());
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.BeginPrepare:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(29).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _beginPrepareMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc), buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadNullTerminatedString());
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.Prepare:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(30).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _prepareMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, (PrepareMessage.PrepareFlags)buf.ReadByte(), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc), buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadNullTerminatedString());
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.CommitPrepared:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(30).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _commitPreparedMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, (CommitPreparedMessage.CommitPreparedFlags)buf.ReadByte(), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc), buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadNullTerminatedString());
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.RollbackPrepared:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(38).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _rollbackPreparedMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, (RollbackPreparedMessage.RollbackPreparedFlags)buf.ReadByte(), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc), buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadNullTerminatedString());
					break;
				case BackendReplicationMessageCode.StreamPrepare:
					await buf.EnsureAsync(30).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					yield return _streamPrepareMessage.Populate(xLogData.WalStart, xLogData.WalEnd, xLogData.ServerClock, (StreamPrepareMessage.StreamPrepareFlags)buf.ReadByte(), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), new NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber(buf.ReadUInt64()), PgDateTime.DecodeTimestamp(buf.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc), buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadNullTerminatedString());
					break;
				default:
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Invalid message code {backendReplicationMessageCode} in Logical Replication Protocol.");
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class PgOutputReplicationOptions : IEquatable<PgOutputReplicationOptions>
	{
		public ulong ProtocolVersion { get; }

		public List<string> PublicationNames { get; }

		public bool? Binary { get; }

		public bool? Streaming { get; }

		public bool? Messages { get; }

		public bool? TwoPhase { get; }

		public PgOutputReplicationOptions(string publicationName, ulong protocolVersion, bool? binary = null, bool? streaming = null, bool? messages = null, bool? twoPhase = null)
			: this(new List<string> { publicationName ?? throw new ArgumentNullException("publicationName") }, protocolVersion, binary, streaming, messages, twoPhase)
		{
		}

		public PgOutputReplicationOptions(IEnumerable<string> publicationNames, ulong protocolVersion, bool? binary = null, bool? streaming = null, bool? messages = null, bool? twoPhase = null)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(publicationNames);
			if (list.Count < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("You have to pass at least one publication name.", "publicationNames");
			}
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item))
				{
					throw (item == null) ? new ArgumentNullException("publicationName") : new ArgumentException("Invalid publication name", "publicationName");
				}
			}
			PublicationNames = list;
			ProtocolVersion = protocolVersion;
			Binary = binary;
			Streaming = streaming;
			Messages = messages;
			TwoPhase = twoPhase;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string?>> GetOptionPairs()
		{
			yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("proto_version", ProtocolVersion.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("publication_names", "\"" + string.Join("\",\"", PublicationNames) + "\"");
			if (Binary.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("binary", Binary.Value ? "on" : "off");
			}
			if (Streaming.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("streaming", Streaming.Value ? "on" : "off");
			}
			if (Messages.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("messages", Messages.Value ? "on" : "off");
			}
			if (TwoPhase.HasValue)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<string, string>("two_phase", TwoPhase.Value ? "on" : "off");
			}
		}

		public bool Equals(PgOutputReplicationOptions? other)
		{
			if (other != null)
			{
				if (this != other)
				{
					if (ProtocolVersion == other.ProtocolVersion && PublicationNames.Equals(other.PublicationNames) && Binary == other.Binary && Streaming == other.Streaming && Messages == other.Messages)
					{
						return TwoPhase == other.TwoPhase;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is PgOutputReplicationOptions pgOutputReplicationOptions)
			{
				return pgOutputReplicationOptions.Equals(this);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (((((((((ProtocolVersion.GetHashCode() * 397) ^ PublicationNames.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ Binary.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ Streaming.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ Messages.GetHashCode()) * 397) ^ TwoPhase.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class PgOutputReplicationSlot : LogicalReplicationSlot
	{
		public PgOutputReplicationSlot(string slotName)
			: this(new ReplicationSlotOptions(slotName))
		{
		}

		public PgOutputReplicationSlot(ReplicationSlotOptions options)
			: base("pgoutput", options)
		{
		}

		protected PgOutputReplicationSlot(PgOutputReplicationSlot slot)
			: base(slot.OutputPlugin, new ReplicationSlotOptions(slot.Name, slot.ConsistentPoint, slot.SnapshotName))
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<T> : IReadOnlyList<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IReadOnlyCollection<T>
	{
		public static readonly ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<T> Empty = new ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<T>();

		private T[] _items;

		private int _size;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				return _size;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (_items.Length < value)
				{
					_items = new T[value];
				}
				_size = value;
			}
		}

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index >= _size)
				{
					throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
				}
				return _items[index];
			}
			internal set
			{
				_items[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public ReadOnlyArrayBuffer()
		{
			_items = Array.Empty<T>();
		}

		private ReadOnlyArrayBuffer(T[] items)
		{
			_items = items;
			_size = items.Length;
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _size; i++)
			{
				yield return _items[i];
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<T> Clone()
		{
			T[] array = new T[_size];
			if (_size > 0)
			{
				Array.Copy(_items, array, _size);
			}
			return new ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<T>(array);
		}
	}
	public class ReplicationTuple : IAsyncEnumerable<ReplicationValue>
	{
		private protected readonly NpgsqlReadBuffer ReadBuffer;

		private readonly TupleEnumerator _tupleEnumerator;

		internal RowState State;

		private RowDescriptionMessage _rowDescription;

		public ushort NumColumns { get; private set; }

		internal ReplicationTuple(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			NpgsqlReadBuffer readBuffer = connector.ReadBuffer;
			TupleEnumerator tupleEnumerator = new TupleEnumerator(this, connector);
			ReadBuffer = readBuffer;
			_tupleEnumerator = tupleEnumerator;
		}

		internal void Reset(ushort numColumns, RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription)
		{
			State = RowState.NotRead;
			ushort numColumns2 = numColumns;
			NumColumns = numColumns2;
			_rowDescription = rowDescription;
		}

		public virtual IAsyncEnumerator<ReplicationValue> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			switch (State)
			{
			case RowState.NotRead:
				_tupleEnumerator.Reset(NumColumns, _rowDescription, cancellationToken);
				State = RowState.Reading;
				return _tupleEnumerator;
			case RowState.Reading:
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The row is already been read.");
			case RowState.Consumed:
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The row has already been consumed.");
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}

		internal async Task Consume(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			switch (State)
			{
			case RowState.NotRead:
				State = RowState.Reading;
				_tupleEnumerator.Reset(NumColumns, _rowDescription, cancellationToken);
				while (await _tupleEnumerator.MoveNextAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
				}
				break;
			case RowState.Reading:
				while (await _tupleEnumerator.MoveNextAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
				}
				break;
			case RowState.Consumed:
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum RowState
	{
		NotRead,
		Reading,
		Consumed
	}
	public class ReplicationValue
	{
		private readonly NpgsqlReadBuffer _readBuffer;

		private FieldDescription _fieldDescription;

		private ColumnInfo _lastInfo;

		private bool _isConsumed;

		public int Length { get; private set; }

		public TupleDataKind Kind { get; private set; }

		private PgReader PgReader => _readBuffer.PgReader;

		public bool IsDBNull => Kind == TupleDataKind.Null;

		public bool IsUnchangedToastedValue => Kind == TupleDataKind.UnchangedToastedValue;

		internal ReplicationValue(NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			_readBuffer = connector.ReadBuffer;
		}

		internal void Reset(TupleDataKind kind, int length, FieldDescription fieldDescription)
		{
			Kind = kind;
			Length = length;
			_fieldDescription = fieldDescription;
			_lastInfo = default(ColumnInfo);
			_isConsumed = false;
		}

		public PostgresType GetPostgresType()
		{
			return _fieldDescription.PostgresType;
		}

		public string GetDataTypeName()
		{
			return _fieldDescription.TypeDisplayName;
		}

		public Type GetFieldType()
		{
			return _fieldDescription.FieldType;
		}

		public async ValueTask<T> Get<T>(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			CheckActive();
			_fieldDescription.GetInfo(typeof(T), ref _lastInfo);
			ColumnInfo info = _lastInfo;
			switch (Kind)
			{
			case TupleDataKind.Null:
				if (default(T) == null && typeof(T).IsValueType)
				{
					return default(T);
				}
				if (typeof(T) == typeof(object))
				{
					return (T)(object)DBNull.Value;
				}
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue(_fieldDescription);
				break;
			case TupleDataKind.UnchangedToastedValue:
				throw new InvalidCastException("Column '" + _fieldDescription.Name + "' is an unchanged TOASTed value (actual value not sent).");
			}
			using (_readBuffer.Connector.StartNestedCancellableOperation(cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				PgReader reader = PgReader.Init(Length, _fieldDescription.DataFormat);
				await reader.StartReadAsync(info.ConverterInfo.BufferRequirement, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				T val = ((!info.AsObject) ? (await info.ConverterInfo.Converter.UnsafeDowncast<T>().ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)) : ((T)(await info.ConverterInfo.Converter.ReadAsObjectAsync(reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))));
				T result = val;
				await reader.EndReadAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				return result;
			}
		}

		public ValueTask<object> Get(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Get<object>(cancellationToken);
		}

		public Stream GetStream()
		{
			CheckActive();
			switch (Kind)
			{
			case TupleDataKind.Null:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue(_fieldDescription);
				break;
			case TupleDataKind.UnchangedToastedValue:
				throw new InvalidCastException("Column '" + _fieldDescription.Name + "' is an unchanged TOASTed value (actual value not sent).");
			}
			return _readBuffer.PgReader.Init(Length, _fieldDescription.DataFormat).GetStream(canSeek: false);
		}

		public TextReader GetTextReader()
		{
			CheckActive();
			ref ColumnInfo lastInfo = ref _lastInfo;
			_fieldDescription.GetInfo(typeof(TextReader), ref lastInfo);
			switch (Kind)
			{
			case TupleDataKind.Null:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException_NoValue(_fieldDescription);
				break;
			case TupleDataKind.UnchangedToastedValue:
				throw new InvalidCastException("Column '" + _fieldDescription.Name + "' is an unchanged TOASTed value (actual value not sent).");
			}
			PgReader pgReader = PgReader.Init(Length, _fieldDescription.DataFormat);
			pgReader.StartRead(lastInfo.ConverterInfo.BufferRequirement);
			TextReader result = (TextReader)lastInfo.ConverterInfo.Converter.ReadAsObject(pgReader);
			pgReader.EndRead();
			return result;
		}

		internal async Task Consume(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!_isConsumed)
			{
				if (!PgReader.Initialized)
				{
					PgReader.Init(Length, _fieldDescription.DataFormat);
				}
				await PgReader.ConsumeAsync(null, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await PgReader.CommitAsync(resuming: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				_isConsumed = true;
			}
		}

		private void CheckActive()
		{
			if (PgReader.Initialized)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Column has already been consumed");
			}
		}
	}
	public enum TupleDataKind : byte
	{
		Null = 110,
		UnchangedToastedValue = 117,
		TextValue = 116,
		BinaryValue = 98
	}
	internal sealed class TupleEnumerator : IAsyncEnumerator<ReplicationValue>, IAsyncDisposable
	{
		private readonly ReplicationTuple _tupleEnumerable;

		private readonly NpgsqlReadBuffer _readBuffer;

		private readonly ReplicationValue _value;

		private ushort _numColumns;

		private int _pos;

		private RowDescriptionMessage _rowDescription;

		private CancellationToken _cancellationToken;

		public ReplicationValue Current => _tupleEnumerable.State switch
		{
			RowState.NotRead => throw new ObjectDisposedException(null), 
			RowState.Reading => _value, 
			RowState.Consumed => throw new ObjectDisposedException(null), 
			_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(), 
		};

		internal TupleEnumerator(ReplicationTuple tupleEnumerable, NpgsqlConnector connector)
		{
			_tupleEnumerable = tupleEnumerable;
			_readBuffer = connector.ReadBuffer;
			_value = new ReplicationValue(connector);
		}

		internal void Reset(ushort numColumns, RowDescriptionMessage rowDescription, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			_pos = -1;
			_numColumns = numColumns;
			_rowDescription = rowDescription;
			_cancellationToken = cancellationToken;
		}

		public ValueTask<bool> MoveNextAsync()
		{
			if (_tupleEnumerable.State != RowState.Reading)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(null);
			}
			return MoveNextCore();
			async ValueTask<bool> MoveNextCore()
			{
				if (_pos != -1)
				{
					await _value.Consume(_cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				if (_pos + 1 == _numColumns)
				{
					return false;
				}
				_pos++;
				await _readBuffer.Ensure(1, async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				TupleDataKind kind = (TupleDataKind)_readBuffer.ReadByte();
				int length;
				switch (kind)
				{
				case TupleDataKind.Null:
				case TupleDataKind.UnchangedToastedValue:
					length = 0;
					break;
				case TupleDataKind.BinaryValue:
				case TupleDataKind.TextValue:
					await _readBuffer.Ensure(4, async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					length = _readBuffer.ReadInt32();
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				_value.Reset(kind, length, _rowDescription[_pos]);
				return true;
			}
		}

		public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			if (_tupleEnumerable.State == RowState.Reading)
			{
				while (await MoveNextAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
				}
			}
			_tupleEnumerable.State = RowState.Consumed;
		}
	}
	internal enum TupleType : byte
	{
		Key = 75,
		NewTuple = 78,
		OldTuple = 79
	}
}

	public sealed class RelationMessage : TransactionalMessage
	{
		public readonly struct Column
		{
			[Flags]
			public enum ColumnFlags
			{
				None = 0,
				PartOfKey = 1
			}

			public ColumnFlags Flags { get; }

			public string ColumnName { get; }

			public uint DataTypeId { get; }

			public int TypeModifier { get; }

			internal Column(ColumnFlags flags, string columnName, uint dataTypeId, int typeModifier)
			{
				Flags = flags;
				ColumnName = columnName;
				DataTypeId = dataTypeId;
				TypeModifier = typeModifier;
			}
		}

		public enum ReplicaIdentitySetting : byte
		{
			Default = 100,
			Nothing = 110,
			AllColumns = 102,
			IndexWithIndIsReplIdent = 105
		}

		public uint RelationId { get; private set; }

		public string Namespace { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

		public string RelationName { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

		public ReplicaIdentitySetting ReplicaIdentity { get; private set; }

		public IReadOnlyList<Column> Columns => InternalColumns;

		internal ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<Column> InternalColumns { get; } = new ReadOnlyArrayBuffer<Column>();

		internal RowDescriptionMessage RowDescription { get; set; }

	public abstract class UpdateMessage : TransactionalMessage
	{
		private protected sealed class SecondRowTupleEnumerable : ReplicationTuple
		{
			private readonly ReplicationTuple _oldRowTupleEnumerable;

			internal SecondRowTupleEnumerable(NpgsqlConnector connector, ReplicationTuple oldRowTupleEnumerable)
				: base(connector)
			{
				_oldRowTupleEnumerable = oldRowTupleEnumerable;
			}

			public override async IAsyncEnumerator<ReplicationValue> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
			{
				IAsyncEnumerator<ReplicationValue> enumerator = base.GetAsyncEnumerator(cancellationToken);
				await _oldRowTupleEnumerable.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await ReadBuffer.EnsureAsync(3).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				ReadBuffer.ReadByte();
				ReadBuffer.ReadUInt16();
				while (await enumerator.MoveNextAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
					yield return enumerator.Current;
				}
			}

			internal new async Task Consume(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				if (State == RowState.NotRead)
				{
					await _oldRowTupleEnumerable.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await ReadBuffer.EnsureAsync(3).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					ReadBuffer.ReadByte();
					ReadBuffer.ReadUInt16();
				}
				await base.Consume(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
		}

		public RelationMessage Relation { get; private set; }

		public abstract ReplicationTuple NewRow { get; }

		internal UpdateMessage()
		{
		}

		internal UpdateMessage Populate(NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber walStart, NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber walEnd, DateTime serverClock, uint? transactionXid, RelationMessage relation)
		{
			Populate(walStart, walEnd, serverClock, transactionXid);
			Relation = relation;
			return this;
		}
	}

	public static class LogicalReplicationConnectionExtensions
	{
		public static Task<ReplicationSlotOptions> CreateLogicalReplicationSlot(this LogicalReplicationConnection connection, string slotName, string outputPlugin, bool isTemporary = false, LogicalSlotSnapshotInitMode? slotSnapshotInitMode = null, bool twoPhase = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			connection.CheckDisposed();
			if (slotName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("slotName");
			}
			if (outputPlugin == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("outputPlugin");
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("CREATE_REPLICATION_SLOT ").Append(slotName);
			if (isTemporary)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" TEMPORARY");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(" LOGICAL ").Append(outputPlugin);
			if (connection.PostgreSqlVersion.Major >= 15 && (slotSnapshotInitMode.HasValue || twoPhase))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append('(');
				if (slotSnapshotInitMode.HasValue)
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = stringBuilder;
					stringBuilder2.Append(slotSnapshotInitMode switch
					{
						LogicalSlotSnapshotInitMode.Export => "SNAPSHOT 'export'", 
						LogicalSlotSnapshotInitMode.Use => "SNAPSHOT 'use'", 
						LogicalSlotSnapshotInitMode.NoExport => "SNAPSHOT 'nothing'", 
						_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("slotSnapshotInitMode", slotSnapshotInitMode, string.Format("Unexpected value {0} for argument {1}.", slotSnapshotInitMode, "slotSnapshotInitMode")), 
					});
					if (twoPhase)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(",TWO_PHASE");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("TWO_PHASE");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(')');
			}
			else
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = stringBuilder;
				stringBuilder2.Append(slotSnapshotInitMode switch
				{
					null => string.Empty, 
					LogicalSlotSnapshotInitMode.Export => " EXPORT_SNAPSHOT", 
					LogicalSlotSnapshotInitMode.Use => " USE_SNAPSHOT", 
					LogicalSlotSnapshotInitMode.NoExport => " NOEXPORT_SNAPSHOT", 
					_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("slotSnapshotInitMode", slotSnapshotInitMode, string.Format("Unexpected value {0} for argument {1}.", slotSnapshotInitMode, "slotSnapshotInitMode")), 
				});
				if (twoPhase)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" TWO_PHASE");
				}
			}
			string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
			LogMessages.CreatingReplicationSlot(connection.ReplicationLogger, slotName, text, connection.Connector.Id);
			return connection.CreateReplicationSlot(text, cancellationToken);
		}

		public static IAsyncEnumerable<XLogDataMessage> StartLogicalReplication(this LogicalReplicationConnection connection, LogicalReplicationSlot slot, CancellationToken cancellationToken, NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber? walLocation = null, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string?>>? options = null, bool bypassingStream = false)
		{
			return StartLogicalReplicationInternal(connection, slot, cancellationToken, walLocation, options, bypassingStream);
			static async IAsyncEnumerable<XLogDataMessage> StartLogicalReplicationInternal(LogicalReplicationConnection logicalReplicationConnection, LogicalReplicationSlot logicalReplicationSlot, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken2, NpgsqlLogSequenceNumber? npgsqlLogSequenceNumber, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string?>>? enumerable, bool bypassingStream2)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("START_REPLICATION ").Append("SLOT ").Append(logicalReplicationSlot.Name).Append(" LOGICAL ")
					.Append(npgsqlLogSequenceNumber ?? logicalReplicationSlot.ConsistentPoint);
				List<KeyValuePair<string, string>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<string, string>>(enumerable ?? Array.Empty<KeyValuePair<string, string>>());
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" (");
					string[] array = new string[list.Count];
					for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
					{
						KeyValuePair<string, string> keyValuePair = list[i];
						array[i] = "\"" + keyValuePair.Key + "\"" + ((keyValuePair.Value == null) ? "" : (" '" + keyValuePair.Value + "'"));
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(string.Join(", ", array));
					stringBuilder.Append(')');
				}
				string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
				LogMessages.StartingLogicalReplication(logicalReplicationConnection.ReplicationLogger, logicalReplicationSlot.Name, text, logicalReplicationConnection.Connector.Id);
				IAsyncEnumerator<XLogDataMessage> enumerator = logicalReplicationConnection.StartReplicationInternalWrapper(text, bypassingStream2, cancellationToken2);
				while (await enumerator.MoveNextAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
					yield return enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		internal override string GetPartialNameWithFacets(int typeModifier)
		{
			PostgresFacets facets = GetFacets(typeModifier);
			if (facets == PostgresFacets.None)
			{
				return base.Name;
			}
			switch (base.Name)
			{
			case "timestamp without time zone":
				return $"timestamp{facets} without time zone";
			case "time without time zone":
				return $"time{facets} without time zone";
			case "timestamp with time zone":
				return $"timestamp{facets} with time zone";
			case "time with time zone":
				return $"time{facets} with time zone";
			case "character":
				if (facets.Size == 1)
				{
					return "character";
				}
				break;
			}
			return $"{base.Name}{facets}";
		}

		internal override PostgresFacets GetFacets(int typeModifier)
		{
			if (typeModifier == -1)
			{
				return PostgresFacets.None;
			}
			switch (base.Name)
			{
			case "character":
				return new PostgresFacets(typeModifier - 4, null, null);
			case "character varying":
				return new PostgresFacets(typeModifier - 4, null, null);
			case "decimal":
			case "numeric":
			{
				int value = (typeModifier - 4 >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
				int num = (typeModifier - 4) & 0xFFFF;
				return new PostgresFacets(null, value, (num == 0) ? ((int?)null) : new int?(num));
			}
			case "timestamp without time zone":
			case "time without time zone":
			case "interval":
			{
				int value = typeModifier & 0xFFFF;
				return new PostgresFacets(null, value, null);
			}
			case "timestamp with time zone":
			{
				int value = typeModifier & 0xFFFF;
				return new PostgresFacets(null, value, null);
			}
			case "time with time zone":
			{
				int value = typeModifier & 0xFFFF;
				return new PostgresFacets(null, value, null);
			}
			case "bit":
			case "bit varying":
				return new PostgresFacets(typeModifier, null, null);
			default:
				return PostgresFacets.None;
			}
		}

	internal readonly struct PostgresFacets : IEquatable<PostgresFacets>
	{
		internal static readonly PostgresFacets None = new PostgresFacets(null, null, null);

		public readonly int? Size;

		public readonly int? Precision;

		public readonly int? Scale;

		internal PostgresFacets(int? size, int? precision, int? scale)
		{
			Size = size;
			Precision = precision;
			Scale = scale;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? o)
		{
			if (o is PostgresFacets o2)
			{
				return Equals(o2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(PostgresFacets o)
		{
			if (Size == o.Size && Precision == o.Precision)
			{
				return Scale == o.Scale;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(PostgresFacets x, PostgresFacets y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(PostgresFacets x, PostgresFacets y)
		{
			return !(x == y);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ((((Size?.GetHashCode() ?? 0) * 397) ^ (Precision?.GetHashCode() ?? 0)) * 397) ^ (Scale?.GetHashCode() ?? 0);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!Size.HasValue && !Precision.HasValue && !Scale.HasValue)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder().Append('(');
			bool flag = false;
			if (Size.HasValue)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Size);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (Precision.HasValue)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Precision);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (Scale.HasValue)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Scale);
			}
			return stringBuilder.Append(')').ToString();
		}
	}
