	public abstract class PostgresType
	{
		private PostgresType? _representationalType;

		public uint OID { get; }

		public string Namespace => DataTypeName.Schema;

		public string Name => DataTypeName.UnqualifiedDisplayName;

		public string FullName { get; }

		internal DataTypeName DataTypeName { get; }

		public string DisplayName => DataTypeName.DisplayName;

		public string InternalName => DataTypeName.UnqualifiedName;

		public PostgresArrayType? Array { get; internal set; }

		public PostgresRangeType? Range { get; internal set; }

		private protected PostgresType(string ns, string name, uint oid)
		{
			DataTypeName = DataTypeName.FromDisplayName(name, ns);
			OID = oid;
			FullName = Namespace + "." + Name;
		}

		private protected PostgresType(DataTypeName dataTypeName, Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid oid)
		{
			DataTypeName = dataTypeName;
			OID = oid.Value;
			FullName = Namespace + "." + Name;
		}

		internal virtual string GetPartialNameWithFacets(int typeModifier)
		{
			return Name;
		}

		internal string GetDisplayNameWithFacets(int typeModifier)
		{
			if (!(Namespace == "pg_catalog"))
			{
				return Namespace + "." + GetPartialNameWithFacets(typeModifier);
			}
			return GetPartialNameWithFacets(typeModifier);
		}

		internal virtual PostgresFacets GetFacets(int typeModifier)
		{
			return PostgresFacets.None;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return DisplayName;
		}

		internal PostgresType GetRepresentationalType()
		{
			PostgresType postgresType = _representationalType;
			if (postgresType == null)
			{
				PostgresType? obj = Core(this) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Couldn't map type to representational type");
				PostgresType postgresType2 = obj;
				_representationalType = obj;
				postgresType = postgresType2;
			}
			return postgresType;
			static PostgresType? Core(PostgresType? postgresType4)
			{
				PostgresType postgresType3 = (postgresType4 as PostgresDomainType)?.BaseType;
				PostgresType postgresType5;
				if (postgresType3 == null)
				{
					if (postgresType4 is PostgresArrayType postgresArrayType)
					{
						if (!(postgresArrayType.Element is PostgresDomainType postgresDomainType))
						{
							goto IL_00c3;
						}
						postgresType5 = Core(postgresDomainType.BaseType)?.Array;
					}
					else if (postgresType4 is PostgresMultirangeType { Subrange: var subrange })
					{
						if (subrange == null || !(subrange.Subtype is PostgresDomainType postgresDomainType2))
						{
							goto IL_00c3;
						}
						postgresType5 = postgresDomainType2.BaseType.Range?.Multirange;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(postgresType4 is PostgresRangeType { Subtype: PostgresDomainType subtype }))
						{
							goto IL_00c3;
						}
						postgresType5 = subtype.Range;
					}
					goto IL_00c6;
				}
				goto IL_00c9;
				IL_00c3:
				postgresType5 = postgresType4;
				goto IL_00c6;
				IL_00c9:
				return postgresType3;
				IL_00c6:
				postgresType3 = postgresType5;
				goto IL_00c9;
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class NpgsqlSnakeCaseNameTranslator : INpgsqlNameTranslator
	{
		private readonly CultureInfo _culture;

		internal static NpgsqlSnakeCaseNameTranslator Instance { get; } = new NpgsqlSnakeCaseNameTranslator();

		private bool LegacyMode { get; }

		public NpgsqlSnakeCaseNameTranslator(CultureInfo? culture = null)
			: this(legacyMode: false, culture)
		{
		}

		public NpgsqlSnakeCaseNameTranslator(bool legacyMode, CultureInfo? culture = null)
		{
			LegacyMode = legacyMode;
			_culture = culture ?? CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
		}

		public string TranslateTypeName(string clrName)
		{
			return TranslateMemberName(clrName);
		}

		public string TranslateMemberName(string clrName)
		{
			if (clrName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("clrName");
			}
			if (!LegacyMode)
			{
				return ConvertToSnakeCase(clrName, _culture);
			}
			return string.Concat(LegacyModeMap(clrName)).ToLower(_culture);
			static IEnumerable<string> LegacyModeMap(string text)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
				{
					char c = text[i];
					yield return (i > 0 && char.IsUpper(c)) ? ("_" + c) : c.ToString();
				}
			}
		}

		public static string ConvertToSnakeCase(string name, CultureInfo? culture = null)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return name;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(name.Length + Math.Min(2, name.Length / 5));
			UnicodeCategory? unicodeCategory = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < name.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = name[i];
				if (c == '_')
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('_');
					unicodeCategory = null;
					continue;
				}
				UnicodeCategory unicodeCategory2 = char.GetUnicodeCategory(c);
				switch (unicodeCategory2)
				{
				case UnicodeCategory.UppercaseLetter:
				case UnicodeCategory.TitlecaseLetter:
					if (unicodeCategory == UnicodeCategory.SpaceSeparator || unicodeCategory == UnicodeCategory.LowercaseLetter || (unicodeCategory != UnicodeCategory.DecimalDigitNumber && unicodeCategory.HasValue && i > 0 && i + 1 < name.Length && char.IsLower(name[i + 1])))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('_');
					}
					c = char.ToLower(c, culture ?? CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					break;
				case UnicodeCategory.LowercaseLetter:
				case UnicodeCategory.DecimalDigitNumber:
					if (unicodeCategory == UnicodeCategory.SpaceSeparator)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('_');
					}
					break;
				default:
					if (unicodeCategory.HasValue)
					{
						unicodeCategory = UnicodeCategory.SpaceSeparator;
					}
					continue;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
				unicodeCategory = unicodeCategory2;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
}

	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public readonly struct BufferRequirements : IEquatable<BufferRequirements>
	{
		private readonly Size _read;

		private readonly Size _write;

		public Size Read => _read;

		public Size Write => _write;

		public static BufferRequirements None => new BufferRequirements(Size.Unknown, Size.Unknown);

		public static BufferRequirements Value => new BufferRequirements(Size.CreateUpperBound(int.MaxValue), Size.CreateUpperBound(int.MaxValue));

		private BufferRequirements(Size read, Size write)
		{
			_read = read;
			_write = write;
		}

		public static BufferRequirements CreateFixedSize(int byteCount)
		{
			return new BufferRequirements(byteCount, byteCount);
		}

		public static BufferRequirements Create(Size value)
		{
			return new BufferRequirements(value, value);
		}

		public static BufferRequirements Create(Size read, Size write)
		{
			return new BufferRequirements(read, write);
		}

		public BufferRequirements Combine(Size read, Size write)
		{
			return new BufferRequirements(_read.Combine(read), _write.Combine(write));
		}

		public BufferRequirements Combine(BufferRequirements other)
		{
			return Combine(other._read, other._write);
		}

		public BufferRequirements Combine(int byteCount)
		{
			return Combine(CreateFixedSize(byteCount));
		}

		public bool Equals(BufferRequirements other)
		{
			if (_read.Equals(other._read))
			{
				return _write.Equals(other._write);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is BufferRequirements other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCode.Combine(_read, _write);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(BufferRequirements left, BufferRequirements right)
		{
			return left.Equals(right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(BufferRequirements left, BufferRequirements right)
		{
			return !left.Equals(right);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class ObjectConverter : PgStreamingConverter<object>
	{
		private sealed class WriteState
		{
			public required PgTypeInfo TypeInfo { get; init; }

			public required object EffectiveState { get; set; }
		}

		private readonly PgSerializerOptions _options;

		private readonly PgTypeId _pgTypeId;

		public ObjectConverter(PgSerializerOptions options, PgTypeId pgTypeId)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: true)
		{
			_options = options;
			_pgTypeId = pgTypeId;
		}

		protected override bool IsDbNullValue(object? value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			if ((value == null || value is DBNull) ? true : false)
			{
				return true;
			}
			PgTypeInfo typeInfo = GetTypeInfo(value.GetType());
			object writeState2 = null;
			if (typeInfo.GetObjectResolution(value).Converter.IsDbNullAsObject(value, ref writeState2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			writeState = ((writeState2 != null) ? ((object)new WriteState
			{
				TypeInfo = typeInfo,
				EffectiveState = writeState2
			}) : ((object)typeInfo));
			return false;
		}

		public override object Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override ValueTask<object> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, object value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			object obj = writeState;
			(PgTypeInfo, object) tuple;
			if (!(obj is PgTypeInfo item))
			{
				if (!(obj is WriteState writeState2))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid state");
				}
				tuple = (writeState2.TypeInfo, writeState2.EffectiveState);
			}
			else
			{
				tuple = (item, null);
			}
			(PgTypeInfo, object) tuple2 = tuple;
			PgTypeInfo item2 = tuple2.Item1;
			object writeState3 = tuple2.Item2;
			PgConverter pgConverter = ((item2 is PgResolverTypeInfo pgResolverTypeInfo) ? pgResolverTypeInfo.GetDefaultResolution(null).Converter : item2.GetResolution().Converter);
			BufferRequirements? bufferRequirements = item2.GetBufferRequirements(pgConverter, context.Format);
			if (bufferRequirements.HasValue)
			{
				BufferRequirements valueOrDefault = bufferRequirements.GetValueOrDefault();
				if (valueOrDefault.Write.Kind == SizeKind.Exact)
				{
					return valueOrDefault.Write;
				}
				Size sizeAsObject = pgConverter.GetSizeAsObject(context, value, ref writeState3);
				if (writeState3 != null)
				{
					if (writeState is WriteState writeState4 && writeState4.EffectiveState != writeState3)
					{
						writeState4.EffectiveState = writeState3;
						return sizeAsObject;
					}
					writeState = new WriteState
					{
						TypeInfo = item2,
						EffectiveState = writeState3
					};
				}
				return sizeAsObject;
			}
			ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException($"Resolved converter '{pgConverter.GetType()}' has to support the {context.Format} format to be compatible.");
			return default(Size);
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, object value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, object value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, object value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			object writeState = writer.Current.WriteState;
			(PgTypeInfo, object) tuple;
			if (!(writeState is PgTypeInfo item))
			{
				if (!(writeState is WriteState writeState2))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid state");
				}
				tuple = (writeState2.TypeInfo, writeState2.EffectiveState);
			}
			else
			{
				tuple = (item, null);
			}
			(PgTypeInfo, object) tuple2 = tuple;
			PgTypeInfo item2 = tuple2.Item1;
			object item3 = tuple2.Item2;
			PgConverter converter = ((item2 is PgResolverTypeInfo pgResolverTypeInfo) ? pgResolverTypeInfo.GetDefaultResolution(null).Converter : item2.GetResolution().Converter);
			Size write = item2.GetBufferRequirements(converter, DataFormat.Binary).Value.Write;
			using (await writer.BeginNestedWrite(async, write, writer.Current.Size.Value, item3, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
			{
				await converter.WriteAsObject(async, writer, value, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
		}

		private PgTypeInfo GetTypeInfo(Type type)
		{
			return _options.GetTypeInfo(type, _pgTypeId) ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Writing values of '" + type.FullName + "' having DataTypeName '" + _options.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(_pgTypeId).DisplayName + "' is not supported.");

	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	[RequiresDynamicCode("A dynamic type info resolver may need to construct a generic converter for a statically unknown type.")]
	public abstract class DynamicTypeInfoResolver : IPgTypeInfoResolver
	{
		[RequiresDynamicCode("A dynamic type info resolver may need to construct a generic converter for a statically unknown type.")]
		protected class DynamicMappingCollection
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private static readonly MethodInfo AddTypeMethodInfo = typeof(TypeInfoMappingCollection).GetMethod("AddType", new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(TypeInfoFactory),
				typeof(Func<TypeInfoMapping, TypeInfoMapping>)
			}) ?? throw new NullReferenceException();

			private static readonly MethodInfo AddArrayTypeMethodInfo = typeof(TypeInfoMappingCollection).GetMethod("AddArrayType", new Type[1] { typeof(string) }) ?? throw new NullReferenceException();

			private static readonly MethodInfo AddStructTypeMethodInfo = typeof(TypeInfoMappingCollection).GetMethod("AddStructType", new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(TypeInfoFactory),
				typeof(Func<TypeInfoMapping, TypeInfoMapping>)
			}) ?? throw new NullReferenceException();

			private static readonly MethodInfo AddStructArrayTypeMethodInfo = typeof(TypeInfoMappingCollection).GetMethod("AddStructArrayType", new Type[1] { typeof(string) }) ?? throw new NullReferenceException();

			private static readonly MethodInfo AddResolverTypeMethodInfo = typeof(TypeInfoMappingCollection).GetMethod("AddResolverType", new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(TypeInfoFactory),
				typeof(Func<TypeInfoMapping, TypeInfoMapping>)
			}) ?? throw new NullReferenceException();

			private static readonly MethodInfo AddResolverArrayTypeMethodInfo = typeof(TypeInfoMappingCollection).GetMethod("AddResolverArrayType", new Type[1] { typeof(string) }) ?? throw new NullReferenceException();

			private static readonly MethodInfo AddResolverStructTypeMethodInfo = typeof(TypeInfoMappingCollection).GetMethod("AddResolverStructType", new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(TypeInfoFactory),
				typeof(Func<TypeInfoMapping, TypeInfoMapping>)
			}) ?? throw new NullReferenceException();

			private static readonly MethodInfo AddResolverStructArrayTypeMethodInfo = typeof(TypeInfoMappingCollection).GetMethod("AddResolverStructArrayType", new Type[1] { typeof(string) }) ?? throw new NullReferenceException();

			internal DynamicMappingCollection(TypeInfoMappingCollection? baseCollection = null)
			{
				if (baseCollection != null)
				{
					_mappings = new TypeInfoMappingCollection(baseCollection);
				}
			}

			public DynamicMappingCollection AddMapping(Type type, string dataTypeName, TypeInfoFactory factory, Func<TypeInfoMapping, TypeInfoMapping>? configureMapping = null)
			{
				if (type.IsValueType && (object)Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) != null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Mapping nullable types is not supported, map its underlying type instead to get both.");
				}
				(type.IsValueType ? AddStructTypeMethodInfo : AddTypeMethodInfo).MakeGenericMethod(type).Invoke(_mappings ?? (_mappings = new TypeInfoMappingCollection()), new object[3] { dataTypeName, factory, configureMapping });
				return this;
			}

			public DynamicMappingCollection AddArrayMapping(Type elementType, string dataTypeName)
			{
				(elementType.IsValueType ? AddStructArrayTypeMethodInfo : AddArrayTypeMethodInfo).MakeGenericMethod(elementType).Invoke(_mappings ?? (_mappings = new TypeInfoMappingCollection()), new object[1] { dataTypeName });
				return this;
			}

			public DynamicMappingCollection AddResolverMapping(Type type, string dataTypeName, TypeInfoFactory factory, Func<TypeInfoMapping, TypeInfoMapping>? configureMapping = null)
			{
				if (type.IsValueType && (object)Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) != null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Mapping nullable types is not supported");
				}
				(type.IsValueType ? AddResolverStructTypeMethodInfo : AddResolverTypeMethodInfo).MakeGenericMethod(type).Invoke(_mappings ?? (_mappings = new TypeInfoMappingCollection()), new object[3] { dataTypeName, factory, configureMapping });
				return this;
			}

			public DynamicMappingCollection AddResolverArrayMapping(Type elementType, string dataTypeName)
			{
				(elementType.IsValueType ? AddResolverStructArrayTypeMethodInfo : AddResolverArrayTypeMethodInfo).MakeGenericMethod(elementType).Invoke(_mappings ?? (_mappings = new TypeInfoMappingCollection()), new object[1] { dataTypeName });
				return this;
			}

			internal PgTypeInfo? Find(Type? type, DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return _mappings?.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			public TypeInfoMappingCollection ToTypeInfoMappingCollection()
			{
				return new TypeInfoMappingCollection(_mappings?.Items ?? Array.Empty<TypeInfoMapping>());
			}
		}

		public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
		{
			if (!dataTypeName.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetMappings(type, dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault(), options)?.Find(type, dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault(), options);
		}

		protected static DynamicMappingCollection CreateCollection(TypeInfoMappingCollection? baseCollection = null)
		{
			return new DynamicMappingCollection(baseCollection);
		}

		protected static bool IsTypeOrNullableOfType(Type type, Func<Type, bool> predicate, out Type matchedType)
		{
			matchedType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) ?? type;
			return predicate(matchedType);
		}

		protected static bool IsArrayLikeType(Type type, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Type? elementType)
		{
			return TypeInfoMappingCollection.IsArrayLikeType(type, out elementType);
		}

		protected static bool IsArrayDataTypeName(DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options, out DataTypeName elementDataTypeName)
		{
			if (options.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(dataTypeName) is PostgresArrayType postgresArrayType)
			{
				elementDataTypeName = postgresArrayType.Element.DataTypeName;
				return true;
			}
			elementDataTypeName = default(DataTypeName);
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract DynamicMappingCollection? GetMappings(Type? type, DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options);
	}

			}
		}

		private sealed class GSSPasswordMessageStream : Stream
		{
			private readonly NpgsqlConnector _connector;

			private int _leftToWrite;

			private int _leftToRead;

			private int _readPos;

			private byte[]? _readBuf;

			public override bool CanRead => true;

			public override bool CanWrite => true;

			public override bool CanSeek => false;

			public override long Length
			{
				get
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
			}

			public override long Position
			{
				get
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
				set
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
			}

			internal GSSPasswordMessageStream(NpgsqlConnector connector)
			{
				_connector = connector;
			}

			public override Task WriteAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
			{
				return Write(buffer, offset, count, async: true, cancellationToken);
			}

			public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
			{
				Write(buffer, offset, count, async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			}

			private async Task Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
			{
				if (_leftToWrite == 0)
				{
					_leftToWrite = (buffer[3] << 8) | buffer[4];
					buffer[0] = 22;
					if (buffer[1] != 1)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException($"Received frame header major v {buffer[1]} (different from 1)");
					}
					if (buffer[2] != 0)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException($"Received frame header minor v {buffer[2]} (different from 0)");
					}
					if (count == 5)
					{
						return;
					}
					count -= 5;
					offset += 5;
				}
				if (count > _leftToWrite)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException($"NegotiateStream trying to write {count} bytes but according to frame header we only have {_leftToWrite} left!");
				}
				await _connector.WritePassword(buffer, offset, count, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await _connector.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				_leftToWrite -= count;
			}

			public override Task<int> ReadAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
			{
				return Read(buffer, offset, count, async: true, cancellationToken);
			}

			public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
			{
				return Read(buffer, offset, count, async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			}

			private async Task<int> Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
			{
				if (_leftToRead == 0)
				{
					AuthenticationRequestMessage authenticationRequestMessage = Statics.ExpectAny<AuthenticationRequestMessage>(await _connector.ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), _connector);
					if (authenticationRequestMessage.AuthRequestType == AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationOk)
					{
						throw new AuthenticationCompleteException();
					}
					if (!(authenticationRequestMessage is AuthenticationGSSContinueMessage authenticationGSSContinueMessage))
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException($"Received unexpected authentication request message {authenticationRequestMessage.AuthRequestType}");
					}
					_readBuf = authenticationGSSContinueMessage.AuthenticationData;
					_leftToRead = authenticationGSSContinueMessage.AuthenticationData.Length;
					_readPos = 0;
					buffer[0] = 22;
					buffer[1] = 1;
					buffer[2] = 0;
					buffer[3] = (byte)((_leftToRead >> 8) & 0xFF);
					buffer[4] = (byte)(_leftToRead & 0xFF);
					return 5;
				}
				if (count > _leftToRead)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException($"NegotiateStream trying to read {count} bytes but according to frame header we only have {_leftToRead} left!");
				}
				count = Math.Min(count, _leftToRead);
				Array.Copy(_readBuf, _readPos, buffer, offset, count);
				_leftToRead -= count;
				return count;
			}

			public override void Flush()
			{
			}

			public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public override void SetLength(long value)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		{
		}

					if ((num < 0 || num > 8) ? true : false)
					{
						ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", "Unknown state: " + value);
					}
					Interlocked.Exchange(ref _state, num);
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task Authenticate(string username, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				timeout.CheckAndApply(this);
				AuthenticationRequestMessage authenticationRequestMessage = Statics.ExpectAny<AuthenticationRequestMessage>(await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), this);
				switch (authenticationRequestMessage.AuthRequestType)
				{
				case AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationOk:
					return;
				case AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationCleartextPassword:
					await AuthenticateCleartext(username, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					break;
				case AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationMD5Password:
					await AuthenticateMD5(username, ((AuthenticationMD5PasswordMessage)authenticationRequestMessage).Salt, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					break;
				case AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationSASL:
					await AuthenticateSASL(((AuthenticationSASLMessage)authenticationRequestMessage).Mechanisms, username, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					break;
				case AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationGSS:
				case AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationSSPI:
					await DataSource.IntegratedSecurityHandler.NegotiateAuthentication(async, this).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					return;
				case AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationGSSContinue:
					throw new NpgsqlException("Can't start auth cycle with AuthenticationGSSContinue");
				default:
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Authentication method not supported (Received: {authenticationRequestMessage.AuthRequestType})");
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task AuthenticateCleartext(string username, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			string text = await GetPassword(username, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("No password has been provided but the backend requires one (in cleartext)");
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(text) + 1];
			Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text, 0, text.Length, array, 0);
			await WritePassword(array, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		private async Task AuthenticateSASL(List<string> mechanisms, string username, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			bool flag = mechanisms.Contains("SCRAM-SHA-256");
			bool num = flag && Settings.ChannelBinding != ChannelBinding.Require;
			bool flag2 = mechanisms.Contains("SCRAM-SHA-256-PLUS");
			bool flag3 = flag2 && Settings.ChannelBinding != ChannelBinding.Disable;
			if (!num && !flag3)
			{
				if (flag && Settings.ChannelBinding == ChannelBinding.Require)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException("Couldn't connect because ChannelBinding is set to Require but the server doesn't support SCRAM-SHA-256-PLUS");
				}
				if (flag2 && Settings.ChannelBinding == ChannelBinding.Disable)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException("Couldn't connect because ChannelBinding is set to Disable but the server doesn't support SCRAM-SHA-256");
				}
				throw new NpgsqlException("No supported SASL mechanism found (only SCRAM-SHA-256 and SCRAM-SHA-256-PLUS are supported for now). Mechanisms received from server: " + string.Join(", ", mechanisms));
			}
			string mechanism = string.Empty;
			string cbindFlag = string.Empty;
			string cbind = string.Empty;
			bool successfulBind = false;
			if (flag3)
			{
				DataSource.TransportSecurityHandler.AuthenticateSASLSha256Plus(this, ref mechanism, ref cbindFlag, ref cbind, ref successfulBind);
			}
			if (!successfulBind && flag)
			{
				mechanism = "SCRAM-SHA-256";
				cbindFlag = (flag2 ? "n" : "y");
				cbind = (flag2 ? "biws" : "eSws");
				successfulBind = true;
				IsScram = true;
			}
			if (!successfulBind)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("Unable to bind to SCRAM-SHA-256-PLUS, check logs for more information");
			}
			string passwd = (await GetPassword(username, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)) ?? throw new NpgsqlException("No password has been provided but the backend requires one (in SASL/" + mechanism + ")");
			string clientNonce = GetNonce();
			await WriteSASLInitialResponse(mechanism, NpgsqlWriteBuffer.UTF8Encoding.GetBytes(cbindFlag + ",,n=*,r=" + clientNonce), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			AuthenticationSASLContinueMessage authenticationSASLContinueMessage = Statics.Expect<AuthenticationSASLContinueMessage>(await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), this);
			if (authenticationSASLContinueMessage.AuthRequestType != AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationSASLContinue)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("[SASL] AuthenticationSASLContinue message expected");
			}
			AuthenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage authenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage = AuthenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage.Load(authenticationSASLContinueMessage.Payload, ConnectionLogger);
			if (!authenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage.Nonce.StartsWith(clientNonce, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("[SCRAM] Malformed SCRAMServerFirst message: server nonce doesn't start with client nonce");
			}
			byte[] salt = Convert.FromBase64String(authenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage.Salt);
			byte[] key = Hi(passwd.Normalize(NormalizationForm.FormKC), salt, authenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage.Iteration);
			byte[] array = HMAC(key, "Client Key");
			byte[] key2;
			using (SHA256 sHA = SHA256.Create())
			{
				key2 = sHA.ComputeHash(array);
			}
			string text = "n=*,r=" + clientNonce;
			string text2 = $"r={authenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage.Nonce},s={authenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage.Salt},i={authenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage.Iteration}";
			string text3 = "c=" + cbind + ",r=" + authenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage.Nonce;
			string data = text + "," + text2 + "," + text3;
			byte[] buffer = HMAC(key2, data);
			string text4 = Convert.ToBase64String(Xor(array, buffer));
			byte[] key3 = HMAC(key, "Server Key");
			byte[] serverSignature = HMAC(key3, data);
			string s = text3 + ",p=" + text4;
			await WriteSASLResponse(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			AuthenticationSASLFinalMessage authenticationSASLFinalMessage = Statics.Expect<AuthenticationSASLFinalMessage>(await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), this);
			if (authenticationSASLFinalMessage.AuthRequestType != AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationSASLFinal)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("[SASL] AuthenticationSASLFinal message expected");
			}
			if (AuthenticationSCRAMServerFinalMessage.Load(authenticationSASLFinalMessage.Payload, ConnectionLogger).ServerSignature != Convert.ToBase64String(serverSignature))
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("[SCRAM] Unable to verify server signature");
			}
			static string GetNonce()
			{
				using RandomNumberGenerator randomNumberGenerator = RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
				byte[] array2 = new byte[18];
				randomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(array2);
				return Convert.ToBase64String(array2);
			}
		}

		internal void AuthenticateSASLSha256Plus(ref string mechanism, ref string cbindFlag, ref string cbind, ref bool successfulBind)
		{
			if (!IsSecure)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("Server offered SCRAM-SHA-256-PLUS authentication over a non-SSL connection");
			}
			SslStream sslStream = (SslStream)_stream;
			if (sslStream.RemoteCertificate == null)
			{
				ConnectionLogger.LogWarning("Remote certificate null, falling back to SCRAM-SHA-256");
				return;
			}
			using X509Certificate2 x509Certificate = new X509Certificate2(sslStream.RemoteCertificate);
			HashAlgorithm hashAlgorithm = null;
			string friendlyName = x509Certificate.SignatureAlgorithm.FriendlyName;
			if (friendlyName == null)
			{
				ConnectionLogger.LogWarning("Signature algorithm was null, falling back to SCRAM-SHA-256");
			}
			else if (friendlyName.StartsWith("sha1", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || friendlyName.StartsWith("md5", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || friendlyName.StartsWith("sha256", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				hashAlgorithm = SHA256.Create();
			}
			else if (friendlyName.StartsWith("sha384", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				hashAlgorithm = SHA384.Create();
			}
			else if (friendlyName.StartsWith("sha512", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				hashAlgorithm = SHA512.Create();
			}
			else
			{
				ConnectionLogger.LogWarning("Support for signature algorithm " + friendlyName + " is not yet implemented, falling back to SCRAM-SHA-256");
			}
			if (hashAlgorithm != null)
			{
				using (hashAlgorithm)
				{
					mechanism = "SCRAM-SHA-256-PLUS";
					cbindFlag = "p=tls-server-end-point";
					byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(cbindFlag + ",,");
					byte[] array = hashAlgorithm.ComputeHash(x509Certificate.GetRawCertData());
					byte[] array2 = new byte[bytes.Length + array.Length];
					bytes.CopyTo(array2, 0);
					array.CopyTo(array2, bytes.Length);
					cbind = Convert.ToBase64String(array2);
					successfulBind = true;
					IsScramPlus = true;
					return;
				}
			}
		}

		private static byte[] Xor(byte[] buffer1, byte[] buffer2)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < buffer1.Length; i++)
			{
				buffer1[i] ^= buffer2[i];
			}
			return buffer1;
		}

		private static byte[] HMAC(byte[] key, string data)
		{
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(data);
			using IncrementalHash incrementalHash = IncrementalHash.CreateHMAC(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, key);
			incrementalHash.AppendData(bytes);
			return incrementalHash.GetHashAndReset();
		}

		private async Task AuthenticateMD5(string username, byte[] salt, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			string text = await GetPassword(username, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("No password has been provided but the backend requires one (in MD5)");
			}
			byte[] array3;
			using (MD5 mD = MD5.Create())
			{
				byte[] bytes = NpgsqlWriteBuffer.UTF8Encoding.GetBytes(text);
				byte[] bytes2 = NpgsqlWriteBuffer.UTF8Encoding.GetBytes(username);
				byte[] array = new byte[bytes.Length + bytes2.Length];
				bytes.CopyTo(array, 0);
				bytes2.CopyTo(array, bytes.Length);
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				byte[] array2 = mD.ComputeHash(array);
				foreach (byte b in array2)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(b.ToString("x2"));
				}
				string s = stringBuilder.ToString();
				byte[] bytes3 = NpgsqlWriteBuffer.UTF8Encoding.GetBytes(s);
				array = new byte[bytes3.Length + 4];
				Array.Copy(salt, 0, array, bytes3.Length, 4);
				bytes3.CopyTo(array, 0);
				stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("md5");
				array2 = mD.ComputeHash(array);
				foreach (byte b2 in array2)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(b2.ToString("x2"));
				}
				string text2 = stringBuilder.ToString();
				array3 = new byte[Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(text2) + 1];
				Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text2, 0, text2.Length, array3, 0);
				array3[^1] = 0;
			}
			await WritePassword(array3, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		private async ValueTask<string?> GetPassword(string username, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			string text = await DataSource.GetPassword(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			ProvidePasswordCallback providePasswordCallback = ProvidePasswordCallback;
			if (providePasswordCallback != null)
			{
				try
				{
					ConnectionLogger.LogTrace("Taking password from ProvidePasswordCallback delegate");
					text = providePasswordCallback(Host, Port, Settings.Database, username);
				}
				catch (Exception innerException)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException("Obtaining password using NpgsqlConnection.ProvidePasswordCallback delegate failed", innerException);
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = PostgresEnvironment.Password;
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			string text2 = Settings.Passfile ?? PostgresEnvironment.PassFile ?? PostgresEnvironment.PassFileDefault;
			if (text2 != null)
			{
				PgPassFile.Entry firstMatchingEntry = new PgPassFile(text2).GetFirstMatchingEntry(Host, Port, Settings.Database, username);
				if (firstMatchingEntry != null)
				{
					ConnectionLogger.LogTrace("Taking password from pgpass file");
					text = firstMatchingEntry.Password;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal void FlagAsNotWritableForMultiplexing()
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref MultiplexAsyncWritingLock, 1);
		}

		internal void FlagAsWritableForMultiplexing()
		{
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref MultiplexAsyncWritingLock, 0, 1) != 1)
			{
				throw new Exception("Multiplexing lock was not taken when releasing. Please report a bug.");
			}
		}

		internal NpgsqlConnector(NpgsqlDataSource dataSource, NpgsqlConnection conn)
			: this(dataSource)
		{
			if (conn.ProvideClientCertificatesCallback != null)
			{
				ClientCertificatesCallback = delegate(X509CertificateCollection certs)
				{
					conn.ProvideClientCertificatesCallback(certs);
				};
			}
			if (conn.UserCertificateValidationCallback != null)
			{
				UserCertificateValidationCallback = conn.UserCertificateValidationCallback;
			}
			ProvidePasswordCallback = conn.ProvidePasswordCallback;
		}

		private NpgsqlConnector(NpgsqlConnector connector)
			: this(connector.DataSource)
		{
			ClientCertificatesCallback = connector.ClientCertificatesCallback;
			UserCertificateValidationCallback = connector.UserCertificateValidationCallback;
			ProvidePasswordCallback = connector.ProvidePasswordCallback;
		}

		private NpgsqlConnector(NpgsqlDataSource dataSource)
		{
			DataSource = dataSource;
			LoggingConfiguration = dataSource.LoggingConfiguration;
			ConnectionLogger = LoggingConfiguration.ConnectionLogger;
			CommandLogger = LoggingConfiguration.CommandLogger;
			TransactionLogger = LoggingConfiguration.TransactionLogger;
			CopyLogger = LoggingConfiguration.CopyLogger;
			ClientCertificatesCallback = dataSource.ClientCertificatesCallback;
			UserCertificateValidationCallback = dataSource.UserCertificateValidationCallback;
			State = ConnectorState.Closed;
			TransactionStatus = TransactionStatus.Idle;
			Settings = dataSource.Settings;
			PostgresParameters = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			_isKeepAliveEnabled = Settings.KeepAlive > 0;
			if (_isKeepAliveEnabled)
			{
				_keepAliveTimer = new Timer(PerformKeepAlive, null, -1, -1);
			}
			DataReader = new NpgsqlDataReader(this);
			PreparedStatementManager = new PreparedStatementManager(this);
			if (Settings.Multiplexing)
			{
				Channel<NpgsqlCommand> channel = Channel.CreateUnbounded<NpgsqlCommand>(new UnboundedChannelOptions
				{
					SingleReader = true
				});
				CommandsInFlightReader = channel.Reader;
				CommandsInFlightWriter = channel.Writer;
				if (_isKeepAliveEnabled)
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException("Keepalive not yet implemented for multiplexing");
				}
			}
		}

		internal async Task Open(NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			State = ConnectorState.Connecting;
			LogMessages.OpeningPhysicalConnection(ConnectionLogger, Host, Port, Database, UserFacingConnectionString);
			Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
			try
			{
				await OpenCore(this, Settings.SslMode, timeout, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await DataSource.Bootstrap(this, timeout, forceReload: false, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				SerializerOptions = DataSource.SerializerOptions;
				DatabaseInfo = DataSource.DatabaseInfo;
				if (Settings.Pooling && !Settings.Multiplexing && !Settings.NoResetOnClose && DatabaseInfo.SupportsDiscard)
				{
					_sendResetOnClose = true;
					GenerateResetMessage();
				}
				OpenTimestamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
				if (Settings.Multiplexing)
				{
					Task.Run((Func<Task?>)MultiplexingReadLoop, CancellationToken.None).ContinueWith(delegate(Task t)
					{
						ConnectionLogger.LogError(t.Exception, "Exception bubbled out of multiplexing read loop", Id);
					}, TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted);
				}
				if (_isKeepAliveEnabled)
				{
					lock (SyncObj)
					{
						int num = Settings.KeepAlive * 1000;
						_keepAliveTimer.Change(num, num);
					}
				}
				if (DataSource.ConnectionInitializerAsync != null)
				{
					NpgsqlConnection npgsqlConnection = new NpgsqlConnection(DataSource, this);
					try
					{
						if (async)
						{
							await DataSource.ConnectionInitializerAsync(npgsqlConnection).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						else if (!async)
						{
							DataSource.ConnectionInitializer(npgsqlConnection);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						Connection?.MakeDisposed();
						Connection = null;
					}
				}
				LogMessages.OpenedPhysicalConnection(ConnectionLogger, Host, Port, Database, UserFacingConnectionString, stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds, Id);
			}
			catch (Exception reason)
			{
				Break(reason);
				throw;
			}
			static async Task OpenCore(NpgsqlConnector conn, SslMode sslMode, NpgsqlTimeout timeout2, bool async2, CancellationToken cancellationToken2, bool isFirstAttempt = true)
			{
				await conn.RawOpen(sslMode, timeout2, async2, cancellationToken2, isFirstAttempt).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				string username = await conn.GetUsernameAsync(async2, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				timeout2.CheckAndApply(conn);
				conn.WriteStartupMessage(username);
				await conn.Flush(async2, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				using CancellationTokenRegistration cancellationRegistration = conn.StartCancellableOperation(cancellationToken2, attemptPgCancellation: false);
				try
				{
					await conn.Authenticate(username, timeout2, async2, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				catch (PostgresException ex) when (ex.SqlState == "28000" && ((sslMode == SslMode.Prefer && conn.IsSecure) || (sslMode == SslMode.Allow && !conn.IsSecure)))
				{
					cancellationRegistration.Dispose();
					conn.Cleanup();
					await OpenCore(conn, (sslMode != SslMode.Prefer) ? SslMode.Require : SslMode.Disable, timeout2, async2, cancellationToken2, isFirstAttempt: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					return;
				}
				IBackendMessage backendMessage = await conn.ReadMessage(async2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (backendMessage.Code == BackendMessageCode.BackendKeyData)
				{
					BackendKeyDataMessage backendKeyDataMessage = (BackendKeyDataMessage)backendMessage;
					conn.BackendProcessId = backendKeyDataMessage.BackendProcessId;
					conn._backendSecretKey = backendKeyDataMessage.BackendSecretKey;
					backendMessage = await conn.ReadMessage(async2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				if (backendMessage.Code != BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException($"Received backend message {backendMessage.Code} while expecting ReadyForQuery. Please file a bug.");
				}
				conn.State = ConnectorState.Ready;
			}
		}

		internal async ValueTask<DatabaseState> QueryDatabaseState(NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			using NpgsqlBatch batch = CreateBatch();
			batch.BatchCommands.Add(new NpgsqlBatchCommand("select pg_is_in_recovery()"));
			batch.BatchCommands.Add(new NpgsqlBatchCommand("SHOW default_transaction_read_only"));
			batch.Timeout = (int)timeout.CheckAndGetTimeLeft().TotalSeconds;
			NpgsqlDataReader npgsqlDataReader = ((!async) ? batch.ExecuteReader() : (await batch.ExecuteReaderAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
			NpgsqlDataReader reader = npgsqlDataReader;
			DatabaseState value;
			try
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await reader.ReadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					_isHotStandBy = reader.GetBoolean(0);
					await reader.NextResultAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await reader.ReadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					reader.Read();
					_isHotStandBy = reader.GetBoolean(0);
					reader.NextResult();
					reader.Read();
				}
				_isTransactionReadOnly = reader.GetString(0) != "off";
				value = UpdateDatabaseState().Value;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await reader.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					reader.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void WriteStartupMessage(string username)
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>
			{
				["user"] = username,
				["client_encoding"] = Settings.ClientEncoding ?? PostgresEnvironment.ClientEncoding ?? "UTF8"
			};

			{
				dictionary["database"] = Settings.Database;
			}
			string? applicationName = Settings.ApplicationName;
			if (applicationName != null && applicationName.Length > 0)
			{
				dictionary["application_name"] = Settings.ApplicationName;
			}
			string? searchPath = Settings.SearchPath;
			if (searchPath != null && searchPath.Length > 0)
			{
				dictionary["search_path"] = Settings.SearchPath;
			}
			string text = Settings.Timezone ?? PostgresEnvironment.TimeZone;
			if (text != null)
			{
				dictionary["TimeZone"] = text;
			}
			string text2 = Settings.Options ?? PostgresEnvironment.Options;
			if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
			{
				dictionary["options"] = text2;
			}
			switch (Settings.ReplicationMode)
			{
			case ReplicationMode.Logical:
				dictionary["replication"] = "database";
				break;
			case ReplicationMode.Physical:
				dictionary["replication"] = "true";
				break;
			}
			WriteStartup(dictionary);
		}

			if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)

			return GetUsernameAsyncInternal();
