		private async Task RawOpen(SslMode sslMode, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool isFirstAttempt = true)
		{
			_ = 3;
			try
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await ConnectAsync(timeout, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					Connect(timeout);
				}
				_baseStream = new NetworkStream(_socket, ownsSocket: true);
				_stream = _baseStream;
				if (Settings.Encoding == "UTF8")
				{
					TextEncoding = NpgsqlWriteBuffer.UTF8Encoding;
					RelaxedTextEncoding = NpgsqlWriteBuffer.RelaxedUTF8Encoding;
				}
				else
				{
					TextEncoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(Settings.Encoding, EncoderFallback.ExceptionFallback, DecoderFallback.ExceptionFallback);
					RelaxedTextEncoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(Settings.Encoding, EncoderFallback.ReplacementFallback, DecoderFallback.ReplacementFallback);
				}
				ReadBuffer = new NpgsqlReadBuffer(this, _stream, _socket, Settings.ReadBufferSize, TextEncoding, RelaxedTextEncoding);
				WriteBuffer = new NpgsqlWriteBuffer(this, _stream, _socket, Settings.WriteBufferSize, TextEncoding);
				timeout.CheckAndApply(this);
				IsSecure = false;
				bool flag = sslMode == SslMode.Prefer && DataSource.TransportSecurityHandler.SupportEncryption;
				if (!flag)
				{
					bool flag2 = (uint)(sslMode - 3) <= 2u;
					flag = flag2;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					WriteSslRequest();
					await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await ReadBuffer.Ensure(1, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					char c = (char)ReadBuffer.ReadByte();
					timeout.CheckAndApply(this);
					switch (c)
					{
					default:
						throw new NpgsqlException($"Received unknown response {c} for SSLRequest (expecting S or N)");
					case 'N':
						if (sslMode != SslMode.Prefer)
						{
							throw new NpgsqlException("SSL connection requested. No SSL enabled connection from this host is configured.");
						}
						break;
					case 'S':
						await DataSource.TransportSecurityHandler.NegotiateEncryption(async, this, sslMode, timeout, isFirstAttempt).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						break;
					}
					if (ReadBuffer.ReadBytesLeft > 0)
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException("Additional unencrypted data received after SSL negotiation - this should never happen, and may be an indication of a man-in-the-middle attack.");
					}
				}
				ConnectionLogger.LogTrace("Socket connected to {Host}:{Port}", Host, Port);
			}
			catch
			{
				_stream?.Dispose();
				_stream = null;
				_baseStream?.Dispose();
				_baseStream = null;
				_socket?.Dispose();
				_socket = null;
				throw;
			}
		}

		internal async Task NegotiateEncryption(SslMode sslMode, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async, bool isFirstAttempt)
		{
			X509Certificate2Collection x509Certificate2Collection = new X509Certificate2Collection();
			string text = Settings.SslCertificate ?? PostgresEnvironment.SslCert ?? PostgresEnvironment.SslCertDefault;
			if (text != null)
			{
				string sslPassword = Settings.SslPassword;
				X509Certificate2 x509Certificate = null;
				if (Path.GetExtension(text).ToUpperInvariant() != ".PFX")
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("PEM certificates are only supported with .NET 6 and higher");
				}
				if (x509Certificate == null)
				{
					x509Certificate = new X509Certificate2(text, sslPassword);
				}
				x509Certificate2Collection.Add(x509Certificate);
				_certificate = x509Certificate;
			}
			try
			{
				ClientCertificatesCallback?.Invoke(x509Certificate2Collection);
				bool checkCertificateRevocation = Settings.CheckCertificateRevocation;
				string certRootPath = null;
				RemoteCertificateValidationCallback userCertificateValidationCallback;
				if (UserCertificateValidationCallback != null)
				{
					SslMode sslMode2 = sslMode;
					if ((uint)(sslMode2 - 4) <= 1u)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.CannotUseSslVerifyWithUserCallback, sslMode));
					}
					if (Settings.RootCertificate != null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(NpgsqlStrings.CannotUseSslRootCertificateWithUserCallback);
					}
					if (DataSource.TransportSecurityHandler.RootCertificateCallback != null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(NpgsqlStrings.CannotUseValidationRootCertificateCallbackWithUserCallback);
					}
					userCertificateValidationCallback = UserCertificateValidationCallback;
				}
				else
				{
					SslMode sslMode2 = sslMode;
					if ((uint)(sslMode2 - 2) <= 1u)
					{
						userCertificateValidationCallback = SslTrustServerValidation;
						checkCertificateRevocation = false;
					}
					else
					{
						X509Certificate2 caCertificate;
						if ((caCertificate = DataSource.TransportSecurityHandler.RootCertificateCallback?.Invoke()) == null)
						{
							string? obj = Settings.RootCertificate ?? PostgresEnvironment.SslCertRoot ?? PostgresEnvironment.SslCertRootDefault;
							certRootPath = obj;
							if (obj == null)
							{
								userCertificateValidationCallback = ((sslMode != SslMode.VerifyCA) ? SslVerifyFullValidation : SslVerifyCAValidation);
								goto IL_01cb;
							}
						}
						userCertificateValidationCallback = SslRootValidation(sslMode == SslMode.VerifyFull, certRootPath, caCertificate);
					}
				}
				goto IL_01cb;
				IL_01cb:
				string text2 = Host;
				if (IPAddress.TryParse(text2, out IPAddress _))
				{
					text2 = string.Empty;
				}
				timeout.CheckAndApply(this);
				try
				{
					SslStream sslStream = new SslStream(_stream, leaveInnerStreamOpen: false, userCertificateValidationCallback);
					SslProtocols enabledSslProtocols = SslProtocols.Tls | SslProtocols.Tls11 | SslProtocols.Tls12;
					if (async)
					{
						await sslStream.AuthenticateAsClientAsync(text2, x509Certificate2Collection, enabledSslProtocols, checkCertificateRevocation).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						sslStream.AuthenticateAsClient(text2, x509Certificate2Collection, enabledSslProtocols, checkCertificateRevocation);
					}
					_stream = sslStream;
				}
				catch (Exception innerException)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException("Exception while performing SSL handshake", innerException);
				}
				ReadBuffer.Underlying = _stream;
				WriteBuffer.Underlying = _stream;
				IsSecure = true;
				ConnectionLogger.LogTrace("SSL negotiation successful");
			}
			catch
			{
				_certificate?.Dispose();
				_certificate = null;
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void Connect(NpgsqlTimeout timeout)
		{
			object obj;
			if (NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.IsUnixSocket(Host, Port, out string socketPath))
			{
				obj = new EndPoint[1]
				{
					new System.Net.UnixDomainSocketEndPoint(socketPath)
				};
			}
			else
			{
				EndPoint[] array = IPAddressesToEndpoints(Dns.GetHostAddresses(Host), Port);
				obj = array;
			}
			EndPoint[] array2 = (EndPoint[])obj;
			timeout.Check();
			int microSeconds = -1;
			if (timeout.IsSet)
			{
				microSeconds = (int)(timeout.CheckAndGetTimeLeft().Ticks / array2.Length / 10);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				EndPoint endPoint = array2[i];
				ConnectionLogger.LogTrace("Attempting to connect to {Endpoint}", endPoint);
				ProtocolType protocolType = ((endPoint.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork || endPoint.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6) ? ProtocolType.Tcp : ProtocolType.IP);
				Socket socket = new Socket(endPoint.AddressFamily, SocketType.Stream, protocolType)
				{
					Blocking = false
				};
				try
				{
					try
					{
						socket.Connect(endPoint);
					}
					catch (SocketException ex)
					{
						if (ex.SocketErrorCode != SocketError.WouldBlock)
						{
							throw;
						}
					}
					List<Socket> list = new List<Socket> { socket };
					List<Socket> checkError = new List<Socket> { socket };
					Socket.Select(null, list, checkError, microSeconds);
					int num = (int)socket.GetSocketOption(SocketOptionLevel.Socket, SocketOptionName.Error);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						throw new SocketException(num);
					}
					if (list.Count == 0)
					{
						throw new TimeoutException("Timeout during connection attempt");
					}
					socket.Blocking = true;
					SetSocketOptions(socket);
					_socket = socket;
					ConnectedEndPoint = endPoint;
					break;
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					try
					{
						socket.Dispose();
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					ConnectionLogger.LogTrace(ex2, "Failed to connect to {Endpoint}", endPoint);
					if (i == array2.Length - 1)
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException($"Failed to connect to {endPoint}", ex2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task ConnectAsync(NpgsqlTimeout timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			EndPoint[] array;
			if (NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder.IsUnixSocket(Host, Port, out string socketPath))
			{
				array = new EndPoint[1]
				{
					new System.Net.UnixDomainSocketEndPoint(socketPath)
				};
			}
			else
			{
				EndPoint[] array2 = IPAddressesToEndpoints(await TaskTimeoutAndCancellation.ExecuteAsync(GetHostAddressesAsync, timeout, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), Port);
				array = array2;
			}
			EndPoint[] endpoints = array;
			NpgsqlTimeout perIpTimeout = timeout;
			if (timeout.IsSet)
			{
				TimeSpan expiration = new TimeSpan(timeout.CheckAndGetTimeLeft().Ticks / endpoints.Length);
				perIpTimeout = new NpgsqlTimeout(expiration);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < endpoints.Length; i++)
			{
				EndPoint endpoint = endpoints[i];
				ConnectionLogger.LogTrace("Attempting to connect to {Endpoint}", endpoint);
				ProtocolType protocolType = ((endpoint.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork || endpoint.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6) ? ProtocolType.Tcp : ProtocolType.IP);
				Socket socket = new Socket(endpoint.AddressFamily, SocketType.Stream, protocolType);
				try
				{
					await OpenSocketConnectionAsync(socket, endpoint, perIpTimeout, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					SetSocketOptions(socket);
					_socket = socket;
					ConnectedEndPoint = endpoint;
					break;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					try
					{
						socket.Dispose();
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					if (ex is OperationCanceledException)
					{
						ex = new TimeoutException("Timeout during connection attempt");
					}
					ConnectionLogger.LogTrace(ex, "Failed to connect to {Endpoint}", endpoint);
					if (i == endpoints.Length - 1)
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException($"Failed to connect to {endpoint}", ex);
					}
				}
			}
			Task<IPAddress[]> GetHostAddressesAsync(CancellationToken ct)
			{
				return Dns.GetHostAddressesAsync(Host);
			}
			static Task OpenSocketConnectionAsync(Socket socket2, EndPoint remoteEP, NpgsqlTimeout timeout2, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				return TaskTimeoutAndCancellation.ExecuteAsync(ConnectAsync, timeout2, cancellationToken2);
				Task ConnectAsync(CancellationToken ct)
				{
					return SocketTaskExtensions.ConnectAsync(socket2, remoteEP);
				}
			}
		}

		private IPEndPoint[] IPAddressesToEndpoints(IPAddress[] ipAddresses, int port)
		{
			IPEndPoint[] array = new IPEndPoint[ipAddresses.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < ipAddresses.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new IPEndPoint(ipAddresses[i], port);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void SetSocketOptions(Socket socket)
		{
			if (socket.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork || socket.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6)
			{
				socket.NoDelay = true;
			}
			if (Settings.SocketReceiveBufferSize > 0)
			{
				socket.ReceiveBufferSize = Settings.SocketReceiveBufferSize;
			}
			if (Settings.SocketSendBufferSize > 0)
			{
				socket.SendBufferSize = Settings.SocketSendBufferSize;
			}
			if (Settings.TcpKeepAlive)
			{
				socket.SetSocketOption(SocketOptionLevel.Socket, SocketOptionName.KeepAlive, optionValue: true);
			}
			if (Settings.TcpKeepAliveInterval > 0 && Settings.TcpKeepAliveTime == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("If TcpKeepAliveInterval is defined, TcpKeepAliveTime must be defined as well");
			}
			if (Settings.TcpKeepAliveTime > 0)
			{
				int tcpKeepAliveTime = Settings.TcpKeepAliveTime;
				int num = ((Settings.TcpKeepAliveInterval > 0) ? Settings.TcpKeepAliveInterval : Settings.TcpKeepAliveTime);
				int value = tcpKeepAliveTime * 1000;
				int value2 = num * 1000;
				int num2 = Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(uint));
				byte[] array = new byte[num2 * 3];
				BitConverter.GetBytes(1u).CopyTo(array, 0);
				BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)value).CopyTo(array, num2);
				BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)value2).CopyTo(array, num2 * 2);
				int num3 = 0;
				try
				{
					num3 = socket.IOControl(IOControlCode.KeepAliveValues, array, null);
				}
				catch (PlatformNotSupportedException)
				{
					throw new PlatformNotSupportedException("Setting TCP Keepalive Time and TCP Keepalive Interval is supported only on Windows, Mono and .NET Core 3.1+. TCP keepalives can still be used on other systems but are enabled via the TcpKeepAlive option or configured globally for the machine, see the relevant docs.");
				}
				if (num3 != 0)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException($"Got non-zero value when trying to set TCP keepalive: {num3}");
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task MultiplexingReadLoop()
		{
			NpgsqlCommand command = null;
			int commandsRead = 0;
			try
			{
				while (await CommandsInFlightReader.WaitToReadAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
					commandsRead = 0;
					while (CommandsInFlightReader.TryRead(out command))
					{
						commandsRead++;
						await ReadBuffer.Ensure(5, async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						command.TraceReceivedFirstResponse();
						ReaderCompleted.Reset();
						command.ExecutionCompletion.SetResult(this);
						await new ValueTask(ReaderCompleted, ReaderCompleted.Version).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					if (Interlocked.Add(ref CommandsInFlightCount, -commandsRead) == 0)
					{
						SpinWait.SpinUntil(() => MultiplexAsyncWritingLock == 0 || IsBroken);
						ResetReadBuffer();
						DataSource.Return(this);
					}
				}
				ConnectionLogger.LogTrace("Exiting multiplexing read loop", Id);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				Interlocked.Add(ref CommandsInFlightCount, -commandsRead);
				command?.ExecutionCompletion.SetException(_breakReason);
				try
				{
					while (true)
					{
						(await CommandsInFlightReader.ReadAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)).ExecutionCompletion.SetException(new NpgsqlException("A previous command on this connection caused an error requiring all pending commands on this connection to be aborted", _breakReason));
					}
				}
				catch (ChannelClosedException)
				{
				}
				DataSource.Return(this);
				ConnectionLogger.LogError(exception, "Exception in multiplexing read loop", Id);
			}
		}

		internal void PrependInternalMessage(byte[] rawMessage, int responseMessageCount)
		{
			PendingPrependedResponses += responseMessageCount;
			WritePregenerated(rawMessage);
		}

		internal ValueTask<IBackendMessage?> ReadMessageWithNotifications(bool async)
		{
			return ReadMessageLong(async, DataRowLoadingMode.NonSequential, readingNotifications: true);
		}

		internal ValueTask<IBackendMessage> ReadMessage(bool async, DataRowLoadingMode dataRowLoadingMode = DataRowLoadingMode.NonSequential)
		{
			if (PendingPrependedResponses > 0 || dataRowLoadingMode == DataRowLoadingMode.Skip || ReadBuffer.ReadBytesLeft < 5)
			{
				return ReadMessageLong(async, dataRowLoadingMode, readingNotifications: false);
			}
			BackendMessageCode backendMessageCode = (BackendMessageCode)ReadBuffer.ReadByte();
			switch (backendMessageCode)
			{
			case BackendMessageCode.NotificationResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.ErrorResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.NoticeResponse:
			case BackendMessageCode.ParameterStatus:
				ReadBuffer.ReadPosition--;
				return ReadMessageLong(async, dataRowLoadingMode, readingNotifications: false);
			default:
			{
				int num = ReadBuffer.ReadInt32() - 4;
				if (num > ReadBuffer.ReadBytesLeft)
				{
					ReadBuffer.ReadPosition -= 5;
					return ReadMessageLong(async, dataRowLoadingMode, readingNotifications: false);
				}
				return new ValueTask<IBackendMessage>(ParseServerMessage(ReadBuffer, backendMessageCode, num, isPrependedMessage: false));
			}
			}
		}

		private async ValueTask<IBackendMessage?> ReadMessageLong(bool async, DataRowLoadingMode dataRowLoadingMode, bool readingNotifications, bool isReadingPrependedMessage = false)
		{
			if (PendingPrependedResponses > 0 && !isReadingPrependedMessage)
			{
				try
				{
					while (PendingPrependedResponses > 0)
					{
						await ReadMessageLong(async, DataRowLoadingMode.Skip, readingNotifications: false, isReadingPrependedMessage: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						PendingPrependedResponses--;
					}
					ReadingPrependedMessagesMRE.Set();
				}
				catch (Exception reason)
				{
					Break(reason);
					throw;
				}
			}
			PostgresException error = null;
			try
			{
				BackendMessageCode messageCode;
				IBackendMessage result;
				while (true)
				{
					await ReadBuffer.Ensure(5, async, readingNotifications).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					messageCode = (BackendMessageCode)ReadBuffer.ReadByte();
					int len = ReadBuffer.ReadInt32() - 4;
					if ((messageCode == BackendMessageCode.DataRow && dataRowLoadingMode != DataRowLoadingMode.NonSequential) || messageCode == BackendMessageCode.CopyData)
					{
						if (dataRowLoadingMode == DataRowLoadingMode.Skip)
						{
							await ReadBuffer.Skip(len, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (len > ReadBuffer.ReadBytesLeft)
					{
						if (len > ReadBuffer.Size)
						{
							NpgsqlReadBuffer readBuffer = ReadBuffer.AllocateOversize(len);
							if (_origReadBuffer == null)
							{
								_origReadBuffer = ReadBuffer;
							}
							else
							{
								ReadBuffer.Dispose();
							}
							ReadBuffer = readBuffer;
						}
						await ReadBuffer.Ensure(len, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					result = ParseServerMessage(ReadBuffer, messageCode, len, isReadingPrependedMessage);
					switch (messageCode)
					{
					case BackendMessageCode.ErrorResponse:
						error = PostgresException.Load(ReadBuffer, Settings.IncludeErrorDetail, LoggingConfiguration.ExceptionLogger);
						if (State == ConnectorState.Connecting)
						{
							throw error;
						}
						if (!PostgresErrorCodes.IsCriticalFailure(error, clusterError: false))
						{
							continue;
						}
						throw Break(error);
					case BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery:
						if (error != null)
						{
							NpgsqlEventSource.Log.CommandFailed();
							DataSource.MetricsReporter.ReportCommandFailed();
							throw error;
						}
						break;
					case BackendMessageCode.NotificationResponse:
					case BackendMessageCode.NoticeResponse:
					case BackendMessageCode.ParameterStatus:
						if (!readingNotifications)
						{
							continue;
						}
						return null;
					}
					break;
				}
				BackendMessageCode backendMessageCode = messageCode;
				if ((backendMessageCode == BackendMessageCode.NotificationResponse || backendMessageCode == BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery || backendMessageCode == BackendMessageCode.CopyData) ? true : false)
				{
					ReadBuffer.ResetFlushedBytes();
				}
				return result;
			}
			catch (PostgresException ex)
			{
				if (ex.SqlState == "57014" && PostgresCancellationPerformed)
				{
					throw UserCancellationRequested ? ((SystemException)new OperationCanceledException("Query was cancelled", ex, UserCancellationToken)) : ((SystemException)new NpgsqlException("Exception while reading from stream", new TimeoutException("Timeout during reading attempt")));
				}
				throw;
			}
			catch (NpgsqlException)
			{
				if (error != null)
				{
					ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(error).Throw();
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		internal IBackendMessage? ParseResultSetMessage(NpgsqlReadBuffer buf, BackendMessageCode code, int len, bool handleCallbacks = false)
		{
			return code switch
			{
				BackendMessageCode.DataRow => _dataRowMessage.Load(len), 
				BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete => _commandCompleteMessage.Load(buf, len), 
				_ => ParseServerMessage(buf, code, len, isPrependedMessage: false, handleCallbacks), 
			};
		}

		internal IBackendMessage? ParseServerMessage(NpgsqlReadBuffer buf, BackendMessageCode code, int len, bool isPrependedMessage, bool handleCallbacks = true)
		{
			switch (code)
			{
			case BackendMessageCode.RowDescription:
				return _rowDescriptionMessage.Load(buf, SerializerOptions);
			case BackendMessageCode.DataRow:
				return _dataRowMessage.Load(len);
			case BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete:
				return _commandCompleteMessage.Load(buf, len);
			case BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery:
			{
				ReadyForQueryMessage readyForQueryMessage = _readyForQueryMessage.Load(buf);
				if (!isPrependedMessage)
				{
					ProcessNewTransactionStatus(readyForQueryMessage.TransactionStatusIndicator);
				}
				return readyForQueryMessage;
			}
			case BackendMessageCode.EmptyQueryResponse:
				return EmptyQueryMessage.Instance;
			case BackendMessageCode.ParseComplete:
				return ParseCompleteMessage.Instance;
			case BackendMessageCode.ParameterDescription:
				return _parameterDescriptionMessage.Load(buf);
			case BackendMessageCode.BindComplete:
				return BindCompleteMessage.Instance;
			case BackendMessageCode.NoData:
				return NoDataMessage.Instance;
			case BackendMessageCode.CloseComplete:
				return CloseCompletedMessage.Instance;
			case BackendMessageCode.ParameterStatus:
				ReadParameterStatus(buf.GetNullTerminatedBytes(), buf.GetNullTerminatedBytes());
				return null;
			case BackendMessageCode.NoticeResponse:
				if (handleCallbacks)
				{
					PostgresNotice postgresNotice = PostgresNotice.Load(buf, Settings.IncludeErrorDetail, LoggingConfiguration.ExceptionLogger);
					LogMessages.ReceivedNotice(ConnectionLogger, postgresNotice.MessageText, Id);
					Connection?.OnNotice(postgresNotice);
				}
				return null;
			case BackendMessageCode.NotificationResponse:
				if (handleCallbacks)
				{
					Connection?.OnNotification(new NpgsqlNotificationEventArgs(buf));
				}
				return null;
			case BackendMessageCode.AuthenticationRequest:
			{
				AuthenticationRequestType authenticationRequestType = (AuthenticationRequestType)buf.ReadInt32();
				return authenticationRequestType switch
				{
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationOk => AuthenticationOkMessage.Instance, 
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationCleartextPassword => AuthenticationCleartextPasswordMessage.Instance, 
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationMD5Password => AuthenticationMD5PasswordMessage.Load(buf), 
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationGSS => AuthenticationGSSMessage.Instance, 
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationSSPI => AuthenticationSSPIMessage.Instance, 
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationGSSContinue => AuthenticationGSSContinueMessage.Load(buf, len), 
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationSASL => new AuthenticationSASLMessage(buf), 
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationSASLContinue => new AuthenticationSASLContinueMessage(buf, len - 4), 
					AuthenticationRequestType.AuthenticationSASLFinal => new AuthenticationSASLFinalMessage(buf, len - 4), 
					_ => throw new NotSupportedException($"Authentication method not supported (Received: {authenticationRequestType})"), 
				};
			}
			case BackendMessageCode.BackendKeyData:
				return new BackendKeyDataMessage(buf);
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyInResponse:
				return (_copyInResponseMessage ?? (_copyInResponseMessage = new CopyInResponseMessage())).Load(ReadBuffer);
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyOutResponse:
				return (_copyOutResponseMessage ?? (_copyOutResponseMessage = new CopyOutResponseMessage())).Load(ReadBuffer);
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyData:
				return (_copyDataMessage ?? (_copyDataMessage = new CopyDataMessage())).Load(len);
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyBothResponse:
				return (_copyBothResponseMessage ?? (_copyBothResponseMessage = new CopyBothResponseMessage())).Load(ReadBuffer);
			case BackendMessageCode.CopyDone:
				return CopyDoneMessage.Instance;
			case BackendMessageCode.ErrorResponse:
				return null;
			default:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException(string.Format("Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected value {0} of enum {1}. Please file a bug.", code, "BackendMessageCode"));
				return null;
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		internal IBackendMessage SkipUntil(BackendMessageCode stopAt)
		{
			IBackendMessage result;
			do
			{
				result = ReadMessage(async: false, DataRowLoadingMode.Skip).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			}
			while (result.Code != stopAt);
			return result;
		}

		internal Task Rollback(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ConnectionLogger.LogDebug("Rolling back transaction", Id);
			return ExecuteInternalCommand(PregeneratedMessages.RollbackTransaction, async, cancellationToken);
		}

		private void ProcessNewTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus newStatus)
		{
			if (newStatus == TransactionStatus)
			{
				return;
			}
			TransactionStatus = newStatus;
			switch (newStatus)
			{
			case TransactionStatus.Idle:
				break;
			case TransactionStatus.InFailedTransactionBlock:
			case TransactionStatus.InTransactionBlock:
				if (Connection == null)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("In multiplexing mode, transactions must be started with BeginTransaction");
				}
				break;
			case TransactionStatus.Pending:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Internal Npgsql bug: invalid TransactionStatus Pending received, should be frontend-only");
				break;
			default:
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected value {0} of enum TransactionStatus. Please file a bug.", newStatus);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void ClearTransaction(Exception? disposeReason = null)
		{
			Transaction?.DisposeImmediately(disposeReason);
			TransactionStatus = TransactionStatus.Idle;
		}

		private static RemoteCertificateValidationCallback SslRootValidation(bool verifyFull, string? certRootPath, X509Certificate2? caCertificate)
		{
			return delegate(object _, X509Certificate certificate, X509Chain chain, SslPolicyErrors sslPolicyErrors)
			{
				if (certificate == null || chain == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (sslPolicyErrors == SslPolicyErrors.None)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!verifyFull && sslPolicyErrors == SslPolicyErrors.RemoteCertificateNameMismatch)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (verifyFull && sslPolicyErrors.HasFlag(SslPolicyErrors.RemoteCertificateNameMismatch))
				{
					return false;
				}
				X509Certificate2Collection x509Certificate2Collection = new X509Certificate2Collection();
				if (certRootPath == null)
				{
					x509Certificate2Collection.Add(caCertificate);
				}
				else if (x509Certificate2Collection.Count == 0)
				{
					x509Certificate2Collection.Add(new X509Certificate2(certRootPath));
				}
				chain.ChainPolicy.ExtraStore.AddRange(x509Certificate2Collection);
				return chain.Build((certificate as X509Certificate2) ?? new X509Certificate2(certificate));
			};
		}

		internal void ResetCancellation()
		{
			lock (CancelLock)
			{
				if (PendingPrependedResponses > 0)
				{
					ReadingPrependedMessagesMRE.Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void PerformUserCancellation()
		{
			NpgsqlConnection connection = Connection;
			if (connection == null || connection.ConnectorBindingScope == ConnectorBindingScope.Reader || UserCancellationRequested)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (SyncObj)
			{
				if (!IsConnected)
				{
					return;
				}
				Monitor.Enter(CancelLock);
			}
			try
			{
				if (!ReadingPrependedMessagesMRE.Wait(0))
				{
					return;
				}
				_userCancellationRequested = true;
				if (AttemptPostgresCancellation && SupportsPostgresCancellation)
				{
					int cancellationTimeout = Settings.CancellationTimeout;
					if (PerformPostgresCancellation() && cancellationTimeout >= 0)
					{
						if (cancellationTimeout > 0)
						{
							ReadBuffer.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(cancellationTimeout);
							ReadBuffer.Cts.CancelAfter(cancellationTimeout);
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				ReadBuffer.Timeout = _cancelImmediatelyTimeout;
				ReadBuffer.Cts.Cancel();
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(CancelLock);
			}
		}

		internal bool PerformPostgresCancellation()
		{
			lock (CancelLock)
			{
				if (PostgresCancellationPerformed)
				{
					return true;
				}
				LogMessages.CancellingCommand(ConnectionLogger, Id);
				PostgresCancellationPerformed = true;
				try
				{
					new NpgsqlConnector(this).DoCancelRequest(BackendProcessId, _backendSecretKey);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (!(ex.InnerException is SocketException { SocketErrorCode: SocketError.ConnectionReset }))
					{
						ConnectionLogger.LogDebug(ex, "Exception caught while attempting to cancel command", Id);
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void DoCancelRequest(int backendProcessId, int backendSecretKey)
		{
			try
			{
				RawOpen(Settings.SslMode, new NpgsqlTimeout(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(ConnectionTimeout)), async: false, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
				WriteCancelRequest(backendProcessId, backendSecretKey);
				Flush();
				if (_stream.Read(ReadBuffer.Buffer, 0, 1) > 0)
				{
					ConnectionLogger.LogError("Received response after sending cancel request, shouldn't happen! First byte: " + ReadBuffer.Buffer[0]);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				FullCleanup();
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		internal CancellationTokenRegistration StartCancellableOperation(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken), bool attemptPgCancellation = true)
		{
			bool userCancellationRequested = (PostgresCancellationPerformed = false);
			_userCancellationRequested = userCancellationRequested;
			UserCancellationToken = cancellationToken;
			ReadBuffer.Cts.ResetCts();
			AttemptPostgresCancellation = attemptPgCancellation;
			return _cancellationTokenRegistration = cancellationToken.Register(delegate(object c)
			{
				((NpgsqlConnector)c).PerformUserCancellation();
			}, this);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		internal NestedCancellableScope StartNestedCancellableOperation(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken), bool attemptPgCancellation = true)
		{
			CancellationToken userCancellationToken = UserCancellationToken;
			UserCancellationToken = cancellationToken;
			bool attemptPostgresCancellation = AttemptPostgresCancellation;
			AttemptPostgresCancellation = attemptPgCancellation;
			CancellationTokenRegistration registration = cancellationToken.Register(delegate(object c)
			{
				((NpgsqlConnector)c).PerformUserCancellation();
			}, this);
			return new NestedCancellableScope(this, registration, userCancellationToken, attemptPostgresCancellation);
		}

		internal async Task CloseOngoingOperations(bool async)
		{
			NpgsqlDataReader currentReader = CurrentReader;
			ICancelable copyOperation = CurrentCopyOperation;
			if (currentReader != null)
			{
				await currentReader.Close(async, connectionClosing: true, isDisposing: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				if (copyOperation == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (copyOperation is NpgsqlBinaryImporter || copyOperation is NpgsqlCopyTextWriter || copyOperation is NpgsqlRawCopyStream { CanWrite: not false })
				{
					try
					{
						if (async)
						{
							await copyOperation.CancelAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						else
						{
							copyOperation.Cancel();
						}
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						CopyLogger.LogWarning(exception, "Error while cancelling COPY on connector close", Id);
					}
				}
				try
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await copyOperation.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						copyOperation.Dispose();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception2)
				{
					CopyLogger.LogWarning(exception2, "Error while disposing cancelled COPY on connector close", Id);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Close()
		{
			lock (SyncObj)
			{
				if (IsReady)
				{
					LogMessages.ClosingPhysicalConnection(ConnectionLogger, Host, Port, Database, UserFacingConnectionString, Id);
					try
					{
						WriteBuffer.Clear();
						WriteTerminate();
						Flush();
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						ConnectionLogger.LogError(exception, "Exception while closing connector", Id);
					}
				}
				ConnectorState state = State;
				if (state == ConnectorState.Closed || state == ConnectorState.Broken)
				{
					return;
				}
				State = ConnectorState.Closed;
			}
			FullCleanup();
			LogMessages.ClosedPhysicalConnection(ConnectionLogger, Host, Port, Database, UserFacingConnectionString, Id);
		}

		internal bool TryRemovePendingEnlistedConnector(Transaction transaction)
		{
			return DataSource.TryRemovePendingEnlistedConnector(this, transaction);
		}

		internal void Return()
		{
			DataSource.Return(this);
		}

		internal Exception UnexpectedMessageReceived(BackendMessageCode received)
		{
			throw Break(new Exception($"Received unexpected backend message {received}. Please file a bug."));
		}

		internal Exception Break(Exception reason)
		{
			Monitor.Enter(SyncObj);
			if (State == ConnectorState.Broken)
			{
				Monitor.Exit(SyncObj);
				lock (CleanupLock)
				{
					return reason;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				ReadingPrependedMessagesMRE.Set();
				LogMessages.BreakingConnection(ConnectionLogger, Id, reason);
				Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _breakReason, reason, null);
				State = ConnectorState.Broken;
				Monitor.Enter(CleanupLock);
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(SyncObj);
			}
			try
			{
				lock (CancelLock)
				{
					if ((reason is NpgsqlException { IsTransient: not false } ex && (!(ex.InnerException is TimeoutException) || Settings.CancellationTimeout != -1)) || (reason is PostgresException e && PostgresErrorCodes.IsCriticalFailure(e)))
					{
						DataSource.UpdateDatabaseState(DatabaseState.Offline, DateTime.UtcNow, Settings.HostRecheckSecondsTranslated);
						DataSource.Clear();
					}
					NpgsqlConnection connection = Connection;
					FullCleanup();
					if (connection != null)
					{
						connection.TakeCloseLock();
						if (Settings.ReplicationMode == ReplicationMode.Off)
						{
							Connection = null;
							if (connection.ConnectorBindingScope != ConnectorBindingScope.None)
							{
								Return();
							}
							connection.EnlistedTransaction = null;
							connection.Connector = null;
							connection.ConnectorBindingScope = ConnectorBindingScope.None;
						}
						connection.FullState = ConnectionState.Broken;
						connection.ReleaseCloseLock();
					}
					return reason;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(CleanupLock);
			}
		}

		private void FullCleanup()
		{
			lock (CleanupLock)
			{
				if (Settings.Multiplexing)
				{
					FlagAsNotWritableForMultiplexing();
					CommandsInFlightWriter.Complete();
				}
				ConnectionLogger.LogTrace("Cleaning up connector", Id);
				Cleanup();
				if (_isKeepAliveEnabled)
				{
					_keepAliveTimer.Change(-1, -1);
					_keepAliveTimer.Dispose();
				}
				ReadingPrependedMessagesMRE.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void Cleanup()
		{
			try
			{
				_stream?.Dispose();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (CurrentReader != null)
			{
				CurrentReader.Command.State = CommandState.Idle;
				try
				{
					CurrentReader.Close();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				CurrentReader = null;
			}
			if (CurrentCopyOperation != null)
			{
				try
				{
					CurrentCopyOperation.Dispose();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				CurrentCopyOperation = null;
			}
			ClearTransaction(_breakReason);
			_stream = null;
			_baseStream = null;
			_origReadBuffer?.Dispose();
			_origReadBuffer = null;
			ReadBuffer?.Dispose();
			ReadBuffer = null;
			WriteBuffer?.Dispose();
			WriteBuffer = null;
			Connection = null;
			PostgresParameters.Clear();
			_currentCommand = null;
			if (_certificate != null)
			{
				_certificate.Dispose();
				_certificate = null;
			}
		}

		private void GenerateResetMessage()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION DEFAULT;RESET ALL;");
			_resetWithoutDeallocateResponseCount = 2;
			if (DatabaseInfo.SupportsCloseAll)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("CLOSE ALL;");
				_resetWithoutDeallocateResponseCount++;
			}
			if (DatabaseInfo.SupportsUnlisten)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("UNLISTEN *;");
				_resetWithoutDeallocateResponseCount++;
			}
			if (DatabaseInfo.SupportsAdvisoryLocks)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("SELECT pg_advisory_unlock_all();");
				_resetWithoutDeallocateResponseCount += 2;
			}
			if (DatabaseInfo.SupportsDiscardSequences)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("DISCARD SEQUENCES;");
				_resetWithoutDeallocateResponseCount++;
			}
			if (DatabaseInfo.SupportsDiscardTemp)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("DISCARD TEMP");
				_resetWithoutDeallocateResponseCount++;
			}
			_resetWithoutDeallocateResponseCount++;
			_resetWithoutDeallocateMessage = PregeneratedMessages.Generate(WriteBuffer, stringBuilder.ToString());
		}

		internal async Task Reset(bool async)
		{
			bool flag;
			using (StartUserAction(default(CancellationToken), attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				WriteBuffer.Clear();
				PendingPrependedResponses = 0;
				ResetReadBuffer();
				Transaction?.UnbindIfNecessary();
				switch (TransactionStatus)
				{
				case TransactionStatus.Idle:
				{
					NpgsqlConnection? connection = Connection;
					flag = connection != null && connection.ConnectorBindingScope == ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction;
					break;
				}
				case TransactionStatus.Pending:
					ProcessNewTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.Idle);
					ClearTransaction();
					flag = true;
					break;
				case TransactionStatus.InFailedTransactionBlock:
				case TransactionStatus.InTransactionBlock:
					await Rollback(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					ClearTransaction();
					flag = true;
					break;
				default:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException(string.Format("Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected value {0} of enum {1}. Please file a bug.", TransactionStatus, "TransactionStatus"));
					return;
				}
				if (_sendResetOnClose)
				{
					if (PreparedStatementManager.NumPrepared > 0)
					{
						PrependInternalMessage(_resetWithoutDeallocateMessage, _resetWithoutDeallocateResponseCount);
					}
					else
					{
						PrependInternalMessage(PregeneratedMessages.DiscardAll, 2);
					}
				}
				DataReader.UnbindIfNecessary();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Connection?.EndBindingScope(ConnectorBindingScope.Transaction);
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private void ResetReadBuffer()
		{
			LongRunningConnection = false;
			if (_origReadBuffer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ReadBuffer.ReadBytesLeft > 0)
			{
				if (ReadBuffer.ReadBytesLeft > _origReadBuffer.Size)
				{
					return;
				}
				ReadBuffer.CopyTo(_origReadBuffer);
			}
			ReadBuffer.Dispose();
			ReadBuffer = _origReadBuffer;
			_origReadBuffer = null;
		}

		internal void UnprepareAll()
		{
			ExecuteInternalCommand("DEALLOCATE ALL");
			PreparedStatementManager.ClearAll();
		}

		internal UserAction StartUserAction(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken), bool attemptPgCancellation = true)

		internal UserAction StartUserAction(ConnectorState newState, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken), bool attemptPgCancellation = true)

		internal UserAction StartUserAction(ConnectorState newState, NpgsqlCommand? command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken), bool attemptPgCancellation = true)
		{
			if (!_isKeepAliveEnabled)
			{
				return DoStartUserAction(newState, command, cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation);
			}
			return DoStartUserActionWithKeepAlive(newState, command, cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation);
			UserAction DoStartUserAction(ConnectorState state, NpgsqlCommand? npgsqlCommand, CancellationToken cancellationToken2, bool attemptPgCancellation2)
			{
				switch (State)
				{
				case ConnectorState.Closed:
				case ConnectorState.Broken:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Connection is not open");
					break;
				case ConnectorState.Connecting:
				case ConnectorState.Executing:
				case ConnectorState.Fetching:
				case ConnectorState.Waiting:
				case ConnectorState.Copy:
				case ConnectorState.Replication:
				{
					NpgsqlCommand currentCommand = _currentCommand;
					if (currentCommand == null)
					{
						ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlOperationInProgressException(State);
					}
					else
					{
						ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlOperationInProgressException(currentCommand);
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("State", "Invalid connector state: {0}", State);
					break;
				case ConnectorState.Ready:
					break;
				}
				cancellationToken2.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				LogMessages.StartUserAction(ConnectionLogger, Id);
				State = state;
				_currentCommand = npgsqlCommand;
				StartCancellableOperation(cancellationToken2, attemptPgCancellation2);
				ReadBuffer.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(npgsqlCommand?.CommandTimeout ?? Settings.CommandTimeout);
				return new UserAction(this);
			}
			UserAction DoStartUserActionWithKeepAlive(ConnectorState newState2, NpgsqlCommand? command2, CancellationToken cancellationToken2, bool attemptPgCancellation2)
			{
				lock (SyncObj)
				{
					if (!IsConnected)
					{
						if (IsBroken)
						{
							ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlException("The connection was previously broken because of the following exception", _breakReason);
						}
						else
						{
							ThrowHelper.ThrowNpgsqlException("The connection is closed");
						}
					}
					_keepAliveTimer.Change(-1, -1);
					try
					{
						return DoStartUserAction(newState2, command2, cancellationToken2, attemptPgCancellation2);
					}
					catch (Exception ex) when (!(ex is NpgsqlOperationInProgressException))
					{
						int num = Settings.KeepAlive * 1000;
						_keepAliveTimer.Change(num, num);
						throw;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EndUserAction()
		{
			_cancellationTokenRegistration.Dispose();
			if (_isKeepAliveEnabled)
			{
				lock (SyncObj)
				{
					if (!IsReady && IsConnected)
					{
						int num = Settings.KeepAlive * 1000;
						_keepAliveTimer.Change(num, num);
						LogMessages.EndUserAction(ConnectionLogger, Id);
						_currentCommand = null;
						State = ConnectorState.Ready;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!IsReady && IsConnected)
			{
				LogMessages.EndUserAction(ConnectionLogger, Id);
				_currentCommand = null;
				State = ConnectorState.Ready;
			}
		}

		private void PerformKeepAlive(object? state)
		{
			if (!Monitor.TryEnter(SyncObj))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (IsReady)
				{
					LogMessages.SendingKeepalive(ConnectionLogger, Id);
					AttemptPostgresCancellation = false;
					int num = Math.Max(Settings.CommandTimeout, 3);
					NpgsqlReadBuffer readBuffer = ReadBuffer;
					TimeSpan timeout = (WriteBuffer.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(num));
					readBuffer.Timeout = timeout;
					WriteSync(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
					Flush();
					SkipUntil(BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery);
					LogMessages.CompletedKeepalive(ConnectionLogger, Id);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				LogMessages.KeepaliveFailed(ConnectionLogger, Id, ex);
				try
				{
					Break(new NpgsqlException("Exception while sending a keepalive", ex));
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					ConnectionLogger.LogError(exception, "Further exception while breaking connector on keepalive failure", Id);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(SyncObj);
			}
		}

		internal async Task<bool> Wait(bool async, int timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			using (StartUserAction(ConnectorState.Waiting, cancellationToken, attemptPgCancellation: false))
			{
				await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				int keepaliveMs = Settings.KeepAlive * 1000;
				while (true)
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					bool timeoutForKeepalive = _isKeepAliveEnabled && (timeout <= 0 || keepaliveMs < timeout);
					ReadBuffer.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(timeoutForKeepalive ? keepaliveMs : timeout);
					try
					{
						IBackendMessage backendMessage = await ReadMessageWithNotifications(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						if (backendMessage != null)
						{
							throw Break(new NpgsqlException($"Received unexpected message of type {backendMessage.Code} while waiting"));
						}
						return true;
					}
					catch (NpgsqlException ex) when (ex.InnerException is TimeoutException)
					{
						if (!timeoutForKeepalive)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					LogMessages.SendingKeepalive(ConnectionLogger, Id);
					Stopwatch keepaliveTime = Stopwatch.StartNew();
					await WriteSync(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					bool receivedNotification = false;
					BackendMessageCode expectedMessageCode = BackendMessageCode.RowDescription;
					IBackendMessage backendMessage2;
					while (true)
					{
						try
						{
							backendMessage2 = await ReadMessageWithNotifications(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						catch (Exception ex2) when (ex2 is OperationCanceledException || (ex2 is NpgsqlException ex3 && ex3.InnerException is TimeoutException))
						{
							Break(ex2);
							throw;
						}
						if (backendMessage2 != null)
						{
							break;
						}
						receivedNotification = true;
					}
					if (backendMessage2.Code != BackendMessageCode.ReadyForQuery)
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException($"Received unexpected message of type {backendMessage2.Code} while expecting {expectedMessageCode} as part of keepalive");
					}
					LogMessages.CompletedKeepalive(ConnectionLogger, Id);
					if (receivedNotification)
					{
						break;
					}
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					if (timeout > 0)
					{
						timeout -= keepaliveMs + (int)keepaliveTime.ElapsedMilliseconds;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal void ExecuteInternalCommand(string query)

		}

		internal async Task ExecuteInternalCommand(string query, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			LogMessages.ExecutingInternalCommand(CommandLogger, query, Id);
			await WriteQuery(query, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), this);
			Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), this);
		}

		internal async Task ExecuteInternalCommand(byte[] data, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await WritePregenerated(data, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			Statics.Expect<CommandCompleteMessage>(await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), this);
			Statics.Expect<ReadyForQueryMessage>(await ReadMessage(async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), this);
		}

		private void ReadParameterStatus(ReadOnlySpan<byte> incomingName, ReadOnlySpan<byte> incomingValue)
		{
			int num = 0;
			byte[] array;
			byte[] array2;
			while (true)
			{
				if (num >= _rawParameters.Count)
				{
					array = incomingName.ToArray();
					array2 = incomingValue.ToArray();
					_rawParameters.Add((array, array2));
					break;
				}
				var (array3, array4) = _rawParameters[num];
				if (incomingName.SequenceEqual(array3))
				{
					if (incomingValue.SequenceEqual(array4))
					{
						return;
					}
					array = array3;
					array2 = incomingValue.ToArray();
					_rawParameters[num] = (array, array2);
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			string text = TextEncoding.GetString(array);
			string text2 = TextEncoding.GetString(array2);
			PostgresParameters[text] = text2;
			switch (text)
			{
			case "standard_conforming_strings":
				if (text2 != "on" && Settings.Multiplexing)
				{
					throw Break(new NotSupportedException("standard_conforming_strings must be on with multiplexing"));
				}

				break;
			case "TimeZone":
				Timezone = text2;
				break;
			case "default_transaction_read_only":

			}
		}

		private DatabaseState? UpdateDatabaseState()
		{

		}

		internal async Task WriteParse(string sql, byte[] asciiName, List<NpgsqlParameter> inputParameters, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			int queryByteLen;
			try
			{
				queryByteLen = TextEncoding.GetByteCount(sql);
			}
			catch (Exception reason)
			{
				Break(reason);
				throw;
			}
			NpgsqlWriteBuffer writeBuffer = WriteBuffer;
			int messageLength = 5 + asciiName.Length + 1 + queryByteLen + 1 + 2 + inputParameters.Count * 4;
			WriteBuffer.StartMessage(messageLength);
			if (WriteBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 5 + asciiName.Length + 1)
			{
				await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			WriteBuffer.WriteByte(80);
			WriteBuffer.WriteInt32(messageLength - 1);
			WriteBuffer.WriteNullTerminatedString(asciiName);
			await writeBuffer.WriteString(sql, queryByteLen, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (writeBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 3)
			{
				await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writeBuffer.WriteByte(0);
			writeBuffer.WriteUInt16((ushort)inputParameters.Count);
			NpgsqlDatabaseInfo databaseInfo = DatabaseInfo;
			foreach (NpgsqlParameter p in inputParameters)
			{
				if (writeBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 4)
				{
					await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writeBuffer.WriteUInt32(databaseInfo.GetOid(p.PgTypeId).Value);
			}
		}

		internal async Task WriteBind(List<NpgsqlParameter> parameters, string portal, byte[] asciiName, bool allResultTypesAreUnknown, bool[]? unknownResultTypeList, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			int num = 6 + asciiName.Length + 1 + 2;
			NpgsqlWriteBuffer writeBuffer = WriteBuffer;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Count; i++)
			{
				parameters[i].Bind(out var format, out var size);
				num3 += ((size.Value > 0) ? size.Value : 0);
				num2 += format.ToFormatCode();
			}
			int formatCodeListLength = ((num2 != 0) ? ((num2 == parameters.Count) ? 1 : parameters.Count) : 0);
			int messageLength = num + 2 * formatCodeListLength + 2 + 4 * parameters.Count + num3 + 2 + 2 * ((unknownResultTypeList == null) ? 1 : unknownResultTypeList.Length);
			WriteBuffer.StartMessage(messageLength);
			if (WriteBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < num)
			{
				await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			WriteBuffer.WriteByte(66);
			WriteBuffer.WriteInt32(messageLength - 1);
			writeBuffer.WriteByte(0);
			writeBuffer.WriteNullTerminatedString(asciiName);
			writeBuffer.WriteInt16((short)formatCodeListLength);
			if (formatCodeListLength == 1)
			{
				if (writeBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 2)
				{
					await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writeBuffer.WriteInt16(DataFormat.Binary.ToFormatCode());
			}
			else if (formatCodeListLength > 1)
			{
				for (int paramIndex = 0; paramIndex < parameters.Count; paramIndex++)
				{
					if (writeBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 2)
					{
						await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					writeBuffer.WriteInt16(parameters[paramIndex].Format.ToFormatCode());
				}
			}
			if (writeBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 2)
			{
				await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writeBuffer.WriteUInt16((ushort)parameters.Count);
			if (parameters.Count > 0)
			{
				PgWriter writer = writeBuffer.GetWriter(DatabaseInfo, (!async) ? FlushMode.Blocking : FlushMode.NonBlocking);
				try
				{
					for (int paramIndex = 0; paramIndex < parameters.Count; paramIndex++)
					{
						await parameters[paramIndex].Write(async, writer, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception reason)
				{
					Break(reason);
					throw;
				}
			}
			if (unknownResultTypeList != null)
			{
				if (writeBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 2 + unknownResultTypeList.Length * 2)
				{
					await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writeBuffer.WriteInt16((short)unknownResultTypeList.Length);
				foreach (bool flag in unknownResultTypeList)
				{
					writeBuffer.WriteInt16((!flag) ? ((short)1) : ((short)0));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (writeBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 4)
				{
					await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writeBuffer.WriteInt16(1);
				writeBuffer.WriteInt16((!allResultTypesAreUnknown) ? ((short)1) : ((short)0));
			}
		}

			Write(writeBuffer, num, type, asciiName);
			return Task.CompletedTask;

		internal async Task WriteQuery(string sql, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			int queryByteLen = TextEncoding.GetByteCount(sql);

			WriteBuffer.StartMessage(len);
			if (WriteBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 5)
			{
				await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			WriteBuffer.WriteByte(81);
			WriteBuffer.WriteInt32(len - 1);
			await WriteBuffer.WriteString(sql, queryByteLen, async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (WriteBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 1)
			{
				await Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			WriteBuffer.WriteByte(0);
		}

		internal void WriteStartup(Dictionary<string, string> parameters)
		{
			int num = 9;

		internal Task WritePassword(byte[] payload, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))

		internal async Task WritePassword(byte[] payload, int offset, int count, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			WriteBuffer.StartMessage(5 + count);
			if (WriteBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < 5)
			{
				await WriteBuffer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			WriteBuffer.WriteByte(112);
			WriteBuffer.WriteInt32(4 + count);
			if (count <= WriteBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft)
			{
				WriteBuffer.WriteBytes(payload, offset, count);
				return;
			}
			await WriteBuffer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			await WriteBuffer.DirectWrite(new ReadOnlyMemory<byte>(payload, offset, count), async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		internal async Task WriteSASLInitialResponse(string mechanism, byte[] initialResponse, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			int len = 5 + NpgsqlWriteBuffer.UTF8Encoding.GetByteCount(mechanism) + 1 + 4 + ((initialResponse != null) ? initialResponse.Length : 0);
			WriteBuffer.StartMessage(len);
			if (WriteBuffer.WriteSpaceLeft < len)
			{
				await WriteBuffer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			WriteBuffer.WriteByte(112);
			WriteBuffer.WriteInt32(len - 1);
			WriteBuffer.WriteString(mechanism);
			WriteBuffer.WriteByte(0);
			if (initialResponse == null)
			{
				WriteBuffer.WriteInt32(-1);
				return;
			}
			WriteBuffer.WriteInt32(initialResponse.Length);
			WriteBuffer.WriteBytes(initialResponse);
		}

			{

			return Task.CompletedTask;

			{

				WriteBuffer.WriteBytes(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
		}

		internal void Flush()
		{
			WriteBuffer.Flush(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		}

		private static byte[] Hi(string str, byte[] salt, int count)
		{
			using HMACSHA256 hMACSHA = new HMACSHA256(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(str));
			byte[] array = new byte[salt.Length + 4];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(salt, 0, array, 0, salt.Length);
			array[^1] = 1;
			byte[] buffer;
			byte[] array2 = (buffer = hMACSHA.ComputeHash(array));
			for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				byte[] array3 = hMACSHA.ComputeHash(buffer);
				Xor(array2, array3);
				buffer = array3;
			}
			return array2;
		}

		internal async Task AuthenticateGSS(bool async)
		{
			string targetName = KerberosServiceName + "/" + Host;
			using NegotiateStream negotiateStream = new NegotiateStream(new GSSPasswordMessageStream(this), leaveInnerStreamOpen: true);
			try
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await negotiateStream.AuthenticateAsClientAsync(CredentialCache.DefaultNetworkCredentials, targetName).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					negotiateStream.AuthenticateAsClient(CredentialCache.DefaultNetworkCredentials, targetName);
				}
			}
			catch (AuthenticationCompleteException)
			{
				return;
			}
			catch (IOException ex2) when (ex2.InnerException is AuthenticationCompleteException)
			{
				return;
			}
			catch (IOException ex3) when (ex3.InnerException is PostgresException)
			{
				throw ex3.InnerException;
			}
			throw new NpgsqlException("NegotiateStream.AuthenticateAsClient completed unexpectedly without signaling success");
		}
	}

	[Experimental("NPG9002")]
	public abstract class NpgsqlDatabaseInfo
	{
		private static volatile INpgsqlDatabaseInfoFactory[] Factories = new INpgsqlDatabaseInfoFactory[2]
		{
			new PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfoFactory(),
			new PostgresDatabaseInfoFactory()
		};

		private readonly List<PostgresBaseType> _baseTypesMutable = new List<PostgresBaseType>();

		private readonly List<PostgresArrayType> _arrayTypesMutable = new List<PostgresArrayType>();

		private readonly List<PostgresRangeType> _rangeTypesMutable = new List<PostgresRangeType>();

		private readonly List<PostgresMultirangeType> _multirangeTypesMutable = new List<PostgresMultirangeType>();

		private readonly List<PostgresEnumType> _enumTypesMutable = new List<PostgresEnumType>();

		private readonly List<PostgresCompositeType> _compositeTypesMutable = new List<PostgresCompositeType>();

		private readonly List<PostgresDomainType> _domainTypesMutable = new List<PostgresDomainType>();

		public string Host { get; }

		public int Port { get; }

		public string Name { get; }

		public Version Version { get; }

		public string ServerVersion { get; }

		public virtual bool SupportsRangeTypes => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(9, 2);

		public virtual bool SupportsMultirangeTypes => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(14);

		public virtual bool SupportsEnumTypes => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(8, 3);

		public virtual bool SupportsCloseAll => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(8, 3);

		public virtual bool SupportsAdvisoryLocks => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(8, 2);

		public virtual bool SupportsDiscardSequences => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(9, 4);

		public virtual bool SupportsUnlisten => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(6, 4);

		public virtual bool SupportsDiscardTemp => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(8, 3);

		public virtual bool SupportsDiscard => Version.IsGreaterOrEqual(8, 3);

		public virtual bool HasIntegerDateTimes { get; protected set; } = true;

		public virtual bool SupportsTransactions { get; protected set; } = true;

		internal IReadOnlyList<PostgresBaseType> BaseTypes => _baseTypesMutable;

		internal IReadOnlyList<PostgresArrayType> ArrayTypes => _arrayTypesMutable;

		internal IReadOnlyList<PostgresRangeType> RangeTypes => _rangeTypesMutable;

		internal IReadOnlyList<PostgresMultirangeType> MultirangeTypes => _multirangeTypesMutable;

		internal IReadOnlyList<PostgresEnumType> EnumTypes => _enumTypesMutable;

		internal IReadOnlyList<PostgresCompositeType> CompositeTypes => _compositeTypesMutable;

		internal IReadOnlyList<PostgresDomainType> DomainTypes => _domainTypesMutable;

		internal Dictionary<uint, PostgresType> ByOID { get; } = new Dictionary<uint, PostgresType>();

		internal Dictionary<string, PostgresType> ByFullName { get; } = new Dictionary<string, PostgresType>();

		internal Dictionary<string, PostgresType?> ByName { get; } = new Dictionary<string, PostgresType>();

		protected NpgsqlDatabaseInfo(string host, int port, string databaseName, Version version)
			: this(host, port, databaseName, version, version.ToString())
		{
		}

		protected NpgsqlDatabaseInfo(string host, int port, string databaseName, Version version, string serverVersion)
		{
			Host = host;
			Port = port;
			Name = databaseName;
			Version = version;
			ServerVersion = serverVersion;
		}

		private protected NpgsqlDatabaseInfo(string host, int port, string databaseName, string serverVersion)
		{
			Host = host;
			Port = port;
			Name = databaseName;
			ServerVersion = serverVersion;
			Version = ParseServerVersion(serverVersion);
		}

		internal PostgresType GetPostgresType(Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid oid)
		{
			return GetPostgresType(oid.Value);
		}

		public PostgresType GetPostgresType(uint oid)
		{
			if (!ByOID.TryGetValue(oid, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"A PostgreSQL type with the oid '{oid}' was not found in the current database info");
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal PostgresType GetPostgresType(DataTypeName dataTypeName)
		{
			if (!ByFullName.TryGetValue(dataTypeName.Value, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"A PostgreSQL type with the name '{dataTypeName}' was not found in the current database info");
			}
			return value;
		}

		public PostgresType GetPostgresType(string pgName)
		{
			if (!TryGetPostgresTypeByName(pgName, out PostgresType pgType))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A PostgreSQL type with the name '" + pgName + "' was not found in the current database info");
			}
			return pgType;
		}

		public bool TryGetPostgresTypeByName(string pgName, [NotNullWhen(true)] out PostgresType? pgType)
		{
			if (pgName.IndexOf('.') > -1)
			{
				if (ByFullName.TryGetValue(pgName, out pgType))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (ByName.TryGetValue(pgName, out pgType))
			{
				if (pgType != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ByFullName.TryGetValue("pg_catalog." + pgName, out pgType))
				{
					return true;
				}
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				foreach (string key in ByFullName.Keys)
				{
					if (key.EndsWith("." + pgName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
					{
						list.Add(key);
					}
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("More than one PostgreSQL type was found with the name " + pgName + ", please specify a full name including schema: " + string.Join(", ", list));
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ProcessTypes()
		{
			PostgresBaseType postgresBaseType = new PostgresBaseType(DataTypeName.Unspecified, Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid.Unspecified);
			ByOID[Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid.Unspecified.Value] = postgresBaseType;
			ByFullName[postgresBaseType.DataTypeName.Value] = postgresBaseType;
			ByName[postgresBaseType.InternalName] = postgresBaseType;
			foreach (PostgresType type in GetTypes())
			{
				ByOID[type.OID] = type;
				ByFullName[type.DataTypeName.Value] = type;
				ByName[type.InternalName] = (ByName.ContainsKey(type.InternalName) ? null : type);
				if (!(type is PostgresBaseType item))
				{
					if (!(type is PostgresArrayType item2))
					{
						if (!(type is PostgresRangeType item3))
						{
							if (!(type is PostgresMultirangeType item4))
							{
								if (!(type is PostgresEnumType item5))
								{
									if (!(type is PostgresCompositeType item6))
									{
										if (!(type is PostgresDomainType item7))
										{
											throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
										}
										_domainTypesMutable.Add(item7);
									}
									else
									{
										_compositeTypesMutable.Add(item6);
									}
								}
								else
								{
									_enumTypesMutable.Add(item5);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								_multirangeTypesMutable.Add(item4);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							_rangeTypesMutable.Add(item3);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						_arrayTypesMutable.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_baseTypesMutable.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerable<PostgresType> GetTypes();

		protected static Version ParseServerVersion(string value)
		{
			string text = value.TrimStart(Array.Empty<char>());
			for (int i = 0; i != text.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (!char.IsDigit(c) && c != '.')
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, i);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!text.Contains("."))
			{
				text += ".0";
			}
			return new Version(text);
		}

		public static void RegisterFactory(INpgsqlDatabaseInfoFactory factory)
		{
			if (factory == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("factory");
			}
			INpgsqlDatabaseInfoFactory[] array = new INpgsqlDatabaseInfoFactory[Factories.Length + 1];
			array[0] = factory;
			Array.Copy(Factories, 0, array, 1, Factories.Length);
			Factories = array;
		}

		internal static async Task<NpgsqlDatabaseInfo> Load(NpgsqlConnector conn, NpgsqlTimeout timeout, bool async)
		{
			INpgsqlDatabaseInfoFactory[] factories = Factories;
			for (int i = 0; i < factories.Length; i++)
			{
				NpgsqlDatabaseInfo npgsqlDatabaseInfo = await factories[i].Load(conn, timeout, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				if (npgsqlDatabaseInfo != null)
				{
					npgsqlDatabaseInfo.ProcessTypes();
					return npgsqlDatabaseInfo;
				}
			}
			throw new NpgsqlException("No DatabaseInfoFactory could be found for this connection");
		}

		internal static void ResetFactories()
		{
			Factories = new INpgsqlDatabaseInfoFactory[2]
			{
				new PostgresMinimalDatabaseInfoFactory(),
				new PostgresDatabaseInfoFactory()
			};
		}

		internal Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid GetOid(PgTypeId pgTypeId, bool validate = false)
		{
			if (!pgTypeId.IsOid)
			{
				return GetPostgresType(pgTypeId.DataTypeName).OID;
			}
			if (!validate)
			{
				return pgTypeId.Oid;
			}
			return GetPostgresType(pgTypeId.Oid).OID;
		}

		internal DataTypeName GetDataTypeName(PgTypeId pgTypeId, bool validate = false)
		{
			if (!pgTypeId.IsDataTypeName)
			{
				return GetPostgresType(pgTypeId.Oid).DataTypeName;
			}
			if (!validate)
			{
				return pgTypeId.DataTypeName;
			}
			return GetPostgresType(pgTypeId.DataTypeName).DataTypeName;
		}

		internal PostgresType GetPostgresType(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			if (!pgTypeId.IsOid)
			{
				return GetPostgresType(pgTypeId.DataTypeName.Value);
			}
			return GetPostgresType(pgTypeId.Oid.Value);
		}

		internal PostgresType? FindPostgresType(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			PostgresType value;
			if (!pgTypeId.IsOid)
			{
				if (!TryGetPostgresTypeByName(pgTypeId.DataTypeName.Value, out value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}
			if (!ByOID.TryGetValue(pgTypeId.Oid.Value, out value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	internal sealed class NpgsqlReadBuffer : IDisposable
	{
		internal sealed class ColumnStream : Stream, IAsyncDisposable
		{
			private readonly NpgsqlConnector _connector;

			private readonly NpgsqlReadBuffer _buf;

			private long _startPos;

			private int _start;

			private int _read;

			private bool _canSeek;

			private bool _commandScoped;

			internal int CurrentLength { get; private set; }

			internal bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

			public override bool CanRead => true;

			public override bool CanWrite => false;

			public override bool CanSeek => _canSeek;

			public override long Length
			{
				get
				{
					CheckDisposed();
					return CurrentLength;
				}
			}

			public override long Position
			{
				get
				{
					CheckDisposed();
					return _read;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", "Non - negative number required.");
					}
					Seek(value, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
			}

			internal ColumnStream(NpgsqlConnector connector)
			{
				_connector = connector;
				_buf = connector.ReadBuffer;
				IsDisposed = true;
			}

			internal void Init(int len, bool canSeek, bool commandScoped)
			{
				_startPos = _buf.CumulativeReadPosition;
				_canSeek = canSeek;
				_start = (canSeek ? _buf.ReadPosition : 0);
				CurrentLength = len;
				_read = 0;
				_commandScoped = commandScoped;
				IsDisposed = false;
			}

			public override void SetLength(long value)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

		public async Task Skip(int len, bool async)
		{
			if (len > ReadBytesLeft)
			{
				for (len -= ReadBytesLeft; len > Size; len -= Size)
				{
					ResetPosition();
					await Ensure(Size, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				ResetPosition();
				await Ensure(len, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			ReadPosition += len;
		}

						flag = false;
						int i;
						for (i = 0; i < FilledBytes; i++)
						{
							if (Buffer[i] == 0)
							{
								flag = true;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (byteLen + i > tempBuf.Length)
						{

							Array.Copy(tempBuf, 0, array, 0, byteLen);
							ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(tempBuf);
							tempBuf = array;
						}
						Array.Copy(Buffer, 0, tempBuf, byteLen, i);
						byteLen += i;

					}
					while (!flag);
					ReadPosition++;
					return encoding2.GetString(tempBuf, 0, byteLen);

		}

		public ReadOnlySpan<byte> GetNullTerminatedBytes()
		{
			int num = Span.IndexOf<byte>(0);
			ReadOnlySpan<byte> result = new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(Buffer, ReadPosition, num);
			ReadPosition += num + 1;
			return result;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!_disposed)
			{
				if (_usePool)
				{
					ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(Buffer);
				}
				Cts.Dispose();
				_disposed = true;
			}
		}

		private void ResetPosition()
		{
			_flushedBytes += FilledBytes;
			ReadPosition = 0;
			FilledBytes = 0;
		}

		internal void ResetFlushedBytes()
		{
			_flushedBytes = 0L;
		}

		internal void CopyTo(NpgsqlReadBuffer other)
		{
			Array.Copy(Buffer, ReadPosition, other.Buffer, other.FilledBytes, ReadBytesLeft);
			other.FilledBytes += ReadBytesLeft;
		}

		private static void ValidateArguments(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset");
			}
			if (count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			if (buffer.Length - offset < count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Offset and length were out of bounds for the array or count is greater than the number of elements from index to the end of the source collection.");
			}
		}

		public async Task Flush(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (_copyMode)
			{
				if (WritePosition == 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				int writePosition = WritePosition;
				WritePosition = 1;
				WriteInt32(writePosition - 1);
				WritePosition = writePosition;
			}
			else
			{
				if (WritePosition == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				AdvanceMessageBytesFlushed(WritePosition);
			}
			CancellationToken finalCt = ((async && Timeout > TimeSpan.Zero) ? _timeoutCts.Start(cancellationToken) : cancellationToken);
			try
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await Underlying.WriteAsync(Buffer, 0, WritePosition, finalCt).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await Underlying.FlushAsync(finalCt).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					if (Timeout > TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						_timeoutCts.Stop();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Underlying.Write(Buffer, 0, WritePosition);
					Underlying.Flush();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				_timeoutCts.Stop();
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				if (!(ex2 is OperationCanceledException))
				{
					if (!(ex2 is IOException) || (ex.InnerException as SocketException)?.SocketErrorCode != (SocketError?)((Type.GetType("Mono.Runtime") == null) ? 10060 : 10035))
					{
						throw Connector.Break(new NpgsqlException("Exception while writing to stream", ex));
					}
				}
				else if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					throw Connector.Break(ex);
				}
				throw Connector.Break(new NpgsqlException("Exception while writing to stream", new TimeoutException("Timeout during writing attempt")));
			}
			NpgsqlEventSource.Log.BytesWritten(WritePosition);
			_metricsReporter?.ReportBytesWritten(WritePosition);
			WritePosition = 0;
			if (_copyMode)
			{
				WriteCopyDataHeader();
			}
		}

		internal void Flush()
		{
			Flush(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		internal void DirectWrite(ReadOnlySpan<byte> buffer)

			}
		}

		public Task WriteBytesRaw(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> bytes, bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))

		internal void WriteStringChunked(char[] chars, int charIndex, int charCount, bool flush, out int charsUsed, out bool completed)
		{
			if (WriteSpaceLeft < _textEncoder.GetByteCount(chars, charIndex, (!char.IsHighSurrogate(chars[charIndex])) ? 1 : 2, flush: false))
			{
				charsUsed = 0;
				completed = false;
			}
			else
			{
				_textEncoder.Convert(chars, charIndex, charCount, Buffer, WritePosition, WriteSpaceLeft, flush, out charsUsed, out var bytesUsed, out completed);
				WritePosition += bytesUsed;
			}
		}

		internal unsafe void WriteStringChunked(string s, int charIndex, int charCount, bool flush, out int charsUsed, out bool completed)
		{
			int bytesUsed;
			fixed (char* ptr = s)
			{
				fixed (byte* buffer = Buffer)
				{
					if (WriteSpaceLeft < _textEncoder.GetByteCount(ptr + charIndex, (!char.IsHighSurrogate(ptr[charIndex])) ? 1 : 2, flush: false))
					{
						charsUsed = 0;
						completed = false;
						return;
					}
					_textEncoder.Convert(ptr + charIndex, charCount, buffer + WritePosition, WriteSpaceLeft, flush, out charsUsed, out bytesUsed, out completed);
				}
			}
			WritePosition += bytesUsed;
		}

		internal void StartCopyMode()
		{
			_copyMode = true;
			Size -= 5;
			WriteCopyDataHeader();
		}

		internal void EndCopyMode()
		{
			_copyMode = false;
			Size += 5;
			Clear();
		}

		private void WriteCopyDataHeader()
		{
			WriteByte(100);
			WriteInt32(0);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!_disposed)
			{
				_timeoutCts.Dispose();
				_disposed = true;
			}
		}

		internal void StartMessage(int messageLength)
		{
			if (MessageLengthValidation)
			{
				int? messageLength2 = _messageLength;
				if (messageLength2.HasValue && _messageBytesFlushed != _messageLength && WritePosition != -_messageBytesFlushed + _messageLength)
				{
					Throw();
				}
				_messageBytesFlushed = -WritePosition;
				_messageLength = messageLength;
			}
			void Throw()
			{
				throw Connector.Break(new OverflowException("Did not write the amount of bytes the message length specified"));
			}
		}

		private void AdvanceMessageBytesFlushed(int count)
		{
			int count2 = count;
			NpgsqlWriteBuffer npgsqlWriteBuffer = this;
			if (!MessageLengthValidation)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (count2 >= 0)
			{
				int? messageLength = _messageLength;
				if (messageLength.HasValue && !((long)_messageBytesFlushed + (long)count2 > _messageLength))
				{
					goto IL_0085;
				}
			}
			Throw();
			goto IL_0085;
			IL_0085:
			_messageBytesFlushed += count2;
			void Throw()
			{
				if (count2 < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count", "Can't advance by a negative count");
				}
				int? messageLength2 = _messageLength;
				if (!messageLength2.HasValue)
				{
					throw Connector.Break(new InvalidOperationException("No message was started"));
				}
				if ((long)_messageBytesFlushed + (long)count2 > _messageLength)
				{
					throw Connector.Break(new OverflowException("Tried to write more bytes than the message length specified"));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			WritePosition = 0;
			_messageLength = null;
		}

		internal byte[] GetContents()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[WritePosition];
			Array.Copy(Buffer, array, WritePosition);
			return array;
		}
