	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public abstract class PgBufferedConverter<T> : PgConverter<T>
	{
		protected PgBufferedConverter(bool customDbNullPredicate = false)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate)
		{
		}

		protected abstract T ReadCore(PgReader reader);

		protected abstract void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, T value);

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public sealed override T Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			if (!reader.IsAtStart && reader.ShouldBufferCurrent())
			{
				ThrowIORequired(reader.CurrentBufferRequirement);
			}
			return ReadCore(reader);
		}

		public sealed override ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return new ValueTask<T>(Read(reader));
		}

		internal sealed override ValueTask<object> ReadAsObject(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return new ValueTask<object>(Read(reader));
		}

		public sealed override void Write(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			if (!writer.BufferingWrite && writer.ShouldFlush(writer.CurrentBufferRequirement))
			{
				ThrowIORequired(writer.CurrentBufferRequirement);
			}
			WriteCore(writer, value);
		}

		public sealed override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, [DisallowNull] T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			Write(writer, value);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}

		internal sealed override ValueTask WriteAsObject(bool async, PgWriter writer, object value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Write(writer, (T)value);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class PgComposingConverterResolver<T> : PgConverterResolver<T>
	{
		private readonly PgTypeId? _pgTypeId;

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<PgConverter, PgConverter> _converters = new ConcurrentDictionary<PgConverter, PgConverter>(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance);

		public PgResolverTypeInfo EffectiveTypeInfo { get; }

		protected PgComposingConverterResolver(PgTypeId? pgTypeId, PgResolverTypeInfo effectiveTypeInfo)
		{
			if (!pgTypeId.HasValue && effectiveTypeInfo.PgTypeId.HasValue)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pgTypeId", "Cannot be null if effectiveTypeInfo.PgTypeId is not null.");
			}
			_pgTypeId = pgTypeId;
			EffectiveTypeInfo = effectiveTypeInfo;
		}

		protected abstract PgTypeId GetEffectivePgTypeId(PgTypeId pgTypeId);

		protected abstract PgTypeId GetPgTypeId(PgTypeId effectivePgTypeId);

		protected abstract PgConverter<T> CreateConverter(PgConverterResolution effectiveResolution);

		protected abstract PgConverterResolution? GetEffectiveResolution(T? value, PgTypeId? expectedEffectivePgTypeId);

		public override PgConverterResolution GetDefault(PgTypeId? pgTypeId)
		{
			PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId = (pgTypeId.HasValue ? new PgTypeId?(GetEffectiveTypeId(pgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault())) : ((PgTypeId?)null));
			PgConverterResolution defaultResolution = EffectiveTypeInfo.GetDefaultResolution(expectedPgTypeId);
			return new PgConverterResolution(GetOrAdd(defaultResolution), pgTypeId ?? _pgTypeId ?? GetPgTypeId(defaultResolution.PgTypeId));
		}

		public override PgConverterResolution? Get(T? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
		{
			PgTypeId? expectedEffectivePgTypeId = (expectedPgTypeId.HasValue ? new PgTypeId?(GetEffectiveTypeId(expectedPgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault())) : ((PgTypeId?)null));
			PgConverterResolution? effectiveResolution = GetEffectiveResolution(value, expectedEffectivePgTypeId);
			if (effectiveResolution.HasValue)
			{
				PgConverterResolution valueOrDefault = effectiveResolution.GetValueOrDefault();
				return new PgConverterResolution(GetOrAdd(valueOrDefault), expectedPgTypeId ?? _pgTypeId ?? GetPgTypeId(valueOrDefault.PgTypeId));
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override PgConverterResolution Get(Field field)
		{
			PgResolverTypeInfo effectiveTypeInfo = EffectiveTypeInfo;
			Field field2 = field;
			field2.PgTypeId = GetEffectiveTypeId(field.PgTypeId);
			PgConverterResolution resolution = effectiveTypeInfo.GetResolution(field2);
			return new PgConverterResolution(GetOrAdd(resolution), field.PgTypeId);
		}

		private PgTypeId GetEffectiveTypeId(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			if (_pgTypeId == pgTypeId)
			{
				return EffectiveTypeInfo.PgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			return GetEffectivePgTypeId(pgTypeId);
		}

		{
			(PgComposingConverterResolver<T>, PgConverterResolution) factoryArgument = (this, effectiveResolution);

		}

	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public abstract class PgConverter
	{
		internal enum DbNullPredicate : byte
		{
			None,
			Custom,
			Null,
			PolymorphicNull
		}

		internal DbNullPredicate DbNullPredicateKind { get; }

		public bool IsDbNullable => DbNullPredicateKind != DbNullPredicate.None;

		internal abstract Type TypeToConvert { get; }

		private protected PgConverter(Type type, bool isNullDefaultValue, bool customDbNullPredicate = false)
		{
			DbNullPredicateKind = (customDbNullPredicate ? DbNullPredicate.Custom : InferDbNullPredicate(type, isNullDefaultValue));
		}

		public abstract bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements);

		internal bool IsDbNullAsObject([NotNullWhen(false)] object? value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return DbNullPredicateKind switch
			{
				DbNullPredicate.Null => value == null, 
				DbNullPredicate.None => false, 
				DbNullPredicate.PolymorphicNull => (value == null || value is DBNull) ? true : false, 
				DbNullPredicate.Custom => IsDbNullValueAsObject(value, ref writeState) || (value == null && ThrowInvalidNullValue()), 
				_ => ThrowDbNullPredicateOutOfRange(), 
			};
		}

		private protected abstract bool IsDbNullValueAsObject(object? value, ref object? writeState);

		internal abstract Size GetSizeAsObject(SizeContext context, object value, ref object? writeState);

		internal object ReadAsObject(PgReader reader)
		{
			return ReadAsObject(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		internal ValueTask<object> ReadAsObjectAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ReadAsObject(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal abstract ValueTask<object> ReadAsObject(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

		internal void WriteAsObject(PgWriter writer, object value)
		{
			WriteAsObject(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		internal ValueTask WriteAsObjectAsync(PgWriter writer, object value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return WriteAsObject(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal abstract ValueTask WriteAsObject(bool async, PgWriter writer, object value, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

		private static DbNullPredicate InferDbNullPredicate(Type type, bool isNullDefaultValue)
		{
			if (!(type == typeof(object)) && !(type == typeof(DBNull)))
			{
				if (!isNullDefaultValue)
				{
					return DbNullPredicate.None;
				}
				return DbNullPredicate.Null;
			}
			return DbNullPredicate.PolymorphicNull;
		}

		[DoesNotReturn]
		private protected void ThrowIORequired(Size bufferRequirement)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException($"Buffer requirement '{bufferRequirement}' not respected for converter '{GetType().FullName}', expected no IO to be required.");
		}

		private protected static bool ThrowInvalidNullValue()
		{
			throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "Null value given for non-nullable type converter");
		}

		private protected bool ThrowDbNullPredicateOutOfRange()
		{
			throw new UnreachableException("Unknown case " + DbNullPredicateKind);
		}

		protected bool CanConvertBufferedDefault(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.Value;
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}
	}

		}

	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public abstract class PgConverterResolver
	{
		internal abstract Type TypeToConvert { get; }

		private protected PgConverterResolver()
		{
		}

		public abstract PgConverterResolution GetDefault(PgTypeId? pgTypeId);

		public virtual PgConverterResolution Get(Field field)
		{
			return GetDefault(field.PgTypeId);
		}

		internal abstract PgConverterResolution? GetAsObjectInternal(PgTypeInfo typeInfo, object? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId);

		internal PgConverterResolution GetDefaultInternal(bool validate, bool expectPortableTypeIds, PgTypeId? pgTypeId)
		{
			PgConverterResolution pgConverterResolution = GetDefault(pgTypeId);
			if (validate)
			{
				Validate("GetDefault", pgConverterResolution, TypeToConvert, pgTypeId, expectPortableTypeIds);
			}
			return pgConverterResolution;
		}

		internal PgConverterResolution GetInternal(PgTypeInfo typeInfo, Field field)
		{
			PgConverterResolution pgConverterResolution = Get(field);
			if (typeInfo.ValidateResolution)
			{
				Validate("Get", pgConverterResolution, TypeToConvert, field.PgTypeId, typeInfo.Options.PortableTypeIds);
			}
			return pgConverterResolution;
		}

		private protected static void Validate(string methodName, PgConverterResolution resolution, Type expectedTypeToConvert, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId, bool expectPortableTypeIds)
		{
			if (resolution.Converter == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("'" + methodName + "' returned a null Converter unexpectedly.");
			}
			if (expectedTypeToConvert != typeof(object) && resolution.Converter.TypeToConvert != expectedTypeToConvert)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format("'{0}' returned a {1} of type {2} instead of {3} unexpectedly.", methodName, "Converter", resolution.Converter.TypeToConvert, expectedTypeToConvert));
			}
			if ((expectPortableTypeIds && resolution.PgTypeId.IsOid) || (!expectPortableTypeIds && resolution.PgTypeId.IsDataTypeName))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(methodName + "' returned a resolution with a PgTypeId that was not in canonical form.");
			}
			if (expectedPgTypeId.HasValue)
			{
				PgTypeId pgTypeId = resolution.PgTypeId;
				PgTypeId? pgTypeId2 = expectedPgTypeId;
				if (pgTypeId != pgTypeId2)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("'" + methodName + "' returned a different PgTypeId than was passed in as expected. If such a mismatch occurs an exception should be thrown instead.");
				}
			}
		}

		protected ArgumentOutOfRangeException CreateUnsupportedPgTypeIdException(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			return new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("pgTypeId", pgTypeId, "Unsupported PgTypeId.");
		}
	}
	public abstract class PgConverterResolver<T> : PgConverterResolver
	{
		internal sealed override Type TypeToConvert => typeof(T);

		public abstract PgConverterResolution? Get(T? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId);

		internal PgConverterResolution? GetInternal(PgTypeInfo typeInfo, T? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
		{
			PgConverterResolution? result = Get(value, expectedPgTypeId);
			if (typeInfo.ValidateResolution && result.HasValue)
			{
				PgConverterResolver.Validate("Get", result.GetValueOrDefault(), TypeToConvert, expectedPgTypeId, typeInfo.Options.PortableTypeIds);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal sealed override PgConverterResolution? GetAsObjectInternal(PgTypeInfo typeInfo, object? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
		{
			PgConverterResolution? result = Get((value == null) ? default(T) : ((T)value), expectedPgTypeId);
			if (typeInfo.ValidateResolution && result.HasValue)
			{
				PgConverterResolver.Validate("Get", result.GetValueOrDefault(), TypeToConvert, expectedPgTypeId, typeInfo.Options.PortableTypeIds);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("count", "Cannot rewind further than the buffer start");
			}
			if (CurrentOffset < count)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("count", "Cannot rewind further than the current field offset");
			}
			_buffer.ReadPosition -= count;
		}

		private async ValueTask DisposeUserActiveStream(bool async)
		{
			if (StreamActive)
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await _userActiveStream.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					_userActiveStream.Dispose();
				}
			}
			_userActiveStream = null;
		}

		internal void GetCharsReadInfo(Encoding encoding, out int charsRead, out TextReader reader, out int charsOffset, out ArraySegment<char>? buffer)
		{
			if (!CharsReadActive)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No active chars read");
			}
			charsRead = _charsRead;
			reader = _charsReadReader ?? (_charsReadReader = GetTextReader(encoding));
			charsOffset = _charsReadOffset.GetValueOrDefault();
			buffer = _charsReadBuffer;
		}

		internal void RestartCharsRead()
		{
			if (!CharsReadActive)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No active chars read");
			}
			TextReader charsReadReader = _charsReadReader;
			if (!(charsReadReader is PreparedTextReader preparedTextReader))
			{
				if (charsReadReader is StreamReader streamReader)
				{
					streamReader.BaseStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
					streamReader.DiscardBufferedData();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				preparedTextReader.Restart();
			}
			_charsRead = 0;
		}

		internal void AdvanceCharsRead(int charsRead)
		{
			_charsRead += charsRead;
		}

		internal void StartCharsRead(int dataOffset, ArraySegment<char>? buffer)
		{
			if (!Resumable)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Wasn't initialized as resumed");
			}
			_charsReadOffset = dataOffset;
			_charsReadBuffer = buffer;
		}

		internal void EndCharsRead()
		{
			if (!Resumable)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Wasn't initialized as resumed");
			}
			if (!CharsReadActive)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("No active chars read");
			}
			_charsReadOffset = null;
			_charsReadBuffer = null;
		}

		internal PgReader Init(int fieldLength, DataFormat format, bool resumable = false)
		{
			if (Initialized)
			{
				if (resumable)
				{
					if (Resumable)
					{
						return this;
					}
					_resumable = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!IsAtStart)
					{
						ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Cannot be initialized to be non-resumable until a commit is issued.");
					}
					_resumable = false;
				}
			}
			_fieldStartPos = _buffer.CumulativeReadPosition;
			_fieldFormat = format;
			_fieldSize = fieldLength;
			_resumable = resumable;
			_fieldConsumed = false;
			return this;
		}

		internal void StartRead(Size bufferRequirement)
		{
			_fieldBufferRequirement = bufferRequirement;
			if (ShouldBuffer(bufferRequirement))
			{
				Buffer(bufferRequirement);
			}
		}

		internal ValueTask StartReadAsync(Size bufferRequirement, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			_fieldBufferRequirement = bufferRequirement;
			if (!ShouldBuffer(bufferRequirement))
			{
				return default(ValueTask);
			}
			return BufferAsync(bufferRequirement, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal void EndRead()
		{
			if (_resumable || StreamActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size fieldBufferRequirement = _fieldBufferRequirement;
			if (fieldBufferRequirement.Kind == SizeKind.UpperBound)
			{
				Consume(FieldRemaining);
				return;
			}
			if (FieldOffset != FieldSize)
			{
				ThrowNotConsumedExactly();
			}
			_fieldConsumed = true;
		}

		internal ValueTask EndReadAsync()
		{
			if (_resumable || StreamActive)
			{
				return default(ValueTask);
			}
			Size fieldBufferRequirement = _fieldBufferRequirement;
			if (fieldBufferRequirement.Kind == SizeKind.UpperBound)
			{
				return ConsumeAsync(FieldRemaining);
			}
			if (FieldOffset != FieldSize)
			{
				ThrowNotConsumedExactly();
			}
			_fieldConsumed = true;
			return default(ValueTask);
		}

		internal async ValueTask<NestedReadScope> BeginNestedRead(bool async, int size, Size bufferRequirement, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (size > CurrentRemaining)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("size", "Cannot begin a read for a larger size than the current remaining size.");
			}
			if (size < 0)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("size", "Cannot be negative");
			}
			int previousSize = CurrentSize;
			int previousStartPos = _currentStartPos;
			Size previousBufferRequirement = CurrentBufferRequirement;
			_currentSize = size;
			_currentBufferRequirement = bufferRequirement;
			_currentStartPos = FieldOffset;
			await Buffer(async, bufferRequirement, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return new NestedReadScope(async, this, previousSize, previousStartPos, previousBufferRequirement);
		}

		public NestedReadScope BeginNestedRead(int size, Size bufferRequirement)
		{
			return BeginNestedRead(async: false, size, bufferRequirement, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public ValueTask<NestedReadScope> BeginNestedReadAsync(int size, Size bufferRequirement, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return BeginNestedRead(async: true, size, bufferRequirement, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal void Seek(int offset)
		{
			if (CurrentOffset > offset)
			{
				Rewind(CurrentOffset - offset);
			}
			else if (CurrentOffset < offset)
			{
				Consume(offset - CurrentOffset);
			}
		}

		internal async ValueTask Consume(bool async, int? count = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (!(count <= 0) && FieldSize >= 0 && FieldRemaining != 0)
			{
				int num = count ?? CurrentRemaining;
				CheckBounds(num);
				_ = FieldOffset;
				if (!_buffer.Connector.IsBroken)
				{
					await _buffer.Skip(num, async).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Consume(int? count = null)
		{
			Consume(async: false, count).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public ValueTask ConsumeAsync(int? count = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Consume(async: true, count, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal void ThrowIfStreamActive()
		{
			if (StreamActive)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("A stream is already open for this reader");
			}
		}

		internal bool CommitHasIO(bool resuming)
		{
			if (Initialized && !resuming)
			{
				return FieldRemaining > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		internal void Commit(bool resuming)
		{
			if (!Initialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (resuming)
			{
				if (!Resumable)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Cannot resume a non-resumable read.");
				}
				return;
			}
			if (_requiresCleanup || (!_fieldConsumed && FieldRemaining > 0))
			{
				CommitSlow();
				return;
			}
			_fieldStartPos = -1L;
			if (HasCurrent)
			{
				_currentStartPos = 0;
				_currentBufferRequirement = default(Size);
				_currentSize = -1;
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			void CommitSlow()
			{
				if (_requiresCleanup)
				{
					if (StreamActive)
					{
						DisposeUserActiveStream(async: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
					}
					if (_pooledArray != null)
					{
						ArrayPool.Return(_pooledArray);
						_pooledArray = null;
					}
					if (_charsReadReader != null)
					{
						_charsReadReader.Dispose();
						_charsReadReader = null;
						_charsRead = 0;
					}
					_requiresCleanup = false;
				}
				Consume(async: false, FieldRemaining).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
				_fieldStartPos = -1L;
				if (HasCurrent)
				{
					_currentStartPos = 0;
					_currentBufferRequirement = default(Size);
					_currentSize = -1;
				}
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		internal ValueTask CommitAsync(bool resuming)
		{
			if (!Initialized)
			{
				return default(ValueTask);
			}
			if (resuming)
			{
				if (!Resumable)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Cannot resume a non-resumable read.");
				}
				return default(ValueTask);
			}
			if (_requiresCleanup || (!_fieldConsumed && FieldRemaining > 0))
			{
				return CommitSlow();
			}
			_fieldStartPos = -1L;
			if (HasCurrent)
			{
				_currentStartPos = 0;
				_currentBufferRequirement = default(Size);
				_currentSize = -1;
			}
			return default(ValueTask);
			async ValueTask CommitSlow()
			{
				if (_requiresCleanup)
				{
					if (StreamActive)
					{
						await DisposeUserActiveStream(async: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					if (_pooledArray != null)
					{
						ArrayPool.Return(_pooledArray);
						_pooledArray = null;
					}
					if (_charsReadReader != null)
					{
						_charsReadReader.Dispose();
						_charsReadReader = null;
						_charsRead = 0;
					}
					_requiresCleanup = false;
				}
				await Consume(async: true, FieldRemaining).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				_fieldStartPos = -1L;
				if (HasCurrent)
				{
					_currentStartPos = 0;
					_currentBufferRequirement = default(Size);
					_currentSize = -1;
				}
			}
		}

		private byte[] RentArray(int count)
		{
			_requiresCleanup = true;
			byte[] pooledArray = _pooledArray;
			if (pooledArray != null)
			{
				if (pooledArray.Length >= count)
				{
					return pooledArray;
				}
				ArrayPool.Return(pooledArray);
			}
			return _pooledArray = ArrayPool.Rent(count);
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private int GetBufferRequirementByteCount(Size bufferRequirement)
		{
			if (bufferRequirement.Kind != SizeKind.UpperBound)
			{
				return bufferRequirement.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			return Math.Min(CurrentRemaining, bufferRequirement.Value);
		}

		internal bool ShouldBufferCurrent()
		{
			return ShouldBuffer(CurrentBufferRequirement);
		}

		public bool ShouldBuffer(Size bufferRequirement)
		{
			return ShouldBuffer(GetBufferRequirementByteCount(bufferRequirement));
		}

		public bool ShouldBuffer(int byteCount)
		{
			if (_buffer.ReadBytesLeft < byteCount)
			{
				return ShouldBufferSlow();
			}
			return false;
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			bool ShouldBufferSlow()
			{
				if (byteCount > _buffer.Size)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("byteCount", "Buffer requirement is larger than the buffer size, this can never succeed by buffering data but requires a larger buffer size instead.");
				}
				if (byteCount > CurrentRemaining)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentOutOfRangeException("byteCount", "Buffer requirement is larger than the remaining length of the value, make sure the value is always at least this size or use an upper bound requirement instead.");
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public void Buffer(Size bufferRequirement)
		{
			Buffer(GetBufferRequirementByteCount(bufferRequirement));
		}

		public void Buffer(int byteCount)
		{
			_buffer.Ensure(byteCount);
		}

		public ValueTask BufferAsync(Size bufferRequirement, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return BufferAsync(GetBufferRequirementByteCount(bufferRequirement), cancellationToken);
		}

		public ValueTask BufferAsync(int byteCount, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return _buffer.EnsureAsync(byteCount);
		}

		internal ValueTask Buffer(bool async, Size bufferRequirement, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Buffer(async, GetBufferRequirementByteCount(bufferRequirement), cancellationToken);
		}

		internal ValueTask Buffer(bool async, int byteCount, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (async)
			{
				return BufferAsync(byteCount, cancellationToken);
			}
			Buffer(byteCount);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}

		private void ThrowNotConsumedExactly()
		{
			throw _buffer.Connector.Break(new InvalidOperationException((FieldOffset < FieldSize) ? $"The read on this field has not consumed all of its bytes (pos: {FieldOffset}, len: {FieldSize})" : $"The read on this field has consumed all of its bytes and read into the subsequent bytes (pos: {FieldOffset}, len: {FieldSize})"));
		}
	}
	public readonly struct NestedReadScope : IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable
	{
		private readonly PgReader _reader;

		private readonly int _previousSize;

		private readonly int _previousStartPos;

		private readonly Size _previousBufferRequirement;

		private readonly bool _async;

		internal NestedReadScope(bool async, PgReader reader, int previousSize, int previousStartPos, Size previousBufferRequirement)
		{
			_async = async;
			_reader = reader;
			_previousSize = previousSize;
			_previousStartPos = previousStartPos;
			_previousBufferRequirement = previousBufferRequirement;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (_async)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Cannot synchronously dispose async scopes, call DisposeAsync instead.");
			}
			DisposeAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			if (_reader.CurrentRemaining > 0)
			{
				if (_async)
				{
					return AsyncCore(_reader, _previousSize, _previousStartPos, _previousBufferRequirement);
				}
				_reader.Consume();
			}
			_reader.Revert(_previousSize, _previousStartPos, _previousBufferRequirement);
			return default(ValueTask);
			static async ValueTask AsyncCore(PgReader reader, int previousSize, int previousStartPos, Size previousBufferRequirement)
			{
				await reader.ConsumeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				reader.Revert(previousSize, previousStartPos, previousBufferRequirement);
			}
		}
	}
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public sealed class PgSerializerOptions
	{
		private readonly PgTypeInfoResolverChain _resolverChain;

		private readonly Func<string>? _timeZoneProvider;

		private IPgTypeInfoResolver? _typeInfoResolver;

		private object? _typeInfoCache;

		private PostgresType? _textPgType;

		private readonly bool _introspectionInstance;

		[field: ThreadStatic]
		internal static bool IntrospectionCaller { get; set; }

		internal PgTypeInfo UnspecifiedDBNullTypeInfo { get; }

		internal PostgresType TextPgType => _textPgType ?? (_textPgType = DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(DataTypeNames.Text));

		internal bool IntrospectionMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_introspectionInstance)
				{
					return IntrospectionCaller;
				}
				return true;
			}
			init
			{
				_introspectionInstance = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool PortableTypeIds { get; init; }

		internal NpgsqlDatabaseInfo DatabaseInfo { get; }

		public string TimeZone => _timeZoneProvider?.Invoke() ?? throw new NotSupportedException("TimeZone was not configured.");

		public Encoding TextEncoding { get; init; } = Encoding.UTF8;

		public IPgTypeInfoResolver TypeInfoResolver
		{
			get
			{
				return _typeInfoResolver ?? (_typeInfoResolver = new ChainTypeInfoResolver(_resolverChain));
			}
			internal init
			{
				_typeInfoResolver = value;
			}
		}

		public bool EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions { get; init; } = true;

		public ArrayNullabilityMode ArrayNullabilityMode { get; init; }

		public INpgsqlNameTranslator DefaultNameTranslator { get; init; } = NpgsqlSnakeCaseNameTranslator.Instance;

		internal bool RangesEnabled => _resolverChain.RangesEnabled;

		internal bool MultirangesEnabled => _resolverChain.MultirangesEnabled;

		internal bool ArraysEnabled => _resolverChain.ArraysEnabled;

		internal PgSerializerOptions(NpgsqlDatabaseInfo databaseInfo, PgTypeInfoResolverChain? resolverChain = null, Func<string>? timeZoneProvider = null)
		{
			_resolverChain = resolverChain.GetValueOrDefault();
			_timeZoneProvider = timeZoneProvider;
			DatabaseInfo = databaseInfo;
			UnspecifiedDBNullTypeInfo = new PgTypeInfo(this, new VoidConverter(), DataTypeName.Unspecified, typeof(DBNull));
		}

		public static bool IsWellKnownTextType(Type type)
		{
			type = (type.IsValueType ? (Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) ?? type) : type);
			if (Array.IndexOf(new Type[7]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(char),
				typeof(char[]),
				typeof(ReadOnlyMemory<char>),
				typeof(ArraySegment<char>),
				typeof(byte[]),
				typeof(ReadOnlyMemory<byte>)
			}, type) == -1)
			{
				return typeof(Stream).IsAssignableFrom(type);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfoCore(Type? type, PgTypeId? pgTypeId, bool defaultTypeFallback)
		{
			if (!PortableTypeIds)
			{
				return ((TypeInfoCache<Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid>)(_typeInfoCache ?? (_typeInfoCache = new TypeInfoCache<Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid>(this)))).GetOrAddInfo(type, pgTypeId?.Oid, defaultTypeFallback);
			}
			return ((TypeInfoCache<DataTypeName>)(_typeInfoCache ?? (_typeInfoCache = new TypeInfoCache<DataTypeName>(this)))).GetOrAddInfo(type, pgTypeId?.DataTypeName, defaultTypeFallback);
		}

		public PgTypeInfo? GetDefaultTypeInfo(PostgresType pgType)
		{
			return GetTypeInfoCore(null, ToCanonicalTypeId(pgType), defaultTypeFallback: false);
		}

		public PgTypeInfo? GetDefaultTypeInfo(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			return GetTypeInfoCore(null, pgTypeId, defaultTypeFallback: false);
		}

		public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type type, PostgresType pgType)
		{
			return GetTypeInfoCore(type, ToCanonicalTypeId(pgType), defaultTypeFallback: false);
		}

		public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type type, PgTypeId? pgTypeId = null)
		{
			return GetTypeInfoCore(type, pgTypeId, defaultTypeFallback: false);
		}

		public PgTypeInfo? GetObjectOrDefaultTypeInfo(PostgresType pgType)
		{
			return GetTypeInfoCore(typeof(object), ToCanonicalTypeId(pgType), defaultTypeFallback: true);
		}

		public PgTypeInfo? GetObjectOrDefaultTypeInfo(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			return GetTypeInfoCore(typeof(object), pgTypeId, defaultTypeFallback: true);
		}

		internal PgTypeId GetCanonicalTypeId(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			if (!PortableTypeIds)
			{
				return DatabaseInfo.GetOid(pgTypeId);
			}
			return DatabaseInfo.GetDataTypeName(pgTypeId);
		}

		internal PgTypeId ToCanonicalTypeId(PostgresType pgType)
		{
			if (!PortableTypeIds)
			{
				return (Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid)pgType.OID;
			}
			return pgType.DataTypeName;
		}

		public PgTypeId GetArrayTypeId(PgTypeId elementTypeId)
		{
			if (PortableTypeIds && elementTypeId.IsDataTypeName)
			{
				return elementTypeId.DataTypeName.ToArrayName();
			}
			return ToCanonicalTypeId(DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(elementTypeId).Array ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot resolve array type id"));
		}

		public PgTypeId GetArrayElementTypeId(PgTypeId arrayTypeId)
		{
			if (PortableTypeIds && arrayTypeId.IsDataTypeName)
			{
				DataTypeName dataTypeName = arrayTypeId.DataTypeName;
				if (dataTypeName.UnqualifiedNameSpan.StartsWith(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("_"), StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					dataTypeName = arrayTypeId.DataTypeName;
					string schema = dataTypeName.Schema;
					dataTypeName = arrayTypeId.DataTypeName;
					ReadOnlySpan<char> readOnlySpan = dataTypeName.UnqualifiedNameSpan;
					readOnlySpan = readOnlySpan.Slice(1);
					return new DataTypeName(schema + readOnlySpan);
				}
			}
			return ToCanonicalTypeId((DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(arrayTypeId) as PostgresArrayType)?.Element ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot resolve array element type id"));
		}

		public PgTypeId GetRangeTypeId(PgTypeId subtypeTypeId)
		{
			return ToCanonicalTypeId(DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(subtypeTypeId).Range ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot resolve range type id"));
		}

		public PgTypeId GetRangeSubtypeTypeId(PgTypeId rangeTypeId)
		{
			return ToCanonicalTypeId((DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(rangeTypeId) as PostgresRangeType)?.Subtype ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot resolve range subtype type id"));
		}

		public PgTypeId GetMultirangeTypeId(PgTypeId rangeTypeId)
		{
			return ToCanonicalTypeId((DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(rangeTypeId) as PostgresRangeType)?.Multirange ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot resolve multirange type id"));
		}

		public PgTypeId GetMultirangeElementTypeId(PgTypeId multirangeTypeId)
		{
			return ToCanonicalTypeId((DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(multirangeTypeId) as PostgresMultirangeType)?.Subrange ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot resolve multirange element type id"));
		}

		public bool TryGetDataTypeName(PgTypeId pgTypeId, out DataTypeName dataTypeName)
		{
			PostgresType postgresType = DatabaseInfo.FindPostgresType(pgTypeId);
			if (postgresType != null)
			{
				dataTypeName = postgresType.DataTypeName;
				return true;
			}
			dataTypeName = default(DataTypeName);
			return false;
		}

		public DataTypeName GetDataTypeName(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			if (TryGetDataTypeName(pgTypeId, out var dataTypeName))
			{
				return dataTypeName;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Unknown type id", "pgTypeId");
		}
	}
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public abstract class PgStreamingConverter<T> : PgConverter<T>
	{
		protected PgStreamingConverter(bool customDbNullPredicate = false)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.None;
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		internal Task<T>? ReadAsyncAsTask(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken, out T result)
		{
			ValueTask<T> valueTask = ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
			if (valueTask.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
			{
				result = valueTask.Result;
				return null;
			}
			result = default(T);
			return valueTask.AsTask();
		}

		internal unsafe sealed override ValueTask<object> ReadAsObject(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!async)
			{
				return new ValueTask<object>(Read(reader));
			}
			ValueTask<T> valueTask = ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
			if (!valueTask.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
			{
				return PgStreamingConverterHelpers.AwaitTask(valueTask.AsTask(), new PgStreamingConverterHelpers.Continuation((object)this, (delegate*<Task, object>)(&BoxResult)));
			}
			return new ValueTask<object>(valueTask.Result);
			static object BoxResult(Task task)
			{
				return new ValueTask<T>((Task<T>)task).Result;
			}
		}

		internal sealed override ValueTask WriteAsObject(bool async, PgWriter writer, object value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (async)
			{
				return WriteAsync(writer, (T)value, cancellationToken);
			}
			Write(writer, (T)value);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}
	}
	internal static class PgStreamingConverterHelpers
	{
		public readonly struct Continuation
		{
			private unsafe readonly delegate*<Task, object> _continuation;

			public object Handle { get; }

			public unsafe Continuation(object handle, delegate*<Task, object> continuation)
			{
				Handle = handle;
				_continuation = continuation;
			}

			public unsafe object Invoke(Task task)
			{
				return _continuation(task);
			}
		}

		public static async ValueTask<object> AwaitTask(Task task, Continuation continuation)
		{
			await task.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			object result = continuation.Invoke(task);
			GC.KeepAlive(continuation.Handle);
			return result;
		}
	}
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public class PgTypeInfo
	{
		private readonly bool _canBinaryConvert;

		private readonly BufferRequirements _binaryBufferRequirements;

		private readonly bool _canTextConvert;

		private readonly BufferRequirements _textBufferRequirements;

		public Type Type { get; }

		public PgSerializerOptions Options { get; }

		public bool SupportsWriting { get; init; }

		public DataFormat? PreferredFormat { get; init; }

		private PgConverter? Converter { get; }

		[MemberNotNullWhen(false, "Converter")]
		[MemberNotNullWhen(false, "PgTypeId")]
		internal bool IsResolverInfo
		{
			[MemberNotNullWhen(false, "Converter")]
			[MemberNotNullWhen(false, "PgTypeId")]
			get
			{
				return GetType() == typeof(PgResolverTypeInfo);
			}
		}

		internal bool ValidateResolution => true;

		internal bool IsBoxing { get; }

		public PgTypeId? PgTypeId { get; }

		private PgTypeInfo(PgSerializerOptions options, Type type, Type? unboxedType)
		{
			if ((object)unboxedType != null && !type.IsAssignableFrom(unboxedType))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A value of unboxed type is not assignable to converter type", "unboxedType");
			}
			Options = options;
			IsBoxing = (object)unboxedType != null;
			Type = unboxedType ?? type;
			SupportsWriting = true;
		}

		public PgTypeInfo(PgSerializerOptions options, PgConverter converter, PgTypeId pgTypeId, Type? unboxedType = null)
			: this(options, converter.TypeToConvert, unboxedType)
		{
			Converter = converter;
			PgTypeId = options.GetCanonicalTypeId(pgTypeId);
			_canBinaryConvert = converter.CanConvert(DataFormat.Binary, out _binaryBufferRequirements);
			_canTextConvert = converter.CanConvert(DataFormat.Text, out _textBufferRequirements);
		}

		private protected PgTypeInfo(PgSerializerOptions options, Type type, PgConverterResolution? resolution, Type? unboxedType = null)
			: this(options, type, unboxedType)
		{
			if (resolution.HasValue)
			{
				PgConverterResolution valueOrDefault = resolution.GetValueOrDefault();
				if ((options.PortableTypeIds && valueOrDefault.PgTypeId.IsOid) || (!options.PortableTypeIds && valueOrDefault.PgTypeId.IsDataTypeName))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Given type id is not in canonical form. Make sure ConverterResolver implementations close over canonical ids, e.g. by calling options.GetCanonicalTypeId(pgTypeId) on the constructor arguments.", "PgTypeId");
				}
				PgTypeId = valueOrDefault.PgTypeId;
				Converter = valueOrDefault.Converter;
				_canBinaryConvert = valueOrDefault.Converter.CanConvert(DataFormat.Binary, out _binaryBufferRequirements);
				_canTextConvert = valueOrDefault.Converter.CanConvert(DataFormat.Text, out _textBufferRequirements);
			}
		}

		private bool HasCachedInfo(PgConverter converter)
		{
			return Converter == converter;
		}

		internal void DisposeWriteState(object writeState)
		{
			if (writeState is IDisposable disposable)
			{
				disposable.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public PgConverterResolution GetResolution<T>(T? value)
		{
			if (!(this is PgResolverTypeInfo pgResolverTypeInfo))
			{
				return new PgConverterResolution(Converter, PgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault());
			}
			return pgResolverTypeInfo.GetResolution(value, null) ?? pgResolverTypeInfo.GetDefaultResolution(null);
		}

		public PgConverterResolution GetObjectResolution(object? value)
		{
			if (this != null)
			{
				if (!IsResolverInfo)
				{
					return new PgConverterResolution(Converter, PgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault());
				}
				if (this is PgResolverTypeInfo pgResolverTypeInfo)
				{
					PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution = null;
					if (!(value is DBNull))
					{
						pgConverterResolution = pgResolverTypeInfo.GetResolutionAsObject(value, null);
					}
					return pgConverterResolution ?? pgResolverTypeInfo.GetDefaultResolution(null);
				}
			}
			return ThrowNotSupported();
			static PgConverterResolution ThrowNotSupported()
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Should not happen, please file a bug.");
			}
		}

		internal PgConverterResolution GetResolution()
		{
			if (IsResolverInfo)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Instance is a PgResolverTypeInfo.");
			}
			return new PgConverterResolution(Converter, PgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault());
		}

		private bool CanConvert(PgConverter converter, DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			if (HasCachedInfo(converter))
			{
				switch (format)
				{
				case DataFormat.Binary:
					bufferRequirements = _binaryBufferRequirements;
					return _canBinaryConvert;
				case DataFormat.Text:
					bufferRequirements = _textBufferRequirements;
					return _canTextConvert;
				}
			}
			return converter.CanConvert(format, out bufferRequirements);
		}

		public BufferRequirements? GetBufferRequirements(PgConverter converter, DataFormat format)
		{
			if (!CanConvert(converter, format, out var bufferRequirements))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return bufferRequirements;
		}

		internal bool TryBind(Field field, DataFormat format, out PgConverterInfo info)
		{
			if (this != null)
			{
				BufferRequirements bufferRequirements;
				if (!IsResolverInfo)
				{
					if (!CanConvert(Converter, format, out bufferRequirements))
					{
						info = default(PgConverterInfo);
						return false;
					}
					info = new PgConverterInfo(this, Converter, bufferRequirements.Read);
					return true;
				}
				if (this is PgResolverTypeInfo pgResolverTypeInfo)
				{
					PgConverterResolution resolution = pgResolverTypeInfo.GetResolution(field);
					if (!CanConvert(resolution.Converter, format, out bufferRequirements))
					{
						info = default(PgConverterInfo);
						return false;
					}
					info = new PgConverterInfo(this, resolution.Converter, bufferRequirements.Read);
					return true;
				}
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("Should not happen, please file a bug.");
		}

		internal PgConverterInfo Bind(Field field, DataFormat format)
		{
			if (!TryBind(field, format, out var info))
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException($"Resolved converter does not support {format} format.");
			}
			return info;
		}

		internal PgConverterInfo? Bind<T>(PgConverter<T> converter, T? value, out Size size, out object? writeState, out DataFormat format, DataFormat? formatPreference = null)
		{
			if (!SupportsWriting)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException($"Writing {Type} is not supported for this type info.");
			}
			format = ResolveFormat(converter, out var bufferRequirements, formatPreference ?? PreferredFormat);
			writeState = null;
			Size? sizeOrDbNull = converter.GetSizeOrDbNull(format, bufferRequirements.Write, value, ref writeState);
			if (sizeOrDbNull.HasValue)
			{
				Size valueOrDefault = sizeOrDbNull.GetValueOrDefault();
				size = valueOrDefault;
				return new PgConverterInfo(this, converter, bufferRequirements.Write);
			}
			size = default(Size);
			return null;
		}

		internal PgConverterInfo? BindObject(PgConverter converter, object? value, out Size size, out object? writeState, out DataFormat format, DataFormat? formatPreference = null)
		{
			if (!SupportsWriting)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException($"Writing {Type} is not supported for this type info.");
			}
			format = ResolveFormat(converter, out var bufferRequirements, formatPreference ?? PreferredFormat);
			writeState = null;
			if (!(value is DBNull) || !(Type != typeof(DBNull)))
			{
				Size? sizeOrDbNullAsObject = converter.GetSizeOrDbNullAsObject(format, bufferRequirements.Write, value, ref writeState);
				if (sizeOrDbNullAsObject.HasValue)
				{
					Size valueOrDefault = sizeOrDbNullAsObject.GetValueOrDefault();
					size = valueOrDefault;
					return new PgConverterInfo(this, converter, bufferRequirements.Write);
				}
			}
			size = default(Size);
			return null;
		}

		private DataFormat ResolveFormat(PgConverter converter, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements, DataFormat? formatPreference = null)
		{
			switch (formatPreference)
			{
			case DataFormat.Binary:
				if (CanConvert(converter, DataFormat.Binary, out bufferRequirements))
				{
					return DataFormat.Binary;
				}
				break;
			case DataFormat.Text:
				if (CanConvert(converter, DataFormat.Text, out bufferRequirements))
				{
					return DataFormat.Text;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (CanConvert(converter, DataFormat.Binary, out bufferRequirements))
			{
				return DataFormat.Binary;
			}
			if (CanConvert(converter, DataFormat.Text, out bufferRequirements))
			{
				return DataFormat.Text;
			}
			ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Converter doesn't support any data format.");
			bufferRequirements = default(BufferRequirements);
			return DataFormat.Binary;
		}
	}
	public sealed class PgResolverTypeInfo : PgTypeInfo
	{
		private readonly PgConverterResolver _converterResolver;

		public PgResolverTypeInfo(PgSerializerOptions options, PgConverterResolver converterResolver, PgTypeId? pgTypeId, Type? unboxedType = null)
			: base(options, converterResolver.TypeToConvert, (!pgTypeId.HasValue) ? ((PgConverterResolution?)null) : new PgConverterResolution?(ResolveDefaultId(options, converterResolver, pgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault())), unboxedType ?? ((converterResolver.TypeToConvert == typeof(object)) ? typeof(object) : null))
		{
			_converterResolver = converterResolver;
		}

		private static PgConverterResolution ResolveDefaultId(PgSerializerOptions options, PgConverterResolver converterResolver, PgTypeId typeId)
		{
			return converterResolver.GetDefaultInternal(validate: true, options.PortableTypeIds, options.GetCanonicalTypeId(typeId));
		}

		public PgConverterResolution? GetResolution<T>(T? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
		{
			if (!(_converterResolver is PgConverterResolver<T> pgConverterResolver))
			{
				return ThrowNotSupportedType(typeof(T));
			}
			return pgConverterResolver.GetInternal(this, value, expectedPgTypeId ?? base.PgTypeId);
			PgConverterResolution ThrowNotSupportedType(Type? type)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(base.IsBoxing ? "TypeInfo only supports boxing conversions, call GetResolutionAsObject instead." : $"TypeInfo is not of type {type}");
			}
		}

		public PgConverterResolution? GetResolutionAsObject(object? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
		{
			return _converterResolver.GetAsObjectInternal(this, value, expectedPgTypeId ?? base.PgTypeId);
		}

		public PgConverterResolution GetResolution(Field field)
		{
			return _converterResolver.GetInternal(this, field);
		}

		public PgConverterResolution GetDefaultResolution(PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
		{
			return _converterResolver.GetDefaultInternal(base.ValidateResolution, base.Options.PortableTypeIds, expectedPgTypeId ?? base.PgTypeId);
		}

		public PgConverterResolver GetConverterResolver()
		{
			return _converterResolver;
		}
	}
	public readonly struct PgConverterResolution
	{
		public PgConverter Converter { get; }

		public PgTypeId PgTypeId { get; }

		public PgConverterResolution(PgConverter converter, PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			Converter = converter;
			PgTypeId = pgTypeId;
		}

		public PgConverter<T> GetConverter<T>()
		{
			return (PgConverter<T>)Converter;
		}
	}
	internal readonly struct PgConverterInfo
	{
		private readonly PgTypeInfo _typeInfo;

		public bool IsDefault => _typeInfo == null;

		public Type TypeToConvert { get; }

		public PgTypeInfo TypeInfo => _typeInfo;

		public PgConverter Converter { get; }

		public Size BufferRequirement { get; }

		public bool IsBoxingConverter => _typeInfo.IsBoxing;

		public PgConverterInfo(PgTypeInfo pgTypeInfo, PgConverter converter, Size bufferRequirement)
		{
			_typeInfo = pgTypeInfo;
			Converter = converter;
			BufferRequirement = bufferRequirement;
			if (pgTypeInfo.IsResolverInfo && pgTypeInfo.Type == typeof(object))
			{
				TypeToConvert = Converter.TypeToConvert;
			}
			else
			{
				TypeToConvert = pgTypeInfo.Type;
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder
	{
		private class RangeArrayHandler
		{
			public static RangeArrayHandler Instance { get; } = new RangeArrayHandler();

			public virtual IPgTypeInfoResolver? CreateRangeArrayResolver(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private sealed class RangeArrayHandlerImpl : RangeArrayHandler
		{
			public new static RangeArrayHandlerImpl Instance { get; } = new RangeArrayHandlerImpl();

			public override IPgTypeInfoResolver? CreateRangeArrayResolver(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
			{
				return factory.CreateRangeArrayResolver();
			}
		}

		private class MultirangeArrayHandler
		{
			public static MultirangeArrayHandler Instance { get; } = new MultirangeArrayHandler();

			public virtual IPgTypeInfoResolver? CreateMultirangeArrayResolver(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private sealed class MultirangeArrayHandlerImpl : MultirangeArrayHandler
		{
			public new static MultirangeArrayHandlerImpl Instance { get; } = new MultirangeArrayHandlerImpl();

			public override IPgTypeInfoResolver? CreateMultirangeArrayResolver(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
			{
				return factory.CreateMultirangeArrayResolver();
			}
		}

		private readonly List<(Type ImplementationType, object)> _factories;

		private Action<PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder, List<IPgTypeInfoResolver>>? _addRangeResolvers;

		private Action<PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder, List<IPgTypeInfoResolver>>? _addMultirangeResolvers;

		private RangeArrayHandler _rangeArrayHandler;

		private MultirangeArrayHandler _multirangeArrayHandler;

		private Action<PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder, List<IPgTypeInfoResolver>>? _addArrayResolvers;

		public PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder()
		{
			_addRangeResolvers = null;
			_addMultirangeResolvers = null;
			_addArrayResolvers = null;
			_factories = new List<(Type, object)>();
			_rangeArrayHandler = RangeArrayHandler.Instance;
			_multirangeArrayHandler = MultirangeArrayHandler.Instance;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_factories.Clear();
		}

		public void AppendResolverFactory(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
		{
			AddResolverFactory(factory.GetType(), factory);
		}

		public void AppendResolverFactory<T>(Func<T> factory) where T : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
		{
			AddResolverFactory(typeof(T), Memoize(factory));
		}

		public void PrependResolverFactory(PgTypeInfoResolverFactory factory)
		{
			AddResolverFactory(factory.GetType(), factory, prepend: true);
		}

		public void PrependResolverFactory<T>(Func<T> factory) where T : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
		{
			AddResolverFactory(typeof(T), Memoize(factory), prepend: true);
		}

		private static Func<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory> Memoize(Func<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory> factory)
		{
			PgTypeInfoResolverFactory instance = null;
			return () => instance ?? (instance = factory());
		}

		private static PgTypeInfoResolverFactory GetInstance((Type, object Instance) factory)
		{
			object item = factory.Instance;
			if (!(item is PgTypeInfoResolverFactory result))
			{
				if (item is Func<PgTypeInfoResolverFactory> func)
				{
					return func();
				}
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("factory", factory, null);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void AddResolverFactory(Type type, object factory, bool prepend = false)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _factories.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_factories[i].ImplementationType == type)
				{
					_factories.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (prepend)
			{
				_factories.Insert(0, (type, factory));
			}
			else
			{
				_factories.Add((type, factory));
			}
		}

		public void EnableRanges()
		{
			if (_addRangeResolvers == null)
			{
				_addRangeResolvers = AddResolvers;
			}
			_rangeArrayHandler = RangeArrayHandlerImpl.Instance;
			static void AddResolvers(PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder instance, List<IPgTypeInfoResolver> resolvers)
			{
				foreach (var factory in instance._factories)
				{
					IPgTypeInfoResolver pgTypeInfoResolver = GetInstance(factory).CreateRangeResolver();
					if (pgTypeInfoResolver != null)
					{
						resolvers.Add(pgTypeInfoResolver);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void EnableMultiranges()
		{
			if (_addMultirangeResolvers == null)
			{
				_addMultirangeResolvers = AddResolvers;
			}
			_multirangeArrayHandler = MultirangeArrayHandlerImpl.Instance;
			static void AddResolvers(PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder instance, List<IPgTypeInfoResolver> resolvers)
			{
				foreach (var factory in instance._factories)
				{
					IPgTypeInfoResolver pgTypeInfoResolver = GetInstance(factory).CreateMultirangeResolver();
					if (pgTypeInfoResolver != null)
					{
						resolvers.Add(pgTypeInfoResolver);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void EnableArrays()
		{
			if (_addArrayResolvers == null)
			{
				_addArrayResolvers = AddResolvers;
			}
			static void AddResolvers(PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder instance, List<IPgTypeInfoResolver> resolvers)
			{
				foreach (var factory in instance._factories)
				{
					IPgTypeInfoResolver pgTypeInfoResolver = GetInstance(factory).CreateArrayResolver();
					if (pgTypeInfoResolver != null)
					{
						resolvers.Add(pgTypeInfoResolver);
					}
				}
				if (instance._addRangeResolvers != null)
				{
					foreach (var factory2 in instance._factories)
					{
						IPgTypeInfoResolver pgTypeInfoResolver2 = instance._rangeArrayHandler.CreateRangeArrayResolver(GetInstance(factory2));
						if (pgTypeInfoResolver2 != null)
						{
							resolvers.Add(pgTypeInfoResolver2);
						}
					}
				}
				if (instance._addMultirangeResolvers != null)
				{
					foreach (var factory3 in instance._factories)
					{
						IPgTypeInfoResolver pgTypeInfoResolver3 = instance._multirangeArrayHandler.CreateMultirangeArrayResolver(GetInstance(factory3));
						if (pgTypeInfoResolver3 != null)
						{
							resolvers.Add(pgTypeInfoResolver3);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public PgTypeInfoResolverChain Build(Action<List<IPgTypeInfoResolver>>? configure = null)
		{
			List<IPgTypeInfoResolver> list = new List<IPgTypeInfoResolver>();
			foreach (var factory in _factories)
			{
				list.Add(GetInstance(factory).CreateResolver());
			}
			PgTypeInfoResolverChainBuilder arg = this;
			_addRangeResolvers?.Invoke(arg, list);
			_addMultirangeResolvers?.Invoke(arg, list);
			_addArrayResolvers?.Invoke(arg, list);
			configure?.Invoke(list);
			return new PgTypeInfoResolverChain(list, _addRangeResolvers != null, _addMultirangeResolvers != null, _addArrayResolvers != null);
		}
	}
	internal readonly struct PgTypeInfoResolverChain : IEnumerable<IPgTypeInfoResolver>, IEnumerable
	{
		[Flags]
		private enum EnabledFlags
		{
			None = 0,
			Ranges = 1,
			Multiranges = 2,
			Arrays = 4
		}

		private readonly EnabledFlags _enabled;

		private readonly List<IPgTypeInfoResolver> _resolvers;

		public bool RangesEnabled => _enabled.HasFlag(EnabledFlags.Ranges);

		public bool MultirangesEnabled => _enabled.HasFlag(EnabledFlags.Multiranges);

		public bool ArraysEnabled => _enabled.HasFlag(EnabledFlags.Arrays);

		public PgTypeInfoResolverChain(List<IPgTypeInfoResolver> resolvers, bool rangesEnabled, bool multirangesEnabled, bool arraysEnabled)
		{
			_enabled = EnabledFlags.None;
			_enabled = (rangesEnabled ? (EnabledFlags.Ranges | _enabled) : _enabled);
			_enabled = (multirangesEnabled ? (EnabledFlags.Multiranges | _enabled) : _enabled);
			_enabled = (arraysEnabled ? (EnabledFlags.Arrays | _enabled) : _enabled);
			_resolvers = resolvers;
		}

		public IEnumerator<IPgTypeInfoResolver> GetEnumerator()
		{
			List<IPgTypeInfoResolver>.Enumerator? enumerator = _resolvers?.GetEnumerator();
			if (!enumerator.HasValue)
			{
				return (IEnumerator<IPgTypeInfoResolver>)Array.Empty<IPgTypeInfoResolver>().GetEnumerator();
			}
			return enumerator.GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			List<IPgTypeInfoResolver>.Enumerator? enumerator = _resolvers?.GetEnumerator();
			if (!enumerator.HasValue)
			{
				return Array.Empty<IPgTypeInfoResolver>().GetEnumerator();
			}
			return enumerator.GetValueOrDefault();
		}
	}

		public virtual IPgTypeInfoResolver? CreateRangeResolver()

		public virtual IPgTypeInfoResolver? CreateRangeArrayResolver()

			return null;
		}

		public virtual IPgTypeInfoResolver? CreateMultirangeResolver()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual IPgTypeInfoResolver? CreateMultirangeArrayResolver()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal enum FlushMode
	{
		None,
		Blocking,
		NonBlocking
	}
	internal interface IStreamingWriter<T> : IBufferWriter<T>
	{
		void Flush(TimeSpan timeout = default(TimeSpan));

		ValueTask FlushAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));
	}
	internal sealed class NpgsqlBufferWriter : IStreamingWriter<byte>, IBufferWriter<byte>
	{
		private readonly NpgsqlWriteBuffer _buffer;

		private int? _lastBufferSize;

		public NpgsqlBufferWriter(NpgsqlWriteBuffer buffer)
		{
			_buffer = buffer;
		}

		public void Advance(int count)
		{
			if (_lastBufferSize < count || _buffer.WriteSpaceLeft < count)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Cannot advance past the end of the current buffer.");
			}
			_lastBufferSize = null;
			_buffer.WritePosition += count;
		}

		public Memory<byte> GetMemory(int sizeHint = 0)
		{
			int writePosition = _buffer.WritePosition;
			int num = _buffer.Size - writePosition;
			if (sizeHint > num)
			{
				ThrowOutOfMemoryException();
			}
			_lastBufferSize = num;
			return System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(_buffer.Buffer, writePosition, num);
		}

		public Span<byte> GetSpan(int sizeHint = 0)
		{
			int writePosition = _buffer.WritePosition;
			int num = _buffer.Size - writePosition;
			if (sizeHint > num)
			{
				ThrowOutOfMemoryException();
			}
			_lastBufferSize = num;
			return System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(_buffer.Buffer, writePosition, num);
		}

		private static void ThrowOutOfMemoryException()
		{
			throw new OutOfMemoryException("Not enough space left in buffer.");
		}

		public void Flush(TimeSpan timeout = default(TimeSpan))
		{
			if (timeout == TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				_buffer.Flush();
				return;
			}
			TimeSpan? timeSpan = null;
			try
			{
				if (timeout != TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					timeSpan = _buffer.Timeout;
					_buffer.Timeout = timeout;
				}
				_buffer.Flush();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (timeSpan.HasValue)
				{
					TimeSpan valueOrDefault = timeSpan.GetValueOrDefault();
					_buffer.Timeout = valueOrDefault;
				}
			}
		}

		public ValueTask FlushAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return new ValueTask(_buffer.Flush(async: true, cancellationToken));
		}
	}

			private Task Write(bool async, byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				if (buffer == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
				}
				if (offset < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("offset");
				}
				if (count < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("count");
				}
				if (buffer.Length - offset < count)

					throw new ArgumentException("Offset and length were out of bounds for the array or count is greater than the number of elements from index to the end of the source collection.");
				}
				if (async)

					}
					return _writer.WriteBytesAsync(_allowMixedIO, System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(buffer, offset, count), cancellationToken).AsTask();
				}
				_writer.WriteBytes(_allowMixedIO, new Span<byte>(buffer, offset, count));
				return Task.CompletedTask;
			}

		private readonly IBufferWriter<byte> _writer;

		internal PgWriter Init(NpgsqlDatabaseInfo typeCatalog, FlushMode flushMode = FlushMode.None)
		{
			if (_pos != _offset)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Invalid concurrent use or PgWriter was not committed properly, PgWriter still has uncommitted bytes.");
			}
			if (_typeCatalog != typeCatalog)
			{
				_typeCatalog = typeCatalog;
			}
			FlushMode = flushMode;
			_totalBytesWritten = 0;
			RequestBuffer(0);
			return this;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private void RequestBuffer(int count)
		{
			if (!MemoryMarshal.TryGetArray((ReadOnlyMemory<byte>)_writer.GetMemory(count), out ArraySegment<byte> segment))
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Only array backed writers are supported.");
			}
			_buffer = segment.Array;
			_offset = (_pos = segment.Offset);
			_length = segment.Offset + segment.Count;
		}

		internal void RefreshBuffer()
		{
			RequestBuffer(0);
		}

		internal PgWriter WithFlushMode(FlushMode mode)
		{
			FlushMode = mode;
			return this;
		}

		private void Ensure(int count = 1)
		{
			if (count > Remaining)
			{
				Slow(count);
			}
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			void Slow(int count2)
			{
				Commit();
				RequestBuffer(count2);
			}
		}

		private void Advance(int count)
		{
			_pos += count;
		}

		internal void Commit(int? expectedByteCount = null)
		{
			_totalBytesWritten += _pos - _offset;
			_writer.Advance(_pos - _offset);
			_offset = _pos;
			if (expectedByteCount.HasValue)
			{
				int totalBytesWritten = _totalBytesWritten;
				_totalBytesWritten = 0;
				if (totalBytesWritten != expectedByteCount)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException($"Bytes written ({totalBytesWritten}) and expected byte count ({expectedByteCount}) don't match.");
				}
			}
		}

		}

		public void WriteChars(ReadOnlySpan<char> data, Encoding encoding)
		{
			if (data.Length <= Remaining)
			{
				int byteCount = encoding.GetByteCount(data);
				if (!ShouldFlush(byteCount))
				{
					int bytes = encoding.GetBytes(data, Span);
					Advance(bytes);
					return;
				}
			}
			Core(data, encoding);
			void Core(ReadOnlySpan<char> chars, Encoding encoding2)
			{
				Encoder encoder = encoding2.GetEncoder();
				int maxByteCount = encoding2.GetMaxByteCount(1);
				bool completed;
				do

					if (ShouldFlush(maxByteCount))
					{
						Flush();
					}
					Ensure(maxByteCount);
					encoder.Convert(chars, Span, chars.Length <= Span.Length, out var charsUsed, out var bytesUsed, out completed);
					chars = chars.Slice(charsUsed);
					Advance(bytesUsed);
				}
				while (!completed);
			}
		}

		internal void WriteBytes(bool allowMixedIO, ReadOnlySpan<byte> buffer)
		{
			while (!buffer.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (Remaining == 0)
				{
					Flush(allowMixedIO, default(TimeSpan));
				}
				int num = Math.Min(buffer.Length, Remaining);
				buffer.Slice(0, num).CopyTo(Span);
				Advance(num);
				buffer = buffer.Slice(num);
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldFlush(Size bufferRequirement)

		}

		public bool ShouldFlush(int byteCount)
		{
			if (Remaining < byteCount)
			{
				return FlushMode != FlushMode.None;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Flush(TimeSpan timeout = default(TimeSpan))
		{
			Flush(allowWhenNonBlocking: false, timeout);
		}

		private void Flush(bool allowWhenNonBlocking, TimeSpan timeout = default(TimeSpan))
		{
			switch (FlushMode)
			{
			case FlushMode.None:
				return;
			case FlushMode.NonBlocking:
				if (!allowWhenNonBlocking)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot call Flush on a non-blocking PgWriter, call FlushAsync instead.");
				}
				break;
			}
			IStreamingWriter<byte> obj = (_writer as IStreamingWriter<byte>) ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot call Flush on a buffered PgWriter, FlushMode.None should be used to prevent this.");
			Commit();
			obj.Flush(timeout);
			RequestBuffer(0);
		}

		public ValueTask FlushAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return FlushAsync(allowWhenBlocking: false, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask FlushAsync(bool allowWhenBlocking, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			switch (FlushMode)
			{
			case FlushMode.None:
				return;
			case FlushMode.Blocking:
				if (!allowWhenBlocking)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot call FlushAsync on a blocking PgWriter, call Flush instead.");
				}
				break;
			}
			IStreamingWriter<byte> obj = (_writer as IStreamingWriter<byte>) ?? throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot call FlushAsync on a buffered PgWriter, FlushMode.None should be used to prevent this.");
			Commit();
			await obj.FlushAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			RequestBuffer(0);
		}

		internal ValueTask Flush(bool async, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (async)
			{
				return FlushAsync(cancellationToken);
			}
			Flush();
			return default(ValueTask);
		}

	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public enum SizeKind
	{
		Unknown,
		Exact,
		UpperBound
	}
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	[DebuggerDisplay("{DebuggerDisplay,nq}")]
	public readonly struct Size : IEquatable<Size>
	{
		private readonly int _value;

		private readonly SizeKind _kind;

		public int Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (_kind == SizeKind.Unknown)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Cannot get value from default or Unknown kind");
				}
				return _value;
			}
		}

		public SizeKind Kind => _kind;

		public static Size Unknown { get; } = new Size(SizeKind.Unknown, 0);

		public static Size Zero { get; } = new Size(SizeKind.Exact, 0);

		private string DebuggerDisplay => ToString();

		private Size(SizeKind kind, int value)
		{
			_value = value;
			_kind = kind;
		}

		internal int GetValueOrDefault()
		{
			return _value;
		}

		public static Size Create(int byteCount)
		{
			return new Size(SizeKind.Exact, byteCount);
		}

		public static Size CreateUpperBound(int byteCount)
		{
			return new Size(SizeKind.UpperBound, byteCount);
		}

		public Size Combine(Size result)
		{
			if (_kind == SizeKind.Unknown || result._kind == SizeKind.Unknown)
			{
				return Unknown;
			}
			if (_kind == SizeKind.UpperBound || result._kind == SizeKind.UpperBound)
			{
				return CreateUpperBound((int)Math.Min(_value + result._value, 2147483647L));
			}
			return Create((int)Math.Min(_value + result._value, 2147483647L));
		}

		public static implicit operator Size(int value)
		{
			return Create(value);
		}

		public bool Equals(Size other)
		{
			if (_value == other._value)
			{
				return _kind == other.Kind;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is Size other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCode.Combine(_value, (int)_kind);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(Size left, Size right)
		{
			return left.Equals(right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(Size left, Size right)
		{
			return !left.Equals(right);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			switch (_kind)
			{
			case SizeKind.Exact:
			case SizeKind.UpperBound:
				return $"{_value} ({_kind.ToString()})";
			case SizeKind.Unknown:
				return "Unknown";
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}
	}

			static PgTypeId? AsPgTypeId(TPgTypeId? val2)

				}
				if (typeInfo == null)

				}

				{

				}

			}
			static PgTypeInfo? FindMatch(Type? type2, (Type? Type, PgTypeInfo? Info)[] infos, bool flag2)

	[DebuggerDisplay("{DebuggerDisplay,nq}")]
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public readonly struct TypeInfoMapping
	{
		public TypeInfoFactory Factory { get; init; }

		public Type Type { get; init; }

		public string DataTypeName { get; init; }

		public MatchRequirement MatchRequirement { get; init; }

		public Func<Type?, bool>? TypeMatchPredicate { get; init; }

		private string DebuggerDisplay
		{
			get
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder().Append(Type.Name).Append(" <-> ").Append(Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.DataTypeName.FromDisplayName(DataTypeName).DisplayName);
				if (MatchRequirement != MatchRequirement.All)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" (" + MatchRequirement.ToString().ToLowerInvariant() + ")");
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public TypeInfoMapping(Type type, string dataTypeName, TypeInfoFactory factory)
		{
			TypeMatchPredicate = null;
			Type = type;
			MatchRequirement = ((type == typeof(object)) ? MatchRequirement.DataTypeName : MatchRequirement.All);
			DataTypeName = Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.DataTypeName.NormalizeName(dataTypeName);
			Factory = factory;
		}

		public bool TypeEquals(Type type)
		{
			return TypeMatchPredicate?.Invoke(type) ?? (Type == type);
		}

		public bool DataTypeNameEquals(string dataTypeName)
		{
			ReadOnlySpan<char> readOnlySpan = System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(DataTypeName);
			if (!Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.DataTypeName.IsFullyQualified(readOnlySpan))
			{
				return System.MemoryExtensions.Equals(readOnlySpan, Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.DataTypeName.ValidatedName(dataTypeName).UnqualifiedNameSpan, StringComparison.Ordinal);
			}
			return System.MemoryExtensions.Equals(readOnlySpan, System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(dataTypeName), StringComparison.Ordinal);
		}
	}

		private static Type? ComputeUnboxedType(Type defaultType, Type converterType, Type matchedType)
		{
			if (matchedType == typeof(object))
			{
				return converterType;
			}
			if (matchedType != defaultType)
			{
				return matchedType;
			}
			if (defaultType != converterType)
			{
				return defaultType;
			}
			return null;
		}

		[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("Trimming", "IL2070", Justification = "Checking for IList<T> implementing types requires interface list enumeration which isn't compatible with trimming. However as long as a concrete IList<T> is rooted somewhere in the app, for instance through an `AddArrayType<T>(...)` mapping, every implementation must keep it.")]
		public static bool IsArrayLikeType(Type type, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Type? elementType)
		{
			Type elementType2 = type.GetElementType();
			if ((object)elementType2 != null)
			{
				elementType = elementType2;
				return true;
			}
			if (type.IsConstructedGenericType)
			{
				Type genericTypeDefinition = type.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
				if (genericTypeDefinition == typeof(List<>) || genericTypeDefinition == typeof(IList<>))
				{
					elementType = type.GetGenericArguments()[0];
					return true;
				}
			}
			Type[] interfaces = type.GetInterfaces();
			foreach (Type type2 in interfaces)
			{
				if (type2.IsConstructedGenericType && type2.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IList<>))
				{
					elementType = type2.GetGenericArguments()[0];
					return true;
				}
			}
			elementType = null;
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetArrayDataTypeName(string dataTypeName)
		{
			if (!DataTypeName.IsFullyQualified(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(dataTypeName)))
			{
				return "_" + DataTypeName.FromDisplayName(dataTypeName).UnqualifiedName;
			}
			return DataTypeName.ValidatedName(dataTypeName).ToArrayName().Value;
		}

		private static ArrayBasedArrayConverter<Array, TElement> CreateArrayBasedConverter<TElement>(TypeInfoMapping mapping, PgTypeInfo elemInfo)
		{
			if (!elemInfo.IsBoxing)
			{
				return new ArrayBasedArrayConverter<Array, TElement>(elemInfo.GetResolution(), mapping.Type);
			}
			ThrowBoxingNotSupported(resolver: false);
			return null;
		}

		private static ListBasedArrayConverter<IList<TElement>, TElement> CreateListBasedConverter<TElement>(TypeInfoMapping mapping, PgTypeInfo elemInfo)
		{
			if (!elemInfo.IsBoxing)
			{
				return new ListBasedArrayConverter<IList<TElement>, TElement>(elemInfo.GetResolution());
			}
			ThrowBoxingNotSupported(resolver: false);
			return null;
		}

		private static ArrayConverterResolver<Array, TElement> CreateArrayBasedConverterResolver<TElement>(TypeInfoMapping mapping, PgResolverTypeInfo elemInfo)
		{
			if (!elemInfo.IsBoxing)
			{
				return new ArrayConverterResolver<Array, TElement>(elemInfo, mapping.Type);
			}
			ThrowBoxingNotSupported(resolver: true);
			return null;
		}

		private static ArrayConverterResolver<IList<TElement>, TElement> CreateListBasedConverterResolver<TElement>(TypeInfoMapping mapping, PgResolverTypeInfo elemInfo)
		{
			if (!elemInfo.IsBoxing)
			{
				return new ArrayConverterResolver<IList<TElement>, TElement>(elemInfo, mapping.Type);
			}
			ThrowBoxingNotSupported(resolver: true);
			return null;
		}

		[DoesNotReturn]
		private static void ThrowBoxingNotSupported(bool resolver)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Boxing converters are not supported, manually construct a mapping over a casting converter" + (resolver ? " resolver" : "") + " instead.");
		}
	}
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public static class TypeInfoMappingHelpers
	{
		internal static bool TryResolveFullyQualifiedName(PgSerializerOptions options, string dataTypeName, out DataTypeName fqDataTypeName)
		{
			if (DataTypeName.IsFullyQualified(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(dataTypeName)))
			{
				fqDataTypeName = new DataTypeName(dataTypeName);
				return true;
			}
			if (options.DatabaseInfo.TryGetPostgresTypeByName(dataTypeName, out PostgresType pgType))
			{
				fqDataTypeName = pgType.DataTypeName;
				return true;
			}
			fqDataTypeName = default(DataTypeName);
			return false;
		}

		internal static PostgresType GetPgType(this TypeInfoMapping mapping, PgSerializerOptions options)
		{
			return options.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(new DataTypeName(mapping.DataTypeName));
		}

		public static PgTypeInfo CreateInfo(this TypeInfoMapping mapping, PgSerializerOptions options, PgConverter converter, DataFormat? preferredFormat = null, bool supportsWriting = true)
		{
			return new PgTypeInfo(options, converter, new DataTypeName(mapping.DataTypeName))
			{
				PreferredFormat = preferredFormat,
				SupportsWriting = supportsWriting
			};
		}

		public static PgResolverTypeInfo CreateInfo(this TypeInfoMapping mapping, PgSerializerOptions options, PgConverterResolver resolver, bool includeDataTypeName = true, DataFormat? preferredFormat = null, bool supportsWriting = true)
		{
			return new PgResolverTypeInfo(options, resolver, includeDataTypeName ? new PgTypeId?(new DataTypeName(mapping.DataTypeName)) : ((PgTypeId?)null))
			{
				PreferredFormat = preferredFormat,
				SupportsWriting = supportsWriting
			};
		}
	}
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public readonly struct ValueMetadata
	{
		public required DataFormat Format { get; init; }

		public required Size BufferRequirement { get; init; }

		public required Size Size { get; init; }

		public object? WriteState { get; init; }
	}

namespace Npgsql.Internal.ResolverFactories
{
	internal sealed class AdoTypeInfoResolverFactory : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
	{
		private class Resolver : IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			protected TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection()));

			public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				PgTypeInfo pgTypeInfo = Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
				if (pgTypeInfo == null && dataTypeName.HasValue)
				{
					pgTypeInfo = GetEnumTypeInfo(type, dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault(), options);
				}
				return pgTypeInfo;
			}

			private static PgTypeInfo? GetEnumTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				if ((object)type != null && type != typeof(string))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!(options.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(dataTypeName) is PostgresEnumType))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new PgTypeInfo(options, new StringTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), dataTypeName);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructType<bool>(DataTypeNames.Bool, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new BoolConverter()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<short>(DataTypeNames.Int2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int2Converter<short>()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<byte>(DataTypeNames.Int2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int2Converter<byte>()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<sbyte>(DataTypeNames.Int2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int2Converter<sbyte>()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<int>(DataTypeNames.Int4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int4Converter<int>()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<long>(DataTypeNames.Int8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int8Converter<long>()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<float>(DataTypeNames.Float4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new RealConverter<float>()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<double>(DataTypeNames.Float8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DoubleConverter<double>()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<decimal>(DataTypeNames.Numeric, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DecimalNumericConverter<decimal>()), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<decimal>(DataTypeNames.Money, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new MoneyConverter<decimal>()), MatchRequirement.DataTypeName);
				mappings.AddType<string>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new StringTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<char>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new CharTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text));
				mappings.AddType<byte[]>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new ArrayByteaConverter()), MatchRequirement.DataTypeName);
				mappings.AddStructType<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new ReadOnlyMemoryByteaConverter()), MatchRequirement.DataTypeName);
				mappings.AddType<Stream>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => new PgTypeInfo(options, new StreamByteaConverter(), new DataTypeName(mapping.DataTypeName), (mapping.Type != typeof(Stream)) ? mapping.Type : null), delegate(TypeInfoMapping mapping)
				{
					TypeInfoMapping result = mapping;
					result.MatchRequirement = MatchRequirement.DataTypeName;
					result.TypeMatchPredicate = (Type? type) => typeof(Stream).IsAssignableFrom(type);
					return result;
				});
				mappings.AddType<TextReader>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new TextReaderTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text, supportsWriting: false), MatchRequirement.DataTypeName);
				mappings.AddStructType<GetChars>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new GetCharsTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text, supportsWriting: false), MatchRequirement.DataTypeName);
				string[] array = new string[7]
				{
					"citext",
					DataTypeNames.Varchar,
					DataTypeNames.Bpchar,
					DataTypeNames.Json,
					DataTypeNames.Xml,
					DataTypeNames.Name,
					DataTypeNames.RefCursor
				};
				foreach (string dataTypeName in array)
				{
					mappings.AddType<string>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new StringTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text), isDefault: true);
