		private sealed class ArrayResolver : Resolver, IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private new TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(base.Mappings)));

			public new PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				PgTypeInfo pgTypeInfo = Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
				Type elementType = null;
				if (pgTypeInfo == null && dataTypeName.HasValue)
				{
					NpgsqlDatabaseInfo databaseInfo = options.DatabaseInfo;
					DataTypeName? dataTypeName2 = dataTypeName;
					if (databaseInfo.GetPostgresType(dataTypeName2.HasValue ? ((string)dataTypeName2.GetValueOrDefault()) : null) is PostgresArrayType { Element: var element } && ((object)type == null || type == typeof(object) || TypeInfoMappingCollection.IsArrayLikeType(type, out elementType)))
					{
						pgTypeInfo = GetEnumArrayTypeInfo(elementType, element, type, dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault(), options) ?? GetObjectArrayTypeInfo(elementType, element, type, dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault(), options);
					}
				}
				return pgTypeInfo;
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<bool>(DataTypeNames.Bool);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<short>(DataTypeNames.Int2);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<byte>(DataTypeNames.Int2);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<sbyte>(DataTypeNames.Int2);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<int>(DataTypeNames.Int4);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<long>(DataTypeNames.Int8);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<float>(DataTypeNames.Float4);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<double>(DataTypeNames.Float8);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<decimal>(DataTypeNames.Numeric);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<decimal>(DataTypeNames.Money);
				mappings.AddArrayType<string>(DataTypeNames.Text);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<char>(DataTypeNames.Text);
				mappings.AddArrayType<byte[]>(DataTypeNames.Text);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>>(DataTypeNames.Text);
				mappings.AddArrayType<Stream>(DataTypeNames.Text);
				string[] array = new string[7]
				{
					"citext",
					DataTypeNames.Varchar,
					DataTypeNames.Bpchar,
					DataTypeNames.Json,
					DataTypeNames.Xml,
					DataTypeNames.Name,
					DataTypeNames.RefCursor
				};
				foreach (string elementDataTypeName in array)
				{
					mappings.AddArrayType<string>(elementDataTypeName);
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<char>(elementDataTypeName);
					mappings.AddArrayType<byte[]>(elementDataTypeName);
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>>(elementDataTypeName);
					mappings.AddArrayType<Stream>(elementDataTypeName);
				}
				mappings.AddArrayType<string>(DataTypeNames.Jsonb);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<char>(DataTypeNames.Jsonb);
				mappings.AddArrayType<byte[]>(DataTypeNames.Jsonb);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>>(DataTypeNames.Jsonb);
				mappings.AddArrayType<Stream>(DataTypeNames.Jsonb);
				mappings.AddArrayType<string>(DataTypeNames.Jsonpath);
				mappings.AddArrayType<byte[]>(DataTypeNames.Bytea);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>>(DataTypeNames.Bytea);
				mappings.AddArrayType<Stream>(DataTypeNames.Bytea);
				mappings.AddPolymorphicResolverArrayType(DataTypeNames.Varbit, (PgSerializerOptions options) => delegate(PgConverterResolution resolution)
				{
					PgConverter converter = resolution.Converter;
					if (converter is BoolBitStringConverter)
					{
						return PgConverterFactory.CreatePolymorphicArrayConverter(() => new ArrayBasedArrayConverter<Array, bool>(resolution, typeof(Array)), () => new ArrayBasedArrayConverter<Array, bool?>(new PgConverterResolution(new NullableConverter<bool>(resolution.GetConverter<bool>()), resolution.PgTypeId), typeof(Array)), options);
					}
					if (!(converter is BitArrayBitStringConverter))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException();
					}
					return new ArrayBasedArrayConverter<Array, BitArray>(resolution, typeof(Array));
				});
				mappings.AddArrayType<BitArray>(DataTypeNames.Varbit);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<bool>(DataTypeNames.Varbit);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<BitVector32>(DataTypeNames.Varbit);
				mappings.AddPolymorphicResolverArrayType(DataTypeNames.Bit, (PgSerializerOptions options) => delegate(PgConverterResolution resolution)
				{
					PgConverter converter = resolution.Converter;
					if (converter is BoolBitStringConverter)
					{
						return PgConverterFactory.CreatePolymorphicArrayConverter(() => new ArrayBasedArrayConverter<Array, bool>(resolution, typeof(Array)), () => new ArrayBasedArrayConverter<Array, bool?>(new PgConverterResolution(new NullableConverter<bool>(resolution.GetConverter<bool>()), resolution.PgTypeId), typeof(Array)), options);
					}
					if (!(converter is BitArrayBitStringConverter))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException();
					}
					return new ArrayBasedArrayConverter<Array, BitArray>(resolution, typeof(Array));
				});
				mappings.AddArrayType<BitArray>(DataTypeNames.Bit);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<bool>(DataTypeNames.Bit);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<BitVector32>(DataTypeNames.Bit);
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<DateTime>(DataTypeNames.Timestamp);
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverStructArrayType<DateTime>(DataTypeNames.Timestamp);
				}
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<long>(DataTypeNames.Timestamp);
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<DateTime>(DataTypeNames.TimestampTz);
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverStructArrayType<DateTime>(DataTypeNames.TimestampTz);
				}
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<DateTimeOffset>(DataTypeNames.TimestampTz);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<long>(DataTypeNames.TimestampTz);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<DateTime>(DataTypeNames.Date);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<int>(DataTypeNames.Date);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<TimeSpan>(DataTypeNames.Interval);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlInterval>(DataTypeNames.Interval);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<TimeSpan>(DataTypeNames.Time);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<long>(DataTypeNames.Time);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<DateTimeOffset>(DataTypeNames.TimeTz);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<Guid>(DataTypeNames.Uuid);
				mappings.AddArrayType<Dictionary<string, string>>("hstore");
				mappings.AddArrayType<IDictionary<string, string>>("hstore");
				array = new string[5]
				{
					DataTypeNames.Oid,
					DataTypeNames.Xid,
					DataTypeNames.Cid,
					DataTypeNames.RegType,
					DataTypeNames.RegConfig
				};
				foreach (string elementDataTypeName2 in array)
				{
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<uint>(elementDataTypeName2);
				}
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<char>(DataTypeNames.Char);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<byte>(DataTypeNames.Char);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<ulong>(DataTypeNames.Xid8);
				mappings.AddArrayType<uint[]>(DataTypeNames.OidVector);
				mappings.AddArrayType<short[]>(DataTypeNames.Int2Vector);
				return mappings;
			}

			private static PgTypeInfo? GetObjectArrayTypeInfo(Type? elementType, PostgresType pgElementType, Type? type, DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				if (elementType != typeof(object))
				{
					return null;
				}
				PgTypeId elementId = options.ToCanonicalTypeId(pgElementType);
				if (options.GetDefaultTypeInfo(elementId) == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				TypeInfoMappingCollection typeInfoMappingCollection = new TypeInfoMappingCollection();
				typeInfoMappingCollection.AddType<object>(pgElementType.DataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options2, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options2, new ObjectConverter(options2, elementId)), MatchRequirement.DataTypeName);
				typeInfoMappingCollection.AddArrayType<object>(pgElementType.DataTypeName);
				return typeInfoMappingCollection.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static PgTypeInfo? GetEnumArrayTypeInfo(Type? elementType, PostgresType pgElementType, Type? type, DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				if ((type != typeof(object) && (object)elementType != null && elementType != typeof(string)) || !(pgElementType is PostgresEnumType postgresEnumType))
				{
					return null;
				}
				TypeInfoMappingCollection typeInfoMappingCollection = new TypeInfoMappingCollection();
				typeInfoMappingCollection.AddType<string>(postgresEnumType.DataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions pgSerializerOptions, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(pgSerializerOptions, new StringTextConverter(pgSerializerOptions.TextEncoding)), MatchRequirement.DataTypeName);
				typeInfoMappingCollection.AddArrayType<string>(postgresEnumType.DataTypeName);
				return typeInfoMappingCollection.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}
		}

		private class MultirangeResolver : IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			protected TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection()));

			public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				if (!options.DatabaseInfo.SupportsMultirangeTypes)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<int>[]>(DataTypeNames.Int4Multirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int4Converter<int>(), options), options)), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<int>>>(DataTypeNames.Int4Multirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int4Converter<int>(), options), options)));
				mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<long>[]>(DataTypeNames.Int8Multirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options), options)), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<long>>>(DataTypeNames.Int8Multirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options), options)));
				mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<decimal>[]>(DataTypeNames.NumMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new DecimalNumericConverter<decimal>(), options), options)), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<decimal>>>(DataTypeNames.NumMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new DecimalNumericConverter<decimal>(), options), options)));
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions, timestamp: true), options), options)), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions, timestamp: true), options), options)));
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool dataTypeNameMatch) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, DateTimeConverterResolver.CreateMultirangeResolver<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[], NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(options, options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange), options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange), options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), dataTypeNameMatch), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddResolverType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool dataTypeNameMatch) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, DateTimeConverterResolver.CreateMultirangeResolver<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>, NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(options, options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange), options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange), options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), dataTypeNameMatch));
				}
				mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<long>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options), options)));
				mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<long>>>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options), options)));
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions, timestamp: false), options), options)), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions, timestamp: false), options), options)));
					mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeOffsetConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options), options)), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeOffsetConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options), options)));
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool dataTypeNameMatch) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, DateTimeConverterResolver.CreateMultirangeResolver<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[], NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(options, options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange), options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange), options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), dataTypeNameMatch), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddResolverType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool dataTypeNameMatch) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, DateTimeConverterResolver.CreateMultirangeResolver<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>, NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(options, options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange), options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange), options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), dataTypeNameMatch));
					mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Npgsql.Internal.Converters.DateTimeOffsetConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options), options)), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Npgsql.Internal.Converters.DateTimeOffsetConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options), options)));
				}
				mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<long>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options), options)));
				mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<long>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options), options)));
				mappings.AddType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.DateMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateArrayMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new DateTimeDateConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options), options)), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.DateMultirange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateListMultirangeConverter(PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new DateTimeDateConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options), options)));
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		private sealed class MultirangeArrayResolver : MultirangeResolver, IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private new TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(base.Mappings)));

			public new PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				if (!options.DatabaseInfo.SupportsMultirangeTypes)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<int>[]>(DataTypeNames.Int4Multirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<int>>>(DataTypeNames.Int4Multirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<long>[]>(DataTypeNames.Int8Multirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<long>>>(DataTypeNames.Int8Multirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<decimal>[]>(DataTypeNames.NumMultirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<decimal>>>(DataTypeNames.NumMultirange);
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange);
					mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange);
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange);
					mappings.AddResolverArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange);
				}
				mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<long>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<long>>>(DataTypeNames.TsMultirange);
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
					mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
					mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
					mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
					mappings.AddResolverArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
					mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
					mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
				}
				mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<long>[]>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<long>>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzMultirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>[]>(DataTypeNames.DateMultirange);
				mappings.AddArrayType<List<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>>(DataTypeNames.DateMultirange);
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		private class RangeResolver : IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			protected TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection()));

			public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<int>>(DataTypeNames.Int4Range, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int4Converter<int>(), options)), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<long>>(DataTypeNames.Int8Range, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options)), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<decimal>>(DataTypeNames.NumRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new DecimalNumericConverter<decimal>(), options)), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<BigInteger>>(DataTypeNames.NumRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new BigIntegerNumericConverter(), options)));
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.TsRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions, timestamp: true), options)), isDefault: true);
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverStructType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.TsRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool dataTypeNameMatch) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, DateTimeConverterResolver.CreateRangeResolver(options, options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange), options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsRange), options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), dataTypeNameMatch), isDefault: true);
				}
				mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<long>>(DataTypeNames.TsRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options)));
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions, timestamp: false), options)), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new LegacyDateTimeOffsetConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options)));
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverStructType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool dataTypeNameMatch) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, DateTimeConverterResolver.CreateRangeResolver(options, options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange), options.GetCanonicalTypeId(DataTypeNames.TsRange), options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), dataTypeNameMatch), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Npgsql.Internal.Converters.DateTimeOffsetConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options)));
				}
				mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<long>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int8Converter<long>(), options)));
				mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.DateRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new DateTimeDateConverter(options.EnableDateTimeInfinityConversions), options)), isDefault: true);
				mappings.AddStructType<NpgsqlRange<int>>(DataTypeNames.DateRange, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, PgConverterFactory.CreateRangeConverter(new Int4Converter<int>(), options)));
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		private sealed class RangeArrayResolver : RangeResolver, IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private new TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(base.Mappings)));

			public new PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<int>>(DataTypeNames.Int4Range);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<long>>(DataTypeNames.Int8Range);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<decimal>>(DataTypeNames.NumRange);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<BigInteger>>(DataTypeNames.NumRange);
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.TsRange);
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.TsRange);
				}
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<long>>(DataTypeNames.TsRange);
				if (Statics.LegacyTimestampBehavior)
				{
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange);
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange);
				}
				else
				{
					mappings.AddResolverStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange);
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTimeOffset>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange);
				}
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<long>>(DataTypeNames.TsTzRange);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(DataTypeNames.DateRange);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<NpgsqlRange<int>>(DataTypeNames.DateRange);
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		private Resolver ResolverInstance { get; } = new Resolver();

		public static AdoTypeInfoResolverFactory Instance { get; } = new AdoTypeInfoResolverFactory();

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateResolver()
		{
			return ResolverInstance;
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateArrayResolver()
		{
			return new ArrayResolver();
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateMultirangeResolver()
		{
			return new MultirangeResolver();
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateMultirangeArrayResolver()
		{
			return new MultirangeArrayResolver();
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateRangeResolver()
		{
			return new RangeResolver();
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateRangeArrayResolver()
		{
			return new RangeArrayResolver();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ExtraConversionResolverFactory : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
	{
		private class Resolver : IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			protected TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddInfos(new TypeInfoMappingCollection()));

			public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddInfos(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructType<int>(DataTypeNames.Int2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int2Converter<int>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<long>(DataTypeNames.Int2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int2Converter<long>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<float>(DataTypeNames.Int2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int2Converter<float>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<double>(DataTypeNames.Int2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int2Converter<double>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<decimal>(DataTypeNames.Int2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int2Converter<decimal>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<short>(DataTypeNames.Int4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int4Converter<short>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<long>(DataTypeNames.Int4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int4Converter<long>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<byte>(DataTypeNames.Int4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int4Converter<byte>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<sbyte>(DataTypeNames.Int4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int4Converter<sbyte>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<float>(DataTypeNames.Int4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int4Converter<float>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<double>(DataTypeNames.Int4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int4Converter<double>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<decimal>(DataTypeNames.Int4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int4Converter<decimal>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<short>(DataTypeNames.Int8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int8Converter<short>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<int>(DataTypeNames.Int8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int8Converter<int>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<byte>(DataTypeNames.Int8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int8Converter<byte>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<sbyte>(DataTypeNames.Int8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int8Converter<sbyte>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<float>(DataTypeNames.Int8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int8Converter<float>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<double>(DataTypeNames.Int8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int8Converter<double>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<decimal>(DataTypeNames.Int8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new Int8Converter<decimal>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<double>(DataTypeNames.Float4, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new RealConverter<double>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<float>(DataTypeNames.Float8, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DoubleConverter<float>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<byte>(DataTypeNames.Numeric, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DecimalNumericConverter<byte>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<short>(DataTypeNames.Numeric, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DecimalNumericConverter<short>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<int>(DataTypeNames.Numeric, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DecimalNumericConverter<int>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<long>(DataTypeNames.Numeric, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DecimalNumericConverter<long>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<float>(DataTypeNames.Numeric, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DecimalNumericConverter<float>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<double>(DataTypeNames.Numeric, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new DecimalNumericConverter<double>()));
				mappings.AddStructType<BigInteger>(DataTypeNames.Numeric, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new BigIntegerNumericConverter()));
				mappings.AddStructType<ArraySegment<byte>>(DataTypeNames.Bytea, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new ArraySegmentByteaConverter()));
				mappings.AddStructType<Memory<byte>>(DataTypeNames.Bytea, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new MemoryByteaConverter()));
				mappings.AddType<string>(DataTypeNames.Varbit, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new StringBitStringConverter()));
				mappings.AddType<string>(DataTypeNames.Bit, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new StringBitStringConverter()));
				mappings.AddType<char[]>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new CharArrayTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text));
				mappings.AddStructType<ReadOnlyMemory<char>>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new ReadOnlyMemoryTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text));
				mappings.AddStructType<ArraySegment<char>>(DataTypeNames.Text, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new CharArraySegmentTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text));
				string[] array = new string[7]
				{
					"citext",
					DataTypeNames.Varchar,
					DataTypeNames.Bpchar,
					DataTypeNames.Json,
					DataTypeNames.Xml,
					DataTypeNames.Name,
					DataTypeNames.RefCursor
				};
				foreach (string dataTypeName in array)
				{
					mappings.AddType<char[]>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new CharArrayTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text));
					mappings.AddStructType<ReadOnlyMemory<char>>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new ReadOnlyMemoryTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text));
					mappings.AddStructType<ArraySegment<char>>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new CharArraySegmentTextConverter(options.TextEncoding), DataFormat.Text));
				}
				mappings.AddType<char[]>(DataTypeNames.Jsonb, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new VersionPrefixedTextConverter<char[]>(1, new CharArrayTextConverter(options.TextEncoding))));
				mappings.AddStructType<ReadOnlyMemory<char>>(DataTypeNames.Jsonb, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new VersionPrefixedTextConverter<ReadOnlyMemory<char>>(1, new ReadOnlyMemoryTextConverter(options.TextEncoding))));
				mappings.AddStructType<ArraySegment<char>>(DataTypeNames.Jsonb, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new VersionPrefixedTextConverter<ArraySegment<char>>(1, new CharArraySegmentTextConverter(options.TextEncoding))));
				mappings.AddType<ImmutableDictionary<string, string>>("hstore", (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new HstoreConverter<ImmutableDictionary<string, string>>(options.TextEncoding, (ICollection<KeyValuePair<string, string?>> result) => result.ToImmutableDictionary())));
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ArrayResolver : Resolver, IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private new TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddArrayInfos(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(base.Mappings)));

			public new PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddArrayInfos(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<int>(DataTypeNames.Int2);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<long>(DataTypeNames.Int2);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<float>(DataTypeNames.Int2);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<double>(DataTypeNames.Int2);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<decimal>(DataTypeNames.Int2);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<short>(DataTypeNames.Int4);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<long>(DataTypeNames.Int4);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<byte>(DataTypeNames.Int4);
				mappings.AddStructArrayType<sbyte>(DataTypeNames.Int4);

		public static void ThrowIfUnsupported<TBuilder>(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
		{
			bool flag;
			if (dataTypeName.HasValue)
			{
				DataTypeName valueOrDefault = dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault();
				if (valueOrDefault.SchemaSpan.SequenceEqual(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("pg_catalog")))
				{
					switch (valueOrDefault.UnqualifiedNameSpan)
					{
					case "tsquery":
					case "_tsquery":
					case "tsvector":
					case "_tsvector":
						break;
					default:
						goto IL_007e;
					}
					flag = true;
					goto IL_0081;
				}
			}
			goto IL_007e;
			IL_0081:
			if (flag)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.FullTextSearchNotEnabled, "EnableFullTextSearch", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
			}
			if ((object)type != null)
			{
				if (TypeInfoMappingCollection.IsArrayLikeType(type, out Type elementType))
				{
					type = elementType;
				}
				Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
				if ((object)underlyingType != null)
				{
					type = underlyingType;
				}
				if (type == typeof(NpgsqlTsVector) || typeof(NpgsqlTsQuery).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.FullTextSearchNotEnabled, "EnableFullTextSearch", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
				}
			}
			return;
			IL_007e:
			flag = false;
			goto IL_0081;
		}
	}

	[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Json serializer may perform reflection on trimmed types.")]
	[RequiresDynamicCode("Serializing arbitrary types to json can require creating new generic types or methods, which requires creating code at runtime. This may not work when AOT compiling.")]
	internal sealed class JsonDynamicTypeInfoResolverFactory : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
	{
		internal static class Support
		{
			public static void ThrowIfUnsupported<TBuilder>(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName)
			{
				bool flag;
				if (dataTypeName.HasValue)
				{
					DataTypeName valueOrDefault = dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault();
					if (valueOrDefault.SchemaSpan.SequenceEqual(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("pg_catalog")))
					{
						switch (valueOrDefault.UnqualifiedNameSpan)
						{
						case "json":
						case "_json":
						case "jsonb":
						case "_jsonb":
							break;
						default:
							goto IL_007d;
						}
						flag = true;
						goto IL_007f;
					}
				}
				goto IL_007d;
				IL_007f:
				if (flag)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.DynamicJsonNotEnabled, ((object)type == null || type == typeof(object)) ? "<unknown>" : type.Name, "EnableDynamicJson", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
				}
				return;
				IL_007d:
				flag = false;
				goto IL_007f;
			}
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Json serializer may perform reflection on trimmed types.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Serializing arbitrary types to json can require creating new generic types or methods, which requires creating code at runtime. This may not work when AOT compiling.")]
		private class Resolver : DynamicTypeInfoResolver, IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private JsonSerializerOptions? _serializerOptions;

			private readonly Type[] _jsonbClrTypes;

			private readonly Type[] _jsonClrTypes;

			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private JsonSerializerOptions SerializerOptions => _serializerOptions ?? (_serializerOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions());

			protected TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(), _jsonbClrTypes, _jsonClrTypes, SerializerOptions));

			public Resolver(Type[]? jsonbClrTypes = null, Type[]? jsonClrTypes = null, JsonSerializerOptions? serializerOptions = null)
			{
				_jsonbClrTypes = jsonbClrTypes ?? Array.Empty<Type>();
				_jsonClrTypes = jsonClrTypes ?? Array.Empty<Type>();
				_serializerOptions = serializerOptions;
			}

			public new PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options) ?? base.GetTypeInfo(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings, Type[] jsonbClrTypes, Type[] jsonClrTypes, JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions)
			{
				JsonSerializerOptions jsonSerializerOptions = serializerOptions;
				if (jsonSerializerOptions.TypeInfoResolver == null)
				{
					IJsonTypeInfoResolver jsonTypeInfoResolver = (jsonSerializerOptions.TypeInfoResolver = new DefaultJsonTypeInfoResolver());
				}
				DataTypeName[] array = new DataTypeName[2]
				{
					DataTypeNames.Jsonb,
					DataTypeNames.Json
				};
				foreach (DataTypeName dataTypeName in array)
				{
					bool jsonb = dataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Jsonb;
					mappings.AddType<JsonNode>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new JsonConverter<JsonNode, JsonNode>(jsonb, options.TextEncoding, serializerOptions)));
					mappings.AddType<JsonObject>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new JsonConverter<JsonObject, JsonObject>(jsonb, options.TextEncoding, serializerOptions)));
					mappings.AddType<JsonArray>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new JsonConverter<JsonArray, JsonArray>(jsonb, options.TextEncoding, serializerOptions)));
					mappings.AddType<JsonValue>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new JsonConverter<JsonValue, JsonValue>(jsonb, options.TextEncoding, serializerOptions)));
				}
				AddUserMappings(jsonb: true, jsonbClrTypes);
				AddUserMappings(jsonb: false, jsonClrTypes);
				return mappings;
				void AddUserMappings(bool flag, Type[] clrTypes)
				{
					DynamicMappingCollection dynamicMappingCollection = DynamicTypeInfoResolver.CreateCollection();
					string dataTypeName2 = (flag ? DataTypeNames.Jsonb : DataTypeNames.Json);
					foreach (Type jsonType in clrTypes)
					{
						JsonTypeInfo typeInfo = serializerOptions.GetTypeInfo(jsonType);
						dynamicMappingCollection.AddMapping(typeInfo.Type, dataTypeName2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, CreateSystemTextJsonConverter(mapping.Type, flag, options.TextEncoding, serializerOptions, jsonType)));
						if (!jsonType.IsValueType && typeInfo.PolymorphismOptions != null)
						{
							foreach (JsonDerivedType derivedType in typeInfo.PolymorphismOptions.DerivedTypes)
							{
								dynamicMappingCollection.AddMapping(derivedType.DerivedType, dataTypeName2, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, CreateSystemTextJsonConverter(mapping.Type, flag, options.TextEncoding, serializerOptions, jsonType)));
							}
						}
					}
					mappings.AddRange(dynamicMappingCollection.ToTypeInfoMappingCollection());
				}
			}

			protected override DynamicMappingCollection? GetMappings(Type? type, DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				if ((object)type == null || type == typeof(object) || PgSerializerOptions.IsWellKnownTextType(type) || (dataTypeName != DataTypeNames.Jsonb && dataTypeName != DataTypeNames.Json))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DynamicTypeInfoResolver.CreateCollection().AddMapping(type, dataTypeName, delegate(PgSerializerOptions pgSerializerOptions, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _)
				{
					bool flag = dataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Jsonb;
					Type baseType = (flag ? mapping.Type : typeof(object));
					return mapping.CreateInfo(pgSerializerOptions, CreateSystemTextJsonConverter(mapping.Type, flag, pgSerializerOptions.TextEncoding, SerializerOptions, baseType));
				});
			}

			private static PgConverter CreateSystemTextJsonConverter(Type valueType, bool jsonb, Encoding textEncoding, JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions, Type baseType)
			{
				return (PgConverter)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(JsonConverter<, >).MakeGenericType(valueType, baseType), jsonb, textEncoding, serializerOptions);
			}
		}

		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Json serializer may perform reflection on trimmed types.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Serializing arbitrary types to json can require creating new generic types or methods, which requires creating code at runtime. This may not work when AOT compiling.")]
		private sealed class ArrayResolver : Resolver, IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private new TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(base.Mappings), base.Mappings));

			public ArrayResolver(Type[]? jsonbClrTypes = null, Type[]? jsonClrTypes = null, JsonSerializerOptions? serializerOptions = null)
				: base(jsonbClrTypes, jsonClrTypes, serializerOptions)
			{
			}

			public new PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options) ?? base.GetTypeInfo(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			protected override DynamicMappingCollection? GetMappings(Type? type, DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				if ((object)type == null || !DynamicTypeInfoResolver.IsArrayLikeType(type, out Type elementType) || !DynamicTypeInfoResolver.IsArrayDataTypeName(dataTypeName, options, out var elementDataTypeName))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.GetMappings(elementType, elementDataTypeName, options)?.AddArrayMapping(elementType, elementDataTypeName);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings, TypeInfoMappingCollection baseMappings)
			{
				if (baseMappings.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					return mappings;
				}
				DataTypeName[] array = new DataTypeName[2]
				{
					DataTypeNames.Jsonb,
					DataTypeNames.Json
				};
				foreach (DataTypeName dataTypeName in array)
				{
					mappings.AddArrayType<JsonNode>(dataTypeName);
					mappings.AddArrayType<JsonObject>(dataTypeName);
					mappings.AddArrayType<JsonArray>(dataTypeName);
					mappings.AddArrayType<JsonValue>(dataTypeName);
				}
				DynamicMappingCollection dynamicMappingCollection = DynamicTypeInfoResolver.CreateCollection(baseMappings);
				foreach (TypeInfoMapping item in baseMappings.Items)
				{
					dynamicMappingCollection.AddArrayMapping(item.Type, item.DataTypeName);
				}
				mappings.AddRange(dynamicMappingCollection.ToTypeInfoMappingCollection());
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		private readonly Type[]? _jsonbClrTypes;

		private readonly Type[]? _jsonClrTypes;

		private readonly JsonSerializerOptions? _serializerOptions;

		public JsonDynamicTypeInfoResolverFactory(Type[]? jsonbClrTypes = null, Type[]? jsonClrTypes = null, JsonSerializerOptions? serializerOptions = null)
		{
			_jsonbClrTypes = jsonbClrTypes;
			_jsonClrTypes = jsonClrTypes;
			_serializerOptions = serializerOptions;
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateResolver()
		{
			return new Resolver(_jsonbClrTypes, _jsonClrTypes, _serializerOptions);
		}

		public override IPgTypeInfoResolver CreateArrayResolver()
		{
			return new ArrayResolver(_jsonbClrTypes, _jsonClrTypes, _serializerOptions);
		}

	internal sealed class JsonTypeInfoResolverFactory : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
	{
		private class Resolver : IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private sealed class BasicJsonTypeInfoResolver : IJsonTypeInfoResolver
			{
				public JsonTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type type, JsonSerializerOptions options)
				{
					if (type == typeof(JsonDocument))
					{
						return JsonMetadataServices.CreateValueInfo<JsonDocument>(options, JsonMetadataServices.JsonDocumentConverter);
					}
					if (type == typeof(JsonElement))
					{
						return JsonMetadataServices.CreateValueInfo<JsonElement>(options, JsonMetadataServices.JsonElementConverter);
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			private static JsonSerializerOptions? DefaultSerializerOptions;

			private readonly JsonSerializerOptions _serializerOptions;

			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			protected TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(), _serializerOptions));

			public Resolver(JsonSerializerOptions? serializerOptions = null)
			{
				if (serializerOptions == null)
				{
					serializerOptions = DefaultSerializerOptions;
					if (serializerOptions == null)
					{
						serializerOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions();
						serializerOptions.TypeInfoResolver = new BasicJsonTypeInfoResolver();
						DefaultSerializerOptions = serializerOptions;
					}
				}
				_serializerOptions = serializerOptions;
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings, JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions)
			{
				DataTypeName[] array = new DataTypeName[2]
				{
					DataTypeNames.Jsonb,
					DataTypeNames.Json
				};
				foreach (DataTypeName dataTypeName in array)
				{
					bool jsonb = dataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Jsonb;
					mappings.AddType<JsonDocument>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new JsonConverter<JsonDocument, JsonDocument>(jsonb, options.TextEncoding, serializerOptions)), isDefault: true);
					mappings.AddStructType<JsonElement>(dataTypeName, (PgSerializerOptions options, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _) => mapping.CreateInfo(options, new JsonConverter<JsonElement, JsonElement>(jsonb, options.TextEncoding, serializerOptions)));
				}
				return mappings;
			}

			public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}
		}

		private sealed class ArrayResolver : Resolver, IPgTypeInfoResolver
		{
			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			private new TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection(base.Mappings)));

			public ArrayResolver(JsonSerializerOptions? serializerOptions = null)
				: base(serializerOptions)
			{
			}

			public new PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				return Mappings.Find(type, dataTypeName, options);
			}

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)
			{
				DataTypeName[] array = new DataTypeName[2]
				{
					DataTypeNames.Jsonb,
					DataTypeNames.Json
				};
				foreach (DataTypeName dataTypeName in array)
				{
					mappings.AddArrayType<JsonDocument>(dataTypeName);
					mappings.AddStructArrayType<JsonElement>(dataTypeName);
				}
				return mappings;
			}
		}

		private readonly JsonSerializerOptions? _serializerOptions;

		public JsonTypeInfoResolverFactory(JsonSerializerOptions? serializerOptions = null)
		{
			_serializerOptions = serializerOptions;
		}

	{
		private class Resolver : IPgTypeInfoResolver

			private const byte LTreeVersion = 1;

			private TypeInfoMappingCollection? _mappings;

			protected TypeInfoMappingCollection Mappings => _mappings ?? (_mappings = AddMappings(new TypeInfoMappingCollection()));

			public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)

			private static TypeInfoMappingCollection AddMappings(TypeInfoMappingCollection mappings)

	internal sealed class TupledRecordTypeInfoResolverFactory : PgTypeInfoResolverFactory
	{
		[RequiresUnreferencedCode("Tupled record resolver may perform reflection on trimmed tuple types.")]
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Tupled records need to construct a generic converter for a statically unknown (value)tuple type.")]
		private class Resolver : DynamicTypeInfoResolver
		{
			protected override DynamicMappingCollection? GetMappings(Type? type, DataTypeName dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
			{
				if (!(dataTypeName == DataTypeNames.Record) || (object)type == null || !type.IsConstructedGenericType || type.FullName == null || (!type.FullName.StartsWith("System.Tuple", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !type.FullName.StartsWith("System.ValueTuple", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DynamicTypeInfoResolver.CreateCollection().AddMapping(type, dataTypeName, delegate(PgSerializerOptions pgSerializerOptions, TypeInfoMapping mapping, bool _)
				{
					ConstructorInfo[] constructors = mapping.Type.GetConstructors();
					ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = null;
					if (constructors.Length == 1)
					{
						constructorInfo = constructors[0];
					}
					else
					{
						int num = mapping.Type.GenericTypeArguments.Length;
						ConstructorInfo[] array = constructors;
						foreach (ConstructorInfo constructorInfo2 in array)
						{
							if (constructorInfo2.GetParameters().Length == num)
							{
								constructorInfo = constructorInfo2;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if ((object)constructorInfo == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Couldn't find a suitable constructor for record type: " + mapping.Type.FullName);
					}
					object obj = typeof(Resolver).GetMethod("CreateFactory", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic).MakeGenericMethod(mapping.Type).Invoke(null, new object[2]
					{
						constructorInfo,
						constructorInfo.GetParameters().Length
					});
					PgConverter converter = (PgConverter)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(RecordConverter<>).MakeGenericType(mapping.Type), pgSerializerOptions, obj);
					return mapping.CreateInfo(pgSerializerOptions, converter, null, supportsWriting: false);
				});
			}

			private static Func<object[], T> CreateFactory<T>(ConstructorInfo constructor, int constructorParameters)
			{
				return delegate(object[] array)
				{
					if (array.Length != constructorParameters)
					{

					}
					return (T)constructor.Invoke(array);
				};
			}

	internal sealed class UnsupportedTypeInfoResolver<TBuilder> : IPgTypeInfoResolver
	{
		public PgTypeInfo? GetTypeInfo(Type? type, DataTypeName? dataTypeName, PgSerializerOptions options)
		{
			if (options.IntrospectionMode)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RecordTypeInfoResolverFactory.ThrowIfUnsupported<TBuilder>(type, dataTypeName, options);
			FullTextSearchTypeInfoResolverFactory.ThrowIfUnsupported<TBuilder>(type, dataTypeName, options);
			LTreeTypeInfoResolverFactory.ThrowIfUnsupported<TBuilder>(type, dataTypeName, options);
			JsonDynamicTypeInfoResolverFactory.Support.ThrowIfUnsupported<TBuilder>(type, dataTypeName);
			PostgresType postgresType = ((!dataTypeName.HasValue) ? null : options.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(dataTypeName.GetValueOrDefault()));
			if (!(postgresType is PostgresEnumType))
			{
				if (postgresType is PostgresRangeType)
				{
					if (!options.RangesEnabled)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.RangesNotEnabled, "EnableRanges", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
					}
					throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.UnmappedRangesNotEnabled, "EnableUnmappedTypes", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
				}
				if (postgresType is PostgresMultirangeType)
				{
					if (!options.MultirangesEnabled)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.MultirangesNotEnabled, "EnableMultiranges", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
					}
					throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.UnmappedRangesNotEnabled, "EnableUnmappedTypes", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
				}
				if (postgresType is PostgresArrayType && !options.ArraysEnabled)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.ArraysNotEnabled, "EnableArrays", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
				}
			}
			else if ((object)type != null && type != typeof(object))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.UnmappedEnumsNotEnabled, "EnableUnmappedTypes", typeof(TBuilder).Name));
			}
			if ((object)type != null)
			{
				if (TypeInfoMappingCollection.IsArrayLikeType(type, out Type elementType) && TypeInfoMappingCollection.IsArrayLikeType(elementType, out Type _))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Writing is not supported for jagged collections, use a multidimensional array instead.");
				}
				if (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type) && !typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(type) && type != typeof(string) && (!dataTypeName.HasValue || dataTypeName.Value.IsArray))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Writing is not supported for IEnumerable parameters, use an array or some implementation of IList<T> instead.");
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

namespace Npgsql.Internal.Postgres
{
	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	[DebuggerDisplay("{DisplayName,nq}")]
	public readonly struct DataTypeName : IEquatable<DataTypeName>
	{
		internal const int NAMEDATALEN = 63;

		private readonly string _value;

		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Value.StartsWith("pg_catalog", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !(Value == Unspecified))
				{
					return Schema + "." + UnqualifiedDisplayName;
				}
				return UnqualifiedDisplayName;
			}
		}

		public string UnqualifiedDisplayName => ToDisplayName(UnqualifiedNameSpan);

		internal ReadOnlySpan<char> SchemaSpan => System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(Value, 0, _value.IndexOf('.'));

		public string Schema => Value.Substring(0, _value.IndexOf('.'));

		internal ReadOnlySpan<char> UnqualifiedNameSpan => System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(Value, _value.IndexOf('.') + 1);

		public string UnqualifiedName => Value.Substring(_value.IndexOf('.') + 1);

		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (_value != null)
				{
					return _value;
				}
				return ThrowDefaultException();
			}
		}

		public static DataTypeName Unspecified => new DataTypeName("-.-", validated: true);

		public bool IsArray => UnqualifiedNameSpan.StartsWith(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("_"), StringComparison.Ordinal);

		private DataTypeName(string fullyQualifiedDataTypeName, bool validated)
		{
			if (!validated)
			{
				int num = fullyQualifiedDataTypeName.IndexOf('.');
				if (num == -1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Given value does not contain a schema.", "fullyQualifiedDataTypeName");
				}
				if (System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(fullyQualifiedDataTypeName, num).EndsWith(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("[]")))
				{
					fullyQualifiedDataTypeName = NormalizeName(fullyQualifiedDataTypeName);
				}
				int num2 = fullyQualifiedDataTypeName.Length - (num + 1);
				if (num2 > 63)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Name is too long and would be truncated to: " + fullyQualifiedDataTypeName.Substring(0, fullyQualifiedDataTypeName.Length - num2 + 63));
				}
			}
			_value = fullyQualifiedDataTypeName;
		}

		public DataTypeName(string fullyQualifiedDataTypeName)
			: this(fullyQualifiedDataTypeName, validated: false)
		{
		}

		internal static DataTypeName ValidatedName(string fullyQualifiedDataTypeName)
		{
			return new DataTypeName(fullyQualifiedDataTypeName, validated: true);
		}

		private static string ThrowDefaultException()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("This operation cannot be performed on a default value of DataTypeName.");
		}

		public static implicit operator string(DataTypeName value)
		{
			return value.Value;
		}

		internal static DataTypeName CreateFullyQualifiedName(string dataTypeName)
		{
			if (dataTypeName.IndexOf('.') == -1)
			{
				return new DataTypeName("pg_catalog." + dataTypeName);
			}
			return new DataTypeName(dataTypeName);
		}

		public DataTypeName ToArrayName()
		{
			ReadOnlySpan<char> unqualifiedNameSpan = UnqualifiedNameSpan;
			if (unqualifiedNameSpan.StartsWith(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("_"), StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return this;
			}
			string text = unqualifiedNameSpan.ToString();
			if (text.Length + "_".Length > 63)
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, 63 - "_".Length);
			}
			return new DataTypeName(Schema + "._" + text);
		}

		public DataTypeName ToDefaultMultirangeName()
		{
			ReadOnlySpan<char> unqualifiedNameSpan = UnqualifiedNameSpan;
			if (UnqualifiedNameSpan.IndexOf(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("multirange"), StringComparison.Ordinal) != -1)
			{
				return this;
			}
			string text = unqualifiedNameSpan.ToString();
			int num = text.IndexOf("range", StringComparison.Ordinal);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				string text2 = text.Substring(0, num) + "multirange" + text.Substring(num + "range".Length);
				return new DataTypeName(Schema + "." + ((text.Length + "multi".Length > 63) ? text2.Substring(0, 63 - "multi".Length) : text2));
			}
			return new DataTypeName(Schema + "." + ((text.Length + "multi".Length > 63) ? (text.Substring(0, 63 - "_multirange".Length) + "_multirange") : (text + "_multirange")));
		}

		public static DataTypeName FromDisplayName(string displayName, string? schema = null)
		{
			ReadOnlySpan<char> span = System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(displayName).Trim();
			int num = span.IndexOf('.');
			if (num != -1 && !span.Slice(num).StartsWith(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("_"), StringComparison.Ordinal) && !span.EndsWith(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("[]"), StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new DataTypeName(displayName);
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				schema = span.Slice(0, num).ToString();
				span = span.Slice(num + 1);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (span.StartsWith(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("_")))
			{
				flag = true;
				span = span.Slice(1);
			}
			else if (span.EndsWith(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("[]")))
			{
				flag = true;
				span = span.Slice(0, span.Length - 2);
			}
			string text2;
			if (num == -1)
			{
				int num2 = span.IndexOf('(');
				if (num2 > -1)
				{
					span = span.Slice(0, num2);
				}
				string text = span.ToString();
				text2 = text switch
				{
					"boolean" => "bool", 
					"character" => "bpchar", 
					"decimal" => "numeric", 
					"real" => "float4", 
					"double precision" => "float8", 
					"smallint" => "int2", 
					"integer" => "int4", 
					"bigint" => "int8", 
					"time without time zone" => "time", 
					"timestamp without time zone" => "timestamp", 
					"time with time zone" => "timetz", 
					"timestamp with time zone" => "timestamptz", 
					"bit varying" => "varbit", 
					"character varying" => "varchar", 
					_ => text, 
				};
			}
			else
			{
				text2 = span.ToString();
			}
			return new DataTypeName((schema ?? "pg_catalog") + "." + (flag ? "_" : "") + text2);
		}

		private static string ToDisplayName(ReadOnlySpan<char> unqualifiedName)
		{
			bool flag = unqualifiedName.IndexOf('_') == 0;
			string text = (flag ? unqualifiedName.Slice(1).ToString() : unqualifiedName.ToString());
			string text2 = text switch
			{
				"bool" => "boolean", 
				"bpchar" => "character", 
				"decimal" => "numeric", 
				"float4" => "real", 
				"float8" => "double precision", 
				"int2" => "smallint", 
				"int4" => "integer", 
				"int8" => "bigint", 
				"time" => "time without time zone", 
				"timestamp" => "timestamp without time zone", 
				"timetz" => "time with time zone", 
				"timestamptz" => "timestamp with time zone", 
				"varbit" => "bit varying", 
				"varchar" => "character varying", 
				_ => text, 
			};
			if (flag)
			{
				return text2 + "[]";
			}
			return text2;
		}

		internal static bool IsFullyQualified(ReadOnlySpan<char> dataTypeName)
		{
			return dataTypeName.Contains(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan("."), StringComparison.Ordinal);
		}

		internal static string NormalizeName(string dataTypeName)
		{
			DataTypeName dataTypeName2 = FromDisplayName(dataTypeName);
			if (!IsFullyQualified(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(dataTypeName)))
			{
				return dataTypeName2.UnqualifiedName;
			}
			return dataTypeName2.Value;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Value;
		}

		public bool Equals(DataTypeName other)
		{
			return string.Equals(_value, other._value);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is DataTypeName other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DataTypeName left, DataTypeName right)
		{
			return left.Equals(right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DataTypeName left, DataTypeName right)
		{
			return !left.Equals(right);
		}
	}

	[Experimental("NPG9001")]
	public readonly struct PgTypeId : IEquatable<PgTypeId>
	{
		private readonly DataTypeName _dataTypeName;

		private readonly Oid _oid;

		[MemberNotNullWhen(true, "_dataTypeName")]
		public bool IsDataTypeName
		{
			[MemberNotNullWhen(true, "_dataTypeName")]
			get
			{
				return _dataTypeName != default(DataTypeName);
			}
		}

		public bool IsOid => _dataTypeName == default(DataTypeName);

		public DataTypeName DataTypeName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsDataTypeName)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("This value does not describe a DataTypeName.");
				}
				return _dataTypeName;
			}
		}

		public Oid Oid
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsOid)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("This value does not describe an Oid.");
				}
				return _oid;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsUnspecified
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsOid || !(_oid == Oid.Unspecified))
				{
					return _dataTypeName == DataTypeName.Unspecified;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public PgTypeId(DataTypeName name)
		{
			_oid = default(Oid);
			_dataTypeName = name;
		}

		public PgTypeId(Oid oid)
		{
			_dataTypeName = default(DataTypeName);
			_oid = oid;
		}

		public static implicit operator PgTypeId(DataTypeName name)
		{
			return new PgTypeId(name);
		}

		public static implicit operator PgTypeId(Oid id)
		{
			return new PgTypeId(id);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!IsOid)
			{
				return "DataTypeName " + _dataTypeName.Value;
			}
			return "OID " + _oid;
		}

		public bool Equals(PgTypeId other)
		{
			if (IsOid && other.IsOid)
			{
				return _oid == other._oid;
			}
			if (IsDataTypeName && other.IsDataTypeName)
			{
				return _dataTypeName.Equals(other._dataTypeName);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? obj)
		{
			if (obj is PgTypeId other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (!IsOid)
			{
				return _dataTypeName.GetHashCode();
			}
			return _oid.GetHashCode();
		}

		public static bool operator ==(PgTypeId left, PgTypeId right)
		{
			return left.Equals(right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(PgTypeId left, PgTypeId right)
		{
			return !left.Equals(right);
		}
	}

namespace Npgsql.Internal.Converters

	internal interface IElementOperations
	{
		object CreateCollection(int[] lengths);

		int GetCollectionCount(object collection, out int[]? lengths);

		Size? GetSizeOrDbNull(SizeContext context, object collection, int[] indices, ref object? writeState);

		ValueTask Read(bool async, PgReader reader, bool isDbNull, object collection, int[] indices, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));

		ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, object collection, int[] indices, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));
	}
	internal readonly struct PgArrayConverter
	{
		private sealed class WriteState : MultiWriteState
		{
			public required int Count { get; init; }

			public required int[] Indices { get; init; }

			public required int[]? Lengths { get; init; }
		}

		internal const string ReadNonNullableCollectionWithNullsExceptionMessage = "Cannot read a non-nullable collection of elements because the returned array contains nulls. Call GetFieldValue with a nullable collection type instead.";

		private readonly IElementOperations _elemOps;

		private readonly int? _expectedDimensions;

		private readonly BufferRequirements _bufferRequirements;

		private readonly int _pgLowerBound;

		private readonly PgTypeId _elemTypeId;

		public bool ElemTypeDbNullable { get; }

		public PgArrayConverter(IElementOperations elemOps, bool elemTypeDbNullable, int? expectedDimensions, BufferRequirements bufferRequirements, PgTypeId elemTypeId, int pgLowerBound = 1)
		{
			_elemTypeId = elemTypeId;
			ElemTypeDbNullable = elemTypeDbNullable;
			_pgLowerBound = pgLowerBound;
			_elemOps = elemOps;
			_expectedDimensions = expectedDimensions;
			_bufferRequirements = bufferRequirements;
		}

		private bool IsDbNull(object values, int[] indices)
		{
			object writeState = null;
			return !_elemOps.GetSizeOrDbNull(new SizeContext(DataFormat.Binary, _bufferRequirements.Write), values, indices, ref writeState).HasValue;
		}

		private Size GetElemsSize(object values, (Size, object?)[] elemStates, out bool anyElementState, DataFormat format, int count, int[] indices, int[]? lengths = null)
		{
			Size result = Size.Zero;
			SizeContext context = new SizeContext(format, _bufferRequirements.Write);
			anyElementState = false;
			int num = ((lengths != null) ? lengths[^1] : count);
			ref int reference = ref indices[^1];
			int num2 = 0;
			do
			{
				ref(Size, object?) reference2 = ref elemStates[num2++];
				object writeState = null;
				Size? sizeOrDbNull = _elemOps.GetSizeOrDbNull(context, values, indices, ref writeState);
				anyElementState = anyElementState || writeState != null;
				reference2 = (sizeOrDbNull ?? ((Size)(-1)), writeState);
				result = result.Combine(sizeOrDbNull ?? ((Size)0));
			}
			while (++reference < num || (indices.Length > 1 && CarryIndices(lengths, indices)));
			return result;
		}

		private Size GetFixedElemsSize(Size elemSize, object values, int count, int[] indices, int[]? lengths = null)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = ((lengths != null) ? lengths[^1] : count);
			ref int reference = ref indices[^1];
			if (ElemTypeDbNullable)
			{
				do
				{
					if (IsDbNull(values, indices))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				while (++reference < num2 || (indices.Length > 1 && CarryIndices(lengths, indices)));
			}
			return (count - num) * elemSize.Value;
		}

		private int GetFormatSize(int count, int dimensions)
		{
			return 12 + dimensions * 8 + 4 * count;
		}

		public Size GetSize(SizeContext context, object values, ref object? writeState)
		{
			int[] lengths;
			int collectionCount = _elemOps.GetCollectionCount(values, out lengths);
			int num = ((lengths == null) ? 1 : lengths.Length);
			if (num > 8)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("values", "Postgres arrays can have at most 8 dimensions.");
			}
			Size result = Size.Create(GetFormatSize(collectionCount, num));
			if (collectionCount == 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			int[] indices = new int[num];
			Size write = _bufferRequirements.Write;
			Size result2;
			if (write.Kind == SizeKind.Exact)
			{
				result2 = GetFixedElemsSize(write, values, collectionCount, indices, lengths);
				writeState = new WriteState
				{
					Count = collectionCount,
					Indices = indices,
					Lengths = lengths,
					ArrayPool = null,
					Data = default(ArraySegment<(Size, object)>),
					AnyWriteState = false
				};
			}
			else
			{
				ArrayPool<(Size, object)> shared = ArrayPool<(Size, object)>.Shared;
				(Size, object)[] array = ArrayPool<(Size, object)>.Shared.Rent(collectionCount);
				result2 = GetElemsSize(values, array, out var anyElementState, context.Format, collectionCount, indices, lengths);
				writeState = new WriteState
				{
					Count = collectionCount,
					Indices = indices,
					Lengths = lengths,
					ArrayPool = shared,
					Data = new ArraySegment<(Size, object)>(array, 0, collectionCount),
					AnyWriteState = anyElementState
				};
			}
			return result.Combine(result2);
		}

		public async ValueTask<object> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(12))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 12, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			int dimensions = reader.ReadInt32();
			bool num = reader.ReadInt32() == 1;
			reader.ReadUInt32();
			if (dimensions != 0)
			{
				int? expectedDimensions = _expectedDimensions;
				if (expectedDimensions.HasValue && dimensions != _expectedDimensions)
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException(string.Format("Cannot read an array value with {0} dimension{1} into a ", dimensions, (dimensions == 1) ? "" : "s") + string.Format("collection type with {0} dimension{1}. ", _expectedDimensions, (_expectedDimensions == 1) ? "" : "s") + "Call GetValue or a version of GetFieldValue<TElement[,,,]> with the commas being the expected amount of dimensions.");
				}
			}
			if (num && !ElemTypeDbNullable)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidCastException("Cannot read a non-nullable collection of elements because the returned array contains nulls. Call GetFieldValue with a nullable collection type instead.");
			}
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(8 * dimensions))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 8 * dimensions, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			int[] dimLengths = new int[_expectedDimensions ?? dimensions];
			int lastDimLength = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < dimensions; i++)
			{
				lastDimLength = reader.ReadInt32();
				reader.ReadInt32();
				if (dimLengths.Length == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				dimLengths[i] = lastDimLength;
			}
			object collection = _elemOps.CreateCollection(dimLengths);
			if (dimensions == 0 || lastDimLength == 0)
			{

	internal abstract class ArrayConverter<T> : PgStreamingConverter<T> where T : class
	{
		protected readonly struct Continuation
		{
			private unsafe readonly delegate*<Task, object, int[], void> _continuation;

			public object Handle { get; }

			public unsafe Continuation(object handle, delegate*<Task, object, int[], void> continuation)
			{
				Handle = handle;
				_continuation = continuation;
			}

			public unsafe void Invoke(Task task, object collection, int[] indices)
			{
				_continuation(task, collection, indices);
			}
		}

		private readonly PgArrayConverter _pgArrayConverter;

		protected PgConverterResolution ElemResolution { get; }

		protected Type ElemTypeToConvert { get; }

		private protected ArrayConverter(int? expectedDimensions, PgConverterResolution elemResolution, int pgLowerBound = 1)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			if (!elemResolution.Converter.CanConvert(DataFormat.Binary, out var bufferRequirements))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Element converter has to support the binary format to be compatible.");
			}
			ElemResolution = elemResolution;

			_pgArrayConverter = new PgArrayConverter((IElementOperations)this, elemResolution.Converter.IsDbNullable, expectedDimensions, bufferRequirements, elemResolution.PgTypeId, pgLowerBound);
		}

		{

		}

		public override ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{

			return Unsafe.As<ValueTask<object>, ValueTask<T>>(ref source);
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T values, ref object? writeState)
		{

		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, T values)
		{

		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, T values, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return _pgArrayConverter.Write(async: true, writer, values, cancellationToken);
		}

		private protected static async ValueTask AwaitTask(Task task, Continuation continuation, object collection, int[] indices)
		{
			await task.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			continuation.Invoke(task, collection, indices);
			GC.KeepAlive(continuation.Handle);
		}

		protected static int[]? GetLengths(Array array)
		{
			if (array.Rank == 1)
			{
				return null;
			}

		{

			}
