			}
			else
			{
				Unsafe.As<Array>(collection).SetValue(value, indices);
			}
		}

		object IElementOperations.CreateCollection(int[] lengths)
		{
			switch (lengths.Length)
			{
			case 0:
				return Array.Empty<TElement>();
			case 1:
				if (lengths[0] == 0)
				{
					return Array.Empty<TElement>();
				}
				return new TElement[lengths[0]];
			case 2:
				return new TElement[lengths[0], lengths[1]];
			case 3:
				return new TElement[lengths[0], lengths[1], lengths[2]];
			case 4:
				return new TElement[lengths[0], lengths[1], lengths[2], lengths[3]];
			case 5:
				return new TElement[lengths[0], lengths[1], lengths[2], lengths[3], lengths[4]];
			case 6:
				return new TElement[lengths[0], lengths[1], lengths[2], lengths[3], lengths[4], lengths[5]];
			case 7:
				return new TElement[lengths[0], lengths[1], lengths[2], lengths[3], lengths[4], lengths[5], lengths[6]];
			case 8:
				return new TElement[lengths[0], lengths[1], lengths[2], lengths[3], lengths[4], lengths[5], lengths[6], lengths[7]];
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Postgres arrays can have at most 8 dimensions.");
			}
		}

		}

		{

		}

		ValueTask IElementOperations.Read(bool async, PgReader reader, bool isDbNull, object collection, int[] indices, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!isDbNull && async && _elemConverter is PgStreamingConverter<TElement> converter)
			{
				return ReadAsync(converter, reader, collection, indices, cancellationToken);
			}
			SetValue(collection, indices, isDbNull ? default(TElement) : _elemConverter.Read(reader));

		}

		{
			TElement result;
			Task<TElement> task = converter.ReadAsyncAsTask(reader, cancellationToken, out result);

			{
				return ArrayConverter<T>.AwaitTask(task, new Continuation((object)this, (delegate*<Task, object, int[], void>)(&SetResult)), collection, indices);
			}
			SetValue(collection, indices, result);
			return default(ValueTask);
			static void SetResult(Task task2, object collection2, int[] indices2)
			{
				SetValue(collection2, indices2, new ValueTask<TElement>((Task<TElement>)task2).Result);
			}
		}

		ValueTask IElementOperations.Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, object collection, int[] indices, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (async)
			{
				return _elemConverter.WriteAsync(writer, GetValue(collection, indices), cancellationToken);
			}
			_elemConverter.Write(writer, GetValue(collection, indices));
			return default(ValueTask);

	internal static class AsyncHelpers
	{
		private abstract class CompletionSource
		{
			public abstract void SetException(Exception exception);
		}

		private sealed class CompletionSource<T> : CompletionSource
		{
			private AsyncValueTaskMethodBuilder<T> _amb = AsyncValueTaskMethodBuilder<T>.Create();

			public ValueTask<T> Task => _amb.Task;

			public void SetResult(T value)
			{
				_amb.SetResult(value);
			}

			public override void SetException(Exception exception)
			{
				_amb.SetException(exception);
			}
		}

		private readonly struct Continuation
		{
			private unsafe readonly delegate*<Task, CompletionSource, void> _continuation;

			public object Handle { get; }

			public unsafe Continuation(object handle, delegate*<Task, CompletionSource, void> continuation)
			{
				Handle = handle;
				_continuation = continuation;
			}

			public unsafe void Invoke(Task task, CompletionSource tcs)
			{
				_continuation(task, tcs);
			}
		}

		private static async void AwaitTask(Task task, CompletionSource tcs, Continuation continuation)
		{
			try
			{
				await task.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				continuation.Invoke(task, tcs);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				tcs.SetException(exception);
			}
			GC.KeepAlive(continuation.Handle);
		}

		public unsafe static ValueTask<T?> ReadAsyncAsNullable<T>(this PgConverter<T?> instance, PgConverter<T> effectiveConverter, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken) where T : struct
		{
			ValueTask<T> valueTask = effectiveConverter.ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
			if (valueTask.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
			{
				return new ValueTask<T?>(valueTask.Result);
			}
			CompletionSource<T?> completionSource = new CompletionSource<T?>();
			AwaitTask(valueTask.AsTask(), completionSource, new Continuation((object)instance, (delegate*<Task, CompletionSource, void>)(&UnboxAndComplete)));
			return completionSource.Task;
			static void UnboxAndComplete(Task task, CompletionSource o)
			{
				Unsafe.As<CompletionSource<T?>>(o).SetResult(new ValueTask<T>(Unsafe.As<Task<T>>(task)).Result);
			}
		}

		public unsafe static ValueTask<T> ReadAsObjectAsyncAsT<T>(this PgConverter<T> instance, PgConverter effectiveConverter, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!typeof(T).IsValueType)
			{
				ValueTask<object> source = effectiveConverter.ReadAsObjectAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
				return Unsafe.As<ValueTask<object>, ValueTask<T>>(ref source);
			}
			ValueTask<object> valueTask = effectiveConverter.ReadAsObjectAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
			if (valueTask.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
			{
				return new ValueTask<T>((T)valueTask.Result);
			}
			CompletionSource<T> completionSource = new CompletionSource<T>();
			AwaitTask(valueTask.AsTask(), completionSource, new Continuation((object)instance, (delegate*<Task, CompletionSource, void>)(&UnboxAndComplete)));
			return completionSource.Task;
			static void UnboxAndComplete(Task task, CompletionSource o)
			{
				Unsafe.As<CompletionSource<T>>(o).SetResult((T)new ValueTask<object>(Unsafe.As<Task<object>>(task)).Result);
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class BitStringHelpers
	{
		public static int GetByteLengthFromBits(int n)
		{
			return n - 1 + 8 >>> 3;
		}

		public static byte ReverseBits(byte b)
		{
			return (byte)((ulong)((((long)b * 2149582850L) & 0x884422110L) * 4311810305L) >> 32);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class BitArrayBitStringConverter : PgStreamingConverter<BitArray>
	{
		public override BitArray Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
			{
				reader.Buffer(4);
			}
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			byte[] array = new byte[BitStringHelpers.GetByteLengthFromBits(num)];
			reader.ReadBytes(array);
			return ReadValue(array, num);
		}

		public override async ValueTask<BitArray> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
			{
				await reader.BufferAsync(4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			int bits = reader.ReadInt32();
			byte[] bytes = new byte[BitStringHelpers.GetByteLengthFromBits(bits)];
			await reader.ReadBytesAsync(bytes, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return ReadValue(bytes, bits);
		}

		internal static BitArray ReadValue(byte[] bytes, int bits)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++)
			{
				ref byte reference = ref bytes[i];
				reference = BitStringHelpers.ReverseBits(reference);
			}
			return new BitArray(bytes)
			{
				Length = bits
			};
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, BitArray value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return 4 + BitStringHelpers.GetByteLengthFromBits(value.Length);
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, BitArray value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, BitArray value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, BitArray value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			int byteCount = writer.Current.Size.Value - 4;
			byte[] array = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(byteCount);
			for (int i = 0; i < byteCount; i++)
			{
				int num = i * 8;
				int num2 = Math.Min(8, value.Length - num);
				int num3 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					num3 += (int)((value[num + j] ? 1u : 0u) << 8 - j - 1);
				}
				array[i] = (byte)num3;
			}
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
			{
				await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteInt32(value.Length);
			if (async)
			{
				await writer.WriteBytesAsync(new ReadOnlyMemory<byte>(array, 0, byteCount), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.WriteBytes(new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(array, 0, byteCount));
			}
			ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(array);
		}

		public BitArrayBitStringConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class BitVector32BitStringConverter : PgBufferedConverter<BitVector32>
	{
		private static int MaxSize => 8;

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.Create(Size.CreateUpperBound(MaxSize));
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override BitVector32 ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			if (reader.CurrentRemaining > 8)
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("Can't read a BIT(N) with more than 32 bits to BitVector32, only up to BIT(32).");
			}
			return BitStringHelpers.GetByteLengthFromBits(reader.ReadInt32()) switch
			{
				4 => new BitVector32(reader.ReadInt32()), 
				3 => new BitVector32((reader.ReadInt16() << 8) + reader.ReadByte()), 
				2 => new BitVector32(reader.ReadInt16() << 16), 
				1 => new BitVector32(reader.ReadByte() << 24), 
				_ => new BitVector32(0), 
			};
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, BitVector32 value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return (value.Data == 0) ? 4 : MaxSize;
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, BitVector32 value)
		{
			if (value.Data == 0)
			{
				writer.WriteInt32(0);
				return;
			}
			writer.WriteInt32(32);
			writer.WriteInt32(value.Data);
		}

		public BitVector32BitStringConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class BoolBitStringConverter : PgBufferedConverter<bool>
	{
		private static int MaxSize => 5;

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.Create(Size.CreateUpperBound(MaxSize), MaxSize);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override bool ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (num <= 1)
			{
				if (num == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return (reader.ReadByte() & 0x80) != 0;
			}
			throw new InvalidCastException("Can't read a BIT(N) type to bool, only BIT(1).");
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, bool value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return MaxSize;
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, bool value)
		{
			writer.WriteInt32(1);
			writer.WriteByte((byte)(value ? 128 : 0));
		}

		public BoolBitStringConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class StringBitStringConverter : PgStreamingConverter<string>
	{
		public override string Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask<string> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<string> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			int bits = reader.ReadInt32();
			byte[] bytes = new byte[BitStringHelpers.GetByteLengthFromBits(bits)];
			if (async)
			{
				await reader.ReadBytesAsync(bytes, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				reader.ReadBytes(bytes);
			}
			BitArray bitArray = BitArrayBitStringConverter.ReadValue(bytes, bits);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(bits);
			for (int i = 0; i < bitArray.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(bitArray[i] ? '1' : '0');
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, string value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			int num = System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(value).IndexOfAnyExcept('0', '1');
			if (num != -1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid bitstring character '{value[num]}' at index: {num}", "value");
			}
			return 4 + BitStringHelpers.GetByteLengthFromBits(value.Length);
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, string value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, string value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, string value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			int byteCount = writer.Current.Size.Value - 4;
			byte[] array = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(byteCount);
			for (int i = 0; i < byteCount; i++)
			{
				int num = i * 8;
				int num2 = Math.Min(8, value.Length - num);
				int num3 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					num3 += (int)(((value[num + j] == '1') ? 1u : 0u) << 8 - j - 1);
				}
				array[i] = (byte)num3;
			}
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
			{
				await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteInt32(value.Length);
			if (async)
			{
				await writer.WriteBytesAsync(new ReadOnlyMemory<byte>(array, 0, byteCount), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.WriteBytes(new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(array, 0, byteCount));
			}
			ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(array);
		}

		public StringBitStringConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class PolymorphicBitStringConverterResolver : PolymorphicConverterResolver<object>
	{
		private BoolBitStringConverter? _boolConverter;

		private BitArrayBitStringConverter? _bitArrayConverter;

		public PolymorphicBitStringConverterResolver(PgTypeId bitString)
			: base(bitString)
		{
		}

		protected override PgConverter Get(Field? field)
		{
			int? num = field?.TypeModifier;
			object obj;
			if (!num.HasValue || num != 1)
			{
				obj = _bitArrayConverter;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return _bitArrayConverter = new BitArrayBitStringConverter();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = _boolConverter ?? (_boolConverter = new BoolBitStringConverter());
			}
			return (PgConverter)obj;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CastingConverter<T> : PgConverter<T>
	{
		private readonly PgConverter _effectiveConverter;

		public CastingConverter(PgConverter effectiveConverter)
			: base(effectiveConverter.DbNullPredicateKind == DbNullPredicate.Custom)
		{
			_effectiveConverter = effectiveConverter;
		}

		protected override bool IsDbNullValue(T? value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return _effectiveConverter.IsDbNullAsObject(value, ref writeState);
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			return _effectiveConverter.CanConvert(format, out bufferRequirements);
		}

		public override T Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return (T)_effectiveConverter.ReadAsObject(reader);
		}

		public override ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return this.ReadAsObjectAsyncAsT(_effectiveConverter, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return _effectiveConverter.GetSizeAsObject(context, value, ref writeState);
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			_effectiveConverter.WriteAsObject(writer, value);
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return _effectiveConverter.WriteAsObjectAsync(writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal override ValueTask<object> ReadAsObject(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!async)
			{
				return new ValueTask<object>(_effectiveConverter.ReadAsObject(reader));
			}
			return _effectiveConverter.ReadAsObjectAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal override ValueTask WriteAsObject(bool async, PgWriter writer, object value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (async)
			{
				return _effectiveConverter.WriteAsObjectAsync(writer, value, cancellationToken);
			}
			_effectiveConverter.WriteAsObject(writer, value);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}
	}

	internal static class CastingTypeInfoExtensions
	{
		[RequiresDynamicCode("Changing boxing converters to their non-boxing counterpart can require creating new generic types or methods, which requires creating code at runtime. This may not be AOT  when AOT compiling")]
		internal static PgTypeInfo ToNonBoxing(this PgTypeInfo typeInfo)
		{
			if (!typeInfo.IsBoxing)
			{
				return typeInfo;
			}
			Type type = typeInfo.Type;
			if (typeInfo is PgResolverTypeInfo pgResolverTypeInfo)
			{
				return new PgResolverTypeInfo(typeInfo.Options, (PgConverterResolver)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(CastingConverterResolver<>).MakeGenericType(type), pgResolverTypeInfo), typeInfo.PgTypeId);
			}
			PgConverterResolution resolution = typeInfo.GetResolution();
			return new PgTypeInfo(typeInfo.Options, (PgConverter)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(CastingConverter<>).MakeGenericType(type), resolution.Converter), resolution.PgTypeId);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CompositeConverter<T> : PgStreamingConverter<T> where T : notnull
	{
		private readonly struct ElementState
		{
			public required Size Size { get; init; }

			public required object? WriteState { get; init; }

			public required PgConverter Converter { get; init; }

			public required Size BufferRequirement { get; init; }
		}

		private class WriteState : IDisposable
		{
			public required ArrayPool<ElementState>? ArrayPool { get; init; }

			public required ArraySegment<ElementState> Data { get; init; }

			public required bool AnyWriteState { get; init; }

			public required object BoxedInstance { get; init; }

			public void Dispose()
			{
				ElementState[] array = Data.Array;
				if (array == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (AnyWriteState)
				{
					for (int i = Data.Offset; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (array[i].WriteState is IDisposable disposable)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
					Array.Clear(Data.Array, Data.Offset, Data.Count);
				}
				ArrayPool?.Return(Data.Array);
			}
		}

		private readonly CompositeInfo<T> _composite;

		private readonly BufferRequirements _bufferRequirements;

		public CompositeConverter(CompositeInfo<T> composite)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_composite = composite;
			BufferRequirements bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(4 + _composite.Fields.Count * 8);
			foreach (CompositeFieldInfo field in _composite.Fields)
			{
				Size read = field.BinaryReadRequirement;
				Size write = field.BinaryWriteRequirement;
				if (field.IsDbNullable)
				{
					read = read.Combine(Size.CreateUpperBound(0));
					write = write.Combine(Size.CreateUpperBound(0));
				}
				bufferRequirements = bufferRequirements.Combine(read, write);
			}
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.Create(Limit(bufferRequirements.Read), Limit(bufferRequirements.Write));
			_bufferRequirements = bufferRequirements;
			static Size Limit(Size requirement)
			{
				if (requirement.GetValueOrDefault() <= 1024)
				{
					return requirement;
				}
				return requirement.Combine(Size.Unknown);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = _bufferRequirements;
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		public override T Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<T> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			using CompositeBuilder<T> builder = new CompositeBuilder<T>(_composite);
			if (reader.ReadInt32() != _composite.Fields.Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot read composite type with mismatched number of fields.");
			}
			foreach (CompositeFieldInfo field in _composite.Fields)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(8))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 8, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				uint num = reader.ReadUInt32();
				int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
				if (num != field.PgTypeId.Oid)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException($"Cannot read oid {num} into composite field {field.Name} with oid {field.PgTypeId}. " + "This could be caused by a DDL change after this DataSource loaded its types, or a difference between column order of table composites between backends, make sure these line up identically.");
				}
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					field.ReadDbNull(builder);
					continue;
				}
				Size readRequirement;
				PgConverter converter = field.GetReadInfo(out readRequirement);
				NestedReadScope scope = await reader.BeginNestedRead(async, num2, readRequirement, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				try
				{
					await field.Read(async, converter, builder, reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await scope.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						scope.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			return builder.Complete();
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			ArrayPool<ElementState> shared = ArrayPool<ElementState>.Shared;
			ElementState[] array = shared.Rent(_composite.Fields.Count);
			Size result = Size.Create(4 + _composite.Fields.Count * 8);
			object obj = value;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < _composite.Fields.Count; i++)
			{
				CompositeFieldInfo compositeFieldInfo = _composite.Fields[i];
				Size writeRequirement;
				PgConverter writeInfo = compositeFieldInfo.GetWriteInfo(obj, out writeRequirement);
				object writeState2 = null;
				Size? sizeOrDbNull = compositeFieldInfo.GetSizeOrDbNull(writeInfo, context.Format, writeRequirement, obj, ref writeState2);
				flag = flag || writeState2 != null;
				array[i] = new ElementState
				{
					Size = (sizeOrDbNull ?? ((Size)(-1))),
					WriteState = writeState2,
					Converter = writeInfo,
					BufferRequirement = writeRequirement
				};
				result = result.Combine(sizeOrDbNull ?? ((Size)0));
			}
			writeState = new WriteState
			{
				ArrayPool = shared,
				Data = new ArraySegment<ElementState>(array, 0, _composite.Fields.Count),
				AnyWriteState = flag,
				BoxedInstance = obj
			};
			return result;
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			object writeState = writer.Current.WriteState;
			if (writeState != null && !(writeState is WriteState))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("Invalid write state, expected " + typeof(WriteState).FullName + ".");
			}
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
			{
				await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteInt32(_composite.Fields.Count);
			WriteState writeState2 = writer.Current.WriteState as WriteState;
			object boxedInstance = writeState2?.BoxedInstance ?? ((object)value);
			ElementState[] data = writeState2?.Data.Array;
			for (int i = 0; i < _composite.Fields.Count; i++)
			{
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(8))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				CompositeFieldInfo field = _composite.Fields[i];
				writer.WriteAsOid(field.PgTypeId);
				ElementState? elementState = ((data != null) ? new ElementState?(data[i]) : ((ElementState?)null));
				ElementState elementState2;
				if (elementState.HasValue)
				{
					ElementState valueOrDefault = elementState.GetValueOrDefault();
					elementState2 = valueOrDefault;
				}
				else
				{
					Size writeRequirement;
					PgConverter writeInfo = field.GetWriteInfo(boxedInstance, out writeRequirement);
					object writeState3 = null;
					elementState2 = new ElementState
					{
						Size = (field.IsDbNull(writeInfo, boxedInstance, ref writeState3) ? ((Size)(-1)) : writeRequirement),
						WriteState = null,
						Converter = writeInfo,
						BufferRequirement = writeRequirement
					};
				}
				int value2 = elementState2.Size.Value;
				writer.WriteInt32(value2);
				if (value2 != -1)
				{
					using (await writer.BeginNestedWrite(async, elementState2.BufferRequirement, value2, elementState2.WriteState, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
					{
						await field.Write(async, elementState2.Converter, writer, boxedInstance, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors)]
	internal sealed class EnumConverter<TEnum> : PgBufferedConverter<TEnum> where TEnum : struct, Enum
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<TEnum, string> _enumToLabel;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, TEnum> _labelToEnum;

		private readonly Encoding _encoding;

		public EnumConverter(Dictionary<Enum, string> enumToLabel, Dictionary<string, Enum> labelToEnum, Encoding encoding)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_enumToLabel = new Dictionary<TEnum, string>(enumToLabel.Count);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Enum, string> item in enumToLabel)
			{
				_enumToLabel.Add((TEnum)item.Key, item.Value);
			}
			_labelToEnum = new Dictionary<string, TEnum>(labelToEnum.Count);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Enum> item2 in labelToEnum)
			{
				_labelToEnum.Add(item2.Key, (TEnum)item2.Value);
			}
			_encoding = encoding;
		}

		public EnumConverter(Dictionary<TEnum, string> enumToLabel, Dictionary<string, TEnum> labelToEnum, Encoding encoding)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_enumToLabel = enumToLabel;
			_labelToEnum = labelToEnum;
			_encoding = encoding;
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.Value;
			if (format <= DataFormat.Text)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, TEnum value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			if (!_enumToLabel.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException($"Can't write value {value} as enum {typeof(TEnum)}");
			}
			return _encoding.GetByteCount(value2);
		}

		protected override TEnum ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			string text = _encoding.GetString(reader.ReadBytes(reader.CurrentRemaining));
			if (!_labelToEnum.TryGetValue(text, out var value))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException($"Received enum value '{text}' from database which wasn't found on enum {typeof(TEnum)}");
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, TEnum value)
		{
			if (!_enumToLabel.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException($"Can't write value {value} as enum {typeof(TEnum)}");
			}
			writer.WriteBytes(new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(_encoding.GetBytes(value2)));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TsQueryConverter<T> : PgStreamingConverter<T> where T : NpgsqlTsQuery
	{
		private readonly Encoding _encoding;

		public TsQueryConverter(Encoding encoding)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_encoding = encoding;
		}

		public override T Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return (T)Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override async ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return (T)(await Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
		}

		private async ValueTask<NpgsqlTsQuery> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			int numTokens = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (numTokens == 0)
			{
				return new NpgsqlTsQueryEmpty();
			}
			NpgsqlTsQuery value = null;
			Stack<(NpgsqlTsQuery Node, int Location)> nodes = new Stack<(NpgsqlTsQuery, int)>();
			for (int i = 0; i < numTokens; i++)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(1))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 1, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				byte b = reader.ReadByte();
				switch (b)
				{
				case 1:
				{
					if (reader.ShouldBuffer(2))
					{
						await reader.Buffer(async, 2, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme.Weight weight = (NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme.Weight)reader.ReadByte();
					bool prefix = reader.ReadByte() != 0;
					string text = ((!async) ? reader.ReadNullTerminatedString(_encoding) : (await reader.ReadNullTerminatedStringAsync(_encoding, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
					InsertInTree(new NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme(text, weight, prefix), nodes, ref value);
					break;
				}
				case 2:
				{
					if (reader.ShouldBuffer(1))
					{
						await reader.Buffer(async, 1, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind nodeKind = (NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind)reader.ReadByte();
					NpgsqlTsQuery npgsqlTsQuery;
					switch (nodeKind)
					{
					case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Not:
						npgsqlTsQuery = new NpgsqlTsQueryNot(null);
						InsertInTree(npgsqlTsQuery, nodes, ref value);
						nodes.Push((npgsqlTsQuery, 0));
						goto end_IL_0190;
					case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.And:
						npgsqlTsQuery = new NpgsqlTsQueryAnd(null, null);
						break;
					case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Or:
						npgsqlTsQuery = new NpgsqlTsQueryOr(null, null);
						break;
					case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Phrase:
						if (reader.ShouldBuffer(2))
						{
							await reader.Buffer(async, 2, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						npgsqlTsQuery = new NpgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy(null, reader.ReadInt16(), null);
						break;
					default:
						throw new UnreachableException(string.Format("Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected value {0} of enum {1}. Please file a bug.", nodeKind, "NodeKind"));
					}
					InsertInTree(npgsqlTsQuery, nodes, ref value);
					nodes.Push((npgsqlTsQuery, 1));
					nodes.Push((npgsqlTsQuery, 2));
					break;
				}
				default:
					{
						throw new UnreachableException($"Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected token type {b} when reading tsquery. Please file a bug.");
					}
					end_IL_0190:
					break;
				}
			}
			if (nodes.Count != 0)
			{
				throw new UnreachableException("Internal Npgsql bug, please report.");
			}
			return value;
			static void InsertInTree(NpgsqlTsQuery node, Stack<(NpgsqlTsQuery Node, int Location)> stack, ref NpgsqlTsQuery? reference)
			{
				if (stack.Count == 0)
				{
					reference = node;
				}
				else
				{
					(NpgsqlTsQuery, int) tuple = stack.Pop();
					switch (tuple.Item2)
					{
					case 0:
						((NpgsqlTsQueryNot)tuple.Item1).Child = node;
						break;
					case 1:
						((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)tuple.Item1).Left = node;
						break;
					case 2:
						((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)tuple.Item1).Right = node;
						break;
					default:
						throw new UnreachableException("Internal Npgsql bug, please report.");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return (value.Kind == NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Empty) ? 4 : (4 + GetNodeLength(value));
		}

		private int GetNodeLength(NpgsqlTsQuery node)
		{
			switch (node.Kind)
			{
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Lexeme:
			{
				int byteCount = _encoding.GetByteCount(((NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme)node).Text);
				if (byteCount <= 2046)
				{
					return 4 + byteCount;
				}
				throw new InvalidCastException("Lexeme text too long. Must be at most 2046 encoded bytes.");
			}
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.And:
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Or:
				return 2 + GetNodeLength(((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)node).Left) + GetNodeLength(((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)node).Right);
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Not:
				return 2 + GetNodeLength(((NpgsqlTsQueryNot)node).Child);
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Empty:
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Empty tsquery nodes must be top-level");
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Phrase:
				return 4 + GetNodeLength(((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)node).Left) + GetNodeLength(((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)node).Right);
			default:
				throw new UnreachableException(string.Format("Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected value {0} of enum {1}. Please file a bug.", node.Kind, "NodeKind"));
			}
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, NpgsqlTsQuery value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			int numTokens = GetTokenCount(value);
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
			{
				await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteInt32(numTokens);
			if (numTokens != 0)
			{
				await WriteCore(value).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			async Task WriteCore(NpgsqlTsQuery node)
			{
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(1))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writer.WriteByte((byte)((node.Kind == NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Lexeme) ? 1 : 2));
				if (node.Kind == NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Lexeme)
				{
					NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme lexemeNode = (NpgsqlTsQueryLexeme)node;
					if (writer.ShouldFlush(2))
					{
						await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					writer.WriteByte((byte)lexemeNode.Weights);
					writer.WriteByte(lexemeNode.IsPrefixSearch ? ((byte)1) : ((byte)0));
					if (async)
					{
						await writer.WriteCharsAsync(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(lexemeNode.Text), _encoding, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						writer.WriteChars(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(lexemeNode.Text).Span, _encoding);
					}
					if (writer.ShouldFlush(1))
					{
						await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					writer.WriteByte(0);
				}
				else
				{
					writer.WriteByte((byte)node.Kind);
					switch (node.Kind)
					{
					case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Not:
						await WriteCore(((NpgsqlTsQueryNot)node).Child).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						return;
					case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Phrase:
						writer.WriteInt16(((NpgsqlTsQueryFollowedBy)node).Distance);
						break;
					}
					await WriteCore(((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)node).Right).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					await WriteCore(((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)node).Left).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetTokenCount(NpgsqlTsQuery node)
		{
			switch (node.Kind)
			{
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Lexeme:
				return 1;
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.And:
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Or:
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Phrase:
				return 1 + GetTokenCount(((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)node).Left) + GetTokenCount(((NpgsqlTsQueryBinOp)node).Right);
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Not:
				return 1 + GetTokenCount(((NpgsqlTsQueryNot)node).Child);
			case NpgsqlTsQuery.NodeKind.Empty:
				return 0;
			default:
				throw new UnreachableException(string.Format("Internal Npgsql bug: unexpected value {0} of enum {1}. Please file a bug.", node.Kind, "NodeKind"));
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TsVectorConverter : PgStreamingConverter<NpgsqlTsVector>
	{
		private readonly Encoding _encoding;

		public TsVectorConverter(Encoding encoding)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_encoding = encoding;
		}

		public override NpgsqlTsVector Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask<NpgsqlTsVector> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<NpgsqlTsVector> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			int numLexemes = reader.ReadInt32();
			List<NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme> lexemes = new List<NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme>(numLexemes);
			for (int i = 0; i < numLexemes; i++)
			{
				string text = ((!async) ? reader.ReadNullTerminatedString(_encoding) : (await reader.ReadNullTerminatedStringAsync(_encoding, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
				string lexemeString = text;
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(2))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 2, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				short numPositions = reader.ReadInt16();
				if (numPositions == 0)
				{
					lexemes.Add(new NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme(lexemeString, null, noCopy: true));
					continue;
				}
				if (numPositions > 256)
				{
					throw new NpgsqlException($"Got {numPositions} lexeme positions when reading tsvector");
				}
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(numPositions * 2))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, numPositions * 2, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				List<NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme.WordEntryPos> list = new List<NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme.WordEntryPos>(numPositions);
				for (int j = 0; j < numPositions; j++)
				{
					short value = reader.ReadInt16();
					list.Add(new NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme.WordEntryPos(value));
				}
				lexemes.Add(new NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme(lexemeString, list, noCopy: true));
			}
			return new NpgsqlTsVector(lexemes, noCheck: true);
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, NpgsqlTsVector value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			int num = 4;
			foreach (NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme item in value)
			{
				num += _encoding.GetByteCount(item.Text) + 1 + 2 + item.Count * 2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, NpgsqlTsVector value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, NpgsqlTsVector value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, NpgsqlTsVector value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
			{
				await writer.FlushAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteInt32(value.Count);
			foreach (NpgsqlTsVector.Lexeme lexeme in value)
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await writer.WriteCharsAsync(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(lexeme.Text), _encoding, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					writer.WriteChars(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(lexeme.Text).Span, _encoding);
				}
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(3))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writer.WriteByte(0);
				writer.WriteInt16((short)lexeme.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < lexeme.Count; i++)
				{
					if (writer.ShouldFlush(2))
					{
						await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					writer.WriteInt16(lexeme[i].Value);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class PathConverter : PgStreamingConverter<NpgsqlPath>
	{
		public override NpgsqlPath Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask<NpgsqlPath> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<NpgsqlPath> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(5))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 5, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			bool open = reader.ReadByte() switch
			{
				1 => false, 
				0 => true, 
				_ => throw new UnreachableException("Error decoding binary geometric path: bad open byte"), 
			};
			int numPoints = reader.ReadInt32();
			NpgsqlPath result = new NpgsqlPath(numPoints, open);
			for (int i = 0; i < numPoints; i++)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(16))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 5, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				result.Add(new NpgsqlPoint(reader.ReadDouble(), reader.ReadDouble()));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, NpgsqlPath value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return 5 + value.Count * 8 * 2;
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, NpgsqlPath value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, NpgsqlPath value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, NpgsqlPath value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(5))
			{
				await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteByte((!value.Open) ? ((byte)1) : ((byte)0));
			writer.WriteInt32(value.Count);
			foreach (NpgsqlPoint p in value)
			{
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(16))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writer.WriteDouble(p.X);
				writer.WriteDouble(p.Y);
			}
		}

		public PathConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}

			}

		private async ValueTask<T> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{

			}

				collection2 = collection;
			}
			ICollection<KeyValuePair<string, string?>> result = collection2;

				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))

				}
				int num = reader.ReadInt32();
				string value = null;

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)

				}

				}
				else
				{
					writer.WriteChars(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(kv.Key), _encoding);
				}
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				Size item2 = data.Array[i + 1].Size;
				if (item2.Kind == SizeKind.Unknown)
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException();
				}
				int value3 = item2.Value;
				writer.WriteInt32(value3);
				if (value3 != -1)
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await writer.WriteCharsAsync(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(kv.Value), _encoding, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						writer.WriteChars(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(kv.Value), _encoding);
					}
				}
				i += 2;

	internal sealed class InternalCharConverter<T> : PgBufferedConverter<T>
	{

			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override T ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			byte b = reader.ReadByte();
			if (typeof(byte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)b;
			}
			if (typeof(char) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(char)b;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			if (typeof(byte) == typeof(T))
			{
				writer.WriteByte((byte)(object)value);
				return;
			}
			if (typeof(char) == typeof(T))
			{
				writer.WriteByte(checked((byte)(char)(object)value));
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public InternalCharConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}

	internal sealed class JsonConverter<T, TBase> : PgStreamingConverter<T?> where T : TBase?
	{

		private readonly Encoding _textEncoding;

		private readonly JsonTypeInfo _jsonTypeInfo;

		private readonly JsonTypeInfo<object?>? _objectTypeInfo;

		public JsonConverter(bool jsonb, Encoding textEncoding, JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			if (serializerOptions.TypeInfoResolver == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("System.Text.Json serialization requires a type info resolver, make sure to set-it up beforehand.");
			}
			_jsonb = jsonb;
			_textEncoding = textEncoding;
			_jsonTypeInfo = ((typeof(TBase) != typeof(object) && typeof(T) != typeof(TBase)) ? ((JsonTypeInfo)(JsonTypeInfo<TBase>)serializerOptions.GetTypeInfo(typeof(TBase))) : ((JsonTypeInfo)(JsonTypeInfo<T>)serializerOptions.GetTypeInfo(typeof(T))));
			_objectTypeInfo = ((typeof(TBase) == typeof(object)) ? ((JsonTypeInfo<object>)serializerOptions.GetTypeInfo(typeof(object))) : null);
		}

		public override T? Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask<T?> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<T?> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (_jsonb && reader.ShouldBuffer(1))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 1, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			JsonTypeInfo jsonTypeInfo;
			T result;
			if (JsonConverter.TryReadStream(_jsonb, _textEncoding, reader, out int byteCount, out Stream stream))
			{
				using (stream)

					if (!(jsonTypeInfo is JsonTypeInfo<JsonDocument>))

							result = (T)(object)val2;
						}
					}
					else

					}

	internal static class JsonConverter
	{
		public const byte JsonbProtocolVersion = 1;

		private const int StreamingThreshold = 81920;

		public static bool TryReadStream(bool jsonb, Encoding encoding, PgReader reader, out int byteCount, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Stream? stream)
		{
			if (jsonb)
			{
				byte b = reader.ReadByte();
				if (b != 1)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException($"Unknown jsonb wire format version {b}");
				}
			}
			bool num = encoding.CodePage == Encoding.UTF8.CodePage;
			byteCount = reader.CurrentRemaining;
			if (num)
			{
				stream = reader.GetStream();
			}
			else
			{
				stream = null;
			}
			return stream != null;
		}

		public static async ValueTask<(ArraySegment<char> RentedChars, byte[]? RentedBytes)> ReadRentedBuffer(bool async, Encoding encoding, int byteCount, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			byte[] rentedBuffer = null;
			if (!reader.TryReadBytes(byteCount, out ReadOnlyMemory<byte> bytes))
			{
				rentedBuffer = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(byteCount);
				if (async)
				{
					await reader.ReadBytesAsync(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(rentedBuffer, 0, byteCount), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					reader.ReadBytes(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(rentedBuffer, 0, byteCount));
				}
				bytes = System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(rentedBuffer, 0, byteCount);
			}
			int charCount = encoding.GetCharCount(bytes.Span);
			char[] array = ArrayPool<char>.Shared.Rent(charCount);
			encoding.GetChars(bytes.Span, array);
			return (new ArraySegment<char>(array, 0, charCount), rentedBuffer);
		}

		public static Size GetSizeCore(bool jsonb, MemoryStream stream, Encoding encoding, ref object? writeState)
		{
			if (encoding.CodePage == Encoding.UTF8.CodePage)
			{
				writeState = stream;
				return (int)stream.Length + (jsonb ? 1 : 0);
			}
			if (!stream.TryGetBuffer(out var buffer))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return ((Array)(writeState = encoding.GetBytes(Encoding.UTF8.GetChars(buffer.Array, buffer.Offset, buffer.Count)))).Length + (jsonb ? 1 : 0);
		}

		public static async ValueTask Write(bool jsonb, bool async, PgWriter writer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (jsonb)
			{
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(1))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writer.WriteByte(1);
			}
			object writeState = writer.Current.WriteState;
			ArraySegment<byte> buffer;
			if (!(writeState is MemoryStream memoryStream))
			{
				if (!(writeState is byte[] array))
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException("Invalid state " + writer.Current.WriteState?.GetType().FullName + ".");
				}
				buffer = new ArraySegment<byte>(array);
			}
			else if (!memoryStream.TryGetBuffer(out buffer))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (async)
			{
				await writer.WriteBytesAsync(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(buffer), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.WriteBytes(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(buffer));
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MoneyConverter<T> : PgBufferedConverter<T>
	{
		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(8);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override T ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			return ConvertTo(new PgMoney(reader.ReadInt64()));
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			writer.WriteInt64(ConvertFrom(value).GetValue());
		}

		private static PgMoney ConvertFrom(T value)
		{
			if (typeof(short) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgMoney((decimal)(short)(object)value);
			}
			if (typeof(int) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgMoney((decimal)(int)(object)value);
			}
			if (typeof(long) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgMoney((decimal)(long)(object)value);
			}
			if (typeof(byte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgMoney((decimal)(byte)(object)value);
			}
			if (typeof(sbyte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgMoney((decimal)(sbyte)(object)value);
			}
			if (typeof(float) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgMoney((decimal)(float)(object)value);
			}
			if (typeof(double) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgMoney((decimal)(double)(object)value);
			}
			if (typeof(decimal) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgMoney((decimal)(object)value);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private static T ConvertTo(PgMoney money)
		{
			if (typeof(short) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(short)money.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(int) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(int)money.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(long) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(long)money.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(byte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(byte)money.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(sbyte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(sbyte)money.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(float) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(float)money.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(double) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(double)money.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(decimal) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)money.ToDecimal();
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public MoneyConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}

	{
		private sealed class WriteState : MultiWriteState
		{
		}

		private readonly PgConverter<TRange> _rangeConverter;

		private readonly BufferRequirements _rangeRequirements;

		public MultirangeConverter(PgConverter<TRange> rangeConverter)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			if (!rangeConverter.CanConvert(DataFormat.Binary, out var bufferRequirements))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Range subtype converter has to support the binary format to be compatible.");
			}
			_rangeRequirements = bufferRequirements;
			_rangeConverter = rangeConverter;
		}

		public override T Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		public async ValueTask<T> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			int numRanges = reader.ReadInt32();
			T multirange = (T)(typeof(T).IsArray ? ((object)new TRange[numRanges]) : ((object)new List<TRange>()));
			for (int i = 0; i < numRanges; i++)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				int size = reader.ReadInt32();
				NestedReadScope scope = await reader.BeginNestedRead(async, size, _rangeRequirements.Read, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				try
				{
					TRange val = ((!async) ? _rangeConverter.Read(reader) : (await _rangeConverter.ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
					TRange val2 = val;
					if (typeof(T).IsArray)
					{
						multirange[i] = val2;
					}
					else
					{
						multirange.Add(val2);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await scope.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						scope.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			return multirange;
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			ArrayPool<(Size, object)> shared = ArrayPool<(Size, object)>.Shared;
			(Size, object)[] array = shared.Rent(value.Count);
			Size result = Size.Create(4 + 4 * value.Count);
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Count; i++)
			{
				object writeState2 = null;
				Size? sizeOrDbNull = _rangeConverter.GetSizeOrDbNull(context.Format, _rangeRequirements.Write, value[i], ref writeState2);
				flag = flag || writeState2 != null;
				array[i] = (sizeOrDbNull.Value, writeState2);
				result = result.Combine(sizeOrDbNull.Value);
			}
			writeState = new WriteState
			{
				ArrayPool = shared,
				Data = new ArraySegment<(Size, object)>(array, 0, value.Count),
				AnyWriteState = flag
			};
			return result;
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			object writeState = writer.Current.WriteState;
			if (!(writeState is WriteState writeState2))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("Invalid state " + writer.Current.WriteState?.GetType().FullName + ".");
			}
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
			{
				await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteInt32(value.Count);
			(Size Size, object? WriteState)[] data = writeState2.Data.Array;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Count; i++)
			{
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				var (size, state) = data[i];
				if (size.Kind == SizeKind.Unknown)
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException();
				}
				int value2 = size.Value;
				writer.WriteInt32(value2);
				if (value2 == -1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				using (await writer.BeginNestedWrite(async, _rangeRequirements.Write, value2, state, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await _rangeConverter.WriteAsync(writer, value[i], cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						_rangeConverter.Write(writer, value[i]);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class NpgsqlInetConverter : PgBufferedConverter<NpgsqlInet>
	{
		private const byte IPv4 = 2;

		private const byte IPv6 = 3;

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			return CanConvertBufferedDefault(format, out bufferRequirements);
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, NpgsqlInet value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return GetSizeImpl(context, value.Address, ref writeState);
		}

		internal static Size GetSizeImpl(SizeContext context, IPAddress ipAddress, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return ipAddress.AddressFamily switch
			{
				AddressFamily.InterNetwork => 8, 
				AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6 => 20, 
				_ => throw new InvalidCastException($"Can't handle IPAddress with AddressFamily {ipAddress.AddressFamily}, only InterNetwork or InterNetworkV6!"), 
			};
		}

		protected override NpgsqlInet ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			var (address, netmask) = ReadImpl(reader, shouldBeCidr: false);
			return new NpgsqlInet(address, netmask);
		}

		internal static (IPAddress Address, byte Netmask) ReadImpl(PgReader reader, bool shouldBeCidr)
		{
			reader.ReadByte();
			byte item = reader.ReadByte();
			reader.ReadByte();
			Span<byte> destination = stackalloc byte[(int)reader.ReadByte()];
			reader.Read(destination);
			return (Address: new IPAddress(destination.ToArray()), Netmask: item);
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, NpgsqlInet value)
		{
			WriteImpl(writer, (Address: value.Address, Netmask: value.Netmask), isCidr: false);
		}

		internal static void WriteImpl(PgWriter writer, (IPAddress Address, byte Netmask) value, bool isCidr)
		{
			writer.WriteByte(value.Address.AddressFamily switch
			{
				AddressFamily.InterNetwork => 2, 
				AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6 => 3, 
				_ => throw new InvalidCastException($"Can't handle IPAddress with AddressFamily {value.Address.AddressFamily}, only InterNetwork or InterNetworkV6!"), 
			});
			writer.WriteByte(value.Netmask);
			writer.WriteByte(isCidr ? ((byte)1) : ((byte)0));
			byte[] addressBytes = value.Address.GetAddressBytes();
			writer.WriteByte((byte)addressBytes.Length);
			writer.WriteBytes(addressBytes);
		}

		public NpgsqlInetConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}

	internal abstract class PolymorphicConverterResolver<TBase> : PgConverterResolver<TBase>
	{
		protected PgTypeId PgTypeId { get; }

		protected PolymorphicConverterResolver(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
		{
			PgTypeId = pgTypeId;
		}

		protected abstract PgConverter Get(Field? field);

		public sealed override PgConverterResolution GetDefault(PgTypeId? pgTypeId)
		{
			if (pgTypeId.HasValue && pgTypeId != PgTypeId)
			{
				throw CreateUnsupportedPgTypeIdException(pgTypeId.Value);
			}
			return new PgConverterResolution(Get(null), PgTypeId);
		}

		public sealed override PgConverterResolution? Get(TBase? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
		{
			return new PgConverterResolution(Get(null), PgTypeId);
		}

		public sealed override PgConverterResolution Get(Field field)
		{
			if (field.PgTypeId != PgTypeId)
			{
				throw CreateUnsupportedPgTypeIdException(field.PgTypeId);
			}
			return new PgConverterResolution(Get(field), PgTypeId);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ArrayPolymorphicConverterResolver : PolymorphicConverterResolver<object>
	{
		private readonly PgResolverTypeInfo _elemTypeInfo;

		private readonly Func<PgConverterResolution, PgConverter> _elemToArrayConverterFactory;

		private readonly PgTypeId _elemPgTypeId;

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<PgConverter, PgConverter> _converterCache = new ConcurrentDictionary<PgConverter, PgConverter>(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance);

		public ArrayPolymorphicConverterResolver(PgTypeId pgTypeId, PgResolverTypeInfo elemTypeInfo, Func<PgConverterResolution, PgConverter> elemToArrayConverterFactory)
			: base(pgTypeId)
		{
			if (!elemTypeInfo.PgTypeId.HasValue)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("elemTypeInfo.PgTypeId must be non-null.", "elemTypeInfo");
			}
			_elemTypeInfo = elemTypeInfo;
			_elemToArrayConverterFactory = elemToArrayConverterFactory;
			_elemPgTypeId = elemTypeInfo.PgTypeId.Value;
		}

		protected override PgConverter Get(Field? maybeField)
		{
			PgConverterResolution pgConverterResolution;
			if (maybeField.HasValue)
			{
				Field valueOrDefault = maybeField.GetValueOrDefault();
				PgResolverTypeInfo elemTypeInfo = _elemTypeInfo;
				Field field = valueOrDefault;
				field.PgTypeId = _elemPgTypeId;
				pgConverterResolution = elemTypeInfo.GetResolution(field);
			}
			else
			{
				pgConverterResolution = _elemTypeInfo.GetDefaultResolution(_elemPgTypeId);
			}
			PgConverterResolution item = pgConverterResolution;
			(Func<PgConverterResolution, PgConverter>, PgConverterResolution) factoryArgument = (_elemToArrayConverterFactory, item);
			return ConcurrentDictionaryExtensions.GetOrAdd(_converterCache, item.Converter, (PgConverter _, (Func<PgConverterResolution, PgConverter> Factory, PgConverterResolution Resolution) state) => state.Factory(state.Resolution), factoryArgument);
		}
	}

	internal abstract class ByteaConverters<T> : PgStreamingConverter<T>
	{
		public override T Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).Result;
		}

		public override ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return ConvertTo(value).Length;
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			writer.WriteBytes(ConvertTo(value).Span);
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return writer.WriteBytesAsync(ConvertTo(value), cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<T> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			byte[] bytes = new byte[reader.CurrentRemaining];
			if (async)
			{
				await reader.ReadBytesAsync(bytes, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				reader.ReadBytes(bytes);
			}
			return ConvertFrom(new Memory<byte>(bytes));
		}

		protected abstract Memory<byte> ConvertTo(T value);

		protected abstract T ConvertFrom(Memory<byte> value);

		protected ByteaConverters()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}

	internal sealed class StreamByteaConverter : PgStreamingConverter<Stream>
	{
		public override Stream Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("Handled by generic stream support in NpgsqlDataReader");
		}

		public override ValueTask<Stream> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("Handled by generic stream support in NpgsqlDataReader");
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, Stream value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			checked
			{
				if (value.CanSeek)
				{
					return (int)(value.Length - value.Position);
				}
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				value.CopyTo(memoryStream);
				writeState = memoryStream;
				return (int)memoryStream.Length;
			}
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, Stream value)
		{
			ArraySegment<byte> buffer2;
			if (writer.Current.WriteState != null)
			{
				if (!((MemoryStream)writer.Current.WriteState).TryGetBuffer(out var buffer))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				writer.WriteBytes(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(buffer));
			}
			else if (value is MemoryStream memoryStream && memoryStream.TryGetBuffer(out buffer2))
			{
				writer.WriteBytes(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(buffer2, (int)value.Position));
			}
			else
			{
				value.CopyTo(writer.GetStream());
			}
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, Stream value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (writer.Current.WriteState != null)
			{
				if (!((MemoryStream)writer.Current.WriteState).TryGetBuffer(out var buffer))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				return writer.WriteBytesAsync(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(buffer), cancellationToken);
			}
			if (value is MemoryStream memoryStream && memoryStream.TryGetBuffer(out var buffer2))
			{
				return writer.WriteBytesAsync(System.MemoryExtensions.AsMemory(buffer2, (int)value.Position), cancellationToken);
			}
			return new ValueTask(value.CopyToAsync(writer.GetStream()));
		}

		public StreamByteaConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DoubleConverter<T> : PgBufferedConverter<T>
	{
		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(8);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override T ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			double num = reader.ReadDouble();
			if (typeof(float) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)num;
			}
			if (typeof(double) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)num;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			if (typeof(float) == typeof(T))
			{
				writer.WriteDouble((float)(object)value);
				return;
			}
			if (typeof(double) == typeof(T))
			{
				writer.WriteDouble((double)(object)value);
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public DoubleConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class GuidUuidConverter : PgBufferedConverter<Guid>
	{
		[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)]
		private struct GuidRaw
		{
			[FieldOffset(0)]
			public Guid Value;

			[FieldOffset(0)]
			public int Data1;

			[FieldOffset(4)]
			public short Data2;

			[FieldOffset(6)]
			public short Data3;

			[FieldOffset(8)]
			public long Data4;

			public GuidRaw(Guid value)
			{
				this = default(GuidRaw);
				Value = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(16);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override Guid ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			GuidRaw guidRaw = new GuidRaw
			{
				Data1 = reader.ReadInt32(),
				Data2 = reader.ReadInt16(),
				Data3 = reader.ReadInt16(),
				Data4 = (BitConverter.IsLittleEndian ? BinaryPrimitives.ReverseEndianness(reader.ReadInt64()) : reader.ReadInt64())
			};
			return guidRaw.Value;
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, Guid value)
		{
			GuidRaw guidRaw = new GuidRaw(value);
			writer.WriteInt32(guidRaw.Data1);
			writer.WriteInt16(guidRaw.Data2);
			writer.WriteInt16(guidRaw.Data3);
			writer.WriteInt64(BitConverter.IsLittleEndian ? BinaryPrimitives.ReverseEndianness(guidRaw.Data4) : guidRaw.Data4);
		}

		public GuidUuidConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}

	internal sealed class BigIntegerNumericConverter : PgStreamingConverter<BigInteger>
	{
		private const int StackAllocByteThreshold = 256;

		public override BigInteger Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			short num = reader.ReadInt16();
			short[] array = null;
			Span<short> digits = ((num > 128) ? System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(array = ArrayPool<short>.Shared.Rent(num)) : stackalloc short[128]).Slice(0, num);
			BigInteger result = ConvertTo(NumericConverter.Read(reader, digits));
			if (array != null)
			{
				ArrayPool<short>.Shared.Return(array);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override ValueTask<BigInteger> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (!reader.ShouldBuffer(reader.CurrentRemaining))
			{
				Read(reader);
			}
			return AsyncCore(reader, cancellationToken);
			static async ValueTask<BigInteger> AsyncCore(PgReader pgReader, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				await pgReader.BufferAsync(PgNumeric.GetByteCount(0), cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				short num = pgReader.ReadInt16();
				ArraySegment<short> digits = new ArraySegment<short>(ArrayPool<short>.Shared.Rent(num), 0, num);
				BigInteger result = ConvertTo(await NumericConverter.ReadAsync(pgReader, digits, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
				ArrayPool<short>.Shared.Return(digits.Array);
				return result;
			}
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, BigInteger value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return PgNumeric.GetByteCount(PgNumeric.GetDigitCount(value));
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, BigInteger value)
		{
			Span<short> destination = stackalloc short[128];
			PgNumeric.Builder numeric = ConvertFrom(value, destination);
			NumericConverter.Write(writer, numeric);
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, BigInteger value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(writer.Current.Size))
			{
				return AsyncCore(writer, value, cancellationToken);
			}
			Write(writer, value);
			return default(ValueTask);
			static async ValueTask AsyncCore(PgWriter pgWriter, BigInteger value2, CancellationToken cancellationToken2)
			{
				await pgWriter.FlushAsync(cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				PgNumeric numeric = ConvertFrom(value2, Array.Empty<short>()).Build();
				await NumericConverter.WriteAsync(pgWriter, numeric, cancellationToken2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
		}

	internal sealed class DecimalNumericConverter<T> : PgBufferedConverter<T> where T : notnull
	{
		private const int StackAllocByteThreshold = 256;

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.Create(Size.CreateUpperBound(NumericConverter.DecimalBasedMaxByteCount));
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override T ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			short length = reader.ReadInt16();
			Span<short> digits = stackalloc short[128].Slice(0, length);
			return ConvertTo(NumericConverter.Read(reader, digits));
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			int digitCount;
			if (typeof(decimal) == typeof(T))
			{
				digitCount = PgNumeric.GetDigitCount((decimal)(object)value);
			}
			else if (typeof(short) == typeof(T))
			{
				digitCount = PgNumeric.GetDigitCount((decimal)(short)(object)value);
			}
			else if (typeof(int) == typeof(T))
			{
				digitCount = PgNumeric.GetDigitCount((decimal)(int)(object)value);
			}
			else if (typeof(long) == typeof(T))
			{
				digitCount = PgNumeric.GetDigitCount((decimal)(long)(object)value);
			}
			else if (typeof(byte) == typeof(T))
			{
				digitCount = PgNumeric.GetDigitCount((decimal)(byte)(object)value);
			}
			else if (typeof(sbyte) == typeof(T))
			{
				digitCount = PgNumeric.GetDigitCount((decimal)(sbyte)(object)value);
			}
			else if (typeof(float) == typeof(T))
			{
				digitCount = PgNumeric.GetDigitCount((decimal)(float)(object)value);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(typeof(double) == typeof(T)))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
				digitCount = PgNumeric.GetDigitCount((decimal)(double)(object)value);
			}
			return PgNumeric.GetByteCount(digitCount);
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			Span<short> destination = stackalloc short[8];
			PgNumeric.Builder numeric = ConvertFrom(value, destination);
			NumericConverter.Write(writer, numeric);
		}

		private static PgNumeric.Builder ConvertFrom(T value, Span<short> destination)
		{
			if (typeof(short) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgNumeric.Builder((decimal)(short)(object)value, destination);
			}
			if (typeof(int) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgNumeric.Builder((decimal)(int)(object)value, destination);
			}
			if (typeof(long) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgNumeric.Builder((decimal)(long)(object)value, destination);
			}
			if (typeof(byte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgNumeric.Builder((decimal)(byte)(object)value, destination);
			}
			if (typeof(sbyte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgNumeric.Builder((decimal)(sbyte)(object)value, destination);
			}
			if (typeof(float) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgNumeric.Builder((decimal)(float)(object)value, destination);
			}
			if (typeof(double) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgNumeric.Builder((decimal)(double)(object)value, destination);
			}
			if (typeof(decimal) == typeof(T))
			{
				return new PgNumeric.Builder((decimal)(object)value, destination);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private static T ConvertTo(in PgNumeric.Builder numeric)
		{
			if (typeof(short) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(short)numeric.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(int) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(int)numeric.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(long) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(long)numeric.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(byte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(byte)numeric.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(sbyte) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(sbyte)numeric.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(float) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(float)numeric.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(double) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)(double)numeric.ToDecimal();
			}
			if (typeof(decimal) == typeof(T))
			{
				return (T)(object)numeric.ToDecimal();
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public DecimalNumericConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
