	internal static class NumericConverter
	{
		public static int DecimalBasedMaxByteCount = PgNumeric.GetByteCount(8);

		public static PgNumeric.Builder Read(PgReader reader, Span<short> digits)
		{
			int byteCount = PgNumeric.GetByteCount(0) - 2;
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(byteCount))
			{
				reader.Buffer(byteCount);
			}
			short weight = reader.ReadInt16();
			short sign = reader.ReadInt16();
			short scale = reader.ReadInt16();
			Span<short> span = digits;
			for (int i = 0; i < span.Length; i++)
			{
				ref short reference = ref span[i];
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(2))
				{
					reader.Buffer(2);
				}
				reference = reader.ReadInt16();
			}
			return new PgNumeric.Builder(digits, weight, sign, scale);
		}

		public static async ValueTask<PgNumeric> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, ArraySegment<short> digits, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			int byteCount = PgNumeric.GetByteCount(0) - 2;
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(byteCount))
			{
				await reader.BufferAsync(byteCount, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			short weight = reader.ReadInt16();
			short sign = reader.ReadInt16();
			short scale = reader.ReadInt16();
			short[] array = digits.Array;
			for (int i = digits.Offset; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(2))
				{
					await reader.BufferAsync(2, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				array[i] = reader.ReadInt16();
			}
			return new PgNumeric.Builder(digits, weight, sign, scale).Build();
		}

		public static void Write(PgWriter writer, PgNumeric.Builder numeric)
		{
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(PgNumeric.GetByteCount(0)))
			{
				writer.Flush();
			}
			writer.WriteInt16((short)numeric.Digits.Length);
			writer.WriteInt16(numeric.Weight);
			writer.WriteInt16(numeric.Sign);
			writer.WriteInt16(numeric.Scale);
			Span<short> digits = numeric.Digits;
			for (int i = 0; i < digits.Length; i++)
			{
				short value = digits[i];
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(2))
				{
					writer.Flush();
				}
				writer.WriteInt16(value);
			}
		}

		public static async ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, PgNumeric numeric, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(PgNumeric.GetByteCount(0)))
			{
				await writer.FlushAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteInt16((short)numeric.Digits.Count);
			writer.WriteInt16(numeric.Weight);
			writer.WriteInt16(numeric.Sign);
			writer.WriteInt16(numeric.Scale);
			foreach (short digit in (IEnumerable<short>)numeric.Digits/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/)
			{
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(2))
				{
					await writer.FlushAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writer.WriteInt16(digit);
			}
		}
	}
	internal readonly struct PgMoney
	{
		[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)]
		private readonly struct DecimalRaw
		{
			private const int ScaleMask = 16711680;

			private const int ScaleShift = 16;

			[FieldOffset(0)]
			private readonly decimal _value;

			[FieldOffset(0)]
			private readonly int _flags;

			[FieldOffset(4)]
			private readonly uint _high;

			[FieldOffset(8)]
			private readonly ulong _low64;

			[FieldOffset(8)]
			private readonly uint _low;

			[FieldOffset(12)]
			private readonly uint _mid;

			public uint High => _high;

			public uint Mid
			{
				get
				{
					if (!BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
					{
						return _low;
					}
					return _mid;
				}
			}

			public uint Low
			{
				get
				{
					if (!BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
					{
						return _mid;
					}
					return _low;
				}
			}

			public int Flags => _flags;

			public short Scale => (short)((_flags & 0xFF0000) >> 16);

			public DecimalRaw(decimal value)
			{
				this = default(DecimalRaw);
				_value = value;
			}
		}

		private const int DecimalBits = 4;

		private const int MoneyScale = 2;

		private readonly long _value;

		public PgMoney(long value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public PgMoney(decimal value)
		{
			if ((value < -92233720368547758.08m || value > 92233720368547758.07m) ? true : false)
			{
				throw new OverflowException($"The supplied value '{value}' is outside the range for a PostgreSQL money value.");
			}
			value = decimal.Round(value, 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
			Span<uint> destination = stackalloc uint[4];
			GetDecimalBits(value, destination, out var scale);
			long num = (long)(((ulong)destination[1] << 32) | destination[0]);
			if (value < 0m)
			{
				num = -num;
			}
			_value = (2 - scale) switch
			{
				1 => num * 10, 
				2 => num * 100, 
				_ => num, 
			};
		}

		public long GetValue()
		{
			return _value;
		}

		public decimal ToDecimal()
		{
			decimal num = new decimal(_value);
			decimal num2 = 0.01m;
			return num * num2;
		}

		private static void GetDecimalBits(decimal value, Span<uint> destination, out short scale)
		{
			DecimalRaw decimalRaw = new DecimalRaw(value);
			destination[0] = decimalRaw.Low;
			destination[1] = decimalRaw.Mid;
			destination[2] = decimalRaw.High;
			destination[3] = (uint)decimalRaw.Flags;
			scale = decimalRaw.Scale;
			scale = (byte)(destination[3] >> 16);
		}
	}
	internal readonly struct PgNumeric
	{
		public readonly ref struct Builder
		{
			private const ushort SignPositive = 0;

			private const ushort SignNegative = 16384;

			private const ushort SignNan = 49152;

			private static bool DivideInPlace(Span<uint> left, uint right, out uint remainder)
			{

			private static bool Divide(ReadOnlySpan<uint> left, uint right, Span<uint> quotient, out uint remainder)
			{

				}

			}

			internal static int GetDigitCountCore(Span<uint> bits, int scale)

			internal static decimal ToDecimal(short scale, short weight, ushort sign, Span<short> digits)
			{
				int length = digits.Length;
				if (length > 8)
				{
					throw new OverflowException("Numeric value does not fit in a System.Decimal");
				}
				if (Math.Abs(scale) > 28)
				{
					throw new OverflowException("Numeric value does not fit in a System.Decimal");
				}
				decimal num = new decimal(1, 0, 0, isNegative: false, (byte)((scale > 0) ? scale : 0));
				if (length == 0)
				{
					switch (sign)
					{
					case 0:
					case 16384:
						return 0m * num;
					case 49152:
						throw new InvalidCastException("Numeric NaN not supported by System.Decimal");
					case 53248:
						throw new InvalidCastException("Numeric Infinity not supported by System.Decimal");
					case 61440:
						throw new InvalidCastException("Numeric -Infinity not supported by System.Decimal");
					default:
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					}
				}
				decimal num2 = 10000m;
				decimal num3 = default(decimal);
				for (int i = 0; i < length - 1; i++)
				{
					num3 *= num2;
					num3 += (decimal)digits[i];
				}
				int num4 = (weight + 1 - length) * 4;
				int num5 = ((scale < 0) ? num4 : (num4 + scale));
				short num6 = digits[length - 1];
				if (length == 8)
				{
					uint num7 = UIntPowers10[-num5];
					num3 *= num2 / (decimal)num7;
					num3 += new decimal(num6 / num7);
				}
				else
				{
					num3 *= num2;
					num3 += (decimal)num6;
					if (num5 < 0)
					{
						num3 /= (decimal)UIntPowers10[-num5];
					}
					else
					{
						while (num5 > 0)
						{
							int num8 = Math.Min(9, num5);
							num3 *= (decimal)UIntPowers10[num8];
							num5 -= num8;
						}
					}
				}
				num3 *= num;
				if (sign != 16384)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				return -num3;
			}

			internal static BigInteger ToBigInteger(short weight, ushort sign, Span<short> digits)
			{
				int length = digits.Length;
				if (length == 0)
				{
					switch (sign)
					{
					case 0:
					case 16384:
						return BigInteger.Zero;
					case 49152:
						throw new InvalidCastException("Numeric NaN not supported by BigInteger");
					case 53248:
						throw new InvalidCastException("Numeric Infinity not supported by BigInteger");
					case 61440:
						throw new InvalidCastException("Numeric -Infinity not supported by BigInteger");
					default:
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					}
				}
				int num = weight + 1 - length;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException("Numeric value with non-zero fractional digits not supported by BigInteger");
				}
				BigInteger bigInteger = new BigInteger(10000u);
				BigInteger zero = BigInteger.Zero;
				Span<short> span = digits;
				for (int i = 0; i < span.Length; i++)
				{
					short value = span[i];
					zero *= bigInteger;
					zero += new BigInteger(value);
				}
				BigInteger bigInteger2 = BigInteger.Pow(bigInteger, num);
				zero *= bigInteger2;
				if (sign != 16384)
				{
					return zero;
				}
				return -zero;
			}
		}

				charsRead = 0;
			}

			static int ConsumeChars(TextReader textReader, int? count)

				char[] buffer2 = new char[512];

					num2 += num3;
					if (count.HasValue && num3 == 0)
					{
						throw new EndOfStreamException();
					}
					flag = ((!count.HasValue) ? (num3 == 0) : (num2 >= count));
				}

			}

	internal static class TextConverter
	{
		public static Size GetSize(ref SizeContext context, ReadOnlyMemory<char> value, Encoding encoding)
		{
			return encoding.GetByteCount(value.Span);
		}

		public static char[] GetChars(Encoding encoding, ReadOnlySequence<byte> bytes)
		{
			ReadOnlyMemory<byte> first;
			if (bytes.IsSingleSegment)
			{
				first = bytes.First;
				ReadOnlySpan<byte> span = first.Span;
				char[] array = new char[encoding.GetCharCount(span)];
				first = bytes.First;
				encoding.GetChars(first.Span, array);
				return array;
			}
			Decoder decoder = encoding.GetDecoder();
			List<(char[], int)> list = new List<(char[], int)>();
			int num = 0;
			ReadOnlySequence<byte> readOnlySequence = bytes;
			bool isSingleSegment;
			do
			{
				first = readOnlySequence.First;
				ReadOnlySpan<byte> span2 = first.Span;
				SequencePosition position = readOnlySequence.GetPosition(span2.Length);
				isSingleSegment = readOnlySequence.IsSingleSegment;
				int charCount = decoder.GetCharCount(span2, isSingleSegment);
				char[] array2 = ArrayPool<char>.Shared.Rent(charCount);
				int chars = decoder.GetChars(span2, array2, isSingleSegment);
				list.Add((array2, chars));
				num += chars;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					throw new OutOfMemoryException();
				}
				readOnlySequence = readOnlySequence.Slice(position);
			}
			while (!isSingleSegment);
			char[] array3 = new char[num];
			Span<char> destination = System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(array3);
			foreach (var (array4, num2) in list)
			{
				System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(array4, 0, num2).CopyTo(destination);
				ArrayPool<char>.Shared.Return(array4);
				destination = destination.Slice(num2);
			}
			return array3;
		}

	internal sealed class RangeConverter<TSubtype> : PgStreamingConverter<NpgsqlRange<TSubtype>>
	{
		private sealed class WriteState
		{
			internal Size LowerBoundSize { get; set; }

			internal object? LowerBoundWriteState { get; set; }

			internal Size UpperBoundSize { get; set; }

			internal object? UpperBoundWriteState { get; set; }
		}

		private readonly PgConverter<TSubtype> _subtypeConverter;

		private readonly BufferRequirements _subtypeRequirements;

		public RangeConverter(PgConverter<TSubtype> subtypeConverter)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			if (!subtypeConverter.CanConvert(DataFormat.Binary, out var bufferRequirements))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Range subtype converter has to support the binary format to be compatible.");
			}
			_subtypeRequirements = bufferRequirements;
			_subtypeConverter = subtypeConverter;
		}

		public override NpgsqlRange<TSubtype> Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask<NpgsqlRange<TSubtype>> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<NpgsqlRange<TSubtype>> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(1))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 1, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			RangeFlags flags = (RangeFlags)reader.ReadByte();
			if ((flags & RangeFlags.Empty) != RangeFlags.None)
			{
				return NpgsqlRange<TSubtype>.Empty;
			}
			TSubtype lowerBound = default(TSubtype);
			TSubtype upperBound = default(TSubtype);
			PgConverter<TSubtype> converter = _subtypeConverter;
			if ((flags & RangeFlags.LowerBoundInfinite) == 0)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				int num = reader.ReadInt32();
				if (num != -1)
				{
					NestedReadScope scope = await reader.BeginNestedRead(async, num, _subtypeRequirements.Read, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					try
					{
						TSubtype val = ((!async) ? converter.Read(reader) : (await converter.ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
						lowerBound = val;
					}
					finally
					{
						if (async)
						{
							await scope.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						else
						{
							scope.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if ((flags & RangeFlags.UpperBoundInfinite) == 0)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
				if (num2 != -1)
				{
					NestedReadScope scope = await reader.BeginNestedRead(async, num2, _subtypeRequirements.Read, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					try
					{
						TSubtype val = ((!async) ? converter.Read(reader) : (await converter.ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
						upperBound = val;
					}
					finally
					{
						if (async)
						{
							await scope.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						}
						else
						{
							scope.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return new NpgsqlRange<TSubtype>(lowerBound, upperBound, flags);
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, NpgsqlRange<TSubtype> value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			Size result = Size.Create(1);
			if (value.IsEmpty)
			{
				return result;
			}
			WriteState writeState2 = null;
			if (!value.LowerBoundInfinite)
			{
				result = result.Combine(4);
				object writeState3 = null;
				Size? sizeOrDbNull = _subtypeConverter.GetSizeOrDbNull(context.Format, _subtypeRequirements.Write, value.LowerBound, ref writeState3);
				if (sizeOrDbNull.HasValue)
				{
					Size valueOrDefault = sizeOrDbNull.GetValueOrDefault();
					result = result.Combine(valueOrDefault);
					(writeState2 ?? (writeState2 = new WriteState())).LowerBoundSize = valueOrDefault;
					writeState2.LowerBoundWriteState = writeState3;
				}
				else if (writeState2 != null)
				{
					writeState2.LowerBoundSize = -1;
				}
			}
			if (!value.UpperBoundInfinite)
			{
				result = result.Combine(4);
				object writeState4 = null;
				Size? sizeOrDbNull = _subtypeConverter.GetSizeOrDbNull(context.Format, _subtypeRequirements.Write, value.UpperBound, ref writeState4);
				if (sizeOrDbNull.HasValue)
				{
					Size valueOrDefault2 = sizeOrDbNull.GetValueOrDefault();
					result = result.Combine(valueOrDefault2);
					(writeState2 ?? (writeState2 = new WriteState())).UpperBoundSize = valueOrDefault2;
					writeState2.UpperBoundWriteState = writeState4;
				}
				else if (writeState2 != null)
				{
					writeState2.UpperBoundSize = -1;
				}
			}
			writeState = writeState2;
			return result;
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, NpgsqlRange<TSubtype> value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, NpgsqlRange<TSubtype> value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, NpgsqlRange<TSubtype> value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			WriteState writeState = writer.Current.WriteState as WriteState;
			Size lowerBoundSize = writeState?.LowerBoundSize ?? ((Size)(-1));
			Size upperBoundSize = writeState?.UpperBoundSize ?? ((Size)(-1));
			RangeFlags flags = value.Flags;
			if (!value.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (lowerBoundSize == -1 && !value.LowerBoundInfinite)
				{
					flags = (flags & ~RangeFlags.LowerBoundInclusive) | RangeFlags.LowerBoundInfinite;
				}
				if (upperBoundSize == -1 && !value.UpperBoundInfinite)
				{
					flags = (flags & ~RangeFlags.UpperBoundInclusive) | RangeFlags.UpperBoundInfinite;
				}
			}
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(1))
			{
				await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteByte((byte)flags);
			bool flag = flags.HasFlag(RangeFlags.LowerBoundInfinite);
			bool upperBoundInfinite = flags.HasFlag(RangeFlags.UpperBoundInfinite);
			if (value.IsEmpty || (flag && upperBoundInfinite))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (writeState == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("Invalid write state, expected " + typeof(WriteState).FullName + ".");
			}
			int byteCount;
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (lowerBoundSize.Kind == SizeKind.Unknown)
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException();
				}
				byteCount = lowerBoundSize.Value;
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writer.WriteInt32(byteCount);
				using (await writer.BeginNestedWrite(async, _subtypeRequirements.Write, byteCount, writeState.LowerBoundWriteState, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await _subtypeConverter.WriteAsync(writer, value.LowerBound, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						_subtypeConverter.Write(writer, value.LowerBound);
					}
				}
			}
			if (upperBoundInfinite)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (upperBoundSize.Kind == SizeKind.Unknown)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
			byteCount = upperBoundSize.Value;
			if (writer.ShouldFlush(4))
			{
				await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			writer.WriteInt32(byteCount);
			using (await writer.BeginNestedWrite(async, _subtypeRequirements.Write, byteCount, writeState.UpperBoundWriteState, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
			{
				if (async)
				{
					await _subtypeConverter.WriteAsync(writer, value.UpperBound, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					_subtypeConverter.Write(writer, value.UpperBound);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class RecordConverter<T> : PgStreamingConverter<T>
	{
		private readonly PgSerializerOptions _options;

		private readonly Func<object[], T>? _factory;

		public RecordConverter(PgSerializerOptions options, Func<object[], T>? factory = null)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_options = options;
			_factory = factory;
		}

		public override T Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<T> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.ShouldBuffer(4))
			{
				await reader.Buffer(async, 4, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			int fieldCount = reader.ReadInt32();
			object[] result = new object[fieldCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < fieldCount; i++)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(8))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 8, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				uint num = reader.ReadUInt32();
				int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PostgresType postgresType = _options.DatabaseInfo.GetPostgresType(num).GetRepresentationalType() ?? throw new NotSupportedException($"Reading isn't supported for record field {i} (unknown type OID {num}");
				PgTypeInfo pgTypeInfo = _options.GetObjectOrDefaultTypeInfo(postgresType) ?? throw new NotSupportedException($"Reading isn't supported for record field {i} (PG type '{postgresType.DisplayName}'");
				PgConverterInfo converterInfo = pgTypeInfo.Bind(new Field("?", _options.ToCanonicalTypeId(postgresType), -1), DataFormat.Binary);
				NestedReadScope scope = await reader.BeginNestedRead(async, num2, converterInfo.BufferRequirement, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				try
				{
					object[] array = result;
					int num3 = i;
					array[num3] = await converterInfo.Converter.ReadAsObject(async, reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (async)
					{
						await scope.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else
					{
						scope.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			return (_factory == null) ? ((T)(object)result) : _factory(result);
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, T value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DateTimeDateConverter : PgBufferedConverter<DateTime>
	{
		private readonly bool _dateTimeInfinityConversions;

		private static readonly DateTime BaseValue = new DateTime(2000, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0);

		public DateTimeDateConverter(bool dateTimeInfinityConversions)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_dateTimeInfinityConversions = dateTimeInfinityConversions;
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(4);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override DateTime ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			switch (num)
			{
			case int.MaxValue:
				if (!_dateTimeInfinityConversions)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException(NpgsqlStrings.CannotReadInfinityValue);
				}
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			case int.MinValue:
				if (!_dateTimeInfinityConversions)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException(NpgsqlStrings.CannotReadInfinityValue);
				}
				return DateTime.MinValue;
			default:
				return BaseValue + TimeSpan.FromDays(num);
			}
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, DateTime value)
		{
			if (_dateTimeInfinityConversions)
			{
				if (value == DateTime.MaxValue)
				{
					writer.WriteInt32(int.MaxValue);
					return;
				}
				if (value == DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					writer.WriteInt32(int.MinValue);
					return;
				}
			}
			writer.WriteInt32((value.Date - BaseValue).Days);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DateTimeConverterResolver<T> : PgConverterResolver<T>
	{
		private readonly PgSerializerOptions _options;

		private readonly Func<DateTimeConverterResolver<T>, T?, PgTypeId?, PgConverterResolution?> _resolver;

		private readonly Func<PgTypeId, PgConverter> _factory;

		private readonly PgTypeId _timestampTz;

		private PgConverter? _timestampTzConverter;

		private readonly PgTypeId _timestamp;

		private PgConverter? _timestampConverter;

		private readonly bool _dateTimeInfinityConversions;

		internal DateTimeConverterResolver(PgSerializerOptions options, Func<DateTimeConverterResolver<T>, T?, PgTypeId?, PgConverterResolution?> resolver, Func<PgTypeId, PgConverter> factory, PgTypeId timestampTz, PgTypeId timestamp, bool dateTimeInfinityConversions)
		{
			_options = options;
			_resolver = resolver;
			_factory = factory;
			_timestampTz = timestampTz;
			_timestamp = timestamp;
			_dateTimeInfinityConversions = dateTimeInfinityConversions;
		}

		public override PgConverterResolution GetDefault(PgTypeId? pgTypeId)
		{
			if (pgTypeId == _timestampTz)
			{
				return new PgConverterResolution(_timestampTzConverter ?? (_timestampTzConverter = _factory(_timestampTz)), _timestampTz);
			}
			if (!pgTypeId.HasValue || pgTypeId == _timestamp)
			{
				return new PgConverterResolution(_timestampConverter ?? (_timestampConverter = _factory(_timestamp)), _timestamp);
			}
			throw CreateUnsupportedPgTypeIdException(pgTypeId.Value);
		}

		public PgConverterResolution? Get(DateTime value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId, bool validateOnly = false)
		{
			if (value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc)
			{
				if (!(expectedPgTypeId == _timestamp))
				{
					if (!validateOnly)
					{
						return GetDefault(expectedPgTypeId ?? _timestampTz);
					}
					return null;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.TimestampNoDateTimeUtc, _options.GetDataTypeName(_timestamp).DisplayName, _options.GetDataTypeName(_timestampTz).DisplayName), "value");
			}
			PgTypeId? pgTypeId = expectedPgTypeId;
			PgTypeId timestampTz = _timestampTz;
			if (pgTypeId.HasValue && pgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault() == timestampTz && (!_dateTimeInfinityConversions || (!(value == DateTime.MinValue) && !(value == DateTime.MaxValue))))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(NpgsqlStrings.TimestampTzNoDateTimeUnspecified, value.Kind, _options.GetDataTypeName(_timestampTz).DisplayName), "value");
			}
			return GetDefault(expectedPgTypeId ?? _timestamp);
		}

		public override PgConverterResolution? Get(T? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
		{
			return _resolver(this, value, expectedPgTypeId);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DateTimeConverterResolver
	{
		public static DateTimeConverterResolver<DateTime> CreateResolver(PgSerializerOptions options, PgTypeId timestampTz, PgTypeId timestamp, bool dateTimeInfinityConversions)
		{
			return new DateTimeConverterResolver<DateTime>(options, (DateTimeConverterResolver<DateTime> resolver, DateTime value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId) => resolver.Get(value, expectedPgTypeId), delegate(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
			{
				if (pgTypeId == timestampTz)
				{
					return new DateTimeConverter(dateTimeInfinityConversions, DateTimeKind.Utc);
				}
				if (pgTypeId == timestamp)
				{
					return new DateTimeConverter(dateTimeInfinityConversions, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}, timestampTz, timestamp, dateTimeInfinityConversions);
		}

		public static DateTimeConverterResolver<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>> CreateRangeResolver(PgSerializerOptions options, PgTypeId timestampTz, PgTypeId timestamp, bool dateTimeInfinityConversions)
		{
			return new DateTimeConverterResolver<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>(options, delegate(DateTimeConverterResolver<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>> resolver, NpgsqlRange<DateTime> value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
			{
				PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution = null;
				if (!value.LowerBoundInfinite)
				{
					pgConverterResolution = resolver.Get(value.LowerBound, expectedPgTypeId);
				}
				if (!value.UpperBoundInfinite)
				{
					PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution2 = resolver.Get(value.UpperBound, pgConverterResolution.HasValue ? new PgTypeId?(pgConverterResolution.GetValueOrDefault().PgTypeId) : expectedPgTypeId, pgConverterResolution.HasValue);
					PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution3 = pgConverterResolution;
					if (!pgConverterResolution3.HasValue)
					{
						pgConverterResolution = pgConverterResolution2;
					}
				}
				return pgConverterResolution;
			}, delegate(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
			{
				if (pgTypeId == timestampTz)
				{
					return new RangeConverter<DateTime>(new DateTimeConverter(dateTimeInfinityConversions, DateTimeKind.Utc));
				}
				if (pgTypeId == timestamp)
				{
					return new RangeConverter<DateTime>(new DateTimeConverter(dateTimeInfinityConversions, DateTimeKind.Unspecified));
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}, timestampTz, timestamp, dateTimeInfinityConversions);
		}

		public static DateTimeConverterResolver<T> CreateMultirangeResolver<T, TElement>(PgSerializerOptions options, PgTypeId timestampTz, PgTypeId timestamp, bool dateTimeInfinityConversions) where T : IList<TElement> where TElement : notnull
		{
			if (typeof(TElement) != typeof(NpgsqlRange<DateTime>))
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowNotSupportedException("Unsupported element type");
			}
			return new DateTimeConverterResolver<T>(options, delegate(DateTimeConverterResolver<T> resolver, T? value, PgTypeId? expectedPgTypeId)
			{
				PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution = null;
				if (value == null)
				{
					return (PgConverterResolution?)null;
				}
				foreach (NpgsqlRange<DateTime> item in (IList<NpgsqlRange<DateTime>>)(object)value)
				{
					if (!item.LowerBoundInfinite)
					{
						PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution2 = resolver.Get(item.LowerBound, pgConverterResolution.HasValue ? new PgTypeId?(pgConverterResolution.GetValueOrDefault().PgTypeId) : expectedPgTypeId, pgConverterResolution.HasValue);
						PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution3 = pgConverterResolution;
						if (!pgConverterResolution3.HasValue)
						{
							pgConverterResolution = pgConverterResolution2;
						}
					}
					if (!item.UpperBoundInfinite)
					{
						PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution2 = resolver.Get(item.UpperBound, pgConverterResolution.HasValue ? new PgTypeId?(pgConverterResolution.GetValueOrDefault().PgTypeId) : expectedPgTypeId, pgConverterResolution.HasValue);
						PgConverterResolution? pgConverterResolution3 = pgConverterResolution;
						if (!pgConverterResolution3.HasValue)
						{
							pgConverterResolution = pgConverterResolution2;
						}
					}
				}
				return pgConverterResolution;
			}, delegate(PgTypeId pgTypeId)
			{
				if (pgTypeId == timestampTz)
				{
					return new MultirangeConverter<T, TElement>((PgConverter<TElement>)(object)new RangeConverter<DateTime>(new DateTimeConverter(dateTimeInfinityConversions, DateTimeKind.Utc)));
				}
				if (pgTypeId == timestamp)
				{
					return new MultirangeConverter<T, TElement>((PgConverter<TElement>)(object)new RangeConverter<DateTime>(new DateTimeConverter(dateTimeInfinityConversions, DateTimeKind.Unspecified)));
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}, timestampTz, timestamp, dateTimeInfinityConversions);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DateTimeConverter : PgBufferedConverter<DateTime>
	{
		private readonly bool _dateTimeInfinityConversions;

		private readonly DateTimeKind _kind;

		public DateTimeConverter(bool dateTimeInfinityConversions, DateTimeKind kind)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_dateTimeInfinityConversions = dateTimeInfinityConversions;
			_kind = kind;
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(8);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override DateTime ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			return PgTimestamp.Decode(reader.ReadInt64(), _kind, _dateTimeInfinityConversions);
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, DateTime value)
		{
			writer.WriteInt64(PgTimestamp.Encode(value, _dateTimeInfinityConversions));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DateTimeOffsetConverter : PgBufferedConverter<DateTimeOffset>
	{
		private readonly bool _dateTimeInfinityConversions;

		public DateTimeOffsetConverter(bool dateTimeInfinityConversions)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_dateTimeInfinityConversions = dateTimeInfinityConversions;
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(8);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override DateTimeOffset ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			return new DateTimeOffset(PgTimestamp.Decode(reader.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc, _dateTimeInfinityConversions), TimeSpan.Zero);

		{
			if (value.Offset != TimeSpan.Zero)
			{

			}
			writer.WriteInt64(PgTimestamp.Encode(value.DateTime, _dateTimeInfinityConversions));
		}

	internal sealed class TimeSpanIntervalConverter : PgBufferedConverter<TimeSpan>
	{
		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(16);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override TimeSpan ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			long num = reader.ReadInt64();
			int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (reader.ReadInt32() <= 0)
			{
				return new TimeSpan(num * 10 + num2 * 864000000000L);
			}
			throw new InvalidCastException("Cannot read interval values with non-zero months as TimeSpan, since that type doesn't support months. Consider using NodaTime Period which better corresponds to PostgreSQL interval, or read the value as NpgsqlInterval, or transform the interval to not contain months or years in PostgreSQL before reading it.");
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, TimeSpan value)
		{
			long num = value.Ticks - 864000000000L * value.Days;
			writer.WriteInt64(num / 10);
			writer.WriteInt32(value.Days);
			writer.WriteInt32(0);
		}

		public TimeSpanIntervalConverter()
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
		}
	}

	internal sealed class LegacyDateTimeConverter : PgBufferedConverter<DateTime>
	{
		private readonly bool _dateTimeInfinityConversions;

		private readonly bool _timestamp;

		public LegacyDateTimeConverter(bool dateTimeInfinityConversions, bool timestamp)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_dateTimeInfinityConversions = dateTimeInfinityConversions;
			_timestamp = timestamp;
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(8);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override DateTime ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			if (_timestamp)
			{
				return PgTimestamp.Decode(reader.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Unspecified, _dateTimeInfinityConversions);
			}
			DateTime dateTime = PgTimestamp.Decode(reader.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc, _dateTimeInfinityConversions);
			if ((!(dateTime == DateTime.MinValue) && !(dateTime == DateTime.MaxValue)) || !_dateTimeInfinityConversions)
			{
				return dateTime.ToLocalTime();
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, DateTime value)
		{
			if (!_timestamp && value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Local)
			{
				value = value.ToUniversalTime();
			}
			writer.WriteInt64(PgTimestamp.Encode(value, _dateTimeInfinityConversions));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class LegacyDateTimeOffsetConverter : PgBufferedConverter<DateTimeOffset>
	{
		private readonly bool _dateTimeInfinityConversions;

		public LegacyDateTimeOffsetConverter(bool dateTimeInfinityConversions)
			: base(customDbNullPredicate: false)
		{
			_dateTimeInfinityConversions = dateTimeInfinityConversions;
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bufferRequirements = BufferRequirements.CreateFixedSize(8);
			return format == DataFormat.Binary;
		}

		protected override DateTimeOffset ReadCore(PgReader reader)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = PgTimestamp.Decode(reader.ReadInt64(), DateTimeKind.Utc, _dateTimeInfinityConversions);
			if (_dateTimeInfinityConversions)
			{
				if (dateTime == DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					return DateTimeOffset.MinValue;
				}
				if (dateTime == DateTime.MaxValue)
				{
					return DateTimeOffset.MaxValue;
				}
			}
			return dateTime.ToLocalTime();
		}

		protected override void WriteCore(PgWriter writer, DateTimeOffset value)
		{
			writer.WriteInt64(PgTimestamp.Encode(value.UtcDateTime, _dateTimeInfinityConversions));
		}
	}
	internal static class PgTimestamp
	{
		private const long PostgresTimestampOffsetTicks = 630822816000000000L;

		internal static long Encode(DateTime value, bool dateTimeInfinityConversions)
		{
			if (dateTimeInfinityConversions)
			{
				long ticks = value.Ticks;
				DateTime maxValue = DateTime.MaxValue;
				if (ticks == maxValue.Ticks)
				{
					return long.MaxValue;
				}
				long ticks2 = value.Ticks;
				maxValue = DateTime.MinValue;
				if (ticks2 == maxValue.Ticks)
				{
					return long.MinValue;
				}
			}
			return (value.Ticks - 630822816000000000L) / 10;
		}

		internal static DateTime Decode(long value, DateTimeKind kind, bool dateTimeInfinityConversions)
		{
			try
			{
				switch (value)
				{
				case long.MaxValue:
					if (!dateTimeInfinityConversions)
					{
						throw new InvalidCastException("Cannot read infinity value since DisableDateTimeInfinityConversions is true.");
					}
					return DateTime.MaxValue;
				case long.MinValue:
					if (!dateTimeInfinityConversions)
					{
						throw new InvalidCastException("Cannot read infinity value since DisableDateTimeInfinityConversions is true.");
					}
					return DateTime.MinValue;
				default:
					return new DateTime(value * 10 + 630822816000000000L, kind);
				}
			}
			catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException innerException)
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("Out of range of DateTime (year must be between 1 and 9999).", innerException);
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class VersionPrefixedTextConverter<T> : PgStreamingConverter<T>
	{
		private readonly byte _versionPrefix;

		private readonly PgConverter<T> _textConverter;

		private BufferRequirements _innerRequirements;

		public VersionPrefixedTextConverter(byte versionPrefix, PgConverter<T> textConverter)
			: base(textConverter.DbNullPredicateKind == DbNullPredicate.Custom)
		{
			_versionPrefix = versionPrefix;
			_textConverter = textConverter;
		}

		protected override bool IsDbNullValue(T? value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return _textConverter.IsDbNull(value, ref writeState);
		}

		public override bool CanConvert(DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			return VersionPrefixedTextConverter.CanConvert(_textConverter, format, out _innerRequirements, out bufferRequirements);
		}

		public override T Read(PgReader reader)
		{
			return Read(async: false, reader, CancellationToken.None).Result;
		}

		public override ValueTask<T> ReadAsync(PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Read(async: true, reader, cancellationToken);
		}

		public override Size GetSize(SizeContext context, [DisallowNull] T value, ref object? writeState)
		{
			return _textConverter.GetSize(context, value, ref writeState).Combine((context.Format == DataFormat.Binary) ? 1 : 0);
		}

		public override void Write(PgWriter writer, [DisallowNull] T value)
		{
			Write(async: false, writer, value, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override ValueTask WriteAsync(PgWriter writer, [DisallowNull] T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return Write(async: true, writer, value, cancellationToken);
		}

		private async ValueTask<T> Read(bool async, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			await VersionPrefixedTextConverter.ReadVersion(async, _versionPrefix, reader, _innerRequirements.Read, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return (!async) ? _textConverter.Read(reader) : (await _textConverter.ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
		}

		private async ValueTask Write(bool async, PgWriter writer, [DisallowNull] T value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			await VersionPrefixedTextConverter.WriteVersion(async, _versionPrefix, writer, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			if (async)
			{
				await _textConverter.WriteAsync(writer, value, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				_textConverter.Write(writer, value);
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class VersionPrefixedTextConverter
	{
		public static async ValueTask WriteVersion(bool async, byte version, PgWriter writer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (writer.Current.Format == DataFormat.Binary)
			{
				if (writer.ShouldFlush(1))
				{
					await writer.Flush(async, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				writer.WriteByte(version);
			}
		}

		public static async ValueTask ReadVersion(bool async, byte expectedVersion, PgReader reader, Size textConverterReadRequirement, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (reader.Current.Format != DataFormat.Binary)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!reader.IsResumed)
			{
				if (reader.ShouldBuffer(1))
				{
					await reader.Buffer(async, 1, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				byte b = reader.ReadByte();
				if (b != expectedVersion)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException($"Unknown wire format version: {b}");
				}
			}
			await reader.Buffer(async, textConverterReadRequirement, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		public static bool CanConvert(PgConverter textConverter, DataFormat format, out BufferRequirements textConverterRequirements, out BufferRequirements bufferRequirements)
		{
			bool flag = textConverter.CanConvert(format, out textConverterRequirements);
			if (!flag)
			{
				bufferRequirements = default(BufferRequirements);
				return false;
			}
			if (textConverter.CanConvert((format == DataFormat.Binary) ? DataFormat.Text : DataFormat.Binary, out var bufferRequirements2) && bufferRequirements2 != textConverterRequirements)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Text converter should have identical requirements for text and binary formats.");
			}
			bufferRequirements = ((format == DataFormat.Binary) ? textConverterRequirements.Combine(1) : textConverterRequirements);
			return flag;
		}
	}
}

namespace Npgsql.Internal.Composites

	internal abstract class CompositeBuilder
	{
		protected StrongBox[] _tempBoxes;

		protected int _currentField;

		protected CompositeBuilder(StrongBox[] tempBoxes)
		{
			_tempBoxes = tempBoxes;
		}

		protected abstract void Construct();

		protected abstract void SetField<TValue>(TValue value);

		public void AddValue<TValue>(TValue value)
		{
			StrongBox[] tempBoxes = _tempBoxes;
			int currentField = _currentField;
			if (currentField >= tempBoxes.Length)
			{
				if (currentField == tempBoxes.Length)
				{
					Construct();
				}
				SetField(value);
			}
			else
			{
				((Npgsql.Util.StrongBox<TValue>)tempBoxes[currentField]).TypedValue = value;
				if (currentField + 1 == tempBoxes.Length)
				{
					Construct();
				}
			}
			_currentField++;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CompositeBuilder<T> : CompositeBuilder, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly CompositeInfo<T> _compositeInfo;

		private T _instance;

		private object? _boxedInstance;

		public CompositeBuilder(CompositeInfo<T> compositeInfo)
			: base(compositeInfo.CreateTempBoxes())
		{
			_compositeInfo = compositeInfo;
		}

		public T Complete()
		{
			if (_currentField < _compositeInfo.Fields.Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"Missing values, expected: {_compositeInfo.Fields.Count} got: {_currentField}");
			}
			return (T)(_boxedInstance ?? ((object)_instance));
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_instance = default(T);
			_boxedInstance = null;
			_currentField = 0;
			StrongBox[] tempBoxes = _tempBoxes;
			for (int i = 0; i < tempBoxes.Length; i++)
			{
				tempBoxes[i].Clear();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		protected override void Construct()
		{
			StrongBox[] tempBoxes = _tempBoxes;
			if (_currentField < tempBoxes.Length - 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"Missing values, expected: {tempBoxes.Length} got: {_currentField + 1}");
			}
			IReadOnlyList<CompositeFieldInfo> fields = _compositeInfo.Fields;
			StrongBox[] array = ArrayPool<StrongBox>.Shared.Rent(_compositeInfo.ConstructorParameters);
			for (int i = 0; i < tempBoxes.Length; i++)
			{
				int? constructorParameterIndex = fields[i].ConstructorParameterIndex;
				if (constructorParameterIndex.HasValue)
				{
					int valueOrDefault = constructorParameterIndex.GetValueOrDefault();
					array[valueOrDefault] = tempBoxes[i];
				}
			}
			_instance = _compositeInfo.Constructor(array);
			ArrayPool<StrongBox>.Shared.Return(array);
			if (tempBoxes.Length == _compositeInfo.Fields.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			_boxedInstance = _instance;
			for (int j = 0; j < tempBoxes.Length; j++)
			{
				CompositeFieldInfo compositeFieldInfo = _compositeInfo.Fields[j];
				if (!compositeFieldInfo.ConstructorParameterIndex.HasValue)
				{
					compositeFieldInfo.Set(_boxedInstance, tempBoxes[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void SetField<TValue>(TValue value)
		{
			if (_boxedInstance == null)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Not constructed yet, or no more fields were expected.");
			}
			int currentField = _currentField;
			IReadOnlyList<CompositeFieldInfo> fields = _compositeInfo.Fields;
			if (currentField > fields.Count - 1)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowIndexOutOfRangeException($"Cannot set field {value} at position {currentField} - all fields have already been set");
			}
			((CompositeFieldInfo<TValue>)fields[currentField]).Set(_boxedInstance, value);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CompositeFieldInfo
	{
		protected BufferRequirements _binaryBufferRequirements;

		protected PgTypeInfo PgTypeInfo { get; }

		protected PgConverter? Converter { get; }

		public string Name { get; }

		public PgTypeId PgTypeId { get; }

		public Size BinaryReadRequirement
		{
			get
			{
				if (Converter == null)
				{
					return Size.Unknown;
				}
				return _binaryBufferRequirements.Read;
			}
		}

		public Size BinaryWriteRequirement
		{
			get
			{
				if (Converter == null)
				{
					return Size.Unknown;
				}
				return _binaryBufferRequirements.Write;
			}
		}

		public abstract Type Type { get; }

		public abstract int? ConstructorParameterIndex { get; }

		public abstract bool IsDbNullable { get; }

		private protected CompositeFieldInfo(string name, PgTypeInfo typeInfo, PgTypeId nominalPgTypeId)
		{
			Name = name;
			PgTypeInfo = typeInfo;
			PgTypeId = nominalPgTypeId;
			if (!typeInfo.PgTypeId.HasValue)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentException("PgTypeInfo must have a PgTypeId.");
			}
			if (!typeInfo.IsResolverInfo)
			{
				PgConverterResolution resolution = typeInfo.GetResolution();
				BufferRequirements? bufferRequirements = typeInfo.GetBufferRequirements(resolution.Converter, DataFormat.Binary);
				if (bufferRequirements.HasValue)
				{
					BufferRequirements valueOrDefault = bufferRequirements.GetValueOrDefault();
					_binaryBufferRequirements = valueOrDefault;
					Converter = resolution.Converter;
				}
				else
				{
					ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Converter must support binary format to participate in composite types.");
				}
			}
		}

		public PgConverter GetReadInfo(out Size readRequirement)
		{
			if (Converter != null)
			{
				readRequirement = _binaryBufferRequirements.Read;
				return Converter;
			}
			if (!PgTypeInfo.TryBind(new Field(Name, PgTypeInfo.PgTypeId.GetValueOrDefault(), -1), DataFormat.Binary, out var info))
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Converter must support binary format to participate in composite types.");
			}
			readRequirement = info.BufferRequirement;
			return info.Converter;
		}

		public PgConverter GetWriteInfo(object instance, out Size writeRequirement)
		{
			if (Converter == null)
			{
				return BindValue(instance, out writeRequirement);
			}
			writeRequirement = _binaryBufferRequirements.Write;
			return Converter;
		}

		protected ValueTask ReadAsObject(bool async, PgConverter converter, CompositeBuilder builder, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (async)
			{
				ValueTask<object> task = converter.ReadAsObjectAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
				if (!task.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
				{
					return Core(builder, task);
				}
				AddValue(builder, task.Result);
			}
			else
			{
				AddValue(builder, converter.ReadAsObject(reader));
			}
			return default(ValueTask);
			static async ValueTask Core(CompositeBuilder compositeBuilder, ValueTask<object> valueTask)
			{
				compositeBuilder.AddValue(await valueTask.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
			}
		}

		protected ValueTask WriteAsObject(bool async, PgConverter converter, PgWriter writer, object value, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (async)
			{
				return converter.WriteAsObjectAsync(writer, value, cancellationToken);
			}
			converter.WriteAsObject(writer, value);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}

		protected abstract PgConverter BindValue(object instance, out Size writeRequirement);

		protected abstract void AddValue(CompositeBuilder builder, object value);

		public abstract StrongBox CreateBox();

		public abstract void Set(object instance, StrongBox value);

		public abstract void ReadDbNull(CompositeBuilder builder);

		public abstract ValueTask Read(bool async, PgConverter converter, CompositeBuilder builder, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));

		public abstract bool IsDbNull(PgConverter converter, object instance, ref object? writeState);

		public abstract Size? GetSizeOrDbNull(PgConverter converter, DataFormat format, Size writeRequirement, object instance, ref object? writeState);

		public abstract ValueTask Write(bool async, PgConverter converter, PgWriter writer, object instance, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
	}
	internal sealed class CompositeFieldInfo<T> : CompositeFieldInfo
	{
		private readonly Action<object, T>? _setter;

		private readonly int _parameterIndex;

		private readonly Func<object, T> _getter;

		private readonly bool _asObject;

		public override Type Type => typeof(T);

		public override int? ConstructorParameterIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (_setter == null)
				{
					return _parameterIndex;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsDbNullable => base.Converter?.IsDbNullable ?? true;

		private CompositeFieldInfo(string name, PgTypeInfo typeInfo, PgTypeId nominalPgTypeId, Func<object, T> getter)
			: base(name, typeInfo, nominalPgTypeId)
		{
			if (typeInfo.Type != typeof(T))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"PgTypeInfo type '{typeInfo.Type.FullName}' must be equal to field type '{typeof(T)}'.");
			}
			if (!typeInfo.IsResolverInfo)
			{
				Type typeToConvert = typeInfo.GetResolution().Converter.TypeToConvert;
				_asObject = typeToConvert != typeof(T);
				if (!typeToConvert.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"Converter type '{typeToConvert.FullName}' must be assignable from field type '{typeof(T)}'.");
				}
			}
			_getter = getter;
		}

		public CompositeFieldInfo(string name, PgTypeInfo typeInfo, PgTypeId nominalPgTypeId, Func<object, T> getter, int parameterIndex)
			: this(name, typeInfo, nominalPgTypeId, getter)
		{
			_parameterIndex = parameterIndex;
		}

		public CompositeFieldInfo(string name, PgTypeInfo typeInfo, PgTypeId nominalPgTypeId, Func<object, T> getter, Action<object, T> setter)
			: this(name, typeInfo, nominalPgTypeId, getter)
		{
			_setter = setter;
		}

		private bool AsObject(PgConverter converter)
		{
			if (base.Converter != converter)
			{
				return converter.TypeToConvert != typeof(T);
			}
			return _asObject;
		}

		public T Get(object instance)
		{
			return _getter(instance);
		}

		public override StrongBox CreateBox()
		{
			return new Npgsql.Util.StrongBox<T>();
		}

		public void Set(object instance, T value)
		{
			if (_setter == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Not a composite field for a clr field.");
			}
			_setter(instance, value);
		}

		public override void Set(object instance, StrongBox value)
		{
			if (_setter == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Not a composite field for a clr field.");
			}
			_setter(instance, ((Npgsql.Util.StrongBox<T>)value).TypedValue);
		}

		public override void ReadDbNull(CompositeBuilder builder)
		{
			if (default(T) != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException("Type " + typeof(T).FullName + " does not have null as a possible value.");
			}
			builder.AddValue(default(T));
		}

		protected override PgConverter BindValue(object instance, out Size writeRequirement)
		{
			T val = _getter(instance);
			PgConverterResolution pgConverterResolution = (base.PgTypeInfo.IsBoxing ? base.PgTypeInfo.GetObjectResolution(val) : base.PgTypeInfo.GetResolution(val));
			BufferRequirements? bufferRequirements = base.PgTypeInfo.GetBufferRequirements(pgConverterResolution.Converter, DataFormat.Binary);
			if (!bufferRequirements.HasValue)
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Converter must support binary format to participate in composite types.");
				writeRequirement = default(Size);
				return null;
			}
			writeRequirement = bufferRequirements.GetValueOrDefault().Write;
			return pgConverterResolution.Converter;
		}

		protected override void AddValue(CompositeBuilder builder, object value)
		{
			builder.AddValue((T)value);
		}

		public override ValueTask Read(bool async, PgConverter converter, CompositeBuilder builder, PgReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (AsObject(converter))
			{
				return ReadAsObject(async, converter, builder, reader, cancellationToken);
			}
			if (async)
			{
				ValueTask<T> task = ((PgConverter<T>)converter).ReadAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
				if (!task.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
				{
					return Core(builder, task);
				}
				builder.AddValue(task.Result);
			}
			else
			{
				builder.AddValue(((PgConverter<T>)converter).Read(reader));
			}
			return default(ValueTask);
			static async ValueTask Core(CompositeBuilder compositeBuilder, ValueTask<T> valueTask)
			{
				compositeBuilder.AddValue(await valueTask.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
			}
		}

		public override bool IsDbNull(PgConverter converter, object instance, ref object? writeState)
		{
			T val = _getter(instance);
			if (!AsObject(converter))
			{
				return ((PgConverter<T>)converter).IsDbNull(val, ref writeState);
			}
			return converter.IsDbNullAsObject(val, ref writeState);
		}

		public override Size? GetSizeOrDbNull(PgConverter converter, DataFormat format, Size writeRequirement, object instance, ref object? writeState)
		{
			T val = _getter(instance);
			if (!AsObject(converter))
			{
				return ((PgConverter<T>)converter).GetSizeOrDbNull(format, writeRequirement, val, ref writeState);
			}
			return converter.GetSizeOrDbNullAsObject(format, writeRequirement, val, ref writeState);
		}

		public override ValueTask Write(bool async, PgConverter converter, PgWriter writer, object instance, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			T val = _getter(instance);
			if (AsObject(converter))
			{
				return WriteAsObject(async, converter, writer, val, cancellationToken);
			}
			if (async)
			{
				return ((PgConverter<T>)converter).WriteAsync(writer, val, cancellationToken);
			}
			((PgConverter<T>)converter).Write(writer, val);
			return default(ValueTask);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CompositeInfo<T>
	{
		private readonly int _lastConstructorFieldIndex;

		private readonly CompositeFieldInfo[] _fields;

		public IReadOnlyList<CompositeFieldInfo> Fields => _fields;

		public int ConstructorParameters { get; }

		public Func<StrongBox[], T> Constructor { get; }

		public CompositeInfo(CompositeFieldInfo[] fields, int constructorParameters, Func<StrongBox[], T> constructor)
		{
			_lastConstructorFieldIndex = -1;
			for (int num = fields.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (fields[num].ConstructorParameterIndex.HasValue)
				{
					_lastConstructorFieldIndex = num;
					break;
				}
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int num3 = constructorParameters - 1; num3 > 0; num3--)
			{
				num2 += num3;
			}
			int num4 = 0;
			CompositeFieldInfo[] array;
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				array = fields;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					int? constructorParameterIndex = array[i].ConstructorParameterIndex;
					if (constructorParameterIndex.HasValue)
					{
						int valueOrDefault = constructorParameterIndex.GetValueOrDefault();
						num4 += valueOrDefault;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 != num4)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"Missing composite fields to map to the required {constructorParameters} constructor parameters.");
			}
			_fields = fields;
			CompositeFieldInfo[] array2 = ((constructorParameters == 0) ? Array.Empty<CompositeFieldInfo>() : new CompositeFieldInfo[constructorParameters]);
			array = fields;
			foreach (CompositeFieldInfo compositeFieldInfo in array)
			{
				int? constructorParameterIndex = compositeFieldInfo.ConstructorParameterIndex;
				if (constructorParameterIndex.HasValue)
				{
					int valueOrDefault2 = constructorParameterIndex.GetValueOrDefault();
					array2[valueOrDefault2] = compositeFieldInfo;
				}
			}
			Constructor = constructor;
			ConstructorParameters = constructorParameters;
		}

		public StrongBox[] CreateTempBoxes()
		{
			StrongBox[] array = ((_lastConstructorFieldIndex + 1 == 0) ? Array.Empty<StrongBox>() : new StrongBox[_lastConstructorFieldIndex + 1]);
			CompositeFieldInfo[] fields = _fields;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = fields[i].CreateBox();
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

		private static Delegate CreateGetter<T>(FieldInfo info)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object), "instance");
			return Expression.Lambda(typeof(Func<, >).MakeGenericType(typeof(object), info.FieldType), Expression.Field(UnboxAny(parameterExpression, typeof(T)), info), parameterExpression).Compile();
		}

		private static Delegate CreateSetter<T>(FieldInfo info)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object), "instance");
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression2 = Expression.Parameter(info.FieldType, "value");
			return Expression.Lambda(typeof(Action<, >).MakeGenericType(typeof(object), info.FieldType), Expression.Assign(Expression.Field(UnboxAny(parameterExpression, typeof(T)), info), parameterExpression2), parameterExpression, parameterExpression2).Compile();
		}

		private static Delegate CreateGetter<T>(PropertyInfo info)
		{
			ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(InvalidOperationException).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object), "instance");
			Expression body = (((object)info.GetMethod == null || !info.GetMethod.IsPublic) ? ((Expression)Expression.Throw(Expression.New(constructor, Expression.Constant($"No (public) getter for '{info}' on type {typeof(T)}")), info.PropertyType)) : ((Expression)Expression.Property(UnboxAny(parameterExpression, typeof(T)), info)));
			return Expression.Lambda(typeof(Func<, >).MakeGenericType(typeof(object), info.PropertyType), body, parameterExpression).Compile();
		}

		private static Delegate CreateSetter<T>(PropertyInfo info)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object), "instance");
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression2 = Expression.Parameter(info.PropertyType, "value");
			ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(InvalidOperationException).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
			Expression body = (((object)info.SetMethod == null || !info.SetMethod.IsPublic) ? ((Expression)Expression.Throw(Expression.New(constructor, Expression.Constant($"No (public) setter for '{info}' on type {typeof(T)}")), info.PropertyType)) : ((Expression)Expression.Call(UnboxAny(parameterExpression, typeof(T)), info.SetMethod, parameterExpression2)));
			return Expression.Lambda(typeof(Action<, >).MakeGenericType(typeof(object), info.PropertyType), body, parameterExpression, parameterExpression2).Compile();
		}

		private static Expression UnboxAny(Expression expression, Type type)
		{
			if (!type.IsValueType)
			{
				return Expression.Convert(expression, type, null);
			}
			return Expression.Unbox(expression, type);
		}

		[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("Trimming", "IL2026", Justification = "DynamicDependencies in place for the System.Linq.Expression.Property calls")]

		private static Dictionary<int, PropertyInfo> MapProperties<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicProperties)] T>(IReadOnlyList<PostgresCompositeType.Field> fields, INpgsqlNameTranslator nameTranslator)
		{
			KeyValuePair<string, PropertyInfo>[] source = (from x in typeof(T).GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public)
				select new KeyValuePair<string, PropertyInfo>(x.GetCustomAttribute<PgNameAttribute>()?.PgName ?? nameTranslator.TranslateMemberName(x.Name), x)).ToArray();
			IGrouping<string, KeyValuePair<string, PropertyInfo>>[] array = (from x in source
				group x by x.Key into g
				where g.Count() > 1
				select g).ToArray();
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				throw new AmbiguousMatchException("Multiple properties are mapped to the '" + array[0].Key + "' field.");
			}
			Dictionary<string, PropertyInfo> dictionary = source.ToDictionary((KeyValuePair<string, PropertyInfo> x) => x.Key, (KeyValuePair<string, PropertyInfo> x) => x.Value);
			Dictionary<int, PropertyInfo> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<int, PropertyInfo>();
			for (int num = 0; num < fields.Count; num++)
			{
				PostgresCompositeType.Field field = fields[num];
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(field.Name, out var value))
				{
					dictionary2[num] = value;
				}
			}
			return dictionary2;
		}

		private static Dictionary<int, FieldInfo> MapFields<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicFields)] T>(IReadOnlyList<PostgresCompositeType.Field> fields, INpgsqlNameTranslator nameTranslator)
		{
			KeyValuePair<string, FieldInfo>[] source = (from x in typeof(T).GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public)
				select new KeyValuePair<string, FieldInfo>(x.GetCustomAttribute<PgNameAttribute>()?.PgName ?? nameTranslator.TranslateMemberName(x.Name), x)).ToArray();
			IGrouping<string, KeyValuePair<string, FieldInfo>>[] array = (from x in source
				group x by x.Key into g
				where g.Count() > 1
				select g).ToArray();
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				throw new AmbiguousMatchException("Multiple properties are mapped to the '" + array[0].Key + "' field.");
			}
			Dictionary<string, FieldInfo> dictionary = source.ToDictionary((KeyValuePair<string, FieldInfo> x) => x.Key, (KeyValuePair<string, FieldInfo> x) => x.Value);
			Dictionary<int, FieldInfo> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<int, FieldInfo>();
			for (int num = 0; num < fields.Count; num++)
			{
				PostgresCompositeType.Field field = fields[num];
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(field.Name, out var value))
				{
					dictionary2[num] = value;
				}
			}
			return dictionary2;
		}

		private static (ConstructorInfo? ConstructorInfo, int[] ParameterFieldMap) MapBestMatchingConstructor<[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicConstructors)] T>(IReadOnlyList<PostgresCompositeType.Field> fields, INpgsqlNameTranslator nameTranslator)
		{
			ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = null;
			Exception ex = null;
			foreach (ConstructorInfo item in from x in typeof(T).GetConstructors()
				orderby x.GetParameters().Length descending
				select x)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = item.GetParameters();
				if (parameters.Length == 0)
				{
					constructorInfo = item;
				}
				int[] array = new int[parameters.Length];
				for (int num = 0; num < array.Length; num++)
				{
					array[num] = -1;
				}
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < parameters.Length; num2++)
				{
					ParameterInfo parameterInfo = parameters[num2];
					object obj = parameterInfo.GetCustomAttribute<PgNameAttribute>()?.PgName;
					if (obj == null)
					{
						string name = parameterInfo.Name;
						obj = ((name != null) ? nameTranslator.TranslateMemberName(name) : null);
					}
					string text = (string)obj;
					if (text == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					for (int num3 = 0; num3 < fields.Count; num3++)
					{
						if (fields[num3].Name == text)
						{
							array[num2] = num3;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!array.Any((int x) => x == -1))
				{
					IGrouping<int, int>[] array2 = (from x in array
						group x by x into g
						where g.Count() > 1
						select g).ToArray();
					if (array2.Length == 0)
					{
						return (ConstructorInfo: item, ParameterFieldMap: array);
					}
					ex = new AmbiguousMatchException($"Multiple parameters are mapped to the field '{fields[array2[0].Key].Name}' in constructor: {item}.");
				}
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			if ((object)constructorInfo == null && !typeof(T).IsValueType)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"No parameterless constructor defined for type '{typeof(T)}'.");
			}
			return (ConstructorInfo: constructorInfo, ParameterFieldMap: Array.Empty<int>());
		}
	}

	{
		internal string Nonce { get; }

		internal string Salt { get; }

		internal int Iteration { get; }

		internal static AuthenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage Load(byte[] bytes, ILogger connectionLogger)
		{
			string text = NpgsqlWriteBuffer.UTF8Encoding.GetString(bytes);
			string text2 = null;
			string text3 = null;
			int num = -1;
			string[] array = text.Split(new char[1] { ',' });
			foreach (string text4 in array)
			{
				if (text4.StartsWith("r=", StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					text2 = text4.Substring(2);
				}
				else if (text4.StartsWith("s=", StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					text3 = text4.Substring(2);
				}
				else if (text4.StartsWith("i=", StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					num = int.Parse(text4.Substring(2));
				}
				else
				{
					connectionLogger.LogDebug("Unknown part in SCRAM server-first message:" + text4);
				}
			}
			if (text2 == null)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("Server nonce not received in SCRAM server-first message");
			}
			if (text3 == null)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("Server salt not received in SCRAM server-first message");
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				throw new NpgsqlException("Server iterations not received in SCRAM server-first message");
			}
			return new AuthenticationSCRAMServerFirstMessage(text2, text3, num);
		}

	internal sealed class CommandCompleteMessage : IBackendMessage
	{
		private uint _oid;

		private ulong _rows;

		internal StatementType StatementType { get; private set; }

		internal uint OID => _oid;

		internal ulong Rows => _rows;

		public BackendMessageCode Code => BackendMessageCode.CommandComplete;

		internal CommandCompleteMessage Load(NpgsqlReadBuffer buf, int len)
		{
			ReadOnlySpan<byte> span = buf.Span.Slice(0, len);
			buf.Skip(len);
			(StatementType, int) tuple;
			switch (Convert.ToChar(span[0]))
			{
			case 'S':
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"SELECT "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Select, "SELECT ".Length);
					break;
				}
				goto default;
			case 'I':
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"INSERT "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Insert, "INSERT ".Length);
					break;
				}
				goto default;
			case 'U':
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"UPDATE "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Update, "UPDATE ".Length);
					break;
				}
				goto default;
			case 'D':
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"DELETE "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Delete, "DELETE ".Length);
					break;
				}
				goto default;
			case 'M':
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"MERGE "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Merge, "MERGE ".Length);
					break;
				}
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"MOVE "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Move, "MOVE ".Length);
					break;
				}
				goto default;
			case 'C':
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"COPY "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Copy, "COPY ".Length);
					break;
				}
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"CALL"u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Call, "CALL".Length);
					break;
				}
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"CREATE TABLE AS "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.CreateTableAs, "CREATE TABLE AS ".Length);
					break;
				}
				goto default;
			case 'F':
				if (span.StartsWith((ReadOnlySpan<byte>)"FETCH "u8))
				{
					tuple = (StatementType.Fetch, "FETCH ".Length);
					break;
				}
				goto default;
			default:
				tuple = (StatementType.Other, 0);
				break;
			}
			(StatementType, int) tuple2 = tuple;
			StatementType = tuple2.Item1;
			int item = tuple2.Item2;
			_oid = 0u;
			_rows = 0uL;
			ReadOnlySpan<byte> source = span.Slice(item, span.Length - item - 1);
			StatementType statementType = StatementType;
			if (statementType != StatementType.Insert)
			{
				if (statementType == StatementType.Other || statementType == StatementType.Call)
				{
					goto IL_02c2;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!Utf8Parser.TryParse(source, out _oid, out int bytesConsumed, '\0'))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid bytes in command complete message.");
				}
				source = source.Slice(bytesConsumed + 1);
			}
			if (!Utf8Parser.TryParse(source, out _rows, out int _, '\0'))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid bytes in command complete message.");
			}
			goto IL_02c2;
			IL_02c2:
			return this;
		}
	}

			};
			NumColumns = buf.ReadInt16();
			for (int i = 0; i < NumColumns; i++)
			{
				ColumnFormatCodes.Add(DataFormatUtils.Create(buf.ReadInt16()));
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class ErrorOrNoticeMessage
	{
		internal enum ErrorFieldTypeCode : byte
		{
			Done = 0,
			Severity = 83,
			InvariantSeverity = 86,
			Code = 67,
			Message = 77,
			Detail = 68,
			Hint = 72,
			Position = 80,
			InternalPosition = 112,
			InternalQuery = 113,
			Where = 87,
			SchemaName = 115,
			TableName = 116,
			ColumnName = 99,
			DataTypeName = 100,
			ConstraintName = 110,
			File = 70,
			Line = 76,
			Routine = 82
		}

		internal string Severity { get; }

		internal string InvariantSeverity { get; }

		internal string SqlState { get; }

		internal string Message { get; }

		internal string? Detail { get; }

		internal string? Hint { get; }

		internal int Position { get; }

		internal int InternalPosition { get; }

		internal string? InternalQuery { get; }

		internal string? Where { get; }

		internal string? SchemaName { get; }

		internal string? TableName { get; }

		internal string? ColumnName { get; }

		internal string? DataTypeName { get; }

		internal string? ConstraintName { get; }

		internal string? File { get; }

		internal string? Line { get; }

		internal string? Routine { get; }

		internal static ErrorOrNoticeMessage Load(NpgsqlReadBuffer buf, bool includeDetail, ILogger exceptionLogger)
		{
			string text = null;
			string text2 = null;
			string text3 = null;
			string text4 = null;
			string text5 = null;
			string hint = null;
			int position = 0;
			int internalPosition = 0;
			string internalQuery = null;
			string text6 = null;
			string schemaName = null;
			string tableName = null;
			string columnName = null;
			string dataTypeName = null;
			string constraintName = null;
			string file = null;
			string line = null;
			string routine = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch ((ErrorFieldTypeCode)buf.ReadByte())
				{
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Severity:
					text = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.InvariantSeverity:
					text2 = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Code:
					text3 = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Message:
					text4 = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Detail:
					text5 = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					if (!includeDetail && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text5))
					{
						text5 = "Detail redacted as it may contain sensitive data. Specify 'Include Error Detail' in the connection string to include this information.";
					}
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Hint:
					hint = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Position:
				{
					string text8 = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					if (!int.TryParse(text8, out var result2))
					{
						exceptionLogger.LogWarning("Non-numeric position in ErrorResponse: " + text8);
					}
					else
					{
						position = result2;
					}
					break;
				}
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.InternalPosition:
				{
					string text7 = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					if (!int.TryParse(text7, out var result))
					{
						exceptionLogger.LogWarning("Non-numeric position in ErrorResponse: " + text7);
					}
					else
					{
						internalPosition = result;
					}
					break;
				}
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.InternalQuery:
					internalQuery = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Where:
					text6 = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.File:
					file = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Line:
					line = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Routine:
					routine = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.SchemaName:
					schemaName = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.TableName:
					tableName = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.ColumnName:
					columnName = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.DataTypeName:
					dataTypeName = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.ConstraintName:
					constraintName = buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				default:
					buf.ReadNullTerminatedStringRelaxed();
					break;
				case ErrorFieldTypeCode.Done:
					if (text == null)
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException("Severity not received in server error message");
					}
					if (text3 == null)
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException("Code not received in server error message");
					}
					if (text4 == null)
					{
						throw new NpgsqlException("Message not received in server error message");
					}
					return new ErrorOrNoticeMessage(text, text2 ?? text, text3, text4, text5, hint, position, internalPosition, internalQuery, text6, schemaName, tableName, columnName, dataTypeName, constraintName, file, line, routine);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ErrorOrNoticeMessage(string severity, string invariantSeverity, string sqlState, string message, string? detail = null, string? hint = null, int position = 0, int internalPosition = 0, string? internalQuery = null, string? where = null, string? schemaName = null, string? tableName = null, string? columnName = null, string? dataTypeName = null, string? constraintName = null, string? file = null, string? line = null, string? routine = null)
		{
			Severity = severity;
			InvariantSeverity = invariantSeverity;
			SqlState = sqlState;
			Message = message;
			Detail = detail;
			Hint = hint;
			Position = position;
			InternalPosition = internalPosition;
			InternalQuery = internalQuery;
			Where = where;
			SchemaName = schemaName;
			TableName = tableName;
			ColumnName = columnName;
			DataTypeName = dataTypeName;
			ConstraintName = constraintName;
			File = file;
			Line = line;
			Routine = routine;
		}
	}
