	internal sealed class RowDescriptionMessage : IBackendMessage
	{
		private static readonly StringComparer InvariantIgnoreCaseAndKanaWidthComparer = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.CompareInfo.GetStringComparer(CompareOptions.IgnoreCase | CompareOptions.IgnoreKanaType | CompareOptions.IgnoreWidth);

		private readonly bool _connectorOwned;

		private FieldDescription?[] _fields;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _nameIndex;

		private Dictionary<string, int>? _insensitiveIndex;

		private ColumnInfo[]? _lastConverterInfoCache;

		public FieldDescription this[int index]
		{
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
			get
			{
				return _fields[index];
			}
		}

		public int Count { get; private set; }

		public BackendMessageCode Code => BackendMessageCode.RowDescription;

		internal RowDescriptionMessage(bool connectorOwned, int numFields = 10)
		{
			_connectorOwned = connectorOwned;
			_fields = new FieldDescription[numFields];
			_nameIndex = new Dictionary<string, int>();
		}

		private RowDescriptionMessage(RowDescriptionMessage source)
		{
			Count = source.Count;
			_fields = new FieldDescription[Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				_fields[i] = source._fields[i].Clone();
			}
			_nameIndex = new Dictionary<string, int>(source._nameIndex);
			Dictionary<string, int>? insensitiveIndex = source._insensitiveIndex;
			if (insensitiveIndex != null && insensitiveIndex.Count > 0)
			{
				_insensitiveIndex = new Dictionary<string, int>(source._insensitiveIndex, InvariantIgnoreCaseAndKanaWidthComparer);
			}
		}

		internal RowDescriptionMessage Load(NpgsqlReadBuffer buf, PgSerializerOptions options)
		{
			_nameIndex.Clear();
			_insensitiveIndex?.Clear();
			int num = (Count = buf.ReadInt16());
			int num3 = num;
			if (_fields.Length < num3)
			{
				FieldDescription[] fields = _fields;
				_fields = new FieldDescription[num3];
				Array.Copy(fields, _fields, fields.Length);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
			{
				ref FieldDescription reference = ref _fields[i];
				FieldDescription fieldDescription = reference ?? (reference = new FieldDescription());
				fieldDescription.Populate(options, buf.ReadNullTerminatedString(), buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadInt16(), buf.ReadUInt32(), buf.ReadInt16(), buf.ReadInt32(), DataFormatUtils.Create(buf.ReadInt16()));
				DictonaryExtensions.TryAdd(_nameIndex, fieldDescription.Name, i);
			}
			return this;
		}

		internal static RowDescriptionMessage CreateForReplication(PgSerializerOptions options, uint tableOID, DataFormat dataFormat, IReadOnlyList<RelationMessage.Column> columns)
		{
			RowDescriptionMessage rowDescriptionMessage = new RowDescriptionMessage(connectorOwned: false, columns.Count);
			int num = (rowDescriptionMessage.Count = columns.Count);
			int num2 = num;
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				FieldDescription fieldDescription = (rowDescriptionMessage._fields[i] = new FieldDescription());
				RelationMessage.Column column = columns[i];
				fieldDescription.Populate(options, column.ColumnName, tableOID, checked((short)i), column.DataTypeId, 0, column.TypeModifier, dataFormat);
				if (!rowDescriptionMessage._nameIndex.ContainsKey(fieldDescription.Name))
				{
					rowDescriptionMessage._nameIndex.Add(fieldDescription.Name, i);
				}
			}
			return rowDescriptionMessage;
		}

		internal void SetColumnInfoCache(ReadOnlySpan<ColumnInfo> values)
		{
			if (!_connectorOwned && _lastConverterInfoCache == null)
			{
				Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _lastConverterInfoCache, values.ToArray(), null);
			}
		}

		internal void LoadColumnInfoCache(PgSerializerOptions options, ColumnInfo[] values)
		{
			ColumnInfo[] lastConverterInfoCache = _lastConverterInfoCache;
			if (lastConverterInfoCache != null)
			{
				if (Count > 0 && options != _fields[0]._serializerOptions)
				{
					Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _lastConverterInfoCache, null, lastConverterInfoCache);
				}
				else
				{
					lastConverterInfoCache.CopyTo(System.MemoryExtensions.AsSpan(values));
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetFieldIndex(string name)
		{
			if (!TryGetFieldIndex(name, out var fieldIndex))
			{
				ThrowHelper.ThrowIndexOutOfRangeException("Field not found in row: " + name);
			}
			return fieldIndex;
		}

		internal bool TryGetFieldIndex(string name, out int fieldIndex)
		{
			if (_nameIndex.TryGetValue(name, out fieldIndex))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_insensitiveIndex == null || _insensitiveIndex.Count == 0)
			{
				if (_insensitiveIndex == null)
				{
					_insensitiveIndex = new Dictionary<string, int>(InvariantIgnoreCaseAndKanaWidthComparer);
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, int> item in _nameIndex)
				{
					DictonaryExtensions.TryAdd(_insensitiveIndex, item.Key, item.Value);
				}
			}
			return _insensitiveIndex.TryGetValue(name, out fieldIndex);
		}

		internal RowDescriptionMessage Clone()
		{
			return new RowDescriptionMessage(this);
		}
	}
	public sealed class FieldDescription

		{

			}

		}

		internal void Populate(PgSerializerOptions serializerOptions, string name, uint tableOID, short columnAttributeNumber, uint oid, short typeSize, int typeModifier, DataFormat dataFormat)
		{

			TableOID = tableOID;
			ColumnAttributeNumber = columnAttributeNumber;
			TypeOID = oid;

			PostgresType = _serializerOptions.DatabaseInfo.FindPostgresType((Npgsql.Internal.Postgres.Oid)TypeOID)?.GetRepresentationalType() ?? UnknownBackendType.Instance;
			Field = new Field(Name, _serializerOptions.ToCanonicalTypeId(PostgresType), TypeModifier);
			_objectOrDefaultInfo = default(ColumnInfo);
		}

		internal FieldDescription Clone()
		{
			return new FieldDescription(this);
		}

		internal void GetInfo(Type? type, ref ColumnInfo lastColumnInfo)
		{
			if (!lastColumnInfo.ConverterInfo.IsDefault && lastColumnInfo.ConverterInfo.TypeToConvert == type)
			{
				return;
			}
			PgConverterInfo converterInfo = ((DataFormat == DataFormat.Text && (object)type != null) ? ObjectOrDefaultInfo : _objectOrDefaultInfo.ConverterInfo);
			if (!converterInfo.IsDefault)
			{
				if (typeof(object) == type)
				{
					lastColumnInfo = new ColumnInfo(converterInfo, DataFormat, asObject: true);
					return;
				}
				if (converterInfo.TypeToConvert == type)
				{
					lastColumnInfo = new ColumnInfo(converterInfo, DataFormat, converterInfo.IsBoxingConverter && converterInfo.Converter.TypeToConvert != type);
					return;
				}
			}
			GetInfoSlow(type, out lastColumnInfo);
			[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
			void GetInfoSlow(Type? type2, out ColumnInfo reference)
			{
				PgTypeInfo typeInfoForReading = AdoSerializerHelpers.GetTypeInfoForReading(type2 ?? typeof(object), PostgresType, _serializerOptions);
				PgConverterInfo converterInfo2;
				if (DataFormat == DataFormat.Binary)
				{
					converterInfo2 = typeInfoForReading.Bind(Field, DataFormat);
					reference = new ColumnInfo(converterInfo2, DataFormat.Binary, typeof(object) == type2 || converterInfo2.IsBoxingConverter);
				}
				else if (!typeInfoForReading.TryBind(Field, DataFormat, out converterInfo2))
				{
					typeInfoForReading = AdoSerializerHelpers.GetTypeInfoForReading(type2 ?? typeof(string), _serializerOptions.TextPgType, _serializerOptions);
					converterInfo2 = typeInfoForReading.Bind(Field, DataFormat);
					reference = new ColumnInfo(converterInfo2, DataFormat, type2 != converterInfo2.TypeToConvert || converterInfo2.IsBoxingConverter);
				}
				else
				{
					reference = new ColumnInfo(converterInfo2, DataFormat, typeof(object) == type2 || converterInfo2.IsBoxingConverter);
				}
				if (_objectOrDefaultInfo.ConverterInfo.IsDefault && (object)type2 != null)
				{
					_ = ObjectOrDefaultInfo;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{

		}

namespace System.Net
{
	internal sealed class UnixDomainSocketEndPoint : EndPoint
	{
		private string _filename;

		public string Filename
		{
			get
			{
				return _filename;
			}
			set
			{
				_filename = value;
			}
		}

		public override AddressFamily AddressFamily => AddressFamily.Unix;

		public UnixDomainSocketEndPoint(string filename)
		{
			if (filename == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("filename");
			}
			if (filename == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Cannot be empty.", "filename");
			}
			_filename = filename;
		}

		public override EndPoint Create(SocketAddress socketAddress)
		{
			if (socketAddress.Size == 2)
			{
				return new UnixDomainSocketEndPoint("a")
				{
					_filename = ""
				};
			}
			int num = socketAddress.Size - 2;
			byte[] array = new byte[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = socketAddress[i + 2];
				if (array[i] == 0)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			return new UnixDomainSocketEndPoint(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(array, 0, num));
		}

		public override SocketAddress Serialize()
		{
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_filename);
			SocketAddress socketAddress = new SocketAddress(AddressFamily, 2 + bytes.Length + 1);
			for (int i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++)
			{
				socketAddress[2 + i] = bytes[i];
			}
			socketAddress[2 + bytes.Length] = 0;
			return socketAddress;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _filename;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _filename.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object? o)
		{
			if (!(o is UnixDomainSocketEndPoint unixDomainSocketEndPoint))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return unixDomainSocketEndPoint._filename == _filename;
		}
	}

		public static async Task WaitAsync(this Task task, TimeSpan timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			List<Task> list = new List<Task>(3);
			Task cancellationTask = null;
			CancellationTokenRegistration registration = default(CancellationTokenRegistration);
			if (cancellationToken.CanBeCanceled)
			{
				TaskCompletionSource<bool> taskCompletionSource = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>();

				{
					((TaskCompletionSource<bool>)s).TrySetResult(result: true);
				}, taskCompletionSource);

				list.Add(cancellationTask);
			}
			Task delayTask = null;

			if (timeout != Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan)
			{
				delayCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
				delayTask = Task.Delay(timeout, delayCts.Token);
				list.Add(delayTask);
			}
			try
			{
				if (list.Count != 0)
				{
					list.Add(task);
					Task task2 = await Task.WhenAny(list).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					if (task2 == cancellationTask)
					{
						task = Task.FromCanceled(cancellationToken);
					}
					else if (task2 == delayTask)
					{
						task = Task.FromException(new TimeoutException());
					}
				}
				await task.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				delayCts?.Cancel();
				delayCts?.Dispose();
				registration.Dispose();
			}

			}
		}

		protected abstract DbConnection? DbConnection { get; set; }

		public DbTransaction? Transaction
		{
			get
			{
				return DbTransaction;
			}
			set
			{
				DbTransaction = value;
			}
		}

		protected abstract DbTransaction? DbTransaction { get; set; }

		public DbDataReader ExecuteReader(CommandBehavior behavior = CommandBehavior.Default)
		{
			return ExecuteDbDataReader(behavior);
		}

		protected abstract DbDataReader ExecuteDbDataReader(CommandBehavior behavior);

		public Task<DbDataReader> ExecuteReaderAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ExecuteDbDataReaderAsync(CommandBehavior.Default, cancellationToken);
		}

		public Task<DbDataReader> ExecuteReaderAsync(CommandBehavior behavior, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ExecuteDbDataReaderAsync(behavior, cancellationToken);
		}

		protected abstract Task<DbDataReader> ExecuteDbDataReaderAsync(CommandBehavior behavior, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

		public abstract int ExecuteNonQuery();

		public abstract Task<int> ExecuteNonQueryAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));

		public abstract object? ExecuteScalar();

		public abstract Task<object?> ExecuteScalarAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));

		public abstract void Prepare();

		public abstract Task PrepareAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));

		public abstract void Cancel();

		public DbBatchCommand CreateBatchCommand()
		{
			return CreateDbBatchCommand();
		}

		protected abstract DbBatchCommand CreateDbBatchCommand();

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
		}

		public virtual ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			Dispose();
			return default(ValueTask);
		}
	}
	public abstract class DbBatchCommand
	{
		public abstract string CommandText { get; set; }

		public abstract CommandType CommandType { get; set; }

		public abstract int RecordsAffected { get; }

		public DbParameterCollection Parameters => DbParameterCollection;

		protected abstract DbParameterCollection DbParameterCollection { get; }
	}
	public abstract class DbBatchCommandCollection : IList<DbBatchCommand>, ICollection<DbBatchCommand>, IEnumerable<DbBatchCommand>, IEnumerable
	{
		public abstract int Count { get; }

		public abstract bool IsReadOnly { get; }

		public DbBatchCommand this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return GetBatchCommand(index);
			}
			set
			{
				SetBatchCommand(index, value);
			}
		}

		public abstract IEnumerator<DbBatchCommand> GetEnumerator();

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public abstract void Add(DbBatchCommand item);

		public abstract void Clear();

		public abstract bool Contains(DbBatchCommand item);

		public abstract void CopyTo(DbBatchCommand[] array, int arrayIndex);

		public abstract bool Remove(DbBatchCommand item);

		public abstract int IndexOf(DbBatchCommand item);

		public abstract void Insert(int index, DbBatchCommand item);

		public abstract void RemoveAt(int index);

		protected abstract DbBatchCommand GetBatchCommand(int index);

		protected abstract void SetBatchCommand(int index, DbBatchCommand batchCommand);
	}
	public abstract class DbDataSource : IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable
	{
		public abstract string ConnectionString { get; }

		protected abstract DbConnection CreateDbConnection();

		protected virtual DbConnection OpenDbConnection()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected virtual ValueTask<DbConnection> OpenDbConnectionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected virtual DbCommand CreateDbCommand(string? commandText = null)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected virtual DbBatch CreateDbBatch()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public DbConnection CreateConnection()
		{
			return CreateDbConnection();
		}

		public DbConnection OpenConnection()
		{
			return OpenDbConnection();
		}

		public ValueTask<DbConnection> OpenConnectionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return OpenDbConnectionAsync(cancellationToken);
		}

		public DbCommand CreateCommand(string? commandText = null)
		{
			return CreateDbCommand(commandText);
		}

		public DbBatch CreateBatch()
		{
			return CreateDbBatch();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
		{
			await DisposeAsyncCore().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			Dispose(disposing: false);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
		}

		protected virtual ValueTask DisposeAsyncCore()
		{
			return default(ValueTask);
		}
	}
